title: Doubly isolated Batyrev mirror pairs and non-smoothable Calabi-Yau threefolds
summary: We classify reflexive four-polytopes for which the generic anticanonical hypersurfaces associated with the face fans of the polytope and its polar both have at most isolated singularities. There are exactly 590 such polytopes up to lattice equivalence in the Kreuzer-Skarke classification. Their two-dimensional faces belong to twelve lattice-isomorphism classes, all triangles, zonotopes, or reflexive polygons. The only nonsmoothable local models are the cyclic quotients $\frac13(1,1,1)$ and $\frac15(1,1,3)$ and the anticanonical cone over the first Hirzebruch surface; no singularity has a positive-dimensional reduced deformation space without a smoothing component. Within this classification, the Hirzebruch cone occurs in a unique mirror pair, associated with polytopes having 22 and 26 vertices. We exhibit this pair explicitly: one hypersurface is nonsmoothable, while all singularities of its mirror are locally smoothable. The crepant resolutions have Hodge numbers $(20,26)$ and $(26,20)$. At the opposite extreme, the self-dual 24-cell is the unique member of the classification for which both hypersurfaces are smooth before crepant resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文对Kreuzer-Skarke分类中面扇的泛反规范超曲面（及其极）至多具有孤立奇点的反身四维多胞体进行分类，共得到590个格等价类，并研究其局部奇点模型、镜像对及crepant解消的Hodge数。
AI.motivation: 反身多胞体对应的反规范超曲面是构造Calabi-Yau流形的核心工具，但其奇点结构（尤其是否可光滑化、形变空间性质）在四维情形尚缺乏系统分类，本文旨在填补这一空白并厘清镜像对称下的奇点对应。
AI.method: 以Kreuzer-Skarke反身四维多胞体分类为基础，筛选出多胞体及其极多胞体的面扇所对应泛反规范超曲面均至多具孤立奇点的对象，按格等价分类；分析二维面的格同构类、局部奇点模型、形变空间的光滑化分支，并显式构造镜像对。
AI.result: 共得到590个格等价类；二维面归为12个格同构类（三角形、zonotope或反身多边形）；不可光滑化的局部模型仅有1/3(1,1,1)、1/5(1,1,3)与第一Hirzebruch面上反规范锥；无奇点具有正维既约形变空间且无光滑化分支。Hirzebruch锥出现在唯一镜像对中，对应22与26顶点的多胞体；其中一个超曲面不可光滑化，其镜像的所有奇点局部可光滑化，crepant解消的Hodge数为(20,26)与(26,20)。自对偶24-cell是唯一在crepant解消前两超曲面均已光滑的成员。
AI.conclusion: 该分类从奇点可光滑性角度刻画了反身四维多胞体的结构，明确了局部不可光滑化模型的有限清单，并通过显式镜像对与Hodge数展示了镜像对称在奇点层面上的非平凡对应，同时以24-cell标记了光滑性的极端情形。

title: Flasque resolutions of linear reductive group schemes
summary: This paper studies flasque resolutions for linear reductive group schemes over arbitrary bases, extending Colliot-Thelene's theory. A flasque resolution exists for any linear reductive group scheme over a connected base scheme (resp. a quasi-compact, quasi-separated base scheme). The construction relies on Borovoi's fundamental group and descent theory involving automorphisms of Chevalley groups. Applications include R-equivalence for reductive group schemes over rings and over a field of cohomological dimension at most 2.

AI.tldr: 本文将Colliot-Thélène的flasque预解理论推广到任意基上的线性约化群概形，证明了在连通（或拟紧拟分离）基概形上flasque预解的存在性，并给出R-等价的应用。
AI.motivation: Colliot-Thélène的flasque预解理论原先是针对特定（如域上）的线性约化群建立的。本文的动机在于将其推广到任意基概形上的线性约化群概形，以处理更一般的算术与代数几何情形（如环上及低上同调维数域上的约化群概形），从而扩展R-等价等问题的适用范围。
AI.method: 方法上结合Borovoi基本群与下降理论：通过涉及Chevalley群自同构的下降构造flasque预解。利用Borovoi基本群作为关键工具，将构造从域的情形推广到任意基概形，并处理下降过程中Chevalley群自同构带来的障碍。
AI.result: 证明了：对任意连通基概形（相应地对拟紧、拟分离基概形）上的线性约化群概形，flasque预解均存在。基于该构造得到若干应用，包括环上约化群概形以及上同调维数至多为2的域上的约化群概形的R-等价结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将flasque预解理论从Colliot-Thélène的原始框架推广到任意基上的线性约化群概形，建立了存在性定理并给出R-等价方面的应用，表明该理论在更一般的基概形与算术背景下具有广泛适用性。

title: Stability of the Cotangent Bundle on Surfaces with Ample Canonical Class
summary: In this article, we study the Bridgeland stability of the cotangent bundle on K3 surfaces and surfaces with ample canonical class. On a surface $X$ with ample canonical class $K$, we find values $t_0>0$ such that the cotangent bundle is semistable with respect to the Bridgeland stability $σ_{tK}$ for all $t > t_0$. We also study special cases such as the fake projective planes and the fake quadrics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究K3曲面及具有丰富典范类的曲面上余切丛的Bridgeland稳定性，证明当t充分大时余切丛关于σ_{tK}半稳定，并考察伪射影平面与伪四元曲面等特例。
AI.motivation: 余切丛的稳定性是代数几何与数学物理中的核心问题，而Bridgeland稳定性为研究丛的稳定性提供了更一般的框架，本文旨在将这一框架应用于K3曲面及具有丰富典范类的曲面，并刻画其上的余切丛。
AI.method: 对具有丰富典范类K的曲面X，构造以tK为参数的Bridgeland稳定性条件σ_{tK}，并分析余切丛Ω_X在该稳定性下的（半）稳定性，寻找临界值t_0>0。同时对K3曲面、伪射影平面、伪四元曲面等特例进行具体讨论。
AI.result: 在具有丰富典范类K的曲面X上，存在t_0>0，使得对任意t>t_0，余切丛关于Bridgeland稳定性σ_{tK}是半稳定的；并对K3曲面、伪射影平面和伪四元曲面等特例给出了相应的稳定性结论。
AI.conclusion: 余切丛在Bridgeland稳定性框架下于充分大的t处呈现半稳定性，表明Bridgeland稳定性可有效刻画K3曲面及丰富典范类曲面上余切丛的稳定性行为，特例研究进一步验证与细化了该结论。

title: From wall structures to closed mirror symmetry. The case of $K_{\mathbb{P}^2}$: Renormalized periods over the positive real locus, closed Gromov-Witten invariants from wall functions, and tropical enumeration
summary: We recover closed Gromov-Witten invariants and renormalized mirror periods for $K_{\mathbb{P}^2}$ by the same operation on a wall function. This gives a direct passage from the Gross-Siebert construction of intrinsic mirror pairs to classical enumerative mirror symmetry. The link is a polynomiality theorem for punctured invariants. Assuming the expected identification with the normalized slab function, we also obtain a finite tree sum for closed Gromov-Witten invariants in terms of types of plane tropical curves. The mechanism is expected to extend to more general Calabi-Yau mirror pairs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"墙函数"上的同一操作，恢复了 $K_{\mathbb{P}^2}$ 的闭 Gromov-Witten 不变量与重整化镜像周期，建立了从 Gross-Siebert 内蕴镜像对构造到经典枚举镜像对称的直接通道。核心纽带是关于带孔（punctured）不变量的多项式性定理。
AI.motivation: Gross-Siebert 的内蕴镜像构造与经典枚举镜像对称在方法上相对独立，缺乏直接的过渡机制。作者希望填补这一鸿沟，通过统一的代数操作在两种框架之间建立明确联系，并推广到一般 Calabi-Yau 镜像对。
AI.method: 在 $K_{\mathbb{P}^2}$ 上对墙函数施加与恢复目标量相同的操作。关键工具是带孔不变量的多项式性定理（polynomiality theorem），用于连接 Gross-Siebert 构造；在假设与归一化 slab 函数一致的预期下，进一步导出闭 Gromov-Witten 不变量的有限树求和表达。
AI.result: 恢复了 $K_{\mathbb{P}^2}$ 的闭 Gromov-Witten 不变量与重整化镜像周期；在预期识别成立时，得到闭 Gromov-Witten 不变量按平面热带曲线类型的有限树求和公式。
AI.conclusion: 该机制建立了内蕴镜像构造与经典枚举镜像对称的直接通道，具有推广到更一般 Calabi-Yau 镜像对的潜力，但部分结果依赖于归一化 slab 函数识别的假设。

title: A Two-level Filtered Subspace Iterative Method for Generalized Hermitian Interior Eigenvalue Problems
summary: We propose a two-level filtered subspace iterative (TLFSI) method for computing all eigenpairs whose eigenvalues in the interval of interest $[a,b]$ after finite element discretization of self-adjoint PDE eigenvalue problems. The method combines a two-level approach with a modern filtered subspace iteration framework. In this paper, we use contour integral filtering as an example. The two-level method constructs a coarse space according to the spectral location of the eigenvalues of interest and obtains from it an approximation to the target invariant subspace. We prove that the distance between the approximate and target subspaces depends only on the separation between the spectral region of interest and the remainder of the spectrum, together with the coarse mesh size \(H\). Numerical experiments on benchmark elasticity problems confirm the theoretical predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出两级过滤子空间迭代法（TLFSI），用于自伴PDE特征值问题有限元离散后计算区间[a,b]内的全部特征对。
AI.motivation: 在自伴PDE特征值问题的有限元离散中，高效、可靠地计算感兴趣区间内的全部特征对具有重要需求。
AI.method: 将两级方法与现代过滤子空间迭代框架结合，采用围道积分过滤作为示例；依据感兴趣特征值的谱位置构造粗空间，并由此获得目标不变子空间的近似。
AI.result: 证明了近似子空间与目标子空间之间的距离仅依赖于感兴趣谱区与其余谱的分离度以及粗网格尺寸H；基准弹性问题的数值实验验证了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: TLFSI方法为目标区间内全部特征对的计算提供了具有理论保证的两级过滤子空间迭代框架。

title: Spectral properties of the Riemann zeta function and their physical applications
summary: This work studies the Riemann $ζ$ numerically with emphasis on its physical manifestations. Three areas are examined: (i) the spectral statistics of the non-trivial zeros, which we compare with the Gaussian Unitary Ensemble predictions, obtaining $χ^2/\text{dof} = 1.2$; (ii) the role of $ζ(\frac{3}{2})$ in determining the critical temperature for Bose-Einstein condensation, where we find $T_c = 0.13$ K for an ideal gas; and (iii) the application of $ζ$-function regularisation to the Casimir effect, yielding the standard Casimir energy density $-\frac{π^2 \hbar c}{720 a^3}$, which for $a=1\,\mathrm{nm}$ gives $\sim -4.33\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{J\,m^{-2}}$. The numerical results are consistent with the Montgomery-Odlyzko conjecture and with spectral approaches motivated by the Hilbert-Pólya conjecture, within the statistical limitations of the analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文数值研究Riemann ζ函数及其物理表现，涵盖非平凡零点谱统计、ζ(3/2)与BEC临界温度以及ζ正则化Casimir效应三个方面。
AI.motivation: 探索Riemann ζ函数的物理内涵，检验Montgomery-Odlyzko猜想与Hilbert-Pólya猜想启发的谱方法，并展示ζ函数在统计物理与量子场论中的具体应用。
AI.method: 数值计算非平凡零点的谱统计并与GUE预测比较；利用ζ(3/2)确定理想气体BEC临界温度；将ζ函数正则化用于Casimir效应计算。
AI.result: 零点谱统计与GUE吻合，χ²/dof=1.2；理想气体BEC临界温度Tc=0.13 K；得到标准Casimir能量密度−π²ħc/(720a³)，a=1 nm时约−4.33×10⁻⁴ J·m⁻²。
AI.conclusion: 数值结果在统计误差范围内与Montgomery-Odlyzko猜想及Hilbert-Pólya猜想启发的谱方法一致，表明ζ函数与物理系统之间存在深刻联系。

title: Unveiling the stress field in a flowing complex fluid with velocity and microstructure imaging
summary: The stress in a flowing complex fluid such as a solution of polymers, surfactants and/or colloidal particles is a fundamental dynamic property of the material. It reflects the evolution of the fluid microstructure under deformation and determines the motion of the fluid. While spatially resolved measurements of flow (via velocimetry) and microstructure (e.g.~via scattering) can be made, neither of these individually can uniquely determine the stress. In particular, due to the degenerate nature of the relationship between the stress tensor and the net force exerted by the microstructure on the fluid, the stress tensor is hidden from direct observation. We show that integrating velocity and microstructure measurements with principles of continuum mechanics can break this degeneracy, unveiling the stress tensor. The approach has two stages. In the first, velocity information is used along with the momentum and mass conservation equations to infer the force density exerted by the microstructure on the fluid using a data assimilation framework. In the second, the equation relating force density to stress is solved. This equation has a nontrivial nullspace, introducing a homogeneous solution whose structure must be found to uniquely determine the stress. We do so by using microstructural data and a general model between microstructure and stress, the parameters of which are determined, along with the nullspace solution, by solving a least-squares problem. The approach is illustrated using synthetic velocity and microstructural data from simulation of a flowing polymer solution, demonstrating its validity and robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将速度测量与微结构测量同连续介质力学原理相结合的两阶段方法，可打破应力张量与微观结构净力之间关系的简并性，从而唯一确定复杂流体的应力张量。
AI.motivation: 复杂流体（聚合物、表面活性剂、胶体溶液等）的应力是反映其微结构在变形下演化并决定流体运动的基本动态属性。然而，速度测量（测速）与微结构测量（如散射）各自单独均无法唯一确定应力；由于应力张量与微结构对流体施加的净力之间关系具有简并性，应力张量无法被直接观测。
AI.method: 方法分两阶段：第一阶段利用速度信息结合动量守恒与质量守恒方程，通过数据同化（data assimilation）框架推断微结构对流体施加的力密度；第二阶段求解力密度与应力之间的关系方程，该方程存在非平凡零空间（nullspace），须确定其齐次解结构。为此引入微结构数据以及微结构与应力之间的通用模型，通过求解最小二乘问题同时确定模型参数与零空间解。
AI.result: 使用流动聚合物溶液模拟得到的合成速度与微结构数据对该方法进行了验证，结果表明方法有效且具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将速度与微结构测量同连续介质力学原理相结合，可打破应力张量观测的简并性并揭示应力张量；该方法在合成数据上得到验证，为复杂流体应力的非侵入式测定提供了可行途径。

title: Uniform meandric systems as percolation on planar maps: conjectures and a numerical study
summary: We perform a numerical study of uniform meandric systems via their encoding by pairs of simple random walks and their interpretation as a model of critical percolation on random planar maps. We investigate certain natural box-crossing events and provide numerical evidence for a strong negative association between opposite open crossings and formulate conjectures on their asymptotic behavior. Our second contribution is a simple law-preserving dynamics on meandric systems, by local peak/valley flips in the walk encoding. Our simulations suggest that the percolation structure decorrelates much faster than the underlying random planar map.

AI.tldr: 本文通过简单随机游走对与随机平面图临界渗流的编码，数值研究均匀meandric系统，给出相对开交叉负相关的数值证据与渐近猜想，并提出保律的峰谷翻转动力学，发现渗流结构比底层随机平面图更快去相关。
AI.motivation: 均匀meandric系统具有组合与概率上的重要性，且可等价描述为随机平面图上的临界渗流；但其交叉事件的关联性质与动力学（去相关）行为缺乏定量理解，作者希望借助数值模拟填补这一空白。
AI.method: 将均匀meandric系统编码为成对简单随机游走，并解释为随机平面图上的临界渗流模型；模拟若干自然的box-crossing（箱形交叉）事件；设计一种在游走编码下进行局部峰/谷翻转的保律（law-preserving）动力学。
AI.result: 数值证据表明相反方向的开交叉之间存在强负相关，并据此对其渐近行为提出猜想；模拟显示渗流结构的去相关速度远快于底层随机平面图。
AI.conclusion: meandric系统的临界渗流具有显著负关联的交叉事件，且其提出的峰谷翻转动力学是保律的，可用于刻画该系统；渗流与底层平面图存在明显的时间尺度分离。

title: Aleksandrov-Bakelman-Pucci maximum principle for $L^n$-viscosity solutions of uniformly elliptic equations with unbounded terms: The critical case
summary: We prove the Aleksandrov-Bakelman-Pucci maximum principle for $L^n$-viscosity sub/super-solutions of fully nonlinear uniformly elliptic equations in $Ω\subset\mathbb R^n$ with the drift coefficient $γ$ such that $γ(\ln(1+γ))^{\frac{n-1}{n}}\in L^n(Ω)$. The approach is based on convex duality and Trudinger-Moser type inequalities.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了一类带漂移项的完全非线性一致椭圆方程 $L^n$-粘性下/上解的 Aleksandrov-Bakelman-Pucci 极大值原理，漂移系数满足 $\\gamma(\\ln(1+\\gamma))^{\\frac{n-1}{n}}\\in L^n(\\Omega)$，方法基于凸对偶与 Trudinger-Moser 型不等式。
AI.motivation: 经典 ABP 极大值原理通常要求漂移系数属于 $L^n$，而本文旨在放松对漂移项的可积性要求，在更弱的对数型可积条件下建立极大值原理，扩展其适用范围。
AI.method: 采用凸对偶（convex duality）技术处理完全非线性一致椭圆算子，并结合 Trudinger-Moser 型不等式来估计漂移项对解的影响；研究对象为 $L^n$-粘性下解与上解。
AI.result: 在漂移系数满足 $\\gamma(\\ln(1+\\gamma))^{\\frac{n-1}{n}}\\in L^n(\\Omega)$ 的条件下，成功证明了该方程 $L^n$-粘性下/上解的 ABP 极大值原理成立。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将 ABP 极大值原理的漂移系数可积性假设推广到一类对数加权 $L^n$ 空间，显示了凸对偶与 Trudinger-Moser 不等式结合是处理此类弱可积漂移问题的有效工具。

title: Bayes-Sufficient Compression Is Not Enough: How Does Communication Help Multi-Agent Systems?
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems pair a sender with broad context and an executor with a limited local view. We study when a short message improves the executor's next decision, when raw context is preferable, and when a stronger sender helps. Our framework, \emph{receiver-relative bounded coordination}, expresses message utility as receiver gain minus protocol tax. Compression beats raw context when tax savings exceed losses from omitted information and decoder mismatch. Even \emph{Bayes-sufficient} compression can fail when a bounded executor cannot use its surface form. A three-stage decomposition separates externalization, absorption, and \emph{action closure}, explaining how errors remain after the correct content reaches the receiver. Under a single-crossing condition, sender upgrades help above a receiver-burden threshold. Across six benchmarks, the same Qwen protocol raises ContextBench joint accuracy from $0.633$ to $0.775$ but lowers ToolSandbox from $0.889$ to $0.653$. Fixed-message replay reveals closure failures despite correct artifact recovery. These results guide an inference-time selector that improves the accuracy-cost frontier on the evaluated communication regimes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"接收者相对有界协调"框架，将消息效用建模为接收者收益减协议开销，分析短消息、原始上下文与更强发送者的适用条件，并在六个基准上验证。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统中，发送者拥有广阔上下文，执行者仅具局部视野。需要明确何时短消息优于原始上下文，何时需要更强的发送者，并解释为何正确内容到达接收者后错误仍然存在。
AI.method: 提出接收者相对有界协调框架，用"接收者增益减去协议开销"表达消息效用；采用三阶段分解（外化、吸收、动作闭合）剖析误差来源；在单一交叉条件下分析发送者升级；在六个基准上测试，并使用固定消息回放。
AI.result: 同一Qwen协议将ContextBench联合准确率从0.633提升至0.775，却使ToolSandbox从0.889降为0.653。即使满足贝叶斯充分性的压缩，也可能因有界执行者无法利用其表层形式而失败。固定消息回放揭示在正确工件恢复情况下仍存在动作闭合失败。
AI.conclusion: 当协议开销的节省超过信息遗漏与解码器不匹配的损失时，压缩优于原始上下文；发送者升级需超过接收者负担阈值。基于上述结论设计推理时选择器，可在所评估的通信机制中改善准确率-成本前沿。

title: On the Tightness and Computational Tractability of Higher-Dimensional Confidence Sequences
summary: Modern sequential monitoring problems often involve multiple metrics, where we monitor several data streams simultaneously and may act once the evidence is strong enough. Confidence sequences (CSs) are a natural tool for such continuous monitoring. However, for bounded vector means, existing multivariate CSs are either tight but computationally intractable, or fast to compute but conservative. To address this, we study three lifts of one-dimensional betting-based CSs to higher dimensions: a weighted Bonferroni region, an equivalent max-wealth form, and a portfolio region. The portfolio is typically much tighter, especially in higher dimensions, but its boundary and properties such as volume are not available in closed form. To make this tighter construction usable, we propose tractable outer approximations of the portfolio region that preserve statistical validity: a bounding box, an $\ell_p$-ellipsoid, and their intersection. We prove set relations among all constructions and show empirically that these approximations (i) achieve regions close to the intractable portfolio, (ii) substantially outperform existing tractable multivariate CSs, and (iii) enable practical use cases such as multi-metric A/B testing and model comparison.

AI.tldr: 针对有界向量均值的同时监测问题，本文研究了基于投注的一维置信序列（CS）向高维的三种提升（加权Bonferroni区域、等价的max-wealth形式、portfolio区域），提出保持统计有效性的可处理外近似，并给出集合关系证明与实证验证。
AI.motivation: 现代序贯监测常需同时监控多个数据流，一旦证据足够即可采取行动，而置信序列是连续监测的自然工具。但现有的有界向量均值多元CS存在两难：要么紧致但计算不可处理，要么计算快速但过于保守。
AI.method: 研究三种一维投注型CS的高维提升：加权Bonferroni区域、等价的max-wealth形式以及portfolio区域；针对portfolio边界与体积无闭式表达的问题，提出可处理的外近似（bounding box、ℓ_p-ellipsoid及二者交集），并证明各构造之间的集合关系。
AI.result: 实证表明：所提近似（i）能得到接近不可处理portfolio的区域，（ii）显著优于现有可处理多元CS，（iii）支持多指标A/B测试与模型比较等实际用例。
AI.conclusion: 通过可处理的外近似，本文在保持统计有效性的同时使更紧致的portfolio型多元置信序列变得实用，为连续多指标监测提供了兼具紧致性与计算可行性的方案。

title: Collective Sensing as Emergent Bayesian Inference
comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 7th International Workshop on Active Inference (IWAI 2026, Madrid). Author's accepted manuscript. 26 pages, 12 figures, 1 table; includes appendices
summary: Collective behavior in animal groups is routinely described in cognitive language: fish schools sense gradients, swarms compute, colonies decide. These formulations often leave open what the collective is inferring, what computational object is represented, or how that representation arises from microscopic interactions. Here we develop that description quantitatively in a simulation based on the canonical model of collective sensing in fish schools (Berdahl et al., 2013), in which collective gradient sensing emerges from individuals that do not estimate gradients themselves: agents only modulate their speed in response to local light intensity and respond to simple social forces from neighbors. We show that these local rules admit a mesoscopic Bayesian reinterpretation at the level of the school, and hypothesize that the collective dynamics realize approximate inference on a generative model of how darkness gradients drive inter-individual speed differences. The resulting school-level inference process yields a posterior distribution over the local darkness gradient, whose statistics vary with environmental structure and relate systematically to collective motion and sensing performance. The school can therefore be described, in a Bayesian-mechanical sense, as a distributed inferential system without requiring individual agents to perform probabilistic belief updates themselves. This yields a quantitative, falsifiable account of collective sensing as emergent inference, and a concrete bridge from collective behavior to Bayesian mechanics.

AI.tldr: 本文基于鱼类群体集体感知的经典模型（Berdahl等，2013），通过模拟定量论证：仅调节速度并对社会力响应的个体，其局部规则可在群体层面被重新解释为贝叶斯推断，群体动态近似实现对"黑暗梯度如何驱动个体速度差"这一生成模型的推断，从而将集体感知刻画为分布式推断系统。
AI.motivation: 集体行为常用"感知""计算""决策"等认知语言描述，但这些表述往往含糊：集体究竟在推断什么、所表征的计算对象是什么、该表征如何从微观交互中涌现，均未明确。作者希望将这种描述定量化，并在集体行为与贝叶斯力学之间建立具体桥梁。
AI.method: 采用基于鱼类群体集体感知经典模型（Berdahl等，2013）的仿真。个体不自身估计梯度，仅根据局部光照强度调节速度，并对邻居的简单社会力作出响应。作者在群体（介观）层面给出贝叶斯式重新解释，假设集体动态实现对生成模型的近似推断——该生成模型描述黑暗梯度如何驱动个体间速度差。
AI.result: 群体层面的推断过程产生关于局部黑暗梯度的后验分布；其后验统计量随环境结构变化，并与集体运动和感知性能系统相关。群体因此可被描述为分布式推断系统。
AI.conclusion: 集体感知可被理解为"涌现推断"（emergent inference），无需个体智能体执行概率信念更新。这提供了对集体感知定量的、可证伪的解释，并构成从集体行为通往贝叶斯力学的具体桥梁。

title: Concave Roofs and Downward Recovery for DR-Submodular Polynomial Maximization
summary:
We give approximation algorithms for $\max\{F(x):x\in\K\}$, where $\K$ is a nonempty compact down-closed convex subset of the unit cube and $F$ is a nonnegative diminishing-returns (DR) submodular polynomial: every entry of its Hessian is nonpositive on the cube.
  Starting from quadratic or cubic coefficients, we decompose the objective exactly into nonnegative rooted atoms and affine terms. Concave upper bounds for these components give a tractable roof. We then decrease the coordinates of a roof optimizer using maps that work for all components at once, recovering a fraction of the roof value while preserving feasibility. For quadratics, we also retain the concave diagonal residual exactly.
  Under the stated assumptions on optimization access, these constructions give deterministic polynomial-time factors of $1/2$ for quadratics and $8/17$ for cubics, up to any prescribed additive error. The cubic result includes positive cubic coefficients and repeated variables. The factor $8/17$ also holds for two larger classes: supplied compatible rooted certificates of literal degree at most twelve, and sums of nonnegative submodular local functions of arity at most four. At arbitrary finite literal degree, a common scalar map attains the optimal single-map factor $2\sqrt3-3$. Global monotonicity and concave-cardinality structure give stronger guarantees for multilinear local-function sums, with no recovery beyond the identity map. Standard matroid rounding transfers the multilinear guarantees without loss. We also prove online preservation for directed-hypergraph cuts and, separately, a Unique-Games inapproximability bound of approximately $0.82843$ for explicit quadratic input under a cardinality upper bound.

AI.tldr: 该文针对单位立方体上非空紧致下闭凸集K上的非负递减回报(DR)子模多项式最大化问题，给出近似算法：二次型多项式确定性多项式时间因子1/2，三次型（含正三次系数与重复变量）因子8/17；对更大类别（相容有根证书或arity≤4的非负子模局部函数之和）8/17亦成立；任意有限字面次数下单一映射最优因子为2√3−3，并给出多线性保证、拟阵舍入转移及在线保持与近似困难性结果。
AI.motivation: 论文研究在非空紧致下闭凸集（为单位立方体子集）上最大化非负递减回报(DR)子模多项式的问题。该问题刻画了具有非正Hessian的连续子模结构，属于连续子模最大化与近似算法交叉领域，动机在于为二次、三次乃至更高次的多项式型目标提供有理论保证的确定性多项式时间近似算法，并刻画其可近似性边界。
AI.method: 方法论上，从二次或三次系数出发，将目标函数精确分解为非负有根原子与仿射项；对这些分量使用凹上界构造可处理的"屋顶"(roof)；随后通过可同时作用于所有分量的映射来缩减屋顶最优解的坐标，在保持可行性的同时回收屋顶值的一定比例。对二次型还精确保留了凹对角残差。针对任意有限字面次数，采用公共标量映射；对多线性局部函数之和，利用全局单调性与凹基数结构给出更强保证，并借助拟阵舍入无损转移多线性保证。
AI.result: 在给定优化访问假设下，得到确定性多项式时间近似因子：二次型为1/2，三次型为8/17（可含任意规定加性误差）。三次结果包含正三次系数和重复变量。因子8/17还适用于两类更大问题：字面次数至多十二的相容有根证书，以及arity至多四的非负子模局部函数之和。在任意有限字面次数下，一个公共标量映射达到单一映射的最优因子2√3−3。全局单调性与凹基数结构对多线性局部函数之和给出更强保证，且无需超过恒等映射的回收；标准拟阵舍入可无损转移这些多线性保证。此外，证明了有向超图割的在线保持性，以及基数上界下显式二次型输入的Unique-Games近似困难性约为0.82843。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了下闭凸集上非负DR子模多项式最大化的近似算法框架，通过原子分解、凹屋顶与坐标缩减映射，给出二次型1/2、三次型8/17的确定性多项式时间因子，并将结果推广到更高字面次数的相容证书与低arity局部函数之和，确定了单一映射的最优因子2√3−3。研究同时表明多线性结构可带来更强保证、拟阵舍入可无损转移，并揭示了基数约束下显式二次型输入所固有的近似困难性（约0.82843）。

title: The topology of Kähler manifolds and 1-forms without zeros
summary: We study how the topology and geometry of a compact Kähler manifold relate to the zeros of its one-forms. We determine all implications among several closely related conditions. In particular, we construct a smooth projective variety for which the Aomoto complex is exact for every nonzero holomorphic one-form and every semisimple local system, although every closed real one-form, and hence every holomorphic one-form, has a zero.

AI.tldr: 本文研究紧Kähler流形的拓扑与几何如何与其一形式的零点相关联，确定了若干相近条件之间的全部蕴含关系，并构造了一个光滑射影簇：其Aomoto复形对每个非零全纯一形式和每个半单局部系都正合，但每个闭实一形式（从而每个全纯一形式）都有零点。
AI.motivation: 经典结果（如Aomoto复形的正合性与一形式无零点之间的关系）在紧Kähler流形背景下存在若干相近但互不等价的条件。作者希望厘清这些条件之间的逻辑关系，并检验“一形式无零点”是否为实现Aomoto复形正合所必需。
AI.method: 利用紧Kähler流形的拓扑与几何性质，系统分析“Aomoto复形正合性”“全纯一形式无零点”“闭实一形式无零点”等条件之间的蕴含关系；并通过构造具体的光滑射影簇作为反例来说明条件之间的非等价性。
AI.result: 确定了相关条件之间的全部蕴含关系，并构造出光滑射影簇使Aomoto复形对任意非零全纯一形式及任意半单局部系均正合，然而该簇上每个闭实一形式（含所有全纯一形式）都必然有零点。
AI.conclusion: Aomoto复形的正合性与一形式无零点并非等价条件：即使每个一形式都必有零点，Aomoto复形仍可对所有非零全纯一形式和半单局部系保持正合，说明二者之间的蕴含是单向的。

title: On the involution preserving properties of semi-discrete Active Flux methods on simplex
summary:
We study the involution-preserving properties of the Active Flux method on unstructured triangular meshes. Two model problems are considered: the two-dimensional linear acoustic system, which satisfies a curl involution on the velocity field, and the two-dimensional Maxwell equations with an in-plane magnetic field, which satisfy a divergence involution. Both systems can be written in conservative form. The question we address is how a single discretization can satisfy the conservative form and the involution at the same time. Within a discrete Active Flux framework on simplices, we derive explicit formulas for a discrete curl operator that is exactly preserved by the scheme for acoustics, and for a discrete divergence operator preserved for the Maxwell system. The analysis applies to general simplex meshes and to any polynomial degree, including extensions of the method beyond third order. Numerical experiments with the third-order scheme confirm the theoretical results.
  Highlights: 1-Active Flux on unstructured triangular meshes preserves discrete involutions, 2-Explicit discrete curl operator preserved by the scheme for linear acoustics, 3- Explicit discrete divergence operator preserved for 2D Maxwell equations, 4- Results hold on general simplex meshes,% and for any polynomial degree 5- Third-order numerical experiments confirm the theoretical results. \end{itemize}

AI.tldr: 本文研究非结构三角形网格上Active Flux方法的对合保持性质，针对二维线性声学系统（速度场旋度对合）和二维Maxwell方程（散度对合），推导了被格式精确保持的离散旋度与散度算子的显式公式。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探讨单一离散格式能否同时满足守恒形式与对合（involution）约束，这对结构保持型数值方法具有重要意义。
AI.method: 在单纯形上的离散Active Flux框架中，针对可写成守恒形式的两类系统，推导显式离散旋度算子（声学）与显式离散散度算子（Maxwell）。分析适用于一般单纯形网格及任意多项式阶数，包括三阶以上扩展。
AI.result: 得到了被格式精确保持的显式离散旋度与散度算子公式，适用于一般单纯形网格和任意多项式阶数；三阶数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: Active Flux方法在非结构三角形网格上能够保持离散对合，为守恒与对合同时满足的离散格式设计提供了理论依据。

title: HFS-TransNet: A Hybrid Fixed-Stress Transferable Neural Network for Quasi-Static Biot Poroelasticity
summary: The quasi-static Biot system, which governs coupled fluid-solid interactions in poroelastic media, poses significant computational challenges due to its strong coupling and multiscale nature. To address these, we propose a hybrid fixed-stress transferable neural network (HFS-TransNet) method. In HFS-TransNet, a data-driven TransNet module first approximates observed data on an initialization domain to supply a high-quality starting point for the subsequent physics-informed stage, which then drives fixed-stress splitting iterations via TransNet and admits an error bound. After each iteration, a greedy update strategy on a validation domain prevents model degradation and a relative tolerance criterion governs convergence termination. HFS-TransNet thereby inherits the robustness of the fixed-stress splitting scheme, the flexibility of data-driven modeling, and the transferability of TransNet, effectively overcoming the strong coupling and locking instability inherent in the Biot system. Ablation studies and comparisons with FS-FEM and FS-PINN confirm HFS-TransNet's superior performance in capturing multiscale coupled physics across varying physical parameters and boundary conditions. By bridging classical decoupled iterative schemes with hybrid scientific machine learning, HFS-TransNet offers a novel perspective for complex poroelastic simulations, as demonstrated by its successful application to brain edema simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出HFS-TransNet混合方法求解准静态Biot多孔弹性系统，融合数据驱动TransNet与固定应力分裂迭代，兼具鲁棒性、灵活性与可迁移性，在脑水肿模拟中验证有效。
AI.motivation: 准静态Biot系统因强耦合与多尺度特性导致计算困难，传统解耦迭代格式（如固定应力分裂）易陷入锁定不稳定，而纯数据驱动或纯物理信息方法在鲁棒性、灵活性和可迁移性上难以兼顾，故需融合二者优势的新范式。
AI.method: HFS-TransNet分两阶段：先由数据驱动TransNet模块在初始化域上逼近观测数据，提供高质量初始点；随后进入物理信息阶段，借助TransNet驱动固定应力分裂迭代并给出误差界。每次迭代后在验证域上执行贪婪更新策略以防模型退化，并以相对容差准则判定收敛终止。
AI.result: 消融实验与FS-FEM、FS-PINN的对比表明，HFS-TransNet在不同物理参数与边界条件下捕捉多尺度耦合物理的性能更优，成功应用于脑水肿模拟，验证了方法的有效性与可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: HFS-TransNet将经典解耦迭代格式与混合科学机器学习相结合，兼顾固定应力分裂的鲁棒性、数据建模的灵活性与TransNet的可迁移性，有效克服Biot系统的强耦合与锁定不稳定，为复杂多孔弹性模拟提供了新思路。

title: Transparent 3D-printed flow cells for porous media studies with proof-of-concept on two-phase flow-reversal asymmetry
comment: 30 pages, 11 figures. Accompanying design files, data, and analysis code are available on Zenodo
summary: Porous media experiments commonly rely on geometry-controlled and optically transparent experimental flow cells. Examples include studies of flow structure, solute mixing, multiphase flow, bacterial dynamics, and reactive transport. Here, we provide a reproducible and open-source protocol to fabricate transparent monolithic porous flow cells by stereolithography 3D printing. The protocol covers digital design, resin printing, internal flushing, and resin coating. The flushing and coating steps are central to the workflow, enabling enclosed single-material cells to be cleared of uncured resin and made optically transparent for direct imaging. The protocol produces optically transparent, millimetre-scale, and quasi-two-dimensional flow cells suitable for simultaneous pressure and image-based measurements. As a proof of concept, we study flow-reversal asymmetry in steady oil-air two-phase flow in quasi-two-dimensional Hele-Shaw cells containing either triangular or cylindrical obstacles. Directional differences are quantified from pressure measurements and from image-based active-width measurements. The triangular geometry produces a clear directional response, whereas the cylindrical geometry remains symmetric within experimental uncertainty. These results demonstrate that our fabrication protocol can link digitally designed pore geometries to macroscopic pressure response and steady-state two-phase flow organisation. By making the design files, scripts, and manufacturing workflow openly available, we aim to make 3D-printed flow cells readily adaptable to other experimental systems and research fields.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于立体光刻3D打印的可复现开源方案，用于制备透明单体多孔流腔，并将其应用于研究准二维Hele-Shaw单元中油-气两相流的流向反转不对称性。
AI.motivation: 多孔介质实验通常依赖几何可控且光学透明的流腔，用于研究流动结构、溶质混合、多相流、细菌动力学和反应运移等。然而，传统透明流腔在几何设计自由度、密封性与光学透明性之间的兼顾上存在困难，亟需一种可复现、开放且易于推广的制备方法。
AI.method: 采用立体光刻3D打印制备透明单体多孔流腔，方案涵盖数字设计、树脂打印、内部冲洗与树脂涂层。冲洗与涂层步骤为核心环节，可清除封闭单体单元内未固化树脂并使其光学透明，从而支持直接成像。所制流腔为光学透明、毫米尺度、准二维，适用于同步压力测量与图像测量。并以稳态油-气两相流中的流向反转不对称性作为验证案例，对比三角形与圆柱形障碍物的Hele-Shaw单元。
AI.result: 通过压力测量与基于图像的活性宽度测量量化方向性差异。三角形几何表现出明显的方向响应，而圆柱形几何在实验不确定度范围内保持对称。
AI.conclusion: 该制备方案能够将数字化设计的孔隙几何与宏观压力响应及稳态两相流组织联系起来。通过公开设计文件、脚本与制造流程，3D打印流腔可被便捷地适配到其他实验系统和研究领域。

title: Harnessing Measurement Error as a Thermodynamic Resource in Two-Reservoir Information Engines
summary: In general, measurement error constrains the performance of information engines. However, this may not hold universally. In this work, we propose a class of two-reservoirs information engines (TRIEs) with a two-level system and demonstrate that the monotonic relationships between the work output, the efficiency, as well as the work fluctuations of the TRIEs and measurement error are determined by the demon's control parameters. Utilizing this, we establish the conditions that allow the TRIEs to generate useful work under any level of measurement error, and identify the regimes in which these performance parameters can be optimized simultaneously by the measurement error. Furthermore, we demonstrate that when the demon's energy cost is supplied solely by the cold reservoir, the efficiency that accounts for this cost can surpass the standard Carnot bound without violating the second law. Finally, we design a dual Otto cycles TRIE and provide an experimental scheme for its implementation based on a trapped $^{40}\mathrm{Ca}^+$ ion. Significantly, our results can be applied to the multi-level system information engines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一类双热库信息引擎（TRIEs），证明测量误差对其功输出、效率和功涨落的影响由"妖"的控制参数决定，并给出在任意测量误差下仍可输出有用功的条件及可同时优化性能参数的区域，最终设计了双Otto循环方案并给出基于囚禁⁴⁰Ca⁺离子的实验实现。
AI.motivation: 通常认为测量误差会限制信息引擎的性能，但这一结论未必普遍成立。作者希望探究测量误差是否可能不限制、甚至优化信息引擎的性能，从而揭示测量误差与信息引擎性能之间更一般的非单调关系。
AI.method: 构建一类由双能级系统与两个热库组成的双热库信息引擎（TRIEs），引入"妖"（demon）的控制参数，分析功输出、效率及功涨落与测量误差之间的单调关系；推导在任意测量误差水平下产生有用功的条件，并确定性能参数可被测量误差同时优化的参数区域；进一步分析当"妖"的能量代价仅由冷库提供时的效率表现，并设计双Otto循环TRIE及其基于囚禁⁴⁰Ca⁺离子的实验方案。
AI.result: 功输出、效率与功涨落同测量误差之间的单调关系取决于"妖"的控制参数；存在使TRIEs在任意测量误差下都能输出有用功的条件，也存在测量误差可同时优化多个性能参数的区域；当"妖"的能量代价仅由冷库供给时，计入该代价的效率可超越标准卡诺上限而不违背热力学第二定律。
AI.conclusion: 测量误差并非普遍约束信息引擎性能，其作用由"妖"的控制参数决定，可被利用来优化引擎性能；所得结果可推广至多能级系统的信息引擎，并为双Otto循环TRIE提供了可行的离子阱实验实现方案。

title: Distance Geometry and a Hydrodynamical Hopf-Rinow Criterion
summary: The hydrodynamical Hopf-Rinow problem asks whether a given reconfiguration of an ideal fluid can be attained by an Euler flow. On the flat two-dimensional torus, we give an equivalent criterion for the strong version of this problem (which requires that the fluid motion minimizes the total kinetic energy required) in terms of metric betweenness. Toward this, we prove that sufficiently small normal neighborhoods in the volume-preserving diffeomorphism group of the flat $n$-dimensional torus, $n \geq 2$, equipped with the kinetic energy metric, are geodesically convex; resolving the strong problem locally in the $H^s$ topology. We further establish local bi-Lipschitz equivalence of the intrinsic geodesic distance and the extrinsic $L^2$ distance. Finally, we prove that the squared geodesic distance from the identity admits a $C^{1,1}$ extension from a sufficiently small normal neighborhood to the ambient $L^2$ space.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平环上理想流体的强Hopf-Rinow问题，用度量中间性给出等价判据，并证明体积保持微分同胚群中充分小法邻域测地凸、内蕴测地距离局部双Lipschitz等价于L²距离，以及平方测地距离的C^{1,1}延拓。
AI.motivation: 解决理想流体重构能否由Euler流实现的Hopf-Rinow问题，特别是要求动能最小的强版本；先前缺乏局部几何凸性与距离等价性等基础结果。
AI.method: 在平n维环(n≥2)的体积保持微分同胚群上赋予动能度量，利用度量中间性刻画强问题；在H^s拓扑下分析法邻域的测地凸性，比较内蕴测地距离与外蕴L²距离，并研究平方测地距离的光滑延拓。
AI.result: 证明充分小法邻域在动能度量下测地凸，从而局部解决强问题；建立内蕴测地距离与外蕴L²距离的局部双Lipschitz等价；平方测地距离可从法邻域C^{1,1}延拓到L²空间；平二维环上给出强Hopf-Rinow问题的度量中间性等价判据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为流体Hopf-Rinow问题提供局部几何基础，强问题在H^s局部可由测地凸性与距离等价性解决，并给出平方距离的C^{1,1}延拓。

title: Least Squares for Time Series Forecasting
summary: A time-series forecast is scored on a future value of the series. A representation loss that regresses the next latent, as in LeNEPA, is a different least-squares problem on the same bottleneck. We write both programs down. The forecast program minimizes the error of a decoded latent on the coordinate that will be reported. For a scalar target and a linear decoder, every latent rank of at least one matches ordinary least squares, and an isotropy constraint is only a rescaling: after the decoder is refit, the forecast does not move. The other program fits the whole next vector at a fixed rank, then freezes the encoder and attaches a head. On a four-dimensional series whose last three coordinates are the same autoregression, that rank-1 fit puts mass $0.9998$ on the repeated coordinate and forecasts the remaining signal at the marginal variance $2.794$. The forecast program puts mass $1$ on the signal and matches the innovation variance $0.992$. Rank $2$ gives the vector fit a second direction, and the two programs agree. Iterating the fitted one-step coefficient $0.803$ raises the open-loop error from $0.992$ at one step to $2.700$ at eight steps.

AI.tldr: 本文将 LeNEPA 式"回归下一潜变量"的表征损失与直接以未来观测值为目标的预测损失写成两个显式最小二乘程序，证明在标量目标与线性解码器下二者等价（等秩≥1 时与 OLS 一致，各向同性约束仅是重标定），而在固定秩拟合整个下一向量时会出现目标错配，导致秩不足时预测崩溃。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测的评价指标是序列的未来数值，但 LeNEPA 一类方法却用"回归下一潜变量"的表征损失来训练，二者的目标函数并不相同。作者希望厘清这两种损失在什么样的条件下等价、在什么条件下会偏离，并量化偏离带来的实际预测代价。
AI.method: 把两种目标写成两个最小二乘程序：(1) 预测程序，直接在被报告坐标上最小化解码潜变量的误差；(2) 表征程序，在固定秩下拟合整个下一向量，然后冻结编码器并接一个预测头。用构造的四维序列（后三维共享同一自回归）做解析与数值对比：标量目标+线性解码器下比较各秩解、各向同性约束与重拟合解码器后的结果；并在秩1、秩2下比较两程序的系数分配、质量分布以及一步与多步（开环迭代）预测误差。
AI.result: 标量目标、线性解码器时，任何秩≥1 的潜变量解都与普通最小二乘（OLS）相同，各向同性约束只等价于重标定，解码器重拟合后预测不变。固定秩拟合整向量的程序则在构造序列上失效：秩1 时把 0.9998 的质量放在被重复的坐标上，对其余信号仅以边际方差 2.794 预测；预测程序把全部质量 1 放在真实信号上，匹配新息方差 0.992。秩2 时向量拟合获得第二个方向，两程序一致。将拟合的一步系数 0.803 迭代做开环预测，误差从一步 0.992 升至八步 2.700。
AI.conclusion: 表征损失与预测损失并非同一问题：在标量、线性、低秩条件下二者可等价，但当目标为整个下一向量且秩受限时，表征损失会把容量分配给与预测无关的方向，造成严重的预测偏差。多步开环迭代会进一步放大误差，说明应以最终预测指标而非潜变量回归质量来选择训练目标与秩。

title: Targeted Active Learning for Preference-Based Treatment Effects on Multivariate Outcomes
summary: Treatment efficacy is traditionally demonstrated on the basis of a single primary outcome. However, clinical decision-making usually requires consideration of multiple outcomes, balancing expected benefits against potential risks. The relative value assigned to these outcomes varies substantially from one patient to another. Given a preference rule over outcome profiles, treatment effects and optimal policies can be defined and estimated. Such a rule is rarely available in practice: it must itself be estimated from pairwise comparisons of outcome profiles, which are costly to collect from clinical experts. We propose an active learning framework that selects which comparisons to query. Standard criteria maximize the information gained on the preference rule itself. We instead target the quantities of interest, and select the query that most reduces uncertainty on the treatment effect and on the optimal policy induced by the learned rule. Under a Gaussian process model of the preference rule, we derive a closed-form approximation of this criterion. On semi-synthetic data built from a Parkinson's disease cohort with 13 clinical outcomes, our criterion achieves lower treatment effect estimation error and lower policy regret than existing criteria at equal query budget.

AI.tldr: 提出一种主动学习框架，用于高效获取临床专家偏好，直接以降低疗效估计与最优策略的不确定性为查询准则，在半合成帕金森病数据上优于现有准则。
AI.motivation: 临床决策需同时权衡多个结局的获益与风险，而各结局的相对价值因人而异，因此需要偏好规则。但该规则在实践中难以直接获得，须通过临床专家对结局画像的两两比较来估计，而这类比较数据采集成本高昂。现有主动学习方法以最大化偏好规则本身的信息量为目标，未直接针对真正关心的治疗效应与最优策略，效率不足。
AI.method: 提出主动学习框架以选择查询哪些比较。与标准信息准则不同，本文以决策相关量为目标，选择能最大程度降低治疗效应估计和由所学规则诱导的最优策略不确定性的查询。在偏好规则的高斯过程模型下，推导出该准则的闭式近似。
AI.result: 在基于帕金森病队列、含13项临床结局的半合成数据上，在相同查询预算下，该准则比现有准则取得更低的治疗效应估计误差和更低的策略遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 面向决策相关量的主动查询准则可在有限预算下更有效地估计治疗效应并逼近最优策略，为多结局偏好驱动的临床决策提供可行方案。

title: Studying oscillation death in two-dimensional cylinder-airfoil interactions with synchronization-theoretic autoencoder
summary: Body-body interactions have long been investigated to leverage the performance of various fluid-based machines. This study analyzes the flow interaction between a cylinder and a NACA0012 airfoil using direct numerical simulation and machine learning. We consider a two-dimensional incompressible flow at Reynolds number 100, where the airfoil is positioned in the wake of a cylinder. By sweeping the parameter space, composed of the distance between the cylinder and the airfoil $Δx$, the relative height $Δy$, and the angle of attack of the airfoil $α$, four characteristic vortex-shedding regimes are observed. This study particularly focuses on suppressed vortex shedding at a certain arrangement as oscillation death in coupled oscillators, with the theoretical prediction of flow stability on a machine-learned low-order coordinate. Independent flows around each body are regarded as a system that exhibits isolated periodic vortex shedding at infinite distance, and interactions appear at smaller distances. We employ a synchronization-theoretic autoencoder to derive models for two coupled oscillators from an aerodynamic coefficient. The proposed approach, which enables the assessment of system stability and the prediction of vortical interaction behavior, may pave the way for the analysis of unsteady body-body interactions from the data-driven and synchronization perspectives.

AI.tldr: 本文通过直接数值模拟与机器学习，研究Re=100下圆柱与NACA0012翼型尾流相互作用，识别出四种涡脱落regimes，并将特定间距下涡脱落被抑制现象类比为耦合振子的"振荡死亡"，用同步理论自编码器在低维坐标上预测流稳定性。
AI.motivation: 流体机械中物体间相互作用长期受关注，但缺乏从数据驱动与同步理论角度分析非定常体-体相互作用、并对流稳定性进行理论预测的方法。
AI.method: 对Re=100二维不可压缩流进行直接数值模拟，翼型置于圆柱尾流中；扫描间距Δx、相对高度Δy与攻角α参数空间，观察涡脱落regimes；将各物体独立绕流视为无穷远距离下的孤立周期涡脱落系统，采用同步理论自编码器，从气动系数推导两耦合振子模型，并在机器学习得到的低阶坐标上理论预测流稳定性。
AI.result: 在参数扫描中发现四种特征涡脱落regimes；在特定排布下出现涡脱落被抑制现象，可类比为耦合振子的振荡死亡，并可在机器学习低阶坐标上对流动稳定性进行理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能够评估系统稳定性并预测涡相互作用行为，为从数据驱动与同步视角分析非定常体-体相互作用提供了新途径。

title: Latent Score-Based Bayesian Cramér-Rao Bound Estimation for High-Dimensional Imaging Systems
summary: We propose a data-driven framework for estimating the Bayesian Cramér-Rao bound (CRB) in high-dimensional imaging systems with complex, analytically intractable priors. Direct CRB computation is challenging in this setting due to the need to model the prior score and to form and invert the Bayesian Fisher information matrix in very high dimensions. To address these issues, we first reformulate the inverse problem in the latent space of a pre-trained variational autoencoder, thereby dramatically reducing the dimensionality of the bound estimation problem while preserving the spatial structure of the images. The Bayesian CRB is formed in this latent space and mapped back to the native parameter space using a change-of-variables formula. Second, to learn the latent prior score, we introduce a new sliced score matching objective defined in a Bochner space endowed with an $H^1(Ω)$ Sobolev norm in space. This "Bochner-space sliced score matching" objective is consistent with standard sliced score matching, but penalizes errors in the spatial gradients of the score, suppressing high-frequency artifacts that otherwise contaminate the resulting CRB estimates. We validate the approach on a stylized quantitative photoacoustic computed tomography (qPACT) breast imaging problem with over one million unknown parameters, using a foundation-model autoencoder derived from Stable Diffusion. The proposed method yields stable, artifact-free Bayesian CRB estimates that reflect the highly non-Gaussian structure of the learned prior and reveal the substantial impact of the prior on the relative performance of competing qPACT design schemes.

AI.tldr: 提出数据驱动框架，在预训练VAE隐空间估计高维成像的贝叶斯Cramér-Rao界（CRB），并用Bochner空间切片分数匹配学习隐先验分数，实现稳定、无伪影的CRB估计。
AI.motivation: 高维成像系统中先验复杂且解析不可解，直接计算贝叶斯CRB困难：既需建模先验分数，又需在高维下构造并求逆贝叶斯Fisher信息矩阵。
AI.method: 1）将逆问题重构到预训练VAE隐空间，大幅降维并保留图像空间结构；在隐空间构造贝叶斯CRB，再通过变量替换公式映射回原始参数空间。2）提出Bochner空间切片分数匹配目标，在赋H^1(Ω) Sobolev范数的Bochner空间中定义，与标准切片分数匹配一致，但惩罚分数空间梯度的误差，抑制高频伪影。
AI.result: 在具有超百万未知参量的定量光声计算断层成像（qPACT）乳腺成像问题上，使用源自Stable Diffusion的基础模型自编码器验证：获得稳定、无伪影的贝叶斯CRB估计，反映所学先验的高度非高斯结构，并揭示先验对竞争性qPACT设计方案相对性能的显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过隐空间重构与Bochner空间切片分数匹配，使高维、先验不可解成像系统中的贝叶斯CRB估计可行，并可用于评估先验影响下的成像系统设计。

title: Stochastic Sequential Feedback Optimization for Wind Farm Control under Time-Varying Inflow
summary: We consider steady-state optimization of nonlinear dynamical systems under time-varying stochastic operating conditions, where the objective is an expected-value function over the current operating-condition distribution, so that changes in the distribution induce a moving stochastic optimum. To address this problem, we propose stochastic sequential feedback optimization (S2FO), which combines projected feedback-gradient updates with sequential sensitivity estimates obtained by linearizing the plant at realized stochastic operating conditions. We analyze the closed-loop performance of S2FO through expected dynamic regret, instantaneous tracking in expectation, and almost-sure convergence under diminishing step sizes. We then apply the method to wind farm power maximization under time-varying stochastic inflow. Simulations on a benchmark layout and on a realistic offshore wind farm show that S2FO improves average power generation when persistent wake interactions are present, and that its advantage decreases as wind-direction variability increases.

AI.tldr: 本文针对时变随机工况下的非线性动态系统稳态优化问题，提出随机序列反馈优化方法（S2FO），结合投影反馈梯度更新与序列灵敏度估计，并从期望动态遗憾、期望意义下的瞬时跟踪和几乎必然收敛三方面分析闭环性能，最后在风电场功率最大化场景中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 在时变随机运行工况下，目标函数是关于当前工况分布的期望值函数，分布变化会导致随机最优点持续移动，传统稳态优化方法难以跟踪这种动态最优。因此需要一种能在线适应工况分布变化的反馈优化方法。
AI.method: 提出随机序列反馈优化（S2FO）：将投影反馈梯度更新与序列灵敏度估计相结合，其中灵敏度估计通过在实际实现的随机工况处对对象进行线性化获得。
AI.result: 理论上从期望动态遗憾、期望意义下的瞬时跟踪以及递减步长下的几乎必然收敛三个角度分析S2FO的闭环性能。仿真在基准布局和真实海上风电场进行，结果表明：在存在持续尾流相互作用时S2FO可提升平均发电量，且其优势随风向变化性增大而减小。
AI.conclusion: S2FO能够有效应对时变随机工况下的稳态优化问题，在持续尾流耦合场景中提升风电场平均功率，但其增益随风向波动增强而衰减。

title: Core Coordinates and Negative Support in A-Hypergeometric Systems
summary: For a homogeneous $A$-hypergeometric system, let $K_v$ be the intersection of the negative support family for a fake exponent $v$, and let $C_w$ be the set of indices of variables that do not occur in any minimal monomial generator of $\operatorname{in}_w(I_A)$. We prove that $K_v=\operatorname{nsupp}(v)\cap C_w$ holds for every parameter and every fake exponent if and only if $\operatorname{Cone}(A_{C_w})$ meets the interior of $\operatorname{Cone}(A)$. We give equivalent criteria using the reduced Gröbner basis and the associated regular triangulation. When the condition fails, we construct an infinite family of fake exponents for which the equality fails.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了A-超几何系统中"假指数负支撑族与Grobner退化指标集交集"这一等式成立的充要条件，并给出等价判据及反例族构造。
AI.motivation: 在A-超几何系统的研究中，假指数的负支撑族（negative support family）与由初始理想Grobner退化决定的指标集之间的交集关系，是理解解空间结构与参数依赖性的关键问题。然而该等式何时对所有参数和假指数普遍成立尚不清楚，需要一个精确的几何判据来界定其成立范围。
AI.method: 设K_v为假指数v的负支撑族族交集，C_w为初始理想in_w(I_A)的极小单项式生成元中不出现的变量指标集。作者将等式 K_v = nsupp(v) ∩ C_w 的普遍成立性归结为锥条件：Cone(A_{C_w}) 是否与 Cone(A) 的内部相交。并利用约化Grobner基与关联正则三角化给出等价判据。
AI.result: 证明了：对每个参数和每个假指数均有 K_v = nsupp(v) ∩ C_w 成立，当且仅当 Cone(A_{C_w}) 与 Cone(A) 的内部相交。给出了基于约化Grobner基和关联正则三角化的等价判据。在条件不成立时，构造出使该等式失效的无限族假指数。
AI.conclusion: 该等式普遍成立与否完全由锥的相交性决定；条件失败时不仅存在反例，而且反例构成无限族，说明该现象具有结构性的普遍意义。

title: Inference of Hamiltonian and Lie-Poisson structures from vector field samples
summary: We present a method for the data-driven inference of Hamiltonian and Lie-Poisson dynamical systems from vector-field samples, in which the Hamiltonian and the underlying Poisson tensor are estimated jointly rather than assuming the structure is known. The Hamiltonian is represented as a linear combination of random feature maps with fixed random internal weights, so its estimation is a linear regression problem for any given Poisson structure. We treat three cases of increasing generality: a known Poisson tensor, an unknown constant invertible (symplectic) structure matrix, and Lie-Poisson and affine Poisson structures, with structure matrix linear in the state. In the constant case, the Hamiltonian and structure matrix are recovered jointly from an eigenvalue problem that avoids the trivial zero solution due to the scaling symmetry of Hamiltonian systems. For Lie-Poisson and affine Poisson systems we alternate between an initial Hamiltonian estimate from a generalized eigenvalue problem for an approximate first integral, and a constrained nonlinear least-squares fit of the structure constants that enforces the Jacobi identity and, for affine structures, the cocycle condition, via continuation in a penalty parameter. Orthogonal matching pursuit selects a compact, well-conditioned subset of random features. Because the learned Hamiltonian is a sum of single-feature terms, the model admits an explicit Poisson/symplectic splitting integrator, which we use to validate the learned systems via long-time Poincare sections. We demonstrate the approach on the four- and five-dimensional Lorenz-86 model and a six-dimensional Kirchhoff rigid-body system, recovering Hamiltonians, structure constants and Casimir invariants to high accuracy, and showing the inferred Poincare sections converge to the correct invariant-tori topology as the number of random features increases.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种从向量场样本中联合推断哈密顿函数与泊松张量的数据驱动方法，可处理已知泊松结构、常量辛结构以及Lie-Poisson/仿射泊松结构，并用显式分裂积分器验证学习系统。
AI.motivation: 现有哈密顿系统辨识通常假设泊松结构已知，无法同时学习哈密顿函数与底层几何结构；本文希望在结构未知的情况下联合估计哈密顿量与泊松张量。
AI.method: 哈密顿函数用固定随机内权重的随机特征映射线性表示，使估计成为线性回归；分三类：已知泊松张量、未知常量可逆（辛）结构矩阵、结构矩阵随状态线性的Lie-Poisson与仿射泊松结构。常量情形通过特征值问题联合恢复哈密顿量与结构矩阵以避免缩放对称性导致的零解；Lie-Poisson/仿射情形交替进行广义特征值问题初估哈密顿量（近似首次积分）与约束非线性最小二乘拟合结构常数，通过罚参数延拓强制Jacobi恒等式及仿射结构的余循环条件；用正交匹配追踪（OMP）选取紧凑且条件良好的随机特征子集。
AI.result: 在四维和五维Lorenz-86模型及六维Kirchhoff刚体系统上验证，高精度恢复哈密顿量、结构常数与Casimir不变量；推断的Poincare截面随随机特征数增加收敛到正确的不变环面拓扑。
AI.conclusion: 由于学习到的哈密顿量为单特征项之和，模型可导出显式泊松/辛分裂积分器，用于通过长时间Poincare截面验证学习系统，表明该方法能有效联合辨识哈密顿几何结构并保持几何一致性。

title: A Contrast-Source Inversion Scheme Based on Stochastic Optimization and Plug-and-Play Regularization
summary: An electromagnetic inversion scheme that integrates stochastic optimization (STO) and plug-and-play (PNP) regularization into contrast-source inversion (CSI), termed STO-PNP-CSI, is developed. Standard CSI solves for the contrast source vector of every transmitter at each iteration, which is expensive in a multi-transmitter configuration. STO instead solves for only one randomly selected contrast source vector per iteration, which reduces the per-iteration cost and can help the inversion escape poor local minima and saddle points. The resulting loss of information, however, increases the ill-posedness of the inversion. To counter this, the Swin-Conv-UNet (SCUNet) denoiser is plugged into the CSI scheme as an implicit regularizer, supplying a learned prior that is stronger than conventional hand-crafted ones and stabilizes the reconstruction. The proposed STO-PNP-CSI is applied to both synthetic and experimental data. The results show that it yields accurate reconstructions at substantially lower computational cost than CSI, including under strong nonlinearity and measurement noise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STO-PNP-CSI电磁反演方案，将随机优化与即插即用正则化嵌入对比源反演，在显著降低计算成本的同时实现高精度重建。
AI.motivation: 标准对比源反演（CSI）在多发射机配置下需要求解每个发射机对应的对比源向量，逐迭代计算成本高昂；同时反演易陷入较差的局部极小值和鞍点。
AI.method: 将随机优化（STO）与即插即用（PNP）正则化集成到CSI中，构成STO-PNP-CSI。STO每次迭代仅随机选取一个对比源向量进行求解，降低单次迭代开销并有助于跳出局部极小与鞍点；针对由此造成的信息损失与病态性加剧，将Swin-Conv-UNet（SCUNet）去噪器作为隐式正则项接入CSI，提供强于传统手工设计先验的学习型先验以稳定重建。
AI.result: 在合成数据与实验数据上验证，STO-PNP-CSI在计算成本显著低于CSI的前提下获得准确重建，且在强非线性与测量噪声条件下依然有效。
AI.conclusion: STO-PNP-CSI通过在低成本随机优化中嵌入学习型隐式正则化，兼顾了计算效率与重建精度及鲁棒性，是一种可推广的电磁反演框架。

title: The ejected volume and drop statistics by bubble bursting in a sessile drop
summary: A bubble bursting inside a drop resting on a substrate can eject jet droplets where a bubble at a bath would not. We compute how much liquid it ejects and how the ejected droplets are distributed in size. The volume ejected by the jet grows by more than an order of magnitude as the Bond number decreases from $0.5$ to $0.1$ and then saturates, and the larger the Bond number, the smaller the viscosity that suppresses ejection. At zero Bond number the substrate alone extends the ejection boundary to larger Ohnesorge numbers, contrary to expectation, and yet reduces the volume ejected at the same distance from it. Gravity sets how much liquid the jet carries, not how the jet fragments: scaled with its mean, the droplet-size distribution is independent of the Bond number and has an exponential tail, as for free hollow droplets. The simulations, built on a closed family of sessile equilibria, reproduce the measured velocity of the first droplet within 7\,\%, while the volumes emitted in experiments are eight to ten times those computed for the same geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文数值研究了静置液滴内气泡破裂的射流喷射，量化了喷射体积与液滴尺寸分布，揭示Bond数、Ohnesorge数、黏性与重力的作用，并给出实验与模拟的体积差异。
AI.motivation: 气泡在液池中破裂不足以喷射液滴，但液滴内气泡破裂可喷射射流液滴；需要弄清衬底、重力与黏性如何控制喷射体积和液滴尺寸分布。
AI.method: 基于闭族静置（sessile）平衡解的数值模拟，改变Bond数（0.5降至0.1）与Ohnesorge数，统计射流喷射体积及液滴尺寸分布，并与实验对比。
AI.result: Bond数从0.5降至0.1时喷射体积增大逾一个数量级后饱和；Bond数越大，抑制喷射所需黏性越小；零Bond数下衬底将喷射边界扩展至更大Ohnesorge数，但减小同一距离处的喷射体积；液滴尺寸分布以其均值为尺度时与Bond数无关并呈指数尾，类似自由空心液滴；模拟首滴速度与实测吻合在7%以内，但实验体积为同几何计算的8至10倍。
AI.conclusion: 重力决定射流携带的液量而非其破碎方式；液滴尺寸分布具普适性（指数尾）；模拟对首滴速度预测准确，但喷射体积仍显著低估，需进一步解释实验与计算的体积差异。

title: Information Entropy and Dissipation Potential in Stochastic Nambu Nonequilibrium Thermodynamics
summary: We investigate the relationship between the dissipation potential $S_{\mathrm{NB}}$ and information entropy in stochastic Nambu nonequilibrium thermodynamics (NNET). Starting from pure diffusion, gradient-flow systems, and systems with Hamiltonian rotational currents, we derive the stationary distribution of the Fokker--Planck equation including a Nambu flow. We show that, when the Nambu flow preserves the dissipation potential and an Einstein-type relation holds between the diffusion matrix and the transport tensor, the stationary distribution is governed by an exponential weight determined by $S_{\mathrm{NB}}$. Consequently, the local self-information is directly related to the dissipation potential, demonstrating that $S_{\mathrm{NB}}$ should not be identified with the Shannon entropy itself but instead serves as the stationary quasipotential governing the nonequilibrium steady-state distribution. Using the distinction between the thermodynamic entropy and the dissipation potential established for an open gas--piston system coupled to a thermal bath and an external-pressure reservoir, we further clarify the Massieu interpretation of $S_{\mathrm{NB}}$, introduce a Nambu canonical distribution, and derive the covariance of fluctuations within the saddle-point approximation. These results provide a statistical interpretation of the NNET dissipation potential by identifying it as the stationary quasipotential underlying nonequilibrium steady states.

AI.tldr: 本文在随机Nambu非平衡热力学(NNET)框架下，证明耗散势$S_{\mathrm{NB}}$并非香农熵本身，而是决定非平衡稳态分布的定态准势。
AI.motivation: 厘清NNET中耗散势$S_{\mathrm{NB}}$与信息熵的关系，明确其统计力学含义，从而为耗散势提供统计解释。
AI.method: 从纯扩散、梯度流系统及含Hamiltonian旋转流的系统出发，推导含Nambu流的Fokker--Planck方程的定态分布；在Nambu流保持耗散势、且扩散矩阵与输运张量满足Einstein型关系时，得到由$S_{\mathrm{NB}}$指数加权的定态分布。进一步以耦合热浴与外部压力库的开放气体-活塞系统区分热力学熵与耗散势，阐明$S_{\mathrm{NB}}$的Massieu解释，引入Nambu正则分布，并在鞍点近似下推导涨落协方差。
AI.result: 定态分布由$S_{\mathrm{NB}}$决定的指数权重控制，局域自信息与耗散势直接相关；$S_{\mathrm{NB}}$应理解为支配非平衡稳态分布的定态准势，而非香农熵。
AI.conclusion: 为NNET耗散势提供了统计解释，将其识别为非平衡稳态的定态准势。

title: Vanishing discount selection for constant-sign local perturbations of periodic Hamiltonians
summary: We study the vanishing discount selection problem for critical Hamil\-ton--Jacobi equations posed on ${\mathbb R}^d$ with Hamiltonian $G=H-V$, where $H$ is continuous, periodic in space, convex and superlinear in the momentum, and $V$ is a compactly supported potential of constant sign. For $V\leqslant0$, we prove local uniform convergence of the discounted solutions to a distinguished critical solution, which we characterize in terms of Mather measures and of the solution selected by the unperturbed periodic problem. The proof relies on a decomposition of limiting discounted measures into a retained component and a periodic component accounting for the mass lost at infinity. For $V\geqslant0$, we establish convergence under the additional assumption that the unperturbed selected solution has zero average with respect to every periodic Mather measure. We also give explicit examples in which the discounted solutions converge, but natural formulas for the candidate limit fail to identify the selected solution.

AI.tldr: 研究临界 Hamilton–Jacobi 方程 G=H−V 的消失折扣选择问题，证明 V≤0 时折扣解局部一致收敛到以 Mather 测度刻画的临界解，V≥0 时在附加零平均条件下收敛，并给出反例。
AI.motivation: 研究消失折扣（vanishing discount）极限中选择哪个临界解的问题，尤其是紧支撑、定号的势 V 对解选择的影响，并厘清 Mather 测度与周期问题所选解之间的关系。
AI.method: 考虑 R^d 上临界 Hamilton–Jacobi 方程，Hamiltonian 为 G=H−V，H 连续、空间周期、关于动量凸且超线性，V 为紧支撑定号势。对 V≤0，将极限折扣测度分解为保留分量与补偿无穷远处质量损失的周期分量；对 V≥0，引入未扰动所选解关于所有周期 Mather 测度零平均的假设。
AI.result: V≤0 时，折扣解局部一致收敛到某临界解，并用 Mather 测度及未扰动周期问题所选解刻画该极限；V≥0 时，在零平均条件下同样得到收敛；此外构造了折扣解收敛但候选极限的自然公式无法识别所选解的反例。
AI.conclusion: 消失折扣极限的选择机制依赖于势 V 的符号：负势导致极限可借由 Mather 测度分解刻画；非负势需额外零平均条件；并且自然候选极限公式不一定能确定实际选中的临界解。

title: Memory-State Critic for Asymmetric Actor-Critic with Application to Vision-Based Pursuit-Evasion
comment: Accepted at the 19th European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning (EWRL 2026), Lille, France. Non-archival workshop
summary: In partially observable Markov decision processes, the optimal policy generally depends on the history of observations and past actions. Asymmetric actor-critic methods have become popular to learn such policies when additional information, such as the true state of the environment, is available during training. The critic, which is not needed at execution, is given access to the state. A critic conditioned on the state alone is generally ill-defined and yields biased policy gradients. Conditioning on the state and the history, the history-state critic restores both. In this paper, we show that conditioning the critic on the state and the policy's own memory, i.e., the internal representation of the history through which the policy selects its actions, is already well-defined and gives unbiased policy gradients, removing the need for a second recurrent approximator of the history. We call it the memory state critic. It follows that a critic based on the policy's memory need not backpropagate its loss into that memory, even though the memory is a lossy encoding of the history. We evaluate the memory-state critic in a vision-based pursuit-evasion environment between two quadrotors across two arena types. The pursuer is the learning agent, and the evader is sampled per episode from a fixed pool of heuristic behaviours. The results show that the memory-state critic outperforms the history-state critic and converges faster. In addition to being unbiased compared to the state-only critic, it maintains a slight edge in the wall arena, where the actor's history carries information that the privileged state alone does not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"记忆状态评论家"（memory-state critic），仅以状态和策略自身记忆为条件，即构成良定义且无偏的策略梯度，无需额外循环网络建模历史，实验证明其优于历史-状态评论家并收敛更快。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测MDP中，最优策略依赖观测-动作历史；非对称actor-critic在训练时可获得真实状态等额外信息，但仅以状态为条件的评论家通常定义不良并产生有偏策略梯度；而以状态+历史为条件虽可恢复无偏性，却需引入第二个循环近似器来建模历史，代价高。作者希望找到一种既无偏又无需额外历史建模的评论家设计。
AI.method: 提出memory-state critic：将评论家条件设为环境状态与策略自身的记忆（即策略据以选择动作的历史内部表示）。论证该条件已足够良定义并给出无偏策略梯度，因此无需再训练第二个循环网络近似历史；同时指出基于策略记忆的评论家无需将损失反传进该记忆，即便记忆是历史的有损编码。实验在视觉驱动的双四旋翼追逃环境中评估，涵盖两种竞技场类型；追捕者为学习智能体，逃逸者每回合从固定启发式行为池中采样。
AI.result: 记忆状态评论家优于历史-状态评论家且收敛更快；与仅用状态的评论家相比保持无偏性，并在墙式竞技场中略占优势——该场景下actor的历史包含特权状态所不具备的信息。
AI.conclusion: 以状态加策略记忆为条件的评论家是良定义且无偏的，可免除第二个历史循环近似器及其梯度反传，为部分可观测下的非对称actor-critic提供更简洁高效的方案。

title: Probability flow ODEs in score-based and reflected diffusion models
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: AI for Stochastic Dynamics
summary:
Probability-flow ordinary differential equations (PF-ODEs) are widely used as deterministic samplers for score-based diffusion models. Their usual justification is that the Fokker--Planck equation of a diffusion can be rewritten as a continuity equation driven by the score function of the forward diffusion. This identity does not, however, guarantee that the resulting velocity field generates a well-posed flow. We provide theoretical insights into the design of such deterministic samplers for generative models based on diffusions and reflected diffusions. We identify sufficient conditions for a regular Lagrangian PF-ODE flow to exist; reverse sampling and invertibility require two-sided divergence control. For learned scores, sampler stability is controlled by an unweighted velocity error, exposing a mismatch with density-weighted score matching and motivating architectural control of Jacobians, divergence, growth, and compression. Under the manifold hypothesis, positive-time regularization justifies an early-stopped PF-ODE while constants deteriorate near the data endpoint; an explicit sphere example shows that the exact deterministic flow becomes singular as the noise level vanishes even though the diffusion marginals remain well defined.
  These theoretical insights translate into concrete design principles for stable, invertible, and constraint-preserving diffusion samplers. We illustrate the practical relevance of these design principles using controlled numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上研究基于扩散与反射扩散的确定性采样器（PF-ODE）的适定性，给出正则可解流存在的充分条件，并提出稳定、可逆、保约束采样器的设计原则，辅以数值实验验证。
AI.motivation: PF-ODE 作为扩散模型的确定性采样器被广泛使用，常规理由是把扩散的 Fokker–Planck 方程改写为由前向扩散 score 驱动的连续性方程。但作者指出：该恒等式并不能保证所得到的速度场能生成适定（well-posed）的流，因此需要重新审视确定性采样器设计的理论基础。
AI.method: 1) 针对扩散与反射扩散的生成模型，给出正则可解 PF-ODE 流存在的充分条件；2) 分析逆向采样与可逆性所需的双侧散度控制（two-sided divergence control）；3) 对学习到的 score，分析采样稳定性由未加权速度误差控制，揭示其与密度加权 score matching 之间的错配，进而提出对 Jacobian、散度、增长与压缩的架构层面控制；4) 在流形假设下讨论正时间正则化，论证提前停止（early-stopped）PF-ODE 的合理性，并指出常数在数据端点附近会退化；5) 以显式球面例子说明噪声水平趋于零时精确确定性流变为奇异，而扩散边缘分布仍良定义。
AI.result: 得到一组关于 PF-ODE 适定性的理论结论：可解流存在的充分条件、可逆性依赖双侧散度控制、稳定性由未加权速度误差控制、以及流形假设下正则化常数在数据端点附近的退化与球面例子中流的奇异性（尽管边缘分布仍良定义）。这些结论被转化为可操作的设计原则。
AI.conclusion: 理论洞见可转化为设计稳定、可逆且保约束的扩散采样器的具体原则，并通过受控数值实验说明其实用相关性。

title: On leading Gopakumar--Vafa invariants of local $\mathbb{P}^2$ and leading Betti numbers of moduli spaces of one-dimensional sheaves on $\mathbb{P}^2$
summary: In this paper we use the topological vertex formalism to derive a structural formula for the leading terms of the generating series of Gromov--Witten invariants of local $\mathbb P^2$. Then we give two applications of this formula. First we use this result to derive an explicit formula for the leading terms of the transformed Gopakumar--Vafa invariants of local $\mathbb P^2$. This is an extension of a formula of Guo--Zhou \cite{gz} from degree $2d-5$ to $3d-1$, and shares some similar features with the famous Göttsche--Yau--Zaslow formula. And as the second application, we prove Guo--Wu--Moreira's Conjecture \cite{gw} about the leading Betti numbers of the moduli space of one-dimensional Gieseker semistable sheaves on $\mathbb P^2$.

AI.tldr: 利用拓扑顶点形式推导局部 $\mathbb P^2$ 的 Gromov--Witten 不变量的生成级数的首项结构公式，并给出两个应用。
AI.motivation: 推导局部 $\mathbb P^2$ 的 Gromov--Witten 不变量的生成级数的首项结构公式，并拓展 Guo--Zhou 的结果、证明 Guo--Wu--Moreira 猜想。
AI.method: 拓扑顶点形式 (topological vertex formalism)。
AI.result: 推导出局部 $\mathbb P^2$ 的变换 Gopakumar--Vafa 不变量的首项显式公式，将 Guo--Zhou 公式从度数 $2d-5$ 拓展到 $3d-1$，且具有与 Göttsche--Yau--Zaslow 公式相似的特征；同时证明了关于 $\mathbb P^2$ 上一维 Gieseker 半稳定层模空间的首个 Betti 数的 Guo--Wu--Moreira 猜想。
AI.conclusion: 该结构公式成功应用于推导 GV 不变量首项显式公式及证明 Guo--Wu--Moreira 猜想。

title: Accelerated Benders decomposition for bi-objective mixed integer programming
summary: We investigate bi-objective mixed integer programming to which Benders decomposition can be applied, a widely used technique for exploiting problem structures in real-world applications. Our study focuses on a sustainable supply chain network design problem that aims to minimise both economic and environmental objectives. To address the bi-objective nature, we employ the weighted sum method, which requires solving similar problems repeatedly with different weight values. To tackle this, we propose a straightforward acceleration technique that reuses Benders cuts generated in previous iterations of the weighted sum method. This approach enables the Benders decomposition master problem to be initialised with pre-generated cuts. Our computational experiments demonstrate that reusing these cuts significantly reduces computing time.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可应用Benders分解的双目标混合整数规划，聚焦于同时最小化经济与环境目标的可持续供应链网络设计问题。为处理双目标特性，采用加权和法，并提出复用Benders割的加速技术，显著缩短计算时间。
AI.motivation: 双目标混合整数规划在可持续供应链网络设计等实际应用中十分常见，其结构适合用Benders分解求解；但加权和法需针对不同权重反复求解相似问题，计算成本高昂，亟需加速策略。
AI.method: 采用加权和法处理双目标问题；提出一种直接的加速技术，复用加权和法先前迭代中生成的Benders割，使Benders分解主问题能够以预生成的割进行初始化。
AI.result: 计算实验表明，复用Benders割能够显著减少计算时间。
AI.conclusion: 该割复用策略为加权和法求解双目标混合整数规划提供了一种有效的加速手段，具有实际应用价值。

title: Zero loci of Bernstein-Sato ideals are not necessarily linear
summary: We find a polynomial map the zero locus of whose Bernstein-Sato ideal is not linear, giving a counterexample to a conjecture of N. Budur.

AI.tldr: 构造出一个多项式映射，其Bernstein-Sato理想的零点轨迹非线性，从而否证了N. Budur的一个猜想。
AI.motivation: Budur曾猜想Bernstein-Sato理想的零点轨迹具有线性结构；验证或否证该猜想需要寻找反例。
AI.method: 显式构造一个多项式映射，并计算其Bernstein-Sato理想，分析其零点轨迹的几何形状。
AI.result: 所构造的多项式映射的Bernstein-Sato理想的零点轨迹不是线性的。
AI.conclusion: Budur关于Bernstein-Sato理想零点轨迹线性的猜想不成立，该反例表明需要修正或弱化原猜想。

title: Operator splitting methods for non-autonomous evolution equations comprising three parts, with application to the Bloch-Torrey equation of MRI
summary: In this paper we devise and analyze Lie Trotter splitting schemes for non-autonomous evolution equations, following two approaches: 1) A fully non-autonomous scheme, motivated by the potential use of explicit solutions of some subproblems. 2) A splitting scheme relying on the concept of Magnus integrators, where we freeze the operators at the beginning of each time interval as this suffices for first order convergence of the Lie-Trotter integrator. We derive first order convergence in a general setting and apply the analysis to the Bloch-Torrey equation of magnetic resonance imaging, where a decomposition into three subproblems is well-motivated by the physical role of the underlying operators. Numerical tests, complementing the time stepping scheme by a finite element space discretization, illustrate the theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析了两类用于非自治演化方程的Lie-Trotter分裂格式：全非自治格式与基于Magnus积分器的冻结算子格式，均达到一阶收敛，并将分析应用于MRI的Bloch-Torrey方程。
AI.motivation: 非自治演化方程难以直接求解，而分裂方法可利用子问题的显式解、降低计算复杂度。针对非自治情形，需要有理论保证的一阶分裂格式，并将其用于具有明确物理算符分解的Bloch-Torrey方程。
AI.method: 1) 全非自治Lie-Trotter分裂格式，便于利用某些子问题的显式解；2) 基于Magnus积分器思想的格式，在每个时间区间起点冻结算子（该处理足以保证Lie-Trotter积分器的一阶收敛）。在一般框架下推导一阶收敛性；对Bloch-Torrey方程按三个物理子问题分解；数值实验结合有限元空间离散。
AI.result: 在一般设定下证明了两类格式的一阶收敛性；对MRI的Bloch-Torrey方程给出了三子问题分解的适用性；数值测试（含有限元空间离散）验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的全非自治与算子冻结Lie-Trotter分裂格式在非自治演化方程中均具有一阶收敛性，能够利用物理上自然的算子分解，并可用于Bloch-Torrey方程的数值求解。

title: Mechanism-resolved phase-field fracture of composite shells with a certified admissible constitutive operator
summary: Phase-field models of fracture in fibre-reinforced shells are usually formulated against a single closed-form stored energy, so that the stress, consistent tangent and plane-stress condensation are derived and verified for that expression alone. Here the constitutive law enters instead as a replaceable operator. The Green-Lagrange strain of a geometrically exact Reissner-Mindlin shell is pulled back through the Cholesky factor of the reference metric and resolved on four mutually orthogonal invariants with an exact closure identity, making the separation into fibre, inter-fibre and interaction channels a change of basis rather than a modelling assumption. On a curved midsurface, the metric, Cholesky factor and fibre direction vary through the thickness through the shifter I - zeta b, and the invariants inherit that dependence. The tension-compression split, channel degradation, plane-stress condensation, consistent tangent and finite-element assembly are all expressed in the channel potentials and their derivatives, allowing either closed-form or learned operators. The fibre-transverse interaction energy is stored once and degraded by the product of the fields whose mechanisms it couples. Six conditions define admissible operators; the two linear invariants are proved convex in the deformation gradient, the geometric tangent is shown independent of the material tangent, and the plane-stress condensation is regular wherever the residual stiffness is positive. A three-tier protocol certifies the algebra, solver state and admission of a state as training data. Numerical studies on notched IM7/8552 shells verify the discretisation in thin and curved regimes and show that fibre orientation governs the damage envelope and load capacity, while curvature drives a through-thickness fracture asymmetry that a single midsurface field cannot represent.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种纤维增强壳体相场断裂模型，将本构律作为可替换算子，通过参考度量的Cholesky因子与四个正交不变量（含精确闭合恒等式）实现纤维/纤维间/相互作用通道的基变换表述，并统一处理拉压分解、通道退化、平面应力凝聚与一致切线。
AI.motivation: 已有纤维增强壳体相场模型通常针对单一闭式应变能构建，其应力、一致切线与平面应力凝聚仅对该表达式推导和验证，缺乏本构律的可替换性与通用性；同时弯曲中面上度量、纤维方向随厚度变化，单中面场难以刻画厚度方向的断裂不对称。
AI.method: 以几何精确Reissner-Mindlin壳的Green-Lagrange应变为基础，经参考度量Cholesky因子拉回，在四个相互正交的不变量上分解并满足精确闭合恒等式，使通道分离成为基变换而非建模假设；弯曲中面通过shifter I - ζb引入厚度依赖。给出六个可容许算子条件，证明两个线性不变量关于变形梯度凸、几何切线与材料切线独立、残余刚度正定时平面应力凝聚正则；建立三层协议校验代数、求解器状态与训练数据可容许性。
AI.result: 在带缺口IM7/8552壳体上的数值研究验证了薄壁与弯曲工况下的离散化；纤维方向控制损伤包络与承载能力；曲率驱动厚度方向断裂不对称，而单中面场无法表征这一现象。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将本构律抽象为可替换算子，实现了闭式与学习型本构的兼容，并证明相关数学性质与正则性，从而在弯曲纤维增强壳体中捕捉到单中面场无法表示的厚度方向断裂不对称。

title: Excitation of non-modal perturbations in hypersonic boundary layers by free stream forcing. Part III: effects of wall temperature and nose bluntness
summary: This paper constitutes Part III of a series investigating the excitation of non-modal perturbations in hypersonic blunt-nose boundary layers. Based on the numerical shock-fitting harmonic linearised Navier-Stokes (SF-HLNS) approach presented in Part I (Zhao & Dong, J. Fluid Mech. 2025, vol. 1013: A44) and the asymptotic analysis developed in Part II (Dong et al., J. Fluid Mech., under review), the present work focuses specifically on the influence of nose bluntness (Reynolds number R) and wall temperature T_w on receptivity efficiency through seven detailed case studies. Analysed via the three-step asymptotic model, the downstream perturbation amplitude is governed by two distinct factors: the stagnation vorticity perturbation, determined through shock-perturbation interaction and the slow-down convection mechanism, and the parabolic evolution of non-modal perturbations driven by the lift-up mechanism. Increasing R strongly amplifies the stagnation vorticity response, with only mild enhancement of the lift-up effect. In contrast, decreasing T_w strengthens the stagnation vorticity perturbation, but slightly weakens the lift-up effect; the net result is an overall intensification of the downstream perturbation amplitude with decreasing T_w. Furthermore, explicit scaling laws for receptivity efficiency with respect to R and T_w are established. This study completes the theoretical foundation for non-modal receptivity in hypersonic blunt boundary layers, and serves as a key step toward a physics-based transition prediction framework.

AI.tldr: 本文是高超声速钝头边界层非模态感受性系列的第三部分，通过七个算例研究头部钝度（雷诺数R）与壁温T_w对感受性效率的影响，并用三步渐近模型揭示下游扰动幅值由驻点涡量扰动与lift-up机制共同决定，给出显式标度律。
AI.motivation: 前两部分已建立数值方法（SF-HLNS）与渐近分析框架，但头部钝度与壁温如何定量影响非模态感受性效率尚不明确，需要系统参数研究以完善高超声速钝头边界层非模态感受性理论，支撑基于物理的转捩预测。
AI.method: 基于第一部分提出的激波拟合谐波线性化Navier-Stokes（SF-HLNS）方法，结合第二部分发展的三步渐近模型，针对头部钝度（雷诺数R）与壁温T_w设计七个算例开展参数研究，将下游扰动幅值分解为驻点涡量扰动（由激波-扰动相互作用与减速对流机制决定）与lift-up机制驱动的非模态扰动抛物型演化两部分。
AI.result: 增大R显著增强驻点涡量响应，对lift-up效应仅有轻微强化；降低T_w增强驻点涡量扰动但略削弱lift-up效应，净效应是随T_w降低下游扰动幅值整体增强；并建立了感受性效率关于R与T_w的显式标度律。
AI.conclusion: 本研究完善了高超声速钝头边界层非模态感受性的理论基础，是迈向基于物理的转捩预测框架的关键一步。

title: An Absorbing State Model with an Emergent Ising Transition
summary: We study a dynamical model of repulsive needles with centers fixed on a square lattice. Needles that overlap are active and receive a repulsive rotation $ θ\in [0,ε)$; needles with no overlap do not move. This model exhibits an absorbing state transition. Nematic order was observed for long needles. For a range of needle lengths and $ε$, the system self-organizes into a state with checkerboard symmetry. As $ε$ is increased, this phase melts and becomes disordered. Remarkably, we find that this phase boundary exhibits critical exponents identical to those of the equilibrium 2D Ising model.

AI.tldr: 该文研究固定于方格点阵中心的排斥性“针”动力学模型：重叠针获得[0,ε)的排斥旋转，非重叠针不动，系统呈现吸收态相变与长针向列序，并在一定长度与ε范围内自组织出棋盘对称相，随ε增大熔化；该相界临界指数与二维平衡Ising模型一致。
AI.motivation: 作者希望理解一个由简单几何排斥与局域旋转规则驱动的非平衡动力学系统，其能否出现吸收态相变、向列序与自发对称破缺相，并检验非平衡相变是否可与平衡二维Ising普适类对应。
AI.method: 构建方格点阵上中心固定的排斥性针模型；统计重叠针为“活跃”并施加[0,ε)的随机排斥旋转，非重叠针保持静止；通过改变针长与旋转幅度ε进行数值模拟，观测序参量、向列序与棋盘对称相，并用临界指数分析熔化相变。
AI.result: 模型表现出吸收态相变；长针出现向列序；在部分针长与ε参数区间内系统自组织为棋盘对称态；随ε增大该有序相熔化并转为无序；该相界临界指数与平衡二维Ising模型相同。
AI.conclusion: 该非平衡排斥针动力学模型可产生吸收态转变及棋盘对称有序相，其有序—无序相变属于二维Ising普适类，说明简单非平衡规则也能导致与平衡临界现象相同的普适行为。

title: Slow motion for the time-fractional Allen-Cahn equation with linear and nonlinear diffusion
summary: We study the slow motion of phase transition layers for a time-fractional Allen--Cahn equation with a Caputo time derivative of order $α\in(0,1)$. We show that the fractional memory preserves the distinction between exponentially and algebraically slow dynamics associated with non-degenerate and degenerate potentials, respectively. In the non-degenerate case, layered solutions persist on an exponentially long time scale of order $\exp(A/(α\varepsilon))$, $A>0$, while in the degenerate case the corresponding algebraic time scale is modified by the factor $1/α$. Finally, we extend the analysis to nonlinear diffusion operators, considering both the $p$-Laplacian and a Perona--Malik type diffusion, showing that the same fractional slow-motion mechanism persists in these more general settings.

AI.tldr: 时间分数阶Allen--Cahn方程（Caputo导数，阶$\alpha\in(0,1)$）中相变层慢速运动：分数记忆保持非退化与退化势对应指数/代数慢速动力学的区分；非退化情形层状解持续指数长时间尺度$\exp(A/(\alpha\varepsilon))$，退化情形代数时间尺度被$1/\alpha$修正；并推广至$p$-Laplacian与Perona--Malik型非线性扩散。
AI.motivation: 经典Allen--Cahn方程中，非退化势对应指数长时间尺度的慢速运动、退化势对应代数时间尺度；已有工作未刻画时间分数阶（Caputo，阶$\alpha\in(0,1)$）如何影响该慢速动力学，以及这种刻画能否推广到更一般的非线性扩散算子。
AI.method: 针对含Caputo时间导数的时间分数阶Allen--Cahn方程，分析相变层（界面）的慢速运动，采用渐近展开与奇异摄动（层状解、内层/外层匹配）方法，分别处理非退化势与退化势，并借助分数阶记忆核估计长时间行为；进一步将分析推广至$p$-Laplacian及Perona--Malik型非线性扩散算子。
AI.result: 分数阶记忆保持指数与代数慢速动力学的区分：非退化情形层状解在$\exp(A/(\alpha\varepsilon))$量级的指数长时间尺度上持续存在；退化情形对应代数时间尺度被因子$1/\alpha$修正；在$p$-Laplacian和Perona--Malik型非线性扩散下，相同的分数阶慢速运动机制依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 时间分数阶记忆不改变非退化/退化势所决定慢速动力学类型，仅对时间尺度作$\alpha$相关的定量修正（指数标度含$1/\alpha$、代数标度乘$1/\alpha$），该结论对一般非线性扩散算子（$p$-Laplacian、Perona--Malik型）稳健成立。

title: Where Does Jagged Competence Come From?
summary: Capable systems often show jagged competence: low average error alongside failures on particular inputs. We ask where it comes from in a task built from two known layers. A lower layer A computes five per-slot sums from records; an upper layer B uses the slot-1 sum and a mode carried over from earlier boards to predict the next board's category, so B cannot be computed from the current A alone: B is a strict extension of A. We train small recurrent networks on B and measure, against exact ground truth, what they acquire of A. The central finding is that learning B gives the network a jagged version of A, measured through probe readability and supervised outputs. It is readable where B needs it (slot 1, 97-98% by a linear probe) and becomes less readable where B does not (the other slots, 5-10%); category misreads concentrate near the slot-1 cutoffs; and when A is trained explicitly it comes out only approximately right. The networks show jagged competence in B: natural KL below $3\times10^{-4}$ bits coexists with a maximum law TV of about 0.25 on constructed histories. Matched experiments show that even a good A is not enough: connecting a learned A to B cuts misreads 1.3 to 17-fold, the same exact A gives fewer misreads as one-hot inputs (0-2) than as numerical inputs (10-317), one B update makes an exact A inexact unless the B gradient is blocked, and exact A still leaves some B failures. In this task, uneven acquisition, access and preservation of the lower theory explain part of the jagged competence of a network that learns the theory built on it; some failures remain unexplained. Whether the same holds in larger systems is a test to run.

AI.tldr: 通过在两层任务中训练小型循环网络，发现学习上层理论会使网络获得"参差不齐"的下层理论：仅在需要处可读、被语义漂移干扰，且即使下层精确也无法保证上层无错。
AI.motivation: 能力强的系统的"参差胜任"（平均误差低但个别输入失败）来源不明，作者希望在一个可精确验证真值、由两层已知结构组成的任务中定位其机制。
AI.method: 构造两层任务：下层A从记录中计算五个逐槽求和；上层B用槽1求和与跨板传来的mode预测下一板的类别，故B无法仅由当前A算出。训练小型循环网络学习B，用线性探针可读性与监督输出、对构造历史的KL与全变差(TV)误差、以及匹配实验（将学习到的A接入B、one-hot vs 数值输入、单次B更新是否阻塞B梯度）来量化网络对A的获取、访问与保持。
AI.result: 学习B得到的A是"参差"的：槽1可读性97-98%，其他槽仅5-10%；类别误读集中在槽1截断点附近；显式训练A也只近似正确。B本身自然KL<3e-4比特，但构造历史上最大TV约0.25。匹配实验显示：接入学习到的A使误读降低1.3至17倍；同一精确A以one-hot输入(0-2)比数值输入(10-317)误读更少；一次B更新即可让精确A变不精确（除非阻塞B梯度）；精确A仍留下部分B失败。
AI.conclusion: 下层理论的获取不均、访问受限与保持不佳，部分解释了学习其上理论的网络的参差胜任；仍有失败未被解释，是否在更大系统中成立有待检验。

title: A proof of GW/DT4 conjecture on local projective plane
summary: We prove a closed formula for DT4 invariants of one dimensional stable sheaves on the total space of $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^2}(-1,-2)$ for all degree curve classes. During the proof, orientations of moduli spaces are chosen in a canonical way. Combining with Gopakumar-Vafa type invariants proposed and computed by Klemm-Pandharipande, we verify a conjecture proposed by the author, Maulik and Toda.

AI.tldr: 该文给出了 $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^2}(-1,-2)$ 全空间上一维稳定层的 DT4 不变量的封闭公式，并验证了作者与 Maulik、Toda 提出的猜想。
AI.motivation: DT4 不变量（四维 Donaldson-Thomas 理论）在一维稳定层情形下缺乏显式计算结果，且其模空间定向选择通常不唯一，需要给出规范定向。同时，Klemm-Pandharipande 提出的 Gopakumar-Vafa 型不变量与该理论之间的关系尚待验证，作者与 Maulik、Toda 的猜想亦需检验。
AI.method: 在全空间 $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^2}(-1,-2)$ 上研究一维稳定层，对所有次数曲线类证明 DT4 不变量的封闭公式；证明过程中以规范方式选取模空间的定向；并结合 Klemm-Pandharipande 提出并计算的 Gopakumar-Vafa 型不变量进行对照与计算。
AI.result: 得到了对所有次数曲线类成立的 DT4 不变量封闭公式，并在规范定向选取下，通过与 Gopakumar-Vafa 型不变量的结合，验证了作者、Maulik 与 Toda 提出的猜想。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了 $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^2}(-1,-2)$ 上一维稳定层 DT4 不变量的显式公式，并证实了相关猜想，为 DT4 理论与 Gopakumar-Vafa 型不变量之间的联系提供了证据。

title: Learning in Large Populations With Anticipatory Payoffs: Bregman Meets Willems and Lyapunov
summary: We study evolutionary Nash equilibrium learning in large populations whose payoffs are generated by dynamic mechanisms. Counterclockwise dissipativity (CCW) provides a passivity-like framework for establishing learning/convergence under a broad convex cone of so-called well-behaved learning rules satisfying a natural payoff-alignment condition according to which, away from equilibria, the population's state (strategic profile) moves in a direction positively correlated with the payoffs. The cone is closed under conic combinations and encompasses a broad range of noise-free rules, including discontinuous rules such as best response, imitative rules such as the replicator rule that is not $δ$-passive, and all noise-free $δ$-passive rules. Existing CCW results require no knowledge of the particular rule, but establish convergence without providing a Lyapunov function or Lyapunov stability. We develop a methodology that closes this gap by constructing rule-independent Lyapunov functions from CCW storage functions of the payoff mechanism. For a nonlinear class of anticipatory mechanisms, in which agents compare current payoffs with those associated with a smoothed population state, we show that a storage can be derived as a Bregman divergence. The resulting Lyapunov function combines a potential gap with this divergence and establishes global asymptotic stability. A congestion game with a nonlinear congestion-growth toll illustrates the results.

AI.tldr: 本文在逆时针耗散（CCW）框架下，为一大类无噪声学习规则的演化 Nash 均衡学习构造了与规则无关的 Lyapunov 函数，并针对带预期机制的非线性博弈证明全局渐近稳定性。
AI.motivation: 已有 CCW 结果虽能在不依赖具体规则的情况下证明收敛，但既不给出 Lyapunov 函数，也不建立 Lyapunov 稳定性，因而无法刻画收敛的定量性质与稳定性强度。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 以支付机制的 CCW 存储函数为基础，构造与学习规则无关的 Lyapunov 函数；对一类非线性预期机制（个体将当前支付与平滑种群状态对应的支付进行比较），证明其存储函数可表示为 Bregman 散度，并将该散度与势能间隙组合成 Lyapunov 函数。
AI.result: 所构造的 Lyapunov 函数由势能间隙与 Bregman 散度组成，据此建立了学习的全局渐近稳定性；并通过带有非线性拥堵增长收费的拥堵博弈示例验证了结论。
AI.conclusion: CCW 存储函数可系统性地转化为规则无关的 Lyapunov 函数，从而在保持规则无关性的同时获得 Lyapunov 稳定性与全局渐近稳定性；该方法论适用于包括最优反应、复制动态等广泛的无噪声规则。

title: Conditioning and Singular Value Distribution of Jacobi Weighted Histopolation Matrices
summary: In this paper, we first study the singular value distribution of the unscaled matrices arising from Jacobi weighted histopolation. For the Jacobi weight with parameters $(α,β)$, and using the Jacobi basis with parameters $(α+1,β+1)$, we previously proved that, for $α,β>1/2$ and quasi-uniform meshes, the growth of these matrices in the sense of singular value distribution is slower than any positive power of the logarithm of the matrix size. However, the numerical behavior of the unscaled matrices suggested a nontrivial singular value symbol, which we identify explicitly in this paper. Starting from the standard asymptotic formula for Jacobi polynomials, we derive an asymptotic representation of the weighted cell averages defining the entries of the histopolation matrices. This representation allows us to analyze the associated Gram sequence by means of GLT theory. We identify its GLT symbol and, consequently, we obtain the singular value distribution of the histopolation matrices for any $α,β>-1$. We also characterize the set $\mathcal Z$ where the resulting symbol vanishes and compute its measure, showing that this set depends only on the mesh, while the Jacobi parameters affect the values of the symbol on its support. When this measure is positive, the singular value distribution implies the discrete asymptotic ill-posedness of the problem, while a comparison with the Toeplitz setting suggests exponential growth of the spectral condition number. When the measure of $\mathcal Z$ is zero, the problem is well-posed and the observed conditioning is algebraic in the matrix size. Finally, numerical experiments supporting the theoretical findings are reported and discussed, while conclusions are given in the final section of the current work together with a few open problems.
