AI.tldr: 本文研究了Jacobi加权直方插值（histopolation）中未缩放矩阵的奇异值分布，通过GLT理论显式识别其奇异值符号，并刻画符号零点集及其测度对问题适定性的影响。
AI.motivation: 此前作者证明了在α,β>1/2及拟一致网格下，未缩放矩阵的奇异值增长慢于矩阵尺寸对数的任意正幂，但数值实验暗示存在非平凡的奇异值符号，本文旨在显式确定该符号并推广到任意α,β>-1。
AI.method: 从Jacobi多项式的标准渐近公式出发，推导定义直方插值矩阵元素的加权单元平均的渐近表示，进而用GLT（广义局部Toeplitz）理论分析相应的Gram序列，识别其GLT符号。
AI.result: 得到了任意α,β>-1下直方插值矩阵的奇异值分布，刻画了符号零点集𝒵并计算其测度：𝒵仅依赖网格，而Jacobi参数影响符号在支撑上的取值。当𝒵测度为正时，奇异值分布意味着问题的离散渐近不适定，且与Toeplitz情形比较暗示谱条件数呈指数增长；当𝒵测度为零时，问题适定，条件数随矩阵尺寸呈代数增长。数值实验支持了理论结论。
AI.conclusion: Jacobi加权直方插值矩阵的奇异值符号被显式识别，其零点集测度决定了问题的适定性：正测度导致离散渐近不适定与指数条件数增长，零测度则对应适定与代数条件数增长，最后给出了若干开放问题。

title: MUTACO: Simulator-Efficient Response Matching in Stochastic Nonlinear Systems via Compatibility-Aware Sequential Design
summary: Many physical inverse problems are mediated by expensive stochastic simulators for which response gradients, adjoint sensitivities, or a differentiable simulator interface are unavailable. We introduce Multiple Target-based Confident Acquisition (MUTACO), an uncertainty-aware sequential-design method for response matching that requires only noisy forward evaluations and learns the multicomponent response together with its predictive uncertainty. We develop and evaluate MUTACO for a disordered network of stochastic phase oscillators. The inverse task is to infer statistical properties of the local potential and interactions from macroscopic rotation and synchronization curves under multiple driving conditions. Rather than requiring unique recovery of these statistical properties, MUTACO searches for parameter configurations whose predicted rotation and synchronization responses are compatible with the target response while accounting for predictive uncertainty. This response-centered formulation is appropriate when experimentally accessible observables characterize ensemble statistics rather than a particular microscopic realization. Under strictly limited simulation budgets, MUTACO achieves the lowest held-out response error among the tested adaptive-search, space-filling, and simulation-based inference methods, while also yielding lower parameter-recovery error than the compared methods. These results demonstrate that response-targeted sequential design is a simulator-efficient approach to inverse modeling from finite noisy forward evaluations and suggest broader applicability to stochastic physical systems with correlated multicomponent responses and weakly constrained parameter directions.

AI.tldr: 提出不确定性感知的序列设计方法 MUTACO，仅用噪声前向评估即可进行多目标响应匹配逆建模，在随机相位振子网络逆问题中以最低仿真预算取得最优响应误差与参数恢复精度。
AI.motivation: 许多物理逆问题依赖昂贵的随机仿真器，且无法获得响应梯度、伴随灵敏度或可微仿真接口，传统基于梯度和模拟推断的方法难以适用；同时实验可观测的往往是系综统计量而非某一次微观实现，因此不必强求参数唯一恢复，而应关注预测响应与目标响应的一致性。
AI.method: 提出 MUTACO（Multiple Target-based Confident Acquisition），一种不确定性感知的序列设计方法，仅需噪声前向评估，联合学习多分量响应及其预测不确定性；以响应匹配为目标，在多驱动条件下从宏观旋转与同步曲线推断局部势与相互作用的统计性质，搜索在预测不确定性下与目标响应兼容的参数配置。
AI.result: 在无序随机相位振子网络逆任务中，于严格受限的仿真预算下，MUTACO 在留出响应误差上优于所比较的自适应搜索、空间填充和基于模拟的推断方法，同时参数恢复误差也更低。
AI.conclusion: 以响应为目标的序列设计是一种仿真高效的逆建模途径，适用于仅有有限噪声前向评估的情形，并可推广至具有相关多分量响应和弱约束参数方向的随机物理系统。

title: Weakly Nonlinear Analysis of Phototactic Bioconvection under Thermal Buoyancy
summary: A weakly nonlinear stability analysis is performed to investigate the influence of thermal buoyancy on phototactic bioconvection in a suspension of swimming microorganisms confined between horizontal boundaries and subjected to bottom heating or cooling. The objective is to examine how thermal forcing modifies the post-critical evolution of bioconvective instability through its influence on bifurcation behaviour and finite-amplitude convection. Linear stability theory is first employed to determine the critical conditions for the onset of convection. The corresponding direct and adjoint eigenvalue problems, together with the second-order resolvent system, are then solved numerically to derive the Stuart-Landau amplitude equation governing the nonlinear evolution of disturbances. A systematic analysis is carried out for varying thermal Rayleigh numbers. The results show that, as the thermal Rayleigh number approaches the classical Rayleigh-Benard critical value, the critical bioconvection Rayleigh number decreases to zero, indicating a gradual transition from phototaxis-dominated to thermally driven convection. The computed positive Landau coefficient predicts supercritical pitchfork and Hopf bifurcations for stationary and oscillatory instabilities, respectively. In parameter regimes with oscillatory onset, increasing the thermal Rayleigh number drives a transition from a supercritical Hopf bifurcation to a supercritical pitchfork bifurcation. The nonlinear dynamics are further characterized through amplitude evolution, phase portraits, potential functions, and finite-amplitude flow structures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过弱非线性稳定性分析，研究热浮力对水平夹层中趋光微生物悬浮液生物对流的影响，推导Stuart-Landau振幅方程并刻画分岔行为与有限振幅对流结构。
AI.motivation: 探讨热浮力（底部加热或冷却）如何通过影响分岔行为和有限振幅对流，改变生物对流不稳定性的超临界演化。
AI.method: 先以线性稳定性理论确定对流起始的临界条件；再数值求解直接与伴随特征值问题及二阶预解系统，导出支配扰动非线性演化的Stuart-Landau振幅方程；针对不同热瑞利数进行系统分析。
AI.result: 当热瑞利数趋近经典Rayleigh-Bénard临界值时，临界生物对流瑞利数降至零，表明由趋光主导逐渐转为热驱动对流；Landau系数为正，预示定常与振荡不稳定分别对应超临界叉式分岔与Hopf分岔；在振荡失稳参数区，增大热瑞利数使超临界Hopf分岔转变为超临界叉式分岔。
AI.conclusion: 热浮力显著调控生物对流的分岔类型与非线性动力学，并借助振幅演化、相图、势函数及有限振幅流结构加以刻画。

title: Transport, Hall Effect, and Collective Dynamics of Driven Particles in Active Chiral Media
summary: We examine the dc driven transport of particles with Yukawa interactions through an assembly of chiral active particles undergoing circular motion. The driven particles exhibit a jammed phase, a nonlinear disordered or plastic regime where there is a finite Hall effect produced by interactions with the active chiral particles, and a high drive linear regime where the driven and nondriven particles phase separate and the Hall effect nearly disappears. The chiral particles experience strong drag and Hall effects from the driven particles, and these effects vary monotonically with changing thermal fluctuations or chiral motion parameters. The different dynamical phases are correlated with features in the longitudinal and transverse transport curves, and we map out the phases as a function of active orbit size, thermal fluctuations, and particle density.

AI.tldr: 研究了Yukawa相互作用粒子在直流驱动下穿过手性活性粒子集合的输运行为，揭示了阻塞相、塑性非线性相（存在霍尔效应）和高驱动线性相（相分离且霍尔效应消失）三种动力学相，并绘制了相图。
AI.motivation: 探究驱动粒子与手性活性粒子（做圆周运动）相互作用时的输运特性，理解活性手性运动如何影响霍尔效应及相行为。
AI.method: 对具有Yukawa相互作用的粒子施加直流驱动，使其穿过由做圆周运动的手性活性粒子组成的介质；考察纵向与横向（霍尔）输运曲线随轨道尺寸、热涨落和粒子密度的变化。
AI.result: 观察到三种动力学相：阻塞相；由与手性活性粒子相互作用产生有限霍尔效应的非线性无序（塑性）区；以及驱动粒子与非驱动粒子相分离、霍尔效应几乎消失的高驱动线性区。手性粒子受驱动粒子作用出现强拖曳与霍尔效应，且随热涨落或手性运动参数单调变化。
AI.conclusion: 不同动力学相与纵向、横向输运曲线特征相对应，并绘制了以活性轨道尺寸、热涨落和粒子密度为参数的相图。

title: Existence and stability of shock profiles for a one-dimensional full compressible Navier--Stokes--Poisson equations
summary: This paper studies the existence and asymptotic stability of traveling shock waves for the one-dimensional full compressible Navier--Stokes--Poisson equations, which model viscous heat-conducting ions in a self-consistent electrostatic field. We first prove the existence and uniqueness of a smooth shock profile of small amplitude by the center manifold theorem, and then establish its large-time asymptotic stability under suitably small smooth perturbations. The proof is based on an energy estimate for a specially constructed integrated system derived from the full compressible Navier--Stokes--Poisson equations. To carry out this estimate, we introduce suitable anti-derivative variables that incorporate the effects of the self-consistent electrostatic potential and heat conduction, thereby reformulating the original system as a dissipative integrated one. The subsequent energy estimates are completed by carefully handling the induced couplings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一维完全可压缩Navier--Stokes--Poisson方程行激波的存在性与大时间渐近稳定性，通过中心流形定理证明小振幅光滑激波剖面的存在唯一性，并对特殊构造的积分系统进行能量估计，建立了小光滑扰动下的渐近稳定性。
AI.motivation: 完全可压缩Navier--Stokes--Poisson方程刻画了自洽静电场中粘性导热离子的运动，其行激波的存在性与稳定性是理解该类耗散-电场耦合系统渐近行为的关键问题，然而耦合静电势与热传导使得经典分析面临挑战。
AI.method: 先利用中心流形定理证明小振幅光滑激波剖面的存在唯一性；随后对原方程进行积分变换，引入能同时吸收自洽静电势与热传导效应的反导数变量，将原系统重写为耗散的积分系统，再通过精细处理诱导耦合项完成能量估计，进而构造稳定性证明。
AI.result: 证明了小振幅光滑激波剖面的存在唯一性，并在适当小的光滑扰动下建立了该剖面的整体大时间渐近稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将中心流形与积分系统能量估计方法成功推广至包含自洽静电势和热传导的完全可压缩Navier--Stokes--Poisson方程，为这类电场耦合耗散系统行波解的稳定性研究提供了有效框架。

title: LLM-enhanced spatio-temporal learning for grid-level docked bike sharing demand prediction
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC)
summary: Short-term bike-sharing demand forecasting is complicated by spatial-temporal non-stationarity and the practical difficulty of incorporating unstructured external text into numerical pipelines. Conventional approaches rely on historical flow sequences and fixed graph structures, thereby constraining their accuracy when anomalous social events perturb normal travel patterns. We propose a forecasting framework in which a Large Language Model (LLM) drives a semantic shockwave mechanism that converts free-form urban text, such as municipal event schedules, local news, and transit bulletins, into quantified spatial-temporal perturbation fields. The LLM extracts three physically interpretable parameters per event (intensity, spatial reach, and temporal lag), from which Gaussian decay fields are constructed and injected into a Zero-Inflated Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (ZI-ASTGCN). To handle the pronounced sparsity of grid-level measurements, the model couples a dual-branch output head with a multi-task zero-inflated loss that jointly trains a gating probability and a conditional flow intensity. Experiments on the operational Barcelona Bicing dataset show that ZI-ASTGCN outperforms established neural baselines, with particularly strong gains during high-demand periods, validating the utility of physics-grounded semantic signals in spatial-temporal mobility forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文将LLM驱动的语义冲击波机制与零膨胀自适应时空图卷积网络（ZI-ASTGCN）结合，把城市非结构化文本转化为量化时空扰动场，提升共享单车短期需求预测精度。
AI.motivation: 共享单车短期需求预测受时空非平稳性困扰，且非结构化外部文本难以融入数值预测流程；传统方法依赖历史流量序列与固定图结构，当异常社会事件扰动正常出行模式时精度受限。
AI.method: 提出由LLM驱动的语义冲击波机制：从市政活动日程、本地新闻、交通公告等自由文本中，为每个事件抽取三个具物理可解释性的参数（强度、空间影响范围、时间滞后），据此构建高斯衰减场并注入ZI-ASTGCN。针对网格级测量的强稀疏性，模型采用双分支输出头与多任务零膨胀损失，联合训练门控概率与条件流量强度。
AI.result: 在巴塞罗那Bicing实际运营数据集上，ZI-ASTGCN优于已有神经基线，在高需求时段提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了物理可解释的语义信号在时空出行需求预测中的有效性。

title: Adaptive Partitioning Schemes for Optimistic Optimization
summary: Applications such as engineering design often require us to optimize a black-box function, i.e., a system whose inner processing is not analytically known and whose gradients are not available. Practitioners often have a fixed budget for the number of function evaluations and the performance of an optimization algorithm is measured by its simple regret. In this paper, we study the class of "Optimistic Optimization" algorithms for black-box optimization that use a partitioning scheme for the domain. We develop algorithms that learn a good partitioning scheme and use flexible surrogate models such as neural networks in the optimization procedure. For multi-index functions on an $m$-dimensional subspace within $d$ dimensions, our algorithm attains $\tilde{O}(n^{-β/ d})$ regret, where $β= 1 + \frac{d-m}{2m-1}$, as opposed to $\tilde{O}(n^{-1/d})$ for SequOOL, a state-of-the-art optimistic optimization algorithm. We use our approach to improve the quality of Activation-aware Weight Quantization (AWQ) of the OPT-1.3B model, achieving $\sim10\%$ improvement in performance relative to the best possible unquantized model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究黑盒函数优化，提出可学习划分方案并结合神经网络代理模型的乐观优化算法，在特定多指标函数上取得优于SequOOL的遗憾界，并应用于AWQ量化改进。
AI.motivation: 工程设计中常需优化黑盒函数（内部机制未知、无梯度），且实际预算固定，性能以简单遗憾衡量。现有乐观优化算法（如SequOOL）划分方案固定、代理模型灵活性不足，遗憾界受限。
AI.method: 基于使用域划分的"乐观优化"算法类，提出能够学习良好划分方案的算法，并在优化过程中采用神经网络等灵活代理模型；针对$d$维空间内$m$维子空间上的多指标函数进行分析。
AI.result: 对多指标函数取得$\tilde{O}(n^{-\beta/d})$遗憾，其中$\beta=1+\frac{d-m}{2m-1}$，优于SequOOL的$\tilde{O}(n^{-1/d})$；同时用于改善OPT-1.3B模型的AWQ量化，性能相对最佳未量化模型提升约10%。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习划分方案与灵活代理模型，可显著改进乐观优化算法的理论遗憾界，并在大模型权重量化等实际任务中验证有效性。

title: The $L^1$-realization of an elliptic operator with unbounded coefficients
summary: We establish an $L^1$-theory for a class of elliptic operators with unbounded coefficients, extending the semigroup generation results of Boutiah et al. (J. Differential Equations 264 (2018), 2184--2204) and Canale et al. (Ann. Sc. Norm. Super. Pisa Cl. Sci. (5) 16 (2016), 581--601) to the endpoint $p=1$. The $L^1$-realization generates a positive analytic $C_0$-semigroup that is compact for every positive time. We characterize the generator domain through weighted estimates and prove consistency with the corresponding $L^p$-semigroups for $1<p<\infty$.

AI.tldr: 本文为带无界系数的椭圆算子建立 $L^1$-理论，将对 Boutiah 等与 Canale 等的半群生成结果推广至端点 $p=1$。
AI.motivation: 已有工作（Boutiah 等 2018；Canale 等 2016）在 $L^p$（$1<p<\infty$）框架下给出了带无界系数椭圆算子的半群生成结果，但端点情形 $p=1$ 尚未解决。端点 $L^1$ 的缺失使得理论不完整，尤其在需要保测度、概率解释或最优正则性的应用中。
AI.method: 建立 $L^1$-实现：在加权 $L^1$ 空间中构造算子实现，利用加权估计刻画生成元定义域；证明其生成正解析 $C_0$-半群。
AI.result: $L^1$-实现生成正解析 $C_0$-半群，且对每个正时刻 $t>0$ 该半群是紧的；通过加权估计给出了生成元定义域的刻画。
AI.conclusion: 证明了 $p=1$ 端点结果的成立，并验证其与 $1<p<\infty$ 的 $L^p$-半群的一致性，从而补全了带无界系数椭圆算子的 $L^p$ 半群理论。

title: Time-reliability optimization of multi-pass underfill dispensing sequences on printed circuit boards: a schedule-dependent reliability model solved by a multiset-permutation binary-addition-tree algorithm
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables. Submitted to Reliability Engineering & System Safety. Supplementary code and data (solvers, instances, reference fronts, heuristic archives, validation outputs, one-command test suite) accompany the journal submission and are available from the author
summary: Multi-pass underfill dispensing couples cycle time with process reliability because the sequence determines the inter-pass flow times. This paper formulates a tri-objective multiset-permutation routing model that minimises nominal cycle time and additive duration variance while maximising reliability under hard- and soft-dwell policies; reliability combines pass, schedule-dependent flow and travel terms. Under independent durations and deterministic dwell thresholds, the variance measure equals the cycle-time variance under soft dwell and bounds it from above under hard dwell. A multiset-permutation binary-addition-tree algorithm enumerates the feasible routes without duplication and prunes prefixes by dominance. Six instances, including three BeagleBone Black benchmarks, yield reference Pareto fronts, the largest search space of $1.47 \times 10^{12}$ routes in 38 minutes on 20 CPU cores. Among simulated candidates, the nominally cost-selected routes incur maximum estimated excess costs of USD 0.0014 per board at the modelled duration variability and USD 0.0035 with it doubled. Round-robin dispatch is within 3.7 % of the reference optimum at the tested costs; NSGA-II and simplified swarm optimisation show at most 0.53 % observed cost regret while recovering about 30 % of the largest hard-dwell front. The framework quantifies sequencing trade-offs and heuristic decision regret; physical reliability prediction requires inspection-based calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个三目标多重集排列路径模型，用于多道次底部填充点胶，同时最小化名义节拍时间与附加持续时间方差，并最大化硬/软驻留政策下的可靠性，通过多重集排列二进制加法树算法精确枚举可行路径并给出参考Pareto前沿。
AI.motivation: 多道次底部填充点胶中，各道次顺序决定道次间流动时间，从而使节拍时间与工艺可靠性相互耦合，需要量化排序权衡及启发式决策后悔。
AI.method: 构建三目标多重集排列路由模型（名义节拍时间、附加持续时间方差、可靠性；可靠性含道次项、调度相关流动项与行程项），在独立持续时间与确定性驻留阈值下，方差度量等于软驻留下的节拍时间方差并给出硬驻留下上界；采用多重集排列二进制加法树算法无重复枚举可行路径，并按支配关系剪枝前缀。
AI.result: 六个实例（含三个BeagleBone Black基准）给出参考Pareto前沿，最大搜索空间为1.47×10^12条路径，在20个CPU核上38分钟完成；模拟候选中，名义成本选出的路径在建模持续时间变异性下最大估计超额成本为每板0.0014美元，变异性翻倍时为0.0035美元；轮询调度在测试成本下距参考最优3.7%以内；NSGA-II与简化群优化的观测成本后悔至多0.53%，同时恢复最大硬驻留前沿约30%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架量化了排序权衡与启发式决策后悔；物理可靠性预测仍需基于检测的标定。

title: Fake quadrics with bounded cohomology property
summary: In this paper, we characterize fake quadrics $X$ satisfying the bounded cohomology property. Namely, there exists a constant $c_X>0$ such that $h^1(\mathcal O_X(C))\le c_X h^0(\mathcal O_X(C))$ for every curve $C$ on $X$.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了满足有界上同调性质的伪二次曲面（fake quadrics）X，即存在常数 c_X>0 使得对 X 上任意曲线 C 有 h^1(O_X(C)) ≤ c_X h^0(O_X(C))。
AI.motivation: 有界上同调性质是代数几何与双曲几何交叉领域中的重要研究对象，伪二次曲面作为具有特殊拓扑与几何性质的曲面类，其是否满足该性质尚需刻画，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 通过考察伪二次曲面 X 上的曲线 C 所对应线丛 O_X(C) 的上同调维数，寻找满足存在一致常数 c_X>0 使 h^1 被 h^0 控制的这类曲面，并对其进行分类刻画。
AI.result: 给出了满足有界上同调性质的伪二次曲面 X 的完整刻画。
AI.conclusion: 伪二次曲面满足有界上同调性质的条件被明确刻画，为后续研究此类曲面的几何与上同调性质提供了判据。

title: Arbitrarily High-Order Structure-Preserving Parametric Finite Element Methods for Geometric PDEs via Local Pullback Flow Maps
summary: We develop arbitrarily high-order structure-preserving parametric finite element methods for geometric PDEs including surface diffusion and volume-preserving mean curvature flow based on local pullback flow maps. The central idea is to reformulate the geometric PDEs on an arbitrary intermediate hypersurface and represent the subsequent evolution through a local pullback flow map. Using admissible local pullbacks, we derive two formulations from the corresponding pullback identities for the Laplace-Beltrami operator, referred to as the conformal and equidistribution formulations. We discretize both formulations using arbitrary-degree isoparametric finite elements and Runge-Kutta collocation methods with positive weights. For the conformal formulation, weighted averages of the normal-Jacobian vector ensure exact preservation of the enclosed area or volume, while algebraic stability of the Runge-Kutta method additionally guarantees dissipation of the perimeter or surface area. For the equidistribution formulation, a path-averaged normal-Jacobian vector and a geometric discrete gradient guarantee both exact preservation of the enclosed area or volume and dissipation of the perimeter or surface area, without requiring algebraic stability. Numerical experiments confirm the expected high-order accuracy and structure-preserving properties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于局部拉回流映射的任意高阶保结构参数化有限元方法，用于求解表面扩散与保体积平均曲率流等几何偏微分方程。
AI.motivation: 几何PDE（如表面扩散、保体积平均曲率流）具有面积/体积守恒及周长/表面积耗散等内在几何结构，传统数值方法难以同时实现任意高阶精度与结构保持，因此需要发展高阶保结构离散格式。
AI.method: 基于局部拉回流映射，将几何PDE重新表述在任意中间超曲面上，利用Laplace-Beltrami算子的拉回恒等式推导出共形（conformal）与等分布（equidistribution）两种表述；采用任意次等参有限元与正权重Runge-Kutta配点法离散。共形表述用法向-Jacobi向量的加权平均保证面积/体积精确守恒，RK代数稳定性进一步保证周长/表面积耗散；等分布表述用路径平均法向-Jacobi向量与几何离散梯度，无需代数稳定性即可同时实现守恒与耗散。
AI.result: 数值实验验证了所提方法具有预期的高阶精度以及保结构（守恒与耗散）性质。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为几何PDE提供了统一的高阶保结构离散途径，两种表述分别在不同条件下实现面积/体积守恒与周长/表面积耗散，具有良好的精度与结构保持能力。

title: A general synthetic iterative scheme with high-order spatial discretization for rarefied gas mixture flows
summary: We develop a high-order discontinuous Galerkin formulation of the general synthetic iterative scheme (GSIS) for steady rarefied gas mixture flows. The resulting GSIS-DG discretizes the mesoscopic kinetic equations for monatomic gas mixtures and the macroscopic synthetic equations with the same polynomial degree and solves them alternately. The kinetic solution supplies nonequilibrium corrections to the stress and heat flux, while the synthetic equations accelerate the convergence toward the steady state. Asymptotic analysis shows that GSIS-DG recovers the continuum limit without requiring the spatial mesh to resolve the molecular mean free path. Numerical results over a wide range of Knudsen numbers demonstrate high-order spatial accuracy and rapid steady-state convergence, with more than an order-of-magnitude reduction in computational cost relative to conventional kinetic iteration in the near-continuum regime. Comparisons with second-order finite-volume GSIS further demonstrate that GSIS-DG achieves comparable or better accuracy on coarser physical meshes with fewer total spatial degrees of freedom.

AI.tldr: 本文将广义合成迭代格式（GSIS）与高阶间断伽辽金（DG）方法结合，提出GSIS-DG格式，用于求解稳态稀薄气体混合物流动，实现了跨Knudsen数的高阶精度与快速稳态收敛。
AI.motivation: 稀薄气体流动的介观动理学方程求解面临两大困难：传统动理学迭代收敛慢（尤其在近连续区），且需要空间网格解析分子平均自由程。需要一种兼具高阶精度、能跨流域加速收敛、且不要求网格解析平均自由程的数值方法。已有GSIS多采用二阶有限体积，精度受限。
AI.method: 构建GSIS的高阶DG离散：对单原子气体混合物的介观动理学方程与宏观合成方程采用相同多项式阶数离散，并交替求解。动理学解为非平衡应力与热流的本构关系提供修正，宏观合成方程加速向稳态收敛。并进行渐近分析以考察连续极限行为。
AI.result: 渐近分析表明GSIS-DG在空间网格无需解析分子平均自由程的情况下即可恢复连续极限。数值实验在宽Knudsen数范围内展现了高阶空间精度与快速稳态收敛，近连续区计算成本较传统动理学迭代降低一个数量级以上；与二阶有限体积GSIS相比，在更粗物理网格、更少总空间自由度下达到相当或更优精度。
AI.conclusion: GSIS-DG是一种高效、高精度的稳态稀薄气体混合物流动求解方法，兼顾渐近保持特性与收敛加速，显著优于传统动理学迭代和二阶有限体积GSIS。

title: Landau damping and mode-selective instability of a vortex gas
summary: We show that a collisionless point-vortex gas behaves as a genuine Vlasov system. Starting from the non-canonical Hamiltonian structure of point-vortex dynamics, we derive a reduced Klimontovich equation and the corresponding Vlasov description directly on the physical plane, without introducing auxiliary momentum variables. The theory predicts a rich spectrum of collective phenomena, including vortex Rossby-like waves, global oscillations, resonant critical layers, and a dielectric response operator analogous to that of plasmas and self-gravitating systems. For smooth vortex distributions, differential rotation gives rise to a vortex analogue of Landau damping, whereby collective modes transfer energy and angular momentum to resonant vortex annuli in the absence of collisions or dissipation. Remarkably, differential rotation acts as a stringent mode-selection mechanism: for a Gaussian vortex cloud, only a single quadrupolar quasi-mode survives, while all higher multipoles are destroyed by phase mixing. We further predict a vortex counterpart of the beam--plasma instability, in which a thin vortex ring orbiting an Onsager patch selectively excites Kelvin modes with an azimuthal symmetry controlled by the ring population. These results establish kinetic theory as a natural framework for collective vortex dynamics and suggest new mechanisms for vortex transport, vortex avalanches, and rotational glitches in neutron-star superfluids.

AI.tldr: 该文证明无碰撞点涡气体可作为真正的Vlasov系统处理，直接在物理平面上导出约化Klimontovich方程与Vlasov描述，并预言了涡旋Rossby波、全局振荡、共振临界层、介电响应算符、涡旋版Landau阻尼、模式选择机制及束-等离子体不稳定性等一系列集体现象。
AI.motivation: 点涡动力学通常采用非正则Hamilton结构描述，需要引入辅助动量变量，物理图像不直观。作者希望建立类似等离子体与自引力系统的动理学理论框架，以统一理解无碰撞涡旋系统中的集体行为。
AI.method: 从点涡动力学的非正则Hamilton结构出发，不引入辅助动量变量，直接在物理平面上导出约化Klimontovich方程及其对应的Vlasov描述，并据此分析线性响应与集体模式。
AI.result: 理论预言了丰富的集体现象：涡旋Rossby类波、全局振荡、共振临界层以及与等离子体/自引力系统类似的介电响应算符。对光滑涡旋分布，差动旋转导致涡旋版Landau阻尼，集体模式在无碰撞、无耗散条件下向共振涡旋环带传递能量与角动量。差动旋转还充当严格的模式选择机制：高斯涡云中仅存单一四极准模式，更高多极矩被相位混合破坏。此外预言了束-等离子体不稳定性的涡旋对应物：绕Onsager斑块运动的薄涡环选择性激发Kelvin模，其方位对称性由环的粒子数控制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了动理学理论作为集体涡旋动力学自然框架的地位，并为涡旋输运、涡旋雪崩以及中子星超流体中的旋转突变等提供了新机制。

title: Casimir Force, Magnetization, and Susceptibility for \\ Ising Chain with an Impurity Atom in the Presence of an External Field
summary: The article contains exact results for the behavior of the Casimir force of Ising chain of $N$ atoms containing an impurity atom. The force is considered as a function of $N$ and on both the temperature $T$ and the external magnetic field $h$. The interactions between nearest neighbors within the chain are supposed to be of a ferromagnetic short-ranged type $J>0$. The impurity atom interacts with constants $J_{ia}$ with its nearest neighbors, where $J_{ia}$ can be both of ferromagnetic type, i.e., $J_{ia}>0$, as well as of antiferromagnetic type, i.e., $J_{ia}<0$. It turns out that the Casimir force can be both attractive or repulsive, depending on the sign and the magnitude of the ratio $J_{ia}/J$.

AI.tldr: 该文给出了含一个杂质原子的N原子Ising链Casimir力的精确结果，力依赖于N、温度T和外磁场h，可表现为吸引或排斥，取决于杂质耦合比Jia/J的符号和大小。
AI.motivation: 研究杂质对有限Ising链Casimir力行为的影响，特别是杂质原子与最近邻耦合常数Jia（可为铁磁或反铁磁）如何改变力的性质。
AI.method: 采用精确解析方法，考虑最近邻铁磁短程相互作用J>0的Ising链，引入一个与最近邻以Jia耦合的杂质原子，将Casimir力作为N、T和h的函数进行求解。
AI.result: Casimir力可表现为吸引或排斥，其性质依赖于比值Jia/J的符号和大小。
AI.conclusion: 杂质耦合的类型和强度能够调控有限Ising链中Casimir力的吸引或排斥行为。

title: Sharp Poincaré Inequalities for Families of Nonlocal Nonconvex Functionals
summary: Let $N\in\mathbb N$, $p\in[1,\infty)$, and $Q_0:=(0,1)^N$. In this article, we establish sharp Poincaré inequalities for the nonlocal nonconvex functionals $$ Φ_{λ,p}^γ(g;Q_0) :=λ^p\iint_{\{(x,y)\in Q_0^2:\,x\ne y,\,|g(x)-g(y)|>λ|x-y|^{1+\fracγ{p}}\}} |x-y|^{γ-N}\,dx\,dy, $$ where $g:Q_0\to\mathbb R$ is measurable, $λ\in(0,\infty)$, and $γ\in\mathbb R$. Specifically, we prove that the estimate $$ \int_{Q_0}\int_{Q_0}|g(x)-g(y)|^p\,dx\,dy \lesssimλ^p+Φ_{λ,p}^γ(g;Q_0) $$ holds for any such $g$ and $λ$ if and only if $γ\in(-\infty,-1]$, where the implicit positive constant depends only on $N$, $p$, and $γ$. This extends Nguyen's Poincaré inequality for $γ=-p$ and provides a useful tool for studying regularity and compactness through these functionals. As applications, we obtain a lower bound for the $Γ$-convergence of $Φ^γ_{λ,p}$ and related asymptotic characterizations for Sobolev and BV spaces. Moreover, we identify the optimal range of $γ$ for which both the Rellich--Kondrachov theorem and a criterion for VMO regularity involving $Φ^γ_{λ,p}$ at a fixed threshold hold. These results also answer the question on nonlocal Poincaré inequalities posed by H.-M. Nguyen in [C. R. Math. Acad. Sci. Paris 363 (2025)]. For $γ\in(-\infty,-1]$, they further answer questions on Sobolev and BV characterizations posed in the same article and by H. Brezis et al. in [Anal. PDE 17 (2024)].

AI.tldr: 本文建立了非局部非凸泛函 $\Phi_{\lambda,p}^\gamma$ 的尖锐 Poincaré 不等式，证明其成立当且仅当 $\gamma\in(-\infty,-1]$，并给出 $\Gamma$-收敛下界、Sobolev/BV 空间刻画、Rellich--Kondrachov 定理及 VMO 正则性准则的最优 $\gamma$ 范围。
AI.motivation: Nguyen 提出的非局部 Poincaré 不等式问题及 Sobolev/BV 刻画问题尚未解决；Brezis 等人也提出了相关刻画问题。本文旨在确定该类非局部非凸泛函控制 $L^p$ 范数的充要条件，并厘清其在正则性与紧性理论中的适用范围。
AI.method: 研究定义在 $Q_0=(0,1)^N$ 上的泛函 $\Phi_{\lambda,p}^\gamma(g;Q_0)=\lambda^p\iint_{\{|g(x)-g(y)|>\lambda|x-y|^{1+\gamma/p}\}}|x-y|^{\gamma-N}dx\,dy$，通过分析尾部能量对差商积分的控制关系，确定不等式 $\int\int|g(x)-g(y)|^p\lesssim\lambda^p+\Phi_{\lambda,p}^\gamma(g;Q_0)$ 成立的阈值条件，并借助 $\Gamma$-收敛与渐近分析推导空间刻画。
AI.result: 证明该尖锐 Poincaré 不等式对任意可测 $g$ 和 $\lambda$ 成立当且仅当 $\gamma\in(-\infty,-1]$，常数仅依赖于 $N,p,\gamma$。由此得到 $\Phi_{\lambda,p}^\gamma$ 的 $\Gamma$-收敛下界、Sobolev 与 BV 空间的渐近刻画，并确定了 Rellich--Kondrachov 定理及固定阈值下 VMO 正则性准则成立的最优 $\gamma$ 范围。
AI.conclusion: 本文推广了 Nguyen 关于 $\gamma=-p$ 的 Poincaré 不等式，回答了 Nguyen 及 Brezis 等人提出的非局部不等式与 Sobolev/BV 刻画问题，为利用非局部泛函研究正则性与紧性提供了有效工具。

title: KVE-KD: Key Visual Evidence-Guided Knowledge Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Knowledge distillation is crucial for deploying vision-language models on resource-constrained devices. However, existing methods typically impose uniform supervision across visual tokens or rely on static token selection, which confuses task-relevant cues with background noise and degrades cross-modal reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Key Visual Evidence-guided Knowledge Distillation (KVE-KD), a framework that dynamically focuses feature distillation on task-relevant visual tokens identified by the teacher model. Specifically, KVE-KD appoints the final pre-generation textual token as a unified semantic anchor and identifies the target cross-modal fusion layer by analyzing changes in the anchor representation through iterative visual-token contribution removal. Within this layer, KVE-KD ranks visual tokens via the anchor-conditioned attention distribution and selects the most informative visual tokens as key visual evidence with normalized entropy. The key visual evidence subsequently guides focused visual feature distillation, making the student align closely with the teacher's task-relevant visual representations while suppressing irrelevant background information. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that KVE-KD outperforms state-of-the-art cross-modal distillation methods, with particularly pronounced gains on tasks requiring complex reasoning and fine-grained visual understanding. Importantly, these improvements are achieved without introducing any inference-time overhead. The source code is available at https://github.com/zhangjianbin07/KVE-KD.

AI.tldr: 提出KVE-KD框架，通过教师模型动态识别任务相关视觉token，实现聚焦式视觉特征蒸馏，在六个基准上超越现有跨模态蒸馏方法且无推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型知识蒸馏方法对整个视觉token施加统一监督或采用静态token选择，无法区分任务相关线索与背景噪声，导致跨模态推理性能下降。
AI.method: 以最终生成前文本token作为统一语义锚点，通过迭代移除视觉token贡献分析锚点表示变化以定位目标跨模态融合层；在该层用锚点条件注意力分布对视觉token排序，并基于归一化熵选出关键视觉证据；以此指导聚焦的视觉特征蒸馏。
AI.result: 在六个基准上优于最先进的跨模态蒸馏方法，在需要复杂推理和细粒度视觉理解的任务上提升尤为显著，且不引入任何推理时开销。
AI.conclusion: KVE-KD通过动态、任务相关的关键视觉证据引导蒸馏，有效抑制背景信息干扰，提升学生模型跨模态推理能力，兼具性能与部署效率优势。

title: Mitigating Over-squashing without Rewiring: A Sheaf Effective Resistance Perspective
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) often struggle to capture long-range dependencies due to over-squashing -- a phenomenon in which the repeated compression of node embeddings into finite-size messages causes representations to collapse. Over-squashing is most often diagnosed as a property of the graph topology, with effective resistance serving as a principled measure of the bottleneck. We provide a complementary view on the matter: building on cellular sheaves, we introduce sheaf effective resistance, a generalization of effective resistance that depends on the sheaf attached to the graph, and we prove that for flat vector bundles, the over-squashing sensitivity in the Jacobian sense is upper bounded by a quantity related to the sheaf effective resistance between the nodes. The bottleneck thus need not lie in the graph itself: it can be relocated, and reduced, by adjusting the sheaf. We instantiate this idea in FlatNSD, a simple message-passing variant of Neural Sheaf Diffusion, and show that it implicitly learns to modulate total sheaf effective resistance, performing well on benchmarks designed to stress over-squashing without altering the original graph topology.

AI.tldr: 本文引入基于胞腔层（cellular sheaves）的“层有效电阻”，并证明在平直向量丛下，Jacobian意义下的过挤压敏感度受节点间层有效电阻上界约束；据此提出FlatNSD，通过调整层而非图拓扑来缓解过挤压。
AI.motivation: GNN常因过挤压（over-squashing）难以捕捉长程依赖：节点嵌入被反复压缩为有限大小消息，导致表示坍塌。既有工作多将过挤压视为图拓扑属性，以有效电阻作为瓶颈的度量。作者希望提供互补视角：瓶颈未必固定于图本身，可通过改变附加结构来迁移并降低。
AI.method: 基于cellular sheaves定义“层有效电阻（sheaf effective resistance）”，它是有效电阻的推广，依赖于附加在图上 的层结构。对平直向量丛（flat vector bundles），证明Jacobian意义下的过挤压敏感度被节点间层有效电阻相关量所上界。据此提出FlatNSD——Neural Sheaf Diffusion的简单消息传递变体，隐式学习调节总层有效电阻。
AI.result: 理论上给出过挤压敏感度与层有效电阻的上界关系；实验上FlatNSD在专门施压过挤压的基准上表现良好，且不改变原始图拓扑。
AI.conclusion: 过挤压瓶颈不必源于图拓扑本身，可通过调整层结构重新定位并降低；FlatNSD验证了通过隐式调制层有效电阻缓解过挤压的可行性。

title: An inverse-stochastic-control Galerkin estimator for drift potentials
summary: We consider the ill-posed inverse problem of recovering the drift potential of an overdamped Langevin diffusion from discrete, possibly irregular position observations. Specializing the suboptimality gap for inverse stochastic control to drift-potential recovery, we parametrize the associated value function in a finite basis. Under a basis nondegeneracy condition, the resulting Galerkin estimator is obtained from one positive-definite linear system whose entries are smooth functionals of the empirical time marginals; no transition density is required. The gap equals one half of the squared energy distance to the true potential, yielding a best-approximation identity and energy-seminorm consistency as the basis becomes complete. At a fixed basis, we separate the sample fluctuation from the time-quadrature error, thereby avoiding the Euler--Maruyama $O(Δt)$ drift-discretization bias. We also analyze the finite basis as regularization, give a dimension-dependent convergence rate for a concrete basis family, and bound observation-noise bias. One- and two-dimensional experiments verify the predicted sampling-interval behavior. An application to irregular animal telemetry illustrates the method on a single long trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于逆随机控制的 Galerkin 估计方法，从离散、可能不规则的观测数据中恢复过阻尼 Langevin 扩散的漂移势。
AI.motivation: 该问题是病态逆问题：观测为离散且可能不规则的位置数据，且漂移势恢复困难。作者希望避免传统方法中对转移密度的依赖以及 Euler--Maruyama 离散化带来的漂移偏差。
AI.method: 将逆随机控制的次优性间隙专门化到漂移势恢复问题，在有限基中参数化值函数。在基非退化条件下，Galerkin 估计量由一个正定线性系统给出，其元素是经验时间边缘分布的平滑泛函，无需转移密度；并将样本波动与时间求积误差分离。
AI.result: 间隙等于到真实势能平方能量距离的一半，得到最佳逼近恒等式与能量半范数一致性；固定基下避免 Euler--Maruyama 的 O(Δt) 漂移离散偏差；给出有限基作为正则化的分析、具体基族的维度依赖收敛率以及观测噪声偏差界；一维与二维实验验证预测的采样区间行为；不规则动物遥测应用在单条长轨迹上展示有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为漂移势恢复提供了无需转移密度、规避漂移离散偏差的估计框架，并具备理论一致性与收敛率保证及实验验证。

title: Decomposition of toric sheaves
summary: We show that the abelian category of coherent toric sheaves is generated, as a Serre subcategory, by pushforwards of rank one reflexive sheaves supported on invariant subvarieties. As an application, we extend previous results by Klyachko on cohomology of toric vector bundles to coherent toric sheaves.

AI.tldr: 证明了相干环面层构成的阿贝尔范畴作为Serre子范畴，由支撑在不变子簇上的秩一自反层的推出生成，并据此将Klyachko关于环面向量丛上同调的结果推广到相干环面层。
AI.motivation: 相干环面层的结构与上同调计算此前缺乏统一框架：已知结果主要针对环面向量丛（Klyachko的工作），而更一般的相干环面层尚未被系统描述，需要寻找其生成元以简化研究。
AI.method: 范畴论方法：考虑相干环面层构成的阿贝尔范畴，证明其作为Serre子范畴由不变子簇上秩一自反层的直接像（pushforward）生成，并利用该生成性将向量丛情形下的过滤/分解技术移植到一般相干层。
AI.result: 得到相干环面层范畴的生成性定理（由不变子簇上秩一自反层的推出生成），并作为应用把Klyachko关于环面向量丛上同调的计算推广至相干环面层。
AI.conclusion: 该生成性结论为相干环面层提供了以秩一自反层为基础的结构描述，使上同调等不变量可归结到不变子簇上的简单构件，从而扩展了Klyachko理论的适用范围。

title: A Locally Conservative Enriched Linearized Neural Network Approximation to Elliptic PDEs
summary: This paper presents a locally conservative Enriched Linearized Neural Network (ENN) method for the Darcy flow model. A linearized shallow ReLU$^k$ network, whose hidden-layer parameters are fixed on a quasi-uniform set of the sphere, carries the approximation, and piecewise constant functions on an auxiliary subdivision of the domain are added to ensure local mass conservation. The subdivision may consist of general, possibly curved, elements. Since neural network functions do not satisfy the inverse inequality, the stability and error analysis of the standard discontinuous Galerkin interior penalty formulation do not apply. The missing inverse inequality is remedied by an edge identity combined with a Galerkin least-squares (GLS) term, together with a single neural approximant that is optimal in the $L^2$, $H^1$ and $H^2$ norms simultaneously. We use the nonsymmetric interior penalty (NIPG) form, which is coercive for every positive penalty parameter. With $n$, the width of the shallow neural network, used in ENN, we prove an error estimate in the EG norm that is of the optimal $H^1$ order, i.e., $O(n^{-(r-1)/d})$ for solutions in $H^r$, $r\ge2$, and $O(n^{-(s-1)/d})$ for solutions in $H^s$, $\frac32<s\le2$, for any shape-regular subdivision, when the GLS parameter satisfies $\min\{h,n^{-1/d}\}^2\lesssimτ\lesssim n^{-2/d}$ and the edge terms are scaled with $\min\{h_e,n^{-1/d}\}$, i.e., by the resolution of the network rather than of the mesh. A numerical Darcy flux is constructed, which is locally conservative, regardless of the size or the number of the elements. Sample numerical results demonstrate the correctness of the theory. In particular, a fixed $4\times4$ subdivision gives the same accuracy as a subdivision refined with the network, and the mass loss stays at round-off unlike a non-conservative neural network method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种局部守恒的富集线性化神经网络（ENN）方法求解 Darcy 流模型，用分段常值函数保证局部质量守恒，并借助边缘恒等式与 GLS 项弥补神经网络缺乏逆不等式的问题，在 NIPG 形式下证明了最优 H¹ 阶误差估计。
AI.motivation: 神经网络函数不满足逆不等式，导致标准间断 Galerkin 内罚格式的稳定性与误差分析失效；同时希望构造局部守恒的数值 Darcy 通量，弥补非守恒神经网络方法的缺陷。
AI.method: 采用线性化浅层 ReLU^k 网络，其隐藏层参数固定于球面上的拟一致点集；在一般（可含曲边）辅助子剖分上叠加分段常值函数以保证局部质量守恒。通过边缘恒等式结合 Galerkin 最小二乘（GLS）项，并使用在 L²、H¹、H² 范数下同时最优的单一神经逼近元，采用对任意正罚参数均强制的非对称内罚（NIPG）形式。
AI.result: 在 GLS 参数满足 min{h,n^{-1/d}}²≲τ≲n^{-2/d}、边缘项按 min{h_e,n^{-1/d}} 缩放时，对任意形状正则子剖分证明了 EG 范数下最优 H¹ 阶误差估计：H^r（r≥2）解为 O(n^{-(r-1)/d})，H^s（3/2<s≤2）解为 O(n^{-(s-1)/d})。数值结果验证理论，固定 4×4 子剖分与随网络细化的子剖分精度相同，质量损失仅为舍入误差。
AI.conclusion: ENN 方法在保持局部质量守恒的同时达到最优收敛阶，且精度主要由网络分辨率而非网格决定，数值通量的局部守恒性不受单元尺寸与数量影响。

title: Physics-Augmented Graph Transformers for Patch-Antenna Forward and Inverse Design
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP 2026), Atlanta, USA. Code, dataset and Colab demo: https://github.com/AviEpstein/GNN-for-Antenna-design
summary: Full-wave electromagnetic (EM) simulation enables accurate patch-antenna analysis but is computationally expensive for large-scale forward prediction and inverse design. We present a mesh-native, physics-augmented graph-learning framework that treats radiation-pattern prediction as signal reconstruction on an irregular surface mesh. For the forward problem, a GPS graph transformer is trained with Physics-Augmented Intermediate Supervision (PAIS), an auxiliary node-level objective that predicts complex surface currents, the physical intermediate linking geometry to radiation. PAIS improves multiple GNN backbones at no inference-time cost, while shuffled-current and non-physical controls show the gain comes from physical correspondence. Direction-conditioned decoding and a differentiable radiation-integral consistency loss further exploit this structure. On an 80,000-sample CST benchmark, GPS+PAIS reaches MSE 0.17 / PSNR 19.67, generalizes to a PCA split, and transfers zero-shot to canonical patches. For inverse design, surrogate-filtered diffusion beats nearest-neighbor retrieval by 32% relative MSE.

AI.tldr: 提出网格原生、物理增强的图学习框架，将辐射方向图预测视为不规则表面网格上的信号重建，通过物理增强中间监督（PAIS）等机制提升正向预测与逆向设计性能。
AI.motivation: 全波电磁仿真虽能精确分析贴片天线，但在大规模正向预测与逆向设计中计算成本高昂，需借助高效的学习型替代方法，同时克服纯数据驱动方法缺乏物理约束的问题。
AI.method: 采用网格原生的物理增强图学习框架：正向任务中用GPS图Transformer结合物理增强中间监督（PAIS），以辅助节点级目标预测复表面电流这一连接几何与辐射的物理中间量；并引入方向条件解码与可微辐射积分一致性损失；逆向设计则采用代理过滤扩散模型。
AI.result: 在80,000样本的CST基准上，GPS+PAIS达到MSE 0.17/PSNR 19.67，可泛化到PCA划分，并能零样本迁移至经典贴片结构；逆向设计中代理过滤扩散相比最近邻检索相对MSE降低32%。
AI.conclusion: 物理中间监督可在不增加推理成本的前提下提升多种GNN骨干性能，且消融对照表明增益源于物理对应关系，验证了物理增强图学习在电磁正向预测与逆向设计中的有效性。

title: Generating Kolmogorov spectra and structure functions with a Rosenhead profile trefoil vortex knot
summary: Motivated by recent experimental observations by Matsuzawa et al. (2026) of colliding several vortex rings within a water tank, this paper extends a compact trefoil vortex simulation to later times and generates a persistent ==energy spectrum that obeys Kolmogorov scaling, together with other statistics characteristic of fully developed turbulence, including structure function scaling. This temporal extension uses a larger (4pi)3 periodic domain, with the improved compactness being achieved by the use of an algebraic Rosenhead vorticity profile, from which viscosity(nu)-independent finite energy dissipation is generated and pre-reconnection convergence of nu1/4-dependent higher-order vorticity moments. These properties suggest, perhaps for the first time, how decaying Navier-Stokes simulations can generate fully-developed turbulent flow from an unforced initial state that is far from boundaries, thereby suggesting how further simulations at higher values of Re could be harnessed for experimental comparisons. Moreover, the exponents for the energy decay and the integral scale growth, E(t)~(t+t0)-10/7 and and ell(t)~(t+t0)2/7, follow those based upon preservation of the Loitsyanskii integral. On a related question, an integral scale growth rate ell that is close to the experiment rate of ellX~(t+t0)(0.16or1/7)is only obtained if the Fourier modes at the scale of the periodic domain are not considered.

AI.tldr: 该文将紧致三叶结涡模拟扩展到更晚时刻，采用更大周期域和Rosenhead涡量剖面，得到遵守Kolmogorov标度的持续能谱及充分发展湍流统计特性，揭示衰减Navier-Stokes模拟可自无强迫初始态生成充分发展湍流。
AI.motivation: 受Matsuzawa等（2026）水箱中多个涡环碰撞实验的启发，作者希望探究衰减型Navier-Stokes模拟能否从远离边界的无强迫初始态生成充分发展湍流，并为更高雷诺数下的实验对比提供可行性依据。
AI.method: 将紧致三叶结涡模拟推广到更晚时间，使用(4π)³周期域，采用代数Rosenhead涡量剖面提高紧致性，从而产生与黏性ν无关的有限能量耗散和重联前ν^{1/4}相关高阶涡量矩的收敛。
AI.result: 生成了遵守Kolmogorov标度的持续能谱以及包括结构函数标度在内的充分发展湍流统计量；能量衰减与积分尺度增长指数E(t)~(t+t0)^{-10/7}、ℓ(t)~(t+t0)^{2/7}符合Loitsyanskii积分守恒的预测；积分尺度增长速率仅在忽略周期域尺度Fourier模时才接近实验值ℓX~(t+t0)^{0.16或1/7}。
AI.conclusion: 衰减Navier-Stokes模拟可自远离边界的无强迫初始态生成充分发展湍流，这可能是首次此类观察，说明更高雷诺数模拟可用于实验对比；但积分尺度增长与实验符合需排除周期域尺度的Fourier模。

title: From Equilibrium Criticality to Universal Collective Phases through Nonreciprocal Coupling of Ordered Systems
summary: Nonreciprocal interactions have emerged as a fundamental driver of collective behavior far from equilibrium. Here, we show that nonreciprocal couplings between spin systems whose isolated dynamics favors ordered states, beyond the previously identified oscillatory (swap) phase, give rise to a richer nonequilibrium phenomenology, including a multistable regime where ordered and disordered states coexist, a scenario strictly forbidden in equilibrium. Crucially, we show that this nonequilibrium phenomenology is inherited directly from the critical properties of the underlying isolated model. In particular, tricriticality in the isolated system gives rise to multistability, hysteresis, and hard excitations in the oscillatory dynamics, while non-normal interactions further enrich the phase diagram by generating multistability. Moving beyond mean-field theory, we derive a universal field equation governing the onset of these nonreciprocal oscillations in finite dimensions. Our results establish a unified theoretical framework connecting critical phenomena, dynamical systems, and non-reciprocal collective dynamics, with applications ranging from opinion dynamics to active matter

AI.tldr: 非互易耦合在倾向有序的孤立自旋系统间可产生比振荡相更丰富的非平衡现象，包括平衡态禁止的有序/无序共存多稳态；该现象直接继承孤立模型的临界性质，并给出了有限维下振荡涌现的普适场方程。
AI.motivation: 非互易相互作用被视为远离平衡集体行为的基本驱动因素，但已有研究主要识别出振荡（交换）相，对更丰富的非平衡现象及其与孤立模型临界性质的联系缺乏统一认识。
AI.method: 研究孤立动力学倾向有序态的自旋系统之间的非互易耦合；采用平均场理论分析相图（多稳、滞后、硬激发），并推导有限维下非互易振荡涌现的普适场方程；结合非正规（non-normal）相互作用分析。
AI.result: 除振荡相外发现多稳区域，有序与无序态共存，这在平衡态被严格禁止；孤立系统的三临界性导致振荡动力学中的多稳态、滞后和硬激发；非正规相互作用进一步通过产生多稳态丰富相图；导出有限维下控制非互易振荡涌现的普适场方程。
AI.conclusion: 建立了连接临界现象、动力系统与非互易集体动力学的统一理论框架，可应用于观点动力学到活性物质等领域。

title: Complete classification of solutions for spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensates in R
summary: Spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensates provide a fundamental platform for exploring quantum magnetism and coherent spin dynamics. Their three Zeeman components are coupled by spin-exchange interactions under conserved particle number and magnetization, giving rise to rich magnetic phases and nonlinear spin structures; a rigorous classification of stationary states therefore clarifies the possible spin configurations and their physical origins. In this paper, as a continuation of our previous work \cite{LLWZ23,LLWZ24,LLWZ26}, we study the classification of solution for the spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensates in $\mathbb{R}$, by applying the non-standard Hirota's bilinear method, the determinant formula and the general left-uniqueness strategy, we present some novel explicit solution and give the complete classification of the solutions. In comparison with the classical Hirota's method, the non-standard Hirota's method needs to introduce auxiliary functions to construct Hirota's bilinear form, which essentially adds additional constraint on the wave functions, so that it possible to deal with more complex equations. As far as we know, this is the first systematic study the complete classification of solutions to the spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensates. Our classification results yields experimentally testable predictions for spin populations, relative phases, and magnetic textures

AI.tldr: 本文延续作者前期工作，采用非标准Hirota双线性方法、行列式公式与一般左唯一性策略，给出自旋-1玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在实数轴上的显式解与解的完全分类，并给出可实验检验的预言。
AI.motivation: 自旋-1玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体具有三个Zeeman分量，在粒子数与磁化守恒下由自旋交换相互作用耦合，产生丰富磁性相与非线性自旋结构。对定态解进行严格分类有助于厘清可能的自旋构型及其物理来源，而此前缺乏系统的完全分类研究。
AI.method: 非标准Hirota双线性方法（相对经典方法需引入辅助函数以构造双线性形式，从而附加约束、处理更复杂方程）；行列式公式；一般左唯一性策略。
AI.result: 给出了若干新颖显式解，并完成了自旋-1玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体解的完全分类；据作者所知，这是对该模型解的完全分类的首次系统研究。
AI.conclusion: 分类结果对自旋布居、相对相位与磁结构给出可实验检验的预言，为量子磁性与相干自旋动力学研究提供理论依据。

title: BAT-NO: A Boundary-Condition-Aware Transformer Neural Operator for Crashworthiness Prediction of Vehicle Components
summary: High-fidelity finite-element simulations provide accurate crashworthiness predictions, but their cost limits iterative design exploration. Deep learning surrogates can reduce this cost, but many component-level models are developed under a single prescribed boundary condition, limiting generalisation to boundary variations. This work proposes a Boundary-Condition-Aware Transformer Neural Operator (BAT-NO) for autoregressive prediction of transient displacement fields and scalar crashworthiness responses under variations in geometry and boundary conditions. A B-pillar simulation framework evaluates generalisation across variations in geometry, impact position and velocity, and support stiffness. BAT-NO combines recurrent mesh processing with latent-grid Fourier operator processing. Boundary-condition information is transferred to the latent grid through a hybrid local--global mechanism. Slice-based attention models interactions among physically related regions, while direct boundary-to-grid projection preserves local spatial structure. Across the validation sets for the shape-only, shape-and-loading, and shape-loading-boundary cases, BAT-NO achieves the lowest mean final-step mean nodal Euclidean displacement error among the evaluated baselines. In the most challenging case, it reduces the mean error by 32.6% relative to the second-best model. Hyperparameter tuning reduces the validation error from 0.451 to 0.269 mm, with a comparable error of 0.267 mm on 300 unseen test simulations sampled within the investigated design space. An attention-based scalar decoder jointly predicts six response trajectories with a mean relative error of 2.46%. Most derived crashworthiness indicators have median errors below 3%. These results show that explicit local and global boundary-condition representations improve crashworthiness prediction over expanded component-level design spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出边界条件感知的Transformer神经算子（BAT-NO），用于在几何与边界条件变化下自回归预测瞬态位移场与标量耐撞性响应，并在B柱算例中取得优于基线的精度。
AI.motivation: 高保真有限元仿真精度高但成本大，限制迭代设计探索；深度学习代理模型虽可降本，但多数部件级模型在单一预设边界条件下开发，难以泛化到边界条件变化的情形。
AI.method: 提出BAT-NO模型，结合循环网格处理与潜网格傅里叶算子处理；通过局部—全局混合机制将边界条件信息传递至潜网格；采用切片式注意力建模物理相关区域间交互，并通过边界到网格的直接投影保留局部空间结构；同时用基于注意力的标量解码器联合预测六条响应轨迹。以B柱仿真框架评估其在几何、冲击位置与速度、支撑刚度变化下的泛化能力。
AI.result: 在仅形状、形状与载荷、形状—载荷—边界三类验证集上，BAT-NO均取得最低的平均末步节点欧氏位移误差；在最困难情形下较次优模型降低32.6%。超参数调优将验证误差从0.451 mm降至0.269 mm，在300个未见测试仿真上误差为0.267 mm。标量解码器预测六条响应轨迹的平均相对误差为2.46%，多数衍生耐撞性指标中位误差低于3%。
AI.conclusion: 显式的局部与全局边界条件表征可提升在扩展部件级设计空间中的耐撞性预测性能。

title: Risk-Calibrated Proposal Transport for Finite-Particle Diffusion Steering
comment: Earlier version accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics (STODY)
summary: Inference-time steering combines pretrained diffusion experts or rewards without retraining by changing the dynamics that transport noise to data. Feynman-Kac correction compensates for proposal mismatch through importance-weighted sequential Monte Carlo (SMC), whose finite-particle behavior depends on the proposal. Variance-controlling guidance (VCG) improves that proposal by fitting a linear drift correction to minimize empirical log-weight-rate variance. Although its population optimum cannot worsen residual variance, finite-particle VCG can nearly eliminate its fitting residual while increasing residual risk on new states by orders of magnitude. The resulting update can degrade unweighted generation or accelerate particle collapse. We show that the centered Feynman-Kac rate is the normalized transport residual and that expected out-of-fit benefit is exactly population headroom minus coefficient-estimation penalty. Under regularity assumptions, a Wasserstein analysis bounds the unweighted proposal's terminal error using this residual. These results motivate Risk-Calibrated Proposal Transport (RCPT), which uses deletion leave-one-out residuals to calibrate the retained fraction of the VCG update, adding no model calls and only small linear-algebra overhead. Experiments on 2D checker distributions, scaffold decoration, molecular property optimization, and class-conditional CIFAR-10 generation demonstrate recovery from harmful fitted updates. Across molecular and image domains, RCPT mitigates harmful fitted updates and improves a broad range of terminal metrics relative to uncalibrated VCG.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示有限粒子方差控制引导(VCG)会因过拟合残差而在新状态上放大风险，提出用删除式留一残差校准更新比例的RCPT方法，在分子与图像任务上减轻有害更新并改善终端指标。
AI.motivation: 推理时引导通过在噪声到数据的传输动力学中改变动力学，结合预训练扩散专家或奖励而无需重训练。Feynman-Kac校正通过重要性加权SMC补偿提议不匹配，其有限粒子行为依赖于提议；VCG虽能通过线性漂移修正最小化经验对数权重速率方差，但有限粒子下可能几乎消除拟合残差却将新状态上的残余风险放大数个数量级，导致无权重生成退化或粒子坍缩。
AI.method: 论文首先从理论刻画问题：证明中心化Feynman-Kac速率即归一化传输残差，期望的样本外收益恰等于群体余量减去系数估计惩罚；并在正则性假设下用Wasserstein分析以该残差界定无权重提议的终端误差。据此提出Risk-Calibrated Proposal Transport (RCPT)，利用删除式留一(leave-one-out)残差来校准VCG更新中保留的比例，不增加模型调用，仅带来少量线性代数开销。
AI.result: 在2D棋盘分布、支架修饰(scaffold decoration)、分子性质优化以及类条件CIFAR-10生成上，RCPT能够从有害的拟合更新中恢复；在分子与图像领域，RCPT减轻了有害拟合更新，并相对未校准的VCG在广泛终端指标上取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 有限粒子VCG的拟合残差最小化并不保证样本外性能，反而可能带来风险放大；通过留一残差校准保留比例的RCPT是一种低开销、无需额外模型调用的稳健方案，可有效缓解有害更新并提升生成质量。

title: Computing Equilibria in Integer Programming Games with Shared Constraints
summary: We develop a cutting-plane algorithm for computing pure Nash equilibria in finite integer games with shared constraints, where a deviation may be feasible against one opponent profile and infeasible against another. Conditional equilibrium inequalities capture this dependence through an explicit activation term. We give affine encodings of costs and activation conditions and prove that the resulting inequalities characterize the equilibrium set exactly. Embedded as lazy constraints in branch-and-cut, they yield the Generalized Zero-Regret algorithm for optimizing a linear objective over exact or approximate equilibria; a bisection procedure maintains certified bounds on the smallest achievable approximation factor. We also prove that, when the conditional polytopes have integral vertices, a concave cost is constant on the minimal face containing an equilibrium strategy, so strict concavity forces vertex strategies; for uniform integer-splittable bin packing, a cost-preserving transformation yields vertex equilibria even without strict concavity. We give formulations for bin packing, network formation, and knapsack games with shared capacities and evaluate the algorithm on 3,300 instances, computing a socially optimal equilibrium on all but 43, certifying nonexistence on 16, and certifying approximation factors within a few percent where no exact equilibrium exists.

AI.tldr: 提出割平面算法，通过条件均衡不等式与lazy约束求解有限整数博弈的纯Nash均衡，并可在branch-and-cut中优化近似均衡。
AI.motivation: 有限整数博弈中，某一偏离策略在一个对手策略剖面下可行、在另一个下不可行，现有均衡刻画难以精确处理这种可行性依赖，因此需要能刻画该依赖的均衡不等式与可扩展求解方法。
AI.method: 给出成本与激活条件的仿射编码，构造条件均衡不等式并证明其精确刻画均衡集；将其作为lazy约束嵌入branch-and-cut，得到Generalized Zero-Regret算法，用二分法维护最小可达近似因子的认证界。理论上证明条件多面体积分顶点下凹成本在含均衡策略的最小面上恒定，严格凹性迫使顶点策略；对均匀整数可分装箱，通过保成本变换得到顶点均衡。
AI.result: 为共享容量下的装箱、网络形成与背包博弈给出建模；在3300个实例上评估，除43个外均算得社会最优均衡，16个认证不存在，其余无精确均衡情形将近似因子认证到几个百分点内。
AI.conclusion: 条件均衡不等式与割平面框架可精确或近似求解带共享约束的整数博弈均衡，并提供可认证的近似保证与结构性顶点结果。

title: Subspace concentration condition and Bogomolov--Gieseker inequality
summary: We provide a necessary condition for integral polytopes to satisfy subspace concentration type inequalities, by mean of a convex geometric interpretation of the Bogomolov--Gieseker inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了整多面体满足子空间集中型不等式的必要条件，其手段是对Bogomolov–Gieseker不等式进行凸几何解释。
AI.motivation: 子空间集中型不等式是一类重要的几何不等式，刻画了测度或体积在多面体子空间上的分布性质。作者希望厘清整多面体在何种条件下能够满足此类不等式，因此需要一个必要条件来界定其适用范围。
AI.method: 方法上，作者借助凸几何的视角重新诠释代数几何中的Bogomolov–Gieseker不等式，以此作为工具推导整多面体满足子空间集中型不等式的必要条件。
AI.result: 论文建立了一个必要条件：整多面体若要满足子空间集中型不等式，必须符合由Bogomolov–Gieseker不等式凸几何解释所导出的约束。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明子空间集中型不等式与Bogomolov–Gieseker不等式之间存在深刻联系，凸几何解释为整多面体的相关性质提供了新的刻画途径。

title: Pressure Monotonicity for a Rotation-Based Biot Discretization with Circumcentric Mass Lumping
summary: We establish cellwise pressure monotonicity for a mixed finite element discretization of the rotation-based Biot system. The spatial discretization is based on compatible discrete de Rham complexes, using standard lowest-order elements for rotation, displacement, Darcy flux, and pressure. For the temporal discretization, we employ the backward Euler method. Exactness of the discrete complexes reduces the mechanics contribution to the pressure Schur complement to a scaled pressure mass matrix, yielding a positive diagonal mechanics capacity. For the Darcy part, positive circumcentric facet weights yield a weighted cell graph Laplacian after flux elimination, while the mass-lumped product remains uniformly equivalent to the standard Darcy product. The diagonal mechanics capacity and the weighted cell graph Laplacian make the condensed pressure matrix Stieltjes. Consequently, the pressure propagator is entrywise nonnegative, which yields a cellwise discrete maximum principle. Numerical experiments confirm the predicted convergence rates and show that the proposed discretization suppresses spurious cellwise pressure oscillations.

AI.tldr: 针对旋转型Biot系统的混合有限元离散，建立了单元级压力单调性：离散复形精确性使力学容量为正对角项，Darcy部分流消元后得加权单元图Laplacian，凝聚压力矩阵为Stieltjes矩阵，压力传播算子逐元非负，从而导出单元级离散极值原理。
AI.motivation: 混合有限元离散Biot系统在数值上易出现压力非物理振荡（尤其单元级振荡），需要从离散结构上给出保证压力单调性的理论机制，以抑制伪振荡。
AI.method: 空间上用基于相容离散de Rham复形的混合有限元，旋转、位移、Darcy通量与压力均取标准最低阶元；时间上用后向Euler。利用离散复形精确性将力学部分对压力Schur补的贡献化为缩放的宋量质量矩阵（正对角力学容量）；Darcy部分利用正的circumcentric面权，消去通量后得加权单元图Laplacian，且质量集中乘积与标准Darcy乘积一致等价。
AI.result: 凝聚后的压力矩阵为Stieltjes矩阵，压力传播算子逐元非负，进而得到单元级离散极值原理；数值实验验证了理论收敛率，并表明该离散能抑制伪单元级压力振荡。
AI.conclusion: 通过离散复形精确性与正权图Laplacian的结构性质，可为多孔弹性混合离散提供压力单调性与极值原理的理论保证，并有效消除压力伪振荡。

title: On finite elements for geometrically-exact planar beams with hyperelastic material models
summary: A geometrically-exact planar beam finite-element framework is developed for the analysis of beams with hyperelastic constitutive models. A conventional three-field beam model is first formulated with full geometrical nonlinearity and a linear elastic material law. The kinematics are then enriched by an additional global field that permits deformation through the in-plane thickness. The out-of-plane direction is incorporated separately through plane-strain and plane-stress constitutive reductions, allowing the cross-sectional deformation assumptions and constitutive behaviour to be formulated independently. Numerical results for the present benchmarks show that the plane-stress condition gives essentially coincident centreline deformations for the Poisson's ratio values considered. In contrast, the plane-strain condition, which is widely employed in the literature, makes the formulation sensitive to Poisson's ratio coupling, with the beam becoming significantly stiffer at higher Poisson's ratios. Comparisons between Saint Venant-Kirchhoff and Neo-Hookean hyperelastic models further demonstrate close agreement in the global deformation and in-plane thickness response, with small constitutive differences becoming more apparent in the local out-of-plane stretch. The proposed approach offers a simple and consistent framework to integrate hyperelastic material models into planar geometrically-exact beam models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种几何精确平面梁有限元框架，可纳入超弹性本构，并通过面内厚度附加场与平面应力/应变两种约化独立处理截面变形。
AI.motivation: 在几何精确平面梁中引入超弹性本构时，截面变形假设与本构约化往往耦合不清；文献常用的平面应变假设对泊松比敏感，需要一种简单一致的框架来分离截面变形与三维本构约化。
AI.method: 先建立含完全几何非线性和线弹性材料律的三场梁模型；再引入额外全局场以允许面内厚度方向变形；面外方向分别通过平面应变与平面应力本构约化纳入，使截面变形假设与本构行为独立构造。
AI.result: 基准算例表明：平面应力条件下，所考虑的泊松比范围内中心线变形基本一致；平面应变条件下公式对泊松比耦合敏感，泊松比越高梁显著变刚。Saint Venant-Kirchhoff 与 Neo-Hookean 模型在整体变形和面内厚度响应上吻合良好，本构差异主要体现在局部面外拉伸。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为在平面几何精确梁模型中集成超弹性材料模型提供了简单且一致的途径，并揭示了平面应变假设的泊松比敏感性及两种超弹性模型的差异所在。

title: Gas-surface scattering and collisional feedback in rarefied hypersonic flow past an inclined flat plate
comment: 48 pages, 14 figures, 11 tables. Data, code and movies: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21360802
summary: Through intermolecular collisions, a gas-surface scattering law can reshape the incident molecular population on which it acts. We examine this feedback using direct simulation Monte Carlo for hypersonic flow past a $40^\circ$ inclined flat plate at four benchmark conditions spanning $0.023\leq Kn_\infty\leq8.439$. Maxwell and Cercignani-Lampis-Lord (CLL) scattering are assessed through fixed-incidence moment references and evaluation of alternative kernels on the same recorded non-reactive incident populations. At $Kn_\infty=0.023$, Maxwell shear and heat transfer depart from diffuse-specular endpoint interpolation by up to $40\%$ of their diffuse-reference values. In the trailing patch, the population change induced by reduced tangential CLL accommodation overturns the fixed-incidence reductions in both shear and translational heat transfer. At the two highest conditions, the CLL momentum responses become nearly componentwise, producing nearly orthogonal displacements in the drag-lift plane. Nevertheless, a total-energy constraint required by common incidence across wall laws retains a defect of $3.1\%$ of the diffuse heat-transfer coefficient at $Kn_\infty=8.439$. Recovery of selected response relations therefore does not establish common incidence or a free-molecular flow. A cold-beam symmetry makes lift invariant under exchange of the normal and tangential CLL accommodation coefficients, but not drag. This provides a limiting explanation for the simulated asymmetric cases: at $Kn_\infty=8.439$, they yield nearly equal lift while one produces $66\%$ more drag. Population feedback and force projection thus determine whether the conditional scattering response is reinforced, obscured or reversed in the macroscopic observables.

AI.tldr: 本文用DSMC研究高超声速稀薄气体绕40°斜平板流动，考察气固散射律通过分子间碰撞对入射分子群的反馈效应，比较Maxwell与CLL散射律在四个基准工况（0.023≤Kn∞≤8.439）下的宏观响应，揭示群体反馈与力投影如何决定条件散射响应在宏观量中被强化、掩盖或反转。
AI.motivation: 气固散射律所作用的入射分子群本身会被分子间碰撞重塑，由此形成反馈回路，使得固定入射假设下标定的散射核在真实流场中的宏观表现发生偏离；需明确这种群体反馈在什么条件下会强化、掩盖或反转条件散射响应。
AI.method: 以高超声速绕40°斜平板为算例，采用直接模拟蒙特卡罗（DSMC），覆盖Kn∞=0.023至8.439的四个基准工况；通过固定入射矩参考，以及在同一记录的非反应入射分子群上评估替代核，对Maxwell与Cercignani-Lampis-Lord（CLL）散射律进行对比评估。
AI.result: Kn∞=0.023时，Maxwell剪应力与传热相对漫反射-镜面反射端点插值偏差达其漫反射参考值的40%；尾缘区切向CLL适应系数降低引起的群体变化，反转了固定入射下剪应力与平动传热的降低趋势。最高两个工况下CLL动量响应近似分量式，在阻力-升力平面产生近正交位移；但壁面律共入射要求的总能量约束在Kn∞=8.439处仍残留相当于漫反射传热系数3.1%的缺陷。冷束对称性使升力在交换法向与切向CLL适应系数时不变，而阻力则不然；Kn∞=8.439时非对称工况升力近相等，但其中一个阻力高出66%。
AI.conclusion: 部分响应关系的恢复并不足以证明存在共入射或自由分子流。群体反馈与力投影共同决定条件散射响应在宏观观测中是被强化、掩盖还是反转。

title: On some concepts of convergence and their connections
summary: The notions of classical two-scale convergence and the periodic unfolding method, which both rely on an additional scale for the representation of periodic micro-oscillations, are in this paper traced back to the wider concept of general two-scale convergence. Moreover, a comparison is made between very weak two-scale convergence and periodic unfolding with respect to sequences bounded in Sobolev spaces, amplified by the scale of the micro-oscillations. It turns out that, for amplified sequences, these approaches are not equivalent in an immediate sense. The paper both serves as a literature overview, with examples and illustrations of the concepts of convergence, and contains new results.

AI.tldr: 该文将经典双尺度收敛与周期展开法溯源至一般双尺度收敛框架，并比较非常弱双尺度收敛与周期展开在处理Sobolev空间中按微观振荡尺度放大的序列时的差异。
AI.motivation: 经典双尺度收敛与周期展开法均依赖额外尺度来表示周期微振荡，二者关系及与一般双尺度收敛的渊源尚需厘清，特别是对按微振荡尺度放大的Sobolev空间有界序列，不同方法是否等价并不明确。
AI.method: 概念溯源与比较分析：将经典双尺度收敛和周期展开法纳入一般双尺度收敛的统一框架；针对Sobolev空间中按微振荡尺度放大的有界序列，比较非常弱双尺度收敛与周期展开两种刻画方式，并辅以示例与图示。
AI.result: 对于放大的序列，非常弱双尺度收敛与周期展开在直接意义下并不等价。
AI.conclusion: 论文兼具文献综述与新结果：既梳理并示例了各种收敛概念，又揭示了两类方法在放大序列情形下的非等价性。

title: Retrieval-Centric Deep Learning in Growing Nonparametric Neural Networks
summary: We investigate a general-purpose layer for deep learning that, instead of compressing arbitrary-size training data into fixed-size weight matrices, stores a new pair of key-value representations for every data point during training, and retrieves and recombines these representations through an attention mechanism at inference time - resulting in a growing neural net (NN). While Irie et al. (arXiv:2202.05798) have put forward this perspective from the classic duality expressing any linear layer in a deep NN trained by gradient descent as linear attention (LA) over the training data points, replacing LA by more powerful attention functions, as they suggest, turns out to be non-trivial: we show that naively applying learning rules from the LA case to advanced kernels does not lead to principled optimization. Here we fill this gap and develop functional gradient-based learning rules for kernelized attention layers, based on radial basis function (RBF) and softmax-like kernels - establishing the principled "retrieval-centric deep learning" (RCDL) paradigm. Empirically, we demonstrate the promising performance and learning-efficiency of RCDL on image classification and synthetic teacher-student learning tasks. Moreover, we show that replacing LA in the dual form of NNs by advanced LA variants, namely MesaNet/DeltaNet, yields a formal connection to recently proposed optimizers for conventional fixed-size NNs, offering a novel perspective on deep learning optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文将"线性注意力即训练数据的对偶表达"这一视角推广到更强的核化注意力，提出基于泛函梯度的学习规则，建立"检索中心深度学习"（RCDL）范式。
AI.motivation: 现有工作（Irie等）指出，按梯度下降训练的深层网络线性层可表达为对训练数据点的线性注意力（LA），从而可用"为每个数据点存储键值对并在推理时检索重组"的"增长型神经网络"替代固定权重的压缩。但直接将其中的LA替换为更强的注意力/核函数并非平凡：简单套用LA情形下的学习规则在先进核上无法得到有原则的优化。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 针对核化注意力层（基于径向基函数RBF与类softmax核），推导基于泛函梯度（functional gradient）的学习规则，形成有原则的"检索中心深度学习"（RCDL）范式。
AI.result: 在图像分类与合成的teacher-student学习任务上验证了RCDL的性能与学习效率；并证明将NN对偶形式中的LA替换为MesaNet/DeltaNet等先进LA变体后，与传统固定规模NN的近期优化器存在形式上的联系。
AI.conclusion: RCDL为增长型检索式深度网络提供了有原则的优化框架，并为深度学习优化提供了新的视角。

title: Local Fisher Information Enables Sparse Causal Discovery
summary: Sparse causal discovery calls for methods that exploit graph structure without estimating high-dimensional densities. We introduce Fisher Information Completion Search (FiCS), a source-first algorithm for additive noise models that uses one local Fisher score for both ordering and parent selection. Under regularity and nonconstant-parent conditions, we prove that a node's local Fisher information equals the noise Fisher information exactly when the conditioning set contains all parents, provided that it contains no descendants. This Fisher parent completion identifies the parent set as the unique minimal Fisher completion. With a maximum conditioning set size $q$ at least the maximum indegree $d$, population FiCS queries marginals of at most $q+1$ variables and recovers the true directed acyclic graph under a positive ordering margin. Bounded conditioning also has a population advantage: reducing $q$ toward $d$ cannot decrease, and can strictly increase, the ordering margin. A growing non-Gaussian family separates local Fisher selection from conditional-variance and leaf-first Fisher ordering. For the regularized kernel Stein estimator, we establish high-dimensional DAG consistency under $q\{1+\log(p/q)\}+\log p=o(n)$, uniform Fisher separation, local approximation, and compatible ridge and parent penalty parameters. Experiments show the strongest gains when $n$ is small relative to $p$, quantify the effect of the conditioning size, and demonstrate competitive reference-graph recovery on three real-data benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出FiCS（Fisher信息补全搜索）源优先算法，用单一局部Fisher评分同时完成加性噪声模型中的节点排序与父节点选择，在理论上证明其可识别性与高维DAG一致性，并在实验中验证其优势。
AI.motivation: 稀疏因果发现需要在避免高维密度估计的前提下利用图结构。现有方法往往依赖条件方差或叶优先排序，难以统一处理排序与父节点选择，且小样本/高维场景下性能不足。
AI.method: FiCS基于加性噪声模型，采用源优先策略，使用一个局部Fisher评分同时用于节点排序与父节点选择。核心机制为"Fisher父节点补全"：在正则性与父节点非恒定条件下，当条件集包含全部父节点且不含后代时，节点的局部Fisher信息恰好等于噪声Fisher信息，从而将父节点集识别为唯一最小Fisher补全。算法限制最大条件集大小为q（q≥最大入度d），仅查询至多q+1个变量的边际分布。结合正则化核Stein估计器实现。
AI.result: 理论上：（1）在正排序间隔下，FiCS恢复真实DAG；（2）减小q趋向d不会降低、且可严格增大排序间隔；（3）构造增长的非高斯分布族，将局部Fisher选择与条件方差法、叶优先Fisher排序区分开；（4）对正则化核Stein估计器，在q{1+log(p/q)}+log p=o(n)、均匀Fisher分离、局部近似及相容的岭与父节点惩罚参数条件下，建立高维DAG一致性。实验上：n相对p较小时增益最强，量化了条件集大小的影响，并在三个真实数据基准上展现有竞争力的参考图恢复能力。
AI.conclusion: FiCS通过局部Fisher信息补全统一了排序与父节点选择，兼具理论可识别性与高维一致性，且限制条件集大小在总体上有利于排序间隔，实验证明其在稀疏高维小样本因果发现中有效。

title: Amortized Score-Hamiltonian Policy Iteration: A Grid-Free Scheme for Relaxed Stochastic Control Problems
summary: We develop an amortized, grid-free implementation of continuous Langevin dynamics based policy-value iteration for entropy-regularized, infinite-horizon relaxed stochastic control problems. The improvement rate of the exact iteration is a discounted aggregate of relative Fisher information between the policy and the Gibbs law of its Hamiltonian. The associated score residual is the velocity with which the control's Langevin dynamics transport its law. We project this velocity onto a conditional sampler shared across states, instead of one Langevin dynamics per state, and the value dynamics onto a parametric critic, estimating both projections at sampled states to obtain coupled actor--critic flows. The score loss measures the actor's agreement with the current critic, while the policy-evaluation residual measures the critic's agreement with the actor. We also derive gradient and Hessian residuals, including a Feynman--Kac representation for the gradient equation, to control errors not detected by the projected value iteration. An exact decomposition of the HJB residual combines these errors into a policy-suboptimality bound under verification and logarithmic Sobolev assumptions. In the linear-quadratic class, both projections are exact and recover the pointwise iteration, and we provide numerical experiments on general models to demonstrate the coupled actor--critic learning in high-dimensions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于摊销、无网格的连续Langevin动力学策略-价值迭代方法，用于求解熵正则化无限时域松弛随机控制问题。通过将得分残差（速度场）投影到跨状态共享的条件采样器上，并将价值动力学投影到参数化评论家上，得到耦合的演员-评论家流，并在HJB残差分解下给出策略次优性界。
AI.motivation: 精确的连续Langevin动力学策略-价值迭代需要为每个状态维护一条Langevin动力学，计算与存储成本随状态空间爆炸式增长，无法扩展到高维问题，因此需要一种摊销且无网格的近似实现。
AI.method: 1) 改进率被刻画为策略与其哈密顿量Gibbs律之间相对Fisher信息的折扣聚合，得分残差即控制Langevin动力学传输其分布的“速度”。2) 将该速度投影到一个跨状态共享的条件采样器（演员），替代逐状态的Langevin动力学。3) 将价值动力学投影到参数化评论家，在采样状态上估计两个投影，得到耦合的演员-评论家流。4) 得分损失度量演员与当前评论家的一致性，策略评估残差度量评论家与演员的一致性。5) 推导梯度与Hessian残差，含梯度方程的Feynman–Kac表示，以控制投影价值迭代未检测到的误差；对HJB残差做精确分解，在验证性与对数Sobolev假设下给出策略次优性界。
AI.result: 在线性-二次类中，两个投影均精确，可恢复逐点迭代；在一般模型上的数值实验展示了高维情形下耦合演员-评论家学习的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将连续时间熵正则松弛控制的价值迭代摊销为无网格的耦合演员-评论家流，并通过得分/策略评估/梯度/Hessian残差及HJB残差分解建立了策略次优性的理论保证，在线性-二次情形下保持精确，且可扩展至一般高维模型。

title: Cyclic automorphisms beyond the canonical bound
summary: Let X be a smooth projective curve of genus g >= 2 over an algebraically closed field K, and suppose that Aut(X) contains a cyclic subgroup G of order N > 2g - 2. The cases N >= 2g + 1 are known. We treat the two boundary values N = 2g and N = 2g - 1. In the tame case we obtain an explicit finite list of ramification signatures. In odd characteristic we prove that the Sylow p-subgroup of G has order p and determine all wild boundary cases by a direct ramification analysis; the resulting curves are Artin-Schreier-Kummer fiber products. In characteristic two we prove that the 2-part has order at most four and classify all wild boundary cases, including Artin-Schreier-Witt normal forms for the C4 and C12 cases.

AI.tldr: 分析特征 p 代数闭域上亏格 g≥2 的光滑射影曲线 X，当其自同构群含阶 N>2g−2 的循环子群 G 时，处理边界值 N=2g 与 N=2g−1 的分歧分类：驯服情形给出分歧签名有限列表，奇特征下确定 Sylow p-子群阶并分类野边界情形（Artin-Schreier-Kummer 纤维积），特征 2 下 2-部分阶至多 4 并分类野边界情形（含 C4、C12 的 Artin-Schreier-Witt 正规形）。
AI.motivation: 已知 N≥2g+1 的情形已被解决，但两个边界值 N=2g 和 N=2g−1 尚属空白。本文旨在补齐这一分类缺口，完整刻画大循环自同构群作用下曲线的分歧结构与野分歧行为。
AI.method: 设 X 为代数闭域 K 上亏格 g≥2 的光滑射影曲线，Aut(X) 含阶 N>2g−2 的循环子群 G。对边界值 N=2g、2g−1：驯服情形通过分歧签名枚举得到显式有限列表；奇特征下用直接分歧分析证明 G 的 Sylow p-子群阶为 p，并确定所有野边界情形，所得曲线为 Artin-Schreier-Kummer 纤维积；特征 2 下证明 2-部分的阶至多 4，并分类所有野边界情形，其中 C4 与 C12 情形给出 Artin-Schreier-Witt 正规形。
AI.result: 驯服情形获得显式有限的分歧签名列表；奇特征下 Sylow p-子群阶为 p，所有野边界情形被确定，对应曲线为 Artin-Schreier-Kummer 纤维积；特征 2 下 2-部分阶至多 4，所有野边界情形被分类，C4 与 C12 情形具 Artin-Schreier-Witt 正规形。
AI.conclusion: 论文完整解决了循环自同构群阶为大值（含边界 N=2g、2g−1）时曲线的分歧分类问题，统一了驯服与野分歧情形的描述。

title: Quasi-Optimal Randomized Recovery of $\mathcal{H}^2$ Matrices
summary:
An $\mathcal H^2$ matrix represents well-separated interactions using nested low-rank bases while retaining nearby interactions explicitly. We consider the problem of constructing an explicit, strongly admissible $\mathcal H^2$ approximation using only products with the matrix and its adjoint, and develop two randomized recovery algorithms on an adaptive geometric hierarchy.
  Carried recovery begins with a single pair of dense Gaussian test matrices, without hierarchy-specific probing, and updates the resulting forward--adjoint sketches across levels. All operator samples can therefore be acquired in one batch. Resketched recovery applies the same recovery procedure using fresh Gaussian test matrices at each level. For this variant, we prove a global quasi-optimal bound on the expected Frobenius error relative to the best approximation with the prescribed hierarchy, rank bounds, and retained near-neighbor pattern.
  Carried recovery requires only $O(k+p)$ applications of the matrix and its adjoint, independent of tree depth, whereas resketched recovery requires $O((k+p)\log(N/k))$ on trees of logarithmic depth. Here $N$ is the matrix dimension, $k$ the maximum prescribed box rank, and $p$ the oversampling parameter. These bounds assume bounded near-neighbor counts and $O(k)$ local dimensions. Experiments on Laplace, Dirichlet-to-Neumann, and Helmholtz operators in two and three dimensions with up to $1.28$ million unknowns show that, with sufficient oversampling, carried recovery achieves nearly refinement-independent error and accuracy comparable to resketched recovery while using many fewer operator applications. Its compressed application cost scales linearly for a fixed rank.

AI.tldr: 本文研究仅通过矩阵及其伴随的乘积来构造强容许的 $\mathcal H^2$ 近似，提出"承接恢复"（carried）与"重采样恢复"（resketched）两种随机算法；前者每层复用同一对稠密高斯测试矩阵、只需单批算符采样，代价 $O(k+p)$ 与树深无关，后者每层使用新测试矩阵并给出全局准最优 Frobenius 误差界，代价 $O((k+p)\log(N/k))$；数值实验表明在足够过采样下承接恢复能以更少算符应用达到接近与细化无关的精度。
AI.motivation: $\mathcal H^2$ 矩阵以嵌套低秩基高效表示远场交互、显式保留近场交互，其优势依赖于拥有显式的层级低秩因子。但实际中矩阵常仅以黑盒形式给出（只能做矩阵-向量乘积），如何仅凭矩阵与其伴随的乘法、在没有层级特定探针的条件下构造出显式、强容许的 $\mathcal H^2$ 近似，并降低算符采样代价、提升对细化层次的鲁棒性，是本文的动机。
AI.method: 在自适应几何层次上提出两种随机恢复算法：(1) 承接恢复——仅用一对稠密高斯测试矩阵，不做层次特定探针，逐层更新由此得到的正向-伴随 sketch，所有算符采样可一次性批量获取；(2) 重采样恢复——在每一层使用全新的高斯测试矩阵执行相同恢复流程。对第二种变体证明相对于给定层次、秩界与保留近邻模式的最优近似的期望 Frobenius 误差全局准最优界。复杂度上，承接恢复需 $O(k+p)$ 次矩阵及其伴随应用（与树深无关），重采样恢复在对数深度树上需 $O((k+p)\log(N/k))$；此处 $N$ 为矩阵维数、$k$ 为最大规定盒秩、$p$ 为过采样参数，并假设近邻数有界、局部维数为 $O(k)$。
AI.result: 在二维和三维的 Laplace、Dirichlet-to-Neumann、Helmholtz 算符上、规模至 $1.28\times10^6$ 未知量进行实验：在足够过采样时，承接恢复达到近乎与细化无关的误差，精度与重采样恢复相当，但使用的算符应用次数远少；其压缩应用代价在固定秩下呈线性增长。
AI.conclusion: 承接恢复在保持与重采样恢复相近精度的同时，将算符采样次数降至与树深无关的 $O(k+p)$，且可实现单批采样与线性压缩应用代价，适合大规模黑盒算符的显式 $\mathcal H^2$ 构造；重采样恢复则提供了理论上的全局准最优误差保证。二者在效率与理论保障之间形成互补。

title: Structure Preserving High-Order FDTD Methods for the Nonlinear Kerr-Debye Model with Lorentz Dispersion
summary: We develop and analyze several families of fully discrete, high-order methods in the finite difference time domain (FDTD) framework for a nonlinear dispersive electromagnetic model for ultrashort pulse propagation in a nonlinear optical medium. The model consists of the time domain Maxwell's equations coupled to two ordinary differential equations; the nonlinear Kerr-Debye equation and the linear dispersive Lorentz equation, in one space dimension. The proposed methods combine staggered spatial discretizations of $2M$th-order, for integer $M>0$, with second-order explicit leapfrog or implicit trapezoidal time integrators. To handle the stiff relaxation in the nonlinear Kerr-Debye equation, we adopt a modified exponential integrator, introduced in \cite{PengJCP2020}, which ensures asymptotic-preserving (AP) behavior in the limit of vanishing relaxation time. We prove that the resulting schemes satisfy a discrete analogue of the continuous energy identity and preserve the positivity (PP) of the nonlinear susceptibility. For the schemes based on the leapfrog time integrator, we establish energy stability under a CFL condition, while the schemes based on the trapezoidal time integrator are unconditionally energy stable. High-order temporal accuracy in the trapezoidal time integrator based schemes is further achieved via Richardson extrapolation yielding $2M$th-order accurate methods in both space and time. Numerical experiments demonstrate the theoretical convergence rates and the ability of the proposed schemes to capture nonlinear wave phenomena such as soliton propagation, self-steepening, and odd harmonic generation. This work extends previous AP-PP and energy stable approaches in a discontinuous Galerkin framework to the FDTD setting, offering a computationally efficient, flexible and robust tool for simulating electromagnetic wave propagation in nonlinear dispersive optical media.

AI.tldr: 本文在FDTD框架下构造并分析了多族全离散高阶格式，用于一维非线性色散电磁模型（Maxwell方程耦合Kerr-Debye与Lorentz方程），具渐近保持、正性保持与能量稳定性。
AI.motivation: 超声短脉冲在非线性色散光学介质中的传播需高效稳健的数值工具；此前AP-PP与能量稳定方法多在间断Galerkkin框架，需拓展到计算更高效的FDTD框架。
AI.method: 空间采用2M阶交错网格离散，时间采用二阶显式蛙跳或隐式梯形积分；对Kerr-Debye方程刚性松弛采用修正指数积分器以保证渐近保持；梯形格式通过Richardson外推获得时空均为2M阶精度。
AI.result: 证明了格式满足离散能量恒等式、保持非线性极化率正性；蛙跳格式在CFL条件下能量稳定，梯形格式无条件能量稳定；数值实验验证了理论收敛阶，并成功模拟孤子传播、自陡峭和奇次谐波产生等非线性波现象。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将先前的AP-PP与能量稳定方法从DG框架推广至FDTD，提供了高效、灵活且稳健的非线性色散光学介质电磁波传播模拟工具。

title: Droplet-triggered Faraday waves in a vertically forced bath
summary: Repeated impacts of a droplet on a vertically forced bath can produce a growing Faraday-wave response under forcing conditions for which the corresponding initially undisturbed bath remains linearly stable. We investigate this mechanism using axisymmetric two-phase direct numerical simulations over a wide range of Reynolds and Weber numbers. The resulting phenomenological regime map identifies quasi-periodic, decaying, faint, and unstable-bath responses. Along the parameter path considered here, the transition to the unstable-bath regime occurs over a narrow range of Weber numbers and varies only weakly with Reynolds number. In the unstable regime, the bath develops a coherent subharmonic response at half the forcing frequency, while disturbances in the decaying regime remain broadband and weaken between successive rebounds. Bath-only simulations show that a finite-amplitude perturbation representative of droplet impact can seed the confined radial mode susceptible to parametric forcing, initiating a growing subharmonic response below the linear instability threshold of the initially flat bath. A reduced capillary-dominated model provides a scaling estimate for the impact-equivalent perturbation amplitude, and bath-only simulations initialized with these perturbations reproduce the bounded-to-growing transition observed in the coupled simulations. Floquet analysis of the finite cylindrical bath identifies the first axisymmetric Neumann mode as having the lowest subharmonic instability threshold. A time-resolved Bessel decomposition independently shows that the growing bath response is dominated by the same radial mode, while the droplet-induced subharmonic response projects predominantly onto this structure. These results identify a finite-amplitude route by which localized droplet impacts can access Faraday-wave dynamics below the linear onset threshold of an initially undisturbed bath.

AI.tldr: 本文通过轴对称两相直接数值模拟研究液滴重复撞击竖直振动的液池，揭示了一种有限振幅机制，使液滴撞击可在低于线性失稳阈值的条件下激发法拉第波。
AI.motivation: 初始未受扰动的液池在其对应的强迫条件下仍处于线性稳定状态，但液滴重复撞击却能产生增长的Faraday波响应。作者旨在阐明这一看似矛盾的机制，并厘清其触发条件与主导模态。
AI.method: 采用轴对称两相直接数值模拟，在宽雷诺数与韦伯数范围内进行参数扫描；建立约化毛细主导模型估计撞击等效扰动幅值；对有限圆柱液池进行Floquet分析；并用时间分辨Bessel分解识别主导径向模态。
AI.result: 得到包含准周期、衰减、微弱和不稳定液池响应的现象学区域图；不稳定液池区在较窄Weber数范围内发生转变，且对Reynolds数依赖较弱。不稳定区液池出现半频亚谐响应，衰减区扰动为宽频且逐次反弹减弱。Floquet分析表明第一轴对称Neumann模态具有最低亚谐失稳阈值；Bessel分解证实增长响应由该径向模态主导。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出一条有限振幅路径：局域液滴撞击可作为有限振幅扰动，播种受参数强迫的受限径向模态，从而在初始平坦液池线性失稳阈值以下激发增长的法拉第波动力学。

title: Active lattice percolation: an apparently new universality class of percolation transitions
summary: We investigate a class of dynamic percolation models on a lattice, in which connections are added and removed by a set of local stochastic rules. In particular, the removal of any connection that can result in one connected cluster becoming two (or more) separate clusters is strictly forbidden. These models include and are inspired by a model for local quantum error correction for a toric code studied by Chirame, et al., PRX Quantum 6, 030363 (2025), who identified a phase transition with first-order characteristics, such as bistability and a discontinuous order parameter. We show numerically that this transition is a hybrid percolation transition (HPT), having characteristics of a continuous percolation transition such as diverging critical clusters while at the same transition having discontinuities like a first-order transition. We then modify this model to be fully isotropic, showing that the HPT remains. In both of these models, the steady state on one side of the HPT is an absorbing state; by turning on additional isotropic local stochastic moves, we remove the absorbing state and strongly suppress or remove the first-order transition, leaving an apparently continuous percolation transition. Curiously, the numerically-observed percolation critical exponents do not change significantly between the models with hybrid transitions and the model with an apparently continuous transition. These exponents are significantly different from known percolation transitions, indicating that this may be a new universality class.

AI.tldr: 本文研究格点上一类带局部随机连接增减规则的动态渗流模型（禁止断开使连通团簇分裂的边），数值证实其相变为兼具连续与不连续特征的混合渗流相变（HPT），并发现引入各向同性局部随机移动消除吸收态后，HPT被强烈抑制或消失、呈连续渗流相变，但临界指数变化不大且不同于已知渗流普适类，可能构成新普适类。
AI.motivation: 该模型源于Chirame等人（PRX Quantum 6, 030363 (2025)）对toric code局部量子纠错模型的研究，其中观察到具有双稳性和不连续序参量等一阶特征的相变。作者希望厘清该相变的确切性质（一阶还是连续），并探究吸收态与各向异性在其中的作用，以及是否存在新的普适类。
AI.method: 在格点上定义动态渗流模型，通过一组局部随机规则增删连接，严格禁止任何会导致单个连通团簇分裂为多个团簇的连接移除。首先对标度原模型进行数值模拟；随后将模型修改为完全各向同性版本；再通过引入额外的各向同性局部随机移动以消除吸收态，系统比较各模型的相变行为并测量渗流临界指数。
AI.result: 数值结果表明原模型的相变为混合渗流相变（HPT），同时具备连续渗流的发散临界团簇特征和一阶相变的不连续性；修改为完全各向同性后HPT仍然存在。两个模型中HPT一侧的稳态均为吸收态；加入额外各向同性局部随机移动消除吸收态后，一阶相变被强烈抑制或消除，表现为表观连续的渗流相变。值得注意的是，混合相变模型与表观连续相变模型测得的渗流临界指数变化不显著，且明显不同于已知渗流相变。
AI.conclusion: 所研究的动态渗流相变属于混合渗流相变（HPT），兼具连续与一阶特征；该行为在各向同性修改下稳健，但在消除吸收态后被强烈抑制或消失。临界指数在HPT与表观连续相变间基本不变，且偏离已知渗流普适类，提示这可能是一个新的普适类。

title: Global and nonglobal solutions for an abstract semilinear heat equation
comment: Submitted for publication on November 11, 2024. 28 pages
summary: In this paper, we focus on the existence of both global and non-global nonnegative solutions for the abstract semilinear heat equation $u_t - Lu = \sum_{i=1}^k \ell_i(t) f_i(u)$ in $L^p(X, μ)$. Here $(X,μ)$ represents a $σ$-finite measure space, $L$ is the infinitesimal generator of a sub-Markovian strongly continuous semigroup of bounded linear operators in $L^p(X,μ)$, and for each $i = 1, \ldots, k$, the functions $\ell_i: [0, \infty) \rightarrow [0, \infty)$ and $f_i: [0, \infty) \rightarrow [0, \infty)$ are continuous. We utilize our findings to apply to the Laplacian operator on sub-Riemannian manifolds and locally finite graphs, obtaining Fujita-type results. Our results extend the recent work of Lenz, Schmidt, and Zimmermann, "Blow-up of nonnegative solutions of an abstract semilinear heat equation" (Calc. Var. Partial Differential Equations, 2023).

AI.tldr: 研究抽象半线性热方程在L^p空间中的全局与非全局非负解存在性，推广Fujita型结果。
AI.motivation: 近期Lenz、Schmidt和Zimmermann研究了抽象半线性热方程非负解的爆破问题，本文旨在进一步给出该方程全局与非全局非负解的存在性，并将结论推广至更一般的奇异扩散算子和图结构。
AI.method: 在σ-有限测度空间(X,μ)上，考虑由次马尔可夫强连续有界线性算子半群的无穷小生成元L所驱动的抽象半线性热方程u_t - Lu = Σ ℓ_i(t) f_i(u)，其中ℓ_i、f_i为连续非负函数；在L^p(X,μ)框架下建立解的存在性判别准则。
AI.result: 给出该抽象方程全局与仅局部（非全局）非负解的存在性结果；并将所得理论应用于子黎曼流形上的Laplace算子及局部有限图，获得相应Fujita型结论。
AI.conclusion: 所得结果扩展了Lenz、Schmidt和Zimmermann（Calc. Var. PDE, 2023）关于抽象半线性热方程非负解爆破的工作，并将其Fujita型结论推广到子黎曼流形与局部有限图等情形。

title: Reinforcement Learning on the Discrete Composition Channel of a Crystal Generator: Validated Gains and Reward Hacking
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/paprakash/OMatGRPO. Models and structures: https://huggingface.co/paprakash/OMatGRPO
summary: Inverse materials design is a long-standing goal of computational materials discovery.
