Generative models for crystalline materials are typically trained to match the distribution of a structure database, while nothing in their training objective points them at specific design goals such as targeted properties. We use group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) to align a generative model based on stochastic interpolants and discrete flow matching with general black-box reward functions through reinforcement learning. Atom types are generated by a discrete flow and the policy gradient of our generalization of GRPO directly acts on the likelihoods of the atom-type transitions, which differentiates our work from previous reinforcement-learning approaches for diffusion and flow-based generative models of crystalline materials. We introduce a reward function that raises the yield of metastable, unique and novel structures (mSUN) from 13.4% for the pretrained model to 45.5% for the reinforced model, as evaluated by a community benchmark. Our reward also improves the performance of a reinforcement learning framework for crystalline materials based on latent denoising diffusion models. At the same time, we find that directly reinforcing atom-type transition likelihoods enables reward exploitation that has to be prevented with explicit guards. The same analysis also exposes a gap in the community metric. Single-element structures in distinct packings are counted as metastable, unique and novel materials and inflate mSUN without yielding any new compounds. A stability claim is only as good as its reference hull. We report every result split by the number of reference phases behind it and argue that benchmarks should do the same.

AI.tldr: 该论文将GRPO强化学习用于晶体材料的生成模型对齐，通过直接作用于原子类型转移似然来优化黑盒奖励，使亚稳、独特、新颖结构的产率从13.4%提升至45.5%，同时揭示了奖励利用风险与基准指标的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 逆材料设计是计算材料发现的长期目标，但现有晶体材料生成模型仅被训练去匹配结构数据库的分布，其训练目标并未指向特定设计目标（如目标性质），因此需要一种能对齐任意黑盒奖励函数的方法。
AI.method: 采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）对基于随机插值与离散流匹配的生成模型进行强化学习对齐；原子类型由离散流生成，广义GRPO的策略梯度直接作用于原子类型转移的似然，区别于以往针对扩散与流模型的强化学习方法；并设计奖励函数以提升亚稳、独特、新颖结构（mSUN）的产率。
AI.result: 社区基准评估显示，mSUN产率从预训练模型的13.4%提升至强化模型的45.5%；该奖励函数同样提升了基于潜在去噪扩散模型的晶体材料强化学习框架性能；但直接强化原子类型转移似然会导致奖励利用，需显式防护加以阻止；分析还暴露社区指标的缺陷——不同堆积方式的单元素结构被计为mSUN，虚增指标却不产生新化合物。
AI.conclusion: 稳定性声明的可信度取决于其参考凸包；作者按参考相数量对全部结果进行拆分报告，并主张基准评测也应采取同样做法。

title: Gaussian Flow Dynamics: Simulation-Free Neural SDE Learning Beyond One-Time Marginals
summary: Simulation-free training of latent Stochastic Differential Equations (SDEs) relies on a variational posterior process whose one-time marginals are tractable, typically Gaussian. Such marginals, however, do not determine the underlying dynamics: many processes share the same marginals while differing in their temporal structure, and existing parameterizations fix this structure implicitly, which restricts the posterior family and biases the learned model. We introduce Gaussian flow dynamics, which construct stochastic processes directly from smoothly evolving Gaussian marginals while making the marginal-preserving, or gauge, degrees of freedom explicit and parameterizable. The construction admits state-dependent diffusion coefficients and recovers every linear SDE with additive noise and a non-degenerate Gaussian initial distribution. Building on it, we propose Gauge Matching, a simulation-free method for latent SDE learning that combines Gaussian flow dynamics with the SDE Matching objective. Gauge Matching costs at most quadratically in the latent dimension per step, like SDE Matching, but learns the temporal structure of the posterior beyond its one-time marginals. It comes within a nat of Helmholtz-SDE, which computes the gauge from the prior Jacobian at cubic cost, on the linear benchmark where the exact posterior is known, matches it on nonlinear systems, and applies where Helmholtz-SDE does not, to state-dependent noise.

AI.tldr: 提出Gaussian flow dynamics与Gauge Matching，实现无需模拟的隐SDE训练，可显式参数化保持边缘分布的规范自由度，学习后验的时间结构。
AI.motivation: 现有隐SDE的无模拟训练依赖单时刻边缘分布可解（通常为高斯）的变分后验过程，但边缘分布无法确定底层动力学：多个过程可共享相同边缘分布而时间结构不同。现有参数化隐含地固定了该结构，限制了后验族并使学习模型产生偏差。
AI.method: 提出Gaussian flow dynamics，直接从平滑演化的高斯边缘分布构造随机过程，并将保持边缘分布（规范）的自由度显式化、可参数化；该构造允许状态依赖的扩散系数，并能涵盖所有带加性噪声且初始分布为非退化高斯的线性SDE。基于此提出Gauge Matching：将Gaussian flow dynamics与SDE Matching目标结合，实现隐SDE的无模拟学习。
AI.result: 每步至多与潜变量维度呈二次复杂度（与SDE Matching相当），但能学到超出单时刻边缘分布的后验时间结构。在精确后验已知的线性基准上，与Helmholtz-SDE（以三次代价从先验Jacobian计算规范）相差约一个nat；在非线性系统上与之相当；并可应用于Helmholtz-SDE无法处理的状态依赖噪声场景。
AI.conclusion: Gauge Matching在保持低计算复杂度的同时，突破单时刻边缘分布的限制，显式学习后验时间结构，在精度与适用性上兼具优势，可推广至状态依赖噪声情形。

title: Intrinsic Path Following on $\mathsf{SO}(3)$
summary: This paper studies intrinsic path following for fully actuated rigid-body attitude dynamics over a broad class of attitude paths, namely arbitrary smooth embedded closed curves on $\mathsf{SO}(3)$. We construct a tangential--transverse state decomposition on a tubular neighborhood using normal and pullback bundle geometry. The resulting second-order dynamics admit a smooth feedback transformation that independently assigns tangential and transverse covariant accelerations. A transverse proportional--derivative law renders the path-following manifold invariant and locally uniformly exponentially stable on an explicit forward-invariant neighborhood, while leaving the tangential dynamics freely assignable. This allows independent regulation of progression along the path, stabilization of a selected attitude on the path, or tracking of a time-varying motion. For a representative fiber path, the tubular coordinates are obtained in closed form up to the natural cut-locus obstruction, and simulations illustrate point stabilization and trajectory tracking.

AI.tldr: 本文研究全驱动刚体姿态动力学在SO(3)上任意光滑嵌入闭曲线姿态路径的内蕴路径跟踪问题。
AI.motivation: 针对SO(3)上一般姿态路径的刚体姿态路径跟踪问题，需要一种能在流形上内蕴地构造、且能独立解耦切向与横向动力学的控制框架。
AI.method: 利用法丛与拉回丛几何，在管状邻域上构造切向-横向状态分解，得到具有光滑反馈变换的二阶动力学，从而独立指定切向与横向协变加速度；对横向采用比例-微分律使路径跟踪流形前向不变并在显式前向不变邻域上局部一致指数稳定。
AI.result: 横向PD律保证路径跟踪流形局部一致指数稳定且切向动力学可自由配置；针对一类代表性纤维路径，管状坐标在自然割迹障碍下可闭式求解；仿真验证了点镇定与轨迹跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了SO(3)上姿态路径跟踪中切向与横向动力学的解耦，支持沿路径推进、路径上姿态镇定及时变运动跟踪，并给出闭式管状坐标与仿真验证。

title: On the classification of polarized surfaces with weakly Ulrich or initialized aCM tangent bundles
summary: Counterexamples to the Eisenbud-Schreyer conjecture on the existence of Ulrich bundles have appeared recently (see Anghel [A1] and the third author [Lo]). As weakly Ulrich bundles are a useful generalization of Ulrich ones, in this paper, we classify smooth surfaces $S\subseteq \mathbb P^N$ with weakly Ulrich tangent bundle. They are Del-Pezzo surfaces of degree at least 5 and we classify the possible embeddings. An interesting feature is the appearance of two infinite series of polarizations, which is quite different from the Ulrich case [BMPT, LR]. We also achieve the classification of surfaces with initialized aCM tangent bundles and, as a consequence, of surfaces with almost Ulrich tangent bundles.

AI.tldr: 本文分类了具有弱Ulrich切丛的光滑曲面，得到其为次数至少5的Del-Pezzo曲面，并刻画了可能的嵌入；同时完成了具有初始aCM切丛及几乎Ulrich切丛的曲面分类。
AI.motivation: 近期出现了关于Ulrich丛存在性的Eisenbud-Schreyer猜想反例（Anghel与第三作者）。弱Ulrich丛作为Ulrich丛的有用推广，其几何分类尚待研究，本文据此展开对弱Ulrich切丛曲面的分类。
AI.method: 利用弱Ulrich丛作为Ulrich丛推广的性质，对光滑射影曲面$S\subseteq \mathbb P^N$的弱Ulrich切丛进行分类，并结合初始aCM切丛的分类，进而导出几乎Ulrich切丛的曲面分类。
AI.result: 具有弱Ulrich切丛的曲面恰为次数至少5的Del-Pezzo曲面，并给出了其所有可能嵌入的分类；重要特征是出现了两族无限极化，与Ulrich情形[BMPT, LR]显著不同。同时给出了具有初始aCM切丛的曲面分类，及作为推论，具有几乎Ulrich切丛的曲面分类。
AI.conclusion: 弱Ulrich切丛的曲面分类揭示了与Ulrich情形不同的无限极化族现象，完善了切丛相关丛的曲面分类，为Eisenbud-Schreyer猜想反例背景下的推广研究提供了新的分类结果。

title: Instability of Gaussian elimination is exponentially rare (proof of partial result)
summary: Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting is the standard algorithm for solving a dense $n\times n$ system of linear equations $Ax=b$. The ``growth factor'' $ρ\,$ for this process may be as large as $2^{n-1}$, and when $ρ$ is large, the algorithm is unstable. Nevertheless, long experience has shown that Gaussian elimination is resoundingly stable in practice. Experiments indicate that among random matrices with independent normally distributed entries, growth factors $ρ\gg n^{1/2}$ are in a precise sense exponentially rare. Here we take a step toward confirming this observation by proving it not for the full growth factor, which depends on all the entries of the upper-triangular factor $U$, but for the corner entry $u_{nn}^{}$.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了高斯消去法（部分选主元）的数值稳定性，针对增长因子 ρ 在实践中极少出现大的现象，给出了一种理论解释：在随机正态矩阵下，证明上三角因子 U 的角元 u_nn 具有大值的概率是指数稀有的，为最终证明完整增长因子情形提供了初步但也关键的一步。
AI.motivation: 高斯消去法是求解稠密线性方程组的标准算法，其增长因子在最坏情况下可高达 2^{n-1}，导致理论上的不稳定。然而长期实验表明该算法在实践中非常稳定。已有实验发现，对独立正态随机矩阵，增长因子 ρ≫n^{1/2} 在精确意义上呈指数稀有。论文动机正是要部分证实这一长期观察，为理解该算法的实际稳定性提供严格理论基础。
AI.method: 论文没有直接研究依赖于上三角因子 U 全部元素的完整增长因子，而是转而分析 U 的角元 u_nn，证明在随机矩阵下该角元取大值的概率呈指数稀有。通过这种简化处理，论文为完整增长因子的稀有性研究提供了初步的理论支撑。
AI.result: 论文证明了在随机正态矩阵下，角元 u_nn 取大值的概率是指数稀有的，即在精确意义上极少发生。这一结果是对增长因子稀有性观察的初步证实，尽管尚未覆盖依赖于 U 全部元素的完整增长因子。
AI.conclusion: 论文为高斯消去法在实践中稳定性良好的现象提供了理论上的初步支持：随机矩阵下 U 的角元 u_nn 出现大值的概率指数稀有，这为最终证明完整增长因子的稀有性奠定了基础。

title: Entropy-Stable and Well-Balanced Discontinuous Galerkin Methods for the Compressible Euler Equations in Vector-Invariant Form
summary: We develop structure-preserving methods for the compressible Euler equations with gravity in vector-invariant form and potential temperature as a prognostic variable within the flux-differencing discontinuous Galerkin spectral element method (DGSEM) framework. By discretizing the nonconservative terms as symmetric and antisymmetric products, we derive two-point numerical fluxes that conserve both the thermodynamic entropy and the total energy. Moreover, we design an entropy-stable numerical flux that is well-balanced for both isothermal and isentropic background states. All properties are shown to carry over to the high-order DGSEM on general curvilinear meshes. Several numerical examples confirm the theoretical findings and show the robustness and accuracy of the scheme for use in modern dynamical cores for atmospheric flows.

AI.tldr: 该文在通量差分数值谱元（DGSEM）框架下，为含重力可压缩Euler方程（矢量不变形式、以位温为预报变量）发展了保结构方法，构造了同时守恒热力学熵与总能量的两点数值通量，并设计了在等温与等熵背景态下均满足良平衡性的熵稳定通量。
AI.motivation: 现代大气动力核心需要同时保持熵、能量等物理不变量，并在重力分层背景下满足良平衡性，以抑制虚假振荡、提升长期积分稳定性与精度。
AI.method: 在DGSEM框架下采用矢量不变形式的含重力可压缩Euler方程，以位温作为预报变量；将非守恒项离散为对称与反对称乘积，从而推导出两点数值通量；设计对等温和等熵背景态良平衡的熵稳定数值通量；并在一般曲线网格上的高阶DGSEM中证明这些性质可保持。
AI.result: 推导出的两点通量同时守恒热力学熵与总能量；所设计的熵稳定通量具备等温、等熵背景下的良平衡性；所有性质在高阶DGSEM及一般曲线网格上均成立，数值算例验证了理论结论并显示了方案的鲁棒性和精度。
AI.conclusion: 所提保结构DGSEM方案适用于现代大气流动力核心，兼具鲁棒性、精度与物理保真性。

title: Multicatalyst reactions induce abrupt transition in a dense catalytic reaction network model
summary: We generalize the Furusawa--Kaneko model, a simple model of intracellular catalytic reaction networks, to multicatalyst reactions and analyze the generalized model using dynamical mean-field theory. In the thermodynamic and dense-network limit, we derive exact effective equations and analyze their fixed points for arbitrary degree distributions. Under nutrient-poor conditions, network heterogeneity suppresses the metabolic--starvation transition irrespective of the number of catalysts per reaction. In contrast, under nutrient-rich conditions, the bifurcation structure changes with the number of catalysts. With one catalyst per reaction, only continuous transitions occur, whereas two or more catalysts give rise to bistable phases and discontinuous transitions. The bifurcation structure also differs between two and three catalysts per reaction, with three catalysts allowing bistability between metabolic states with different cell growth rates. Our results provide a possible mechanism for bistability and abrupt switching in metabolic dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文将Furusawa–Kaneko胞内催化反应网络模型推广至多催化剂反应，用动力学平均场理论在热力学与稠密网络极限下推导精确有效方程，分析任意度分布下的不动点，揭示营养条件与每反应催化剂数如何调控代谢—饥饿转变与分岔结构。
AI.motivation: 原始Furusawa–Kaneko模型仅考虑简单（单催化剂）催化反应网络，难以刻画真实胞内代谢中一个反应常需多种催化剂参与的复杂性。作者希望建立更一般的理论框架，理解网络异质性与催化剂数量如何影响代谢动力学，尤其是代谢状态间的双稳与突变切换机制。
AI.method: 将Furusawa–Kaneko模型推广为多催化剂反应网络；采用动力学平均场理论，在热力学极限与稠密网络极限下推导精确有效方程；对任意度分布求解并分析其不动点与分岔结构，按每反应催化剂数目（1、2、3）分类讨论，并区分营养贫乏与营养丰富条件。
AI.result: 在营养贫乏条件下，网络异质性抑制代谢—饥饿转变，且该结论与每反应催化剂数无关。在营养丰富条件下，分岔结构随催化剂数改变：每反应仅一个催化剂时只出现连续转变；两个及以上催化剂则产生双稳相与不连续（突变）转变。每反应两个与三个催化剂的分岔结构亦不同，三个催化剂可实现具有不同细胞生长速率的代谢状态之间的双稳。
AI.conclusion: 多催化剂推广结合动力学平均场分析，为代谢动力学中的双稳性与突然切换提供了一种可能的机制，并表明催化剂数量与网络异质性是决定代谢相变类型的关键因素。

title: Remarks on a multi-dimensional transport equation with nonlocal velocity
summary: In this paper, we revisit a multi-dimensional nonlocal transport equation of the form \begin{eqnarray*} \partial_tρ+g\mathcal{R}_aρ\cdot \nablaρ= 0,~ρ(\cdot,0)=ρ_{0}, \end{eqnarray*} where the transform $\mathcal{R}_a$ is defined by \begin{eqnarray*} \mathcal{R}_aρ(x,t)=\frac{Γ(\frac{n+1}{2})}{π^{\frac{n+1}{2}}}P.V.\int\limits_{\mathbb{R}^n}\Big(\frac{x-y}{|x-y|^{n+1}}-\frac{x-y}{(|x-y|^2+a^2)^{\frac{n+1}{2}}}\Big)ρ(y,t)dy. \end{eqnarray*} This model was first introduced in [W. Zhang, J. Differential Equations 467 (2026) 114275] as a natural generalization of the well-known Kiselev-Sarsam equation proposed in [A. Kiselve and N.A. Sarsam, Nonlinearity 38 (2025) 055018]. By using an improved pointwise inequality for the transform $\mathcal{R}_a$, we obtain a better and more natural version of a nonlinear integral inequality proved in Zhang [31] for the transform $\mathcal{R}_a$. In addition, we also establish a new weighted nonlinear inequality for the transform $\mathcal{R}_a$ implying the finite-time blow-up for a class of smooth radial initial data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一类多维非局部输运方程，改进关于变换 R_a 的逐点不等式，得到更自然的非线性积分不等式，并建立新的加权非线性不等式，证明一类光滑径向初值会在有限时间内爆破。
AI.motivation: 该模型是 Kiselev-Sarsam 方程的自然推广，其非局部变换 R_a 的分析性质（如非线性积分不等式与爆破判据）尚可改进和补充，尤其是已有不等式形式不够自然，且缺乏对径向初值爆破的刻画。
AI.method: 针对变换 R_a 建立改进的逐点不等式；据此推导更佳、更自然的非线性积分不等式；进一步建立关于 R_a 的加权非线性不等式，用于分析径向初值的有限时间爆破。
AI.result: 得到 R_a 的改进逐点不等式与更自然的非线性积分不等式；建立新的加权非线性不等式，并证明一类光滑径向初值导致有限时间爆破。
AI.conclusion: 改进的逐点估计提升了已有非线性积分不等式，加权不等式给出了径向情形有限时间爆破的判据，深化了对该非局部输运方程的理解。

title: AdaEva: Accelerating LLM-Driven Algorithm Design with Adaptive Partial Evaluation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated algorithm design. However the computational cost of evaluating the generated algorithms can be excessive. We consider the common LLM-driven automated algorithm design (LLM4AD) setting in which a candidate algorithm is evaluated by aggregating its performance over a shared set of training instances. This instance-wise structure raises a natural question: must every candidate be evaluated on the entire instance set before deciding whether it remains competitive? Taking inspiration from algorithm configuration, we introduce AdaEva, a drop-in adaptive partial-evaluation framework that progressively evaluates candidates on larger subsets of the same instance pool and eliminates unpromising candidates as evidence accumulates. Importantly, AdaEva leaves the underlying LLM4AD procedure and per-instance evaluator unchanged and requires no prior knowledge about instance difficulty. We instantiate this idea using successive halving (AdaEva-S) and statistical racing (AdaEva-R), and evaluate both mechanisms across three representative LLM4AD frameworks, multiple LLM backbones, and optimization domains spanning combinatorial and continuous black-box optimization. Under matched evaluation budgets, AdaEva more reliably balances evaluation effort across candidates than fixed partial-evaluation strategies, yielding strong search efficiency and anytime performance together with improved held-out generalization across the evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdaEva，一种即插即用的自适应部分评估框架，通过逐步扩大候选算法的评估实例子集并及早淘汰劣质候选，显著降低 LLM4AD 的评估成本。
AI.motivation: LLM 驱动的自动化算法设计（LLM4AD）中，候选算法的评估需要在其全部训练实例上聚合性能，计算开销巨大。作者受算法配置领域启发，提出一个自然问题：是否必须在完整实例集上评估每个候选才能判断其是否仍有竞争力。
AI.method: 提出 AdaEva 自适应部分评估框架：在同一实例池上逐步用更大子集评估候选，并随证据积累淘汰无望候选。该框架不改变底层 LLM4AD 流程和单实例评估器，且无需实例难度的先验知识。具体实例化为两种机制——逐次减半（AdaEva-S）和统计竞赛（AdaEva-R）。
AI.result: 在三种代表性 LLM4AD 框架、多种 LLM 骨干以及涵盖组合与连续黑箱优化的优化域上进行评估。在相同评估预算下，AdaEva 比固定部分评估策略更可靠地在候选间平衡评估开销，取得更强的搜索效率与任意时刻性能，并改善了留出泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: AdaEva 作为一种通用的自适应部分评估框架，能够在不修改现有 LLM4AD 流程的前提下，有效提升评估效率与搜索质量，具有良好的通用性与实用价值。

title: Gradient-Free Sampling from Generative Models via Stochastic Bounded Extremum Seeking
summary: We introduce a sampling approach for energy- and score-based generative models that requires no gradient evaluations of the model. Replacing the drift term that would normally contain the score $\nabla_\mathbf{x} \log p_θ(\bf{x})$ with a high-frequency dithered cosine of the model's \textit{value}, $\sqrt{αω}\,\cos(ωt + k \log p_θ(\bf{x}))$, produces, in the high-frequency averaging limit, Langevin Markov chain Monte Carlo for energy-based models and the reverse-time SDE of score-based diffusion. We prove that trajectories of the dithered Itô SDE converge to those of the target SDE, driven by the same Brownian motion, uniformly on compact time intervals in probability, by an averaging argument that extends bounded extremum seeking (ES) to Itô processes, with an explicit $O(ω^{-1/2})$ mean-square rate under global bounds. The approach is not confined to smooth targets: it extends to $C^{1,1}$ energies with discontinuous curvature (without ellipticity requirement) and to Sobolev energies whose Hessians exist only off measure zero sets; for Lipschitz energies with gradient kinks the averaged limit remains well posed; the Krylov-Röckner integrability class is the boundary of provability. The approach provides a hard \textit{a priori} bound on the per-step update rate and applies to explicitly time-varying targets on finite horizons. Gradient-free pixel-space sampling is not competitive with well-tuned backpropagation-based samplers at practical evaluation budgets; the regime where the approach offers an advantage is latent-space sampling when the model is a black box and the target drifts in time. We demonstrate latent-space tracking for time-varying images on CelebA-HQ ($256{\times}256$) from limited 1D projection measurements and latent-space EBM sampling on CIFAR-10.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需模型梯度评估的采样方法，用高频抖动余弦项替代漂移项中的score，在高频平均极限下恢复Langevin MCMC与逆向扩散SDE，并给出O(ω^{-1/2})均方收敛率。
AI.motivation: 现有能量模型与score-based扩散模型的采样依赖score（∇_x log p_θ(x)）的梯度评估，在模型为黑盒、无法获取梯度或目标随时间漂移的场景下受限。本文旨在设计一种无需梯度评估的采样方案。
AI.method: 将漂移项中的score替换为模型value的高频抖动余弦 √(αω) cos(ωt + k log p_θ(x))。在高频平均极限下，该抖动Itô SDE的轨迹收敛到目标SDE（能量模型对应Langevin MCMC，扩散模型对应逆向时间SDE）。通过扩展有界极值搜索（ES）到Itô过程的平均论证证明收敛。方法可推广至C^{1,1}能量（曲率不连续、无椭圆性要求）与仅几乎处处存在Hessian的Sobolev能量，Lipschitz能量（梯度有折点）的极限仍适定，Krylov-Röckner可积类为可证边界。
AI.result: 证明了抖动Itô SDE轨迹在紧时间区间上依概率一致收敛到目标SDE，由同一布朗运动驱动，全局界下均方速率O(ω^{-1/2})。方法给出每步更新率的硬先验界，适用于有限时域上显式时变目标。实验上，pixel-space无梯度采样在实际评估预算下不及调优的反向传播采样器；优势体现在模型为黑盒且目标随时间漂移的latent-space采样。在CelebA-HQ 256×256上由有限1D投影测量实现时变图像latent-space跟踪，并在CIFAR-10上实现latent-space EBM采样。
AI.conclusion: 该无梯度采样框架统一了能量模型与score-based扩散采样，并拓展至非光滑能量与弱可积类，提供显式收敛率与更新率先验界；其实际价值主要在黑盒、时变目标的latent-space采样场景。

title: Asymptotic analyis of an optimal control problem for a phase field tumor growth model with hyperbolic relaxation of the chemical potential
comment: Key words: tumor growth models, singular potentials, hyperbolic relaxation, optimal control, asymptotic behavior
summary: In this paper, we study the optimal control of a phase field tumor growth model of Cahn--Hilliard type with possibly singular potential in which the often assumed parabolic relaxation of the chemical potential is replaced by a hyperbolic one. We investigate the asymptotic behavior of the control problem as the relaxation parameter $\,α\,$ approaches zero. It is shown that the corresponding state and adjoint state variables of the relaxed problem converge in a suitable sense to their counterparts for the unrelaxed regime where $α=0$. Also, weak limits of optimal controls for the relaxed problem can be shown to be optimal controls for the unrelaxed case. Moreover, every fixed optimal control $\,u^*\,$ for the unrelaxed system turns out to be the limit of a family $\{u^*_α\}_{α>0}$ of minimizers of suitable optimal control problems for the relaxed systems, where the original cost functional is replaced by the so-called ``adapted'' cost functional. It is also shown that the variational inequalities satisfied by $u^*_α$, which constitute the first-order necessary optimality conditions of the relaxed problems with adapted cost functional, converge to the corresponding variational inequality fulfilled by $u^*$ for the unrelaxed problem with the original (nonadapted) cost functional.

AI.tldr: 研究带有奇异势的Cahn–Hilliard型相场肿瘤生长模型的最优控制,其中化学势的抛物型松弛被双曲型取代。分析当松弛参数α→0时控制问题的渐近行为,证明松弛问题的状态、伴随状态与最优控制收敛到未松弛(α=0)情形的对应量,并给出最优控制的极限刻画与一阶最优性条件的收敛。
AI.motivation: 经典的相场肿瘤生长模型通常假设化学势满足抛物型松弛,但实际生理过程中化学势的演化可能具有双曲(有限传播速度)特征。为更真实地描述肿瘤生长动力学,作者引入含奇异势的Cahn–Hilliard型模型并采用双曲型松弛。而松弛参数α是一个小参数,因此需要研究α→0时最优控制问题的渐近行为,以建立松弛模型与未松弛模型之间的联系。
AI.method: 在含奇异势的Cahn–Hilliard型相场肿瘤生长模型中,将化学势的抛物型松弛替换为双曲型松弛,得到依赖参数α>0的松弛最优控制问题。研究α→0的极限:分析松弛问题的状态变量与伴随状态变量到未松弛(α=0)情形的收敛性;证明松弛问题最优控制的弱极限是未松弛问题的最优控制;对未松弛问题的固定最优控制u*,构造一簇松弛问题的极小元{u*_α}加以逼近,其中原代价泛函被替换为"adapted"代价泛函;并考察u*_α满足的变分不等式(即adapted问题的 一阶最优性必要条件)到u*在原始非adapted问题的对应变分不等式的收敛。
AI.result: 松弛问题的状态变量与伴随状态变量在合适意义下收敛到未松弛情形(α=0)的对应量;松弛问题最优控制的弱极限为未松弛问题的最优控制。对未松弛系统的任一固定最优控制u*,存在松弛系统adapted最优控制问题的极小元族{u*_α},使得u*为该族当α→0时的极限。此外,u*_α满足的变分不等式(adapted问题的一阶最优性条件)收敛到u*在原始(非adapted)代价泛函的未松弛问题中所满足的对应变分不等式。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了带奇异势、双曲型松弛的Cahn–Hilliard型相场肿瘤生长模型最优控制问题的松弛极限理论。结果表明,松弛问题(α>0)与未松弛问题(α=0)在状态、伴随状态、最优控制及一阶最优性条件层面具有一致的极限对应关系,未松弛问题的每个最优控制都可由adapted松弛问题的最优控制族逼近,从而为双曲型松弛模型的合理性及其与抛物型松弛模型的联系提供了理论依据。

title: Code Equivalence and Automorphism Groups of Weighted Superelliptic Codes
summary: We study permutation and monomial equivalence for one-point codes on weighted superelliptic curves. On strata where $H_m\simeq \Z/n\Z\times\Z/m\Z$ acts regularly on the evaluation set, we prove that these codes are Cartesian character codes and determine their primal and dual minimum distances. We compute the projective monomial normalizer of the regular action and classify the compatible permutation and monomial equivalences through the induced actions on the defining sets. When $d > n$ and $m \geq 2$, the common permutation automorphism group of the full filtration is exactly $H_m$, and the regular action can be recovered from its two lowest nonconstant members. We determine the full permutation automorphism group in closed form at the top of the filtration and give a field-independent finite certificate for $\PAut ( \CC_s ) = H_m$ in the remaining primitive cases treated here. The hull dimension is bounded by the genus on every regular stratum, apart from the type $(3,3,3)$. Explicit examples show that length, dimension, and hull dimension do not determine monomial equivalence, and that the hull profile together with the regular automorphism subgroup does not determine the curve up to isomorphism. As an application, we determine the corresponding hull-based invariants and punctured signatures used in support-splitting methods.

AI.tldr: 研究加权超椭圆曲线上一点码的置换与单项等价，证明其在正则作用层上是笛卡尔特征码，确定原码与对偶码最小距离，分类兼容等价，并给出置换自同构群、hull维数与基于hull的不变量。
AI.motivation: 研究加权超椭圆曲线代数几何码的等价性分类问题，特别是置换与单项等价，因为等价性影响码的唯一性、自同构群结构以及基于hull的支撑分裂等解码方法中不变量与签名的确定。需要在正则作用层上刻画码的结构、距离、等价与自同构，并澄清长度、维数、hull维数及hull轮廓对等价和曲线同构的判定能力。
AI.method: 在H_m≅Z/nZ×Z/mZ正则作用于求值集的层上，将码识别为笛卡尔特征码；确定原码与对偶码的最小距离；计算正则作用的射影单项正规化子，并通过定义集上的诱导作用分类兼容的置换与单项等价；对d>n且m≥2的全滤链求公共置换自同构群，并研究最顶端与剩余本原情形；用亏格界定各正则层的hull维数；构造显式例子说明不变量与等价、曲线同构的关系；确定支撑分裂方法所需的hull型不变量与穿孔签名。
AI.result: 码为正则层上的笛卡尔特征码，原码与对偶码最小距离被确定；分类了兼容置换与单项等价；当d>n且m≥2时，全滤链公共置换自同构群恰为H_m，且正则作用可由两个最低非平凡成员恢复；给出滤链顶端置换自同构群闭式及剩余本原情形下PAut(C_s)=H_m的域无关有限证书；hull维数在除类型(3,3,3)外的每个正则层上由亏格界定；显式例子表明长度、维数与hull维数不能决定单项等价，hull轮廓与正则自同构子群不能决定曲线同构；确定支撑分裂方法中的hull型不变量与穿孔签名。
AI.conclusion: 加权超椭圆曲线上一点码在正则层具有笛卡尔特征码结构与可分类的等价性，其置换自同构群、hull维数界及hull型不变量得到明确刻画；但常用码参数与hull轮廓不足以判定单项等价或曲线同构，因此支撑分裂等方法需要更精细的hull与签名不变量。

title: Accurate contact discontinuity resolving Boltzmann schemes based on peculiar velocity
summary: Starting from the robust foundation of the peculiar velocity based upwind (PVU) Boltzmann scheme, which fails to recognize contact discontinuities, this paper introduces new variants for the numerical solutions of equations of gas dynamics. A modified partial differential equation (MPDE) analysis of the original scheme reveals that the numerical diffusion coefficient corresponding to the peculiar velocity part does not vanish as the Mach number goes to zero. The numerical discretization of the peculiar velocity term is redesigned so that the numerical diffusion depends only on the bulk fluid velocity across the stationary contact discontinuities, enabling its exact capture in 1D and exact capture of slip surfaces in 2D. The resulting variants achieve low numerical diffusion while preserving the robustness of the original scheme, as demonstrated through several 1D and 2D benchmark compressible flow test cases.

AI.tldr: 本文针对PVU Boltzmann格式无法识别接触间断的问题，通过MPDE分析揭示其peculiar velocity项数值扩散在低马赫数下不消失的缺陷，重新设计该项离散，使数值扩散仅依赖体速度，从而实现1D接触间断与2D滑移面的精确捕捉，并在保持鲁棒性的同时降低数值扩散。
AI.motivation: 原始的peculiar velocity based upwind (PVU) Boltzmann格式虽然鲁棒性强，但无法识别接触间断（contact discontinuities）。其根本原因在于数值扩散机制对接触间断的处理不当，因此需要分析并改进该格式的数值扩散特性。
AI.method: 采用modified partial differential equation (MPDE)分析原始格式，发现对应peculiar velocity部分的数值扩散系数在马赫数趋于零时不消失。据此重新设计peculiar velocity项的数值离散方式，使数值扩散仅取决于跨静止接触间断的体流体速度。
AI.result: 新变体实现了1D接触间断的精确捕捉以及2D滑移面（slip surfaces）的精确捕捉，同时保持低数值扩散并保留了原格式的鲁棒性。通过多个1D和2D基准可压缩流测试案例进行了验证。
AI.conclusion: 通过重新设计peculiar velocity项的离散，解决了PVU Boltzmann格式无法捕捉接触间断的问题，在保持鲁棒性的同时获得了低数值扩散，适用于可压缩流数值模拟。

title: A simple Lagrangian for shallow water equations with constant potential vorticity
summary: Inspired by a recent gauge field description of shallow water equations [SciPost Phys. 14 (2023) 102], in this work we build a simple Lagrangian formulation for the case of constant potential vorticity. An attractive feature of the construction is that it does not appeal to a Clebsch-like parametrization or the use of auxiliary fields. It is also emphasized that on the equator, where the Coriolis parameter vanishes, the shallow water equations exhibit extra SO(2,1) conformal invariance. Using the group-theoretic method, a new exact solution is found, which is associated with the scaling symmetry transformation entering the conformal group.

AI.tldr: 受近期浅水方程的规范场描述启发，本文在常数位涡条件下构建了一个简单的拉格朗日表述，无需Clebsch型参数化或辅助场；并指出在赤道处科里奥利参数为零时，浅水方程具有额外的SO(2,1)共形不变性，利用群论方法找到了与共形群标度对称变换相关的新精确解。
AI.motivation: 已有工作（SciPost Phys. 14 (2023) 102）给出了浅水方程的规范场描述，但通常的表述依赖Clebsch型参数化或引入辅助场，结构较为复杂；本文旨在为常数位涡情形构建更简洁的拉格朗日表述，并借助对称性分析获取新的精确解。动机可概括为：简化浅水方程的拉格朗日构造，并利用赤道处额外的共形对称性求解。
AI.method: 在常数位涡条件下，直接构造浅水方程的拉格朗日表述，避免使用Clebsch型参数化及辅助场。随后分析方程的对称性，指出在赤道处科里奥利参数消失时方程呈现额外的SO(2,1)共形不变性，并采用群论方法构造精确解。
AI.result: 得到了一个不依赖Clebsch型参数化和辅助场的简洁拉格朗日表述；确认赤道处（科里奥利参数为零）浅水方程具有额外的SO(2,1)共形不变性；利用群论方法获得了一个新的精确解，该解与进入共形群的标度对称变换相关联。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，常数位涡下的浅水方程可用更简洁的拉格朗日框架描述，且赤道处额外的SO(2,1)共形对称性可用于通过群论方法导出新的精确解，为浅水方程的对称性与可积结构研究提供了新途径。

title: Parisi's solution of the Sherrington--Kirkpatrick model from synchronous Monte Carlo dynamics
summary: Sompolinsky and Zippelius obtained Parisi's solution of the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) model from the relaxational dynamics of soft spins in continuous time, by assuming a hierarchy of widely separated time scales. Here we carry out the same programme for a discrete-time dynamics in which all Ising spins are updated at once. This dynamics, synchronous Monte Carlo (SyncMC), introduces Gaussian auxiliary fields so that the spins become conditionally independent, and it samples the Boltzmann distribution exactly for any system with symmetric pairwise couplings. We show that, for any such system, the correlation and response functions of SyncMC obey an exact fluctuation-dissipation relation in discrete time in equilibrium. The dynamical mean-field equations of SyncMC for the SK model contain two terms absent in continuous-time dynamics, a self-coupling of each spin and a noise correlated through the couplings; both affect only the fast relaxation. As a result, under the same assumptions as in the Sompolinsky-Zippelius construction (widely separated time scales, and on each slow scale the same relation with a reduced ratio x, as expected in relaxation from random initial conditions), the long-time structure of SyncMC reproduces the Parisi equations, including the Parisi partial differential equation and the equation for the distribution of local fields. Equilibrium simulations with replica exchange for up to N=2048 spins exclude the replica-symmetric distribution of the actual local fields and are consistent with the Parisi solution. The function x(q) estimated from the overlap distribution, and from the response in relaxation from random configurations for up to N=4096 spins, is also consistent with Parisi's.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究同步蒙特卡洛（SyncMC）离散时间动力学，证明其在SK模型中复现Parisi解，并通过数值模拟加以验证。
AI.motivation: Sompolinsky与Zippelius曾从连续时间软自旋弛豫动力学推导出SK模型的Parisi解，但该推导依赖连续时间假设。本文旨在将这一方案推广到所有Ising自旋同时更新的离散时间动力学，检验Parisi解在离散时间框架下是否依然成立。
AI.method: 引入同步蒙特卡洛（SyncMC）动力学，通过高斯辅助场使自旋条件独立，对任意具有对称两两耦合的系统精确采样Boltzmann分布。推导SyncMC在平衡态离散时间下的精确涨落-耗散关系，并导出SK模型的动力学平均场方程，分析其与连续时间动力学的差异。同时使用副本交换平衡模拟（N最大2048）和随机初态弛豫模拟（N最大4096）进行数值检验。
AI.result: SyncMC的动力学平均场方程比连续时间情形多出自旋自耦合和通过耦合关联的噪声两项，但二者仅影响快速弛豫。在与Sompolinsky-Zippelius相同的假设下，SyncMC的长时结构复现Parisi方程，包括Parisi偏微分方程及局域场分布方程。数值模拟排除了副本对称的局域场分布，与Parisi解一致；由重叠分布及弛豫响应估计的x(q)函数也与Parisi结果相符。
AI.conclusion: 离散时间的同步蒙特卡洛动力学能够精确复现SK模型的Parisi解，表明Parisi解的动力学起源不依赖于连续时间假设，同步更新动力学同样可以作为其微观动力学基础，数值结果进一步支持了Parisi理论的正确性。

title: Global well-posedness for the 2D primitive equations with subcritical horizontal dissipation
summary:
We establish global well-posedness of classical solutions to the two-dimensional primitive equations with fractional horizontal dissipation for arbitrarily large initial data in the full subcritical range $1<α\leq2$. Together with the known ill-posedness results for $0\leqα<1$, this establishes the sharp dissipation threshold for large-data global well-posedness in the corresponding solution framework.
  The key ingredient is a hydrostatic energy estimate obtained by splitting the nonlinear energy into symmetric and antisymmetric parts and exploiting the commutator structure of the latter. Using anisotropy and incompressibility, we bound the nonlinear energy by the $L^\infty$ norm of the hydrostatic vorticity times a quadratic velocity norm with only one-half additional horizontal derivative. The vorticity maximum principle then yields enhanced velocity bounds, which close the vorticity estimates and verify the continuation criterion throughout the subcritical regime.

AI.tldr: 本文在二维原始方程中引入分数阶水平耗散，证明了在满次临界范围 1<α≤2 内对任意大初值经典解的全局适定性，并结合已有 0≤α<1 的不适定性结果确定了尖锐的耗散阈值。
AI.motivation: 刻画二维原始方程在大初值下全局适定性与分数阶水平耗散强度之间的精确临界关系，补齐次临界区间 1<α≤2 的结果并确定尖锐阈值。
AI.method: 核心是静水平衡能量估计：将非线性能量分解为对称部分与反对称部分，利用反对称部分的交换子结构；借助各向异性与不可压缩性，用静水涡度的 L∞ 范数乘以仅含二分之一阶附加水平导数的速度二次范数来控制非线性能量；再由涡度极值原理获得增强的速度估计，闭合涡度估计并验证延拓准则。
AI.result: 证明了对任意大初值，在 1<α≤2 的满次临界范围内二维原始方程经典解全局适定；结合 0≤α<1 的不适定性结果，确立了相应解框架下大初值全局适定性的尖锐耗散阈值 α=1。
AI.conclusion: 分数阶水平耗散的强度阈值 α=1 是二维原始方程大初值全局适定性的分界点，所建立的静水平衡能量估计与涡度极值原理方法可有效处理次临界情形。

title: COVER: Learning to Accept More in Selective Sleep Staging
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures; code and frozen-result reproduction: https://github.com/Kevin11Kaikai/COVER-Selective-Sleep-Staging
summary: Traditional sleep-staging methods apply the same model to every EEG epoch. Such uniform deployment expends computation on epochs that a smaller model could handle reliably, motivating cascades in which a primary classifier accepts its reliable predictions and defers the remainder to a more capable model. In this paper, we study the first stage of such a cascade: maximizing the coverage of fixed primary predictions subject to a prescribed accepted-risk target. We propose COVER (COVerage-oriented Error Ranking), which integrates two key innovations: (i) auxiliary-informed primary-error learning, which replaces maximum softmax probability (MSP) with a learned error score while preserving the primary labels, and (ii) fixed-scale scorer refinement, which builds on this score to directly maximize coverage under an empirical accepted-risk constraint rather than error-prediction accuracy over all epochs. We evaluate COVER on Sleep-EDF-20 at a 5% accepted-risk target, with subjects held out from all fitting and selection. Auxiliary-informed error learning raises mean subject coverage from 31.5% for MSP to 48.8% at similar subject-equal risk. At equal acceptance volume, with MSP accepting the same number of epochs as the learned scorer in each subject (20,639 in total), errors fall from 1,467 to 867. Fixed-scale refinement then adds 1.7 percentage points of coverage over its initialization in nested development, and COVER attains the highest mean coverage among eight evaluated scorers, 50.4% at 4.5% subject-equal risk, above the selective-ranking baseline SELE (49.3%) and the probability-fusion comparator DuoF (43.6%). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to combine auxiliary-informed primary-error learning with fixed-scale coverage refinement for selective sleep staging, offering a basis for reliability-aware allocation of computation in cascaded sleep staging.

AI.tldr: 提出COVER方法，通过辅助信息驱动的主模型误差学习和固定尺度评分器精炼，在给定接受风险约束下最大化主预测覆盖率，用于级联睡眠分期第一阶段。
AI.motivation: 传统睡眠分期对所有EEG epoch统一使用同一模型，计算资源浪费；级联方法中较小主模型可处理可靠样本，其余交由更强模型，但需最大化主模型可靠预测的覆盖率。现有选择性预测以最大softmax概率(MSP)为主导，未能针对覆盖率优化。
AI.method: COVER包含两项创新：(i) 辅助信息驱动的主误差学习，用学习到的误差分数替代MSP，同时保留主模型标签；(ii) 固定尺度评分器精炼，基于该分数在经验接受风险约束下直接最大化覆盖率，而非优化全体epoch的误差预测精度。
AI.result: 在Sleep-EDF-20上以5%接受风险为目标、被试完全留出：辅助信息误差学习将平均被试覆盖率从MSP的31.5%提升至48.8%（被试等风险下）；同等接受量（共20,639个epoch）下错误从1467降至867；固定尺度精炼在嵌套开发中比初始化增加1.7个百分点覆盖率；COVER在八种评分器中平均覆盖率最高，为50.4%（被试等风险4.5%），优于SELE(49.3%)与DuoF(43.6%)。
AI.conclusion: 首次将辅助信息驱动的主误差学习与固定尺度覆盖率精炼结合用于选择性睡眠分期，为级联睡眠分期中可靠性感知的计算分配提供了基础。

title: Hypergraph Representation Learning with Hyperlink Random Effects
summary: Hypergraphs record multi-way interactions among entities. Extracting information from the combinatorial structure underlying observed multi-way interactions is a central task in many real-world problems. Existing methods face several limitations. First, many deep architectures for hypergraphs do not explicitly exploit the potential low-rank structure, which can sacrifice parsimony and interpretability in the learned representations. Second, many low-rank-based methods operate on tensor representations, which typically require hyperlinks to have uniform sizes and thus limit their applicability to general hypergraphs with non-uniform hyperlink sizes. Third, many methods ignore the fact that hyperlinks often arise from heterogeneous mechanisms. For example, medical symptoms may co-occur in the profiles of patients with very different conditions, and such heterogeneity should be incorporated into the learning process. In this work, we develop a general framework for hypergraph representation learning using hyperlink random effects while exploiting the low-rank structure in hypergraphs. The proposed framework accommodates latent heterogeneity in hyperlink formation while preserving entity interaction patterns. We establish identifiability of the model parameters and theoretical guarantees of representation-level recovery under this framework. The framework allows flexible specifications for the hyperlink random effects; in this paper, we study three choices: categorical, Gaussian mixture, and score-based effects, and develop corresponding estimation algorithms. Through simulation studies, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in recovering latent structure and capturing heterogeneous interaction patterns. Empirical studies on real-world hypergraph datasets further illustrate the practical utility of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种引入超边随机效应的超图表示学习通用框架，在利用低秩结构的同时建模异质性，具有可识别性与表示恢复理论保证，并在模拟和真实数据上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有超图表示学习方法存在三方面局限：一是许多深度架构未显式利用潜在低秩结构，牺牲了表示的简约性与可解释性；二是许多低秩方法基于张量表示，要求超边尺寸统一，难以适用于非均匀超边的一般超图；三是许多方法忽视了超边往往源自异质机制（如不同病症患者的症状共现），未将这种异质性纳入学习过程。
AI.method: 提出基于超边随机效应（hyperlink random effects）的超图表示学习通用框架，在保留实体交互模式的同时利用超图低秩结构并容纳超边形成的潜在异质性。框架对超边随机效应允许灵活设定，文中研究三种选择：分类（categorical）、高斯混合（Gaussian mixture）与基于打分（score-based）的效应，并给出相应估计算法。同时建立模型参数的可识别性及表示层面的恢复理论保证。
AI.result: 模拟研究显示，所提方法在恢复潜在结构与捕捉异质交互模式方面有效；在真实超图数据集上的实证研究进一步表明其实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一处理低秩结构与超边异质性，适用于非均匀超边的一般超图，具备理论保证与实证效果，为超图表示学习提供了通用且灵活的工具。

title: Largest Rashomon sets of decision trees for robust contextual optimization
summary: Many decision trees fit the same data almost equally well, yet they can route a query point to different leaves and induce different local empirical distributions. We study decisions that meet prescribed cost, shortage or risk targets despite this predictive multiplicity. We propose the joint Rashomon and robustness optimization framework for optimal decision trees. It jointly selects an operational decision and the largest Rashomon set of trees, so that the targets hold under the local empirical distribution that every tree in this set induces at the query point. We specialize the framework to the regression setting, and we show that a tree affects the decision only through the training observations sharing the query leaf, which we call its query neighborhood. As a result, the robust problem involves only finitely many distinct constraints, which can be examined in order of increasing estimation loss. We develop a constraint generation algorithm that combines query-path pricing with dynamic programming to identify violating neighborhoods without enumerating trees. On synthetic newsvendor instances, the algorithm typically needs few neighborhoods and runs substantially faster than full neighborhood enumeration. On restaurant demand data, the robust orders increase the mean tolerated excess estimation loss by 17.6% and reduce the empirical conditional value-at-risk of the worst 10% of realized costs by 8.3% relative to the sample average approximation orders of the optimal tree, while the mean cost difference is not statistically significant. An interpretability analysis further shows how the retained neighborhoods explain the decision and its robustness limit.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出联合Rashomon集与鲁棒性优化框架，用于在预测多重性下选择能满足既定成本、短缺或风险目标的最优决策树及操作决策。
AI.motivation: 许多决策树对同一数据的拟合效果几乎相同，但会将查询点导向不同叶节点，产生不同的局部经验分布，即预测多重性。这种多重性使基于单一树的决策在成本、短缺或风险目标上可能不可靠，因此需要在Rashomon集意义上保证决策鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出联合Rashomon与鲁棒性优化框架，同时选择操作决策和最大的Rashomon树集合，使目标在该集合中每棵树于查询点诱导的局部经验分布下均成立。在回归设定下证明树仅通过共享查询叶节点的训练观测（查询邻域）影响决策，因此鲁棒问题只涉及有限个不同约束，可按估计损失递增顺序检查。开发约束生成算法，结合查询路径定价与动态规划识别违约邻域，无需枚举所有树。
AI.result: 在合成newsvendor实例上，算法通常只需少量邻域，且显著快于完整邻域枚举。在餐厅需求数据上，相对于最优树的样本平均近似订单，鲁棒订单将平均可容忍超额估计损失提高17.6%，并将最差10%实现成本的实证条件风险价值降低8.3%，而平均成本差异在统计上不显著。可解释性分析进一步展示了保留邻域如何解释决策及其鲁棒性极限。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在预测多重性下提供满足目标的操作决策，并通过查询邻域刻画树的决策影响；约束生成算法高效可行，在真实数据上提升了风险容忍度并降低尾部风险，同时保持平均成本无显著恶化，并具备可解释性。

title: Relative completions and separating boundary divisors in moduli of curves
summary: We study relative completions of fundamental groups of moduli stacks of curves of compact type and of partial compactifications of the smooth moduli stack. For $g\geq3$, the compact-type completion has commutative prounipotent radical with Lie algebra $Λ^3_0H\oplus H^{\oplus n}$. Fix $1\leq h\leq g-1$. We show that adjoining the one-node loci of the separating divisors whose genus-$h$ side carries at most two markings gives the same relative completion. The proof uses explicit separating-twist calculations in weight $-2$, pointed Johnson homomorphisms, and the lantern relation. Functorial specialization gives the corresponding results in positive characteristic for odd $\ell$ different from the characteristic. As a consequence, extension to compact type of iterated extensions of algebraic symplectic local systems can be tested on these selected divisors. We also prove that any collection of separating divisors giving the same relative completion contains at least $\binom n2$ divisors.

AI.tldr: 研究紧致型曲线模栈与光滑模栈部分紧化的基本群的相对完备化，确定其单幂零根的李代数，并证明只需附加特定分离除子的单节点轨迹即可得到相同相对完备化，进而给出正特征推广与局部系统的延拓判据。
AI.motivation: 紧致型曲线模栈基本群的相对完备化结构及其单幂零根已知，但如何在更少的数据（更少的除子）上刻画同一完备化尚不清楚；这对于简化延拓判据、理解代数辛局部系统的迭代延拓具有重要意义。
AI.method: 对 g≥3 计算紧致型完备化的交换单幂零根，其李代数为 Λ^3_0 H ⊕ H^{⊕n}；固定 1≤h≤g−1，利用权 −2 的显式分离扭转计算、带基点 Johnson 同态和 lantern 关系，证明附加分离除子（其属 h 侧至多带两个标记）的单节点轨迹给出相同相对完备化；并通过函子性特化推广到正特征。
AI.result: 紧致型完备化的单幂零根交换，李代数为 Λ^3_0 H ⊕ H^{⊕n}；附加满足条件的分离除子单节点轨迹不改变相对完备化；得到奇 ℓ（异于特征）正特征下的对应结论；代数辛局部系统的迭代延拓可在这些选定除子上检验；任何给出相同相对完备化的分离除子集合至少含 C(n,2) 个除子。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了相对完备化的更经济的除子刻画，并给出延拓检验与计数下界，统一了特征零与正特征（奇 ℓ）情形。

title: A second-order energy-stable low-regularity integrator for the Navier--Stokes equations
summary: A second-order exponential low-regularity integrator is proposed for the incompressible Navier--Stokes equations. The method requires only linear solves and satisfies a discrete energy-decay property. Second-order temporal convergence is established under a uniform $H^4$ solution bound, with an error constant that remains bounded as the viscosity tends to zero. For the Fourier--Galerkin discretization, the optimal spatial convergence rate is established for fixed viscosity. The method can also be extended to conforming finite element methods while retaining the discrete energy-decay structure. Numerical results confirm the convergence orders and robustness with respect to the viscosity.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于不可压缩Navier–Stokes方程的二阶指数型低正则积分器，仅需线性求解并保持离散能量衰减；在H^4解界下证明具有对粘性一致有界的二阶时间收敛，并给出Fourier–Galerkin最优空间收敛及有限元扩展。
AI.motivation: 不可压缩Navier–Stokes方程的低正则数值求解需要兼顾稳定性与精度。现有方法常依赖非线性求解或正则性要求较高，且误差估计在粘性趋于零时可能失去一致性。本文旨在构造一种仅需线性求解、结构保持且对粘性鲁棒的二阶积分格式。
AI.method: 提出二阶指数型低正则积分器：利用指数积分处理刚性线性粘性项，非线性项采用低正则离散以降低对解正则性的要求；时间推进仅需线性求解，并设计保持离散能量衰减的格式。分析上在H^4解一致有界假设下建立二阶时间收敛估计，误差常数对粘性趋零一致有界；空间上采用Fourier–Galerkin离散并证明固定粘性下的最优收敛阶，同时说明可推广至协调有限元并保持能量衰减结构。
AI.result: 理论上获得二阶时间收敛率，误差常数随粘性趋于零保持有界；Fourier–Galerkin离散达到最优空间收敛阶；方法可扩展到协调有限元且保持离散能量衰减。数值实验验证了所证收敛阶及对粘性的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该二阶指数低正则积分器兼具线性求解成本、离散能量衰减与对粘性的鲁棒收敛性，适用于不可压缩Navier–Stokes方程的高效数值模拟，并可推广至有限元框架。

title: A Semi-Implicit All-Mach Numerical Method for Implicit Large Eddy Simulations
comment: Submitted to Journal of Computational Physics
summary: Implicit Large Eddy Simulation (ILES) is a well established approach for modeling high-Reynolds-number turbulent flows by numerical solution of the inviscid Euler equations in 3D. These turbulent flows cover a wide range of Mach numbers, including within individual simulations. For example, Richtmyer-Meshkov instability simulations transition from a high-Mach compressible regime to a low-Mach quasi-incompressible regime during the late-time evolution. These flows motivate the development of a semi-implicit all-Mach numerical method, which is subject to a CFL stability constraint corresponding to the fluid velocity, but independent of the speed of sound, and can be applied efficiently and accurately across the whole spectrum of Mach numbers. Furthermore, finite-volume discretization is chosen to maintain strict conservation and ensure robust and accurate capturing of strong shocks. The method is validated in both high- and low-Mach regimes. Validation is also presented for stratified atmospheres in the presence of gravity, and the method is thus shown to be applicable to buoyancy driven flows. We present favorable comparison against previously published ILES simulations of multimode Richtmyer-Meshkov instability from the $Θ$-group collaboration, Thornber et al., (arXiv:1706.09991).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种半隐式全马赫数有限体积数值方法，用于隐式大涡模拟（ILES），其CFL条件仅受流体速度限制而与声速无关，可在高、低马赫数及分层大气、浮力驱动流动中高效准确求解。
AI.motivation: 高雷诺数湍流流动（如Richtmyer-Meshkov不稳定性）在演化过程中会从高马赫可压缩区过渡到低马赫准不可压缩区，单一模拟内跨越宽马赫数范围，传统方法效率与精度受限，因此需要一种在全部马赫数区间都高效、准确的全马赫数数值方法。
AI.method: 采用半隐式全马赫数数值方法求解无粘Euler方程进行三维ILES；时间步受基于流体速度的CFL稳定性约束，与声速无关；采用有限体积离散以保证严格守恒，并稳健、准确地捕捉强激波。
AI.result: 方法在高马赫和低马赫区间均通过验证；在存在重力的分层大气中验证成功，证明可适用于浮力驱动流动；与Θ-group合作组Thornber等（arXiv:1706.09991）已发表的多模态Richtmyer-Meshkov不稳定性ILES模拟结果对比良好。
AI.conclusion: 该半隐式全马赫数有限体积方法适用于高雷诺数湍流的大涡模拟，能统一处理跨越宽马赫数范围的流动，并对强激波、分层大气和浮力驱动流动具有良好精度与鲁棒性，与已有基准模拟吻合。

title: Confined Riesz gas: From Newtonian Dynamics to Emergent Hydrodynamics
summary: We investigate the real-time dynamics of the Riesz gas (RG), a paradigmatic system of particles with power-law interactions that encapsulates several many-body interacting classical systems. While the equilibrium properties of the system have been extensively studied the connection between microscopic dynamics, macroscopic evolution and thermalization has remained largely unexplored. Combining extensive large-scale Newtonian simulations with a hydrodynamic framework formulated in terms of three coarse grained fields -- density, velocity, and temperature -- we establish a direct and quantitative correspondence between the two descriptions. The hydrodynamic theory incorporates two phenomenological transport coefficients, the bulk viscosity $ξ$ and thermal conductivity $κ$, which encode dissipative effects at a macroscopic level. By analyzing representative classes of initial conditions, such as dome-like and Newton-cradle-type profiles, we find excellent agreement between microscopic and hydrodynamic evolution over a broad range of timescales, starting from relatively early all the way up to times at which steady state is attained. Notably, this agreement persists across a substantial window of $ξ$ and $κ$, demonstrating the robustness of the emergent hydrodynamic description. Our results provide a systematic validation of hydrodynamics in the RG and establish a concrete bridge between Newtonian dynamics and continuum theories in systems with power-law interactions, starting from first principles.

AI.tldr: 本文结合大规模牛顿动力学模拟与包含密度、速度、温度三场的流体力学框架，系统研究了Riesz气体的实时动力学，揭示了微观动力学、宏观演化与热化之间的定量对应关系，并验证了流体力学的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: Riesz气体作为具有幂律相互作用的典型多体经典系统，其平衡性质已被广泛研究，但微观动力学、宏观演化与热化之间的联系在很大程度上仍未得到探索，因此需要建立微观与宏观描述之间的桥梁。
AI.method: 将大规模牛顿动力学模拟与以密度、速度、温度三个粗粒化场表述的流体力学框架相结合；该流体力学理论引入两个唯象输运系数——体积黏度ξ和热导率κ，以在宏观层面刻画耗散效应；并针对穹顶型和牛顿摆型等代表性初始条件进行分析。
AI.result: 在从相对早期到达到稳态的广泛时间尺度范围内，微观演化与流体力学演化之间表现出极好的一致性；且这种一致性在相当大的ξ和κ参数窗口内持续存在，表明所涌现的流体力学描述具有良好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究系统性地验证了Riesz气体中流体力学的有效性，并从第一性原理出发，在具有幂律相互作用的系统中建立了牛顿动力学与连续介质理论之间的具体联系。

title: Compactly Supported Strong Ill-Posedness of the Two-Dimensional Euler Flow in $W^{3,1}(\mathbb R^2)$
summary:
We prove strong ill-posedness for the two-dimensional incompressible Euler equation in the endpoint velocity space $W^{3,1}_σ(\mathbb R^2)$. Given any compactly supported smooth divergence-free background and any $δ>0$, we construct a single compactly supported divergence-free datum within $δ$ of the background in $W^{3,1}$. The perturbation can be localized inside any prescribed nonempty open neighborhood of the background support while remaining disjoint from that support. The associated unique global finite-energy solution $u$ satisfies ${\rm curl} u\in C([0,\infty);W^{2,1}(\mathbb R^2))$, but \[
  \operatorname*{ess\,sup}_{0<t<T}\|u(t)\|_{W^{3,1}}=\infty
  \qquad\text{for every }T>0. \] The proof combines localized hyperbolic insertion, the Bonami--Poornima nonmultiplier mechanism, and many-packet dilution. Moment cancellation and positive material separation control the nonlocal Biot--Savart interactions, allowing a nested construction inside one fixed compact region. Without the compact-support requirement on the limiting datum, a complementary far-field argument yields a dense $G_δ$ set of data whose solutions leave $W^{3,1}$ at every positive rational time and on a residual set of times, with unbounded essential supremum on every nonempty open time interval.

AI.tldr: 该文证明了二维不可压缩Euler方程在端点速度空间 \(W^{3,1}_\sigma(\mathbb R^2)\) 中的强不适定性：可构造紧支光滑无散背景附近的任意小紧支无散扰动数据，其唯一有限能量全局解具有 \(W^{2,1}\) 的涡度但 \(W^{3,1}\) 范数在每个正时刻附近本质无界。
AI.motivation: 研究二维不可压缩Euler方程在临界/端点正则性空间中的适定性边界。\(W^{3,1}\) 恰好是速度空间中使涡度落入 \(W^{2,1}\) 的端点，作者旨在揭示该空间上解映射的强不连续性与正则性崩塌现象，并刻画这种失效在时间上的普遍性。
AI.method: 结合三种机制：局部双曲插入（localized hyperbolic insertion）、Bonami--Poornima 非乘子机制以及多包稀释（many-packet dilution）。利用矩抵消与正的材料分离控制非局部 Biot--Savart 相互作用，从而在同一固定紧区域内完成嵌套构造。另对不要求极限数据紧支的情形，采用远场论证构造稠密 \(G_\delta\) 集。
AI.result: 给定任意紧支光滑无散背景及任意 \(\delta>0\)，可构造位于背景 \(W^{3,1}\) 范数 \(\delta\) 邻域内的单个紧支无散数据，扰动可局部化于背景支集的任意既定非空开邻域内且与支集不相交；其对应的唯一全局有限能量解 \(u\) 满足 \({\rm curl}\,u\in C([0,\infty);W^{2,1})\)，但对每个 \(T>0\) 有 \(\operatorname*{ess\,sup}_{0<t<T}\|u(t)\|_{W^{3,1}}=\infty\)。若去掉极限数据的紧支要求，则存在稠密 \(G_\delta\) 数据集，其解在每个正有理时刻及一个剩余时间集上离开 \(W^{3,1}\)，且在每个非空时间开区间上本质上确界无界。
AI.conclusion: 二维Euler方程在端点空间 \(W^{3,1}_\sigma\) 上强不适定，解映射不连续且正则性在瞬时崩塌，且该现象可由紧支局部扰动或远场扰动普遍实现。

title: TreeWalker: Partial Evaluation for Grouped Tree-Ensemble Inference
comment: 23 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/Shopify/treewalker
summary:
Many inference workloads evaluate a trained tree ensemble on row groups that share feature values: discrete-time survival models expand each patient into $G$ time steps, click-through-rate models score every item in a search session, and scenario analyses vary a few inputs while holding the rest fixed. Standard inference treats each row independently and repeats the shared work $G$ times.
  We present TreeWalker, which applies partial evaluation to grouped inference: constant features are static, varying features dynamic. It walks each tree once per group, partitions a row bitmask at varying splits, and skips empty subtrees. Training is unchanged: TreeWalker reads standard LightGBM and XGBoost models.
  We prove a structural work decomposition: per-tree work splits into the constant-projected subtree size $|T_c|$, $G$ leaf writes, and a predicate-mask provisioning cost $Q$. For the trace evaluator, per-row work approaches a $(d_v+1)/(d+1)$ fraction of a row-independent walk as $G \to \infty$.
  On Intel, TreeWalker is 2.5-3.2$\times$ faster than a row-independent traversal at the reference configuration ($T=500$, $L=8$) and 6.8-7.8$\times$ faster at $G=128$ on the survival datasets, with larger gains on Arm. On a scenario-analysis benchmark it is faster in all 16 configurations on both architectures. For f64 models, outputs match treelite's GTIL up to summation order; for f32 models, f64 accumulation is closer to a Kahan-compensated reference than native f32 on 99.98% of rows and never farther.

AI.tldr: TreeWalker 将分组推理中的常量特征视为静态、变化特征视为动态，通过对每棵树做部分求值（一次遍历覆盖整组行），跳过空子树并证明工作量分解，在 Intel/Arm 上实现显著加速且数值精度不劣于现有方案。
AI.motivation: 许多推理负载（离散时间生存模型、CTR 模型、情景分析）在同一行组内共享部分特征值，而标准逐行推理会重复计算共享工作 G 次，造成大量冗余。
AI.method: 提出 TreeWalker，对分组推理做部分求值：常量特征为静态、变化特征为动态；每组每棵树仅遍历一次，在动态分裂处对行位掩码进行划分，并跳过空子树；训练流程不变，直接读取标准 LightGBM 与 XGBoost 模型。
AI.result: 证明结构性工作量分解：每棵树工作分为常量投影子树大小 |T_c|、G 次叶写入与谓词掩码供给开销 Q；当 G→∞ 时，trace 评估器的逐行工作量趋近于行独立遍历的 (d_v+1)/(d+1)。Intel 上在参考配置 (T=500, L=8) 下比行独立遍历快 2.5–3.2×，G=128 的生存数据集上快 6.8–7.8×，Arm 上增益更大；情景分析基准的 16 种配置在两种架构上均更快。f64 模型输出与 treelite GTIL 在求和顺序上一致；f32 模型下，f64 累加在 99.98% 的行上比原生 f32 更接近 Kahan 补偿参考，且从不更差。
AI.conclusion: TreeWalker 通过部分求值有效消除分组推理中的重复工作，理论上有工作量分解与渐近加速保证，实践中在多种架构和负载上均获得显著加速，同时保持与现有实现相当或更优的数值精度。

title: Exact Fast Batch Simulation for Tabular Reinforcement Learning
summary: Simulation is a fundamental computational primitive in reinforcement learning (RL), yet conventional simulation explicitly generates individual trajectories even when downstream procedures use only aggregate statistics. To address this, we develop an exact fast-simulation framework for finite-horizon tabular Markov decision processes. Our framework has two complementary modes. In direct batch simulation, a batch is represented by its aggregate Markov flow. With sufficient parallel simulation resources, this flow can be obtained by trajectory aggregation; when such simulation is unavailable or costly but the initial state and transition distributions are directly accessible, we instead generate an identically distributed flow through forward Markov-flow sampling without materializing individual trajectories. The latter reduces the simulator-side computational dependence on batch size $m$ from $O(m)$ to $O(1)$. In adaptive batch simulation, when batch length is determined by a data-dependent condition, exact multivariate-hypergeometric splitting recursively refines a candidate Markov flow while preserving the conditional law, reducing the cost dependence on $m$ from $O(m)$ to $O(\log m)$. Together, these modes accelerate simulation by keeping trajectories aggregated whenever possible and refining flows only when required to locate data-dependent boundaries. The framework applies broadly across simulator-based, offline, and online batch or stage-based RL, as illustrated with representative algorithms from each setting.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出面向有限时域表格型MDP的精确快速仿真框架，通过“聚合的马尔可夫流”替代显式生成单条轨迹，将仿真侧对批量大小m的计算依赖从O(m)降至O(1)或O(log m)。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习仿真即使在后续只使用聚合统计量时，仍显式生成每条独立轨迹，造成不必要的计算开销；作者希望消除这种冗余，实现更高效的仿真原语。
AI.method: 提出包含两种互补模式的精确快速仿真框架：1）直接批量仿真，用聚合马尔可夫流表示一个批次，可通过轨迹聚合获得，或在初始状态与转移分布可直接访问时通过前向马尔可夫流采样生成同分布流，无需物化单条轨迹；2）自适应批量仿真，当批量长度由数据相关条件决定时，采用精确多元超几何分裂递归细化候选马尔可夫流，同时保持条件分布。
AI.result: 直接批量仿真将仿真侧对批量大小m的计算依赖从O(m)降到O(1)；自适应批量仿真将依赖从O(m)降到O(log m)。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过尽可能保持轨迹聚合、仅在需要定位数据相关边界时细化流，广泛适用于基于仿真器、离线及在线的批量或阶段式强化学习，并以各类代表性算法进行了说明。

title: Rank-sensitive vertex bounds for semidefinite lifts
summary:
We study how the ranks of factors in a positive semidefinite slack factorization constrain its size. We bound the number of low-rank vertex factors in any fixed factorization, and use this to determine the asymptotic order of the minimum factorization size under any fixed bound on vertex-factor ranks: $Θ(n\log n)$ for permutahedra $Π_n$ and $Θ(\log N)$ for regular $N$-gons. In the rank-one case this gives the order of the minimum dimension of a space of real functions on the vertices in which every facet slack is a sum of squares, with no symmetry or degree restriction. For unrestricted lifts, the bound gives $\mathrm{xc}_{\mathrm{PSD}}(Π_n)\ge n+\log_3 n-O(1)$, and shows that a permutahedron factorization of linear size would need vertex factors of rank $Ω(\log n)$ at all but a vanishing fraction of vertices.
  We also prove that every polytope of real positive semidefinite rank at most four has at most twelve vertices, and construct explicit size-four lifts for every square-symmetric octagon, so eight is attained. The upper bound combines a count of the polygon corners reached by curves of rank-one factors with incidence constraints on factor ranks. Whether eight is the maximum remains open.

AI.tldr: 研究半正定松弛因子分解中因子秩对分解规模的约束：给出低秩顶点因子数量的界，确定顶点因子秩受固定限制时最小分解规模的渐近阶（permutahedron 为 Θ(n log n)，正 N 边形为 Θ(log N)），并证明实 PSD 秩 ≤4 的多面体至多 12 个顶点，同时构造出达到 8 的方对称八边形 size-4 提升。
AI.motivation: 半正定（PSD）提升的规模与因子的秩结构之间存在基本但未被充分理解的关系。本文旨在刻画顶点因子秩如何限制整体分解规模，从而理解 PSD 扩张复杂度（如 xc_PSD）的下界，并推进"PSD 秩与多面体顶点数"之间定量关系的分类问题。
AI.method: 将 PSD 松弛分解视为 slack 分解，统计任意固定分解中低秩顶点因子的个数，由此导出最小分解规模的上下界；在秩一情形下将问题转化为"每个面 slack 均为平方和"的实函数空间的最小维数；对无限制提升给出 xc_PSD 的下界估计；对上界则结合秩一因子曲线所到达的多边形角点计数与因子秩的关联约束进行论证。
AI.result: 顶点因子秩固定限制下：permutahedron Π_n 的最小分解规模为 Θ(n log n)，正 N 边形为 Θ(log N)；秩一情形给出对应函数空间最小维数的阶；无限制提升下 xc_PSD(Π_n) ≥ n + log_3 n − O(1)，且线性规模的 permutahedron 分解需在几乎所有顶点处具有秩 Ω(log n) 的顶点因子。此外，实 PSD 秩 ≤4 的多面体至多 12 个顶点，并构造了每个方对称八边形显式的 size-4 提升，故 8 是可以达到的；8 是否为最大值仍未解决。
AI.conclusion: 因子秩对 PSD 分解规模构成实质性约束，据此可得多个渐近最优的规模估计及 xc_PSD 的新下界。对于小 PSD 秩（≤4），多面体顶点数被限制在 12 以内，且方对称八边形可达 size 8；"8 是否为最大可达规模"作为开放问题留待后续研究。

title: Counting higher-rank sheaves on toric threefolds
summary:
We develop an equivariant K-theoretic vertex formalism for a colored, abelianized higher-rank sector on smooth projective toric threefolds $X$. Nonzero first Chern classes are encoded as magnetic fluxes and absorbed into line-bundle twists, after which the virtual character is redistributed into finite perturbative, vertex, and edge contributions. We compute the resulting (unreduced and trace-free) virtual dimensions and analyze the interaction terms relevant to a possible reduction to rank one. We emphasize that, on a compact toric threefold, colored partitions do not classify all torus-fixed stable higher-rank sheaves: the resulting series is therefore a proposed abelianized/framed vertex series unless an additional comparison theorem with the full stable-sheaf moduli problem is supplied.
  When the threefold obstruction theory is not available in the desired form, we pass to the local Calabi--Yau fourfold $Y=\operatorname{Tot}(K_X)$ and formulate the corresponding colored DT4 vertex. A $K_X$-twisted tautological insertion removes fixed points with nontrivial fiber layers, reducing solid partitions to plane partitions at the level of the local vertex. In rank one we give a scheme-theoretic explanation: the Hilbert functor of subschemes of $X$ is canonically isomorphic to the constrained Hilbert functor of subschemes of $Y$ lying scheme-theoretically in the fixed zero section. Under the hypotheses of the DT4 K-theoretic Lefschetz/virtual-pullback formalism, the associated support insertion reduces the rank-one fourfold theory to the threefold theory. We keep this global rank-one statement logically distinct from the higher-rank colored-vertex reduction.

AI.tldr: 构建光滑射影toric三维簇上带色、阿贝尔化高秩扇区的等变K理论顶点形式，将非零第一陈类作为磁通量吸收进线丛扭曲，并分析约化到秩一的相关相互作用项；在DT4情形下通过K_X-扭曲插入将固体分拆约化为平面分拆，并在秩一给出概型论解释。
AI.motivation: 在紧toric三维簇上，带色分拆并不能分类所有环面固定的稳定高秩层，因此需要明确顶点级数的性质（阿贝尔化/框架化），并在三维阻碍理论不可用时转向局部Calabi-Yau四维情形处理。
AI.method: 发展等变K理论顶点形式；将非零第一陈类编码为磁通量并吸收为线丛扭曲，把虚拟特征分解为有限微扰、顶点和边贡献；计算（未约化与无迹）虚拟维数；在局部CY四维Y=Tot(K_X)上构造带色DT4顶点，使用K_X-扭曲的tautological插入消除非平凡纤维层的不动点；在秩一时给出Hilbert函子的概型论同构。
AI.result: 得到（未约化与无迹）虚拟维数并分析了与约化到秩一相关的相互作用项；在局部顶点层面将固体分拆约化为平面分拆：秩一时X子概型的Hilbert函子与位于零截面内的Y子概型的约束Hilbert函子典范同构；在DT4 K理论Lefschetz/虚拟拉回形式假设下，支撑插入将秩一四维理论约化为三维理论。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的级数在无额外比较定理时仅为阿贝尔化/框架化顶点级数；全局秩一的约化与高秩带色顶点约化在逻辑上严格区分。

title: Oriented point-cloud varifolds for estimating the perimeter and computing its Wasserstein gradient flow
summary: This paper develops a mesh-free numerical method for the one-phase Mullins-Sekerka flow, in which the interface bounding a set moves as the Wasserstein gradient flow of its perimeter. One difficulty in computing this flow is that two pieces of the interface with opposite normals form a hidden boundary when components merge. Our approach represents the interface by an oriented point cloud, which we treat as an oriented varifold. We introduce a quantity that measures how much nearby normals cancel each other and use it to detect the hidden boundary. Based on this quantity, we construct a perimeter estimator, prove that its expected error decays at an algebraic rate in the number of points, also in the presence of a hidden boundary, and use it in a minimizing movement scheme for the flow in two dimensions. Numerical experiments show that the scheme computes mergers of components through the hidden boundary, while the perimeter term in the scheme decreases at every step and the area is nearly conserved. As hidden boundaries also appear in other perimeter-driven interface problems, we expect our oriented representation to be applicable to them as well.

AI.tldr: 提出无网格数值方法求解单相Mullins-Sekerka流，用有向点云（有向varifold）表示界面，引入法向抵消量检测隐藏边界，构建周长估计子并证明期望误差随点数代数衰减，结合最小化运动格式模拟两维流动。
AI.motivation: 界面由Wasserstein梯度流驱动运动，当两组法向相反的界面片段相遇形成隐藏边界（hidden boundary）时，合并过程难以计算；隐藏边界也出现在其他以周长为驱动的界面问题中，需要统一的表示与检测手段。
AI.method: 以有向点云表示界面，并视作有向varifold；构造度量邻近法向相互抵消程度的量以检测隐藏边界；基于该量构建周长估计子，证明其期望误差在点数上呈代数速率衰减（含隐藏边界情形）；将其嵌入两维最小化运动（minimizing movement）格式求解流动。
AI.result: 数值实验表明该格式能通过隐藏边界计算组分合并，每步周长项递减，且面积近似守恒；周长估计子的期望误差在隐藏边界存在时仍满足代数衰减率。
AI.conclusion: 有向表示与隐藏边界检测为Mullins-Sekerka流提供了有效的无网格计算方案，并有望推广至其他周长驱动的界面问题。

title: Direct Numerical Simulation of Transonic Flows Induced Pitching of NACA Airfoil
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, Presented and submitted to International Conference on Thermofluids Engineering (INCOTHERM 2025)
summary: A Direct Numerical Simulation (DNS) investigates transonic flow over a NACA0012 airfoil coupled with single-DOF structural dynamics. Analysis is performed for angle of attack (α) 8° with varying reduced velocity (U*) from 2 to 8, reduced mass (m*) 5.0, Reynolds number (Re_\infty) of 3 \times 10^6, and Mach number (M_\infty) 0.8. The speed of sound in air is calculated as a = sqrt(γRT_\infty). It is noted that the magnitude of the aerodynamic loads and moments increased with higher reduced velocity. The Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) of the moment coefficient (C_M) in the fixed-airfoil condition is carried out to extract the non-dimensional dominant frequency, referred to as the Strouhal number (St), along with the coupled oscillation frequency of the airfoil (Stc). The FFT analysis for the stationary case at α = 8° yields a value of St = 1.3161. The presence of high-frequency components indicates the onset of instability associated with shock-boundary layer interaction. The computed values of the coupled oscillation frequency (Stc ) are 0.0762 and 0.1716 for the cases with angle of attack (AoA) 8° and reduced velocities U* = 2.0 and 8.0, respectively. The corresponding natural aeroelastic frequencies (Stn) are taken as 1/U*, yielding values of 0.5 and 0.125. It is observed that for U* = 2, the coupled frequency (Stc) aligns with the subharmonic of shock-buffet frequency, indicating flow-dominated dynamics. In contrast, for U* = 8, Stc coincides with the natural pitching frequency, indicating a dominant influence of the structural mode. Pressure fluctuation contours are examined to analyze the characteristics of acoustic radiation. Vorticity and schlieren visualizations are employed to identify the nature of vortex structures, the strength of the shock, and its spatial location, respectively.

AI.tldr: 采用DNS研究NACA0012翼型跨声速流动与单自由度结构耦合，α=8°、Re=3×10⁶、M=0.8，U*=2~8。随U*增大气动载荷与力矩增大；固定翼FFT得St=1.3161，且存在高频分量（激波-边界层干扰失稳）。耦合频率Stc在U*=2时为0.0762（对应激波抖振亚谐，流动主导），U*=8时为0.1716（接近自然俯仰频率1/U*=0.125，结构主导）。
AI.motivation: 跨声速下激波-边界层干扰与结构运动相互耦合，气动弹性响应机制复杂；需要明确不同折合速度下流动主导与结构主导的转换规律，以及激波抖振亚谐与结构模态的相互作用。
AI.method: 直接数值模拟（DNS）求解NACA0012翼型跨声速流动，耦合单自由度结构动力学。参数：攻角α=8°，折合速度U*=2~8，折合质量m*=5.0，Re=3×10⁶，M=0.8，声速a=sqrt(γRT∞)。对固定翼力矩系数C_M作FFT提取无量纲主频St及耦合振荡频率Stc；自然气动弹性频率取Stn=1/U*。采用压力脉动云图分析声辐射，涡量与纹影可视化识别涡结构、激波强度与空间位置。
AI.result: 气动力与力矩幅值随U*增大而增大。固定翼α=8°时FFT得St=1.3161，高频分量的出现指示激波-边界层干扰引发的失稳。耦合振荡频率Stc：U*=2时为0.0762，U*=8时为0.1716；对应自然频率Stn=1/U*分别为0.5与0.125。U*=2时Stc与激波抖振频率的亚谐一致，表现为流动主导；U*=8时Stc与自然俯仰频率吻合，表现为结构模态主导。
AI.conclusion: 跨声速翼型气弹耦合响应随折合速度呈现由流动主导到结构主导的转变：低U*下耦合频率锁定于激波抖振亚谐，高U*下由结构俯仰频率控制。高频成分与激波-边界层干扰失稳相关，压力脉动、涡量与纹影结果共同揭示了声辐射特征、涡结构性质及激波强度与位置。

title: Probabilistic Algorithms for Ising Machines from Optimization to Generative AI
summary: Ising machines have emerged as promising hardware accelerators for intractable optimization and sampling problems, yet their practical impact increasingly hinges on the co-design of algorithms and hardware, where algorithmic demands shape new architectures and new hardware capabilities inspire entirely new algorithms. In this Review, we survey probabilistic algorithms designed for portability across diverse Ising platforms, advocating a top-down perspective that prioritizes principled methods with provable guarantees. We cover foundational methods such as simulated annealing and parallel tempering, including two-dimensional extensions that natively encode hard constraints, and examine approaches that expand the scale of solvable problems from cluster mean-field methods to variational samplers. We highlight the Probabilistic Approximate Optimization Algorithm (PAOA), a classical analog of QAOA that emerged directly from probabilistic hardware development, and explore how generative AI and Ising machines might reinforce each other: learned models propose global moves to accelerate optimization, while probabilistic techniques improve inference in large language models. Much as quantum computing has seen algorithms co-evolve with hardware, probabilistic and Ising computing stand at a similar inflection point. We outline a co-design framework for accelerating the capabilities and adoption of next-generation Ising machines.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇综述，从自顶向下视角梳理了面向多样化Ising平台的概率算法，强调软硬件协同设计，并展望下一代Ising机器的加速与落地框架。
AI.motivation: Ising机器作为求解难解优化与采样问题的硬件加速器，其实际影响力日益取决于算法与硬件的协同设计：算法需求塑造新架构，新硬件能力催生新算法。作者因此倡导以可证明保证的原则性方法为核心的综述视角。
AI.method: 综述性方法：以自顶向下（top-down）视角，聚焦可跨多种Ising平台移植的概率算法。内容涵盖模拟退火、并行回火及其二维扩展（原生编码硬约束）、簇平均场到变分采样器等扩展问题规模的方法，重点介绍源自概率硬件发展的PAOA（QAOA的经典类比），并探讨生成式AI与Ising机器的相互促进。
AI.result: 归纳出概率算法在Ising平台上的可移植性谱系；指出PAOA是从概率硬件开发中直接涌现的算法；阐明生成式AI与Ising机器的双向增强关系——学习模型提供全局移动以加速优化，概率技术提升大语言模型推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 正如量子计算中算法与硬件共同演化，概率与Ising计算正处于类似拐点。作者提出一个协同设计框架，以加速下一代Ising机器能力的提升与推广应用。

title: Hardy Space and Exponential Decay of Inhomogeneous Navier-Stokes System in the 2D Global domain
summary: We investigate the inhomogeneous incompressible Navier-Stokes system in the 2D global domain with zero initial total momentum, allowing vacuum and densities with finite moments but not necessarily compact support. Exploiting the cancellation structure inherent in the 2D equations along with spatial moment bounds on the density, we derive that the inertial force belongs to the Hardy space and establish weighted Stokes estimates through endpoint Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev inequalities. These estimates identify the far-field velocity and control the remainder, leading to uniform exponential decay of the velocity throughout global domains. Combined with higher order regularity bounds, we establish the global well-posedness of strong solutions for the density-dependent viscosity case, and prove the uniform regularity of flow maps for measurable density patches in the constant viscosity model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二维全空间中零初始总动量的非齐次不可压Navier-Stokes系统，允许出现真空及具有有限矩（但未必紧支）的密度。通过利用二维方程的消去结构并结合密度的空间矩估计，证明惯性力属于Hardy空间，并借助端点Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev不等式建立加权Stokes估计，从而刻画远场速度并获得速度的一致指数衰减。结合高阶正则性估计，得到密度依赖粘性情形强解的全局适定性，并证明常粘性模型中可测密度斑块流映射的一致正则性。
AI.motivation: 研究允许真空、密度仅具有限矩且未必紧支的二维非齐次不可压Navier-Stokes系统在零初始总动量下的全局适定性与长时间行为，填补密度正则性较弱时强解适定性及速度衰减理论空白。
AI.method: 利用二维方程的消去结构，结合密度的空间矩有界性，证明惯性力属于Hardy空间；通过端点Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev不等式建立加权Stokes估计，用于识别远场速度并控制余项；进而结合高阶正则性估计进行分析。
AI.result: 在二维全空间零初始总动量条件下，获得速度在全空间上的一致指数衰减；对密度依赖粘性模型建立强解的全局适定性；对常粘性模型中可测密度斑块证明流映射的一致正则性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，借助Hardy空间框架与加权Stokes估计，可在密度仅具有限矩且允许真空的弱正则性假设下，统一处理二维非齐次不可压Navier-Stokes系统的全局适定性、速度衰减及流映射正则性。

title: DePICT: Decision-Preserving Interface for Constrained Downstream Tasks
summary: A constrained optimization problem may involve a parameter in its objective and active constraints, yet the final decision may remain insensitive to small changes in that parameter. This raises a fundamental question: which inputs does a decision making system truly depend on? Building on this question, we introduce DePICT, a procedure for constructing decision preserving interfaces by ranking context directions according to the optimizer's solution sensitivity and aggregating them across an operating regime. We study this problem in a high dimensional setting where primitive context parameterizes a constrained task and the downstream agent observes only a selected subset of context directions. For locally regular constrained programs, we derive a Karush Kuhn Tucker (KKT) based characterization of when a context direction is optimizer relevant. Our analysis shows that appearing in the active optimization problem does not necessarily imply that a variable affects the final decision. Some context directions can alter the KKT conditions while leaving the optimal solution unchanged because their effect is absorbed by the dual variables. DePICT is designed to remove exactly these directions. In a controlled diagnosis, it recovers the decision relevant interface exactly and reduces linear predictor regret to 0.009, compared with 0.475 for the strongest competing baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DePICT，通过对优化器解的敏感度排序并聚合上下文方向，构建"决策保持接口"，在约束优化问题中精确识别真正影响最优解的上下文方向。
AI.motivation: 约束优化问题的目标函数与活跃约束中虽含参数，但最终决策可能对参数微小变化不敏感。核心问题是：决策系统究竟依赖哪些输入？现有理解不足，作者希望刻画"优化器相关"的上下文方向。
AI.method: 在高维设定下，原始上下文参数化一个约束任务，下游智能体仅观测上下文方向的选定子集。针对局部正则约束规划，作者基于KKT条件推导出"某上下文方向是否与优化器相关"的判别刻画，并据此设计DePICT：按解敏感度对上下文方向排序，并在一个运行区间内聚合，从而剔除那些改变KKT条件但因对偶变量吸收而最优解不变的方向。
AI.result: 在受控诊断实验中，DePICT精确恢复了与决策相关的接口，将线性预测器的遗憾降至0.009，而最强竞争基线为0.475。
AI.conclusion: 出现在活跃优化问题中并不必然意味着该变量影响最终决策；某些上下文方向仅改变KKT条件却被对偶变量吸收。DePICT能精确剔除这类方向，构建真正决策保持的接口。

title: Variance-Aware Fine-Grained Gap-Dependent Bounds for Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: We study model-free online reinforcement learning (RL) for episodic tabular Markov decision processes, focusing on both gap-dependent regret and policy switching cost. While fine-grained gap-dependent analysis has been established for model-free RL algorithms using Hoeffding-type exploration bonuses, such results for model-free algorithms with variance-based exploration bonuses remain unknown, despite their superior worst-case and coarse-grained gap-dependent guarantees. In this paper, we resolve this open problem by establishing the first fine-grained gap-dependent regret upper bound for UCB-Bernstein+, a refined UCB-Bernstein algorithm, in variance-aware model-free online RL. Moreover, by integrating a stage-wise policy update design into our fine-grained framework and using refined variance-based bonuses, we achieve the best-known gap-dependent local switching cost to date. In addition, our analysis yields improved worst-case guarantees for both regret and local switching cost over the original UCB-Bernstein algorithm. Numerical experiments further demonstrate that UCB-Bernstein+ achieves favorable empirical performance in both regret and local switching cost.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为基于方差探索奖励的无模型强化学习算法（UCB-Bernstein+）建立了细粒度间隙依赖遗憾上界，并实现了目前最优的间隙依赖局部策略切换成本。
AI.motivation: 基于Hoeffding型探索奖励的无模型RL算法已有细粒度间隙依赖分析，但基于方差探索奖励的无模型算法尽管在worst-case和coarse-grained间隙依赖保证上更优，其细粒度间隙依赖分析仍属空白。本文旨在解决这一开放问题。
AI.method: 针对episodic tabular MDP，提出精细化的UCB-Bernstein+算法；在细粒度分析框架中引入stage-wise策略更新设计，并采用改进的方差型探索奖励。
AI.result: 建立了UCB-Bernstein+首个细粒度间隙依赖遗憾上界；实现了目前最优的间隙依赖局部切换成本；相较原UCB-Bernstein算法，在遗憾和局部切换成本的worst-case保证上均有提升；数值实验验证了其在遗憾和局部切换成本上的良好经验性能。
AI.conclusion: UCB-Bernstein+在理论保证与实验性能上均优于原UCB-Bernstein，填补了方差型无模型RL细粒度间隙依赖分析的空白。

title: Tensor Envelopes in the Nonconvex Setting
summary: We introduce a tensor envelope (TEE) for composite objectives $\varphi=f+g$, built from a $q$th-order Taylor model of the smooth term $f$ regularized by a $p$th power with $p>q$. To construct it, we first establish a tensor descent lemma and characterize its behavior in the three regimes $q<p<q+1$, $p=q+1$, and $p>q+1$. Under suitable prox-boundedness and parameter conditions, the associated tensor operator (TOP) has nonempty compact values, and TEE is finite-valued and continuous, preserves global minimizers, and inherits the level-boundedness of $\varphi$. We further show that TEE is locally Lipschitz continuous and directionally differentiable, characterize its Fréchet differentiability, and prove that it is $C^1$ whenever TOP is single-valued. As such, TEE preserves the essential optimization landscape properties of $\varphi$ while enjoying a richer analytical structure, which facilitates the design and analysis of tensor-based optimization methods. Finally, TEE serves as a Lyapunov function for the exact tensor iteration: every cluster point is critical, and, for bounded trajectories with $q<p\le q+1$, an $ε$-stationary point is reached within $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-p/(p-1)})$ iterations. To our knowledge, both the tensor descent lemma and this complexity bound are the first of their kind obtained without assuming global Lipschitz or Hölder continuity of the $q$th-order derivative of $f$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出张量包络（TEE），基于光滑项的q阶泰勒模型并用p次幂（p>q）正则化，系统刻画其分析性质与优化景观保持性，并作为精确张量迭代的Lyapunov函数给出收敛性与复杂度保证。
AI.motivation: 面向复合目标φ=f+g，传统张量方法通常依赖f的q阶导数的全局Lipschitz或Hölder连续性假设，限制了适用范围；本文希望在更弱假设下构造具有良好分析性质的张量型代理模型与算法。
AI.method: 构造张量包络TEE：用光滑项f的q阶泰勒模型，配合p次幂（p>q）正则项。先建立张量下降引理，并分三种情形q<p<q+1、p=q+1、p>q+1刻画其行为；在适当的prox有界性与参数条件下分析张量算子TOP，进而研究TEE的有限性、连续性、全局极小点保持、水平集有界性继承，以及局部Lipschitz连续性、方向可微性、Fréchet可微性与C^1条件。最后将TEE用作精确张量迭代的Lyapunov函数。
AI.result: 在给定条件下，TOP具有非空紧值；TEE有限值且连续，保持全局极小点并继承φ的水平集有界性；TEE局部Lipschitz连续、方向可微，并给出Fréchet可微性刻画，且当TOP单值时TEE为C^1。作为Lyapunov函数，精确张量迭代的任意聚点是临界点；对于有界轨迹且q<p≤q+1，可在O(ε^{-p/(p-1)})次迭代内达到ε-稳定点。
AI.conclusion: TEE在保持φ关键优化景观性质的同时具备更丰富的分析结构，便于张量型优化方法的设计与分析；所建立的张量下降引理与复杂度界据作者所知均为首次在不假设f的q阶导数全局Lipschitz或Hölder连续性的情况下获得。

title: Uniform positivity of the tau invariant
summary: We prove the Baker--Rumely conjecture that the tau invariant of a metrized graph admits a positive lower bound proportional to its total length, with an absolute constant. We also construct simple cubic metrized graphs whose normalized tau invariants tend to $59/7260<1/108$, disproving the proposed universal constant $1/108$. The lower bound is independent of the genus, the number of edges, and the distribution of edge lengths. Its proof combines a second-moment inequality for Euclidean lattices with a partition of the edge coordinates of a cycle lattice into three independent sets. The counterexamples have only two edge lengths and admit an elementary resistance calculation. Through the tropical moment identity, the lower bound also gives a uniform estimate for the non-archimedean terms in height formulas for Jacobians.

AI.tldr: 证明Baker–Rumely猜想：度量图的tau不变量具有与总长度成比例的正下界（绝对常数），并构造反例推翻普适常数1/108。
AI.motivation: 探究度量图tau不变量是否存在与总长度成正比、且与亏格、边数、边长分布无关的绝对正下界，同时检验所提出的普适常数1/108是否成立。
AI.method: 将欧氏格点的二阶矩不等式与循环格点边坐标划分为三个独立集合的方法相结合来证明下界；构造仅含两种边长的简单三次度量图作为反例，并通过电阻计算给出初等验证。
AI.result: 证明了Baker–Rumely猜想，得到与总长度成正比、不依赖亏格、边数和边长分布的绝对正下界；构造的反例使归一化tau不变量趋于59/7260<1/108，从而推翻普适常数1/108。
AI.conclusion: tau不变量存在绝对正下界且与图的结构参数无关；凭借tropical moment恒等式，该下界还为Jacobian高度公式中的非阿基米德项提供了统一估计。

title: Dispersion-corrected compact finite difference discretizations for the elastic Helmholtz equation in two and three dimensions
summary: We develop a family of compact, dispersion-corrected marker-and-cell (MAC)-based finite-difference discretizations for the elastic Helmholtz equation. While dispersion correction is well established for scalar Helmholtz problems, fewer approaches exist for the elastic problems, and most use non-compact stencils. To this end, we introduce a generalized MAC (GMAC) framework that enables compact discretization of the elastic Helmholtz equation. We prove that even though GMAC is non-symmetric, this discretization produces no numerical dissipation and no shear-mode separation. For certain weights, GMAC has lower polarization error than standard MAC. We also introduce an elastic dispersion correction (EDC) process, extending real-shifted-wavenumber dispersion correction methods from acoustic to elastic Helmholtz problems. We prove and demonstrate numerically that GMAC is second-order accurate. Furthermore, we show that EDC substantially reduces dispersion for standard MAC and can provide additional correction in some instances of GMAC. Dispersion analysis shows that the resulting method outperforms existing compact finite-difference discretizations in dispersion accuracy and is competitive with some non-compact schemes. We give numerical evidence for improved phase alignment in mildly heterogeneous media.

AI.tldr: 提出基于GMAC的紧致有限差分格式并引入EDC色散校正，用于弹性Helmholtz方程，数值验证二阶精度、无色散耗散且色散精度优于既有紧致格式。
AI.motivation: 弹性Helmholtz方程的色散校正研究较少，现有方法多采用非紧致模板，紧致且高精度的弹性离散格式亟待发展。
AI.method: 构建广义MAC（GMAC）框架实现紧致离散；证明其虽非对称但无数值耗散、无剪切模式分离；提出弹性色散校正（EDC），将实移波数色散校正从声学推广至弹性问题。
AI.result: 证明并数值验证GMAC具二阶精度；EDC显著降低标准MAC色散并能对部分GMAC情形提供额外校正；色散分析表明该方法优于现有紧致有限差分格式，与部分非紧致格式相当，并在弱非均匀介质中改善相位对齐。
AI.conclusion: GMAC与EDC相结合为弹性Helmholtz方程提供了紧致、低色散且无数值耗散的离散方案，精度与稳定性具有理论与数值支持。

title: Global strong solutions to the 1D full compressible Navier--Stokes equations with temperature-dependent coefficients and vacuum
summary: We study the initial--boundary value problem for the one-dimensional full compressible Navier--Stokes system whose viscosity and heat conductivity are given by $μ(θ)=μθ^α$ and $κ(θ)=κθ^β$, respectively. The initial density is nonnegative and is allowed to vanish. For $α>2$ and $β>2α+4$, we prove the existence of a global strong solution for arbitrarily large compatible $H^2$ data, provided that the prescribed boundary temperature is sufficiently high relative to their size. No velocity or temperature perturbation is required to shrink as the boundary temperature tends to infinity. A shifted initial-layer weight and an exact symmetrization of the two material-derivative equations separate the fast thermal mode from the momentum mode. The resulting estimates are uniform with respect to the positive lower bound used in the approximation and therefore survive the limit to genuine vacuum. The proof further combines a relative-entropy identity centered at the conserved mean density, the physical effective viscous flux, a Zlotnik-type estimate along particle trajectories, and finite-time transport estimates for the density derivatives. The density remains uniformly bounded and the temperature stays uniformly comparable with the prescribed boundary temperature. After the initial layer we establish vacuum-compatible exponential relaxation: the density converges to its conserved mean in every finite $L^p$, the velocity and temperature perturbation decay in $H^1$, and the weighted material-derivative energy decays at rate $c\barθ^{1-α}$.

AI.tldr: 研究一维完全可压缩Navier–Stokes系统在密度可退化（含真空）、温度依赖型黏性与热传导系数（μ(θ)=μθ^α, κ(θ)=κθ^β）下的初边值问题。对 α>2、β>2α+4，证明任意大相容 H² 初值在边界温度足够高时存在整体强解，并给出真空相容的指数松弛。
AI.motivation: 经典完全可压缩Navier–Stokes系统的整体适定性结果多要求密度有正下界或温度/速度扰动足够小，难以处理初始密度非负且允许出现真空的情形。同时当黏性与热传导强烈依赖温度（幂律形式）时，快速热模与动量模耦合，常规能量估计易在真空处退化。本文旨在突破上述限制，在无需速度、温度扰动随边界温度增大而缩小的条件下建立可退化密度的整体强解与长时间渐近行为。
AI.method: 针对 μ(θ)=μθ^α、κ(θ)=κθ^β，在 α>2、β>2α+4 的范围内对两个物质导数方程作精确对称化，将快速热模与动量模分离；引入平移的初始层权函数以处理初始层并保持对逼近中正下界的估计一致性，从而可取真空极限。证明工具包括：以守恒平均密度为中心的相对熵恒等式、物理有效黏性通量、沿粒子轨道的Zlotnik型估计，以及密度导数的有限时间输运估计。
AI.result: 在边界温度相对初值规模充分高时，对任意大且相容的 H² 初值构造出整体强解，且不需要速度或温度扰动随边界温度趋于无穷而衰减。所得估计关于逼近所用正下界一致，故可过渡到真正真空。密度保持一致有界，温度与给定边界温度一致可比，不出现退化或爆破。
AI.conclusion: 初始层之后建立了真空相容的指数松弛：密度在每个有限 L^p 中收敛到其守恒平均，速度与温度扰动在 H¹ 中衰减，加权物质导数能量以速率 c\barθ^{1-α} 衰减。结果表明高边界温度可稳定大初值并驱动系统指数趋于平衡态，为含真空的温度依赖型完全可压缩Navier–Stokes方程提供了整体适定性与长时间行为刻画。

title: Synthesizing Physics Formulae with Transformers
summary: Finding a compact formula that fits a set of input-output pairs and predicts outputs on unseen inputs is a fundamental problem in science. Symbolic regression automates the search for such formulae: search-based methods explore the space of possible formulae directly, while transformers pre-trained on synthetic data produce formulae of comparable quality substantially faster. Existing transformers, however, are prone to overfitting --- they find formulae that fit the training data well but do not extrapolate to input ranges unseen during training. We address this by shaping the set of formulae used to train a transformer, and show that the resulting formulae extrapolate substantially better. Fine-tuning the transformer on data with noise-corrupted target values further makes the synthesized formulae robust to noise in the observations. On SRBench and LLM-SRBench our transformer synthesizes a formula in about ten seconds and extrapolates better than all evaluated methods at a comparable budget. Search-based methods surpass our accuracy only when given one to three orders of magnitude more time.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过设计训练公式集合并微调，提升了预训练Transformer符号回归模型的泛化与外推能力。
AI.motivation: 符号回归旨在从输入-输出对中寻找紧凑公式并预测未见输入。基于搜索的方法直接探索公式空间，而基于合成数据预训练的Transformer速度更快、质量相当。但现有Transformer易过拟合，生成的公式虽能很好拟合训练数据，却无法外推到训练时未见的输入范围。
AI.method: 通过塑造（shaping）用于训练Transformer的公式集合来缓解过拟合；并进一步在目标值含噪声的数据上微调Transformer，使合成公式对观测噪声鲁棒。
AI.result: 在SRBench和LLM-SRBench上，该Transformer约十秒即可合成一个公式，且在同等预算下外推表现优于所有被评估方法；基于搜索的方法只有在给定多出一到三个数量级的时间时，才能超越其精度。
AI.conclusion: 塑造训练公式集合可显著提升Transformer符号回归的外推能力，噪声微调进一步增强鲁棒性，使模型在效率与泛化上优于搜索类方法与现有Transformer。

title: A Statistical Inference Framework for PMI Estimation and SGNS Word Embeddings
summary:
Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) is a core measure of testing word association, and Skip-gram with Negative Sampling (SGNS) is essentially a method that implicitly factorizes a shifted PMI matrix. However, a systematic and well-rounded characterization of finite-sample uncertainty in PMI estimation remains absent and imperative to venture into.
  We provide a statistical framework for PMI estimation and its connection to SGNS.
