This design avoids repeated full-state simulation during forecasting and full-field reconstruction during likelihood evaluation. LD-EnFF substantially outperforms a broad range of data assimilation algorithms on benchmarks spanning Kolmogorov flow, tsunami propagation, and atmospheric modeling, all featuring complex dynamics and sparse, noisy observations.

AI.tldr: LD-EnFF是一种在紧凑潜空间中同时进行预报传播与滤波更新的序贯贝叶斯滤波框架，利用潜动力学代理模型与VAE观测模型，结合流匹配系综滤波更新，显著优于多类资料同化算法。
AI.motivation: 现有资料同化方法面临两重叠加挑战：（1）高维非线性动力学导致重复前向模拟的计算代价高昂；（2）稀疏观测只能提供关于完整状态的有限直接信息。论文旨在同时缓解预报阶段的全状态重复模拟与似然评估阶段的全场重构需求。
AI.method: 提出Latent-Dynamics Ensemble Flow Filter（LD-EnFF），一种序贯贝叶斯滤波框架，预报传播与滤波更新均在紧凑潜空间内完成。该框架将用于系综传播的潜动力学代理模型与基于变分自编码器（VAE）的观测模型相结合，在潜空间中评估依赖于状态的观测似然。每个同化步中，采用基于流匹配的系综滤波更新，利用预报系综与上述似然生成后验样本，并联合更新潜状态与不确定性参数。
AI.result: 在涵盖Kolmogorov流、海啸传播与大气建模等具有复杂动力学和稀疏、含噪观测的基准上，LD-EnFF大幅优于广泛的资料同化算法。
AI.conclusion: 通过在潜空间中统一执行预报与同化，LD-EnFF规避了预报时重复的全状态模拟及似然评估时的全场重构，为高维非线性、稀疏观测场景下的资料同化提供了高效且性能优越的解决方案。

title: On the Sequentially Semiseparable Structure of SDE-Induced Kernels and Efficient Algorithms for Kernel-Based Estimation Problems
summary: We study kernel functions induced by a linear time-invariant (LTI) stochastic differential equation (SDE), an approach that embeds prior knowledge about the function to be estimated directly into the state-space description of the SDE. This kernel-design perspective is relevant across the many settings where kernels play a central role, including kernel methods in statistics, Gaussian process (GP) regression in machine learning, and kernel-based regularization methods in system identification. The resulting class of SDE-induced kernels includes several kernels of practical interest, such as Matérn kernels with half-integer smoothness, spline kernels, and related kernels used in system identification. In contrast to existing linear-time GP regression methods for these kernels, which are typically based on Kalman filtering and Rauch--Tung--Striebel smoothing on the latent state, we work directly with the SSS representation of the observed covariance matrix. This yields linear-complexity recursive algorithms for the matrix operations required in GP regression, including factorization, linear solves, log determinants, posterior covariance, log-marginal-likelihood gradients, and posterior sampling; the same generator-level recursions extend, with only minor modifications, to the analogous computations in kernel-based regularization methods for system identification. Compared with previous uses of SSS representations in GP regression, we derive efficient recursive algorithms for analytic marginal-likelihood gradients in three application-relevant cases, and we develop new recursions for posterior computations and Matheron-type sampling. Numerical experiments verify the accuracy of the proposed recursions and illustrate posterior inference and sampling for representative SDE-induced kernels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究由线性时不变随机微分方程（LTI SDE）诱导的核函数，并基于观测协方差矩阵的状态空间半可分（SSS）表示，为GP回归与系统辨识中的核正则化方法设计了线性复杂度的递归算法。
AI.motivation: SDE诱导核涵盖Matérn（半整数光滑度）、样条核及系统辨识常用核，应用广泛；但现有针对这些核的线性时间GP回归方法多依赖隐状态上的Kalman滤波与RTS平滑，本文希望直接在观测协方差矩阵层面处理，从而获得更直接、可扩展的递归算法。
AI.method: 将待估函数的先验知识嵌入SDE状态空间描述以构造核；针对观测协方差矩阵的SSS表示，推导线性复杂度递归算法，覆盖分解、线性求解、对数行列式、后验协方差、对数边缘似然梯度与后验采样；同一生成元层面的递归稍加修改即可扩展至系统辨识的核正则化方法。
AI.result: 给出解析边缘似然梯度在三种应用相关情形下的高效递归；提出后验计算与Matheron型采样的新递归；数值实验验证了递归的准确性，并展示了代表性SDE诱导核的后验推断与采样效果。
AI.conclusion: 基于观测协方差的SSS表示可统一且高效地实现SDE诱导核下的GP回归与核正则化计算，避免隐状态滤波平滑框架，提供线性复杂度且可扩展的递归方案。

title: From Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman to Riccati via Carleman: The Scalar Case
summary:
The Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation of a nonlinear system is a nonlinear partial differential equation, and in that form it gives little away. This paper shows that it hides a Riccati equation. Carleman linearization reveals this structure. For scalar input-affine systems with analytic data, the lifted HJB equation is a single infinite-dimensional Riccati equation in a lower-triangular Toeplitz matrix. Its first entry is the Riccati equation of the standard linearization at equilibrium. Its remaining entries hold the nonlinear terms. Nothing about this is an approximation.
  Under controllability of the standard linearization and detectability of the cost, the equation has exactly one solution with positive diagonal entries, and it can be computed one entry at a time. This solution is the derivative of the value function. We prove that finite-sections of the solution are exact and converge exponentially to the derivative of the value function near the origin. The scalar case has a closed-form solution. This closed form is our benchmark: every result on the lifted equation is checked against it. Nothing in this structure depends on the state dimension. Our methodology points to a general theory of optimal control in which the HJB equation of analytic nonlinear systems becomes an infinite-dimensional Riccati equation.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明非线性系统的HJB方程经Carleman线性化后隐藏着一个Riccati方程结构：对标量输入仿射解析系统，提升后的HJB方程是一个无穷维Riccati方程，其解即值函数的导数，且有限截断精确并以指数速率收敛。
AI.motivation: HJB方程是非线性偏微分方程，其形式本身难以提供可直接利用的结构信息，因此作者希望揭示其内在的代数结构，以简化非线性最优控制问题的求解。
AI.method: 采用Carleman线性化方法，对标量输入仿射且数据解析的系统将HJB方程提升为无穷维Riccati方程，其系数为下三角Toeplitz矩阵：首项对应平衡点处标准线性化的Riccati方程，其余项承载非线性项；在标准线性化可控且代价可检测的条件下逐项求解。并以标量情形的闭式解作为基准进行验证。
AI.result: 提升后的方程在标准线性化可控与代价可检测条件下存在唯一具有正对角元的解，可逐项计算，该解即为值函数的导数；有限截断解是精确的，并在原点附近以指数速率收敛到值函数的导数。标量情形存在闭式解，且所有关于提升方程的结论均以该闭式解为基准校验。
AI.conclusion: 该结构不依赖于状态维数，表明解析非线性系统的最优控制理论可统一为无穷维Riccati方程框架，为一般性最优控制理论提供了方向。

title: Varieties Admitting Polarized Galois Endomorphisms
summary: Let $X$ be an $n$-dimensional smooth complex projective variety admitting an int-amplified Galois endomorphism. We prove that its maximal rationally connected fibration is represented by a smooth toric fibration over a smooth $Q$-abelian variety. Consequently, if $X$ is rationally connected, then it is toric. If it also has Picard number one, then $X\cong \mathbf{P}^n$. As another application, we prove that such $X$ is of log Calabi-Yau type as conjectured by Gongyo.

AI.tldr: 设 $X$ 为 $n$ 维光滑复射影簇，若其容许 int-amplified Galois 自同态，则其极大有理连通纤维化可由光滑 $Q$-阿贝尔簇上的光滑环面纤维化表示；从而有理连通时 $X$ 为环面簇，Picard 数为 1 时 $X\cong \mathbf{P}^n$，并验证 Gongyo 猜想下的对数 Calabi-Yau 型结论。
AI.motivation: 研究具有 int-amplified Galois 自同态的光滑复射影簇的几何结构，刻画其极大有理连通纤维化，并应用该结构回答有理连通性、Picard 数及 Gongyo 对数 Calabi-Yau 型猜想等问题。
AI.method: 通过对极大有理连通纤维化（MRC fibration）的基与纤维结构进行分析，证明该纤维化可由光滑 $Q$-阿贝尔簇上的光滑环面纤维化表示，并由此推导特殊情形下的分类结论。
AI.result: 证明了 $X$ 的极大有理连通纤维化可由光滑 $Q$-阿贝尔簇上的光滑环面纤维化表示；若 $X$ 有理连通则 $X$ 为环面簇；若其 Picard 数为 1，则 $X\cong \mathbf{P}^n$；此外，这类 $X$ 为对数 Calabi-Yau 型。
AI.conclusion: 具有 int-amplified Galois 自同态的光滑复射影簇具有受限的几何结构，其 MRC 纤维化呈环面纤维化形式，并由此得到分类与刚性结果，同时验证了 Gongyo 关于对数 Calabi-Yau 型的猜想。

title: Quasi-Trefftz spaces for the first-order time-harmonic Maxwell's equations
summary: The goal of this article is to study optimal high-order Taylor-based polynomial quasi-Trefftz spaces for first-order time-harmonic Maxwell's equations. Compared with standard polynomial spaces, the purpose of quasi-Trefftz spaces is to retain the same high-order best approximation property but more efficiently: their dimension is considerably smaller. To achieve this goal, they approximate only smooth solutions to the governing equation rather than to approximate general smooth functions. While there is a natural definition of Taylor-based polynomial quasi-Trefftz spaces for scalar equations, the situation is fundamentally different for vector-valued equations, as the naive quasi-Trefftz property does not systematically define the smallest space with the desired best approximation property. This article identifies the optimal quasi-Trefftz spaces for first-order time-harmonic Maxwell's equations, proposes two approaches to construct quasi-Trefftz bases, and proves the spaces' best approximation property. The theoretical results, which strongly leverage polynomial Helmholtz decompositions and the exactness of the polynomial de Rham sequences, are validated with numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一阶时谐麦克斯韦方程的最优高阶Taylor型多项式拟Trefftz空间，提出两种构造拟Trefftz基的方法并证明其最佳逼近性，数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.motivation: 标准多项式空间维数较大，拟Trefftz空间旨在逼近方程的光滑解而非一般光滑函数，从而在保持高阶最佳逼近性的同时显著降低维数。但对于向量值方程，朴素的拟Trefftz性质并不能系统性地定义出具有最佳逼近性质的最小空间。
AI.method: 针对一阶时谐麦克斯韦方程，识别最优拟Trefftz空间，提出两种构造拟Trefftz基的方法，并证明这些空间的最佳逼近性；理论分析主要借助多项式Helmholtz分解与多项式de Rham序列的正合性。
AI.result: 确定了一阶时谐麦克斯韦方程的最优拟Trefftz空间，给出两种基构造方式并证明其最佳逼近性质，数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文为向量值方程构造高阶Taylor型多项式拟Trefftz空间提供了最优框架，克服了朴素拟Trefftz性质的局限。

title: The Global Existence and Energy Decay of a Partially Logarithmically Damped Wave System
summary:
We investigate the global existence and energy decay properties of a weakly coupled evolution system consisting of two wave equations in a bounded domain. The system exhibits a unique structural asymmetry: a nonlinear logarithmic damping term acts exclusively as a friction-like feedback mechanism on the first wave equation, while the second equation remains completely undamped and relies solely on linear cross-coupling to transfer and dissipate its energy.
  We establish two primary objectives. First, by utilizing the Faedo-Galerkin approximation scheme in conjunction with the structural monotonicity properties of the non-Lipschitz logarithmic nonlinearity, we prove a rigorous global existence result for strong solutions. Second, we provide a rigorous mathematical proof demonstrating the stability and asymptotic energy decay of the solutions under suitable constraints on the cross-coupling parameter. These results provide new insights into the stabilization mechanisms of coupled hyperbolic systems under degenerate nonlinear damping.

AI.tldr: 研究一类由两个波动方程构成的弱耦合发展系统，仅对第一个方程施加非线性对数阻尼，第二个方程无阻尼，通过线性交叉耦合传递并耗散能量。利用Faedo-Galerkin逼近与对数非线性项的单调性，证明强解的整体存在性，并在交叉耦合参数的适当约束下证明解的稳定性与能量渐近衰减。
AI.motivation: 系统具有独特的结构非对称性：阻尼仅作用于第一个波动方程，第二个方程完全无阻尼，仅依靠线性交叉耦合传递能量。这构成了退化非线性阻尼下耦合双曲系统的稳定化问题，需要阐明其整体适定性与能量衰减机制。
AI.method: 采用Faedo-Galerkin逼近格式，结合非Lipschitz对数非线性项的结构单调性，证明强解的整体存在性；随后在交叉耦合参数的适当约束下，对解的稳定性与渐近能量衰减进行严格数学证明。
AI.result: 证明了强解的整体存在性，并在交叉耦合参数的适当条件下给出了解的稳定性与渐近能量衰减结果。
AI.conclusion: 该结果揭示了退化非线性阻尼下耦合双曲系统的稳定化机制，为仅部分方程带阻尼、其余方程依靠耦合耗散能量的系统提供了新的理论认识。

title: Protecting Sensitive Data in Image Synthesis via PAC-Private Adaptation for Diffusion Models
summary: Synthetic data are increasingly used as an alternative to sharing sensitive records. However, synthetic data generation does not guarantee privacy, as diffusion models trained or adapted on sensitive data remain susceptible to reconstruction attacks. Moreover, while approaches that use differential privacy (DP), such as DP-SGD, achieve provably private diffusion model training, the repeated gradient clipping and noise injection they require result in significant utility loss. An important limitation of DP-based privacy is that, although it has a provable relationship to reconstruction privacy (RP), that relationship is indirect. RP is defined in terms of limiting how much an adversary's posterior distribution over sensitive data differs from the prior, whereas DP provides guarantees by bounding the sensitivity of outputs to changes in individual records. This indirection is an important source of the utility loss. To address this, we propose a PAC-private diffusion model adaptation to achieve reconstruction privacy. Since PAC-privacy is defined directly with respect to posterior advantage over the prior, it directly implicates RP. To obtain scalable PAC privatization in high dimensions, we first learn a compact data-dependent diffusion model component using LoRA or Textual Inversion, and then calibrate anisotropic Gaussian noise from the covariance of repeated mechanism outputs. Unlike DP-SGD, our method perturbs the learned component only once after optimization, thereby avoiding privacy composition across gradient updates. We evaluate the framework on few-shot concept personalization and full-dataset image synthesis, and show that the proposed approach better preserves subject identity, generation quality, and downstream classification accuracy than DP while achieving the same reconstruction privacy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于PAC隐私的扩散模型适配方法，直接以后验优势实现重建隐私（RP），通过LoRA/Textual Inversion学习紧凑数据相关组件并利用重复机制输出的协方差校准各向异性高斯噪声，仅扰动一次，避免梯度组合，在保护相同重建隐私的同时优于DP方法。
AI.motivation: 合成数据被广泛用于替代敏感记录共享，但扩散模型在敏感数据上训练或适配后仍易受到重建攻击。DP-SGD类方法虽可证明隐私，然而其反复的梯度裁剪与加噪导致显著效用损失；且DP与重建隐私（RP）的关系是间接的：RP限制对手后验分布相对先验的差异，而DP通过限制输出对单个记录变化的敏感度提供保证，这种间接性是效用损失的重要来源。
AI.method: 提出PAC私有的扩散模型适配以实现重建隐私。因PAC隐私直接以后验相对先验的优势定义，故直接关联RP。为在高维获得可扩展的PAC私有化，先使用LoRA或Textual Inversion学习紧凑的、依赖数据的扩散模型组件，然后从重复机制输出的协方差校准各向异性高斯噪声。与DP-SGD不同，该方法在优化后仅对学习组件扰动一次，从而避免跨梯度更新的隐私组合。
AI.result: 在少样本概念个性化与全数据集图像合成上评估框架。结果表明，与DP相比，所提方法在实现相同重建隐私的同时，更好地保持了主体身份、生成质量以及下游分类精度。
AI.conclusion: PAC隐私因直接刻画后验优势，可更直接地实现重建隐私，避免DP的间接性导致的效用损失。通过在优化后对紧凑学习组件施加单次各向异性高斯噪声扰动，方法规避了梯度级别的隐私组合开销，在重建隐私约束下取得优于DP的效用，为扩散模型敏感数据适配提供了更实用的隐私-效用权衡。

title: Finite-Sample Distribution Theory and Efficient Large-Scale Inference for Online Quantile Regression
summary: This paper studies online quantile regression for large-scale and streaming data using Stochastic SubGradient Descent (SSGD) with constant learning rates. Classical offline inference for quantile regression is computationally and memory intensive. Existing works of online inference for quantile regression provide only asymptotic guarantees and typically require sub-exponential tail conditions for distribution theory. To bridge these gaps, we introduce new techniques to prove a quenched central limit theorem (CLT) and finite-sample Gaussian approximation for SSGD under a finite-moment assumption. We further show that Ruppert-Polyak averaging with a constant learning rate has a non-vanishing bias and fails to satisfy CLT centering at the population target. Hence we propose suffix averaging to address this issue and establish its finite-sample Gaussian approximation. Based on these results, we provide an efficient online inference method for quantile regression that avoids covariance estimation. Numerical experiments show that our method achieves desirable empirical coverage rates and competitive performance compared to other inference methods. We also apply our approach to U.S. wage data to demonstrate its practical effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大规模流式数据下的在线分位数回归，采用常学习率的随机次梯度下降（SSGD）。作者证明有限矩假设下的淬火中心极限定理（CLT）与有限样本高斯逼近，指出现有Ruppert-Polyak平均在常学习率下存在非消失偏差，进而提出后缀平均（suffix averaging）并建立其有限样本高斯逼近，据此给出无需协方差估计的高效在线推断方法。数值实验与U.S. wage数据验证了方法的覆盖率和实用效果。
AI.motivation: 经典离线分位数回归推断计算与存储开销大，难以适应大规模与流式数据；已有在线推断工作仅提供渐近保证，且分布理论通常依赖次指数尾条件，限制较严。本文旨在放松矩条件、提供有限样本保证，并解决常学习率下在线平均估计量的偏差与中心化问题。
AI.method: 以常学习率SSGD求解在线分位数回归；采用新技术在有限矩假设下证明淬火CLT与有限样本高斯逼近；分析Ruppert-Polyak平均在常学习率下的非消失偏差及其无法以总体目标为中心的CLT失效；提出后缀平均以消除该偏差，并建立其有限样本高斯逼近；基于上述理论设计无需协方差估计的在线推断流程。
AI.result: 理论上给出有限矩条件下的淬火CLT与有限样本高斯逼近，并刻画常学习率Ruppert-Polyak平均的偏差问题；后缀平均恢复以总体目标为中心的推断并具有限样本高斯逼近。数值实验显示所提方法达到理想的经验覆盖率并具竞争力，U.S. wage数据应用亦验证其实用性。
AI.conclusion: 常学习率SSGD配合后缀平均可在温和的有限矩假设下实现高效、无需协方差估计的在线分位数回归推断，兼具有限样本理论保证与良好的实证表现，适用于大规模流式数据场景。

title: Near-Optimal Complexity of Finite-Sum Nonconvex-Strongly-Concave Minimax Optimization
summary: We characterize, up to logarithmic factors, the minimax expected query complexity of finite-sum nonconvex-strongly-concave optimization under mean-squared averaged smoothness. For randomized zero-respecting incremental first-order algorithms, the complexity is $\tildeΘ(n+\min\{\sqrt{n}\,κ,n^{3/4}\sqrtκ\}\,LΔ\varepsilon^{-2})$ throughout $κ=L/μ\ge1$, under exact dual initialization and for $0<\varepsilon^2\le c_0LΔ$, where $c_0>0$ is universal. This characterization is our main result. A dual-chain construction provides the lower bound and matches the existing Catalyst upper bound for $κ\ge\sqrt{n}$. For $1\leκ\le\sqrt{n}$, we introduce recursive proximal descent-ascent (RPDA), which retains a recursive gradient estimator across proximal subproblems and attains $\tilde{O}(n+\sqrt{n}\,κLΔ\varepsilon^{-2})$ with a fixed query budget. Both upper bounds guarantee an expected squared primal gradient at most $\varepsilon^2$. Under individual smoothness, we also prove $Ω(n+\min\{κ,\sqrt{nκ}\}\,LΔ\varepsilon^{-2})$ for every $κ\ge1$. It matches the polynomial upper rate for a bilinear subclass when $κ\ge n$; the intermediate-condition-number gap remains open.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了均方平均光滑性下有限和强凹-非凸优化的极小极大期望查询复杂度：随机零尊重增量一阶算法复杂度为$\tilde\Theta(n+\min\{\sqrt{n}\kappa,n^{3/4}\sqrt{\kappa}\}L\Delta\varepsilon^{-2})$。
AI.motivation: 研究有限和强凹-非凸优化在均方平均光滑条件下的查询复杂度，填补不同条件数区间最优复杂度刻画的空白，尤其是$1\le\kappa\le\sqrt{n}$区间的上界与下界匹配问题。
AI.method: 通过构造对偶链（dual-chain）给出下界；针对$1\le\kappa\le\sqrt{n}$提出递归近端下降-上升（RPDA）算法，在近端子问题间保留递归梯度估计器，采用固定查询预算；并在个体光滑条件下给出新的下界。
AI.result: 主结果：复杂度$\tilde\Theta(n+\min\{\sqrt{n}\kappa,n^{3/4}\sqrt{\kappa}\}L\Delta\varepsilon^{-2})$贯穿$\kappa\ge1$（精确对偶初始化、$0<\varepsilon^2\le c_0L\Delta$）；对偶链下界在$\kappa\ge\sqrt{n}$匹配Catalyst上界；RPDA达到$\tilde{O}(n+\sqrt{n}\kappa L\Delta\varepsilon^{-2})$；个体光滑下证明$\Omega(n+\min\{\kappa,\sqrt{n\kappa}\}L\Delta\varepsilon^{-2})$，在$\kappa\ge n$时匹配双线性子类的多项式上界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作完整刻画了均方平均光滑性下的极小极大查询复杂度（对数因子内），并指出个体光滑条件下中间条件数区间的复杂度差距仍为开放问题。

title: Generically Flexible Varieties with an Invariant Divisor
summary: In this paper, we construct a series of smooth affine varieties of dimension $n \geqslant 3$ that are generically flexible but not flexible. Moreover, these varieties admit a nontrivial divisor invariant under the subgroup of special automorphisms.

AI.tldr: 构造了一类维数 n≥3 的光滑仿射簇，它们是一般柔性（generically flexible）但非柔性（not flexible），且存在一个在特殊自同构子群作用下不变的非平凡除子。
AI.motivation: 柔性（flexibility）是仿射代数几何中刻画自同构群作用传递性的重要性质，而一般柔性是较弱的条件。研究二者之间的差异，有助于厘清柔性概念的不同层次，并刻画一般柔性簇的几何与自同构群结构。
AI.method: 对维数 n≥3 的光滑仿射簇进行显式构造，通过分析其自同构群及特殊自同构子群（由局部幂零向量场生成的子群）的作用，检验一般柔性与柔性定义的差别；同时寻找并构造在该子群作用下保持不变的除子。
AI.result: 得到了一系列维数 n≥3 的光滑仿射簇，它们是一般柔性但不柔性；并且每个这样的簇都带有一个在特殊自同构子群下不变的非平凡除子。
AI.conclusion: 一般柔性严格弱于柔性，两者在 n≥3 的光滑仿射簇中确实存在非空的反例族；不变除子的存在为区分这两类性质提供了明确的几何判据。

title: Nonparametric face-based finite element methods on complex hybrid three-dimensional meshes
summary: In this work, we propose and analyze low-order nonconforming face-based finite element methods for elliptic problems on complex hybrid three-dimensional meshes, composed of arbitrary polytopal cells. The focus is on scalar problems, but the approach can be extended in a tensor manner to design generalizations of the classical Crouzeix--Raviart and Rannacher--Turek methods for mixed formulations. We adopt a nonparametric construction of the local approximation spaces. We demonstrate that it avoids the degradation of approximation properties commonly induced by parametric mappings on distorted meshes. Using these approximation spaces, we define finite element schemes for very general cells. We further demonstrate that, on strongly degraded meshes, an approach inspired by discontinuous Galerkin methods enables removing consistency errors, even in the presence of potentially curved faces. Explicit examples of the construction of the polynomial space are given for prismatic (of triangular basis) and pyramidal (of quadrilateral basis) cells. The resulting schemes are shown theoretically and numerically to be stable and convergent, with an optimal convergence rate.

AI.tldr: 提出并分析面向复杂三维混合多面体网格的低阶非协调面基有限元方法，采用非参数化局部逼近空间，避免参数映射在畸变网格上引起的逼近退化；借鉴间断伽辽金思想消除强畸变（含曲边）网格上的相容性误差；给出三棱柱与四棱锥单元的多项式空间构造，理论与数值验证方案稳定、收敛且具最优收敛阶。
AI.motivation: 复杂混合三维网格（任意多面体单元）上的椭圆问题需要适用性强的有限元离散。传统参数化映射在畸变网格上会导致逼近性质退化，因此需要一种不依赖参数映射的构造方式，以保持任意多面体单元（含曲边情形）上的逼近精度与相容性。
AI.method: 采用非协调面基（face-based）低阶有限元框架；局部逼近空间采用非参数化（nonparametric）构造，直接在物理单元上定义；对基于这些逼近空间的格式，借助间断伽辽金（DG）思想处理强畸变网格上的相容性误差，允许出现曲边；针对三角形底三棱柱和四边形底四棱锥单元给出多项式空间的具体构造；标量问题为主，可张量式推广到Crouzeix–Raviart与Rannacher–Turek类型的混合格式推广。
AI.result: 非参数化构造可避免参数映射在畸变网格上导致的逼近性质退化；所定义格式适用于非常一般的单元，并在强畸变网格（含曲边）上通过DG式处理消除相容性误差；对三棱柱与四棱锥单元给出了显式多项式空间；方案在理论与数值上均表现稳定、收敛，且达到最优收敛阶。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为任意多面体混合三维网格上的椭圆问题提供了一个稳定、收敛且最优阶的低阶非协调面基有限元框架；非参数化局部空间与DG启发的相容性修正相结合，有效应对强畸变与曲边单元，并具备向混合问题（Crouzeix–Raviart、Rannacher–Turek推广）张量式扩展的潜力。

title: Existence of a separating norm for the semilinear heat equation
summary: We consider the initial value problem of the semilinear heat equation in the Fujita supercritical range for which global-in-time solutions may exist. The main result shows the existence of a separating norm $\|\cdot\|_X$ in the sense that, for nonnegative initial data $u_0\in L^\infty(\mathbf{R}^n)$, the smallness of $\|u_0\|_X$ implies global-in-time existence, whereas the largeness of $\|u_0\|_X$ implies finite-time blow-up. The separating norm is unique up to equivalence on nonnegative data.

AI.tldr: 针对Fujita超临界半线性热方程初值问题，构造了一个分离范数，其小性保证全局解存在，其大性导致有限时间爆破，且该范数在非负数据上等价意义下唯一。
AI.motivation: 在半线性热方程的Fujita超临界区域，全局解与爆破之间存在临界阈值现象，但刻画这一阈值的规范度量尚不明确，本文旨在找到能精确区分全局存在与爆破的范数。
AI.method: 在Fujita超临界范围内研究半线性热方程初值问题，对非负初始数据u0∈L∞(R^n)，构造并分析分离范数‖·‖_X，证明其小性对应全局存在、大性对应有限时间爆破，并论证唯一性（在非负数据上等价意义下）。
AI.result: 证明存在分离范数‖·‖_X：当非负初始数据u0的该范数足够小时，解全局存在；当该范数足够大时，解在有限时间爆破。此外，该分离范数在非负数据上至多相差等价，即唯一。
AI.conclusion: 在Fujita超临界情形下，全局存在性与有限时间爆破可由一个范数的阈值精确划分，且这一分离范数在等价意义下唯一，为刻画该方程的临界阈值提供了新的度量工具。

authors: A. M. C. M. van Gils
title: On architectural choices for interpretability and thermodynamic consistency in Physically Recurrent Neural Networks in the low-data regime
summary: In this paper, we unravel the effect of different decoder architectures on the interpretability of the latent space of the Physically Recurrent Neural Network. Particular emphasis is given to a new weight normalization constraint, which acts as a regularization technique and enables robust training in the low-data regime. A brief visual exploration illustrates how these changes impact the latent space and how the fictitious stress can align with the true state of the RVE without explicit training. Reaping the benefits of a meaningful latent space, a case study illustrates how information from the microscopic level can be retrieved and incorporated into a multi-task approach that does not require extra parameters or larger training sets. Another key contribution shows that a specific architectural choice can naturally lead to a thermodynamically consistent formulation. By enforcing an adjoint encoder-decoder structure with positive scalar contributions, this modification ensures energy consistency across scales and non-negative dissipation, leading to even lower training requirements. This alternative completes the study on interpretability, inductive bias, and thermodynamic consistency, and demonstrates that data efficiency can be improved with careful architectural choices rooted in the underlying physics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究解码器架构对物理循环神经网络隐空间可解释性的影响，提出一种权重归一化约束以实现低数据下的稳健训练，并通过满足热力学一致性的伴随编码器-解码器结构进一步提升数据效率。
AI.motivation: 探究不同解码器架构如何影响物理循环神经网络隐空间的可解释性，并寻求在低数据条件下提升训练稳健性与数据效率的架构设计思路。
AI.method: 引入一种新的权重归一化约束作为正则化手段；对隐空间进行可视化分析；采用多任务方法利用微观信息而不增加参数或训练集规模；采用伴随编码器-解码器结构并施加正标量贡献以保证热力学一致性。
AI.result: 权重归一化约束实现了低数据条件下的稳健训练；隐空间具有可解释性，虚构应力可在无显式训练下与RVE真实状态对齐；多任务方法无需额外参数即可融合微观信息；伴随编码器-解码器结构保证跨尺度能量一致与非负耗散，且进一步降低训练需求。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，植根于底层物理的架构选择可显著提升模型的可解释性、归纳偏置与热力学一致性，并有效改善数据效率。

title: Reconstruction-Aware Distribution Matching for Inverse Problems with Unpaired Data
summary: Recovering the forward operator of an imaging system from unpaired data avoids both calibration hardware and the clean/degraded pairs that supervision requires-pairs that, for a real lens, are often impossible to acquire. Existing unpaired approaches that explicitly estimate the forward operator by distribution matching evaluate a candidate only through the measurements it generates, whose distribution should match that of the real ones. Components suppressed by the operator are barely present in the degraded images, and therefore barely constrain the operator under such a criterion. Yet inversion precisely tries to recover them. As a result, two operators that are nearly indistinguishable as forward models can invert very differently. We address this by adding a comparison on the clean side: real degraded images, once restored, should be distributed like clean ones. Restorations are computed by a differentiable plug-and-play algorithm parameterized by the operator being learned. On spatially varying PSF calibration and blind super-resolution, the method recovers more accurate operators than degraded-side matching alone, and closes much of the gap to restoration with the true operator.

AI.tldr: 提出在干净域添加分布匹配约束的无配对前向算子估计方法，通过可微即插即用复原算法参数化算子，显著提升空间变化PSF标定与盲超分中的算子精度。
AI.motivation: 现有无配对方法仅通过生成测量与真实退化图像的分布匹配来估计前向算子。但被算子抑制的成分在退化图像中几乎不存在，对算子的约束极弱，导致两个作为前向模型几乎无法区分、却复原结果差异巨大的算子均可通过该判据。因此需要引入干净侧的比较来约束算子。
AI.method: 在干净域加入比较：真实退化图像经复原后，其分布应与干净图像一致。复原由以被学习算子为参数的可微即插即用（plug-and-play）算法计算，从而将复原质量作为算子估计的监督信号，与退化侧匹配联合约束。
AI.result: 在空间变化PSF标定与盲超分辨率任务上，该方法恢复的算子比仅用退化侧匹配更准确，并将与使用真实算子复原的性能差距大幅缩小。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠退化侧的分布匹配不足以保证算子可逆性正确，联合干净侧的分布约束能有效提升无配对前向算子估计精度，并接近使用真值算子的复原效果。

title: Social Optimality Does Not Imply Coalitional Stability in Unweighted Max-k-Cut Games
summary: In Max-$k$-Cut games, optimal colorings maximize social welfare, but are they stable against coordinated deviations that strictly benefit every participating player? A recurring conjecture in the literature asserts that, for unweighted graphs, every optimal coloring has this stability property, known as strong equilibrium. We disprove the conjecture for every $k\ge3$ by exhibiting a finite, simple, connected, unweighted graph with an optimal coloring that is not a strong equilibrium. The profitable coalitional deviation leads to another optimal coloring: every coalition member gains, while players outside the coalition bear the corresponding losses and social welfare remains unchanged. We also give an exact identity relating coalitional gains, changes in cut value, and internal conflicts, recovering the known stability guarantee for optimal colorings when the maximum degree is at most $2k-1$. For strong deviations from general Nash equilibria, we establish a sharp upper bound on the number of monochromatic edges remaining within the coalition and show that this number can exceed the coalition size.

AI.tldr: 本文否定了 Max-k-Cut 博弈中"最优着色必为强均衡"的猜想（k≥3），给出反例并建立联盟收益与割值变化的精确恒等式及一般纳什均衡强偏离的单色边上界。
AI.motivation: Max-k-Cut 博弈中，最优着色最大化社会福利，但文献中反复出现一个猜想：对无权重图，每个最优着色都应具备对协调性偏离的稳定性（强均衡）。该猜想的真伪此前未被彻底判定，本文旨在检验并在一般情况下加以否定，同时刻画稳定性成立的条件与偏离的代价结构。
AI.method: 构造性反例：对每个 k≥3 给出有限、简单、连通、无权重图及其最优着色，证明其不是强均衡。进一步推导联盟收益、割值变化与联盟内部冲突之间的精确恒等式，据此在最大度不超过 2k-1 时重新得到最优着色的已知稳定性保证。对一般纳什均衡的强偏离，证明联盟内残留单色边数的紧上界，并给出该数量可超过联盟规模的构造。
AI.result: 对每个 k≥3 构造出反例，其盈利性联盟偏离导致另一个最优着色：联盟成员均获益，联盟外玩家承担相应损失，社会福利保持不变。所得恒等式在最大度≤2k-1 时恢复最优着色的强均衡稳定性。对一般纳什均衡的强偏离，给出联盟内单色边数的紧上界，并证明该数目可以超过联盟规模。
AI.conclusion: Max-k-Cut 中"最优着色即强均衡"的猜想对 k≥3 不成立；最优性与强均衡稳定性之间不存在一般性蕴含关系。割值变化与联盟收益可由所提恒等式精确刻画，度约束是稳定性成立的关键条件；一般纳什均衡下的强偏离可容忍大量内部单色边，其数量甚至超过联盟规模。

title: A natural Chow lemma for smooth threefolds and fourfolds
summary: Let $X$ be a smooth proper integral variety of dimension at most four over a field of characteristic zero. We construct a finite sequence of blowups along smooth centers with projective endpoint, preserving the intersection of all maximal quasi-projective opens of $X$. The construction depends only on a fixed functorial principalization procedure and is natural under isomorphisms, including those over different ground fields. The proof has two parts. A colength argument on regular local surfaces gives, in every dimension, a finite preparation after which some maximal quasi-projective open has complement mapping into codimension at least three in $X$. In dimensions at most four these images are points or curves. Ample numerical classes on the normalized components of that complement give finite bounds for summing base ideals of linear systems. The resulting ideal descends to the original field; geometric integrality is not required.

AI.tldr: 对特征零域上维数至多四的光滑固有整簇，构造沿光滑中心的有限爆破序列，使终点为射影簇，并保持所有极大拟射影开集的交；构造仅依赖固定函子式主化过程，在 isomorphism 下自然，包括不同基域之间。证明分两步：正则局部曲面上的 colength 论证给出有限准备，使某极大拟射影开集的补集像落入余维至少三；在维数至多四时这些像是点或曲线。补集正规化分量上的 ample 数值类给出求和线性系统基理想的有限界，所得理想可下降到原域，无需几何整性。
AI.motivation: 研究光滑固有簇的射影化或紧化问题，试图在保持特定拟射影开集交的前提下，通过纯代数构造获得射影终点；并避免依赖几何整性，使结果对一般基域（特征零）成立。
AI.method: 沿光滑中心作有限次爆破；使用固定函子式主化程序保证自然性。证明采用两步：一是正则局部曲面上的 colength 论证，进行有限准备，使某极大拟射影开集的补集像在 X 中余维至少三（维数至多四时为点或曲线）；二是利用该补集正规化分量上的 ample 数值类，对线性系统基理想求和给出有限界；最后将理想下降到原域。
AI.result: 在特征零域上、维数至多四的光滑固有整簇，存在沿光滑中心的有限爆破序列，终点射影，并保持所有极大拟射影开集的交；构造函子式且在同构（含不同基域）下自然；所得理想可下降到原域，不需要几何整性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为低维光滑固有簇提供了一种函子式的射影化/紧化方法，在保持极大拟射影开集交的同时实现射影终点，并放宽了几何整性假设，适用于更一般的域上情形。

title: IGA-KAN: Isogeometric Analysis with Physics-Informed Closed-Form Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Forward and Inverse PDEs
comment: 29 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Code and notebooks: https://github.com/Sima-Naraghi/iga-kan
summary: Isogeometric analysis (IGA) solves partial differential equations accurately on exact NURBS geometry, whereas neural solvers are mesh-free but often orders of magnitude less accurate and typically trained by non-convex optimization without error control. We propose IGA-KAN, which uses local Kolmogorov-Arnold networks, fitted in closed form, to improve the IGA solution instead of replacing it. An IGA Galerkin solve produces u_h; on every knot-vertex patch a Kolmogorov-Arnold ridge model is fitted to the strong form of the equation, the exact boundary data and u_h, and the models are blended by IGA hat functions. With fixed inner functions the fit is one batched linear least-squares problem, without optimizer, learning rate or initialization. An a posteriori safeguard, motivated by a maximum-principle bound, decides where local models are used, keeping the IGA solution elsewhere. On eight benchmarks with exact solutions, five from the literature and one also posed on a domain fitted to a brain slice from MRI, the method reduces the error of IGA, at an unchanged number of Galerkin unknowns, by factors of 4.2 to 90 in L^2 and 4.1 to 220 in H^1 on the reference meshes, and its L^2 error is 6 to 6x10^4 times smaller than that of the best Kolmogorov-Arnold network trained from scratch on the same equations with a fixed budget. In an inverse problem it recovers an unknown constant source from one noise-free observation 167 times more accurately than IGA. The gain is attributed to the superconvergence of local averages of the Galerkin solution.

AI.tldr: 提出IGA-KAN：用闭式拟合的局部KAN修正IGA Galerkin解（而非替代），在Galerkin未知数不变下显著降误差，逆问题亦更准。
AI.motivation: IGA能在精确NURBS几何上高精度求解PDE，但神经求解器虽无网格却精度低数个量级，且靠非凸优化、无误差控制。作者希望在保留IGA框架与计算规模的前提下进一步提升精度。
AI.method: 先做IGA Galerkin求得u_h；在每个knot-vertex patch上，以方程强形式、精确边界数据和u_h拟合Kolmogorov-Arnold ridge模型（内函数固定，拟合为批量线性最小二乘，无优化器/学习率/初始化）；再用IGA hat函数混合局部模型；并以基于最大值原理界的后验 safeguard 决定何处启用局部模型，其余仍用IGA解。
AI.result: 八个有精确解的基准（五个来自文献，一个域由MRI脑切片拟合），在参考网格上Galerkin未知数不变时，L^2误差降4.2–90倍，H^1降4.1–220倍；L^2误差比同预算从头训练的最佳KAN小6–6×10^4倍；逆问题中由一次无噪观测恢复未知常数源，比IGA准167倍。
AI.conclusion: 增益归因于Galerkin解局部平均的超收敛性；IGA-KAN以闭式、可控方式增强IGA，而非替代它，兼顾精度与成本。

title: Global solutions to the two-dimensional compressible MHD equations with density-dependent bulk viscosity
summary: We study the two-dimensional periodic resistive compressible magnetohydrodynamic equations with constant shear viscosity and magnetic diffusivity, bulk viscosity $ρ^β$, and pressure $ρ^γ$. For every $β>1$ and $γ>1$, we construct global finite-energy renormalized weak solutions from strictly positive bounded $W^{1,q}$ densities, $q>2$, and arbitrary $H^1$ velocity and magnetic data. The construction combines approximation-independent finite density moments, generalized effective-flux identities, and a joint logarithmic renormalization of the density and its entropy defect. An augmented relative energy containing the $β$-power density potential yields weak--strong uniqueness against positive $H^2$ strong solutions for the same full pressure range. We also establish global strong existence for a large-background family when $γ>\max\{5-2β,β+1\}$. Writing $m=\intρ_0$, the density perturbation is bounded in the scaled norm $m^{(γ-3)/2}\|ρ_0-m\|_{H^2}$, while the fixed $H^2$ velocity and magnetic norms need not be small. For sufficiently large $m$, frequency-dependent acoustic dissipation, staged vorticity weights, and a separate initial-layer flux estimate close a simultaneous bootstrap. The admissible pressure exponents have infimum $7/3$, with the endpoint excluded. For $β>2$ the relevant damping rate is the minimum of the viscous and pressure-relaxation rates; keeping both rates extends the argument without an upper restriction on $β$. The strong theorem has no upper restriction on $γ$ under this scaled density hypothesis; for fixed additive density perturbations it applies in the stated lower range up to $γ=3$.

AI.tldr: 该文研究二维周期区域上可压缩磁流体力学方程（常剪切黏度、磁扩散率，体积黏度ρ^β，压强ρ^γ），对所有β>1、γ>1构造全局有限能量重整化弱解；并证明弱-强唯一性，以及在γ>max{5-2β,β+1}时的大背景全局强解存在性。
AI.motivation: 在体积黏度与压强均为密度幂次、且允许具有真空或接近真空密度的情形下，已有可压缩MHD全局适定性结果对指数范围与初始正则性要求较强；本文旨在放宽γ、β的限制，并刻画密度扰动在背景质量m较大时的可容许尺度。
AI.method: 构造弱解时，结合逼近无关的有限密度矩、广义有效通量恒等式，以及对密度与其熵缺陷的联合对数重整化。唯一性采用含β次幂密度势的增广相对能量泛函。强解部分利用频率相关的声学耗散、分阶段涡量权重与初始层通量估计，完成同时进行的自举论证；当β>2时取黏性与压强松弛率的最小值作为阻尼率，并保留两种速率。
AI.result: 对任意β>1、γ>1，从严格正的有界W^{1,q}密度（q>2）与任意H^1速度、磁场数据出发，得到全局有限能量重整化弱解；增广相对能量给出对正H^2强解的弱-强唯一性。当γ>max{5-2β,β+1}时，对m足够大的大背景族证明全局强解；密度扰动以m^{(γ-3)/2}‖ρ0-m‖_{H^2}度量有界，而固定H^2速度与磁场范数无需很小。可容许压强指数下确界为7/3（端点不取）。
AI.conclusion: 结果把可压缩MHD的全局弱解与强解理论推广到更广的压强/体积黏度指数范围，并给出大背景质量下密度扰动的自然尺度；在缩放密度假设下强解定理对γ无上界，而固定加性密度扰动情形适用于所述下界范围直到γ=3。

title: Articulatory Entrainment and Coordination Complexity in Spontaneous Autistic and Non-autistic Dialogue
comment: Accepted to be published in Interspeech 2026
summary: Articulatory entrainment, the adaptation of vocal tract coordination to facilitate interaction remains underexplored in spontaneous dialogue, particularly among autistic speakers. Many prior studies have utilized task-based, phoneme-level analyses with invasive measurement techniques. Here, we introduce a speaker-independent framework to quantify articulatory entrainment in spontaneous dyadic conversations among autistic and non-autistic adults using acoustic-to-articulatory inversion and coordination complexity metrics. We examine temporal changes in articulatory coordination across interaction. Non-autistic dyads exhibit increasing coordination complexity and stronger entrainment over time, autistic dyads show moderate effects, and mixed dyads demonstrate the least alignment. Greater articulatory entrainment correlates with higher self-reported conversational success, indicating increase in coordination complexity as a marker of effective social interaction.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种与说话人无关的框架，利用声学到发音反演与协调复杂度指标，量化自闭症与非自闭症成人自发对话中的发音同步（articulatory entrainment）。结果显示非自闭症配对随互动推进协调复杂度上升、同步增强，自闭症配对效果中等，混合配对对齐最弱；发音同步越强，自评对话成功率越高。
AI.motivation: 发音同步（发音器官协调对互动的适应）在自发对话中研究不足，尤其针对自闭症说话者。既有研究多采用任务式、音素级分析及侵入性测量手段，缺乏生态效度且难以刻画自然互动中的动态变化。
AI.method: 提出与说话人无关的量化框架，结合声学到发音反演技术与协调复杂度指标，对自闭症与非自闭症成人组成的双人自发对话进行发音同步测量，并考察互动过程中发音协调的时间变化。
AI.result: 非自闭症双人组随时间推移协调复杂度升高、同步性增强；自闭症双人组效应中等；混合双人组对齐程度最低。发音同步程度越高，自评对话成功率越高，表明协调复杂度可作为有效社会互动的标志。
AI.conclusion: 发音同步及协调复杂度是有效社会互动的可量化标志；所提框架可在自然对话中对不同神经类型配对进行非侵入、说话人无关的发音协调分析。

title: Latent Similarity Gaussian Processes: A Theory-Grounded Approach to Personalized Suicide-Risk Forecasting for Clinical Decision-Support
summary: Forecasting suicide risk is difficult due to the high heterogeneity of patients and the low base rate of suicide-related events (SREs). We present Latent Similarity Gaussian Processes (LSGPs), which embed patients in a continuous latent space to jointly model similarity and forecast risk. By selectively drawing information from latent peers, LSGPs better capture individualized risk trajectories, generalizing nomothetic (pooled), idiographic (per-patient), and hierarchical frameworks. Our contributions are: (1) an identifiable two-channel Similarity Kernel; (2) proof that the standard model-fitting algorithm, mean-field variational inference, collapses LSGPs to nomothetic models, along with a fix; and (3) empirical results on intensive longitudinal suicide data showing LSGPs outperform nomothetic, idiographic, and hierarchical models for next-week risk forecasting, with the largest gains in forecasting first-occurrence SREs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Latent Similarity Gaussian Processes (LSGPs)，将患者嵌入连续潜在空间以联合建模相似性并预测自杀风险，在强化纵向自杀数据上优于nomothetic、idiographic和hierarchical模型。
AI.motivation: 自杀风险预测困难，主要源于患者高度异质性以及自杀相关事件(SREs)极低的基率。既有nomothetic(汇总)、idiographic(个体)及hierarchical框架各有局限，难以兼顾群体信息共享与个体化风险轨迹刻画。
AI.method: 提出LSGPs，将患者嵌入连续潜在空间，通过选择性从潜在"同侪"中提取信息，联合建模相似性与风险预测。核心包括：(1)一个可辨识的双通道Similarity Kernel；(2)证明标准模型拟合算法——平均场变分推断会使LSGPs退化为nomothetic模型，并提出修复方案。
AI.result: 在强化纵向自杀数据上的实验表明，LSGPs在下周风险预测中优于nomothetic、idiographic和hierarchical模型，且在预测首次发生的SREs时增益最大。
AI.conclusion: LSGPs通过潜在相似性建模统一并推广了nomothetic、idiographic和hierarchical框架，能更好捕捉个体化风险轨迹，对低基率、首次发生的自杀相关事件预测尤为有效。

title: Optimal Oracle Complexity for Finite-Sum Monotone Inclusions
summary: We present an oracle-optimal method for finite-sum monotone inclusions under mean-square Lipschitz continuity. Our switching regularization method finds a point $y$ and a certificate $g\in G(y)$ with $(\mathbb{E}\|F(y)+g\|^2)^{1/2}\le\varepsilon$ using $\mathcal{O}(n+\sqrt{n}LR/\varepsilon)$ expected component evaluations and resolvent evaluations. It removes the additive $n\log n$ cost of restarting a variance-reduced solver at every regularization stage by switching to a centered stochastic proximal iteration at regularization strength $L/\sqrt{n}$. Carrying an operator estimate between the remaining stages limits their total cost to $\mathcal{O}(n)$. A matching $Ω(n+\sqrt{n}LR/\varepsilon)$ lower bound holds for randomized linear-span component-oracle algorithms with adaptive stopping and expected query budgets. Thus, for $0<\varepsilon\le LR/2$, our method attains the optimal worst-case expected component complexity in this oracle model, up to universal constants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于切换正则化的方法，在均方Lipschitz连续条件下求解有限和单调包含问题，达到最优的期望分量复杂度 O(n+√n LR/ε)，并证明匹配下界。
AI.motivation: 现有方差缩减求解器在正则化的每个阶段重启会引入额外的 n log n 开销，未能达到最优复杂度。作者希望消除这一额外代价，实现该 oracle 模型下的最优期望分量复杂度。
AI.method: 提出切换正则化方法：在正则化强度 L/√n 处切换为中心化随机邻近迭代，从而避免每阶段重启方差缩减求解器；在剩余阶段之间携带算子估计，将其总成本限制在 O(n)。
AI.result: 方法找到点 y 及证书 g∈G(y)，使 (E‖F(y)+g‖²)^{1/2} ≤ ε，使用 O(n+√n LR/ε) 次期望分量求值与预解算子求值。对于具有自适应停止和期望查询预算的随机线性张成分量 oracle 算法，存在匹配的 Ω(n+√n LR/ε) 下界。
AI.conclusion: 对于 0<ε≤LR/2，该方法在该 oracle 模型下达到最优最坏情况期望分量复杂度（相差普适常数），解决了此类问题复杂度最优性的问题。

title: Centralizers of elements in the orthogonal, symplectic and unitary groups
summary: We explicitly compute and parametrize the centralizers of elements, encompassing dege\-ne\-rate and unipotent ones, in the orthogonal, symplectic, and unitary gro\-ups over the real and complex fields, including the indefinite cases. The same approach simultaneously yields the isotropy groups of $H$-skew-symme\-tric, Hamiltonian, and $H$-Hermitian matrices under the adjoint representations of the corresponding classical groups. The resulting groups are conjugate to subgroups of nonsingular block matrices whose blocks exhibit a rectangular block Toeplitz structure.

AI.tldr: 本文在实数和复数域上对正交、辛、酉群（含不定情形）中元素（包括退化与幂零元素）的中心化子进行了显式计算与参数化，并同时得到H-反对称、Hamiltonian及H-Hermitian矩阵在相应对经群伴随表示下的各向同性群；这些群共轭于具有矩形分块Toeplitz结构的分块非奇异矩阵子群。
AI.motivation: 经典群中元素中心化子的显式参数化是表示论与矩阵分析中的基础问题，但已有结果多局限于特定情形（如半单元素或紧群），对退化与幂零元素及不定号实形式缺乏统一、显式的处理。本文旨在给出一个统一方法，覆盖实/复域上正交、辛、酉群在确定的与不定情形下的全部元素中心化子，并借此顺带刻画相关矩阵型在伴随表示下的各向同性群。
AI.method: 采用统一的显式计算与参数化方法：在实数与复数域上处理正交、辛、酉群，允许退化（degenerate）与幂零（unipotent）元素，包含indefinite（不定号）情形。通过将中心化子与H-反对称、Hamiltonian、H-Hermitian矩阵在相应经典群伴随表示下的各向同性群（isotropy groups）联系，利用同一技术路线同时导出结果；最终刻画这些群共轭于分块非奇异矩阵子群，其分块呈现矩形分块Toeplitz结构（rectangular block Toeplitz structure）。
AI.result: 给出了中心化子的显式参数化（覆盖退化与幂零元素，实/复域，正交/辛/酉群，含不定情形）；同时得到H-反对称、Hamiltonian、H-Hermitian矩阵在相应经典群伴随表示下的各向同性群；并证明这些群共轭于具有矩形分块Toeplitz结构的分块非奇异矩阵子群。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了经典群元素中心化子及相应矩阵型各向同性群的统一显式描述，揭示了其共轭于矩形分块Toeplitz结构分块矩阵的共性结构，推广了以往限于半单或紧情形的结果，为相关表示论与矩阵分类问题提供了可直接使用的参数化工具。

title: A Mixed-Precision Model for Matrix-Splitting Methods
summary: The performance of stationary iterative methods is memory-bound, due to the low arithmetic intensity. So, we propose a mixed-precision technique to reduce the amount of data movement in matrix-splitting iterative methods. We demonstrate both theoretically and experimentally that this technique will generally converge at a similar rate as an exact-precision iteration, depending on the precision used and the conditioning of the $M$ matrix. Furthermore, we demonstrate that iterative refinement can be used to refine the solution to full double-precision accuracy. Using this approach, we mixed half and double precision to achieve an average speedup over uniform double precision of $1.60\times$ for scalar and block Jacobi and $1.25\times$ for scalar and block Gauss-Seidel. Furthermore, we reduced the precision in the SSOR iteration used by OVERFLOW, a NASA code for compressible fluid dynamics simulations, and achieved a $1.14\times$ speedup to the overall application.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种混合精度技术，用于减少矩阵分裂迭代方法中的数据移动量，从而缓解其内存带宽瓶颈。理论分析与实验表明，该技术通常能以与精确精度迭代相近的收敛速率收敛，并可用迭代精化将解精化至完整双精度。混合半精度与双精度后，标量/块Jacobi平均加速1.60×，标量/块Gauss-Seidel加速1.25×；在OVERFLOW中降低SSOR精度，整体应用加速1.14×。
AI.motivation: 平稳迭代方法算术强度低，性能受内存带宽限制（memory-bound）。因此需要减少数据移动来提升性能，而不是减少浮点运算量。降低精度可以直接减少数据移动，但需保证收敛速率与最终精度不受损害。
AI.method: 提出用于矩阵分裂迭代方法的混合精度技术：在迭代过程中部分使用低精度（如half）以降低数据移动，并通过理论分析给出收敛速率与所用精度及M矩阵条件数相关。结合迭代精化（iterative refinement）将解精化回完整double精度。在标量/块Jacobi、标量/块Gauss-Seidel以及OVERFLOW中使用的SSOR迭代上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 理论与实验表明，该混合精度迭代通常以与精确精度迭代相近的速率收敛，取决于所用精度和M矩阵条件数；迭代精化可将解精化至完整双精度。混合half与double平均比统一双精度加速：标量/块Jacobi 1.60×，标量/块Gauss-Seidel 1.25×；在NASA的OVERFLOW可压缩流体动力学代码中降低SSOR精度使整体应用加速1.14×。
AI.conclusion: 混合精度是缓解矩阵分裂平稳迭代方法内存带宽瓶颈的有效手段：在保持与全精度迭代相近收敛速率的前提下减少数据移动，并通过迭代精化恢复双精度精度，在多个迭代方法及实际CFD应用中取得显著加速。

title: Sharp uniform stability of the logarithmic Sobolev inequality on finite cycles and stability of the cubic Sobolev inequality
summary: We determine the sharp uniform constant in the quartic stability estimate for the logarithmic Sobolev inequality on finite cycles. We equip $C_{n}=\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ with the uniform probability measure, and we let $\mathcal{E}_{n}$ be the Dirichlet form of the simple random walk on $C_{n}$, normalized so that its spectral gap is one. Frank and Ivanisvili recently proved the sharp logarithmic Sobolev inequality $2\mathcal{E}_{n}(u)\geq \mathrm{Ent}(u^{2})$ for all $n\geq 4$. We prove that $2\mathcal{E}_{n}(u)-\mathrm{Ent}(u^{2})\geq \frac{1}{3}\Vert u-1\Vert _{2}^{4}$ for all $n\geq 4$ and all nonnegative $u$ with $\Vert u\Vert _{2}=1$. This is the sharp form, uniformly in $n$, of the quartic stability estimate of Xie and Zhang, who obtained the constant $\frac{1}{12}$. The same estimate holds on the circle and for the word-length energy on $C_{n}$. Among these models, the four-cycle is the only extremal one: on $C_{4}$ the constant $\frac{1}{3}$ is sharp but not attained, while on $C_{n}$ with $n\geq 5$ and on the circle the sharp constant is at least $\frac{1}{3}+c$, where $c>0$ does not depend on $n$. We also give explicit upper bounds for these sharp constants. Our second main result is a stability estimate for the cubic Sobolev inequality of Frank and Ivanisvili, which is the main step in their proof. It gives the quantitative version of this inequality expected by Frank and Ivanisvili, with the optimal powers of $\Vert u-1\Vert _{2}$: four on $C_{n}$ with $n\geq 5$ and on the circle, and six on $C_{4}$. Two key new ingredients of the proofs are a bound for the first Fourier coefficient of $u$ in terms of its mean, which holds because $u$ is nonnegative, and a sharp stability estimate for Gross's two-point logarithmic Sobolev inequality, with sharp constants in both the fourth and the sixth powers of the distance.

AI.tldr: 本文确定了有限环上对数Sobolev不等式四次稳定性估计的精确一致常数，证明了 $2\mathcal{E}_n(u)-\mathrm{Ent}(u^2)\geq \frac13\|u-1\|_2^4$（$n\geq 4$），并给出三次Sobolev不等式的稳定性估计。
AI.motivation: Frank与Ivanisvili最近证明了有限环上的精确对数Sobolev不等式；Xie与Zhang得到了带常数 $1/12$ 的四次稳定性估计，但该常数并非最优。本文旨在建立对所有 $n\geq 4$ 一致成立的最优四次稳定性常数，并给出相应三次Sobolev不等式的定量版本。
AI.method: 在 $C_n$ 上赋予均匀概率测度，取简单随机游走的Dirichlet形式 $\mathcal{E}_n$ 并归一化使其谱隙为1。核心新工具包括：利用 $u\geq 0$ 得到其第一傅里叶系数关于均值的界；以及Gross两点对数Sobolev不等式的精确稳定性估计，给出距离的四次与六次幂的精确常数。
AI.result: 证明了对所有 $n\geq 4$ 及满足 $\|u\|_2=1$ 的非负 $u$，有 $2\mathcal{E}_n(u)-\mathrm{Ent}(u^2)\geq \frac13\|u-1\|_2^4$，这是Xie-Zhang结果的精确形式且常数一致。相同估计在圆周及 $C_n$ 上的字长能量下也成立。在 $C_4$ 上常数 $1/3$ 精确但不可达；对 $n\geq 5$ 及圆周，精确常数至少为 $\frac13+c$（$c>0$ 与 $n$ 无关），并给出显式上界。此外得到三次Sobolev不等式的稳定性估计，最优幂次为：$n\geq5$ 及圆周上四次，$C_4$ 上六次。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了有限环对数Sobolev不等式四次稳定性估计的一致精确常数 $1/3$，并确认四环是唯一极值模型；同时给出三次Sobolev不等式的定量稳定性结果。所用傅里叶系数界与两点对数Sobolev精确稳定性估计是关键新方法。

title: DUET: Co-Evolving Solver and Grader Agents
summary: Agentic workflows are increasingly used across domains such as technology, finance, and enterprise operations. As these agents become more widely deployed, continually improving them becomes increasingly important. This raises an immediate challenge: How should the agent evolve? This evolution requires effective evaluation that can assess outcomes and provide useful feedback for optimization. As the agent evolves, its behaviors and failure modes may also change, making a fixed evaluator increasingly inadequate. Another fundamental question: How should we evaluate an evolving agent? These two challenges are inherently coupled; changes in agent behavior can expose limitations of the current evaluator, while a stronger evaluator provides more informative feedback for improving the agent. Motivated by this interaction, we introduce DUET, a framework that jointly optimizes a solver agent and a grader agent to improve both. DUET iteratively selects training tasks, executes them with the solver, evaluates the resulting outcomes with the grader, and uses a tool-using update module to revise the solver and the grader, alternating between the two across rounds. By updating the grader within the optimization loop, DUET turns evaluation from a fixed source of feedback into a first-class optimization objective that adapts alongside the solver. Experiments across four agent benchmarks show that DUET improves both solver and grader performance and consistently outperforms baselines that optimize the solver with a fixed grader.

AI.tldr: 提出DUET框架，在优化循环中联合优化求解器智能体与评分器智能体，使评估器随求解器共同进化，从而持续提升两者性能。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体工作流在技术、金融、企业运营等领域的广泛部署，持续改进智能体变得愈发重要。这引出两个相互耦合的核心问题：智能体应如何进化（需要有效评估提供反馈以支持优化），以及在智能体行为与失效模式不断变化的情况下应如何评估一个进化中的智能体（固定评估器会逐渐失效）。求解器行为变化会暴露现有评估器的局限，而更强评估器又能为改进求解器提供更有信息量的反馈，二者相互影响，因此需要协同处理。
AI.method: DUET是一个联合优化求解器智能体（solver agent）与评分器智能体（grader agent）的框架。其流程为迭代执行：选择训练任务，用求解器执行任务，用评分器评估结果，再通过一个可调用工具（tool-using）的更新模块修订求解器与评分器，并在多轮之间交替更新二者。通过在优化循环内更新评分器，DUET将评估从固定的反馈来源转变为与求解器同步自适应的首要优化目标。
AI.result: 在四个智能体基准（agent benchmarks）上，DUET同时提升了求解器与评分器的性能，并且持续优于使用固定评分器优化求解器的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将评分器纳入优化循环、与求解器联合进化，能够把评估转变为可自适应的优化目标，从而在求解器与评估器两方面取得更好表现，优于固定评估器的方案。

title: On the Comparison of Optimizers for Imbalanced Learning
summary: Data imbalance is pervasive in machine learning, from rare words and anomalies to underrepresented patterns in heterogeneous or cross-tabulated data. We study idealized optimizers geometries in continuous time to model small-step training in deep learning. We assume that the source of imbalance is unobserved: the optimizer has only access to the aggregate training loss ignoring the exact contributions of the majority and minority groups. In this setting, we characterize a region where majority losses are optimized regardless of the admissible minority structure. We derive explicit equations of this zone and bounds on the time needed to leave it. These bounds exhibit a milder dependence on minority amplitude for sign, spectral, and Newton descent than for Euclidean gradient descent. Experiments with AdamW and Muon suggest similar advantages over SGD across language, tabular, and image tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文从连续时间理想化优化器几何角度研究数据不平衡下的小步长深度学习训练，在仅能获取聚合损失、无法观测多数/少数群体分解的设定下，刻画了"多数群体损失被优先优化"的停滞区域，推导该区域的显式方程与逃离时间上界，并证明符号、谱、牛顿下降对少数群体幅度的依赖弱于欧氏梯度下降，实验在语言、表格与图像任务上验证了AdamW与Muon相对SGD的优势。
AI.motivation: 数据不平衡普遍存在于机器学习中（稀有词、异常、异质或交叉表中的低代表模式）。作者希望建立一个理想化的优化器几何框架，用以解释和预测小步长训练中不平衡数据导致的优化行为，尤其是当不平衡来源不可观测、优化器只能看到聚合损失而无法区分多数与少数群体贡献时的训练动力学。
AI.method: 作者采用连续时间理想化优化器几何建模深度学习的小步长训练，假设不平衡来源不可观测，优化器仅能访问聚合训练损失。在此设定下，刻画了多数群体损失被优化（与容许的少数结构无关）的区域，推导该区域的显式方程，并给出逃离该区域所需时间的界。理论分析比较了符号下降、谱下降、牛顿下降与欧氏梯度下降对少数群体幅度的依赖。实验方面，在语言、表格与图像任务上对比AdamW、Muon与SGD。
AI.result: 理论结果显示，逃离多数优化区域的界对少数群体幅度的依赖，在符号、谱和牛顿下降下比欧氏梯度下降更为温和。实验表明，在语言、表格和图像任务上，AdamW与Muon相对SGD表现出类似的优势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过连续时间优化器几何框架，揭示了不可观测数据不平衡下多数群体主导优化的停滞机制，并量化了不同优化器逃离该区域的时间代价，说明符号/谱/牛顿类方法（如AdamW、Muon）在少数群体幅度较小时比欧氏梯度下降（SGD）更具优势，理论与实验一致。

title: A Local Geometric Analysis of Maximal Coding Rate Reduction via Error Bounds
comment: This paper is accepted by NeurIPS 2026
summary: While the maximal coding rate reduction (MCR$^2$) objective has become a useful principle for learning compact and discriminative representations, a theoretical understanding of its optimization geometry remains limited, especially regarding why first-order methods often exhibit fast convergence near its local maximizers. In this work, we show that the MCR$^2$ objective satisfies an error-bound property in a neighborhood of its local maximizers. This property guarantees that the distance to the local maximizer set can be bounded above by the gradient norm at any point in the neighborhood, directly implying regularity conditions such as the Polyak--Łojasiewicz inequality and quadratic growth. Leveraging this property, we prove that first-order methods converge linearly to a local maximizer of the MCR$^2$ objective under mild conditions. Numerical experiments validate the predicted local convergence behavior and provide empirical evidence that optimizing the MCR$^2$ objective improves representation geometry while maintaining competitive downstream accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文证明MCR²目标函数在局部极大值附近满足误差界性质，进而导出PL不等式与二次增长等正则性条件，并据此证明一阶方法可线性收敛到局部极大值。
AI.motivation: MCR²已成为学习紧凑且具判别性表示的有效准则，但其优化几何的理论理解仍有限，尤其缺乏对一阶方法在局部极大值附近快速收敛原因的解释。
AI.method: 在MCR²目标函数的局部极大值邻域内建立误差界性质，即到局部极大值集合的距离可被该点梯度范数上界控制；由此推导出Polyak–Łojasiewicz不等式和二次增长等正则性条件；结合这些条件分析一阶方法的收敛性，并进行数值实验验证。
AI.result: 理论上证明了MCR²满足误差界性质及其蕴含的正则性条件；在温和条件下证明一阶方法线性收敛到局部极大值。数值实验验证了预测的局部收敛行为，并表明优化MCR²可改善表示几何，同时保持有竞争力的下游准确率。
AI.conclusion: MCR²的误差界性质为其优化几何提供了理论解释，说明一阶方法在局部极大值附近的快速收敛源于该性质，并为MCR²的实际有效性提供了理论与经验支持。

title: Tame Discrete Sets on Affine Semisimple Homogeneous Spaces
summary: Winkelmann conjectures that every smooth flexible complex affine variety of dimension at least two is a Rosay--Rudin space. We verify this for every positive-dimensional quotient $G/H$ with $G$ a connected complex semisimple algebraic group and $H$ a closed connected reductive subgroup. Weak and strong tameness coincide, every injection between tame discrete sets extends to a holomorphic automorphism, and complements of tame, finite, or empty sets are Oka. Every sufficiently sparse enumerated sequence can be sent to a fixed sequence by a composition of $n$ complete holomorphic flow maps, with $n\le6$; injective self-maps of the fixed sequence admit such a realization with $n\le2$. These flows preserve an invariant algebraic volume form. The proof uses entire interpolation and regular functions invariant under two solvable subgroups to construct the automorphisms. If $G$ is simple of rank at least two and $G/H$ is spherical and admits a closed equivariant embedding into an irreducible module, the normalization bound improves to $n\le4$. We also prove that $\SL_2/N(T)$, where $T$ is a maximal torus, is an RR-space. This quotient is the complement of a smooth conic in $\mathbf P^2$.

AI.tldr: 该论文验证了Winkelmann关于光滑柔性复仿射簇是Rosay--Rudin空间的猜想在齐性空间 $G/H$ 情形，并给出流映射生成自同构的定量界。
AI.motivation: Winkelmann猜想：每个维数至少为2的光滑柔性复仿射簇都是Rosay--Rudin空间。该猜想刻画了复仿射空间的自同构群中流映射生成的动力学性质，需要在一类自然且重要的仿射齐性空间上加以验证。
AI.method: 方法是利用全纯插值和在两个可解子群下不变的正则函数来构造自同构，把稀疏枚举序列通过有限个完备全纯流映射的复合送到给定序列。
AI.result: 对任意正维数的 $G/H$（$G$ 连通复半单代数群，$H$ 闭连通约化子群）验证了猜想：弱与强驯顺性一致，驯顺离散集之间的单射均可延拓为全纯自同构，驯顺、有限或空集的补集是Oka的。任意足够稀疏的枚举序列可由至多 $n\le6$ 个完备全纯流映射送到固定序列；固定序列的单射自映射可实现为 $n\le2$。流保持不变代数体积形式。当 $G$ 单且秩至少2、$G/H$ 为球型且可闭等变嵌入既约模时，界改进为 $n\le4$。此外证明 $\SL_2/N(T)$（$T$ 极大环面，即 $\mathbf P^2$ 中光滑圆锥曲线的补集）是RR空间。
AI.conclusion: Winkelmann猜想在这类约化齐性空间上成立，并给出了流映射复合长度的明确上界；$\SL_2/N(T)$ 作为RR空间提供了具体例证。

title: Delta Redistribution: a variation of State Redistribution for steady-state embedded boundary computations
summary: We present an algorithm for handling the small cell problem in Cartesian cut cell grids. The advantage of this variation is that it preserves the base scheme's steady state exactly. We show several computational examples using finite volume schemes in two space dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种处理笛卡尔切割网格小单元问题的算法，其优势在于严格保持基础格式的稳态，并通过二维有限体积格式算例验证。
AI.motivation: 笛卡尔切割网格在处理复杂几何边界时会产生尺寸极小的"小单元"，破坏显式格式的稳定性条件（CFL限制），从而降低计算效率。此外，现有处理方法往往难以在修复小单元的同时保持原格式的稳态精确性，因此需要一种既能解决小单元问题又不破坏格式稳态保持性质的算法。
AI.method: 针对笛卡尔切割网格中的小单元问题提出一种新的处理算法，核心在于保留基础格式的稳态精确保持特性；并在二维空间中结合有限体积格式开展计算实现与验证。
AI.result: 给出了若干二维有限体积格式的计算算例，验证了所提算法在处理小单元问题时能够保持基础格式的稳态。
AI.conclusion: 该算法有效缓解了笛卡尔切割网格的小单元问题，同时严格保持基础格式的稳态，具有良好的实用价值。

title: A constrained log-HLS inequality and its associated Wasserstein flow
comment: 32 pages. Any comments or suggestions are welcome!!!
summary: We study a log-Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev (log-HLS) inequality under constraints and a naturally induced Wasserstein flow. The constrained log-HLS inequality is dual, in a variational sense, to the constrained Trudinger-Moser-Onofri-Aubin inequality. The corresponding gradient-flow formulation leads to a parabolic-elliptic Patlak-Keller-Segel (PKS) system whose global dynamics exhibit a dichotomy between global existence and finite-time blow-up depending on the initial mass. Remarkably, the constraint raises the critical mass threshold of the flow by a factor of two compared with the unconstrained setting. This provides a distinct mechanism for suppressing blow-up from those arising in related formulations of the PKS-system, where blow-up is mitigated through additional effects such as a forcing term, coupling with a fluid equation, or the ambient flow generated by harmonic perturbations of the Newtonian potential.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带约束的对数 Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev (log-HLS) 不等式及其自然诱导的 Wasserstein 流，揭示该流对应的抛物-椭圆 PKS 系统在临界质量处呈现全局存在与有限时间爆破的二分类，且约束将临界质量阈值提高为无约束情形的两倍。
AI.motivation: 带约束的 log-HLS 不等式在变分意义上对偶于带约束的 Trudinger-Moser-Onofri-Aubin 不等式；作者希望借助其梯度流结构刻画 PKS 系统的全局动力学，并寻找抑制爆破的新机制。
AI.method: 建立带约束的 log-HLS 不等式，利用其变分对偶性推导对应的梯度流（Wasserstein 流），并得到抛物-椭圆 Patlak-Keller-Segel (PKS) 系统，进而分析其质量依赖的全局动力学。
AI.result: 所得 PKS 系统依初始质量出现全局存在与有限时间爆破的二分类；约束使流的临界质量阈值相对无约束情形提高一倍，从而提供了一种与已有抑制爆破机制不同的新途径。
AI.conclusion: 约束本身即可显著提升 PKS 流的临界质量阈值并抑制爆破，这种机制区别于通过外力项、与流体方程耦合或牛顿势调和扰动所生成的环境流等额外效应实现抑爆的相关构造。

title: Pareto-Dominant Clarification: Post-Training Coding LLMs via PPO-Lagrangian Budget Constraints
comment: Accepted to the LMP Workshop at EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 8 figures, 1 table. Abhinav Rajput and Acey Vogelstein contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/Abhinav0710rajput/coding_llms_cmdp
summary: Coding agents operating under ambiguous instructions or user prompts must decide whether to ask clarifying questions or attempt a solution directly. While clarification from the user may improve the correctness of the agent's solution, each back-and-forth interaction incurs user and system costs, forming an explicit accuracy vs. efficiency tradeoff. Existing works study clarification behavior but do not train policies under enforceable clarification budgets; penalty-based approaches typically require separate coefficient tuning swept across all clarification budget levels. We formulate clarification as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and post-train Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct with PPO-Lagrangian to optimize coding accuracy, subject to an expected question-budget constraint. Evaluated on HumanEvalComm with a GPT-4o-mini oracle simulator, the resulting policies reveal that untuned clarification behavior is Pareto-inefficient: budget-constrained policies can simultaneously achieve higher accuracy and lower clarification rates than the baseline model. Across budget levels, we observe a log-shaped Pareto frontier with diminishing returns to additional clarification. Gains arise not from simply asking more questions overall, but from improved question targeting and better code generation under ambiguity. Without explicit supervision, trained policies learn to allocate clarification budget non-uniformly, asking more frequently on tougher (multi-degradation) tasks. These results suggest that unconstrained interactive LLM systems may systematically use clarification inefficiently.

AI.tldr: 本文将澄清行为建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程(CMDP)，用PPO-Lagrangian对Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct进行后训练，在期望提问预算约束下优化编码准确率；实验揭示无约束澄清行为存在帕累托低效。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体在指令模糊时需决策是提问澄清还是直接作答：澄清可提升正确性，但每次交互都带来用户与系统成本，形成显式的准确率-效率权衡。已有工作虽研究澄清行为，但未在可强制执行的澄清预算下训练策略；基于惩罚的方法通常需为每个预算水平单独调参扫描，成本高。
AI.method: 将澄清形式化为约束马尔可夫决策过程(CMDP)，采用PPO-Lagrangian对Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct进行后训练，在期望提问预算约束下最大化编码准确率；在HumanEvalComm数据集上以GPT-4o-mini作为oracle模拟器进行评估。
AI.result: 无调优的澄清行为呈帕累托低效：受预算约束的策略可同时取得高于基线的准确率和更低的澄清率。跨预算水平呈现对数形帕累托前沿，额外澄清收益递减。性能提升并非来自整体提问更多，而源于更优的提问定向与歧义下更好的代码生成。无需显式监督，策略即学会非均匀分配澄清预算，在更困难（多重降级）任务上提问更频繁。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，无约束的交互式LLM系统可能系统性地低效使用澄清机制，为此类系统引入显式澄清预算约束具有实际价值。

title: Valid Stopping in Adaptive Generator-Verifier Loops
summary: Numerous agentic workflows are based on a generator-verifier loop: a generator proposes candidates, a cheap verifier scores them, and the workflow terminates when a proposal is verified as good enough. The verifier typically proxies a more costly ground-truth oracle, and as the generator searches adaptively against it, false acceptances may accumulate. Proposals can pass the proxy but fail under the costlier ground-truth check. We study when to stop these loops while controlling the false discovery rate of the accepted proposals. Our construction introduces tools of independent interest in distribution-free statistical testing and conformal risk control, including analysis of $e$-values constructed through index betting and a novel conformal risk control procedure for non-monotone losses. We validate the approach in synthetic settings and on a protein-design benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成器-验证器循环中的停止时机问题，在控制被接受提案的错误发现率的前提下，提出基于e值和共形风险控制的分布无关统计检验方法。
AI.motivation: 许多智能体工作流采用生成器-验证器循环：生成器提出候选方案，廉价验证器为其打分，当某提案被验证为足够好时循环终止。验证器通常代理一个更昂贵的真实预言机，随着生成器自适应地针对验证器搜索，错误接受可能不断累积——提案可能通过代理验证却无法通过更昂贵的真实检查。因此需要研究何时停止此类循环，同时控制被接受提案的错误发现率。
AI.method: 本文提出一项构建方法，引入在分布无关统计检验与共形风险控制中具有独立价值的工具，包括：（1）通过指数投注（index betting）构建的e值分析；（2）一种针对非单调损失的共形风险控制新方法。
AI.result: 该方法在合成实验设置中以及一个蛋白质设计基准任务上均得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，所提出的方法能够在生成器-验证器循环中控制被接受提案的错误发现率，并在合成设置与蛋白质设计基准上验证了其有效性。

title: Single-call Polyak-Type Extragradient Methods for Monotone Root-Finding Problems
summary: We propose a single-call variant of Polyak extragradient, termed SPolyakEG, by recycling the previous extrapolation operator evaluation. Under a delayed critical condition, we establish that SPolyakEG achieves an $O(1/K)$ residual convergence rate for monotone operators and linear convergence under strong monotonicity. Compared with PolyakEG, SPolyakEG reduces the number of operator evaluations from two to one per iteration.

AI.tldr: 提出单次算子评估的Polyak外推梯度变体SPolyakEG，通过复用上一次外推算子评估值，在延迟临界条件下实现单调算子的O(1/K)残差收敛率及强单调下的线性收敛，将每迭代算子评估次数由2降至1。
AI.motivation: Polyak外推梯度法（PolyakEG）每迭代需两次算子评估，计算开销较大，因此需要在保持收敛性的前提下降低评估成本。
AI.method: 通过循环复用前一次外推算子评估结果，构造单次调用变体SPolyakEG；在延迟临界条件下进行收敛性分析。
AI.result: 在延迟临界条件下，SPolyakEG对单调算子达到O(1/K)的残差收敛率，在强单调条件下达到线性收敛；相较PolyakEG，每迭代算子评估次数由两次减少为一次。
AI.conclusion: SPolyakEG在保持PolyakEG收敛性质的同时显著降低单次迭代的计算代价，是外推梯度类方法的高效变体。

title: Sharp bounds and gap phenomena for large $p$-subgroups of automorphism groups of curves
summary: Let $X$ be a curve of genus $g\ge2$ over an algebraically closed field of odd characteristic $p$, and let $G=\mathrm{Aut}(X)$. A theorem of Giulietti and Korchmaros shows that if $G$ fixes no point and a $p$-subgroup $S\le G_P$ satisfies $|S|>\frac{p}{p-1}g$, then $X$ is one of the classical hyperelliptic, Hermitian, or Ree curves. We determine the sharp boundary and the first gap below it. At equality, besides the classical curves, exactly three types occur: the ordinary curves $y^p-y=x+c/x$, the zero-$p$-rank curves $y^3=x^p-x$ for $p\equiv2\pmod3$, and, in characteristic $3$, the ordinary genus-six family $y^3-y=c\left(x+\frac1{x^3-x}\right)$. As a key ingredient, we classify zero-$p$-rank curves whose full automorphism group fixes no point and which admit a $p$-subgroup of order larger than the genus. We then prove that, when $|S|>p$, the boundary classification already follows from the weaker inequality $|S|>p(g-p+1)/(p-1)$. For $|S|\ge p^3$, the forbidden interval above $m=(p-1)|S|/p$ has width at least $p(p-1)/2$, and below $m+(p^2-1)/2$ at most one further genus can occur, with a rigid ramification structure. Finally, we classify the first admissible layer: it occurs only for $|S|=p^2$, and the resulting ordinary curves admit a complete description in terms of two-dimensional Artin--Schreier spaces.

AI.tldr: 该文在奇特征代数闭域上研究亏格g≥2曲线X的自同构群G，精确确定Giulietti-Korchmaros定理中不等式|S|>(p/(p-1))g的尖锐边界及下方第一个间隙，并对达到边界和第一可容许层的曲线进行完整分类。
AI.motivation: Giulietti与Korchmaros证明了若G无不动点且某p-子群S≤G_P满足|S|>p/(p-1)·g，则X必为经典超椭圆、Hermitian或Ree曲线。但该不等式并非尖锐，边界处及边界下方曲线的结构尚不清楚，本文旨在确定尖锐边界、第一间隙，并给出相应曲线的分类。
AI.method: 通过分类零p-秩曲线（其全自同构群无不动点且含阶大于亏格的p-子群）作为关键工具；利用|S|>p时的较弱不等式|S|>p(g-p+1)/(p-1)推导边界分类；分析|S|≥p³时m=(p-1)|S|/p上方禁止区间的宽度以及m+(p²-1)/2下方至多一个额外亏格的可能性与刚性分歧结构；并用二维Artin-Schreier空间描述第一可容许层的普通曲线。
AI.result: 在等式|S|=p/(p-1)·g处，除经典曲线外恰有三种类型：普通曲线y^p-y=x+c/x；p≡2 (mod 3)时的零p-秩曲线y³=x^p-x；以及特征3下的普通亏格6族y³-y=c(x+1/(x³-x))。当|S|>p时，边界分类由较弱不等式|S|>p(g-p+1)/(p-1)即可推出。当|S|≥p³时，m上方禁止区间宽度至少为p(p-1)/2，m+(p²-1)/2下方至多出现一个额外亏格且具刚性分歧结构。第一可容许层仅当|S|=p²时出现，对应普通曲线可由二维Artin-Schreier空间完整描述。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了Giulietti-Korchmaros界定的尖锐形式与第一间隙，完整刻画了边界处的三类非经典曲线，并分类了第一可容许层；同时揭示了当|S|>p时较弱的亏格-阶数不等式已足以导出边界分类，且在高阶p-子群情形下禁止区间宽度与刚性分歧结构受到严格限制。

title: One Extra Dimension Suffices for the Complete-Graph Squared-Stress
comment: 9 pages. Lean 4 formalization and exact arithmetic checks included as ancillary files
summary: Let all pairwise distances of an arbitrary configuration of points in $\mathbb{R}^{\ell}$ be known exactly. We prove that every second-order stationary point of the complete-graph squared-stress objective over configurations in $\mathbb{R}^{k}$ has zero residual whenever $k > \ell$. The result holds for every number of points, without a genericity assumption, and allows repeated points and degenerate ground-truth configurations. It resolves the one-extra-dimension conjecture for complete, uniformly weighted data. The proof combines positivity of the residual stress, polar normalization of the candidate configuration, a row-wise rank-nullity argument, and propagation of zero curvature through the full Hessian. The theorem, including the passage from derivatives of the original quartic objective to its matrix formulation, has been formalized in Lean 4. The accompanying verification records include a kernel check with zero trust level and a transitive axiom audit.

AI.tldr: 证明：当嵌入维度 k 大于真值维度 ℓ 时，完整图平方应力目标的每个二阶稳定点残差为零；无需一般位置假设，并已在 Lean 4 中形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 解决均匀加权完整图数据下的“多一维猜想”，且要求结论对任意点数、允许重合点与退化真值构型成立。
AI.method: 结合残差应力的正性、候选构型的极坐标归一化、逐行秩-零化度论证，以及通过完整 Hessian 传播零曲率；并处理从原始四次目标导数到矩阵表述的过渡。
AI.result: 证明若 k > ℓ，则 R^k 中完整图平方应力目标的每个二阶稳定点残差均为零；该结论无一般位置假设，允许重复点和退化构型。
AI.conclusion: 该定理解决了完整、均匀加权数据的一多一维猜想；形式化验证包含零信任级别的内核检查与传递公理审计。

title: Affine variational functionals, isoperimetric problems and stability
summary: We study three affine variational quantities built on the affine $L^p$ energy of Lutwak, Yang and Zhang: the affine Poincaré--Sobolev constants $Λ^{\mathcal{A}}_{p,q}(Ω)$ of a bounded open set, the associated affine torsional rigidity, and the affine $p$-capacity of a compact set. We show that ellipsoids are the only extremal sets in their corresponding isoperimetric inequalities, and that the affine capacity of a compact set of positive volume is attained by a potential solving the affine $p$-Laplace equation. We also prove an affine Kohler-Jobin inequality: among sets with prescribed affine torsional rigidity, only ellipsoids minimize $Λ^{\mathcal{A}}_{p,q}$. Following the approach of Haddad, Jiménez and Montenegro to affine Sobolev inequalities, our methods rest on the $L_p$ Busemann--Petty centroid inequality. Proving a stability version of it, we obtain quantitative forms of the isoperimetric inequalities for $Λ^{\mathcal{A}}_{p,q}$, the affine torsional rigidity and the affine $p$-capacity, together with a stability result for the affine Kohler-Jobin inequality on convex sets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于Lutwak-Yang-Zhang仿射L^p能量的三个仿射变分量：仿射Poincaré-Sobolev常数、仿射扭转刚度与仿射p-容量，证明椭球是对应等周不等式中的唯一极值集，并建立仿射Kohler-Jobin不等式及其稳定性，还给出等周不等式的定量（稳定性）形式。
AI.motivation: 将经典等周型泛函（Poincaré-Sobolev常数、扭转刚度、p-容量）推广到仿射框架，识别其极值集并量化与椭球的偏差，从而深化对仿射Sobolev理论的理解。
AI.method: 沿用Haddad-Jiménez-Montenegro处理仿射Sobolev不等式的方法，核心依赖于L_p Busemann-Petty质心不等式；通过证明该不等式的稳定性版本导出定量结果。
AI.result: 证明椭球是仿射Poincaré-Sobolev常数、仿射扭转刚度和仿射p-容量对应等周不等式的唯一极值集；正体积紧集的仿射容量由满足仿射p-Laplace方程的解达成；建立仿射Kohler-Jobin不等式：在给定仿射扭转刚度的集合中仅椭球最小化该常数；并获得各量的定量等周不等式及凸集上仿射Kohler-Jobin不等式的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 椭球在仿射等周问题中具有唯一极值地位，L_p Busemann-Petty质心不等式的稳定性是获得定量仿射等周不等式与稳定性结果的关键工具。

title: Robust blind unmixing: A geometric approach to overcoming basis variation
summary: Signal separation problems are common in science. A prominent example of this occurs during the use of diffraction or spectroscopy to identify the individual components of a mixture by measuring it. In the simplest case, the measured signal is a linear combination of basis patterns corresponding to the constituent parts. The unmixing problem is to infer all or some of these basis patterns and abundances of components from measurements of distinct mixtures. One of the core challenges of this task is the variation of the basis from mixture to mixture due to noise and the exact physics of the measurement process. This is usually addressed with tailored model-based and parametric methods that are then limited in use to specific application domains by the nature of the assumptions made. We propose a novel geometric approach to unmixing problems which views the generation of data during measurement through a metric space lens, thereby shifting the focus from parametrised models to a general relationship between basis transformations and the corresponding geometry. We take advantage of the optimal transport distances to capture commonly occurring basis variations, and use minimisation of in-class variance of candidate solutions to drive the optimisation. We pay special attention to the one-dimensional case due to its practical importance and availability of efficient distance and transport map routines. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated on a range of unmixing tasks using random Gaussian mixture models, simulated powder X-ray diffraction, and laboratory hyperspectral imaging datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于度量空间与最优传输的几何视角解混方法，摆脱参数化模型限制。
AI.motivation: 信号解混广泛存在于科学中，传统方法依赖针对特定领域定制的模型与参数化假设，通用性受限。
AI.method: 以度量空间视角看待测量数据生成，关注基变换与几何的通用关系，利用最优传输距离刻画基的变化，并通过最小化候选解类内方差来驱动优化，重点处理一维情形。
AI.result: 在随机高斯混合模型、模拟粉末X射线衍射和实验室高光谱成像数据的解混任务上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 几何式解混框架可跨领域通用，摆脱参数化假设限制，在一维解混任务中表现良好。

title: KESurv: A Kernel Ensemble Method for Patient-Specific Survival Prediction
summary: Predicting patient-specific survival functions is crucial for clinicians in making informed decisions about patient care and treatment strategies. Among the various models available, the Survival Forest has demonstrated significant effectiveness in numerous scenarios. In this work, we propose an ensemble method that leverages the strengths of the Survival Forest as the master model, complemented by several base models. This ensemble incorporates the Beran estimator, a type of kernel estimator, to enhance predictions of patient-specific survival curves. We evaluated the performance of our proposed model using four distinct healthcare datasets. The results highlight the superiority of our ensemble method over baseline models in both calibration and ranking across most datasets. The findings suggest that our approach offers a more accurate and reliable estimation of patient-specific survival functions, providing a valuable tool for clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种以Survival Forest为主模型、以Beran核估计器等基模型为辅的集成方法，用于预测患者个体化生存函数，并在四个医疗数据集上验证了其在校准和排序上的优越性。
AI.motivation: 患者个体化生存函数预测对临床决策与治疗策略制定至关重要；Survival Forest虽表现良好，但单一模型在预测精度和可靠性上仍有提升空间，需借助集成方法增强生存曲线估计。
AI.method: 提出一种集成方法，将Survival Forest作为主模型，结合多个基模型，并引入Beran核估计器以提升患者个体化生存曲线的预测。
AI.result: 在四个不同的医疗数据集上评估，所提集成方法在大多数数据集上的校准与排序性能均优于基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能更准确、可靠地估计患者个体化生存函数，为临床决策提供有价值的工具。

title: Ordered Weighted Average Support Vector Regression
summary: This paper introduces a novel Support Vector Regression (SVR) model that incorporates Ordered Weighted Average (OWA) operators to differently penalize deviations of observations from the ε-strip. The penalty is determined based on the position of each deviation in the ordered vector of all deviations. A key contribution of this work is the development of two nonlinear formulations: a continuous formulation for non-decreasing monotone weight vectors and a mixed-integer formulation for general weight vectors. By leveraging dual approaches associated with these formulations, the model accommodates nonlinear kernel functions. To enhance computational efficiency, two heuristic approaches are proposed for deriving suitable regression hyperplanes in reduced computation times, as compared to exact methods. Additionally, a third heuristic approach is developed to handle nonlinear kernel functions effectively. Computational experiments conducted on both real and synthetic datasets demonstrate that the exact formulations yield remarkable regression functions with respect to the following standard metrics: mean absolute errors (MAE) and mean squared errors (MSE). The heuristic approaches are shown to be particularly efficient for larger datasets, striking a balance between solution quality and computational effort.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合有序加权平均(OWA)算子的支持向量回归(SVR)模型，对偏离ε带的不同观测给予差异化惩罚，并给出连续型与混合整数型两种非线性建模形式及三种启发式方法。
AI.motivation: 传统SVR对所有偏离ε带的观测施加相同惩罚，无法区分不同偏差的重要性。本文引入OWA算子，根据各偏差在全体偏差有序向量中的位置来确定惩罚权重，从而实现差异化惩罚，提升回归拟合的灵活性与合理性。
AI.method: 1) 构建基于OWA算子的SVR模型，按偏差排序位置实施不同惩罚；2) 提出两种非线性建模形式：针对非递减单调权重向量的连续型形式，以及针对一般权重向量的混合整数形式；3) 利用相应问题的对偶形式引入非线性核函数；4) 为提高计算效率，提出两种启发式方法快速求解回归超平面，并另提出第三种启发式方法处理非线性核函数。
AI.result: 在真实数据集与合成数据集上的计算实验表明，精确建模形式在平均绝对误差(MAE)和均方误差(MSE)两项标准指标上均能获得优异的回归效果；启发式方法在较大数据集上尤为高效，能够在解质量与计算代价之间取得良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 将OWA算子嵌入SVR可实现对ε带偏差的差异化惩罚，配合连续型与混合整数型精确模型以及对偶核化处理，兼顾了建模灵活性与非线性拟合能力；所提启发式方法在大规模数据下具有显著的效率优势，为该类回归问题提供了实用求解途径。

title: A Quadratic Bound for Automorphism Groups of Curves of Positive $p$-Rank in Odd Characteristic
summary: Let $X$ be a nonsingular projective curve of genus $g\ge2$ over an algebraically closed field of odd characteristic $p$. Giulietti and Korchmáros established a quadratic genus bound with constant $900$ forcing zero $p$-rank for curves of even genus. We extend this bound to odd genus: for every $g\ge2$, positive $p$-rank implies $|\Aut(X)|<900g^2$. Starting from Montanucci's two-short-orbit reduction, we combine ramification estimates and a minimum-genus argument to reduce a counterexample to an almost-simple group acting on a cover of the projective line with two branch points. The main ingredients are an intrinsic description of the second ramification group via Hasse--Arf and genus bounds for intermediate quotients associated with parabolic subgroups. These, together with order and local-structure estimates, exclude every possible simple socle. The proof uses the classification of finite simple groups.

AI.tldr: 该论文将Giulietti–Korchmáros关于偶亏格曲线的二次亏格界（常数900）推广到奇亏格情形：对任意g≥2，若曲线具有正p-秩，则|Aut(X)|<900g²。证明经由Montanucci的两短轨道归约，结合分歧估计与最小亏格论证，将反例化为作用在射影直线上、仅两个分支点的几乎单群覆叠，并用Hasse–Arf的第二分歧群描述、中间商亏格界及阶与局部结构估计排除所有可能的单基座，最终依赖有限单群分类。
AI.motivation: Giulietti与Korchmáros此前建立了常数900的二次亏格界，可在偶亏格情形强制p-秩为零；该结果未覆盖奇亏格。本文旨在把这一界推广到所有亏格g≥2，给出正p-秩条件下自同构群阶的统一上界。
AI.method: 从Montanucci的两短轨道归约出发，结合分歧估计与最小亏格论证，将潜在反例约化为几乎单群作用于射影直线上的两分支点覆叠。核心技术包括：用Hasse–Arf不变量对第二分歧群作内蕴描述，对与抛物子群相关的中间商给出亏格界，并配合群阶与局部结构估计。证明中使用了有限单群分类。
AI.result: 对任意亏格g≥2的非奇异射影曲线（奇特征代数闭域上），正p-秩蕴含|Aut(X)|<900g²。该界对偶亏格与奇亏格一致成立，将Giulietti–Korchmáros的结果完整推广。
AI.conclusion: 在奇特征代数闭域上，正p-秩曲线的自同构群阶被900g²统一控制；证明通过将反例归约为两分支点的几乎单群覆叠并逐一排除可能的单基座实现，表明该二次界与亏格奇偶性无关。

title: Singular parameters and missing limits in neural PDE solvers
summary: Neural solvers for partial differential equations (PDEs) can approach an accurate solution while their parameters grow without bound. In such cases, the limiting solution may have no finite representation in the chosen model, leaving the best loss unattained. Our analysis connects missing limits in deep neural tanh- networks to unbounded hidden parameters or increasingly redundant neurons. For a class of models built from translated kernels, we describe the missing functions and recover them by adding kernel derivatives to the model. This completion makes the best approximation attainable under standard assumptions. Numerical studies follow the associated parameter growth and explore how completion affects PDE optimization.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨深度tanh网络求解PDE时因参数无界导致极限解无法被有限表示的问题，通过补充核导数恢复缺失函数，使最优逼近可达。
AI.motivation: 神经PDE求解器在参数无界增长时，其极限解可能无法在所选模型中有限表示，导致最优损失不可达，需要刻画并修复这一缺失极限问题。
AI.method: 将深度神经tanh网络的缺失极限与隐藏参数无界或神经元冗余增加联系起来；针对由平移核构成的一类模型，刻画缺失函数，并通过在模型中加入核导数来恢复它们。
AI.result: 该补全使最优逼近在标准假设下可达；数值研究跟踪了相关参数增长，并考察了补全对PDE优化的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过核导数补全模型可修复缺失极限，使最优逼近可达，并影响PDE优化过程。

title: Homogenization of some viscous Hamilton--Jacobi equations using variational arguments on probability spaces
summary: This work studies the asymptotic behavior of a class of viscous Hamilton--Jacobi equations with oscillatory periodic potentials, already studied by other authors in the PDE framework, and described in terms of an effective Hamiltonian. A novel variational approach is introduced, based on the classical stochastic control representation involving a Brownian motion, which allows the problem to be reformulated in terms of functionals defined on probability spaces. The core result is the identification of a homogenized Lagrangian obtained via a $Γ$-convergence procedure adapted to random processes, where filtrations and Brownian motions are treated as variables. The effective Hamiltonian is then recovered as the Legendre transform of this homogenized Lagrangian. The analysis provides both lower and upper bounds by means of blow-up arguments and the construction of stochastic correctors, yielding a complete characterization of the homogenized limit. This approach allows for a stability result with respect to the addition of some localized defects embedded in the periodic background.

AI.tldr: 本文用变分方法研究带振荡周期势的粘性Hamilton–Jacobi方程的渐近行为，通过在概率空间上定义泛函并引入随机过程版本的Γ-收敛，得到均质化Lagrangian，其Legendre变换即为有效Hamiltonian，并给出带有局部缺陷时的稳定性结果。
AI.motivation: 该类粘性Hamilton–Jacobi方程此前主要在PDE框架下、以有效Hamiltonian描述的方式被研究。作者希望引入一种新的变分视角，借助经典的Brownian运动随机控制表示，将问题重构到概率空间上的泛函层面，从而更本质地刻画均质化极限，并获得对局部缺陷的稳定性。
AI.method: 基于涉及Brownian运动的经典随机控制表示，把原问题改写为定义在概率空间上的泛函。核心是构造一种适用于随机过程的Γ-收敛程序，其中滤流与Brownian运动被视为变量，由此识别出均质化Lagrangian，并取其Legendre变换得到有效Hamiltonian。证明中利用blow-up论证给出下界，并通过构造随机校正子（stochastic correctors）给出上界。
AI.result: 通过下界与上界的匹配，完整刻画了均质化极限；有效Hamiltonian被恢复为均质化Lagrangian的Legendre变换；并由此得到一个关于在周期背景中嵌入局部缺陷的稳定性结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种基于随机控制与概率空间泛函的变分均质化框架，用随机过程版本的Γ-收敛统一处理周期势的振荡效应，完整刻画了均质化极限，并展示了方法对局部缺陷扰动的稳定性。

title: Beyond Masked Sparsity: SNACK Enables Truly Sparse Neural Networks on GPU
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/JafarBadour/Snack-SNN
summary: Deep neural networks continue to grow in parameter count, driving up training and inference cost on GPUs. Sparse neural networks and Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) promise to reduce these costs, but most implementations rely on binary masks over dense tensors and recover little of the theoretical compute, memory, or energy savings. We propose SNACK, a truly sparse GPU layer that stores and computes only non-zero connections. SNACK exposes a simple PyTorch API for restructuring connections and backpropagating gradients entirely in the sparse paradigm, and ships SNACK-COO, a custom COO-format SpMM CUDA kernel with a batch-to-Streaming-Multiprocessor mapping tuned for the small-batch, high-sparsity regime typical of large-model training and single-stream inference. At the kernel level, SNACK is up to 7x faster than the masked dense baseline (Dense+Mask) and competitive with cuSPARSE, Sputnik, and FlashSparse at 95% sparsity. At 90% sparsity, a single SNACK layer accelerates training by 8x and 3.7x, and inference by 4x and 2x, over Dense+Mask and fully dense layers, respectively, while using 72% less memory than dense and substantially less energy. End-to-end, SNACK reduces GPT-2 peak training memory by up to 40% and graph-style inference latency by 4.8x over Dense+Mask at 99% sparsity.

AI.tldr: 提出 SNACK，一种真正稀疏的 GPU 层，仅存储与计算非零连接，并配套自定义 COO 格式 SpMM CUDA 内核 SNACK-COO，在小批量、高稀疏场景下显著加速训练与推理并降低内存与能耗。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络参数量持续增长，推高 GPU 训练与推理成本。稀疏神经网络与动态稀疏训练（DST）虽可降低成本，但多数实现依赖稠密张量上的二值掩码，几乎无法兑现理论上的计算、内存与能耗节省。
AI.method: SNACK 是一个真正稀疏的 GPU 层，仅存储和计算非零连接，并提供简洁的 PyTorch API，在完全稀疏范式下重构连接与反向传播梯度；同时提出 SNACK-COO，一种自定义 COO 格式 SpMM CUDA 内核，采用批到 SM（Streaming Multiprocessor）的映射策略，针对大模型训练与单流推理常见的小批量、高稀疏度场景优化。
AI.result: 内核层面，在 95% 稀疏度下 SNACK 比掩码稠密基线（Dense+Mask）快至多 7 倍，并与 cuSPARSE、Sputnik、FlashSparse 相当。在 90% 稀疏度下，单个 SNACK 层训练相比 Dense+Mask 和全稠密层分别加速 8 倍与 3.7 倍，推理加速 4 倍与 2 倍，内存比稠密少 72%，能耗显著更低。端到端上，SNACK 在 99% 稀疏度下将 GPT-2 峰值训练内存最多降低 40%，图式推理延迟相比 Dense+Mask 降低 4.8 倍。
AI.conclusion: SNACK 通过真正的稀疏存储与计算及定制 CUDA 内核，在高稀疏度下实现了显著的训练/推理加速、内存与能耗节省，验证了稀疏范式在大型模型中的实际收益。

title: The Surrogate Is Not the Reward: Post-Surrogate Primary-Outcome Acquisition in Contextual Bandits
summary: We study contextual bandits in which a surrogate is observed after the action but before the learner decides whether to acquire the primary outcome that defines action value and regret. The value of acquiring the primary outcome depends on both decision relevance (how much the current outcome matters for comparing policies) and the residual uncertainty after observing the surrogate. The Audited Surrogate Bandit (ASB) learns a contextual policy while allocating a budget of $B$ primary-outcome acquisitions over $T$ rounds. ASB sets a pre-surrogate acquisition level from current decision relevance and, after observing the surrogate, redistributes that level using an estimate of that residual uncertainty. For a finite class of $N$ policies over $K$ actions, ASB incurs $\widetilde O[\sqrt{KT\log N}\{1+\sqrt{T/B}\}]$ regret relative to the best policy in the class. In a two-action family where the surrogate does not reveal the better action, a learner that observes the surrogate before deciding whether to acquire can achieve bounded regret, whereas any learner that must decide before seeing the surrogate incurs $Ω(T/B)$ worst-case regret under the same budget. Synthetic experiments show that both acquisition factors matter: ASB has lower regret than variants using only decision relevance or only residual uncertainty. On a KuaiRec benchmark of user-video interactions, the regret gap relative to relevance-only acquisition widens and then narrows as the budget grows.

AI.tldr: 研究在观察到替代指标后再决定是否获取主结果的上下文赌博机问题，提出 ASB 算法，兼顾决策相关性与残余不确定性来分配主结果获取预算，并给出遗憾上界与理论下界。
AI.motivation: 获取主结果（定义动作价值与遗憾）的代价高昂，而替代指标可在决策前观测；是否值得获取主结果取决于"决策相关性"与替代指标后的"残余不确定性"两个因素。现有方法往往只考虑其中之一。
AI.method: 提出 Audited Surrogate Bandit (ASB)：先依据当前决策相关性设定一个"替代指标前"的获取水平，观测替代指标后，再用对残余不确定性的估计重新分配该水平，从而在 T 轮内分配 B 次主结果获取预算并学习上下文策略。
AI.result: 对 N 个策略、K 个动作的有限策略类，ASB 遗憾为 Õ[√(KT log N)(1+√(T/B))]。在替代指标不揭示更优动作的两动作族中，先观测替代指标者可达有界遗憾，而必须先决策者最坏情形遗憾为 Ω(T/B)。实验显示两个获取因子都重要，ASB 优于仅用相关性或仅用残余不确定性的变体；KuaiRec 基准上相对"仅相关性"获取的遗憾差距随预算先扩大后收窄。
AI.conclusion: 在替代指标可先行观测的场景下，将决策相关性与残余不确定性结合用于获取预算分配是必要的，可实现近最优遗憾并显著优于单因子方案。

title: Chebyshev-Exact Acceleration under Hessian Variation, II: Computer-Assisted Variational Lower Bound
summary:
