As an application, we deduce the $\mathbb{A}^1$-connectedness of moduli stack of quasi-parabolic symplectic vector bundles with forms valued in a fixed line bundle.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了固定行列式半稳定向量丛模叠的 $\mathbb{A}^1$-连通性等价于其存在 $k$-有理点，并进一步得到辛丛模叠及拟抛物辛丛模叠的 $\mathbb{A}^1$-连通性。
AI.motivation: 研究代数曲线上的模叠在 $\mathbb{A}^1$-同伦意义下的连通性，将经典模空间几何与 $\mathbb{A}^1$-代数拓扑联系起来，并推广到辛丛等结构群情形。
AI.method: 使用 Langton 的初等修改（elementary modifications）方法，将其推广到族（families）的层面上来处理向量丛。
AI.result: 在无限域 $k$ 上的几何不可约光滑射影曲线上，固定行列式半稳定向量丛模叠 $\mathbb{A}^1$-连通当且仅当该模叠有 $k$-有理点；并在 $g\ge 2$ 且 $C(k)\neq\emptyset$ 时证明取值于固定线丛 $L$ 的辛丛模叠 $\mathbb{A}^1$-连通。
AI.conclusion: 作为应用，导出取值于固定线丛的拟抛物辛向量丛模叠具有 $\mathbb{A}^1$-连通性。

title: Path-Space Optimal Transport with Interactions: Kinetic Equations and Eikonal Structure
summary: We study a dynamical optimal transport problem on path-space with kinetic cost and nonlocal interaction. For a Gaussian interaction kernel, cyclical monotonicity and the regularity of the effective endpoint cost yield a conservative vector field associated with the initial momentum of the optimal trajectories. Separately, the Gaussian interaction potential $W_{π_0}$ satisfies a uniform gradient estimate and, under a quantitative condition on the interaction strength, is a classical and hence viscosity subsolution of an eikonal equation. We also derive the Euler--Lagrange dynamics directly from path-space optimality by means of endpoint-preserving perturbations of the optimal path measure. The associated phase-space marginals satisfy a measure-valued Liouville-type, or nonlocal kinetic, equation driven by the smooth Gaussian self-consistent force. Conversely, a superposition principle lifts suitable measure-valued solutions of the phase-space continuity equation to measures on phase-space trajectories. Thus path-space optimal transport provides a variational connection between endpoint geometry, eikonal behavior of the Gaussian interaction potential, and kinetic mean-field dynamics.

AI.tldr: 研究带动力学代价与非局部相互作用的路径空间动态最优传输问题。对高斯相互作用核，利用循环单调性与端点代价正则性构造保守向量场，并证明高斯相互作用势在相互作用强度定量条件下为程函方程的粘性下解；由路径空间最优性导出Euler–Lagrange动力学与相空间上的非局部动力学Liouville方程，并通过叠加原理建立反问题。
AI.motivation: 将路径空间动态最优传输与端点几何、程函方程行为及动力学平均场动力学联系起来，为高斯非局部相互作用下的最优轨迹提供变分刻画。
AI.method: 在路径空间上研究含动力学代价与非局部相互作用的动态最优传输；对高斯相互作用核，利用循环单调性和有效端点代价正则性构造与初始动量相关的保守向量场；证明高斯相互作用势满足一致梯度估计，并在相互作用强度定量条件下是程函方程的经典解从而也是粘性下解；通过保持端点的路径测度扰动，从路径空间最优性直接推导Euler–Lagrange动力学。
AI.result: 得到与最优轨迹初始动量关联的保守向量场；证明高斯相互作用势W_{π_0}的一致梯度估计及程函方程粘性下解性质；导出Euler–Lagrange动力学；相空间边缘测度满足由光滑高斯自洽力驱动的测度值Liouville型（非局部动力学）方程；并借助叠加原理将相空间连续性方程的合适测度值解提升为相空间轨迹上的测度。
AI.conclusion: 路径空间最优传输为端点几何、高斯相互作用势的程函行为与动力学平均场动力学之间提供了变分联系。

title: Consideration Circuits: Depth Separation and Universality Beyond a Single Softmax
summary: Most feature-based choice models, classical and deep, score items and apply a single softmax. We introduce consideration circuits (CC), feature-based models of multi-stage choice defined by directed acyclic graphs of multinomial logit (MNL) units. Source units assign probabilities to menu items, and internal units combine predecessor distributions using MNL weights computed from their probability-weighted feature summaries. On a three-item compromise task with fixed non-collinear features, menu-independent random-utility models (RUM), including a single MNL unit, suffer an error bounded away from zero. For CC, in contrast, we establish a sharp depth--norm separation: increasing depth from $2$ to $3$ reduces the optimal maximum taste-vector norm for error $ε$ from $Θ(\log(1/ε)/ε)$ to $Θ(\log(1/ε))$. The depth-$2$ lower bound holds for arbitrary width and menu-independent routing biases, while a five-node depth-$3$ circuit with zero routing biases attains the logarithmic rate. More generally, we characterize two geometric conditions that are necessary and sufficient for approximating arbitrary deterministic choice tables on finite menu families. Under these conditions, depth $3$ suffices, while depth $4$ achieves optimal logarithmic norm scaling whenever the family contains a non-singleton menu. In experiments, standalone tree circuits with fewer than $600$ parameters attain the lowest mean test negative log-likelihood (NLL) among the evaluated models on four fixed-pool benchmarks and the Expedia temporal split. As output heads, CC generalize the linear MNL readout and lower mean test NLL for every tested encoder on Expedia and Trivago.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"考虑电路"(CC)：由MNL单元构成的有向无环图定义的多阶段特征型选择模型。在固定特征的三项折中任务上，证明深度从2增至3可将达到误差ε所需最优口味向量范数从Θ(log(1/ε)/ε)降至Θ(log(1/ε))，并给出可逼近任意确定性选择表的充要几何条件。实验显示少于600参数的树形电路在多个基准上取得最低测试NLL。
AI.motivation: 传统特征型选择模型（无论经典还是深度）通常对候选项打分后施加单一softmax，属于菜单无关的随机效用模型，无法表达依赖菜单构成的折中效应等情境依赖行为。作者希望构建能够刻画多阶段、情境依赖选择过程的特征型模型，并从理论上刻画其表达能力与复杂度优势。
AI.method: 将选择过程建模为由多项式logit(MNL)单元构成的有向无环图：源单元为菜单项分配概率，内部单元用基于概率加权特征摘要计算出的MNL权重来组合前驱分布。在固定非共线特征的三项折中任务上，分析深度—范数分离；进一步刻画逼近有限菜单族上任意确定性选择表的两个几何充要条件；在四个固定池基准与Expedia时间划分上训练少于600参数的树形电路，并作为输出头替换线性MNL读出。
AI.result: 建立了尖锐的深度—范数分离：深度2到3使误差ε所需最优最大口味向量范数从Θ(log(1/ε)/ε)降到Θ(log(1/ε))；深度2下界对任意宽度和菜单无关路由偏置成立，而零路由偏置的五节点深度3电路可达对数速率。满足两个几何条件时深度3足够，深度4在菜单族含非单元素菜单时达到最优对数范数缩放。实验中树形电路在四个固定池基准及Expedia时间划分上取得最低平均测试NLL；作为输出头时在Expedia与Trivago上对每个测试编码器均降低平均测试NLL。
AI.conclusion: 考虑电路通过多阶段MNL组合突破了单softmax菜单无关RUM的表达瓶颈，并能以极小参数量获得更优的拟合与泛化表现，兼具理论表征力与实用价值。

title: Drop, Swap, and Generate: A Self-Supervised Approach for Generating Neural Activity
summary: Meaningful and simplified representations of neural activity can yield insights into how and what information is being processed within a neural circuit. However, without labels, finding representations that reveal the link between the brain and behavior can be challenging. Here, we introduce a novel unsupervised approach for learning disentangled representations of neural activity called Swap-VAE. Our approach combines a generative modeling framework with an instance-specific alignment loss that tries to maximize the representational similarity between transformed views of the input (brain state). These transformed (or augmented) views are created by dropping out neurons and jittering samples in time, which intuitively should lead the network to a representation that maintains both temporal consistency and invariance to the specific neurons used to represent the neural state. Through evaluations on both synthetic data and neural recordings from hundreds of neurons in different primate brains, we show that it is possible to build representations that disentangle neural datasets along relevant latent dimensions linked to behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出无监督解耦表示学习方法 Swap-VAE，通过在生成模型中加入实例对齐损失，最大化输入脑状态不同增强视图间的表示相似性，从而在无标签条件下学习与行为相关的神经活动解耦表示。
AI.motivation: 神经活动的有意义且简化的表示有助于理解神经回路中处理的信息，但在缺乏标签的情况下，难以找到能够揭示大脑与行为之间联系的表示。因此需要一种无监督方法来学习解耦的神经表示。
AI.method: Swap-VAE 将生成建模框架与实例特定的对齐损失相结合。该损失通过创建输入（脑状态）的变换视图并最大化其表示相似性来训练网络。变换（增强）操作包括随机丢弃神经元和在时间上抖动样本，从而引导网络学习既保持时间一致性、又对用于表示神经状态的具体神经元具有不变性的表示。
AI.result: 在合成数据以及来自不同灵长类大脑中数百个神经元的神经记录上评估，表明可以构建出沿与行为相关的潜在维度解耦神经数据集的表示。
AI.conclusion: Swap-VAE 是一种有效的无监督解耦表示学习方法，可在无标签条件下从神经活动中提取与行为相关的潜在维度表示。

title: An Inexact Halpern-accelerated Preconditioned Generalized Proximal Point Algorithm for the Maximal Monotone Inclusion Problem
summary: This paper studies an inexact Halpern-accelerated generalized proximal point algorithm with an admissible positive semidefinite preconditioner $\mathcal{M}$ for solving maximal monotone inclusion problems. The proposed framework combines Halpern anchoring, resolvent inexactness, and relaxation over the full weight range $ρ\in(0,2]$, thereby covering both under-relaxed and over-relaxed proximal iterations within a unified scheme. We first establish convergence of the inexact resolvent sequence under conditions that allow general anchoring parameters and certain nonsummable tolerances. For anchoring parameters $β_{k}=1/(k+r)$ with $r\geq2$, we then derive explicit bounds on the squared fixed-point residual in the $\mathcal{M}$-seminorm. In particular, if the tolerances satisfy $\varepsilon_{k}=\mathcal{O}((k+1)^{-α})$ with $α>3/2$ for $0<ρ<2$ and $α>2$ for $ρ=2$, these bounds yield an $\mathcal{O}(1/k^{2})$ convergence rate. The stronger decay condition on the inexactness tolerances at $ρ=2$ highlights a qualitative distinction between the endpoint and the interior regime in the inexact setting. Finally, we develop inexact accelerated versions of the preconditioned alternating direction method of multipliers (pADMM) and the preconditioned primal--dual hybrid gradient (PDHG) method based on this framework, derive inexactness criteria based on subproblem residuals, and establish a nonergodic $\mathcal{O}(1/k)$ KKT residual rate for their inexact iterates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带半正定预条件子的非精确Halpern加速广义邻近点算法，用于求解极大单调包含问题。在统一框架下结合Halpern锚定、预解算子非精确性与全权重松弛ρ∈(0,2]，证明收敛性，并在β_k=1/(k+r)（r≥2）时给出M-半范数下平方不动点残差的显式界，进而得到O(1/k²)收敛率；最后构建预条件ADMM与PDHG的非精确加速版本并建立非遍历O(1/k) KKT残差率。
AI.motivation: 邻近点类算法在求极大单调包含问题时，预解算子通常难以精确求解，且迭代加速与松弛参数的选取对收敛速率有显著影响。现有工作尚缺乏在非精确设定下统一处理Halpern锚定、全范围松弛与预条件的一般框架，也缺少对端点松弛（ρ=2）与内部松弛（0<ρ<2）之间定性差异的刻画，以及对ADMM/PDHG等具体算法的非精确加速理论保证。
AI.method: 提出带可容许半正定预条件子M的非精确Halpern加速广义邻近点算法。框架融合三项机制：(1) Halpern锚定项；(2) 预解算子非精确性（容差ε_k）；(3) 覆盖0<ρ≤2全权重范围的松弛，统一包含欠松弛与过松弛迭代。先在允许一般锚定参数与某类不可和容差的条件下证明非精确预解序列的收敛性；再针对β_k=1/(k+r)、r≥2，推导M-半范数下平方不动点残差的显式上界。随后基于该框架发展预条件交替方向乘子法（pADMM）与预条件原始-对偶混合梯度法（PDHG）的非精确加速版本，并依据子问题残差给出非精确性判定准则。
AI.result: 证明了非精确预解序列在一般锚定参数与不可和容差下的收敛性。对β_k=1/(k+r)（r≥2）给出M-半范数平方不动点残差显式界：当容差ε_k=O((k+1)^(-α))，且0<ρ<2时α>3/2、ρ=2时α>2，该界导出O(1/k²)收敛率。ρ=2处需更强的容差衰减条件，揭示非精确设定下端点与内部区域的定性区别。对导出的非精确加速pADMM与PDHG，基于子问题残差建立非精确性准则，并证明非精确迭代的非遍历O(1/k) KKT残差率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为非精确加速邻近点类方法提供了统一理论与速率保证：通过Halpern锚定、预解非精确性与全范围松弛的结合，在可容许半正定预条件下获得O(1/k²)的收敛率，并刻画了ρ=2端点相对内部松弛对容差衰减的更高要求；同时将框架落地到pADMM与PDHG，给出可验证的非精确性准则与非遍历O(1/k) KKT残差率，为大规模包含问题的非精确加速求解提供理论支撑。

title: ON THE DISTANCE TO DISCRIMINANTS AND OSCULATING VARIETIES
summary: We study the problem of finding the closest singular hypersurface to a given nonsingular one from algebro-geometric point of view. The set of singular hypersurfaces $Ξ$ of a given degree is a projective variety dual to the Veronese variety. However, as was shown by Raffalli [Raf14], the Bombieri-Weyl (also known as apolar) distance from a general real hypersurface to $Ξ$ could be minimized at a singular point of $Ξ$. We study the singular locus of $Ξ$ and its irreducible component, consisting of hypersurfaces with cuspidal singularities. This variety is projectively dual to the tangential variety of the Veronese variety. We compute its Euclidean Distance Degree using topological tools and deduce a formula for the number of critical points of the distance function to $Ξ$ from a general hypersurface. We also initiate the study of the analogous problem for higher osculating varieties to the Veronese variety. Furthermore, we establish a new extremal property of Chebyshev polynomials (conjectured in [Raf14]) by characterizing real-rooted binary forms that maximize the distance to $Ξ$.

AI.tldr: 该文从代数几何视角研究从一般实超曲面到奇异超曲面集合Ξ的距离极小化问题，重点分析Ξ的奇异轨迹（尖点超曲面分量），计算其欧氏距离度，并得到距离函数临界点数目公式；同时研究Veronese簇的高阶密切簇的类似问题，并证明Raffalli猜想的一个Chebyshev多项式的极值性质。
AI.motivation: Raffalli指出一般实超曲面到奇异超曲面集合Ξ的Bombieri-Weyl（apolar）距离可能在Ξ的奇异点处取极小，因此仅研究Ξ本身不足以刻画最近奇异超曲面；需要深入理解Ξ的奇异轨迹及其分量的几何结构，以正确计数距离函数的临界点并刻画极值情形。
AI.method: 作者采用代数几何与拓扑工具：将奇异超曲面集合Ξ视为Veronese簇的对偶射影簇，研究Ξ的奇异轨迹中由尖点奇异超曲面构成的不可约分量（该分量对偶于Veronese簇的切触簇/tangential variety）；计算该分量的欧氏距离度（Euclidean Distance Degree），并推广到Veronese簇的高阶密切簇；此外通过刻画使到Ξ的距离最大化的实根二元型来建立Chebyshev多项式的新极值性质。
AI.result: 计算出了对偶于Veronese簇切触簇的尖点超曲面分量的欧氏距离度，并由此导出一般超曲面到Ξ的距离函数临界点数目的公式；启动了对Veronese簇高阶密切簇的类似距离问题的研究；证明了[Raf14]中猜想的一个Chebyshev多项式极值性质，刻画出最大化到Ξ距离的实根二元型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将奇异超曲面的最近距离问题与Veronese簇的对偶/切触几何及欧氏距离度理论联系起来，给出了临界点计数公式并验证了相关猜想，为研究高阶密切簇的距离问题提供了框架。

title: Inferring physical fields in coupled systems with unknown parameters from incomplete observations using physics-constrained attentive neural operators
summary: Given incomplete measurements of a single physical field in a coupled system with unknown parameters, can we infer its full physical state and identify the underlying parameters? This problem is challenging because multiple coupled fields must be reconstructed simultaneously from limited observations of only one, while the system parameters are unknown. In this work, we propose a machine learning framework for full-field reconstruction and parameter identification of unknown physical systems from sparse observations of a single physical field. Specifically, the cross-attention encoder propagates sparse sensor observations onto a regular grid to construct a sensor-conditioned latent representation, while a Fourier neural operator (FNO) decoder captures global spatial dependencies to reconstruct all coupled physical fields. The network parameters and unknown physical parameters are jointly optimized by minimizing observation losses, governing equation residuals, and boundary/initial condition constraints. The proposed approach is validated on two- and three-dimensional lid-driven cavity flows, a two-dimensional cylinder wake, and a two-dimensional non-ideal magnetohydrodynamics problem, demonstrating the recovery performance of unobserved fields and physical parameters from incomplete observations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种机器学习框架，可仅凭单一物理场的稀疏观测，重建耦合系统中所有场的完整状态并辨识未知物理参数。
AI.motivation: 耦合系统中多个耦合场需同时重建，但观测仅来自单一物理场且系统参数未知，传统方法难以处理这种欠定、不适定问题。
AI.method: 采用交叉注意力编码器将稀疏传感器观测映射到规则网格，生成以传感器为条件的隐表示；用Fourier神经算子（FNO）解码器捕捉全局空间依赖以重建所有耦合场；联合优化网络参数与未知物理参数，损失包含观测损失、控制方程残差及边界/初始条件约束。
AI.result: 在二维与三维驱动方腔流、二维圆柱尾流以及二维非理想磁流体力学问题上验证，能够从不完整观测中恢复未观测场及物理参数。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了从单一物理场稀疏观测出发的全场重建与参数辨识，具备跨维度、跨物理系统的泛化能力。

title: Scattering of non-radial solutions for the fourth-order Schrödinger equation with $\dot{H}^{1/2}$-critical and supercritical nonlinearity

AI.tldr: 本文证明聚焦非线性四阶薛定谔方程在质量-能量空间下低于基态的非径向解具有散射性质，适用范围为 \(d\ge2\)、\(1+8/(d-1)\le p<1+8/(d-4)_+\)，从而将已有径向结果推广到非径向情形。
AI.motivation: 此前低于基态的散射结果（Guo 2016；Dinh 2021）仅在径向解情形下对 \(1+8/d<p<1+8/(d-4)_+\) 成立。非径向解缺乏径向对称带来的紧性优势，是主要困难，因此需要新工具来建立散射。
AI.method: 采用 Kenig--Merle（2006）的集中紧性论证。为处理非径向情形，沿与动量向量正交的方向使用 virial 恒等式，并利用 \(p\ge 1+8/(d-1)\) 保证该 virial 恒等式中所出现泛函的正性。
AI.result: 在 \(d\ge2\) 且 \(1+8/(d-1)\le p<1+8/(d-4)_+\) 范围内，证明了低于基态的非径向解具有散射性质，推广了已有径向散射结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过正交于动量方向的 virial 恒等式与集中紧性方法，成功克服非径向解缺少对称性的困难，实现了低于基态散射结论从径向到非径向的推广，其代价是 \(p\) 的下界由 \(1+8/d\) 提高为 \(1+8/(d-1)\)。

title: You May Be Running the Wrong Inception Crop
summary: A decade after its inception, Inception crop has become the standard crop-based data augmentation method for training deep vision models. Not only is its practice of uniformly sampling crop scale and aspect ratio widely adopted, but also its lower and upper bounds, with the scale lower bound being the sole exception that is sometimes tuned. It is therefore surprising that the standard implementation in the TensorFlow / JAX ecosystem samples crop scale with probability density function $f(A) \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{A}}$ unlike the PyTorch counterpart, which follows the original description. Motivated by this discovery, we train 522 ViT-S/16 models on the ImageNet-1k dataset with various training budgets and crop scale distributions. We reach $78.78\pm0.09$ top-1 val. accuracy with 90 epochs of training budget and find that 1. Higher training budget requires stronger augmentation; 2. Lower tail of the distribution of the crop scale determines the augmentation strength of Inception crop; 3. Models trained with higher training budget exhibit sparser saliency, regardless of the crop scale distribution or weight decay. Based on 2. we revisit the performance of Beta crop, whose softer cutoff allows it to optimize model performance across training budgets with less compromise. We replicate 1. and 3. with Scion optimizer in addition to AdamW, suggesting that the results may be general.

AI.tldr: 本文发现TensorFlow/JAX与PyTorch的Inception crop实现存在尺度分布不一致，通过522个ViT-S/16模型实验揭示训练预算、裁剪尺度分布下尾与增强强度、显著性稀疏性的规律，并据此改进Beta crop。
AI.motivation: Inception crop已成为视觉模型训练的标准数据增强方法，其均匀采样的做法与上下界被广泛采用，但作者发现TensorFlow/JAX生态中的标准实现使用f(A)∝1/√A的尺度概率密度，与PyTorch按原始描述的实现不同，这一实现分歧促使作者系统研究裁剪尺度分布对训练的影响。
AI.method: 在ImageNet-1k上训练522个ViT-S/16模型，覆盖不同训练预算与多种crop尺度分布，并在AdamW之外使用Scion优化器进行验证性复现。
AI.result: 在90 epochs训练预算下达到78.78±0.09 top-1验证准确率；发现：(1)更高训练预算需要更强增强；(2)crop尺度分布的下尾决定Inception crop的增强强度；(3)高训练预算模型呈现更稀疏的显著性，与crop尺度分布和权重衰减无关。基于结论(2)重新评估Beta crop，其更软的截断可在不同训练预算下以更小代价优化性能，并在Scion优化器上复现了结论(1)和(3)。
AI.conclusion: Inception crop的实现差异（尺度分布）显著影响增强强度与模型表现，裁剪尺度分布的下尾是控制增强强度的关键因素，Beta crop因更软的截断在不同训练预算下更具鲁棒性；相关规律在AdamW与Scion优化器下均成立，具有一定普适性。

title: Adaptive Multi-Goal Exploration
summary: We introduce a generic strategy for provably efficient multi-goal exploration. It relies on AdaGoal, a novel goal selection scheme that leverages a measure of uncertainty in reaching states to adaptively target goals that are neither too difficult nor too easy. We show how AdaGoal can be used to tackle the objective of learning an $ε$-optimal goal-conditioned policy for the (initially unknown) set of goal states that are reachable within $L$ steps in expectation from a reference state $s_0$ in a reward-free Markov decision process. In the tabular case with $S$ states and $A$ actions, our algorithm requires $\tilde{O}(L^3 S A ε^{-2})$ exploration steps, which is nearly minimax optimal. We also readily instantiate AdaGoal in linear mixture Markov decision processes, yielding the first goal-oriented PAC guarantee with linear function approximation. Beyond its strong theoretical guarantees, we anchor AdaGoal in goal-conditioned deep reinforcement learning, both conceptually and empirically, by connecting its idea of selecting "uncertain" goals to maximizing value ensemble disagreement.

AI.tldr: 提出通用多目标探索策略AdaGoal，通过不确定性度量自适应选取难易适中的目标，在表格型与线性混合MDP中实现近乎最优的探索复杂度，并给出首个线性函数逼近下的目标导向PAC保证，同时与深度强化学习中的价值集成分歧最大化建立联系。
AI.motivation: 多目标探索中目标选择至关重要：目标过难则难以获得有效学习信号，过易则无法推动探索。现有方法缺乏可证明高效的通用目标选择机制，且缺乏在函数逼近下的理论保证。
AI.method: 提出AdaGoal目标选择方案，利用到达状态的不确定性度量来自适应地选取"既不过难也不过易"的目标。将其用于在无奖励MDP中学习ε-最优目标条件策略，目标为从参考状态s0出发在期望L步内可达的目标状态集合。在表格型情形和线性混合MDP中分别实例化该算法，并通过价值集成分歧最大化将其与深度目标条件强化学习相连接。
AI.result: 在含S个状态、A个动作的表格型情形下，算法需要Õ(L³SAε⁻²)步探索，接近极小极大最优；在线性混合MDP中给出首个目标导向的PAC保证，支持线性函数逼近。同时在概念与实验层面验证了AdaGoal与深度目标条件强化学习中价值集成分歧最大化的一致性。
AI.conclusion: AdaGoal为多目标探索提供了通用且可证明高效的框架，兼具理论最优性与实践可迁移性，将不确定性驱动的目标选择与集成分歧方法统一起来。

title: Learning to Solve Mixed-Integer Nonlinear Programming with Neural Networks and Sequential Quadratic Programming Refinement
summary: We propose a learning-to-optimize framework for solving parametric mixed-integer nonlinear programs arising in model predictive control and trajectory optimization. The proposed method combines neural network prediction with a sequential quadratic programming (SQP) refinement layer. First, neural networks are trained using a combination of supervised and self-supervised losses to predict integer solutions together with compatible continuous warm starts. To account for prediction inaccuracies, the trained predictor generates multiple candidate integer solutions, each paired with a continuous initialization. The integer solutions are then fixed, and a differentiable SQP layer refines the associated continuous variables over a prescribed number of iterations. The SQP-layer parameters, including the curvature regularization and step size, are trained to improve both feasibility and objective value after every iteration. By separating integer prediction from continuous optimization-based refinement, the proposed framework improves robustness to imperfect neural predictions while maintaining a predictable computational budget. We demonstrate the proposed framework on contact and trajectory optimization for a planar box-pushing example.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"神经预测 + 可微SQP精修"的学习优化框架,用于求解MPC与轨迹优化中的参数化混合整数非线性规划,提升对预测误差的鲁棒性并保持可预测的计算开销。
AI.motivation: 参数化混合整数非线性规划在模型预测控制与轨迹优化中广泛出现,但其整数变量与连续变量耦合,求解通常计算昂贵;纯神经网络端到端预测又对预测误差敏感、缺乏可靠性与计算预算保证,因此需要兼顾鲁棒性与效率的求解方法。
AI.method: 框架分三步:(1) 用监督损失与自监督损失联合训练神经网络,同时预测整数解及相容的连续变量热启动;(2) 为应对预测不准确,训练后的预测器生成多个候选整数解,每个候选配一个连续初始化;(3) 固定整数解,用可微SQP层对相应连续变量做指定迭代次数的精修,并将SQP层参数(曲率正则化与步长)训练为在每次迭代后同时改善可行性与目标值。其核心思想是将整数预测与连续优化精修解耦。
AI.result: 在平面推箱(planar box-pushing)的接触与轨迹优化任务上验证了所提框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将整数预测与基于优化的连续精修分离,可在神经网络预测不完美时仍保持鲁棒性,并获得可预测的计算预算,适用于接触与轨迹优化等参数化MINLP场景。

title: Borel subgroups of the automorphism group of an affine variety
summary: We study Borel subgroups of the automorphism group of an affine variety X and their associated Lie algebras. We prove a bijective correspondence between the set of Borel subgroups of Aut(X) and the set of maximal nested unipotent subgroups of Aut(X). We show that if X is factorial of dimension at most 3, then the Lie algebra of every maximal nested unipotent subgroup has the special property of being what we call "integral"; we also show that this fails for X = affine space of dimension > 3. As an application of our results, we show that Nagata's automorphism is contained in a unique Borel subgroup.

AI.tldr: 研究仿射簇自同构群的Borel子群及其李代数，建立Borel子群与极大嵌套单能子群的双射，证明维数≤3的阶乘簇满足"整性"，并给出Nagata自同构的Borel唯一性应用。
AI.motivation: 刻画仿射簇自同构群Aut(X)的Borel子群结构及其李代数性质，厘清Borel子群与单能子群之间的关系，并探索这些代数结构性质对维数的依赖性。
AI.method: 研究Aut(X)的Borel子群及对应李代数；建立Borel子群集合与极大嵌套单能子群集合之间的双射对应；考察维数≤3的阶乘仿射簇的李代数"整性"（integral）性质，并与维数>3的仿射空间作反例对比。
AI.result: 证明了Borel子群与极大嵌套单能子群之间的双射；当X为维数≤3的阶乘簇时，每个极大嵌套单能子群的李代数具有"整性"；当X为维数>3的仿射空间时该性质不成立。
AI.conclusion: Aut(X)的Borel子群与极大嵌套单能子群存在一一对应；李代数的整性在低维阶乘簇成立但在高维仿射空间失效；作为应用，Nagata自同构包含在唯一的Borel子群中。

title: The influence of a Generalized Hardy-Type Potential on Finite Morse Index Solutions of the Hénon Problem: Local and Nonlocal Cases
summary:
In this paper, we investigate nonexistence results for stable solutions of the semilinear elliptic problem $$(-Δ)^s u+λ|x|^αu=|x|^β|u|^{p-1}u \; \mbox{in}\; \mathcal{H}, $$ where $\mathcal{H}=\mathbb{R}^n$ or $\mathcal{H}=\mathbb{R}^n_+=\{x=(x',x_n),\, x'\in\mathbb{R}^{n-1},x_n>0\}$ , with Dirichlet conditions in the half-space case. We assume that $n\geq2s$, $p>1$, $λ>0,$ $α, β>-2s$ and $0<s\leq1$.
  Our aim is to analyze the influence of the Hardy-type power potential $λ|x|^αu$ in the presence of the Hénon weight $|x|^β$, with particular emphasis on the existence and classification of weak stable solutions, including solutions that may be unbounded or sign-changing. We establish nonexistence results for nontrivial stable solutions and, more generally, for solutions that are stable outside a compact set, covering critical and supercritical regimes without additional assumptions, and the subcritical regime under a suitable $L ^\infty$-smallness condition on a weighted version of the solution. Our results apply to both the local case $s = 1$ and the nonlocal case $0 < s < 1 $, in the whole space and in the half-space.
  The proofs are based on energy estimates combined with a Pohozaev identity. In the supercritical regime, we further establish a monotonicity formula, following the approach of Dávila et al. (Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. 369, 6087-6104, 2017).

AI.tldr: 研究半线性椭圆问题(-\Delta)^s u+\lambda|x|^\alpha u=|x|^\beta|u|^{p-1}u在R^n或半空间中稳定解的不存在性，覆盖临界、超临界及部分次临界情形。
AI.motivation: 分析Hardy型幂势\lambda|x|^\alpha u与Hénon权|x|^\beta共同作用对弱稳定解（含无界、变号解）的存在性与分类的影响。
AI.method: 基于能量估计结合Pohozaev恒等式；在超临界情形进一步建立单调性公式，沿用Dávila等（2017）的方法。
AI.result: 对非平凡稳定解以及更一般的紧集外稳定解建立不存在性结果，临界与超临界情形无需附加假设，次临界情形在加权解的L^\infty小性条件下成立；结论同时适用于局部s=1与非局部0<s<1、全空间与半空间。
AI.conclusion: 在n\geq2s, p>1, \lambda>0, \alpha,\beta>-2s, 0<s\leq1条件下，Hardy势与Hénon权下稳定性排除了非平凡解，统一了局域与非局域框架。

title: How RL Reshapes LLM Reasoning: Transferability, Coverage, and Scaling Laws
summary: Recent studies on reinforcement learning (RL) report seemingly conflicting evidence about large language model (LLM) reasoning. Training on mathematics can improve performance in other domains, yet gains in Pass@1 can coincide with lower Pass@$N$ than the base model. This raises a fundamental question: does RL expand an LLM's reasoning boundary, or merely reweight its existing reasoning space? We revisit these phenomena across Qwen and Gemma model families, showing both cross-domain gains and forgetting, while coverage at large sampling budgets increases on some tasks and decreases on others. Detailed analysis of solution traces before and after RL indicates a shift in the reasoning strategies the model employs, motivating a two-stage autoregressive policy model that separates \emph{strategy selection} from problem-specific execution. Within this framework, we prove how RL's implicit bias reshapes strategy preferences, allowing gains on some tasks while suppressing strategies required by others. This mechanism can also broaden or narrow coverage at a given sampling budget even without expanding strategy support. We further provide theoretical justifications for log-sigmoid and log-linear scaling laws in RL compute, and evaluate their predictive power. Together, these results connect changes in strategy selection to cross-domain transfer, reasoning coverage, and compute scaling.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨RL究竟扩展还是仅重加权LLM的推理空间，通过Qwen/Gemma实验与两阶段策略模型理论，揭示RL隐式偏置对策略选择的 reshaping 机制。
AI.motivation: 近期强化学习研究对LLM推理给出了看似矛盾的证据：数学训练能提升其他领域表现，但Pass@1提升可能与低于基线的Pass@N并存。核心问题是RL究系扩展LLM推理边界，还是仅在其既有推理空间内重新加权。
AI.method: 在Qwen和Gemma模型族上复现相关现象，分析跨域收益与遗忘、大采样预算下覆盖度变化；对RL前后解题轨迹进行细粒度分析，提出将"策略选择"与"问题特定执行"分离的两阶段自回归策略模型，并在此框架下给出RL隐式偏置重塑策略偏好的形式化证明，以及对log-sigmoid与log-linear计算缩放律的理论论证与预测力评估。
AI.result: 观察到跨域收益与遗忘并存，大采样预算下覆盖度在部分任务上升、部分下降；解题轨迹显示RL后模型所用推理策略发生转移。理论证明RL隐式偏置会重塑策略偏好，从而在部分任务获益的同时抑制其他任务所需策略；该机制即便在策略支持集未扩展时也能扩大或缩小给定采样预算下的覆盖度。
AI.conclusion: RL主要通过对策略选择的隐式偏置改变模型行为，而非单纯扩展推理边界；这一机制统一解释了跨域迁移、推理覆盖度变化与计算缩放现象，为理解RL对LLM推理的作用提供了连贯框架。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
summary: Most deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms distill experience into parametric behavior policies or value functions via gradient updates. While effective, this approach has several disadvantages: (1) it is computationally expensive, (2) it can take many updates to integrate experiences into the parametric model, (3) experiences that are not fully integrated do not appropriately influence the agent's behavior, and (4) behavior is limited by the capacity of the model. In this paper we explore an alternative paradigm in which we train a network to map a dataset of past experiences to optimal behavior. Specifically, we augment an RL agent with a retrieval process (parameterized as a neural network) that has direct access to a dataset of experiences. This dataset can come from the agent's past experiences, expert demonstrations, or any other relevant source. The retrieval process is trained to retrieve information from the dataset that may be useful in the current context, to help the agent achieve its goal faster and more efficiently. he proposed method facilitates learning agents that at test-time can condition their behavior on the entire dataset and not only the current state, or current trajectory. We integrate our method into two different RL agents: an offline DQN agent and an online R2D2 agent. In offline multi-task problems, we show that the retrieval-augmented DQN agent avoids task interference and learns faster than the baseline DQN agent. On Atari, we show that retrieval-augmented R2D2 learns significantly faster than the baseline R2D2 agent and achieves higher scores. We run extensive ablations to measure the contributions of the components of our proposed method.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"检索增强强化学习"范式：为RL智能体配备一个可训练的神经网络检索过程，使其在决策时直接访问经验数据集（自身经历、专家演示等），从而在测试时可基于整个数据集而非仅当前状态/轨迹来条件化行为。
AI.motivation: 主流深度RL通过梯度更新将经验蒸馏进参数化策略或价值函数。该方式存在四类缺陷：(1)计算开销大；(2)需多次更新才能将经验整合进参数模型；(3)未被充分整合的经验无法恰当影响行为；(4)行为受模型容量限制。作者希望摆脱这一范式局限。
AI.method: 训练一个网络将"过去经验数据集"映射到最优行为。具体做法是为RL智能体增加一个以神经网络参数化的检索过程，该过程可直接访问经验数据集（可来自智能体历史经验、专家演示或其他相关来源）；检索过程被训练以从数据集中检索对当前情境有用的信息，帮助智能体更快、更高效地达成目标。方法被集成到两种RL智能体中：离线DQN与在线R2D2。
AI.result: 在离线多任务问题上，检索增强的DQN避免了任务干扰，且比基线DQN学习更快；在Atari上，检索增强的R2D2比基线R2D2学习显著更快并获得更高分数。作者还进行了大量消融实验以衡量各组成部分的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强提供了一种替代参数化蒸馏的RL范式，使智能体在测试时可基于整个经验数据集进行条件化决策，在多任务离线场景与Atari在线场景中均优于基线，且各组件贡献经消融验证。

title: Dimension-Free Decentralized Nonsmooth Nonconvex Stochastic Optimization
summary: We investigate decentralized nonsmooth nonconvex stochastic optimization over a network of $n$ nodes, with the goal of finding an $(δ,ε)$-Goldstein stationary point. The best existing algorithm achieves $O(δ^{-1}(ε^{-3}+dε^{-1}))$ sample complexity and $\widetilde{O}(γ^{-1/2}δ^{-1}(ε^{-3}+dε^{-1}))$ communication complexity, where $d$ is the problem dimension and $γ$ is the spectral gap of the communication matrix. However, the polynomial dependence on $d$ can be a major bottleneck in high-dimensional regimes. In this paper, we propose a novel algorithm that achieves $O(δ^{-1}ε^{-3})$ sample complexity and $\widetilde{O}(γ^{-1/2}δ^{-1}ε^{-3})$ communication complexity. The primary technique is an elegant decentralized online-to-nonconvex conversion that reduces the original problem to a decentralized online convex optimization (D-OCO) problem. A key property of our conversion is that its consensus requirements can be inherited directly from the consensus of the underlying D-OCO decisions. In particular, this property enables us to establish an explicit connection between the dimension dependence and the consensus error, which in turn shows that the polynomial dependence on $d$ can be removed with only logarithmic additional communication.

AI.tldr: 本文研究网络上的去中心化非光滑非凸随机优化，目标是找到 (δ,ε)-Goldstein 稳定点。作者提出一种新算法，通过去中心化在线到非凸转换技术，将原问题归约到去中心化在线凸优化（D-OCO），实现了 O(δ^{-1}ε^{-3}) 的样本复杂度和 Õ(γ^{-1/2}δ^{-1}ε^{-3}) 的通信复杂度，消除了对维度 d 的多项式依赖。
AI.motivation: 已有最佳算法虽然能达到 (δ,ε)-Goldstein 稳定点，但其样本与通信复杂度对问题维度 d 存在多项式依赖（如 dε^{-1} 项），在高维场景下成为主要瓶颈。本文旨在消除这一维度依赖。
AI.method: 核心方法是一个去中心化在线到非凸（online-to-nonconvex）转换，将原本的非光滑非凸优化问题归约为去中心化在线凸优化（D-OCO）问题。该转换的关键性质是：其共识（consensus）要求可直接继承自底层 D-OCO 决策的共识，从而能够显式建立维度依赖与共识误差之间的联系，证明仅需对数级额外通信即可消除对 d 的多项式依赖。
AI.result: 新算法达到 O(δ^{-1}ε^{-3}) 的样本复杂度和 Õ(γ^{-1/2}δ^{-1}ε^{-3}) 的通信复杂度（γ 为通信矩阵的谱隙）。与已有最佳算法相比，样本和通信复杂度中均去除了维度 d 的多项式项，且仅增加对数级通信开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过去中心化在线到非凸转换与共识继承机制，本文成功消除了去中心化非光滑非凸随机优化中样本与通信复杂度对维度的多项式依赖，为高维场景提供了更高效的算法方案。

title: A quantum connection approach to rationality
summary: We extract rank and regularized exponents from cyclic generic factors of the quantum connection and show that these data persist under the birational comparisons considered here. Applications include showing non-rationality of cubic threefolds, ordinary Gushel--Mukai threefolds, very general quartic fourfolds, and products of the threefolds with $\PP^1$.

AI.tldr: 从量子联络的循环一般因子上提取秩与正则化指数，证明这些数据在双有理比较下保持不变，并用于证明若干簇的非有理性。
AI.motivation: 研究双有理几何中区分有理簇与非有理簇的不变量问题，寻找在双有理变换下稳定、可用于非有理性判定的代数不变量。
AI.method: 从（Fano簇的）量子联络的循环一般因子（cyclic generic factors）中提取秩（rank）与正则化指数（regularized exponents），并证明这些数据在本文所考虑的双有理比较（birational comparisons）下具有保持性。
AI.result: 所得不变量可应用于证明以下簇的非有理性：三次三维簇（cubic threefolds）、一般Gushel–Mukai三维簇、非常一般的四次四维簇（quartic fourfolds），以及上述三维簇与 $\PP^1$ 的乘积。
AI.conclusion: 量子联络的秩与正则化指数构成一类在双有理比较下稳定的不变量，为多类Fano簇及其与 $\PP^1$ 乘积的非有理性提供了统一的判定工具。

title: Polynomial Acceleration of Alternating Projections: Chebyshev Acceleration, Convergence Rates, and Retractions
summary: Alternating projections (AP) near a clean intersection of smooth manifolds can converge slowly when the Friedrichs angle is small. We develop the \emph{Fixed-Point Manifold Acceleration (FPMA) framework} for {local convergence and polynomial acceleration of} smooth maps that fix a manifold pointwise. {Under suitable regularity and uniform normal spectral stability, FPMA establishes local R-linear convergence and a smooth limiting map inducing a local retraction. At fixed points, consistent polynomial acceleration with $p(1)=1$ preserves the selected limit's first-order response to normal initial perturbations whenever the transformed normal blocks are uniformly spectrally stable. Under sufficient smoothness, we give a curvature criterion for second-order induced retractions and show that stable consistent polynomial acceleration preserves both the quadratic retraction expansion and this criterion. {As a special case, we establish new local R-linear convergence guarantees for fixed-degree Chebyshev-accelerated exact AP and second-order induced retractions. For uniform Friedrichs angle $θ_F\in(0,π/2)$, acceleration strictly improves the local convergence rate per AP evaluation. The large-degree limiting spectral factor at fixed $θ_F$ predicts $O(θ_F^{-1})$ evaluations for fixed relative error reduction as $θ_F\downarrow0$, versus $O(θ_F^{-2})$ for ordinary AP.}} {The framework also covers} inexact, relaxed, and generalized AP {under their respective regularity and stability conditions.}

AI.tldr: 本文提出固定点流形加速（FPMA）框架，用于研究逐点固定光滑流形的光滑映射的局部收敛与多项式加速，并将结果应用于交替投影（AP），给出了Chebyshev加速AP的局部R-线性收敛保证及更优的收敛率估计。
AI.motivation: 交替投影（AP）在光滑流形清洁交附近、当Friedrichs角较小时收敛缓慢。作者希望建立一个通用框架，对逐点固定流形的光滑映射实现局部收敛分析与多项式加速，并据此改进AP及其变体的收敛率。
AI.method: 提出Fixed-Point Manifold Acceleration（FPMA）框架。在适当正则性与一致法向谱稳定性假设下，建立局部R-线性收敛及诱导局部收缩的光滑极限映射；采用满足p(1)=1的一致多项式加速，保持所选极限对法向初始扰动的一阶响应；在充分光滑下给出二阶诱导收缩的曲率判据，并证明稳定的多项式加速保持二次收缩展开与该判据。作为特例，对固定次数Chebyshev加速的精确AP和二阶诱导收缩建立局部收敛保证；框架亦覆盖非精确、松弛及广义AP。
AI.result: 对均匀Friedrichs角θ_F∈(0,π/2)，加速严格改善每次AP评估的局部收敛率。固定θ_F时大次数极限谱因子预测：当θ_F↓0时，固定相对误差下降所需评估次数为O(θ_F^{-1})，而普通AP为O(θ_F^{-2})。
AI.conclusion: FPMA为逐点固定流形的光滑映射提供了统一的局部收敛与多项式加速理论，可保持极限映射的一阶/二阶结构，并显著提升AP类算法在Friedrichs角趋于零时的收敛效率。

title: A rigidity result for the weighted p-Laplace equation in higher dimensions
summary: We study rigidity for the weighted $p$-Laplace equation on smooth bounded domains in dimensions three and higher. We show that a smooth positive weight sufficiently close to $1$ is identically $1$ if the derivative of its Dirichlet-to-Neumann map at one affine boundary value agrees with that for the unit weight. We also prove local rigidity at every smooth positive reference weight which is constant in one direction. The reference weight need not be close to $1$, and the unknown weight is only required to be sufficiently close to it, without a directional restriction. No convexity, analyticity, or agreement near the boundary is assumed. The proof combines linearization at a solution without critical points with recent rigidity results for the anisotropic Calderón problem. An identity for the linearized conductivity tensors removes the remaining diffeomorphism. This last step does not require smallness of either weight.

AI.tldr: 该文研究加权p-Laplace方程在光滑有界区域上的刚性，证明在Dirichlet-to-Neumann映射的线性化一致时，接近1的光滑正权为1；并进一步证明在沿一方向为常数的参考权处的局部刚性，证明结合无临界点解处的线性化与各向异性Calderón问题刚性结果。
AI.motivation: 研究加权p-Laplace方程的刚性，旨在由边界的Dirichlet-to-Neumann映射（线性化数据）确定内部权函数，属于逆问题领域。此前结果常需权接近1、凸性、解析性或边界附近一致性等限制，本文希望放宽这些假设并建立更一般的局部刚性。
AI.method: 在无临界点的解处对加权p-Laplace方程进行线性化，将问题转化为各向异性Calderón问题的刚性框架；利用近期关于各向异性Calderón问题的刚性结果；再通过线性化电导张量的一个恒等式消除残余的微分同胚不确定性。
AI.result: 得到两个刚性结论：一是若光滑正权充分接近1，且其Dirichlet-to-Neumann映射在某一仿射边界值处的导数与单位权情形一致，则该权恒等于1；二是对每个沿某一方向为常数的光滑正参考权，证明局部刚性，即未知权只需充分接近该参考权（无方向限制），参考权无需接近1。
AI.conclusion: 在不需要凸性、解析性或边界附近一致性的条件下，建立了加权p-Laplace方程的边界刚性；其中消除微分同胚的最后一步不要求任一权的小性，表明结果具有较一般的适用范围。

title: Principled Top-$k$ Selection for Language Models with Hybrid Gradients
summary: Selecting the best $k$ items out of $m$ candidates is a critical component of modern large language model systems, such as document selection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs). However, training these selection modules remains challenging due to weak gradient signals and suboptimal exploration-exploitation tradeoffs. Furthermore, prior works often rely on heuristics, lacking principled objectives and approaches that explicitly model and solve the top-$k$ selection problem. In this work, we propose a principled objective for training selection modules, whose gradient naturally provides richer training signals in a hybrid form---containing a supervised-gradient component and a policy-gradient component. We show that the selection problem becomes harder as $m$ increases, and our algorithm converges at rate $O(1/\sqrt{T})$, with the optimal upper bound achieved by balancing between bias and variance. Practically, we apply our method to a set of tasks involving top-$k$ selection, including synthetic regression problems, RAG, and MoE systems, showing that our method outperforms the baselines in next-token prediction perplexity and QA accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文为从m个候选中选出top-k项的选择模块提出一个有原则的训练目标，其梯度天然包含监督梯度与策略梯度的混合信号，并给出收敛率O(1/√T)的理论保证，在合成回归、RAG与MoE任务上优于基线。
AI.motivation: top-k选择是现代大模型系统的关键组件（如RAG的文档选择、MoE的专家路由），但训练此类选择模块面临梯度信号弱、探索-利用权衡不佳的问题；已有工作多依赖启发式方法，缺乏对top-k选择问题显式建模与求解的原则性目标和算法。
AI.method: 提出一个面向选择模块的原则性训练目标；其梯度自然地以混合形式提供更丰富的训练信号，包含一个监督梯度分量和一个策略梯度分量；对选择问题的难度随候选数m增大而上升进行了分析，并通过在偏差与方差之间取得平衡来获得最优上界，算法收敛率为O(1/√T)。
AI.result: 在涉及top-k选择的多类任务上（合成回归问题、RAG、MoE系统）验证，方法在下一词预测困惑度与问答准确率上均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将top-k选择形式化为具有原则性目标的学习问题，可同时获得更丰富的混合梯度信号与理论收敛保证，并在实际RAG与MoE场景中带来稳定的性能提升。

title: Marginalized Operators for Off-policy Reinforcement Learning
summary: In this work, we propose marginalized operators, a new class of off-policy evaluation operators for reinforcement learning. Marginalized operators strictly generalize generic multi-step operators, such as Retrace, as special cases. Marginalized operators also suggest a form of sample-based estimates with potential variance reduction, compared to sample-based estimates of the original multi-step operators. We show that the estimates for marginalized operators can be computed in a scalable way, which also generalizes prior results on marginalized importance sampling as special cases. Finally, we empirically demonstrate that marginalized operators provide performance gains to off-policy evaluation and downstream policy optimization algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“边缘化算子”（marginalized operators），一类新型离策略评估算子，严格推广了 Retrace 等通用多步算子，并给出可扩展的样本估计方法，实现在离策略评估与策略优化上的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 离策略评估（OPE）中的多步算子（如 Retrace）虽能平衡偏差与方差，但其样本估计仍存在方差较大的问题；同时，边缘化重要性采样等已有结果缺乏统一的一般化框架。作者希望构造一类更一般的算子，既能严格包含现有多步算子，又能带来潜在的方差缩减。
AI.method: 提出 marginalized operators 这一类新的 OPE 算子；证明其严格推广 Retrace 等通用多步算子为特例；基于该算子构造样本估计形式以实现潜在方差缩减；并给出可扩展的计算方式，该方法同时将边缘化重要性采样的既有结论推广为特例。
AI.result: 实验表明，边缘化算子能够为离策略评估以及下游的策略优化算法带来性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 边缘化算子为离策略评估提供了一个统一且更具一般性的算子框架，兼具理论推广性与可扩展的计算形式，并在实证中验证了其有效性。

title: Partial-State Deadzone-Adapted Disturbance Suppression Control For Strict-Feedback Systems
summary: In this paper we provide an extension of the partial-state Deadzone-Adapted Disturbance Suppression (DADS) adaptive control scheme in the case of strict-feedback systems. We study two cases: the cases of strict-feedback systems with and without integrators. The DADS controller achieves attenuation of the output to an assignable small level, despite the presence of (time-varying) disturbances, unknown (time-varying) parameters and unknown (time-varying) input coefficients; all of them with arbitrary and unknown bounds. The mechanism that makes DADS work is the same in all previously studied cases where DADS has been applied: the update law "pumps up" the nonlinear controller gain to a sufficient size, adapting the gain to the unknown uncertainties, and shuts off further pumping up of the gain once the output is in the residual set. The results are directly extended to the infinite-dimensional case. Two simple examples are provided: one finite-dimensional example and one infinite-dimensional example. The finite-dimensional example is used for a detailed comparison with existing results in the literature.

AI.tldr: 本文将部分状态DADS自适应控制方案推广至严格反馈系统，涵盖含与不含积分器的两种情形，并直接扩展至无穷维系统，通过有限维与无穷维两个例子验证，其中有限维例子用于与现有结果详细比较。
AI.motivation: DADS方案此前已在多种情形下应用，但尚未针对严格反馈系统（含/不含积分器）给出推广，且系统同时存在时变扰动、未知时变参数与时变输入系数且界任意未知，需要一种能自动调节增益的控制机制。
AI.method: 扩展部分状态DADS自适应控制方案处理严格反馈系统；核心机制为更新律将非线性控制器增益"泵升"至足够大以适配未知不确定性，一旦输出进入残差集便停止继续泵升增益；并将结果直接推广至无穷维情形。
AI.result: 控制器可将输出衰减至可指定的小水平，同时应对时变扰动、未知时变参数与未知时变输入系数（界均任意未知）；提供了有限维与无穷维两个算例，有限维算例与文献中现有结果进行了详细对比。
AI.conclusion: 部分状态DADS方案可有效推广至严格反馈系统（含及不含积分器）并延伸至无穷维情形，增益泵升-停止机制在各类场景下保持一致有效性，输出衰减性能得到验证。

title: Suciu's Conjecture on hyperplane arrangements
summary: We prove that the resonance of any hyperplane arrangement is separable. Using the main result from arXiv:2512.10160 this proves Suciu's conjecture on the fundamental group of every hyperplane arrangement, in its most effective form.

AI.tldr: 证明了任意超平面配置的共振（resonance）具有可分性，并结合另一篇论文的主要结果，完整证明了 Suciu 关于超平面配置基本群的猜想（最有效形式）。
AI.motivation: Suciu 曾提出关于超平面配置基本群的猜想，此前缺乏完整证明。本文旨在彻底解决该猜想，并给出其最有效的形式。
AI.method: 通过证明任意超平面配置的共振具有可分性（separability），并引用 arXiv:2512.10160 的主要结果进行综合推导。
AI.result: 证明了超平面配置共振的可分性，从而结合已有结果证明了 Suciu 猜想的最有效形式。
AI.conclusion: Suciu 关于超平面配置基本群的猜想在任意超平面配置下成立，并被证明为最有效形式。

title: A Relaxed Maximum-Based Normal \texorpdfstring{$S$}{S}-Iteration Method for Generalized Absolute Value Equations
summary: A relaxed maximum-based normal $S$-iteration method (RMNSI) is proposed for solving generalized absolute value equations (GAVEs). The method combines a maximum-based fixed-point formulation with a constant relaxation parameter and avoids the selection of an auxiliary matrix. Assuming that $A+B$ is non-singular, both stages require linear systems with the same coefficient matrix $A+B$, allowing a single factorization to be reused throughout the iteration. A single spectral condition is established that guarantees unique solvability of the GAVE and global convergence from an arbitrary initial vector. An admissible range of the relaxation parameter is characterized, and $R$-linear convergence and error estimates are derived. Since the global condition can be conservative, a local convergence analysis based on the solution sign pattern is also presented. Numerical experiments on complementarity-derived, dense mixed-sign, and asymmetric ridge-regression problems are presented, and comparisons with several recent methods demonstrate the competitive efficiency and accuracy of RMNSI. The results further indicate that the preferred relaxation parameter depends mainly on the matrix structure and diagonal shift, while its dependence on the problem dimension is generally weak.

AI.tldr: 本文提出松弛最大值型正规S迭代法（RMNSI）求解广义绝对值方程，给出收敛性与参数范围，并通过数值实验验证其高效性。
AI.motivation: 广义绝对值方程（GAVE）在互补问题等领域有重要应用，现有迭代方法往往需要额外选择辅助矩阵，增加计算与调参负担。因此作者希望设计一种无需辅助矩阵、且可利用单一矩阵分解的迭代方法。
AI.method: 提出RMNSI方法，将最大值型不动点格式与常数松弛参数结合，避免辅助矩阵选择。在A+B非奇异的假设下，两阶段均使用同一系数矩阵A+B的线性系统，可复用一次分解。建立单一谱条件以保证GAVE的唯一可解性与任意初值下的全局收敛，刻画松弛参数的容许范围，并推导R-线性收敛及误差估计。针对全局条件可能保守的问题，进一步基于解符号模式进行局部收敛分析。
AI.result: 在互补问题导出、稠密混合符号及非对称岭回归问题上的数值实验表明，RMNSI相比多种近期方法具有竞争性的效率与精度。结果还显示，较优松弛参数主要取决于矩阵结构和对角位移，而对问题维度的依赖总体较弱。
AI.conclusion: RMNSI是一种无需辅助矩阵、可复用单一分解的高效GAVE求解方法，具备完整的全局与局部收敛理论，并在多类问题上表现优于或媲美近期方法。

title: Area-preserving curvature flow for open curves with general contact angles on skew lines
summary: We study an area-preserving curvature flow for planar open curves whose end points lie on skew lines and meet the lines at general contact angles. In previous studies of moving boundary problems for higher-order geometric gradient flows, the right-angle condition has often been imposed to ensure that the evolving curves naturally satisfy the boundary conditions. However, under general contact-angle conditions, the evolution must be described by a free boundary problem. Under suitable assumptions on the contact angles $θ_\pm$, the angle $θ$ between the skew lines, and the initial data $γ_0$, we prove global-in-time existence and uniqueness up to reparametrization. We further prove that, after choosing a constant-speed parametrization at each time, the solution converges exponentially to a circular arc with the same signed area as the initial curve. Our analysis is based on a formulation of the evolution as a free boundary problem together with the derivation of uniform a priori estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平面开曲线在斜交直线上的保面积曲率流，端点以一般接触角接触直线。作者将演化表述为自由边界问题，证明在接触角、斜线夹角及初始数据满足适当假设下，解全局存在且唯一（至重参数化），并证明采用恒定速度参数化后解指数收敛到面积相同的圆弧。
AI.motivation: 以往对高阶几何梯度流的移动边界问题多施加直角条件以保证曲线自然满足边界条件；但一般接触角下无法沿用，需以自由边界问题描述演化，因此需要新的分析框架来研究此类保面积流的长时间行为。
AI.method: 将保面积曲率流表述为自由边界问题，并结合一致先验估计的推导进行分析；在接触角、斜线夹角与初始数据满足适当假设下证明全局存在性与唯一性，并通过选取每一时刻的恒定速度参数化研究收敛性。
AI.result: 在适当假设下证明了全局时刻存在性及至重参数化的唯一性；并证明在每时刻选择恒定速度参数化后，解指数收敛到与初始曲线具有相同有符号面积的圆弧。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将保面积曲率流的移动边界分析从直角条件推广到一般接触角情形，借助自由边界问题表述与一致先验估计，建立了全局存在唯一性及到面积保持圆弧的指数收敛结果。

title: Clean: Second-order LLM Training at Linear Memory Cost via Nyström Sketching
summary: Training large language models (LLMs) entails a fundamental trade-off: memory-efficient optimizers such as Adam discard cross-parameter curvature, whereas full-curvature methods such as SOAP can accelerate convergence at prohibitive memory costs. We introduce Clean, a memory-efficient and full-curvature optimizer designed to resolve this bottleneck. Clean leverages the randomized Nystrom method to accurately approximate the left and right preconditioners in SOAP, and to reduce the optimizer's memory complexity from quadratic to linear in terms of model dimensions. We subsequently reintegrate the off-subspace components to capture curvature information beyond the low-rank approximation, preserving rich curvature at minimal memory cost. We further propose Q-Clean, a low-precision variant that aggressively compresses optimizer states. Q-Clean reduces optimizer memory consumption by \textbf{over 50\%} compared to Muon when pre-training a LLaMA-1.3B architecture, all while maintaining strong and competitive predictive performance. Notably, Clean operates with a smaller optimizer-state footprint than standard AdamW while reaching AdamW's final performance \textbf{26\% faster} in wall-clock time. Furthermore, our methods uniquely enable the pre-training of a 13B-parameter model on a single 80GB GPU, providing a scalable, efficient, and accessible approach to large-scale model optimization.

AI.tldr: Clean 提出一种内存高效的全曲率优化器，利用随机 Nystrom 方法近似 SOAP 的左右预条件子，将优化器内存复杂度从模型维度二次降为线性，并重新整合子空间外分量以保留丰富曲率信息；进一步提出低精度变体 Q-Clean 压缩优化器状态。
AI.motivation: 训练大语言模型存在根本性权衡：Adam 等内存高效优化器丢弃跨参数曲率信息，而 SOAP 等全曲率方法虽能加速收敛，却带来难以承受的内存开销。因此需要一种既能保持全曲率加速能力、又具备内存高效性的优化器来突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: Clean 采用随机 Nystrom 方法准确近似 SOAP 中的左右预条件子，将优化器内存复杂度由关于模型维度的二次降为线性；随后重新整合子空间外分量，以在低内存成本下捕获低秩近似之外的曲率信息。此外提出 Q-Clean，一种通过激进压缩优化器状态实现的低精度变体。
AI.result: 在预训练 LLaMA-1.3B 架构时，Q-Clean 相比 Muon 减少超过 50% 的优化器内存占用，同时保持强劲且有竞争力的预测性能。Clean 的优化器状态占用小于标准 AdamW，却以墙钟时间快 26% 达到 AdamW 的最终性能。此外，所提方法首次支持在单块 80GB GPU 上预训练 13B 参数模型。
AI.conclusion: Clean 与 Q-Clean 在保持强预测性能的同时显著降低优化器内存占用并加速收敛，为大规模模型优化提供了一种可扩展、高效且易于获取的解决方案。

title: Understanding Self-Predictive Learning for Reinforcement Learning
summary: We study the learning dynamics of self-predictive learning for reinforcement learning, a family of algorithms that learn representations by minimizing the prediction error of their own future latent representations. Despite its recent empirical success, such algorithms have an apparent defect: trivial representations (such as constants) minimize the prediction error, yet it is obviously undesirable to converge to such solutions. Our central insight is that careful designs of the optimization dynamics are critical to learning meaningful representations. We identify that a faster paced optimization of the predictor and semi-gradient updates on the representation, are crucial to preventing the representation collapse. Then in an idealized setup, we show self-predictive learning dynamics carries out spectral decomposition on the state transition matrix, effectively capturing information of the transition dynamics. Building on the theoretical insights, we propose bidirectional self-predictive learning, a novel self-predictive algorithm that learns two representations simultaneously. We examine the robustness of our theoretical insights with a number of small-scale experiments and showcase the promise of the novel representation learning algorithm with large-scale experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自预测学习（self-predictive learning）的学习动力学，指出通过加快预测器优化节奏与对表示采用半梯度更新可防止表示坍缩，理论上证明其在理想设定下对状态转移矩阵进行谱分解，并据此提出双向自预测学习算法，实验验证了理论洞见与新算法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 自预测学习通过最小化对自身未来隐表示的预测误差来学习表示，虽近期取得经验成功，但存在明显缺陷：平凡表示（如常数）即可最小化预测误差，导致表示坍缩，因此需要理解何种机制能避免收敛到此类解。
AI.method: 核心洞见是优化动力学的精心设计至关重要。作者识别出两点关键因素：预测器的更快优化节奏（faster paced optimization of the predictor）以及对表示采用半梯度更新（semi-gradient updates）。在理想化设定下分析自预测学习的动力学。基于理论洞见，提出双向自预测学习（bidirectional self-predictive learning），该算法同时学习两个表示。
AI.result: 理论上表明，在理想化设定下自预测学习动力学执行对状态转移矩阵的谱分解，从而有效捕捉转移动力学信息。通过若干小规模实验检验了理论洞见的稳健性，并通过大规模实验展示了新表示学习算法的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 优化动力学的设计（预测器快节奏优化与表示半梯度更新）是防止表示坍缩、学习有意义表示的关键；自预测学习在理想情形下等价于对状态转移矩阵的谱分解；所提出的双向自预测学习算法在实验中得到验证并展现出应用前景。

title: Decision-Tree Surrogates for Weak Counterfactual Explanations in Integer Optimization
summary: The concept of counterfactual explanations (CEs) has recently gained increasing attention for deriving explanations of mathematical optimization problems. For a given problem, a counterfactual is an ideally minimal change in the mutable problem parameters such that an optimal solution of the changed problem exists fulfilling some desired criterion. It was shown that so-called weak CEs can be calculated by solving a computationally demanding bilevel optimization problem, which is $Σ_2^p$-complete if decision variables and mutable parameters are restricted to integers. Hence, the known exact solution methods are expected to fail on practically relevant problem sizes. In this work we derive a fast heuristic algorithm by approximating the feasible region of the CE problem with a decision tree for which CEs can be calculated more quickly. To this end we analyze the mathematical structure of the feasible region and develop a hand-crafted decision tree which applies splits imitating this structure. Additionally, we develop several techniques to increase the performance of our method. The practicability of our methods is supported by computational experiments on the knapsack problem and the facility location problem.

AI.tldr: 本文针对数学优化问题中的反事实解释（CEs）计算难题，提出基于决策树近似可行域的快速启发式算法，并在背包问题和设施选址问题上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 反事实解释在数学优化中的应用日益受关注，但精确计算弱反事实解释需要求解双层优化问题，当决策变量和可变参数为整数时属于Σ₂^p完全问题，现有精确算法在实用规模上不可行，因此亟需快速启发式方法。
AI.method: 分析反事实解释问题可行域的数学结构，构建一个手工设计的决策树，其分裂方式模仿该结构，从而用决策树近似可行域，使得反事实解释可以在树上更快计算；同时开发多种提升性能的技术。
AI.result: 通过在背包问题和设施选址问题上的计算实验，验证了所提方法的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于决策树的启发式算法能快速近似求解反事实解释问题，在实用规模上具备可行性，为数学优化中的反事实解释提供了高效途径。

title: Spreading out perverse sheaves
summary: We spread out geometrically irreducible perverse sheaves. Over an arithmetic base scheme, such sheaves extend from the generic fiber to a relatively perverse, universally locally acyclic sheaf over a dense open of the base scheme. As an application, we prove the arithmetic Kashiwara conjecture by Esnault and Kerz for geometric traits in equicharacteristic and generalize the decomposition theorem for arithmetic complexes to fields finitely generated over a separably closed field. We also recover the Hard Lefschetz theorem for arithmetic perverse sheaves.

AI.tldr: 研究几何不可约反常层在算术基概形上的延拓，证明其可从一般纤维延拓为稠密开集上相对反常且普遍局部无环的层，并给出算术Kashiwara猜想、算术复形分解定理及Hard Lefschetz定理等应用。
AI.motivation: 算术情形下反常层的延拓与分解性质缺乏统一处理，Esnault–Kerz提出的算术Kashiwara猜想仅在有限情形已知；需要一般性框架以推广经典分解定理与Hard Lefschetz定理。
AI.method: 在算术基概形上研究几何不可约反常层，证明其从一般纤维延拓为基概形稠密开集上相对反常且普遍局部无环（universally locally acyclic）的层。
AI.result: 证明等特征几何trait情形下的算术Kashiwara猜想；将算术复形的分解定理推广到可分闭域上有限生成的域；并重新得到算术反常层的Hard Lefschetz定理。
AI.conclusion: 该延拓结果构成算术反常层理论的基础性工具，统一并推广了分解定理、Kashiwara猜想与Hard Lefschetz定理等核心结论。

title: Comparison of neural and spline representations for physics-informed learning
summary: Physics-informed machine learning as recently emerged as a new paradigm for the resolution of partial differential equations, including functionalities for parametric modeling and inverse design, using neural networks to represent the solution fields. However, several difficulties have been reported concerning the training of such networks, resulting in slow convergence, low accurate solutions and sensitivity to the choice of hyper-parameters. In order to better understand the mechanisms underlying these difficulties, the present work proposes a rigourous comparison of neural networks and B-Splines representations within the same physics-informed learning framework. Four problems with closed-form solutions are numerically studied to establish a rigorous analysis of the accuracy and efficiency of the two representations, in terms of asymptotic convergence rates, sampling requirements, loss function minimization and arithmetic precision needed.

AI.tldr: 该文在统一的物理信息学习框架下，对神经网络与B样条两种场表示进行严格对比，以揭示物理信息机器学习训练困难的内在机制。
AI.motivation: 物理信息机器学习作为求解偏微分方程（含参数化建模与逆向设计）的新范式广受关注，但神经网络训练存在收敛慢、精度低、对超参数敏感等问题，其机制尚不清晰。
AI.method: 在同一物理信息学习框架下，将神经网络表示与B样条表示进行严格对比，选取四个具有解析解的问题开展数值实验。
AI.result: 从渐近收敛率、采样需求、损失函数最小化以及所需算术精度等方面，对两种表示形式的精度与效率给出了严格分析。
AI.conclusion: 通过对比揭示了两种表示在物理信息学习中的优劣机制，为理解并缓解神经网络训练的困难提供依据。

title: Steady-State Phase Transition States and Large-Time Asymptotics for the Cauchy Problem of Compressible Navier-Stokes Equations with van der Waals Equation of State
summary: We study the Cauchy problem for the one-dimensional isothermal compressible Navier--Stokes system with the van der Waals equation of state, and analyze the well-posedness and asymptotic stability of steady-state phase-transition solutions at subcritical temperatures. Working in Lagrangian coordinates, we use variational techniques to construct piecewise smooth steady-state solutions corresponding to two-phase equilibrium states under finite-mass perturbations. Introducing artificial-viscosity regularization, we first establish existence of the global minimizer of the regularized variational problem, unique within each fixed symmetry class; passing to the vanishing artificial-viscosity limit then yields a physically admissible steady-state solution with two phase interfaces. For initial perturbations that are small with respect to energy, piecewise-gradient, total-variation, and integral norms but may exhibit large pointwise jumps across phase boundaries, we derive uniform a priori bounds for weak solutions near the two-phase equilibrium profile. We further prove that these global weak solutions converge to the steady-state two-phase equilibrium in $L^\infty(\mathbb{R})$ as $t\to\infty$, thereby characterizing their large-time asymptotic behavior. Physically, finite mass perturbations break the uniqueness of the uniform steady state and generate infinitely many piecewise constant two-phase equilibria satisfying the Maxwell equal-area rule. Artificial viscosity acts as a selection principle that singles out the physically relevant two-interface steady-state configuration, and this two-phase equilibrium is asymptotically stable under small integral perturbations that allow large-amplitude discontinuities at phase interfaces.

AI.tldr: 研究一维等温可压缩Navier-Stokes系统（van der Waals状态方程）Cauchy问题，在亚临界温度下构造稳态相变解并证明其渐近稳定性。
AI.motivation: 有限质量扰动破坏均匀稳态的唯一性，产生无穷多满足Maxwell等面积律的分片常数两相平衡态，需刻画物理相关稳态解的存在性、选取机制及长时间渐近行为。
AI.method: 在Lagrangian坐标下，用变分技术构造分段光滑稳态解；引入人工粘性正则化，先证正则化变分问题全局极小元的存在性与对称类内的唯一性，再取人工粘性消失极限得到含两个相界面的物理容许稳态解；进而对弱解建立一致先验估计。
AI.result: 对能量、分段梯度、全变差与积分范数小但跨相界点态跳跃可能很大的初值扰动，得到两相平衡附近弱解的一致先验界；并证明全局弱解当t→∞时在L∞(R)中收敛到稳态两相平衡，刻画了长时间渐近行为。
AI.conclusion: 人工粘性充当选择原理，唯一挑出物理相关的双界面稳态构型；该两相平衡在小积分扰动（允许相界面处大幅间断）下是渐近稳定的。

title: FTD-GNO: Memory-Efficient Graph Neural Operators through Functional Tensor Decomposition of the Kernel
summary: Graph Neural Operators (GNOs) provide flexible surrogate models for learning solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). However, standard GNOs typically parameterize the integral kernel with a monolithic neural network and evaluate kernel interactions over graph edges, leading to substantial computational and memory overhead at high resolutions or with large neighborhoods. To address these limitations, we propose Functional Tensor Decomposition Graph Neural Operator (FTD-GNO), a memory-efficient GNO framework that decouples the high-dimensional continuous integral kernel into low-dimensional mode-wise functions. By instantiating the kernel with classical tensor decomposition formats, including CP, Tensor-Train, and Tucker decompositions, FTD-GNO enables algebraic reconstruction of the integral operator without explicitly materializing full edge-wise kernel tensors. This factorized formulation reduces the memory footprint of kernel evaluation and aggregation while retaining the continuous operator-learning structure of GNOs. Theoretical complexity analysis shows that FTD-GNO substantially lowers parameter and activation-memory costs associated with high-dimensional kernel construction. Experiments show lower peak memory than the corresponding unfactorized graph-integral baselines, with shorter recorded training times. Fourier-graph experiments further demonstrate that FTD can improve the efficiency of a graph-integral layer within a hybrid operator and has good scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出FTD-GNO，将图神经算子的高维连续积分核分解为低维模态函数（CP/TT/Tucker），避免显式物化边级核张量，从而大幅降低内存与训练开销。
AI.motivation: 标准图神经算子（GNO）用单一神经网络参数化积分核，并在图边上逐边计算核交互，在高分辨率或大邻域下带来巨大的计算与内存开销，限制了其可扩展性。
AI.method: FTD-GNO将高维连续积分核解耦为若干低维模态函数，采用经典张量分解格式（CP、Tensor-Train、Tucker）实例化核，从而对积分算子进行代数重构，无需显式构造完整的逐边核张量；同时保留GNO的连续算子学习结构。
AI.result: 理论复杂度分析表明该方法显著降低高维核构建的参数与激活内存成本；实验显示相比未分解的图积分基线具有更低的峰值内存和更短的训练时间；Fourier-graph实验进一步表明FTD能提升混合算子中图积分层的效率并具备良好可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 张量分解为GNO的核参数化提供了内存高效的替代方案，在不牺牲连续算子学习能力的前提下改善峰值内存、训练时间与可扩展性。

title: Regularization and Variance-Weighted Regression Achieves Minimax Optimality in Linear MDPs: Theory and Practice
summary: Mirror descent value iteration (MDVI), an abstraction of Kullback-Leibler (KL) and entropy-regularized reinforcement learning (RL), has served as the basis for recent high-performing practical RL algorithms. However, despite the use of function approximation in practice, the theoretical understanding of MDVI has been limited to tabular Markov decision processes (MDPs). We study MDVI with linear function approximation through its sample complexity required to identify an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy with probability $1-δ$ under the settings of an infinite-horizon linear MDP, generative model, and G-optimal design. We demonstrate that least-squares regression weighted by the variance of an estimated optimal value function of the next state is crucial to achieving minimax optimality. Based on this observation, we present Variance-Weighted Least-Squares MDVI (VWLS-MDVI), the first theoretical algorithm that achieves nearly minimax optimal sample complexity for infinite-horizon linear MDPs. Furthermore, we propose a practical VWLS algorithm for value-based deep RL, Deep Variance Weighting (DVW). Our experiments demonstrate that DVW improves the performance of popular value-based deep RL algorithms on a set of MinAtar benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了带线性函数逼近的镜像下降价值迭代（MDVI），提出VWLS-MDVI算法，首次在无限视界线性MDP下达到近乎极小极大最优的样本复杂度，并提出实用深度RL算法DVW。
AI.motivation: MDVI是KL与熵正则化强化学习（RL）的抽象，已成为近期高性能实用RL算法的基础。然而尽管实践中使用了函数逼近，MDVI的理论理解仍局限于表格型马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。作者希望将MDVI的理论分析推广到带线性函数逼近的无限视界线性MDP场景。
AI.method: 在无限视界线性MDP、生成模型与G-最优设计设定下，研究MDVI在识别ε-最优策略（概率1-δ）时所需的样本复杂度。核心观察是：以下一状态估计最优价值函数的方差进行加权的least-squares回归对达到极小极大最优性至关重要。据此提出VWLS-MDVI算法，并进一步提出面向基于价值的深度RL的实用VWLS算法Deep Variance Weighting（DVW）。
AI.result: VWLS-MDVI是首个在无限视界线性MDP下达到近乎极小极大最优样本复杂度的理论算法。实验表明，DVW在一组MinAtar基准上提升了主流基于价值的深度RL算法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 方差加权的最小二乘回归是实现MDVI极小极大最优性的关键，VWLS-MDVI在理论上达到近乎最优的样本复杂度，DVW在实践中有效提升深度RL性能，实现了理论与实践的桥接。

title: Structural Foundations of Nonlinear Systems with Unknown Inputs: The UID-Induced Normal Form and Minimal-Sensing Structure-from-Motion
summary: This paper establishes the first general structural solution to the problem of state estimation for nonlinear systems driven by unknown inputs. Building upon nonlinear unknown-input observability theory, we show that every such system admits a structurally equivalent representation, referred to as the UID-induced normal form. The proposed representation decomposes the information carried by the unknown inputs into two complementary components: unknown-input directions that are structurally decoupled from the observable dynamics and observable quantities that completely represent the unknown-input information affecting the observable dynamics. As a consequence, the UID-induced normal form provides a unified structural solution to unknown-input decoupling and unknown-input reconstruction, without requiring any model or stochastic assumption on the unknown inputs. The practical significance of the proposed framework is demonstrated through a previously unexplored minimal Structure-from-Motion configuration. The proposed representation enables recursive state estimation from only three point features and a single-axis gyroscope, allowing the recovery of the three-dimensional structure and camera motion up to an unknown global scale factor. Experiments on real-world data validate the proposed framework and demonstrate the feasibility of this minimal sensing configuration.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出非线性未知输入系统的通用结构性状态估计方案，通过UID诱导标准型实现未知输入解耦与重构，并以极简SfM配置验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 非线性系统在未知输入驱动下的状态估计长期缺乏通用结构性解法，现有方法多依赖模型假设或随机假设，难以同时处理未知输入的解耦与重构。
AI.method: 基于非线性未知输入可观测性理论，证明任意此类系统均可表示为结构等价的UID诱导标准型；该标准型将未知输入信息分解为与可观测动态结构性解耦的方向分量和完全表征影响可观测动态的未知输入信息的可观测分量。
AI.result: UID诱导标准型在无需未知输入模型或随机假设的前提下，统一解决了未知输入解耦与重构问题；在一种此前未探索的极简SfM配置中，仅用三个点特征和单轴陀螺仪即可递归估计状态，恢复三维结构与相机运动至未知全局尺度。
AI.conclusion: 真实数据实验验证了该框架的正确性，并证明极简传感配置的可行性，为非线未知输入状态估计提供了统一的结构性理论基础。

title: Surface Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard System: Analysis and Structure-Preserving Discretization
summary: We study the surface Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard system governing tangential flow and phase separation in viscous fluid membranes. The equations are posed on a closed, stationary $C^2$ hypersurface $Γ\subset\mathbb{R}^{d+1}$, $d=2,3$. For constant viscosity and mobility and a class of regular double-well potentials, we prove global existence and uniqueness of weak solutions for initial phase fields in $H^1(Γ)$, with the velocity chosen orthogonal to the Killing fields. These solutions satisfy an energy equality and conserve mass. We establish Lipschitz continuous dependence in energy norms on every finite time interval, including for initial data with different means, and derive higher regularity results for $d=2$ under additional smoothness assumptions on the surface, potential, and initial data. We also develop a fully discrete unfitted finite element method that conserves the total phase and satisfies an exact discrete energy identity. The method combines a penalty on approximate Killing fields with projections in the transport and capillary terms to control these modes while preserving the energy balance. Numerical experiments examine the identification of Killing fields and illustrate phase separation on a torus and a liposome with experimentally informed material parameters.

AI.tldr: 研究闭曲面上的Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard系统，证明弱解全局存在唯一性、能量等式、质量守恒与Lipschitz稳定性，并在d=2时给出更高正则性，同时构造保能量的非拟合有限元法。
AI.motivation: 曲面粘性流体膜中的切向流动与相分离需要严格的数学理论与数值方法，而现有工作对弱解适定性、能量结构及保结构离散化仍不完善。
AI.method: 在闭的、静止的C^2超曲面Γ⊂R^{d+1}(d=2,3)上，取常数粘性与迁移率及一类正则双井势，将速度限制为与Killing场正交；用能量方法证明弱解适定性，并构造全离散非拟合有限元法，结合近似Killing场罚项与输运、毛细项投影以保持能量平衡。
AI.result: 对H^1(Γ)初值相场证明了弱解全局存在唯一、能量等式与质量守恒；在有限时间区间上得到能量范数下的Lipschitz连续依赖，包括均值不同的初值；在曲面、势与初值额外光滑时得到d=2的高正则性；数值格式精确守恒总相并满足离散能量恒等式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为曲面Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard系统提供了完整的适定性与稳定性理论及保结构数值方法，数值实验验证了Killing场的识别，并在环面与脂质体上展示了相分离现象。

title: Propagation of Energy Moments for the Plasma--Charge Model
summary: This paper proves propagation of energy moments for the three-dimensional plasma-charge model, namely, the repulsive Vlasov-Poisson system with a moving point charge. For every \(K>2\), an initially finite \(K\)th energy moment remains finite on every bounded time interval, without any higher-order moment assumption, smallness condition on the plasma mass, or initial separation from the point charge. The constructed global weak solution conserves total energy for almost every time. The proof relies on a critical space-time density estimate and a direct control of the electric field along the moving charge.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了三维等离子体-电荷模型中能量矩的传播性质：在无高阶矩假设、无小质量条件、无初始分离条件下，初始有限的K阶能量矩(任意K>2)在有界时间区间内保持有限，且构造的全局弱解在几乎处时刻守恒总能量。
AI.motivation: 等离子体-电荷模型（带运动点电荷的排斥型Vlasov-Poisson系统）的解的正则性与矩传播是经典难题。此前结果通常需要额外假设：更高阶矩有限、等离子体质量足够小、或等离子体与点电荷初始分离，这些限制阻碍了对一般初值的分析。本文旨在放宽这些条件。
AI.method: 证明依赖两个关键技术：一是临界空间-时间密度估计，用于控制相空间中的局部集中；二是沿运动电荷轨迹直接控制电场，处理点电荷带来的奇异性。
AI.result: 对任意K>2，初始有限的K阶能量矩在有界时间区间内保持有限，且不需要任何高阶矩假设、质量小性条件或初始分离假设；所构造的全局弱解在几乎处时刻（almost every time）满足总能量守恒。
AI.conclusion: 该工作显著推广了等离子体-电荷模型能量矩传播的已知结果，证明了在极弱假设下矩传播与能量守恒成立，为含奇异源的Vlasov-Poisson系统提供了更强的理论支撑。

title: PaLoRA: Paced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning
summary: LoRA-based continual learning methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting through various mechanisms, yet nearly all complement these with small learning rates as a heuristic to restrict gradient scaling magnitude. Such fixed heuristics lack theoretical guidance on how the strength of this restriction should evolve as tasks accumulate. We reveal that even under directional constraints such as nullspace projection, finite-precision updates inevitably leak into the subspace of accumulated prior knowledge along multiple directions. While small learning rates attenuate such leakage, they cannot prevent the accumulated forgetting from intensifying as the effective rank of historical knowledge grows. We show that the optimal magnitude restriction should adaptively increase with this effective rank to balance stability and plasticity, i.e., preservation of previous knowledge and acquisition of new task information. Under an anisotropic leakage model, we derive a pacing law $s^*=\sqrt{R/c}$ that characterizes the optimal scaling of gradient steps, i.e., the magnitude restriction itself, where $R$ is the effective rank of past updates. Based on this insight, we propose PaLoRA, which compresses historical knowledge via adaptive SVD truncation, projects gradients onto the nullspace of prior tasks, and applies rank-aware adaptive pacing. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over prior methods, with particularly strong performance in long-horizon settings, achieving substantial gains of 4% accuracy on challenging 50-task ImageNet-A and ImageNet-R benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示LoRA持续学习中固定小学习率作为梯度幅值限制的经验做法缺乏理论依据，推导出最优限制应随历史知识有效秩自适应增大的调度律s*=√(R/c)，并提出PaLoRA方法实现秩感知的自适应梯度调度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LoRA的持续学习方法虽通过零空间投影等方向性约束缓解灾难性遗忘，但几乎都辅以固定的小学习率来限制梯度缩放幅度。这种固定经验缺乏理论指导：随着任务累积，该限制强度应如何演化并不清楚。作者希望从理论上刻画最优幅值限制随历史知识规模变化的规律，以平衡稳定性与可塑性。
AI.method: 作者首先分析：即使在零空间投影等方向约束下，有限精度更新仍会沿多个方向泄漏到历史知识的子空间，小学习率只能减弱却不能阻止随历史知识有效秩增长而加剧的累积遗忘。随后在异向泄漏模型下推导出最优梯度缩放（即幅值限制）的调度律 s*=√(R/c)，其中R为过去更新的有效秩。基于该结论提出PaLoRA：通过自适应SVD截断压缩历史知识，将梯度投影到先前任务的零空间，并施加秩感知的自适应调度。
AI.result: 实验表明PaLoRA持续优于先前方法，在长时程设置下优势尤为突出，在具有挑战性的50任务ImageNet-A和ImageNet-R基准上取得约4%的准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 固定小学习率作为梯度幅值限制的做法缺乏理论依据；最优幅值限制应随历史知识有效秩自适应增长。所导出的调度律s*=√(R/c)为稳定性与可塑性的平衡提供了理论指导，PaLoRA验证了该理论在长时程持续学习中的有效性。

title: VA-learning as a more efficient alternative to Q-learning
comment: Accepted to ICML 2023 as a conference paper
summary: In reinforcement learning, the advantage function is critical for policy improvement, but is often extracted from a learned Q-function. A natural question is: Why not learn the advantage function directly? In this work, we introduce VA-learning, which directly learns advantage function and value function using bootstrapping, without explicit reference to Q-functions. VA-learning learns off-policy and enjoys similar theoretical guarantees as Q-learning. Thanks to the direct learning of advantage function and value function, VA-learning improves the sample efficiency over Q-learning both in tabular implementations and deep RL agents on Atari-57 games. We also identify a close connection between VA-learning and the dueling architecture, which partially explains why a simple architectural change to DQN agents tends to improve performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VA-learning，直接以自举方式学习优势函数与价值函数（不显式依赖Q函数），具备与Q-learning类似的理论保证，并在tabular实现与Atari-57的深度RL智能体上提升样本效率；同时揭示其与dueling架构的紧密联系。
AI.motivation: 优势函数对策略改进至关重要，但通常需从学习到的Q函数中提取。作者提出一个自然的问题：为什么不直接学习优势函数？这构成研究的动机。
AI.method: VA-learning：通过bootstrapping直接学习优势函数和价值函数，不显式引用Q函数；支持off-policy学习，并具有与Q-learning相似的理论保证。在tabular实现和深度RL智能体（Atari-57）上进行验证，并分析其与dueling架构的关系。
AI.result: 由于直接学习优势函数与价值函数，VA-learning在tabular实现与Atari-57深度RL智能体上均较Q-learning提升了样本效率；并发现VA-learning与dueling架构存在紧密联系，部分解释了DQN的简单架构改动为何常能提升性能。
AI.conclusion: VA-learning为直接学习优势函数提供了可行且具理论保证的方案，在样本效率上优于Q-learning，并通过与dueling架构的联系为DQN性能提升提供了机理解释。

title: Last-Iterate Convergence Rate of Normalized Gradient Descent under Hölder Smoothness
summary: Normalized gradient descent is a widely studied adaptive optimization method. Most existing analyses focus on the best iterate or a weighted average of the iterates, whereas practical implementations typically return the last iterate. In this paper, we study the last-iterate convergence of normalized gradient descent for convex, $(ν,M_ν)$-Hölder-smooth objectives. For a constant stepsize, we establish an upper bound of $\mathcal{O}\bigl((\log^2(T)/T)^{(1+ν)/2}\bigr)$, which contains a logarithmic overhead relative to the known $\mathcal{O}\bigl(T^{-(1+ν)/2}\bigr)$ guarantees for the best and weighted-average iterates. For $ν= 0$, this overhead is known to be unavoidable. We complement this analysis with numerical results based on the performance estimation problem (PEP), investigating the finite-horizon worst-case behavior in the smooth setting and whether the logarithmic overhead reflects an intrinsic limitation of constant-step normalized gradient descent. We then show that a linearly decreasing stepsize yields a last-iterate guarantee of $\mathcal{O}\bigl(T^{-(1+ν)/2}\bigr)$, matching the order of the best-iterate/weighted-average guarantees without requiring knowledge of $ν$ and $M_ν$.

AI.tldr:
本文研究归一化梯度下降在凸、$(

u)/2})$，并证明线性递减步长可达到$\mathcal{O}(T^{-(1+
u)/2})$，与最优迭代/加权平均的最优阶匹配且无需知道$

AI.motivation: 现有归一化梯度下降的理论分析多针对最优迭代或迭代的加权平均，而实际算法通常返回最后一次迭代。二者之间存在理论—实践差距，尤其对最后迭代的收敛保证尚不清晰，本文旨在填补该空白并厘清常步长下对数项是否为本质限制。
AI.method: 针对凸、$(\nu,M_\nu)$-Hölder光滑目标，分析常步长归一化梯度下降的最后迭代收敛上界；利用性能估计问题（PEP）进行数值实验，考察光滑设定下有限时域最坏情形行为及对数开销是否固有；进一步提出并分析线性递减步长策略。

title: Transparent Boundary Conditions for the Time-Fractional Heat Equation on Metric Graphs
summary: In this work, we study transparent boundary conditions for the time-fractional heat equation on a metric star graph. This equation is the standard continuum model for subdiffusive heat and mass transport in disordered and porous branched media. Using the Laplace transform to solve the exterior branch problems, we demonstrate that the non-local vertex operator observed by the incoming bond is an Abel-type convolution kernel of order $β/2$, which generalizes the classical half-derivative kernel recovered at $β=1$. Our main result is that the diffusion-coefficient sum rule $κ_1=κ_2+κ_3$, known to eliminate thermal backflow for the classical heat equation, remains unchanged for every fractional order $β$: the transparency of the junction depends only on the network's diffusivities and not on the memory of the transport law. We rigorously prove this and uniqueness for the coupled vertex problem. We confirm our results numerically at the level of the underlying coupled partial differential equation system with an implicit L1 finite-difference scheme. We compare the star-graph solution to a reference solution on an unbranched line with matching diffusivity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了度量星图上时间分数阶热方程的透明边界条件，证明经典热方程中消除热回流的扩散系数和规则对任意分数阶β保持不变，并给出严格证明与数值验证。
AI.motivation: 时间分数阶热方程是描述无序、多孔分支介质中次扩散传热传质的标准连续模型，而分支网络节点处的透明边界条件对理解无反射传输至关重要；经典（β=1）情形下的透明条件及其和规则是否依赖传输律的记忆性尚不明确，因此需要在分数阶框架下重新考察。
AI.method: 针对度量星图，利用拉普拉斯变换求解外部支路问题，推导入流键所"看到"的非局部顶点算子，识别其为阶数为β/2的Abel型卷积核；在此基础上建立耦合顶点问题，并证明扩散系数和规则与唯一性；采用隐式L1有限差分格式对底层耦合偏微分方程组进行数值求解。
AI.result: 入射支路处的非局部顶点算子是阶数为β/2的Abel型卷积核，当β=1时退化为经典的半阶导数核；扩散系数和规则κ₁=κ₂+κ₃对任意分数阶β均成立，即节点透明性仅取决于网络的扩散系数，与传输律的记忆无关；该结论及耦合顶点问题的唯一性得到严格证明，并由隐式L1格式的数值实验验证，同时将星图解与具有匹配扩散率的无分支直线参考解进行对比。
AI.conclusion: 透明边界条件在分数阶情形下仍由扩散系数和规则完全支配，与时间记忆核无关，说明经典节点透明性判据具有良好的鲁棒性并可推广到次扩散输运的分支网络模型。

title: Phase-Field Approximation of Vectorial Cohesive Models
summary: We study the $Γ$-convergence of a general class of anisotropic phase-field functionals modelling cohesive fracture in the multidimensional, vector-valued, and geometrically nonlinear setting. The limiting energy comprises a quasiconvexified bulk term, a Cantor part governed by its recession function, and a cohesive surface energy density defined via an asymptotic cell problem. After establishing the structural properties and equivalent formulations of the limiting surface density, we show that, whenever the recession function of the elastic energy is given by the square of an operator norm compatible with the phase-field anisotropy, the vectorial cell problem explicitly reduces to a one-dimensional variational problem. As a consequence, we extend the cohesive law reconstruction procedure of \cite{alessi2025phasefieldpart2} to the vectorial framework, explicitly designing phase-field potentials that recover prescribed classes of anisotropic, jump-dependent traction-separation laws of the form $g(ζ,ν)=γ(ν)g_{\scal}(|ζ|)$.

AI.tldr: 研究一般各向异性相场泛函在Γ-收敛意义下的黏聚断裂极限，给出含准凸化体力项、Cantor项与黏聚面能密度的极限能量，并在特定相容条件下将向量值胞元问题化为一维问题，进而重建预设的各向异性、依赖跳跃的牵引-分离律。
AI.motivation: 在非齐次各向异性、向量值与几何非线性框架下，黏聚断裂的相场模型缺乏严格的Γ-收敛刻画，尤其是极限黏聚面能密度与牵引-分离律的重建关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用Γ-收敛与渐近胞元问题刻画极限能量；将极限能量分解为准凸化体力项、由recession函数支配的Cantor项与黏聚面能密度；在弹性能recession函数为与相场各向异性相容的算子范数平方时，将向量值胞元问题约化为一维变分问题。
AI.result: 建立极限表面密度的结构性质与等价表述；证明在相容性条件下向量值胞元问题显式退化为一维问题；扩展黏聚力律重建程序至向量框架，显式构造相场势以恢复形如 g(ζ,ν)=γ(ν)g_scal(|ζ|) 的各向异性、依赖跳跃的牵引-分离律。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了各向异性黏聚断裂相场泛函的严格Γ-收敛极限，并通过降维胞元问题实现向量情形下黏聚律的重建，为设计恢复预设各向异性黏聚关系的相场势提供了理论工具。

title: Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition for Operator Learning
summary: Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) offer an efficient paradigm for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). However, FNOs rely on a fixed Fourier basis and hard frequency truncation, which inherently limit their ability to model non-periodic, localized, and fine-scale solution structures. We propose the Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition Neural Operator (SAFDNO), a spectral neural operator that replaces predefined Fourier modes with an adaptive Takenaka-Malmquist (TM) orthonormal system derived from the theory of Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition (SAFD). Instead of performing an expensive greedy pole search in classical SAFD, SAFDNO amortizes stochastic pole selection through a neural pole predictor and constructs the adaptive TM system directly from latent features. The resulting operator performs learned filtering on coefficients of analytic branches in the Hardy space with respect to the input-adaptive TM system, preserving the global receptive field of spectral operators while providing a more flexible representation than using fixed spectral bases. Across nine PDE benchmark problems, SAFDNO achieves the best performance on all six regular-grid problems among strong neural operator baselines, with especially notable gains on Darcy, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes, where fixed Fourier modes are often less effective at modeling localized oscillations, sharp transitions, and multiscale structures. SAFDNO also exhibits stronger zero-shot super-resolution performance and shows less performance degradation when deployed on finer discretizations. These results suggest that the input-adaptive TM system provides a promising alternative to fixed spectral representations for neural operator learning.

AI.tldr: 提出SAFDNO，用输入自适应的Takenaka-Malmquist正交系统替代FNO的固定傅里叶基与硬频率截断，在九个PDE基准上取得六个规则网格问题的最优性能，并具备更强的零样本超分辨能力。
AI.motivation: FNO求解PDE高效，但依赖固定傅里叶基和硬频率截断，难以刻画非周期、局部化及细尺度解结构；经典SAFD的贪婪极点搜索代价高昂，难以直接嵌入神经算子。
AI.method: 提出随机自适应傅里叶分解神经算子（SAFDNO）。以SAFD理论导出的自适应TM正交系统替代预定义傅里叶模态；用神经极点预测器对随机极点选择进行摊销（amortization），从潜特征直接构造自适应TM系统；在Hardy空间中对解析分支系数做可学习滤波，保持谱算子的全局感受野，同时比固定谱基更灵活。
AI.result: 在九个PDE基准上，SAFDNO在全部六个规则网格问题上优于强神经算子基线；在Darcy、Burgers、Navier-Stokes上增益尤为显著，对应局部振荡、陡峭过渡与多尺度结构。同时具备更强的零样本超分辨性能，在更细离散化上性能退化更小。
AI.conclusion: 输入自适应的TM系统为神经算子学习提供了替代固定谱表示的有前景方案。

title: DoMo-AC: Doubly Multi-step Off-policy Actor-Critic Algorithm
summary: Multi-step learning applies lookahead over multiple time steps and has proved valuable in policy evaluation settings. However, in the optimal control case, the impact of multi-step learning has been relatively limited despite a number of prior efforts. Fundamentally, this might be because multi-step policy improvements require operations that cannot be approximated by stochastic samples, hence hindering the widespread adoption of such methods in practice. To address such limitations, we introduce doubly multi-step off-policy VI (DoMo-VI), a novel oracle algorithm that combines multi-step policy improvements and policy evaluations. DoMo-VI enjoys guaranteed convergence speed-up to the optimal policy and is applicable in general off-policy learning settings. We then propose doubly multi-step off-policy actor-critic (DoMo-AC), a practical instantiation of the DoMo-VI algorithm. DoMo-AC introduces a bias-variance trade-off that ensures improved policy gradient estimates. When combined with the IMPALA architecture, DoMo-AC has showed improvements over the baseline algorithm on Atari-57 game benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DoMo-VI与DoMo-AC，将多步策略改进与多步策略评估结合，在离策略场景下实现收敛加速并改进策略梯度估计，在Atari-57上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 多步学习在策略评估中有效，但在最优控制中作用有限，原因在于多步策略改进所需的算子难以由随机样本近似，限制了其实际应用。作者希望突破这一瓶颈，使多步改进在一般离策略设定下可用。
AI.method: 提出DoMo-VI：一种同时结合多步策略改进与多步策略评估的oracle算法，具备保证的收敛加速且适用于一般离策略学习；进而提出其实用化实现DoMo-AC，通过引入偏差-方差权衡来改进策略梯度估计，并与IMPALA架构结合。
AI.result: DoMo-AC在Atari-57游戏基准上相较基线算法取得提升；理论上DoMo-VI保证收敛到最优策略并具有加速效果，DoMo-AC提供更优的策略梯度估计。
AI.conclusion: 将多步策略改进与多步策略评估统一在离策略框架下，可有效发挥多步学习的优势，为最优控制中的多步方法提供了可行方案。

title: Descent--Ascent Structure of Uniform Nondegeneracy
summary: Classical models such as smooth strongly convex minimization and strongly convex--strongly concave optimization combine two types of curvature information: curvature remains uniformly separated from zero, and its positive and negative orientations are prescribed in advance. Uniform nondegeneracy disentangles these roles, retaining the separation from zero while allowing the curvature orientation to vary across the domain. We identify a family of descent--ascent inequalities (DAI) that characterizes uniform nondegeneracy and naturally gives rise to Alternating Descent Ascent (ADA), a simple explicit method that alternates full-gradient descent and ascent. ADA converges globally and linearly to the unique stationary point from arbitrary initialization, with dimension-free first-order complexity. The framework recovers the smooth strongly convex setting as a limit and encompasses the strongly convex--strongly concave and linearly constrained settings, highlighting uniform nondegeneracy as a common first-order structure across various classical regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"一致非退化"(uniform nondegeneracy)概念,将经典强凸/强凸-强凹模型中的曲率信息分解为"曲率远离零"与"曲率方向预先指定"两个角色,并给出刻画该概念的下降-上升不等式(DAI)族及相应算法ADA。
AI.motivation: 经典强凸最小化与强凸-强凹优化模型将两类曲率信息糅合在一起:曲率一致地远离零,且其正负方向事先给定。作者希望将这两者解耦,保留"远离零"的性质,同时允许曲率方向在定义域内变化,以刻画更广泛的一阶结构。
AI.method: 提出一致非退化(uniform nondegeneracy)框架,并识别出一族下降-上升不等式(Distal-Ascent Inequalities, DAI)来刻画该性质;基于DAI自然导出交替下降上升(Alternating Descent Ascent, ADA)方法,该方法交替执行全梯度下降与上升步骤,是一种简单显式方法。
AI.result: ADA从任意初始化出发都能全局且线性收敛到唯一驻点,且其一阶复杂度与维度无关(dimension-free)。该框架在极限情形下可恢复光滑强凸设定,并涵盖强凸-强凹设定与线性约束设定。
AI.conclusion: 一致非退化揭示了强凸-强凹、线性约束等多种经典设定背后共同的一阶结构,表明它是一种统一各类经典优化范式的广义曲率框架。

title: EXISTENCE AND UPPER BOUNDS OF FUNDAMENTAL SOLUTIONS TO KINETIC EQUATIONS WITH ROUGH NON-LOCAL DIFFUSION
summary: We study the fundamental solution operators associated to Kolmogorov equations with symmetric non-local diffusion with rough kernels. We prove that these operators are induced by measurable kernels and prove sharp upper bounds in terms of a kinetic profile governed by the interplay of transport and non-local diffusion. Our proof combines the small-jump with loss decomposition of P.-A. Meyer with the ideas of Nash. The proof is purely analytic.

AI.tldr: 研究含粗糙核对称非局部扩散的Kolmogorov方程基本解算子，证明其由可测核诱导，并给出由输运与非局部扩散相互作用决定的动力学剖面的尖锐上界。
AI.motivation: 既有关于Kolmogorov方程基本解的研究多针对局部扩散或光滑核情形，对含粗糙核的对称非局部扩散缺乏基本解核的存在性与尖锐上界刻画，尤其是输运与非局部扩散相互作用的定量刻画尚不清晰。
AI.method: 将P.-A. Meyer的小跳-损失（small-jump with loss）分解与Nash的思想相结合，采用纯解析方法处理粗糙核下的非局部扩散与输运耦合。
AI.result: 证明基本解算子由可测核诱导，并得到以动力学剖面表达的尖锐上界，该剖面由输运与非局部扩散的相互作用决定。
