AI.conclusion: 为粗糙核非局部Kolmogorov方程建立了基本解核的存在性与尖锐估计，表明Nash型方法与Meyer分解可用于非局部输运-扩散耦合问题的纯解析处理。

title: Optimizer Geometry Sets the Pace: Spectral Learning Dynamics in Matrix Factorization
summary: Recent successes of matrix- and curvature-based optimizers have renewed interest in how update geometry shapes learning. These methods normalize or precondition updates, changing how different components progress during training. In deep matrix factorization, the geometry that slows gradient descent (GD) favors low-rank solutions by delaying the emergence of small singular modes. This raises the question of what remains of that spectral bias when normalization or curvature correction weakens or removes the slowdown. We study how optimizer geometry and depth jointly govern this behavior through a common framework for singular mode dynamics. Under explicit balance and alignment assumptions, we derive birth, saturation, and decay laws for Euclidean GD, coordinate-wise updates of SignGD and an instantaneous Adam approximation, spectral updates of Muon and cumulative Shampoo, and a block curvature model of K-FAC. The resulting picture is not a simple ordering from stronger to weaker low-rank bias. To highlight, SignGD and ideal Muon eliminate the divergent birth barrier and drive unsupported modes to zero in finite time. Cumulative Shampoo initially retains GD's depth-dependent barrier, then accumulated gradients produce a catch-up phase while making previously active modes increasingly persistent. Undamped K-FAC cancels the factorization-induced slowdown while preserving the ordering of the target singular values, whereas positive damping introduces a spectral threshold below which the slow GD phase laws reappear. These results give normalization, accumulated state, damping, and depth a direct interpretation as controls determining when modes emerge, persist, and disappear during training.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过统一框架分析优化器几何与深度如何共同决定奇异模动力学，揭示归一化、累积状态、阻尼和深度是控制模涌现、持续与消失的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 矩阵与曲率优化器的成功重新引发对更新几何如何塑造学习的关注；在深度矩阵分解中，延缓梯度下降的几何通过延迟小奇异模涌现而偏好低秩解，需探究当归一化或曲率修正削弱或移除这种减速后，光谱偏置会如何变化。
AI.method: 在显式平衡与对齐假设下，为多种优化器建立奇异模动力学的统一框架，推导出生、饱和与衰减定律，涵盖欧氏GD、SignGD和瞬时Adam近似、Muon和累积Shampoo、以及K-FAC块曲率模型。
AI.result: 结果并非简单的低秩偏置强弱排序。SignGD和理想Muon消除发散的出生屏障并有限时间驱动无支撑模归零；累积Shampoo初期保留GD的深度相关屏障，随后累积梯度产生追赶阶段并使活跃模更持久；无阻尼K-FAC取消分解诱导的减速但保持目标奇异值顺序，正阻尼引入光谱阈值使慢GD相律重现。
AI.conclusion: 归一化、累积状态、阻尼与深度可被直接解释为控制模训练中涌现、持续和消失的调节因素。

title: Half-Hop: A graph upsampling approach for slowing down message passing
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICML 2023
summary: Message passing neural networks have shown a lot of success on graph-structured data. However, there are many instances where message passing can lead to over-smoothing or fail when neighboring nodes belong to different classes. In this work, we introduce a simple yet general framework for improving learning in message passing neural networks. Our approach essentially upsamples edges in the original graph by adding "slow nodes" at each edge that can mediate communication between a source and a target node. Our method only modifies the input graph, making it plug-and-play and easy to use with existing models. To understand the benefits of slowing down message passing, we provide theoretical and empirical analyses. We report results on several supervised and self-supervised benchmarks, and show improvements across the board, notably in heterophilic conditions where adjacent nodes are more likely to have different labels. Finally, we show how our approach can be used to generate augmentations for self-supervised learning, where slow nodes are randomly introduced into different edges in the graph to generate multi-scale views with variable path lengths.

AI.tldr: 提出在图的每条边上插入"慢节点"以减缓消息传递的通用即插即用框架，在监督与自监督基准上普遍提升，尤其在同配性差的异配图上。
AI.motivation: 消息传递神经网络在图结构数据上表现优异，但存在过平滑问题，且当相邻节点属于不同类别（异配条件）时表现不佳，需要一种通用的改进手段。
AI.method: 通过在原始图每条边上添加"慢节点"对边进行上采样，使源节点与目标节点之间通过中间节点间接通信，从而减缓消息传递；方法仅修改输入图，与现有模型即插即用兼容。并为"减缓消息传递"的好处提供理论与实证分析。
AI.result: 在多个监督与自监督基准上均取得一致提升，在相邻节点更可能具有不同标签的异配条件下提升尤为显著；同时慢节点可随机插入不同边以生成变路径长度的多尺度视图，用于自监督学习的增广。
AI.conclusion: 通过边上的慢节点减缓消息传递是一种简单、通用且有效的图学习增强策略，既能缓解过平滑与异配难题，又能自然支持自监督增广视图生成。

title: Energy dissipation and free boundary stability of the Stefan problem
summary: In this paper we prove the stability and the continuity of the free boundaries of two-phase and one-phase weak solutions to the Stefan problem in any dimension. Our proof has two main ingredients. The first one is an energy conservation principle for weak solutions that we derive for general domains in both the one-phase and the two-phase settings; this energy conservation principle provides the modulus of continuity for the displacement of the free boundary and is a flexible tool for analyzing long-time behavior of solutions. The second key ingredient for the control of the displacement of the free boundary is a new lower density bound for the melting region at free boundary points that move with maximal velocity. We also discuss some applications, showing a series of qualitative and quantitative results on the asymptotic behavior of weak solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文证明Stefan问题中两相与单相弱解自由边界的稳定性与连续性（任意维），并给出渐近行为的定性与定量结果。
AI.motivation: Stefan问题自由边界的正则性与稳定性是核心问题，尤其缺乏对弱解自由边界位移的普适控制工具及长时间行为的系统分析。
AI.method: 两个关键要素：一是为一般区域单相与两相弱解建立能量守恒原理，由此得到自由边界位移的连续模；二是针对以最大速度运动的自由边界点，给出熔化区域的新下密度界。
AI.result: 在任意维获得两相与单相弱解自由边界的稳定性与连续性；能量守恒原理为自由边界位移提供连续模，成为分析长时间行为的灵活工具；新下密度界实现了对自由边界位移的控制。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一处理单相与两相情形，导出弱解渐近行为的一系列定性与定量结论。

title: A Hand-Checkable Proof That Two Hidden ReLU Layers Compute the Maximum of Six Numbers
summary: Exactly computing the maximum function is a standard test case for studying depth in ReLU networks. Two hidden layers are known to suffice for up to twelve inputs through computer-assisted constructions. For six real inputs, we give an explicit hexagon identity whose local structure yields a self-contained analytical proof of this depth bound. The identity was found by computer-assisted search; we prove it through explicit cancellations that can be checked entirely by hand, without executing a verification program. The identity also yields an explicit network with hidden widths $17$ and $41$, zero biases, and rational weights.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 ReLU 网络计算 max 函数所需的深度问题，给出六个实输入的显式 hexagon 恒等式，从而提供该深度上界（两层隐藏层）的独立解析证明。
AI.motivation: max 函数的精确计算是研究 ReLU 网络深度的标准测试问题；已知计算机辅助构造表明两层隐藏层可支持最多十二个输入，但六输入情形缺乏简洁、可人工验证的显式证明。
AI.method: 通过计算机辅助搜索发现一个 hexagon 恒等式，并利用显式抵消（cancellation）方法给出完全可手工核验的解析证明，不依赖验证程序。
AI.result: 该恒等式给出了六个实输入下 max 函数的两层隐藏层构造的解析证明，并显式构造出一个隐藏层宽度为 17 和 41、零偏置、有理权重的网络。
AI.conclusion: 研究为六输入 max 函数的两层深度上界提供了不依赖计算机验证的简洁自洽证明，且给出了具体的宽窄与权重参数。

title: Decoding-time Realignment of Language Models
comment: In Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2024)
summary: Aligning language models with human preferences is crucial for reducing errors and biases in these models. Alignment techniques, such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), are typically cast as optimizing a tradeoff between human preference rewards and a proximity regularization term that encourages staying close to the unaligned model. Selecting an appropriate level of regularization is critical: insufficient regularization can lead to reduced model capabilities due to reward hacking, whereas excessive regularization hinders alignment. Traditional methods for finding the optimal regularization level require retraining multiple models with varying regularization strengths. This process, however, is resource-intensive, especially for large models. To address this challenge, we propose decoding-time realignment (DeRa), a simple method to explore and evaluate different regularization strengths in aligned models without retraining. DeRa enables control over the degree of alignment, allowing users to smoothly transition between unaligned and aligned models. It also enhances the efficiency of hyperparameter tuning by enabling the identification of effective regularization strengths using a validation dataset.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出解码时重对齐（DeRa），一种无需重新训练即可在对齐模型中探索和评估不同正则化强度的方法，实现对齐程度的平滑控制并提升超参数调优效率。
AI.motivation: 语言模型与人类偏好对齐至关重要，可减少错误与偏见。RLHF等对齐方法通常需要在对齐奖励与接近未对齐模型的邻近正则化项之间权衡。正则化强度选择十分关键：不足会导致奖励攻击削弱模型能力，过强则妨碍对齐。而传统方法需以不同正则化强度训练多个模型，资源消耗巨大，尤其对大模型。
AI.method: 提出解码时重对齐（DeRa）：一种在解码阶段即可探索和评估不同正则化强度的简单方法，无需重新训练模型。
AI.result: DeRa 能够控制对齐程度，使用户可在未对齐模型与已对齐模型之间平滑过渡；同时借助验证数据集识别有效正则化强度，提升超参数调优效率。
AI.conclusion: DeRa 为对齐正则化强度的探索与调优提供了一种无需重训练的高效方案，兼顾对齐控制与资源节约。

title: Cross-Trait Transfer in Subliminal Learning
comment: 38 pages, including references and appendices. Code: https://github.com/PeterXingyuZhao/cross-trait-transfer
summary: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon where a student language model acquires a teacher model's behavioral traits by training on semantically unrelated outputs. It is a subtle statistical phenomenon as trait transmission relies on weak statistical patterns in the generated data. To understand trait transmission between teacher-student pairs, we study cross-trait transfer: how data generated under one teacher trait changes the student's preferences of other traits. To this end, we introduce a directed trait-transfer matrix that quantifies these effects using log-probability gains for student answers. We find that the trait-transfer matrix reveals clusters of related traits, with students sometimes developing preferences for traits similar, but not identical, to the teacher's trait. Such cross-trait structure can be partially captured by output distribution metrics and representation-based metrics. Further, we analyze trait development and interaction: learning dynamics shows a progression from broad shared shifts toward more trait-specific transfer, and multi-trait experiments suggest that opposed traits can enhance such differentiation. Together, our findings reveal salient statistical structures over trait transfer and competition, thus providing a broader view of how hidden preferences are transmitted in subliminal learning.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"定向特质迁移矩阵"，用对数概率增益量化教师模型某一特质数据对学生其他特质偏好的跨特质迁移效应，揭示特质聚类结构、学习动态及多特质交互规律。
AI.motivation: 潜意识学习中学生模型通过语义无关输出习得教师行为特质，但特质迁移依赖弱统计模式，机制微妙。研究旨在理解师生对之间特质如何传递，特别是跨特质迁移现象。
AI.method: 引入定向特质迁移矩阵，基于学生答案的对数概率增益量化跨特质效应；结合输出分布度量与表征度量分析；开展学习动态跟踪及多特质实验。
AI.result: 迁移矩阵呈现相关特质的聚类结构，学生有时发展出与教师特质相似但不完全相同的偏好；该跨特质结构可被输出分布度量与表征度量部分捕捉；学习动态显示从广泛共享偏移向特质特异迁移演进；对立特质在多特质实验中可增强这种分化。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了特质迁移与竞争中的显著统计结构，为理解潜意识学习中隐藏偏好的传递提供了更广阔的视角。

title: Generalized Preference Optimization: A Unified Approach to Offline Alignment
summary: Offline preference optimization allows fine-tuning large models directly from offline data, and has proved effective in recent alignment practices. We propose generalized preference optimization (GPO), a family of offline losses parameterized by a general class of convex functions. GPO enables a unified view over preference optimization, encompassing existing algorithms such as DPO, IPO and SLiC as special cases, while naturally introducing new variants. The GPO framework also sheds light on how offline algorithms enforce regularization, through the design of the convex function that defines the loss. Our analysis and experiments reveal the connections and subtle differences between the offline regularization and the KL divergence regularization intended by the canonical RLHF formulation. In a controlled setting akin to Gao et al 2023, we also show that different GPO variants achieve similar trade-offs between regularization and performance, though the optimal values of hyper-parameter might differ as predicted by theory. In all, our results present new algorithmic toolkits and empirical insights to alignment practitioners.

AI.tldr: 本文提出广义偏好优化（GPO），用一类凸函数参数化的离线损失统一了 DPO、IPO、SLiC 等现有算法，并可自然导出新变体，同时揭示了离线正则化与 RLHF 中 KL 正则化的联系与差异。
AI.motivation: 离线偏好优化已在对齐实践中被证明有效，但现有算法（如 DPO、IPO、SLiC）各自独立、缺乏统一理论视角；同时离线算法如何施加正则化、其与标准 RLHF 中 KL 正则化的关系尚不清晰。作者希望建立一个统一框架来解释并扩展这些方法。
AI.method: 提出 GPO 框架：将离线偏好损失表示为由一般凸函数类参数化的函数族。通过选择不同凸函数，可将 DPO、IPO、SLiC 等作为特例纳入统一视图，并自然产生新变体；同时借助凸函数的设计来分析离线算法的正则化机制。在类似 Gao et al. 2023 的受控实验环境中，比较不同 GPO 变体在正则化与性能之间的权衡。
AI.result: 理论分析揭示了离线正则化与规范 RLHF 所意图的 KL 散度正则化之间的联系与细微差异；受控实验表明不同 GPO 变体在正则化—性能权衡上表现相似，但最优超参数取值可能不同，且与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: GPO 为偏好优化提供了统一视角与新的算法工具箱，并为对齐实践者带来了关于正则化设计与超参数选择的经验性洞见。

title: Model-Guided Design of Nanoparticle Dispersity through Process-Chain Optimization
summary: The design of high-quality nanoparticles requires the production of materials with narrow particle size distributions, as these strongly influence the functionalities of the final product. To achieve this goal, it is useful to consider a coupled process chain in which nanoparticles are first synthesized and subsequently fractionated by chromatographic separation. We introduce a novel mathematical optimization model for the integrated optimization of coupled nanoparticle synthesis and separation processes. The proposed model simultaneously accounts for process performance and economic objectives through a cost function that incorporates both production costs and achievable profit defined by the particle quality. For efficient evaluation of the synthesis model, we employ the exact method of moments. The resulting non-convex process-design problem is solved numerically using local optimization. Optimization results of our approach are demonstrated for the prototypical design of gold nanoparticles. The computational results show that optimized solutions of the coupled synthesis--separation process are capable of accurately representing both process stages while achieving optimized particle quality. The proposed model highlights the potential of mathematical optimization for the design of coupled nanoparticle production process-chains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个耦合"纳米颗粒合成—色谱分离"过程的数学优化模型，采用矩量法精确求解合成模型，以局部优化数值求解非凸过程设计问题，并以金纳米颗粒为原型验证，表明优化解能兼顾两阶段过程性能与颗粒质量。
AI.motivation: 高质量纳米颗粒需要窄粒径分布，而粒径分布显著影响最终产品功能。单一合成步骤难以精确控制分布，因此需要考虑"合成+色谱分级"的耦合过程链，但缺乏对这类耦合过程进行集成优化的数学方法。
AI.method: 构建耦合纳米颗粒合成与分离过程的集成数学优化模型；通过包含生产成本与由颗粒质量决定的可实现利润的成本函数，同时兼顾过程性能与经济目标；采用精确矩量法（method of moments）高效评估合成模型；对所得非凸过程设计问题使用局部优化进行数值求解，并以金纳米颗粒的原型设计进行算例验证。
AI.result: 计算结果表明，耦合合成—分离过程的优化解能够准确刻画两个过程阶段，并实现优化的颗粒质量；验证了模型在纳米颗粒过程链设计中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提模型展示了数学优化在耦合纳米颗粒生产过程链设计中的潜力，为兼顾过程性能与经济性的集成设计提供了可行途径。

title: Dispersion for the Schrödinger equation inside strictly convex domains: the general case
summary: We consider a general smooth bounded strictly convex domain $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ of dimension $d\geq2$ and describe dispersion for the semiclassical Schrödinger equation with Dirichlet boundary condition. Our results hold more generally on compact smooth Riemannian manifolds with smooth strictly convex boundary. More specifically, we construct a sharp local in (semiclassical) time parametrix and then proceed to obtain dispersion estimates: our fixed-time decay rate for the Green function exhibits a loss of $1/4$ in the exponent of $h/t$ with respect to the boundaryless case. The loss is sharp for dispersion, as shown earlier by the first author in the case of a model convex domain. On compact three-dimensional manifolds with smooth strictly convex boundary, the resulting spectrally localized Strichartz estimates yield global well-posedness in the energy space for the defocusing cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation, thus matching the corresponding result for boundaryless manifolds due to Burq-Gérard-Tzvetkov. Moreover, we extend bounds on the time growth of higher Sobolev norms from Planchon-Visciglia-Tzvetkov to our setting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了严格凸区域上带Dirichlet边界条件的半经典Schrödinger方程的色散现象，构造了尖锐的局部时间参数并给出色散估计；Green函数衰减率相比无边界情形在$h/t$指数上损失$1/4$，该损失是尖锐的；在三维紧流形上得到全局适定性与高Sobolev范数增长界。
AI.motivation: 研究有边界区域上Schrödinger方程的色散行为。此前无边界情形的结果（如Burq-Gérard-Tzvetkov）较为完善，而边界的存在会改变色散性质，需要刻画这种影响并量化衰减损失，同时将非线性Schrödinger方程的适定性与高Sobolev范数增长结果推广到带严格凸边界的情形。
AI.method: 在一般光滑有界严格凸区域$\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^d$（$d\geq2$）以及具光滑严格凸边界的紧光滑Riemannian流形上，采用半经典分析方法，构造尖锐的局部时间参量（parametrix），据此推导色散估计，并将谱局部化的Strichartz估计应用于非线性问题。
AI.result: 得到的固定时间Green函数衰减率相比无边界情形在$h/t$指数上损失$1/4$，且该损失对色散是尖锐的（由第一作者在模型凸区域情形证明）。在三维紧流形上，谱局部化Strichartz估计给出聚焦三次非线性Schrödinger方程在能量空间中的全局适定性，与无边界情形Burq-Gérard-Tzvetkov的结果相匹配；同时将Planchon-Visciglia-Tzvetkov的高Sobolev范数时间增长界推广到本情形。
AI.conclusion: 在严格凸边界区域上，边界导致Schrödinger方程色散衰减相比无边界情形出现$1/4$的指数损失，且该损失不可改进；利用谱局部化Strichartz估计可将无边界情形的非线性适定性与高Sobolev范数增长结果推广到带严格凸边界的流形。

title: Adaptive Bregman Alternating Projections for Feasible Gromov-Wasserstein Learning
summary: The Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) problem compares structured distributions without requiring a shared feature space or known correspondences, but its nonconvex objective and coupled marginal constraints make computation challenging. Bregman alternating projected gradient (BAPG) uses inexpensive alternating row and column updates, yet its fixed-penalty relaxation leaves a persistent feasibility gap. We propose Adaptive KL-BAPG (A-KL-BAPG), which combines a finite fixed-penalty burn-in with a guarded increasing-penalty phase. At each tail iteration, the method reuses BAPG's alternating updates and backtracks a delayed-power step until a Sinkhorn-inspired projective-diameter safeguard is satisfied. We prove finite termination of the backtracking at each iteration and show that the feasibility gap vanishes asymptotically. We further establish a best-iterate $O(1/\log N)$ bound for the weighted squared corrected residual and, under a support regularity condition, the existence of a stationary accumulation point for the original GW problem. This distinguishes A-KL-BAPG from fixed-penalty BAPG, whose stationarity guarantees are given for the relaxed problem. Experiments show that A-KL-BAPG achieves a favorable balance of accuracy, objective value, feasibility, and stationarity relative to BAPG variants, projection-based methods, and task-specific baselines. For synthetic and real graph alignment problems, it closely matches the accuracy and objective value of fixed-penalty KL-BAPG while reducing the marginal feasibility gap by 62-99% and the projected stationarity residual by 28-98%. Heterogeneous domain adaptation experiments show a similar pattern: A-KL-BAPG maintains comparable target accuracy and objective values while achieving better feasibility and stationarity than fixed-penalty KL-BAPG.

AI.tldr: 提出A-KL-BAPG方法，通过自适应增罚策略消除BAPG的可行性差距，理论上证明可行性差距渐近消失并给出O(1/log N)收敛界与原问题驻点存在性。
AI.motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein问题因非凸目标与耦合边缘约束而难以求解；BAPG虽用廉价的交替行列更新，但其固定惩罚松弛会留下持续的可行性差距（feasibility gap），且其驻点保证仅针对松弛问题而非原始GW问题。
AI.method: 提出A-KL-BAPG：先用有限阶段的固定惩罚"预热"（burn-in），再进入带保护的递增惩罚阶段。尾部每次迭代复用BAPG的交替更新，并对延迟幂次步（delayed-power step）回溯，直至满足受Sinkhorn启发的投影直径（projective-diameter）保障条件。
AI.result: 证明每次迭代回溯有限步终止、可行性差距渐近消失；建立加权平方修正残差的最优迭代O(1/log N)界，并在支撑正则条件下证明原GW问题存在驻点聚点。实验显示其在精度、目标值、可行性与驻点性间取得更好平衡：图对齐任务中精度与目标值接近固定惩罚KL-BAPG，但边缘可行性差距降低62-99%、投影驻点残差降低28-98%；异质域适应任务呈类似趋势。
AI.conclusion: A-KL-BAPG通过自适应增罚+回溯保护机制，在保持BAPG计算廉价性的同时消除了固定惩罚的可行性差距，并将驻点保证从松弛问题提升到原GW问题，实验上实现精度、目标值、可行性与驻点性的更优平衡。

title: Understanding the performance gap between online and offline alignment algorithms
summary: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) is the canonical framework for large language model alignment. However, rising popularity in offline alignment algorithms challenge the need for on-policy sampling in RLHF. Within the context of reward over-optimization, we start with an opening set of experiments that demonstrate the clear advantage of online methods over offline methods. This prompts us to investigate the causes to the performance discrepancy through a series of carefully designed experimental ablations. We show empirically that hypotheses such as offline data coverage and data quality by itself cannot convincingly explain the performance difference. We also find that while offline algorithms train policy to become good at pairwise classification, it is worse at generations; in the meantime the policies trained by online algorithms are good at generations while worse at pairwise classification. This hints at a unique interplay between discriminative and generative capabilities, which is greatly impacted by the sampling process. Lastly, we observe that the performance discrepancy persists for both contrastive and non-contrastive loss functions, and appears not to be addressed by simply scaling up policy networks. Taken together, our study sheds light on the pivotal role of on-policy sampling in AI alignment, and hints at certain fundamental challenges of offline alignment algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一系列对照实验证明在线RLHF方法在奖励过度优化场景下明显优于离线对齐方法，并揭示该差距难以用数据覆盖度、数据质量或策略网络规模解释，而与采样过程对判别/生成能力的影响密切相关。
AI.motivation: 离线对齐算法日益流行，挑战了RLHF中在线策略采样是否必要的传统认知。作者希望厘清在线方法与离线方法性能差异的根源，以明确on-policy采样在AI对齐中的关键作用。
AI.method: 在奖励过度优化（reward over-optimization）背景下，先设计一组开场实验对比在线与离线方法；随后进行一系列精心设计的消融实验，检验离线数据覆盖度、数据质量等假设，并考察策略的成对分类能力与生成能力、对比与非对比损失函数，以及策略网络规模扩展的影响。
AI.result: 在线方法明显优于离线方法；数据覆盖度和数据质量本身无法充分解释性能差异；离线算法训练的策略擅长成对分类但生成较差，在线算法则相反；该性能差距在对比与非对比损失下均持续存在，且单纯扩大策略网络规模并未消除差距。
AI.conclusion: on-policy采样在AI对齐中扮演关键角色，离线对齐算法面临某些根本性挑战；判别能力与生成能力之间存在受采样过程显著影响的独特相互作用。

title: Note on the Exponential Stability of the Viscoelastic Wave Equation
summary: In this article, we study the viscoelastic wave equation with a localized history memory term, and without frictional damping. Under the geometric control condition on the memory region, we prove exponential decay of the viscoelastic energy using the Gearhart-Pr{ü}ss-Huang Theorem. We prove in high frequency that a loss of derivative is compensated by a decay in frequency.

AI.tldr: 研究具有局部历史记忆项且无摩擦阻尼的粘弹性波动方程，在记忆区域的几何控制条件下，利用Gearhart-Prüss-Huang定理证明了粘弹性能量的指数衰减，并证明高频下导数的损失由频率的衰减补偿。
AI.motivation: 粘弹性波动方程的稳定性通常依赖摩擦阻尼或全局记忆项。该文关注更困难的情形：仅有局部历史记忆项而无摩擦阻尼，探讨在何种几何条件下仍能获得指数衰减。
AI.method: 对带局部历史记忆项的粘弹性波动方程，在记忆区域施加几何控制条件，运用Gearhart-Prüss-Huang定理作为主要分析工具来建立能量衰减估计。
AI.result: 在记忆区域的几何控制条件下，证明了粘弹性能量的指数衰减；并证明在高频情形下，导数的损失可由频率的衰减来补偿。
AI.conclusion: 局部历史记忆项在几何控制条件下足以保证无摩擦阻尼粘弹性系统的指数稳定性，高频分析中导数损失与频率衰减形成补偿关系。

title: Rigidity results for Euler flows in two dimensional exterior domains
summary: We study steady solutions of the two dimensional incompressible Euler equations in the exterior of a compact domain. We assume that fluid enters the exterior domain through every point of the obstacle boundary. Under suitable assumptions on the direction and decay of the velocity at infinity, we prove that the flow is irrotational if and only if the velocity has no stagnation points.

AI.tldr: 研究二维不可压缩Euler方程在紧致区域外部的定常解，证明在无穷远速度方向与衰减假设下，无旋性等价于速度无驻点。
AI.motivation: 探讨外部区域定常Euler流动中旋涡结构与驻点之间的关系，理解障碍物绕流问题中无旋条件的充要刻画。
AI.method: 假设流体在障碍物边界每一点流入外部区域，并对无穷远处速度的方向和衰减施加适当条件，通过分析定常Euler方程的解结构建立无旋性与驻点存在性的等价关系。
AI.result: 证明了：在给定假设下，流动无旋当且仅当速度场没有驻点。
AI.conclusion: 外部区域绕流问题中，驻点的缺失可作为流动无旋的充要判据。

title: Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning: Enhancing Agent Security against Prompt Injection Attacks from Failure Experience
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in tool-augmented environments, but their reliance on external inputs makes them highly vulnerable to prompt injection attacks that can hijack task objectives. Existing safety alignment methods rely on static expert trajectories or preference optimization, limiting their ability to generalize to adaptive attack patterns. In this work, we propose Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning (SRFT), a training framework that enables agents to improve robustness by learning from their own failure experiences under adversarial conditions. Instead of passively imitating expert behaviors, SRFT exposes the agent to compromised trajectories constructed via injected attacks, and leverages an expert model to generate structured self-reflection reasoning that contrasts unsafe and optimal actions. This reflective supervision teaches the agent to identify malicious instructions, reason about their consequences, and maintain alignment with the original user intent. We instantiate this framework in SR-Agent, built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B, and evaluate it on both static and adaptive prompt injection benchmarks. Experimental results show that SRFT substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving task performance, and demonstrates strong generalization under adaptive attacks. These findings suggest that learning from failure via self-reflection is a promising direction for building robust and secure LLM agents. Our code is released at https://github.com/Eden-Wang1710/srft-repo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自反思微调（SRFT）框架，通过让LLM智能体在对抗条件下从自身失败轨迹中学习结构化反思，从而提升对提示注入攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在工具增强环境中依赖外部输入，易受提示注入攻击而偏离任务目标；现有安全对齐方法依赖静态专家轨迹或偏好优化，难以泛化到自适应攻击模式。
AI.method: SRFT主动将智能体暴露于注入攻击构建的被污染轨迹，并利用专家模型生成对比“不安全动作”与“最优动作”的结构化自反思推理，通过反思式监督教会智能体识别恶意指令、推理后果并保持与原始用户意图一致。实例化为SR-Agent，基于Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen3-8B构建。
AI.result: 在静态与自适应提示注入基准上，SRFT显著降低攻击成功率，同时保持任务性能，并在自适应攻击下展现强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过自反思从失败中学习是构建鲁棒且安全LLM智能体的有前景方向，代码已开源。

title: Preference Optimization with Multi-Sample Comparisons
summary: Recent advancements in generative models, particularly large language models (LLMs) and diffusion models, have been driven by extensive pretraining on large datasets followed by post-training. However, current post-training methods such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and direct alignment from preference methods (DAP) primarily utilize single-sample comparisons. These approaches often fail to capture critical characteristics such as generative diversity and bias, which are more accurately assessed through multiple samples. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel approach that extends post-training to include multi-sample comparisons. To achieve this, we propose Multi-sample Direct Preference Optimization (mDPO) and Multi-sample Identity Preference Optimization (mIPO). These methods improve traditional DAP methods by focusing on group-wise characteristics. Empirically, we demonstrate that multi-sample comparison is more effective in optimizing collective characteristics~(e.g., diversity and bias) for generative models than single-sample comparison. Additionally, our findings suggest that multi-sample comparisons provide a more robust optimization framework, particularly for dataset with label noise.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对现有后训练方法（RLHF、DAP）仅依赖单样本比较、难以刻画生成多样性与偏见等群体特性的问题，提出将后训练扩展到多样本比较，并提出多样本直接偏好优化（mDPO）与多样本恒等偏好优化（mIPO）两种方法。实验表明多样本比较在优化生成模型的集体特性上更有效，且对含标签噪声的数据集具有更强的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 生成模型（LLMs与扩散模型）的后训练方法如RLHF和DAP主要基于单样本比较，无法有效捕捉生成多样性、偏见等更适合用多样本评估的关键特性，因此需要将后训练扩展到多样本比较。
AI.method: 提出两种扩展DAP的方法：多样本直接偏好优化（mDPO）与多样本恒等偏好优化（mIPO），通过关注群体（group-wise）特性来改进传统DAP方法。
AI.result: 实验证明多样本比较在优化生成模型的集体特性（如多样性、偏见）方面比单样本比较更有效；同时多样本比较提供了更稳健的优化框架，尤其在含标签噪声的数据集上表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 多样本比较是后训练中优化集体特性并提升鲁棒性的有效范式，mDPO与mIPO为其提供了具体实现路径。

title: Learning controls in mean field games: the fictitious play and related gradient descent
summary: We investigate two learning procedures and their relationship to the formation of equilibrium in potential mean field games (MFGs). The first one is a version of the fictitious play in which players observe directly the actions (controls) of other players and learn the distribution of the MFG through an update rules on controls. This leads to a new iterative procedure which converges for a wide class of potential MFGs of controls, even in the presence of common noise. On the other hand we also consider the learning procedure of a principal agent trying to solve a mean field control problem with only local gradient information. We prove that under very general assumption, the gradient descent of such agent converges to a solution of the associated potential MFG.

AI.tldr: 本文研究势能平均场博弈(MFG)中两种学习过程及其与均衡形成的关系：一是基于控制量更新的虚拟对弈，收敛于一类广泛的势能MFG(含共同噪声)；二是仅依赖局部梯度信息的主体的梯度下降，收敛于相关势能MFG的解。
AI.motivation: 探讨学习动态如何导致势能平均场博弈均衡的形成，并厘清虚拟对弈类学习与平均场控制中梯度型学习之间的联系。
AI.method: 构造在控制(动作)分布上进行更新的虚拟对弈迭代算法，并在存在共同噪声的势能MFG框架下分析其收敛性；同时考察仅具局部梯度信息的主体求解平均场控制问题的梯度下降过程，证明其收敛到相应势能MFG的解。
AI.result: 所提出的控制更新型迭代对一大类势能MFG(包括带共同噪声情形)收敛；在很一般的假设下，主体的梯度下降收敛到关联势能MFG的解。
AI.conclusion: 两类学习过程均可作为势能平均场博弈均衡形成的机制，表明虚拟对弈式学习与梯度下降式学习在势能MFG中具有一致的收敛性。

title: Hessian operators, null Lagrangians and the integral comparison principle
summary: We investigate the conditions under which a Hessian operator satisfies the integral comparison principle. We establish a rather unexpected connection with the notion of a null Lagrangian from the calculus of variations. Under mild conditions we obtain a complete classification, showing that the only operators for which the integral comparison principle holds are linear combinations of $k$-Hessians and, in the homogeneous case, precisely the $k$-Hessians themselves. An analogous result is established for the complex Hessian operator, revealing in particular substantial obstructions to the development of a genuine pluripotential theory for the $\mathcal{J}$-equation.

AI.tldr: 研究Hessian算子满足积分比较原理的条件，建立其与零拉格朗日量的联系，并给出完整分类。
AI.motivation: 探究Hessian算子何时满足积分比较原理，并寻找其与变分法中已知概念的内在联系，以刻画可行算子类。
AI.method: 利用变分法中零拉格朗日量的概念建立联系，在温和条件下对满足积分比较原理的算子进行分类；并类似地分析复Hessian算子情形。
AI.result: 满足积分比较原理的算子恰为k-Hessian的线性组合；在齐次情形下恰为k-Hessian本身；对复Hessian算子得到类似结果，揭示了为J-方程建立真正多势论理论的实质性障碍。
AI.conclusion: 积分比较原理对Hessian算子的成立条件被完全刻画为k-Hessian（线性组合），复情形下同样受限，表明相关多势论理论的推广存在根本障碍。

title: Rethinking Self-Distillation for Multi-Teacher Capability Merging
summary: Combining capabilities of multiple expert models trained starting from the same base checkpoint has become increasingly common in frontier language-model post-training. Recent trends suggest that multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) outperforms conventional off-policy methods. However, despite the higher inference and environment interaction costs incurred by MOPD, we find that much of its reported accuracy gain is due to certain training design choices and hyperparameter optimization, rather than the algorithm itself. We conduct a controlled self-distillation study across two multi-teacher settings, four models, and eleven benchmarks, comparing off-policy methods, namely supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and soft-label distillation, to hybrid teacher-prefix distillation and MOPD. We found that all four methods achieve \textit{nearly identical} accuracy. However, MOPD uses $14.8$--$23.1\times$ SFT's training GPU-hours. We also revisit four recently published comparisons between on-policy and off-policy distillation and find that the reported on-policy gains shrink substantially when SFT baselines are trained on rejection-sampled teacher trajectories and use independently tuned hyperparameters. As a training-free alternative, we also find that simple weight-merging methods can recover expert capabilities with minutes of CPU merging time, although their accuracy degrades as model size decreases and task interference increases. Overall, our results question recent gains reported due to MOPD and suggest careful tuning of more efficient off-policy baselines as a viable alternative.

AI.tldr: 多教师在线策略蒸馏(MOPD)相对离线策略方法(SFT、软标签蒸馏等)的精度优势在受控比较中几乎消失，主要源于训练设计与超参数优化，而非算法本身；MOPD却耗费14.8–23.1倍SFT的训练GPU时。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型后训练中，融合多个同源专家模型能力已成为常见做法，近期趋势宣称多教师在线策略蒸馏(MOPD)优于传统离线策略方法。但MOPD带来更高的推理与环境交互成本，因此有必要厘清其报告收益究竟来自算法本身还是训练设计与超参数调优。
AI.method: 开展受控自蒸馏研究，覆盖两种多教师设置、四个模型、十一个基准，比较离线策略方法(SFT、软标签蒸馏)与混合教师前缀蒸馏及MOPD；并重新审视四篇已发表的在线/离线策略蒸馏对比；同时评估免训练权重合并(weight merging)作为替代方案。
AI.result: 四种方法精度几乎一致，而MOPD的GPU训练时耗为SFT的14.8–23.1倍。重审的四项研究中，在线策略收益在SFT基线使用拒绝采样教师轨迹与独立调参后大幅缩水。权重合并可在数分钟CPU时间内恢复专家能力，但随模型规模减小与任务干扰增加，精度下降。
AI.conclusion: 结果质疑近期MOPD所报告的收益，建议以精心调优的更高效离线策略基线作为可行替代方案。

title: RL-finetuning LLMs from on- and off-policy data with a single algorithm
summary: We introduce a novel reinforcement learning algorithm (AGRO, for Any-Generation Reward Optimization) for fine-tuning large-language models. AGRO leverages the concept of generation consistency, which states that the optimal policy satisfies the notion of consistency across any possible generation of the model. We derive algorithms that find optimal solutions via the sample-based policy gradient and provide theoretical guarantees on their convergence. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of AGRO in both on-policy and off-policy settings, showing improved performance on the mathematical reasoning dataset over baseline algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGRO——一种基于"生成一致性"概念的强化学习算法,用于大语言模型微调,并给出收敛性理论保证与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型微调需要有效的强化学习算法;作者希望利用"最优策略在模型任意可能生成下均满足一致性"这一性质,构建有理论保障的优化方法。
AI.method: 提出AGRO(Any-Generation Reward Optimization),基于generation consistency假设,通过基于采样的策略梯度(sample-based policy gradient)推导求解最优策略的算法。
AI.result: 在on-policy与off-policy两种设置下均验证有效;在数学推理数据集上相较基线算法取得更优表现。
AI.conclusion: AGRO是一种兼具理论收敛保证与实证有效性的LLM微调强化学习算法,适用于多种策略更新设置。

title: CorleoneGame: A library of biological dynamic games with a companion Julia solver
summary:
Biological agents, from regulatory modules and microbial strains to organisms and populations, act on a common environment while each responds to its own costs, benefits, and limits. A dynamic game makes such interactions explicit by assigning who controls which decision, what each participant values, and which restrictions constrain unilateral deviations.
  We present a library of 25 biological dynamic games with 2 to 10 players spanning molecular, cellular, organismal, and population scales and competitive, antagonistic, mutualistic, and regulatory interactions. Instances cover single seasons, cycles that return to their initial state, or episodic tasks; seven include duration choice and some players' feasible sets are coupled. For each game we provide biological motivation, an executable Julia specification with player-owned controls, objectives and restrictions, a parameter instance, and a reference open-loop generalized Nash equilibrium candidate with interpreted trajectories.
  The solver CorleoneGame.jl computes candidates by sequential optimal-control best responses and audits them for feasibility and profitable unilateral deviations on a coarse and a refined control grid. All 25 reference computations satisfy the audit tolerances on both grids. Using a plant--herbivore game as a running example, we show how an executable specification yields an audited reference candidate that qualitatively reproduces a published prediction, how biological hypotheses become instance variants with different candidates, and how the candidates generate synthetic data for inverse games.

AI.tldr: 该文发布了一个包含25个生物动态博弈的库，覆盖分子到种群四个尺度及竞争、对抗、互利、调控等相互作用，提供可执行Julia规范、参数实例和参考开环广义Nash均衡候选，并配套求解器CorleoneGame.jl进行可行性与单边偏离审计。
AI.motivation: 生物主体（调控模块、菌株、个体、种群）共用同一环境，却各自按自身成本、收益和约束作出响应；动态博弈可显式刻画谁控制何种决策、各方重视什么、以及限制单边偏离的约束，从而为跨尺度生物相互作用提供统一建模框架。
AI.method: 构建含2至10个玩家的25个生物动态博弈库，横跨分子、细胞、个体和种群尺度；每个博弈给出生物学动机、玩家拥有控制权的可执行Julia规范（含目标与约束）、参数实例及参考开环广义Nash均衡候选；求解器CorleoneGame.jl通过序贯最优控制最佳响应计算候选，并在粗、细控制网格上审计可行性与有利可图的单边偏离。
AI.result: 25个参考计算在两种网格上均满足审计容差；以植物—植食者博弈为贯穿示例，展示了可执行规范如何产生经审计的参考候选并定性复现已发表预测，说明生物学假设如何转化为不同候选的实例变体，以及候选如何生成用于逆向博弈的合成数据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了可执行、可审计的生物动态博弈基准与工具链，将生物学假设映射为实例变体，并通过参考均衡候选支持预测复现与逆向博弈数据生成。

title: Solutions stable outside a compact set for anisotropic quasilinear equations with negative exponent or exponential nonlinearity
summary:
We study the equations $Δ_p^H u=u^{-q}$, $u>0$, and $-Δ_p^H u=e^u$ in $\mathbb{R}^N$, where $Δ_p^H u=\operatorname{div}(H(
abla u)^{p-1}
abla H(
abla u))$ is the Finsler $p$-Laplacian associated with a uniformly convex norm $H$, and $p\ge2$. We prove nonexistence of solutions stable outside a compact set for the negative-power equation when $p\le N< rac{p(p+3)}{p-1}$ and $q$ lies above the sharp critical threshold, and for the exponential equation when $p<N< rac{p(p+3)}{p-1}$. Consequently, neither equation admits solutions of finite Morse index in these ranges. In the borderline case $N=p$, we prove that the solutions of $-Δ_N^H u=e^u$ that are stable outside a compact set are precisely the finite-mass solutions classified by Ciraolo and Li. A main ingredient is independent of stability: if $N>qτ$, where $τ= rac{p}{q+p-1}$, a positive exterior solution of $Δ_p^H u=u^{-q}$ cannot remain above $θ$ times the singular solution near infinity for any $θ>1$. An analogous obstruction holds for the exponential equation. Both obstructions are proved by comparison with explicit radial barriers having frozen right-hand sides. We also prove sharpness when $N>p$, and for the negative-power equation when $N=p>2$. Finally, for operators $\operatorname{div}(B'(H(
abla u))
abla H(
abla u))$ with $p$-growth, we establish the integral estimates needed for the stability arguments with fully justified truncation and absorption procedures. These arguments also repair gaps in earlier proofs for the corresponding isotropic and anisotropic problems.

AI.tldr: 该文研究了Finsler p-Laplacian方程 Δ_p^H u=u^{-q} 与 -Δ_p^H u=e^u 在 R^N 中正解的非存在性与分类，证明在特定指数范围内不存在紧集外稳定的解，从而不存在有限Morse指数解，并给出奇性障碍与径向屏障方法，同时完善了一般 p-增长算子稳定性论证的积分估计。
AI.motivation: 研究Finsler p-Laplacian下两类非线性方程（负幂型与指数型）解的稳定性与Morse指数问题，推广并修补各向同性及各向异性情形中已有的结果与证明漏洞，并厘清临界维数 N=p 的边界情形分类。
AI.method: 通过构造具有冻结右端的显式径向屏障作比较，建立与稳定性无关的奇性障碍；利用该障碍结合稳定性论证证明非存在性；对一般 p-增长算子 div(B'(H(∇u))∇H(∇u)) 建立所需的积分估计，并严格处理截断与吸收过程。
AI.result: 当 p≤N<p(p+3)/(p-1) 且 q 超过尖锐临界阈值时，负幂方程不存在紧集外稳定解；当 p<N<p(p+3)/(p-1) 时，指数方程亦无此类解，因此两方程均无有限Morse指数解。边界情形 N=p 下，-Δ_N^H u=e^u 的紧集外稳定解恰为 Ciraolo 与 Li 分类的有限质量解。还证明了 N>p 时以及 N=p>2 时负幂方程的尖锐性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作完整刻画了Finsler p-Laplacian方程在给定指数范围内的稳定性非存在性，并给出临界维数下的分类结果；所建立的积分估计与截断吸收方法具有独立价值，可修补早期各向同性与各向异性问题证明中的缺陷。

title: Integrated Imputation-Classification for Supervised Learning with Missing Data
summary: We study supervised classification problems with missing feature values. Existing approaches often decouple imputation from classification, producing imputations that may be plausible but uninformative for prediction. Instead, we propose the Integrated Imputation and Classification Network (IICN), which jointly trains an imputer and an ${(n{+}1)}$-classdiscriminator adversarially with a single class supervised classification objective, where the discriminator learns to distinguish among the $n$ true classes and an additional ``imputed" class. We prove that at the global optimum, the imputer and discriminator together implement marginalization over missing coordinates and yield a Bayes-optimal classifier. We evaluate IICN on FashionMNIST, CIFAR-10, and tabular datasets with naturally occurring missingness. IICN outperforms classical impute-then-classify pipelines and recent generative baselines, showing strong robustness and accuracy in challenging settings.

AI.tldr: 提出IICN，将插补器与(n+1)类判别器对抗联合训练，理论上可退化为缺失坐标边缘化并给出贝叶斯最优分类器，实验优于插补-分类流水线及生成式基线。
AI.motivation: 现有缺失特征值的监督分类方法通常将插补与分类解耦，产生的插补值虽然看似合理，但对预测任务未必有信息量。
AI.method: 提出集成插补与分类网络IICN：插补器与一个(n+1)类判别器对抗式联合训练，判别器需区分n个真实类别与一个额外的"插补"类别，训练仅使用单一的分类监督目标。
AI.result: 在FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10及具有自然缺失的表格数据集上评估，IICN优于经典"先插补后分类"流水线及近期生成式基线，在困难场景下表现出较强的鲁棒性与准确率。
AI.conclusion: IICN通过将插补与分类整合到统一对抗框架中，实现了面向预测的插补；理论上在全局最优处退化为对缺失坐标的边缘化并得到贝叶斯最优分类器，实践上验证了其有效性与鲁棒性。

title: Blazing the trails before beating the path: Sample-efficient Monte-Carlo planning
comment: Published in Neural Information Processing Systems 2016
summary: You are a robot and you live in a Markov decision process (MDP) with a finite or an infinite number of transitions from state-action to next states. You got brains and so you plan before you act. Luckily, your roboparents equipped you with a generative model to do some Monte-Carlo planning. The world is waiting for you and you have no time to waste. You want your planning to be efficient. Sample-efficient. Indeed, you want to exploit the possible structure of the MDP by exploring only a subset of states reachable by following near-optimal policies. You want guarantees on sample complexity that depend on a measure of the quantity of near-optimal states. You want something, that is an extension of Monte-Carlo sampling (for estimating an expectation) to problems that alternate maximization (over actions) and expectation (over next states). But you do not want to StOP with exponential running time, you want something simple to implement and computationally efficient. You want it all and you want it now. You want TrailBlazer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TrailBlazer，一种将蒙特卡洛采样从期望估计扩展到交替 max/expectation 问题的规划算法，仅探索近优可达状态子集，从而获得依赖近优状态量的样本复杂度保证。
AI.motivation: 动机：在有限或无限转移的 MDP 中做生成模型下的蒙特卡洛规划时，希望利用 MDP 结构，仅探索近优策略可达的状态子集，实现样本高效并给出样本复杂度保证；同时避免已有的基于 StOP 类算子的指数时间复杂度，要求算法简单、计算高效。
AI.method: 方法：提出 TrailBlazer，将估计期望的蒙特卡洛采样推广到交替进行 max（动作）与 expectation（下一状态）的问题；通过仅沿近优策略可达状态进行采样/探索，引入衡量近优状态数量的度量来刻画复杂度，并以简单、计算可行的方式实现。摘要未给出具体算子细节。
AI.result: 结果：给出了依赖近优状态数量度量的样本复杂度保证，且算法避免了指数运行时间；摘要以宣言式叙述呈现，未报告具体实验或数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 结论：TrailBlazer 可作为 StOP 类方法的实用替代，在保持理论保证的同时具备简单性与计算效率，适用于具有大量状态/转移的蒙特卡洛规划场景。

title: A Lagrange-Newton method for solving optimal control problems on manifolds
summary: In PDE-constrained optimization a control is applied within a partial differential equation (PDE), e.g., as a force field, to achieve a desired configuration of the PDE solution. The objective is usually to find an optimal balance between control cost and deviation of the controlled state from the desired configuration. We consider this problem class in a setting, where the PDE is given by a geometric variational equation and the state is a mapping into a nonlinear manifold. We define a Lagrangian function corresponding to this geometric optimal control problem and derive first-order optimality conditions. Moreover, we present a Lagrange-Newton method for their numerical solution. We introduce an implementable algorithm using a local splitting technique and show its equivalence to Newton's method applied to the derivative of the Lagrangian. The theoretical framework is illustrated by numerical examples, including the optimal control of elastic geodesics and surfaces of minimal energy by force fields and the control of inextensible rods and shells.

AI.tldr: 本文研究几何变分方程约束的优化问题，其中状态为到非线性流形的映射。作者定义拉格朗日函数、推导一阶最优性条件，提出Lagrange-Newton方法及基于局部分裂的可实现算法，并证明其等价于对拉格朗日导数的牛顿法，最后通过弹性测地线、最小能量曲面、不可伸长杆与壳等的数值算例验证理论。
AI.motivation: PDE约束优化通常用于求解控制问题，但现有研究多针对线性或欧氏空间中的PDE，状态为非线性流形映射（如几何变分方程）的情形缺乏系统的拉格朗日框架与高效数值求解方法。本文旨在将PDE约束优化推广到几何变分方程约束，并开发可实现的一阶最优性条件与数值算法。
AI.method: 将控制（力场）嵌入几何变分方程，状态为到非线性流形的映射；构建相应的拉格朗日函数，并推导一阶最优性条件；提出Lagrange-Newton求解方法；进一步引入基于局部分裂技术的可实现算法，并证明该算法等价于对拉格朗日导数应用牛顿法。
AI.result: 建立了几何最优控制问题的拉格朗日框架与一阶最优性条件；给出了Lagrange-Newton方法及可实现算法，并证明了局部分裂算法与对拉格朗日导数牛顿法的等价性；通过数值算例验证，包括力场控制下弹性测地线、最小能量曲面，以及不可伸长杆与壳的控制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为几何变分方程约束的最优控制提供了统一的理论与算法框架，局部分裂技术使算法可实际实现且保持牛顿法的收敛性质，数值算例表明方法对多种几何对象（测地线、曲面、杆、壳）的控制问题有效。

title: Large deviations for mean field particle systems via analysis on spaces of measures
summary: This paper introduces a robust strategy to establish large deviation principles for mean field interacting particle systems in T d with vanishing noise. Viewed as a Freidlin-Wentzell type problem, our approach relies on recent techniques for partial differential equations (in short PDE) on the space of probability measures [5]. We first outline the proof strategy for the PDE approach to large deviations in a self-contained manner. As the number of particles goes to infinity, we then show that the transfer function of the system converges to the unique viscosity solution of a limiting Hamilton-Jacobi equation on the space of probability measures. Finally, we explicitly derive the rate function by formulating the solution of this limiting PDE as the value function of an optimal control problem.

AI.tldr: 本文为消失噪声下 T^d 中平均场相互作用粒子系统建立大偏差原理，采用概率测度空间上 PDE 的 Freidlin-Wentzell 型框架，证明转移函数收敛到极限 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程的粘性解，并将速率函数表示为最优控制问题的值函数。
AI.motivation: 平均场相互作用粒子系统在消失噪声极限下的大偏差原理是 Freidlin-Wentzell 型问题，其核心困难在于如何在概率测度空间上刻画极限速率函数。本文借助概率测度空间上的 PDE 技术，旨在建立一套稳健的推导策略。
AI.method: 采用概率测度空间上的偏微分方程方法：先自洽地概述 PDE 大偏差证明策略；再令粒子数趋于无穷，证明系统转移函数收敛到定义在概率测度空间上的极限 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程的独特粘性解；最后将该极限 PDE 的解表述为最优控制问题的值函数，从而显式给出速率函数。
AI.result: 证明了随粒子数趋于无穷，系统转移函数收敛于概率测度空间上极限 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程的唯一粘性解，并由此显式导出了大偏差速率函数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明概率测度空间上的 PDE 方法是研究平均场粒子系统消失噪声大偏差的有效工具，所建立的策略可将速率函数归结为极限 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程粘性解对应最优控制问题的值函数。

title: Do RUL explanations hold up? Faithfulness and stability of attributions on C-MAPSS
summary: Deep remaining-useful-life (RUL) models on NASA C-MAPSS are now routine, and so are heatmaps that colour sensors and timesteps. A heatmap that looks mechanical is not the same as an explanation an engineer can act on. We train three standard architectures - a 1D CNN, an LSTM, and a small Transformer encoder - on the official FD001 and FD003 splits with the piecewise RUL cap of 125 cycles and the official PHM08 asymmetric score. We then attach three attribution maps (Integrated Gradients, occlusion, last-layer attention) and evaluate them with the checks the XAI-for-PdM literature still under-reports: deletion/insertion faithfulness, Spearman stability under sensor-scale noise, agreement across training seeds, and cosine consistency inside RUL bins. Prediction error is a prerequisite, not the claim. The headline is which explanation method moves the RUL output when its top cells are removed, and which map survives a 5% input perturbation. Integrated Gradients and occlusion are similarly faithful on the LSTM; Transformer attention is cheap and temporally smooth but weakly faithful. All three maps are almost unchanged under 5% input noise, yet IG/occlusion agree only moderately across two LSTM seeds - stability to sensor jitter is not the same as stability to retraining. A secondary tabular check on the AI4I 2020 failure dataset shows the same deletion pattern for tree importances. We recommend occlusion or IG for any C-MAPSS-style report that will be read by a maintenance engineer, and we treat raw attention weights as a visualisation only.

AI.tldr: 在NASA C-MAPSS FD001/FD003上训练1D CNN、LSTM与小型Transformer三种RUL模型，并附加Integrated Gradients、occlusion与末层attention三种归因图，用删除/插入忠实性、传感器尺度噪声下的Spearman稳定性、跨随机种子一致性与RUL分箱内余弦一致性加以评估。结论是occlusion与IG忠实性相当且推荐用于工程师可读的C-MAPSS报告，Transformer attention仅作可视化，且输入噪声稳定性不等同于重训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: C-MAPSS上的深度RUL模型与传感器-时间步热力图已很常见，但"看起来机械"的热力图并不等于工程师可据以行动的 explanation。XAI-for-PdM文献对忠实性、稳定性等检验仍报告不足，作者希望区分可操作的归因方法与仅具视觉效果的热力图，并提供选型建议。预测误差被视为前提而非本文主张。
AI.method: 在官方FD001与FD003划分上训练1D CNN、LSTM与小型Transformer encoder三种标准架构，采用分段RUL上限125周期与PHM08非对称评分。为模型附加三种归因图：Integrated Gradients、occlusion、末层attention。评估检验包括：删除/插入忠实性、传感器尺度噪声下归因的Spearman稳定性、跨训练种子的归因一致性、RUL分箱内的余弦一致性。另在AI4I 2020失效数据集上对树模型重要性做表格型辅助验证。
AI.result: 在LSTM上，Integrated Gradients与occlusion的忠实性相近；Transformer attention计算开销低、时间上平滑，但忠实性较弱。三种归因图在5%输入噪声下几乎不变，但IG/occlusion在两个LSTM随机种子间仅达中等一致，说明对传感器抖动稳定不等于对重训练稳定。AI4I 2020的辅助表格检验显示树模型重要性呈现相同的删除模式。
AI.conclusion: 对任何将被维护工程师阅读的C-MAPSS类报告，推荐使用occlusion或IG，并将原始attention权重仅视为可视化工具。归因方法的报告应同时包含忠实性、噪声稳定性与重训练稳定性，二者不可互相替代。

title: Optimal last-iterate convergence in matrix games with bandit feedback using the log-barrier
summary: We study the problem of learning minimax policies in zero-sum matrix games. Fiegel et al. (2025) recently showed that achieving last-iterate convergence in this setting is harder when the players are uncoupled, by proving a lower bound on the exploitability gap of Omega(t^{-1/4}). Some online mirror descent algorithms were proposed in the literature for this problem, but none have truly attained this rate yet. We show that the use of a log-barrier regularization, along with a dual-focused analysis, allows this O-tilde(t^{-1/4}) convergence with high-probability. We additionally extend our idea to the setting of extensive-form games, proving a bound with the same rate.

AI.tldr: 该文研究零和矩阵博弈中的极小极大策略学习，利用对数障碍正则化与对偶聚焦分析，首次以高概率达到 O~(t^{-1/4}) 的末迭代收敛率，并推广到扩展式博弈。
AI.motivation: Fiegel 等 (2025) 证明在非耦合（uncoupled）设定下，末迭代收敛的下界为 Ω(t^{-1/4})，说明该问题本质上比耦合设定更难。已有文献提出的在线镜像下降类算法尚未真正达到该速率，因此需要设计能够匹配该下界的算法。
AI.method: 采用对数障碍（log-barrier）正则化，并结合“对偶聚焦”（dual-focused）分析框架，对零和矩阵博弈中的极小极大策略学习进行分析；随后将该思路扩展到扩展式博弈（extensive-form games）设定。
AI.result: 理论上证明所提方法能以高概率实现 Õ(t^{-1/4}) 的收敛率，与已有下界匹配；在扩展式博弈中也给出相同速率的界。
AI.conclusion: 对数障碍正则化配合对偶聚焦分析可在非耦合零和矩阵博弈中达到最优末迭代收敛率，且该技术可推广至扩展式博弈，填补了现有算法与该下界之间的差距。

title: Direct Vertex-Derivative Coefficient Propagation forHomogeneous Numerical Integration (HNI)
summary: Homogeneous numerical integration (HNI) combines Euler's identity and Stokes' theorem to integrate homogeneous polynomials over a polytope $P$. Existing algorithms return scalar integrals or reusable moment families. Any resulting moment table can be recoded afterward: once all degree-$q$ moments are known, integration on $\mathcal H\_q$ (degree-$q$ forms) has a trivial representation by a pure order-$q$ distribution supported at any single arbitrary point. Our contribution is instead to propagate functionals through the face complex, once for $(P,q)$ and without first forming the moment vector, to obtain a signed vertex-derivative coefficient functional on $\mathcal H\_q$, specific to $P$ and determined directly by its supplied face geometry and chosen anchors. A finite-dimensional Riesz framework describes its nonuniqueness, gives an intrinsic $L^2(P)$ error for restricted formulas, and supports weighted post-processing. The independently generated degree-$q$ and degree-$2q$ coefficient vectors satisfy an explicit compatibility relation. Vertex anchors can prune the propagated representation as shown in some polygon examples and an offline benchmark quantify this effect without claiming global cardinality optimality or improved conditioning. The construction covers convex polytopes and oriented non-convex polyhedral domains in arbitrary dimension.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种在面复形上直接传播泛函的齐次数值积分(HNI)新构造，避免先形成矩向量，直接得到特定于多面体P的符号顶点导数系数泛函，并用Riesz框架刻画其非唯一性与加权后处理。
AI.motivation: 已有HNI算法只能返回标量积分或可复用的矩族，且矩表需事后重编码；作者希望在给定(P,q)下不经矩向量即可直接在面复形上传播泛函，获得由面几何与锚点直接决定的表示。
AI.method: 结合Euler恒等式与Stokes定理，在面复形上对(P,q)传播泛函一次，得到H_q上的符号顶点导数系数泛函；用有限维Riesz框架刻画非唯一性、给出受限公式的内蕴L²(P)误差并支持加权后处理；顶点锚点用于剪枝传播表示；由独立生成的q次与2q次系数向量满足显式相容关系。适用于任意维凸多面体与有向非凸多面体区域。
AI.result: 在若干多边形算例中顶点锚点可剪枝传播表示，离线基准量化了该效应；未声称全局基数最优或条件数改善；q次与2q次系数向量满足显式相容关系。
AI.conclusion: 该构造提供了一种直接由面几何与锚点决定的符号顶点导数系数泛函传播方法，Riesz框架解释了非唯一性并支撑加权后处理，兼容凸与非凸、任意维多面体区域。

title: Existence of positive Solutions to Hénon equation on integer Lattice graph and Half-Space
summary:
We study positive solutions of a discrete Hénon equation on the integer lattice graph and on the half-space, with zero Dirichlet boundary conditions in the half-space case. The nonlinearity is governed by a Hénon-type potential with positive exponent. For sufficiently large nonlinearity exponents, we prove the existence of positive solutions both on the whole lattice in dimensions at least three and on the half-space in dimensions at least two.
  Thanks to the Hénon potential, the standard variational compactness is unavailable to obtain the positive solution. Our proofs combine weighted Banach spaces, two-sided Green kernel estimates and the Schauder fixed point theorem.

AI.tldr: 研究整数格图及半空间上离散Hénon方程的正解，在非线性指数足够大时证明了正解的存在性（全格图维数≥3，半空间维数≥2），证明技巧结合加权Banach空间、双侧Green核估计与Schauder不动点定理。
AI.motivation: Hénon型位势导致标准变分紧性失效，无法用变分方法直接获得正解，因此需要发展非变分的替代工具来研究该离散非线性方程正解的存在性。
AI.method: 在整数格图与半空间（半空间情形带零Dirichlet边界条件）上研究含正指数Hénon型位势的离散Hénon方程；证明结合加权Banach空间、双侧Green核估计以及Schauder不动点定理。
AI.result: 当非线性指数足够大时，证明了正解的存在性：整格图情形需维数至少为3，半空间情形需维数至少为2。
AI.conclusion: Hénon位势破坏了标准变分紧性，但通过加权Banach空间、双侧Green核估计与Schauder不动点定理的非变分框架，仍可在足够大的非线性指数下建立高维离散Hénon方程正解的存在性。

title: First-Order Steering: Translating Weight Adaptation into Activation Steering
summary: Activation steering exploits interpretable directions in the residual stream to enable inference-time manipulation of model behavior. Composing steering vectors to apply multiple target behaviors simultaneously is important in various fields-including AI alignment and safety-but remains a challenge for existing activation steering methods. In contrast, prior work in model merging shows that target behaviors represented by learned weight adaptations can be combined with high accuracy. A method that translates weight adaptations into activation steering vectors could therefore extend prior work in model merging to generate composable steering vectors that better enable simultaneous inference-time behavioral control. For this, we introduce First-Order Steering, a formulation of activation steering as a first-order approximation of weight update matrices parameterized by a vector of steering strengths, and establish theoretical bounds on the approximation error of first-order steering. We then develop a novel model merging procedure, HeRD-Merging, which minimizes the first-order approximation error terms to enable higher first-order steering accuracy. Together, our method produces steering vectors that control both individual and composed behaviors more accurately than existing activation steering methods. Furthermore, HeRD-Merging matches the performance of conventional model-merging baselines, while producing weight adaptations that admit more accurate first-order steering vectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 First-Order Steering，将激活引导形式化为权重更新矩阵的一阶近似，并据此设计 HeRD-Merging 模型合并方法，使生成的引导向量在单一及组合行为控制上比现有激活引导方法更准确。
AI.motivation: 激活引导可在推理时操控模型行为，但组合多个引导向量以同时施加多种目标行为仍较困难；而已有模型合并研究表明，学习得到的权重调整能高精度组合目标行为。因此，若能建立权重调整到激活引导向量的映射，就可借助模型合并生成可组合的引导向量，实现同时的行为控制。
AI.method: 提出 First-Order Steering，将激活引导建模为由引导强度向量参数化的权重更新矩阵的一阶近似，并给出近似误差的理论上界；进一步提出 HeRD-Merging 模型合并流程，通过最小化一阶近似误差项来提升一阶引导精度。
AI.result: 该方法生成的引导向量在控制单一行为和组合行为方面均比现有激活引导方法更准确；HeRD-Merging 在性能上匹配常规模型合并基线，同时其产生的权重调整可支持更准确的一阶引导向量。
AI.conclusion: 将激活引导与模型合并相统一，可同时获得精确的行为组合能力与有竞争力的合并性能，为推理时多行为控制提供了新路径。

title: Scale-free adaptive planning for deterministic dynamics & discounted rewards
summary: We address the problem of planning in an environment with deterministic dynamics and stochastic rewards with discounted returns. The optimal value function is not known, nor are the rewards bounded. We propose Platypoos, a simple scale-free planning algorithm that adapts to the unknown scale and smoothness of the reward function. We provide a sample complexity analysis for Platypoos that improves upon prior work and holds simultaneously over a broad range of discount factors and reward scales, without the algorithm knowing them. We also establish a matching lower bound showing our analysis is optimal up to constants.

AI.tldr: 本文研究确定性动态、随机奖励与折扣回报下的规划问题，提出尺度无关算法 Platypoos，在未知奖励尺度与平滑度下自适应，并给出改进的样本复杂度分析及匹配下界。
AI.motivation: 现有规划方法的样本复杂度分析通常依赖已知的奖励尺度或平滑度参数，且难以同时适用于广泛的折扣因子与奖励尺度范围。本文希望设计无需预知这些参数的算法，并在更宽松条件下获得更优的复杂度保证。
AI.method: 提出 Platypoos 算法，一种简单且尺度无关（scale-free）的规划算法，能够自适应未知的奖励函数尺度与平滑度；针对该算法进行样本复杂度分析，并建立匹配的下界。
AI.result: Platypoos 的样本复杂度优于先前工作，且可在算法不知道折扣因子与奖励尺度的情况下，同时在广泛范围内成立；所建立的下界表明该分析在常数因子内达到最优。
AI.conclusion: Platypoos 为未知尺度与平滑度的折扣回报规划问题提供了尺度无关且样本复杂度最优（至常数因子）的解决方案。

title: A posteriori error bounds for the Uncertain Volatility Model
summary: We develop a posteriori primal-dual bounds for numerical approximations of European option prices in the Uncertain Volatility Model. Given a smooth candidate approximation of the value function, a feedback control induced by its Hessian yields a primal lower bound. On the dual side, we derive a representation based on a matrix-valued Gamma field, which provides an upper bound through a nonnegative Hamiltonian penalty. We further show that, when the dual field is generated by the candidate itself, this upper bound admits an equivalent representation in terms of the residual of the associated Black-Scholes-Barenblatt equation. We then study discrete-time approximations of these primal and dual quantities and quantify the corresponding discretization errors. Finally, we investigate their numerical evaluation for candidates obtained by stochastic policy-gradient and physics-informed neural-network methods, and compare the resulting estimates with a martingale dual approach from the stochastic-control literature. The numerical experiments highlight the importance of derivative accuracy, and in particular of second-order information, for obtaining tight a posteriori bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文为不确定波动率模型下欧式期权价格的数值近似建立了后验原始-对偶界，并给出离散化误差量化与神经网络候选解的数值评估。
AI.motivation: 不确定波动率模型下期权定价的数值近似缺乏可靠的可证误差界，现有方法（如随机控制文献中的鞅对偶）在紧致性和可验证性方面存在不足，因此需要构造能提供上下界、并能量化离散误差的后验界框架。
AI.method: 给定值函数的光滑候选近似，由其Hessian诱导的反馈控制给出原始下界；对偶侧基于矩阵值Gamma场表示，通过非负Hamiltonian惩罚得到上界，并证明当对偶场由候选解自身生成时，上界可等价表示为Black-Scholes-Barenblatt方程残差的表示；随后研究原始与对偶量的离散时间近似并量化离散误差。
AI.result: 建立了原始下界与对偶上界的成对后验界，给出对偶上界的残差等价表示，量化了离散化误差；对随机策略梯度和物理信息神经网络得到的候选解进行数值评估，并与随机控制文献中的鞅对偶方法比较，实验表明导数精度（尤其二阶信息）对获得紧致后验界至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 该后验原始-对偶框架为不确定波动率模型下期权价格数值近似提供了可验证的误差界，其紧致性强烈依赖于候选解的二阶导数精度；神经网络方法需保证二阶信息准确才能得到有意义的界。

title: Logarithmic upper bounds and axial front selection for spatially periodic lattice Fisher--KPP equations
summary: We study the position and shape of invasion fronts for spatially periodic Fisher--KPP equations on higher-dimensional lattices, starting from localized initial data. Periodic spectral geometry determines a directional logarithmic upper bound. When the linear growth rate is independent of the propagation coordinate, we prove the matching axial Bramson correction and identify the critical pulsating front approached by the solution. The selected profile includes the local periodic cell and a bounded phase whose derivative tends to zero. This description also determines the times at which prescribed levels reach distant lattice sites and the asymptotic time gaps between levels or neighboring cells. The proof combines a periodic transverse heat kernel, a scalar lower comparison, and critical-tail analysis. For growth rates varying in every coordinate, a positive Dirichlet quotient comparison reduces the matching lower bound to two explicit estimates on the linear seed and its accumulated nonlinear loss.

AI.tldr: 研究高维格点上空间周期 Fisher–KPP 方程从局部初值出发的入侵锋位置与形状，用周期谱几何给出方向性对数上界，并在增长率不依赖传播坐标时证明匹配的轴向 Bramson 修正及临界脉动锋。
AI.motivation: 刻画空间周期介质中反应扩散入侵锋的传播速度、位置与渐近形状，尤其是高维格点、方向性传播以及周期异质性对 Bramson 对数修正和脉动锋选择的影响。
AI.method: 结合周期横截热核、标量下比较与临界尾分析；在增长率沿所有坐标变化时，利用正 Dirichlet 商比较，将匹配下界归结为对线性种子及其累积非线性损失的两个显式估计。
AI.result: 周期谱几何确定方向性对数上界；当线性增长率独立于传播坐标时，得到匹配的轴向 Bramson 修正，并识别解趋近的临界脉动锋；所选剖面包含局部周期胞与导数趋于零的有界相位，同时给出指定水平到达远距格点的时间及水平间或相邻胞间的渐近时间间隔。
AI.conclusion: 高维周期 Fisher–KPP 入侵锋可由周期谱几何与临界尾分析精确描述；增长率不依赖传播坐标时轴向 Bramson 修正可实现匹配，更一般情形下匹配下界可通过 Dirichlet 商比较和两个显式估计处理。

title: Questioning the Questions: Sustaining Self-Evolution in Reasoning Models
summary: Self-evolving reasoning models learn from their own generated questions, yet repeated self-training can lead to performance collapse. In this paper, we investigate why performance deteriorates over successive rounds and how to sustain self-evolution. Our analysis identifies two recurring quality problems in self-generated questions: invalid questions and repeated variants of the same mathematical questions. First, invalid questions become more prevalent across rounds, and answer-consistency filtering further increases their proportion in training data. Second, existing question diversity controls based on lexical similarity can miss mathematically equivalent questions expressed in different ways, which leads to question diversity collapse in later training rounds. Building on these findings, we introduce R-Quest, which uses question validity and novelty feedback to guide self-evolution. We first train the solver to recognize and reject invalid questions, then use its judgments to guide questioner rewards and filter solver training data. To avoid question repetition, we use a frozen base model to compare sampled question pairs and provide novelty feedback. Empirically, our method consistently achieves the highest average performance on 12 benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, general-domain reasoning, and code generation across two model families. Additionally, R-Quest maintains stable performance gains over ten rounds of self-evolution, peaking in the final round and outperforming R-Zero by 17.32 points.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自进化推理模型性能崩塌的成因，识别出无效问题增多与数学等价问题重复两类质量问题，提出R-Quest方法，引入问题有效性与新颖性反馈，实现稳定自进化并在多领域取得最优表现。
AI.motivation: 自进化推理模型依赖自身生成的问题进行学习，但反复自训练会导致性能崩塌。作者希望探究性能在多轮迭代中恶化的原因，并找到维持自进化持续性的方法。
AI.method: 分析发现两类质量问题：无效问题随轮次增多且答案一致性过滤会进一步放大其比例；基于词汇相似度的多样性控制会漏掉数学等价但表述不同的问题，导致问题多样性崩塌。基于此提出R-Quest：利用问题有效性与新颖性反馈引导自进化；先训练求解器识别并拒绝无效问题，再用其判断引导出题者奖励并过滤求解器训练数据；用冻结基模型比较采样问题对以提供新颖性反馈，避免重复。
AI.result: 在两个模型家族的12个基准（数学推理、通用领域推理、代码生成）上，R-Quest一致取得最高平均性能；在十轮自进化中保持稳定增益，最后一轮达到峰值，比R-Zero高出17.32分。
AI.conclusion: 通过问题有效性与新颖性反馈可有效缓解自进化中的无效问题累积和问题多样性崩塌，实现持续稳定的自进化增益。

title: Planning in entropy-regularized Markov decision processes and games
summary: We propose SmoothCruiser, a new planning algorithm for estimating the value function in entropy-regularized Markov decision processes and two-player games, given a generative model of the environment. SmoothCruiser makes use of the smoothness of the Bellman operator promoted by the regularization to achieve problem-independent sample complexity of order O~(1/epsilon^4) for a desired accuracy epsilon, whereas for non-regularized settings there are no known algorithms with guaranteed polynomial sample complexity in the worst case.

AI.tldr: 提出SmoothCruiser规划算法，利用熵正则化诱导的Bellman算子平滑性，在生成模型下实现与问题无关的O~(1/ε^4)样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 非正则化MDP与双人博弈中，最坏情况下尚无具多项式样本复杂度保证的算法；而熵正则化会诱导Bellman算子平滑性，这一性质此前未被用于降低样本复杂度。
AI.method: 针对熵正则化马尔可夫决策过程和双人博弈，在给定环境生成模型（generative model）的条件下，提出SmoothCruiser规划算法，通过显式利用正则化带来的Bellman算子平滑性来估计值函数。
AI.result: 在目标精度ε下达到与问题无关（problem-independent）的样本复杂度O~(1/ε^4)。
AI.conclusion: 熵正则化所诱导的Bellman算子平滑性可被转化为样本复杂度上的实质收益，使规划问题在最坏情况下获得多项式样本复杂度保证，弥补了非正则化设置下的理论空白。

title: CaCuTe Meets SESOP: Better Theory and Practice with Lipschitz Hessians
summary:
We combine CaCuTe with sequential subspace optimization (SESOP) for smooth convex minimization under Lipschitz continuity of the Hessian. The resulting method, CaCuSESOP, achieves the global rate $O(k^{-2})$ with a fixed number of Hessian--vector products per iteration, while removing key limitations of classical SESOP. In particular, exact minimization of the original objective is replaced by minimization of a low-dimensional cubic upper model, which needs only be solved to a computable accuracy. The cubic regularization parameter is selected by backtracking.
  If the Hessian at the minimizer is positive definite, CaCuSESOP automatically attains an accelerated local linear rate with complexity $O(\sqrt{κ_\star}\log(1/\varepsilon))$. Neither the local strong-convexity parameter, the condition number $κ_\star$, nor the optimal value is supplied to the algorithm. We give finite bounds for entering this regime and adapting the restart schedule. Finally, we prove that the global $O(k^{-2})$ rate is optimal for the considered fixed-budget gradient/Hessian--vector-product linear-span oracle class, even with momentum and unrestricted memory.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CaCuSESOP方法，将CaCuTe与顺序子空间优化（SESOP）结合，用于Hessian Lipschitz连续下的光滑凸最小化，实现全局O(k^{-2})收敛率、局部加速线性收敛以及全局最优性证明。
AI.motivation: 经典SESOP方法存在需要精确最小化原目标等限制，且在光滑凸优化中难以同时兼顾全局率与局部加速性能。
AI.method: 将CaCuTe与SESOP结合，用低维三次上模型的最小化替代原目标的精确最小化（只需达到可计算精度），并通过回溯选择三次正则化参数；每步使用固定数量的Hessian-向量乘积。
AI.result: 在Hessian Lipschitz连续下取得全局O(k^{-2})率；若最小值点处Hessian正定，自动获得局部加速线性率O(√κ⋆ log(1/ε))，且无需已知局部强凸参数、条件数κ⋆或最优值，并给出进入该区域的有限界与重启调度。
AI.conclusion: 证明了在所考虑的固定预算梯度/Hessian-向量乘积线性张成oracle类下，即使允许动量和无限制内存，全局O(k^{-2})率也是最优的。

title: Rough Axisymmetric Euler Dynamics: Global Energy Compactness and Kinetic Passage Across Regularity Breakdown
summary:
We establish global energy compactness for rough three-dimensional axisymmetric Euler flow without swirl and use it to construct hydrodynamic limits of collisional kinetic equations beyond finite-time Euler regularity breakdown. For relative vorticity in $L^1\cap L^p$, regular approximate Euler flows are globally compact in $C_tL_x^2$ for $p\ge4/3$, without a sign condition or any spatial-moment assumption. Below $4/3$, the same conclusion holds under uniform control of the absolute impulse. We identify the sharp radial dynamics governing this confinement: the absolute impulse is propagated without a sign condition for $p\ge5/3$, while for $1<p<5/3$ it is controlled under one-sided $L^{p^\sharp}$ integrability, where $p^\sharp= {4p} / (3p-1)$, and this exponent is sharp. In particular, for one-sign finite-impulse vorticity the resulting global energy compactness holds throughout the full range $p>1$.
  For the Coulomb Landau equation and a class of non-cutoff soft-potential Boltzmann equations, we construct strong solutions on lifespans $T^\varepsilon\to\infty$ realizing prescribed rough finite-energy Euler initial data and obtain energy-conserving axisymmetric Euler limits on every fixed time interval. If the corresponding regular Euler evolution loses regularity in finite time, the hydrodynamic fields converge to the regular Euler solution up to the singular time and have a common strong trace there, while subsequences yield global energy-conserving Euler continuations past that time.

AI.tldr: 该文建立了无旋三维轴对称Euler流的全局能量紧致性，并据此构造了碰撞动理学方程在Euler正则性爆破之后的流体动力学极限。
AI.motivation: 经典流体动力学极限通常只能维持到Euler方程正则解的存在时间；一旦Euler解在有限时间失去正则性，极限过程即失效。本文旨在突破这一有限时间限制，在Euler奇性出现之后仍能建立动理学方程到Euler方程的极限。
AI.method: 将相对涡度置于 $L^1\cap L^p$ 空间，通过研究绝对冲量（absolute impulse）的传播与径向动力学，得到正则逼近Euler流的全局一致紧致性；进而对Coulomb Landau方程及一类非截断软势Boltzmann方程构造寿命 $T^\varepsilon\to\infty$ 的强解，使其在任意固定时间区间上给出保能量的轴对称Euler极限。
AI.result: 在 $p\ge4/3$ 时，对 $L^1\cap L^p$ 相对涡度无需符号条件与空间矩假设即得 $C_tL_x^2$ 全局紧致性；$p<4/3$ 时在绝对冲量一致可控下结论同样成立。绝对冲量在 $p\ge5/3$ 时无条件传播，在 $1<p<5/3$ 时于单侧 $L^{p^\sharp}$ 可积性（$p^\sharp=4p/(3p-1)$）下受控，且该指数最优；单符号有限冲量涡度则在整个 $p>1$ 范围成立。对上述动理学方程，得到保能量的Euler极限；若正则Euler解有限时间失正则，流体场在奇异时刻前收敛并在该时刻具有共同强迹，子列给出跨越该时刻的全局保能量Euler延拓。
AI.conclusion: 轴对称性带来的径向约束使粗糙Euler流在缺乏正则性时仍保持全局能量紧致，从而把流体动力学极限从有限时间延拓到Euler爆破之后，给出了奇性后Euler延拓与共同强迹的存在性。

title: What to Preserve in Recursive Computation: A Local Predictive Sufficiency Principle
summary: Recursive computation repeatedly compresses or reuses intermediate states, creating a simple tension: information that must remain useful across longer recursive paths is also exposed to more opportunities for loss before reaching the final prediction. Existing reconstruction or local-prediction objectives provide tractable supervision, but do not ensure that the retained information remains sufficient for subsequent recursive computation. We identify local predictive sufficiency with recursive predictive closure: controlling local predictive deficiencies at individual interfaces controls the resulting discrepancy at the root. We then turn this principle into a tractable training procedure. Starting from a variational characterization, we derive finite predictive tests and an empirical predictive deficiency that measures predictive value retained across compression. Its predictive sensitivities define margin-relaxed half-space constraints on parameter updates, and we project the host optimizer's proposed update onto their intersection only when predictive preservation would otherwise be violated. Across temporal graphs, language memory, vision-language-action control, and recursive self-improvement, the method matches or improves the corresponding host models under matched compression budgets, with larger gains under heavier recursive or memory demands, while better preserving predictive information across successive transformations. Crucially, the same task-agnostic predictive-preservation principle is instantiated across all four settings through host-compatible interventions while keeping the endpoint task, backbone, and evaluation protocol fixed. These results establish predictive preservation at recursive interfaces as a general training principle for recursive compression.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"递归预测闭包"原则：只要控制每个递归接口处的局部预测缺陷，就能控制根节点的预测偏差；据此设计可训练程序，通过对参数更新施加边缘松弛半空间约束来保持预测信息，在四类递归压缩任务中均匹配或优于宿主模型。
AI.motivation: 递归计算反复压缩或复用中间状态，形成一个内在张力：需要在更长递归路径上保持有用的信息，也暴露于更多损失机会。现有重建或局部预测目标虽能提供可处理的监督信号，但无法保证保留下来的信息对后续递归计算仍然充分。因此作者希望找到一个可度量、可训练的原则，确保递归接口处的信息保真。
AI.method: 论文将局部预测充分性形式化为"递归预测闭包"：控制各接口的局部预测缺陷即可控制根节点处的最终偏差。基于变分刻画，推导出有限预测检验与经验预测缺陷指标，用于度量压缩过程中保留的预测价值；该指标对参数的预测敏感度定义了边缘松弛的半空间约束。训练时仅当预测保持性可能被破坏时，才将宿主优化器提出的更新投影到这些约束的交集上，实现与宿主模型兼容的干预。
AI.result: 在时空图、语言记忆、视觉-语言-动作控制以及递归自我改进四类场景中，在压缩预算相匹配的条件下，该方法达到或优于对应宿主模型；当递归或记忆需求更强时增益更大，同时更好地在连续变换间保留预测信息。所有实验中端点任务、骨干网络与评估协议均保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 递归接口处的预测保持可作为递归压缩的通用训练原则；该原则与任务无关，可通过宿主兼容的干预方式在四种不同设定中实例化，并在更重的递归/记忆压力下带来更大收益。

title: On two ways to use determinantal point processes for Monte Carlo integration
summary: The standard Monte Carlo estimator $\widehat{I}_N^{\mathrm{MC}}$ of $\int fdω$ relies on independent samples from $ω$ and has variance of order $1/N$. Replacing the samples with a determinantal point process (DPP), a repulsive distribution, makes the estimator consistent, with variance rates that depend on how the DPP is adapted to $f$ and $ω$. We examine two existing DPP-based estimators: one by Bardenet & Hardy (2020) with a rate of $\mathcal{O}(N^{-(1+1/d)})$ for smooth $f$, but relying on a fixed DPP. The other, by Ermakov & Zolotukhin (1960), is unbiased with rate of order $1/N$, like Monte Carlo, but its DPP is tailored to $f$. We revisit these estimators, generalize them to continuous settings, and provide sampling algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视两类基于行列式点过程（DPP）的数值积分估计量，将其推广到连续情形并给出采样算法。
AI.motivation: 标准蒙特卡洛估计量的方差为 O(1/N)。用具有排斥性的行列式点过程替代独立样本可提高估计精度，但既有 DPP 估计量在速率与自适应方式上各有局限，需要统一推广与实现。
AI.method: 分析两种既有 DPP 估计量：Bardenet & Hardy (2020) 使用固定 DPP，对光滑 f 达到 O(N^{-(1+1/d)}) 的速率；Ermakov & Zolotukhin (1960) 无偏、速率为 1/N，但 DPP 针对 f 量身定制。将其推广到连续设定并提供采样算法。
AI.result: 将两类估计量推广到连续情形，并给出相应的采样算法，刻画了速率与 DPP 自适应方式之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: DPP 估计量在保持一致性的同时可超越标准蒙特卡洛的方差速率，其表现取决于 DPP 相对于 f 与 ω 的适配方式。

title: Coercivity and regularity for nonlocal divergence-form operators with measurable kernels
summary: We consider nonlocal divergence-form operators of the type $$PV\int_{\mathbb{R}^n}(u(x)-u(y))K(x, y) dy=0\quad \text{in} \; B_2,$$ where the kernel $K$ is symmetric ($K(x, y) = K(y, x)$). We first show that there exists a kernel satisfying the conditions of \cite[Open Question 2.1]{FRRO24} for which this problem admits a bounded discontinuous weak solution, answering that question negatively. We then impose the stronger one-sided lower bound suggested in \cite{CS20,IS20}, together with an $L^p$ bound of $K$ over annuli, and prove a coercivity estimate and interior Hölder regularity of weak solutions. In particular, this establishes the coercivity conjecture of \cite{CS20,IS20} under the additional $L^p$ hypothesis for $p>1$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对称核的非局部散度型算子，构造反例否定了\cite{FRRO24}的一个公开问题，并在更强的单边下界与$L^p$环域界条件下证明了矫顽性估计与弱解的内部Hölder正则性，从而在$p>1$的附加$L^p$假设下确立\cite{CS20,IS20}的矫顽性猜想。
AI.motivation: \cite{FRRO24}提出公开问题：满足其给定条件的核是否足以保证弱解的正则性。同时\cite{CS20,IS20}提出矫顽性猜想，需要明确核条件与正则性之间的精确关系。
AI.method: 考虑对称核$K(x,y)=K(y,x)$的非局部散度型方程$PV\int_{\mathbb{R}^n}(u(x)-u(y))K(x,y)dy=0$（于$B_2$）。先构造满足\cite{FRRO24} Open Question 2.1条件的核，给出有界不连续弱解；再引入\cite{CS20,IS20}建议的更强单边下界，附加核在环域上的$L^p$界，证明矫顽性估计与内部Hölder正则性。
AI.result: 存在满足\cite{FRRO24} Open Question 2.1条件的核，使问题存在有界不连续弱解，从而否定该公开问题；在更强单边下界与环域$L^p$（$p>1$）界下，得到矫顽性估计及弱解的内部Hölder正则性。
AI.conclusion: \cite{FRRO24}所提核条件不足以排除不连续解；而在\cite{CS20,IS20}的更强单边下界并附加$L^p$环域界时，矫顽性猜想成立，弱解具内部Hölder正则性。

title: Modeling Deletion Requests in Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning is seen as a promising approach to enable users to exercise the "right to erasure" in the context of AI models. We ask how users might influence the behavior of models when exercising this right. We define two types of behaviors that users might adopt when requesting the deletion of their data: adaptivity and collectivity. Drawing connections between the goals of users in this context and results in stochastic optimization, we demonstrate theoretical gaps between the potential effects of groups of users who do and do not display these behaviors. We then show how techniques from data valuation might be used to design deletion requesters that can significantly alter model behavior in realistic settings. In experiments on computer vision tasks, we demonstrate the differential effects of different models of user behavior and attempt to isolate the impacts of adaptivity and collectivity.

AI.tldr: 研究用户行使机器遗忘"删除权"时的行为如何影响模型：定义自适应性与集体性两类用户行为，揭示其对模型影响的理论差距，并利用数据估值技术设计删除请求者。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘被视为在AI模型中实现用户"被遗忘权"的途径，但现有研究多关注算法本身，忽视用户在提出删除请求时的行为方式。作者希望探讨用户能否以及如何影响模型行为。
AI.method: 将用户目标与随机优化结果建立联系，理论分析展示存在与不存在这两类行为（自适应性与集体性）的用户群体影响的差距；借助数据估值技术设计能够显著改变模型行为的删除请求者；在计算机视觉任务上开展实验，分离两种行为的影响。
AI.result: 理论上证明不同行为用户群体对模型影响存在显著差距；实验显示不同用户行为模型对模型产生差异化影响，并实现对自适应性与集体性作用的分离。
AI.conclusion: 用户在行使删除权时所采用的行为策略会实质性影响模型行为，数据估值方法可据此设计有效删除请求者，为机器遗忘中的用户权益保护提供新视角。

title: Maximum Entropy Semi-Supervised Inverse Reinforcement Learning
comment: In Proceedings of the 24th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI 2015)
summary: A popular approach to apprenticeship learning (AL) is to formulate it as an inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) problem. The MaxEnt-IRL algorithm successfully integrates the maximum entropy principle into IRL and unlike its predecessors, it resolves the ambiguity arising from the fact that a possibly large number of policies could match the expert's behavior. In this paper, we study an AL setting in which in addition to the expert's trajectories, a number of unsupervised trajectories is available. We introduce MESSI, a novel algorithm that combines MaxEnt-IRL with principles coming from semi-supervised learning. In particular, MESSI integrates the unsupervised data into the MaxEnt-IRL framework using a pairwise penalty on trajectories. Empirical results in a highway driving and grid-world problems indicate that MESSI is able to take advantage of the unsupervised trajectories and improve the performance of MaxEnt-IRL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MESSI算法，将MaxEnt-IRL与半监督学习相结合，利用成对轨迹惩罚项整合无监督轨迹数据，在高速公路驾驶和网格世界任务中提升模仿学习性能。
AI.motivation: 传统模仿学习（AL）通常建模为逆强化学习（IRL）问题，MaxEnt-IRL通过最大熵原理解决了多个策略匹配专家行为的歧义问题。然而，现有方法主要仅利用专家轨迹，未充分利用现实中可能大量存在的无监督轨迹数据。因此，作者希望引入半监督学习思想，借助无监督数据提升模仿学习效果。
AI.method: 提出MESSI算法，将MaxEnt-IRL与半监督学习原理相结合。核心是在MaxEnt-IRL框架中，通过轨迹间的成对惩罚项（pairwise penalty）整合无监督轨迹数据，从而约束和引导奖励函数的学习。
AI.result: 在高速公路驾驶（highway driving）和网格世界（grid-world）两类任务上的实验结果表明，MESSI能够有效利用无监督轨迹，性能优于标准的MaxEnt-IRL。
AI.conclusion: 将无监督轨迹通过半监督机制融入MaxEnt-IRL是提升模仿学习性能的有效途径，MESSI验证了半监督数据在IRL中的价值。

title: Regularity for $H$-systems of bounded distortion
summary: We consider weak solutions $u \in W^{1,n}(U,\mathbf{R}^{n+1})$ of the $H$-system $- \operatorname{div} ( |\mathrm{D} u|^{n-2} \mathrm{D} u ) = (H \circ u) \, \mathbf{J} u$, where $n \ge 2$, $U$ is the open unit ball in $\mathbf{R}^n$, and $H$ is bounded. We show that $u$ is locally bounded if its distortion $|\mathrm{D} u|^n / |\mathbf{J} u|$ is bounded on the set where $|u|$ is large. If moreover $H$ is Hölder continuous, then $u$ is locally Hölder continuous. The proof pushes forward $|\mathrm{D} u|^{n-2} \mathrm{D} u \circ \mathrm{D} u^*$ by $u$ to a linear functional on continuous maps of $\mathbf{R}^{n+1}$ into $\operatorname{Hom}(\mathbf{R}^{n+1},\mathbf{R}^{n+1})$ with compact support, whose values on derivatives are controlled by the equation. When the distortion is bounded, this functional satisfies the hypotheses of an inequality of Michael--Simon type for measures satisfying a first-order partial differential equation, due to De Philippis, Gennaioli, Pigati, and Rindler. The inequality yields lower bounds for the mass ratios of the push-forward of $|\mathrm{D} u|^n \mathscr{L}^n$ by $u$, and these imply boundedness.

AI.tldr: 研究 $n$-调和 $H$-系统弱解 $u\in W^{1,n}(U,\mathbf{R}^{n+1})$ 的正则性，证明当畸变 $|\mathrm{D}u|^n/|\mathbf{J}u|$ 在 $|u|$ 较大处有界时解局部有界，$H$  Hölder 连续时解局部 Hölder 连续。
AI.motivation: $n$-调和 $H$-系统的弱解在一般情形下可能无界或不连续，需要找到保证正则性的定量条件。畸变（distortion）是刻画映射几何性质的关键量，其在 $|u|$ 大处的有界性可望控制解的增长，从而获得局部有界性与连续性。
AI.method: 将 $|\mathrm{D}u|^{n-2}\mathrm{D}u \circ \mathrm{D}u^*$ 经 $u$ 前推为紧支连续映射 $\mathbf{R}^{n+1}\to\operatorname{Hom}(\mathbf{R}^{n+1},\mathbf{R}^{n+1})$ 上的线性泛函，利用方程控制其导数取值；当畸变有界时，该泛函满足 De Philippis–Gennaioli–Pigati–Rindler 关于满足一阶 PDE 的测度的 Michael–Simon 型不等式假设。
AI.result: 证明 $u$ 局部有界；若 $H$ 还 Hölder 连续，则 $u$ 局部 Hölder 连续。
AI.conclusion: 通过前推线性泛函结合 Michael–Simon 型不等式，得到 $|\mathrm{D}u|^n\mathscr{L}^n$ 前推测度的质量比下界，进而推出解的局部有界性与 Hölder 连续性，给出了 $n$-调和 $H$-系统弱解正则性的一个定量充分条件。

title: LyapuFlow: Controlling Generative Flows with Lyapunov Feedback for Inverse Problems
summary: Pretrained flow models are now widely used as generative priors in science and vision, where inference-time guidance enables test-time constraints without retraining. Existing methods use projection, posterior sampling, or iterative optimization of the generative trajectory. We propose LyapuFlow, an alternative based on Lyapunov feedback control. At each sampling step, LyapuFlow predicts the terminal sample towards which the current flow is evolving, and evaluates the constraint violation on this prediction. Then, we compute the minimum-norm control that satisfies a prescribed Lyapunov decrease condition. The resulting control remains inactive when the uncontrolled dynamics already reduce the constraint violation at the prescribed rate. Otherwise, it provides a corrective update within a feedback trust region that prevents the control from dominating the pretrained dynamics. We demonstrate LyapuFlow in both data and latent spaces, outperforming alternatives spanning different mechanisms for test-time constraint enforcement in scientific machine learning and image inverse problems.

AI.tldr: LyapuFlow：基于李雅普诺夫反馈控制的预训练流模型测试时约束施加方法。每步预测终态样本并评估约束违背度，计算满足李雅普诺夫下降条件的最小范数控制，控制仅在必要时激活，并在信任域内提供修正更新，在科学机器学习与图像逆问题中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 预训练流模型广泛用作科学与视觉中的生成先验，可通过推理时引导实现测试时约束而无需重训练。现有方法依赖投影、后验采样或对生成轨迹的迭代优化，存在局限，因此需要一种更有效的约束施加机制。
AI.method: 提出LyapuFlow，基于李雅普诺夫反馈控制。每一步采样时，先预测当前流趋向的终态样本，并在该预测上评估约束违背程度；随后计算满足规定李雅普诺夫下降条件的最小范数控制量。当无控动力学已能按规定速率降低约束违背时，该控制保持不激活；否则在反馈信任域内提供修正更新，避免控制主导预训练动力学。
AI.result: 在数据空间与潜空间两种设置下验证LyapuFlow，在科学机器学习与图像逆问题的测试时约束施加上，超越了涵盖不同机制的现有替代方案。
AI.conclusion: LyapuFlow通过李雅普诺夫反馈控制为预训练流模型提供了一种有效的测试时约束施加范式，兼顾约束满足与对预训练动力学的保真，具有良好的通用性与性能优势。

title: Analysis of Nystrom method with sequential ridge leverage scores
summary: Large-scale kernel ridge regression (KRR) is limited by the need to store a large kernel matrix K_t. To avoid storing the entire matrix K_t, Nystrom methods subsample a subset of columns of the kernel matrix, and efficiently find an approximate KRR solution on the reconstructed matrix. The chosen subsampling distribution in turn affects the statistical and computational tradeoffs. For KRR problems, recent works show that a sampling distribution proportional to the ridge leverage scores (RLSs) provides strong reconstruction guarantees for the approximation. While exact RLSs are as difficult to compute as a KRR solution, we may be able to approximate them well enough. In this paper, we study KRR problems in a sequential setting and introduce the INK-ESTIMATE algorithm, that incrementally computes the RLSs estimates. INK-ESTIMATE maintains a small sketch of K_t, that at each step is used to compute an intermediate estimate of the RLSs. First, our sketch update does not require access to previously seen columns, and therefore a single pass over the kernel matrix is sufficient. Second, the algorithm requires a fixed, small space budget to run dependent only on the effective dimension of the kernel matrix. Finally, our sketch provides strong approximation guarantees on the distance between the true kernel matrix and its approximation, and on the statistical risk of the approximate KRR solution at any time, because all our guarantees hold at any intermediate step.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 INK-ESTIMATE 算法，在序列式 KRR 设定下增量估计岭杠杆分数（RLS），只需单遍扫描核矩阵并使用固定小空间预算，即可在任何中间步骤保证核矩阵近似精度与统计风险。
AI.motivation: 大规模核岭回归（KRR）受限于需存储完整核矩阵 K_t。Nystrom 方法通过子采样列来构造近似，而子采样分布（如与 RLS 成比例）直接影响统计与计算权衡。但精确 RLS 与求解 KRR 同样困难，需要可行的近似方案，且现有方法多针对批处理设定，缺乏序列/在线场景下的低内存增量方案。
AI.method: 提出 INK-ESTIMATE 算法：在序列设定下增量计算 RLS 估计。维护 K_t 的一个小型 sketch，在每一步用该 sketch 计算 RLS 的中间估计。sketch 更新无需访问此前已见过的列，因此只需对核矩阵做单遍扫描；算法运行所需的固定小空间仅依赖于核矩阵的有效维度（effective dimension）。
AI.result: sketch 对真实核矩阵与其近似之间的距离提供强近似保证；同时对近似 KRR 解的统计风险提供保证。由于所有保证在任意中间步骤均成立，因此适用于任意时刻的序列状态。
AI.conclusion: INK-ESTIMATE 在单遍、固定小内存条件下实现 RLS 的增量估计，为大规模序列式 KRR 提供了兼具统计与计算优势的近似框架。

title: Global dynamics for the 1d quartic Klein-Gordon equation with an internal mode
summary:
We study a one dimensional nonlinear Klein-Gordon equation with a potential, a localized quadratic nonlinearity, and a non-localized quartic nonlinearity.
