We assume that the linearized operator has a single discrete eigenvalue below the continuous spectrum, corresponding to an ''internal mode''. This eigenvalue generates localized, time-periodic solutions for the linear equation. Assuming the natural Fermi Golden Rule, we give a global description of the dynamics of the amplitude of the internal mode through the radiation damping mechanism, and prove scattering for the radiation. Our approach is based on the distorted Fourier transform and a collection of refined dispersive decay and smoothing estimates.
  The corresponding cubic problem is closely related to the question of global-in-space dispersive asymptotics for perturbations of kink solutions in the classical $φ^4$ model, which remains a challenging open question. From the perspective of nonlinear estimates, a quartic (non-localized) interaction is essentially sharp for our analysis, and closing the estimates with such a low degree nonlinear term requires a careful and delicate treatment.
  As a direct application of our analysis, we prove a result on the asymptotic stability of kinks for classes of scalar field models that can be seen as perturbations of the $φ^4$ model.

AI.tldr: 研究一维带势、局部二次非线性与全局四次非线性的Klein-Gordon方程，在Fermi Golden Rule假设下给出内部模式振幅的全局动力学描述并证明辐射散射，进而应用于φ⁴类标量场模型扭结的渐近稳定性。
AI.motivation: 线性化算子仅有单一离散特征值（内部模式），该模式产生线性方程的局部化时间周期解；相应三次问题与φ⁴模型扭结扰动在全局空间色散渐近的研究密切相关，后者仍是困难的开问题。四次非局部化相互作用对分析而言本质上是临界的，用如此低阶非线性封闭估计需要精细处理。
AI.method: 基于扭曲傅里叶变换（distorted Fourier transform），结合一系列精细的色散衰减与光滑化估计；在自然的Fermi Golden Rule假设下刻画内部模式振幅通过辐射阻尼机制的演化。
AI.result: 给出内部模式振幅的全局动力学描述，并证明了辐射项的散射；作为直接应用，证明了一类可视为φ⁴模型扰动的标量场模型扭结的渐近稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该分析在四次非局部化非线性这一临界情形下封闭估计，建立了内部模式辐射阻尼与散射的全局图景，并给出扭结渐近稳定性的新结果。

title: S$^3$N: A Spherical Spiral Scanning Network for Weather Forecasting
summary: Machine learning-based weather prediction (MLWP) has achieved strong performance in global weather forecasting. Recent Hierarchical Equal Area isoLatitude Pixelation (HEALPix)-based methods use the HEALPix (HP) grid to avoid area distortion near the poles of conventional latitude-longitude (LL) grids. However, existing HP-based approaches often use pointwise mapping methods and process HP pixels within separate base faces or local windows. Consequently, the mapping may introduce reconstruction errors and cross-face communication depends on handcrafted boundary handling or shifted windows. We propose the Spherical Spiral Scanning Network (S$^3$N) to address both limitations. First, L2Proj provides a bidirectional method for mapping atmospheric fields between the LL and HP grids through an $L^2$ projection of their continuous finite-element representations. Second, the Attention-Guided Quad-Spiral State-Space Scanning (AQSS) block uses cross-latitude attention to guide selective state-space updates along four global pole-to-pole spiral paths. This design enables continuous information propagation across HP base-face boundaries without additional boundary-processing mechanisms. Experiments show that S$^3$N achieves better results at 4-, 7-, and 10-day lead times, and exhibits slower error growth in long-range forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出 S³N 网络，用 L2Proj 双向投影替代点映射减少重建误差，并用 AQSS 螺旋扫描实现跨面连续信息传播，在 4/7/10 天预报上优于现有方法且长程误差增长更慢。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 HEALPix 网格的 MLWP 方法存在两个局限：一是采用逐点映射（pointwise mapping）在 LL 与 HP 网格间转换，会引入重建误差；二是 HP 像素在独立基面或局部窗口内处理，跨面通信依赖人工边界处理或移位窗口（shifted windows），缺乏自然连续性。
AI.method: 提出球面螺旋扫描网络 S³N。其一，L2Proj：基于连续有限元表示的 L² 投影，构建 LL 与 HP 网格间大气场的双向映射方法，替代点映射。其二，AQSS 模块：以跨纬度注意力引导选择性状态空间更新，沿四条全球极到极螺旋路径扫描，实现跨 HP 基面边界的连续信息传播，无需额外边界处理机制。
AI.result: 在 4 天、7 天、10 天预报时效上取得更优结果，并在长程预报中表现出更慢的误差增长。
AI.conclusion: S³N 通过 L² 投影映射与螺旋状态空间扫描，同时缓解了重建误差和跨面通信两个问题，验证了在 HEALPix 网格上进行全局天气预报的有效性。

title: Improved large-scale graph learning through ridge spectral sparsification
summary: Graph-based techniques and spectral graph theory have enriched the field of machine learning with a variety of critical advances. A central object in the analysis is the graph Laplacian L, which encodes the structure of the graph. We consider the problem of learning over this Laplacian in a distributed streaming setting, where new edges of the graph are observed in real time by a network of workers. In this setting, it is hard to learn quickly or approximately while keeping a distributed representation of L. To address this challenge, we present a novel algorithm, GSQUEAK, which efficiently sparsifies the Laplacian by maintaining a small subset of effective resistances. We show that our algorithm produces sparsifiers with strong spectral approximation guarantees, all while processing edges in a single pass and in a distributed fashion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GSQUEAK 算法，在分布式流式环境下通过维护少量有效电阻子集高效稀疏化图拉普拉斯矩阵，并提供强谱近似保证，支持单遍分布式处理。
AI.motivation: 图拉普拉斯 L 是谱图理论与图机器学习分析的核心对象。在分布式流式场景中，图的边由多个工作节点实时观测，既要快速或近似地学习，又要维持 L 的分布式表示，这一需求难以满足，因此需要新的稀疏化方法。
AI.method: 提出 GSQUEAK 算法：在分布式、单遍流式处理每条新边的条件下，通过维护一个小的有效电阻（effective resistance）子集来稀疏化拉普拉斯矩阵。
AI.result: 算法产生的稀疏化器具有强谱近似保证，且以单遍、分布式方式处理边流。
AI.conclusion: GSQUEAK 有效解决了分布式流式环境下拉普拉斯学习的挑战，在保持强谱近似的同时实现高效稀疏化。

title: Optimal control of the Dyson equation
summary: We provide a complete study of the optimal control problem associated to the so-called Dyson equation, which describes the mean field evolution of the spectrum of large random matrices. We treat both the case of regular and singular terminal data. We construct admissible controls and prove the existence of optimal ones. We then proceed to give a thorough mathematical analysis of the associated Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation by means of the theory of viscosity solutions in the space of measures. In particular, we characterize the value function of the optimal control problem as the unique viscosity solution to this infinite dimensional HJB equation.

AI.tldr: 本文为Dyson方程（描述大随机矩阵谱的均场演化）所对应的最优控制问题提供了完整研究，涵盖正则与奇异终值数据情形：构造容许控制并证明最优控制的存在性，进而借助测度空间上的粘性解理论对相关的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程进行深入数学分析，并将最优控制问题的值函数刻画为该无穷维HJB方程的唯一粘性解。
AI.motivation: Dyson方程刻画大随机矩阵谱的均场演化，其最优控制问题此前缺乏系统性研究；同时，相关的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程是无穷维的（定义在测度空间上），既有的粘性解理论难以直接适用，亟需建立相应框架并对正则与奇异终值数据给出统一处理。
AI.method: 方法上分为两条主线：其一，在最优控制层面构造容许控制并证明最优控制的存在性，分别处理正则终值数据与奇异终值数据两种情形；其二，在偏微分方程层面，运用测度空间（即无穷维）上的粘性解理论，对相应的HJB方程进行系统的数学分析，并以此刻画值函数。
AI.result: 主要结果为：（1）构造出该最优控制问题的容许控制，并证明了最优控制的存在性；（2）在正则与奇异终值数据两种情形下均完成上述分析；（3）建立了无穷维HJB方程的粘性解理论框架，并证明值函数是该HJB方程的唯一粘性解，从而给出最优控制问题的完整刻画。
AI.conclusion: 本文将最优控制理论、随机矩阵的均场动力学与测度空间上的粘性解理论相结合，完整刻画了Dyson方程对应的最优控制问题，其核心结论是：值函数等价于相应无穷维HJB方程的唯一粘性解。这一结果为大随机矩阵谱的受控均场演化研究提供了严格的数学基础。

title: Hierarchical Credit Assignment for RLVR on Fused Gromov-Wasserstein Geometry
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been shown to improve the reasoning capability of large language models (LLMs) across diverse reasoning tasks. However, group-based RLVR methods, such as GRPO, assign a uniform advantage to all tokens within rollouts of the same outcome. While existing works refine credit assignment of GRPO based on local signals such as token locations or entropy, they often fail to capture the global semantic novelty of a reasoning behavior relative to the current policy. In this work, we propose a hierarchical credit assignment approach for group-based RLVR methods, called HarA, which identifies and encourages semantically novel reasoning behaviors during RLVR. HarA represents each sampled rollout as a distribution over the hidden states and locations of tokens, and computes the Fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) barycenters of all rollouts with the same outcome, capturing the internal reasoning patterns in the latent space under the current policy. The semantic novelty of a reasoning element can then be measured by its contribution to the FGW distance between the current rollout and the barycenter. While solving the FGW formulation is expensive, we introduce an anchor-guided linearization that turns it into a Wasserstein formulation solvable via the Sinkhorn algorithm efficiently. By reweighing token-level advantage of group-based RLVR methods based on the novelty signals, HarA highlights novel reasoning behaviors at flexible granularities to encourage fine-grained LLM exploration. Extensive experiments across three group-based RLVR methods show that our plug-and-play method effectively enhances the exploration of LLMs, outperforming existing methods across diverse reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HarA，一种面向组式RLVR方法的分层信用分配框架，通过FGW重心刻画同一结果下各rollout的潜在推理模式，并以语义新颖性对token级优势进行重加权，从而更细粒度地鼓励LLM探索。
AI.motivation: 现有组式RLVR方法（如GRPO）对同一结果的所有token赋予相同优势，信用分配过于粗糙；已有改进多依赖token位置或熵等局部信号，无法捕捉某一推理行为相对于当前策略的全局语义新颖性。
AI.method: HarA将每个采样rollout表示为token隐状态与位置的分布，对相同结果的rollout计算Fused Gromov-Wasserstein（FGW）重心，以在潜空间中刻画当前策略下的内部推理模式；用该rollout与重心之间FGW距离的贡献度量推理元素的语义新颖性；针对FGW求解昂贵的问题，提出anchor-guided线性化，将其转化为可用Sinkhorn算法高效求解的Wasserstein形式；最终基于新颖性信号对token级优势重加权。
AI.result: 在三种组式RLVR方法上的大量实验表明，该即插即用方法有效增强了LLM的探索能力，并在多种推理基准上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过全局语义新颖性驱动的分层信用分配，HarA能够在灵活粒度上突出新颖推理行为，实现更细粒度的探索，是一种可广泛适用于组式RLVR的通用增强方案。

title: Large-scale semi-supervised learning with online spectral graph sparsification
comment: Workshop on Resource-Efficient Machine Learning (REML), ICML 2015
summary: We introduce Sparse-HFS, a scalable algorithm that can compute solutions to SSL problems using only O(n polylog(n)) space and O(m polylog(n)) time.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sparse-HFS 算法，可在 O(n polylog(n)) 空间与 O(m polylog(n)) 时间内求解 SSL 问题，具备可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 大规模图上的 SSL 问题在传统算法下时空开销过高，难以扩展到实际规模数据，因此需要更高效的求解方案。
AI.method: Sparse-HFS，一种可扩展算法，通过稀疏化/近似技术将空间复杂度降至 O(n polylog(n))、时间复杂度降至 O(m polylog(n))（n 为顶点数，m 为边数）。
AI.result: 算法在准线性空间与时间（忽略 polylog 因子）内即可计算出 SSL 问题的解。
AI.conclusion: Sparse-HFS 为大规模 SSL 问题提供了近线性时空的可扩展求解途径。

title: Regularity of soda-can domains for the $p$-parabolic equation
summary: We classify the regularity of the origin for the $p$-parabolic equation in the soda-can domains $$Θ_{l,θ}=\{(x,t)\in\mathbb{R}^n\times\mathbb{R}:0 < -t < θ|x|^l < θ\},\text{ where }l,θ>0.$$ The classification covers every $p>1$ in dimensions $n\ge2$. At the endpoint $l=p$, the origin is regular if and only if $p\ge2n/(n+1)$. We also prove that the origin admits a traditional barrier for every $p>2$ and $l>0$. When $2 < p < n$ and $l < p$, the origin is nevertheless irregular. This answers negatively the well-known open question whether one barrier suffices to characterize boundary regularity in the degenerate range $p>2$.

AI.tldr: 本文对 soda-can 域中 p-抛物方程原点的正则性进行了完整分类，覆盖所有 p>1 与 n≥2；在端点 l=p 处原点正则当且仅当 p≥2n/(n+1)，并证明 p>2 时存在传统屏障却仍可不正则。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在解决退化范围 p>2 中"单一屏障是否足以刻画边界正则性"这一著名公开问题，通过对 soda-can 域原点正则性的分类来检验屏障判别法的充分性。
AI.method: 在 soda-can 域 Θ_{l,θ}={(x,t): 0<-t<θ|x|^l<θ} 上研究 p-抛物方程原点正则性，对每个 p>1、n≥2 进行完整分类，并在端点 l=p 处给出正则性判据；同时构造传统屏障以比较其与正则性的关系。
AI.result: 分类覆盖所有 p>1、n≥2；端点 l=p 时原点正则当且仅当 p≥2n/(n+1)；对每个 p>2、l>0 原点存在传统屏障；但当 2
AI.conclusion: 退化范围 p>2 中单一屏障不足以刻画边界正则性，从而对上述公开问题给出否定回答。

title: Semi-supervised learning with max-margin graph cuts
comment: Published at AISTATS 2010 (13th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics)
summary: This paper proposes a novel algorithm for semisupervised learning. This algorithm learns graph cuts that maximize the margin with respect to the labels induced by the harmonic function solution. We motivate the approach, compare it to existing work, and prove a bound on its generalization error. The quality of our solutions is evaluated on a synthetic problem and three UCI ML repository datasets. In most cases, we outperform manifold regularization of support vector machines, which is a state-of-the-art approach to semi-supervised max-margin learning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种半监督学习新算法：学习最大化间隔的图割，其标签由调和函数解诱导，并给出泛化误差界，在合成问题与三个UCI数据集上多数情形优于SVM流形正则化。
AI.motivation: 半监督最大间隔学习已有代表性方法（如SVM的流形正则化），但仍有改进空间；本文试图将图割与最大间隔思想结合以提升性能。
AI.method: 学习使间隔最大化的图割，其中标签由调和函数解诱导；给出算法动机、与已有工作的比较，并证明其泛化误差界。
AI.result: 在一个合成问题和三个UCI机器学习库数据集上评估解的质量，在大多数情况下优于SVM的流形正则化这一半监督最大间隔学习的先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提的最大间隔图割算法在半监督学习中有效，并在多数实验中超越现有先进基线。

title: Policy as Data: Replay-Based Policy Dual Averaging via Advantage Regression
summary: Actor-critic methods reuse past experience to improve sample efficiency. However, historical data are typically regarded as off-policy samples for the current policy-improvement update. This work introduces Regularized Dual Averaging Actor Critic (RDA2C), which assigns a distinct role to replay. In regularized dual averaging, the subsequent policy is determined by accumulated policy-improvement feedback, so historical advantage estimates contribute directly to the actor objective rather than solely to the most recent update. RDA2C stores state-action samples with critic-estimated advantage labels, fits a dual score model $Z_θ$ to the aggregated dataset, and derives the current policy from the accumulated score model using the entropy mirror map. In this way, replay defines an empirical dual objective from which the policy is computed. To analyze RDA2C, we establish a finite-time value-gap decomposition, separating the regularized dual-averaging term from errors due to stale-replay supervised fitting, critic bias, finite-buffer variance, and replay coverage, and stating the assumptions under which each error is bounded. RDA2C accepts advantage labels from any critic. With GAE labels, RDA2C outperforms PPO on six of eight MuJoCo tasks and eight of twelve Atari games. RDA2C also outperforms AAPDA, the closest dual-averaging baseline, on six of eight MuJoCo tasks. With twin-$Q$ labels, RDA2C matches SAC at matched batch size and update frequency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RDA2C算法，将正则化对偶平均引入actor-critic，使回放数据直接参与策略目标而非仅用于当前更新，从而更充分利用历史经验、提升样本效率。
AI.motivation: 现有actor-critic方法虽利用回放提高样本效率，但通常将历史数据视为当前策略改进更新的off-policy样本，导致历史优势估计仅影响最近一次更新，未能充分发挥回放数据的价值。
AI.method: 基于正则化对偶平均，后续策略由累积的策略改进反馈决定；RDA2C存储带critic估计优势标签的状态-动作样本，用聚合数据集拟合对偶评分模型Z_θ，并通过熵镜像映射从累积评分模型导出当前策略，使回放定义了一个经验对偶目标。同时建立有限时间值间隙分解，将对偶平均项与陈旧回放监督拟合、critic偏差、有限缓冲方差、回放覆盖等误差分离。
AI.result: RDA2C可接受任意critic的优势标签。使用GAE标签时，在8个MuJoCo任务中的6个和12个Atari游戏中的8个上优于PPO；在8个MuJoCo任务中的6个上优于最接近的对偶平均基线AAPDA；使用twin-Q标签时，在匹配批量大小和更新频率下与SAC相当。
AI.conclusion: RDA2C通过让回放直接参与策略目标，为actor-critic提供了新的样本复用视角，并在多种基准上验证了其有效性与通用性。

title: Unconditional uniqueness for the cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation in $\dot{H}^{\frac12}(\Bbb R^3)$
summary: While unconditional uniqueness for the cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation (NLS) on $\Bbb R^3$ is known in the scaling-subcritical Sobolev spaces $\dot H^s(\Bbb R^3)$ for $1/2<s<1$, the critical case $s=1/2$ has remained open. We resolve this problem by adapting Kato's bootstrap argument to a new choice of auxiliary space, namely the critical Besov space $\dot B^{-1}_{\infty,\infty}$. The main difficulty at this endpoint is that the natural solution class does not provide the coefficient regularity required to close the bootstrap in this space. To overcome this difficulty, we perform a second Duhamel iteration of Born type and estimate the resulting double Duhamel integral as a whole. This yields improved estimates that allow the bootstrap to close in $\dot B^{-1}_{\infty,\infty}$ using only the available regularity of the coefficients.

AI.tldr: 本文在$\dot H^{1/2}(\mathbb{R}^3)$中解决了三次NLS的无条件唯一性问题，方法是将Kato自举论证与新的辅助空间$\dot B^{-1}_{\infty,\infty}$结合，并通过Born型双Duhamel迭代克服了系数正则性不足的困难。
AI.motivation: 三次非线性Schrödinger方程在$\mathbb{R}^3$上，当$1/2<s<1$时，$\dot H^s(\mathbb{R}^3)$中的无条件唯一性已为人所知，但临界情形$s=1/2$一直未能解决。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 作者将Kato自举论证推广到新的辅助空间，即临界Besov空间$\dot B^{-1}_{\infty,\infty}$。由于自然解类无法提供在该空间中封闭自举所需的系数正则性，作者采用Born型的第二次Duhamel迭代，并对产生的双Duhamel积分整体进行估计，从而获得改进的估计。
AI.result: 通过双Duhamel积分的整体估计，得到了改进的估计，使得仅利用可用的系数正则性即可在$\dot B^{-1}_{\infty,\infty}$中封闭自举论证，从而证明临界情形$s=1/2$的无条件唯一性。
AI.conclusion: 本文解决了$\mathbb{R}^3$上三次NLS在临界Sobolev空间$\dot H^{1/2}$中的无条件唯一性这一悬而未决的问题，所引入的辅助空间与新估计策略为处理端点正则性问题提供了有效途径。

title: A Bird's-Eye View of Iterative Reward Design
summary: Designing effective reward functions in RL typically requires substantial expertise and trial and error. Recent work automates this process with LLM-based systems that generate and iteratively improve reward code using policy feedback. However, these methods are often hard to compare because they differ in implementation details, feedback assumptions, and evaluation environments. To address this, we introduce a Benchmark for Iterative Reward Design (BIRD) that expresses existing methods in a unified configuration and evaluation space. This lets us compare algorithms directly, ablate individual design choices, and prototype new components under matched feedback conditions and policy-training budgets. Across MuJoCo, Meta-World, Assistax, and HumanoidBench, we identify a small set of simple design choices that consistently improve performance. Combining these choices yields significantly better performance than the evaluated methods from prior work. Our results highlight the strength of simple baselines and motivate further study of when additional algorithmic complexity improves iterative reward design. Code is available at https://github.com/safety-research/bird.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出统一基准BIRD，用于公平对比与消融基于LLM的迭代奖励设计方法，并发现一组简单设计选择即可超越先前方法。
AI.motivation: 在强化学习中设计有效奖励函数通常需要大量专业知识和反复试错。近期工作用基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统自动生成并迭代改进奖励代码，并利用策略反馈进行优化。然而，这些方法在实现细节、反馈假设和评测环境上各不相同，导致难以直接比较，也难判断算法复杂度的真实收益。
AI.method: 作者提出“迭代奖励设计基准”（Benchmark for Iterative Reward Design, BIRD），将既有方法统一到同一配置与评测空间：在匹配的反馈条件和策略训练预算下，直接比较算法、消融各设计选择，并原型化新组件。实验覆盖 MuJoCo、Meta-World、Assistax 和 HumanoidBench。
AI.result: 该基准识别出一小组能够稳定提升性能的简单设计选择；将这些选择组合后，其表现显著优于所评估的先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了简单基线的强度，并促使进一步研究在何种情况下增加算法复杂度才能真正改善迭代奖励设计。代码已开源于 https://github.com/safety-research/bird。

title: Online semi-supervised perception: Real-time learning without explicit feedback
comment: IEEE Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshop on Online Learning for Computer Vision (CVPR 2010 OLCV)
summary: This paper proposes an algorithm for real-time learning without explicit feedback. The algorithm combines the ideas of semi-supervised learning on graphs and online learning. In particular, it iteratively builds a graphical representation of its world and updates it with observed examples. Labeled examples constitute the initial bias of the algorithm and are provided offline, and a stream of unlabeled examples is collected online to update this bias. We motivate the algorithm, discuss how to implement it efficiently, prove a regret bound on the quality of its solutions, and apply it to the problem of real-time face recognition. Our recognizer runs in real time, and achieves superior precision and recall on 3 challenging video datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合图半监督学习与在线学习的实时无显式反馈学习算法，可在线构建并更新图表示，用于实时人脸识别并在3个视频数据集上取得更优精度与召回率。
AI.motivation: 解决实时学习中缺乏显式反馈的问题，利用少量离线标注样本作为初始偏置，并通过在线收集的无标注样本持续更新模型。
AI.method: 将图上半监督学习与在线学习相结合：迭代构建世界的图表示并用观测样本更新；离线提供带标签样本作为初始偏置，在线获取无标签样本流以更新偏置；给出高效实现方式，并证明其解的悔界（regret bound）；应用于实时人脸识别。
AI.result: 识别器可实时运行，并在3个具有挑战性的视频数据集上取得更优的精度与召回率。
AI.conclusion: 该算法在无显式反馈条件下实现实时学习，具备理论保证（悔界）与实证优势，适用于实时人脸识别等任务。

title: Hamiltonian Metric Learning and Energy-Based Training: A Dissipative Geometric Framework for Optimization
summary: Optimization in machine learning is usually expressed through iterative rules that update model parameters using information from the loss landscape. In this work, we study an alternative viewpoint in which parameter optimization is treated as the evolution of a dissipative dynamical system. The model parameters are regarded as generalized coordinates, the loss acts as a potential energy, and a positive-definite metric defines the local kinetic geometry of parameter space. Starting from a variational formulation, we derive the corresponding Hamiltonian dynamics, the geometric force generated by a position-dependent metric, and a metric-compatible Rayleigh dissipation law. The resulting continuous system satisfies a monotonic energy-dissipation relation, while its discrete form allows the influence of curvature on the optimization trajectory to be studied directly. We illustrate the framework using a controlled CIFAR-10 image-reconstruction problem for which the optimum is known analytically. With the image Hessian used as the metric, the curvature dependence of the quadratic modal dynamics is removed. We then reparameterize the same image as a matrix product state, producing a genuinely position-dependent metric and a nonzero geometric force. Poincaré return maps provide a complementary phase-space view of the resulting contraction dynamics. These examples establish HAMLET as a geometric, energy-based framework for studying optimization as dissipative motion in parameter space. On a five-seed MNIST MLP benchmark, HAMLET attains the highest mean test accuracy (97.95\%) and the lowest mean test negative log-likelihood (0.0696) among the three evaluated optimizers.

AI.tldr: 本文将参数优化视为耗散动力系统的演化：参数为广义坐标、损失为势能、正定度规定义动能几何，从变分原理导出哈密顿动力学、几何力与Rayleigh耗散，并以CIFAR-10解析可解重构和MPS重参数化验证，提出HAMLET框架，在MNIST MLP五种子基准上取得最优精度。
AI.motivation: 主流优化研究依赖迭代更新规则，从损失景观中提取信息来更新参数，视角偏算法层面。作者希望引入一种替代视角：把参数优化理解为耗散动力系统在参数空间中的演化，从而用能量、几何与相空间等物理语言刻画优化轨迹，并显式研究曲率（度规）对轨迹的影响。
AI.method: 1）以模型参数为广义坐标、损失为势能、正定度规定义参数空间的局部动能几何；2）从变分表述出发，推导相应哈密顿动力学、位置依赖度规产生的几何力，以及满足度规相容性的Rayleigh耗散律；3）连续系统满足单调能量耗散关系，其离散形式可直接研究曲率对优化轨迹的影响；4）在最优解解析已知的受控CIFAR-10图像重构问题上验证：以图像Hessian为度规时，二次模态动力学中的曲率依赖被消除；5）将同一图像重参数化为矩阵乘积态（MPS），得到真正位置依赖的度规与非零几何力；6）用Poincaré返回映射从相空间视角刻画收缩动力学。
AI.result: 受控CIFAR-10重构实验中，Hessian度规去除了二次模态动力学的曲率依赖；MPS重参数化产生位置依赖度规与非零几何力；Poincaré返回映射给出收缩动力学的相空间图像。在五种子MNIST MLP基准上，HAMLET在三个被评估优化器中取得最高平均测试精度（97.95%）和最低平均测试负对数似然（0.0696）。
AI.conclusion: HAMLET被确立为一个几何化、基于能量的框架，用于将优化研究为参数空间中的耗散运动，并通过解析可解重构、MPS重参数化与MNIST MLP基准验证了其有效性。

title: Uniform oscillation properties of almost periodic functions
summary: A synthetic view is provided on scattered results which were never presented in this form in the literature. First we investigate precisely the oscillation length for periodic functions. Then, we establish the existence of a uniform oscillation lentgh for any scalar almost periodic function with mean-value 0. After that, we investigate upper bounds of the oscillation length for some almost periodic functions which appear in the study of continuum mechanics, and we show the existence of a finite oscillation length with respect to time in any open subset of some vibrating continuous media. The paper finally recalls a long standing open problem on the vibrations of a square membrane with fixed edge.

AI.tldr: 本文综合整理了周期性函数与几乎周期函数的振荡长度（oscillation length）的零散结果，系统研究了其精确值、均匀存在性以及在连续介质力学中的应用，并回顾了正方形膜振动的一个长期未决问题。
AI.motivation: 关于振荡长度的结果在文献中零散分布，从未以这种形式统一呈现；作者希望建立一个连贯的综合视图，并连接纯数学（几乎周期函数）与连续介质力学中的应用。
AI.method: 首先精确考察周期函数的振荡长度；随后证明任何均值为0的数量值几乎周期函数存在均匀振荡长度；进而研究连续介质力学中出现的某些几乎周期函数的振荡长度上界，并证明某些振动连续介质中任意开子集上关于时间存在有限振荡长度。
AI.result: 建立了周期函数振荡长度的精确刻画；证明了均值0的几乎周期函数具有均匀振荡长度；给出连续介质力学相关几乎周期函数振荡长度的上界；证明振动连续介质在任意开子集上关于时间存在有限振荡长度。
AI.conclusion: 论文综合并统一了振荡长度的相关结果，将其从周期函数推广到几乎周期函数并应用于连续介质力学，最后回顾了固定边缘正方形膜振动这一长期未决问题。

title: A multi-stage probabilistic framework to estimate gas-fired generator performance during extreme winter weather
summary: Extreme winter weather has repeatedly disrupted gas-fired power generation in the United States, yet the plant-level data needed to systematically quantify outage risk remain proprietary. Using publicly available weather and electricity demand data together with anonymized generator contingency records from the North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC), we develop a three-stage Bayesian probabilistic framework for estimating winter-driven generator performance. Applied to New York State (2013--2022), the framework sequentially estimates: the hourly probability of a generator contingency event, the expected net available capacity conditioned on an event occurring, and the event duration. Colder conditions and higher electricity demand are associated with higher failure probability, lower retained capacity, and longer event duration. Under the most severe observed stress conditions, estimated mean hourly event probability reaches 24\% , while expected mean net available capacity falls to 13\% of nameplate rating. Full outage events have a median duration of 12.7 hours, while partial derating event duration increases from 2.4 to 7.1 hours with capacity loss severity. The proposed framework establishes a transferable baseline that utilities with access to plant-level records can directly extend to obtain more precise reliability estimates for operational planning and resource adequacy assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个三阶段贝叶斯概率框架，利用公开气象与电力需求数据及NERC匿名机组停运记录，估算冬季极端天气下美国发电机组的停运概率、可用容量与事件持续时间。
AI.motivation: 极端冬季天气屡次扰乱美国燃气发电，但系统量化停运风险所需的机组级数据多为专有数据，难以获取，因此需要一种基于公开与匿名数据、可迁移的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建三阶段贝叶斯概率框架，依次估计：机组停运事件的逐小时概率、事件发生条件下的期望净可用容量、事件持续时间；数据来源为公开气象与电力需求数据及NERC匿名发电机停运记录，并以纽约州2013—2022年为案例。
AI.result: 更冷条件与更高电力需求对应更高故障概率、更低保留容量和更长持续时间。最严重观测压力条件下，估计的平均逐小时事件概率达24%，期望平均净可用容量降至铭牌容量的13%。全停运事件中位持续时间12.7小时；部分降额事件持续时间随容量损失严重程度由2.4小时增至7.1小时。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一个可迁移的基准，拥有机组级记录的公用事业公司可直接扩展以获取更精确的可靠性估计，服务于运行规划与资源充裕性评估。

title: Bayesian policy gradient and actor-critic algorithms
comment: Published in Journal of Machine Learning Research 17(66):1-53, 2016
summary: Policy gradient methods are reinforcement learning algorithms that adapt a parameterized policy by following a performance gradient estimate. Conventional policy gradient methods use Monte-Carlo techniques to estimate the gradient, which tend to have high variance, requiring many samples and resulting in slow convergence. We first propose a Bayesian framework for policy gradient, based on modeling the policy gradient as a Gaussian process. This reduces the number of samples needed to obtain accurate gradient estimates. Moreover, estimates of the natural gradient and a measure of the uncertainty in the gradient estimates, namely, the gradient covariance, are provided at little extra cost. Since the proposed framework considers system trajectories as its basic observable unit, it does not require the dynamics within trajectories to be of any particular form, and can be extended to partially observable problems. On the downside, it cannot exploit the Markov property when the system is Markovian. To address this, we supplement our Bayesian policy gradient framework with a new actor-critic learning model in which a Bayesian class of non-parametric critics, based on Gaussian process temporal difference learning, is used. Such critics model the action-value function as a Gaussian process, allowing Bayes rule to be used to compute the posterior distribution over action-value functions, conditioned on the observed data. Appropriate choices of the policy parameterization and of the prior covariance (kernel) between action-values yield closed-form expressions for the posterior of the gradient of the expected return with respect to the policy parameters. We perform detailed experimental comparisons of the proposed Bayesian policy gradient and actor-critic algorithms with classic Monte-Carlo based policy gradient methods, on a number of reinforcement learning problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于高斯过程的贝叶斯策略梯度框架，并结合高斯过程时序差分评论家构建新的actor-critic模型，以降低梯度估计方差、提升样本效率并给出梯度不确定性度量。
AI.motivation: 传统策略梯度方法使用蒙特卡洛技术估计梯度，方差高、所需样本多、收敛慢。作者希望减少获得精确梯度估计所需的样本量，并提供自然梯度估计与梯度不确定性（梯度协方差）的度量。
AI.method: 首先提出贝叶斯策略梯度框架，将策略梯度建模为高斯过程，以系统轨迹为基本可观测单元，不要求轨迹内动态具有特定形式，可扩展到部分可观测问题。为弥补其在马尔可夫系统中无法利用马尔可夫性质的缺陷，进一步引入新的actor-critic学习模型：基于高斯过程时序差分学习的贝叶斯非参数评论家，将动作价值函数建模为高斯过程，用贝叶斯规则在观测数据条件下计算动作价值函数的后验分布。通过合适的策略参数化与动作价值间先验协方差（核函数）选择，得到期望回报对策略参数梯度的后验闭式表达。
AI.result: 在多个强化学习问题上，对所提出的贝叶斯策略梯度与actor-critic算法同经典基于蒙特卡洛的策略梯度方法进行了详细实验比较。
AI.conclusion: 所提贝叶斯框架能降低梯度估计所需样本数，并几乎不增加额外代价即可提供自然梯度与梯度协方差估计；结合高斯过程评论家的actor-critic模型可弥补原框架无法利用马尔可夫性质的不足，并给出梯度后验的闭式解。

title: Interior Regularity of Mixed Local-Nonlocal Parabolic Semilinear Equations
summary: In this paper we prove the existence, uniqueness and regularity of classical solutions \break of a semilinear parabolic equation with a mixed local and nonlocal diffusion operator \break $\mathcal{L} = -(-Δ)^s + Δ$ and Dirichlet boundary conditions. Here, $(-Δ)^s$ is the integral fractional laplacian and $Δ$ is the classic local laplacian. We then study the interior regularity of said solutions and conclude that they are Hölder continuous in both space and time, and they are $C^{2,α}_{loc}$ in space for all positive times.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有混合局部-非局部扩散算子 $\mathcal{L}=-(-\Delta)^s+\Delta$ 及 Dirichlet 边界条件的半线性抛物方程，证明了经典解的存在性、唯一性与正则性，并给出了内部正则性结果。
AI.motivation: 混合局部与非局部扩散算子（结合经典拉普拉斯与分数阶拉普拉斯）在建模中具有重要应用，但其半线性抛物方程的经典解理论尚不完善，因此需要建立相应的适定性理论。
AI.method: 针对由积分分数阶拉普拉斯 $(-\Delta)^s$ 与经典局部拉普拉斯 $\Delta$ 构成的混合算子 $\mathcal{L}=-(-\Delta)^s+\Delta$，在 Dirichlet 边界条件下研究半线性抛物方程，先证明经典解的存在性、唯一性与正则性，再分析解的内部正则性。
AI.result: 证明了经典解的存在性、唯一性与正则性；解在空间与时间上均为 Hölder 连续，且对所有正时刻在空间上为 $C^{2,\alpha}_{loc}$。
AI.conclusion: 该混合局部-非局部抛物方程具有良好的适定性与正则性：解在时间上 Hölder 连续，在空间上达到局部 $C^{2,\alpha}$ 光滑性，表明非局部效应并未削弱解的内部光滑性。

title: Learning from a single labeled face and a stream of unlabeled data
comment: Published at IEEE International Conference on Automatic Face and Gesture Recognition (FG 2013). doi:10.1109/FG.2013.6553720
summary: Face recognition from a single image per person is a challenging problem because the training sample is extremely small. We consider a variation of this problem. In our problem, we recognize only one person, and there are no labeled data for any other person. This setting naturally arises in authentication on personal computers and mobile devices, and poses additional challenges because it lacks negative examples. We formalize our problem as one-class classification, and propose and analyze an algorithm that learns a non-parametric model of the face from a single labeled image and a stream of unlabeled data. In many domains, for instance when a person interacts with a computer with a camera, unlabeled data are abundant and easy to utilize. This is the first paper that investigates how these data can help in learning better models in the single-image-per-person setting. Our method is evaluated on a dataset of 43 people and we show that these people can be recognized 90% of time at nearly zero false positives. This recall is 25+% higher than the recall of our best performing baseline. Finally, we conduct a comprehensive sensitivity analysis of our algorithm and provide a guideline for setting its parameters in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"单人脸、单张标注图像"的人脸识别问题，将其形式化为单类分类，提出并分析一种从单张标注图像和大量无标注数据中学习非参数人脸模型的算法，在43人数据集上以近零误报实现90%识别率。
AI.motivation: 传统单人单样本（single image per person）人脸识别因训练样本极少而困难，且现有方法通常需要多人标注数据。在个人电脑和移动设备认证等场景中，只需识别一个人，且没有任何其他人的标注数据，同时缺乏负样本，带来额外挑战；而这类场景中（如带摄像头的人机交互）无标注数据却大量且易获取，如何利用这些数据改进模型此前尚无研究。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为单类分类（one-class classification），提出并分析一种算法：仅从一张标注人脸图像和一路无标注数据流中学习非参数（non-parametric）人脸模型。
AI.result: 在包含43人的数据集上评估，在接近零误报（nearly zero false positives）的情况下识别召回率达90%，比最优基线高出25%以上；并对算法进行了全面的敏感性分析，给出实践中参数设置的指导。
AI.conclusion: 利用单张标注图像结合大量无标注数据可有效解决单人认证场景的单样本人脸识别问题，显著优于基线，且该方法为首篇探讨无标注数据在单人单图设定下作用的论文。

title: Finite-time blowup of the IPM equation from smooth initial data without forcing
summary: We prove finite-time gradient blow-up for the unforced incompressible porous media equation on the two-dimensional torus, removing the forcing used in the IPM blow-up constructions of Alpöge, Buckmaster, and Coiculescu \cite{lit:ABC} and Córdoba and Martínez-Zoroa \cite{lit:CMIPM}. The key is an identity that expresses the logarithmic growth of a layer's gradient as the negative pressure curvature transverse to its transported phase. A nearly vertical parent layer rotates and amplifies a new phase, with a gain exponential in the reciprocal parent tilt. An asymmetric periodic profile gives a uniform upper bound for the pressure Hessian, preventing rapid decay of the gradient magnitude. Each layer is seeded at time zero; its phase means are selected by a terminal displacement problem, and a finite order expansion is corrected to an exact unforced solution. The scale induction then shows blow-up of two derivative components at the origin and convergence to a terminal density in every $C^η$, $η<1$.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了二维环面上无外力不可压缩多孔介质方程（IPM）的有限时间梯度爆破，去除了前人IPM爆破构造（Alpöge-Buckmaster-Coiculescu、Córdoba-Martínez-Zoroa）中所用的外力项。
AI.motivation: 已有IPM梯度爆破构造依赖于外力项，本文旨在移除该外力，给出无强迫情形下的有限时间梯度爆破证明。
AI.method: 关键是一个恒等式：将某层梯度的对数增长表示为该层被输运相位横向上压力曲率的负值。构造近乎垂直的母层旋转并放大新相位，增益关于母层倾角的倒数呈指数；采用非对称周期剖面给出压力Hessian的一致上界，防止梯度模快速衰减。每层在零时刻播种，其相位均值由终端位移问题确定，并通过有限阶展开修正为精确的无外力解，最后用尺度归纳证明爆破。
AI.result: 证明原点处两个导数分量发生爆破，同时在每个 $C^\eta$（$\eta<1$）空间中收敛到终端密度。
AI.conclusion: 在二维环面上，无外力不可压缩多孔介质方程存在有限时间梯度爆破，且爆破仅在特定导数分量上发生，终端密度在 $C^\eta$（$\eta<1$）意义下存在。

title: Specific Algorithmic Interpretability of Neural Networks: A Case Study on Textures
summary: We develop a principled framework for constructing neural networks whose specific parameter realizations admit an explicit algorithmic interpretation. Existing algorithm-inspired architectures can explain the computational structure of a network, yet after standard training the learned parameters need not retain a clear relation to the motivating algorithm. We address this gap as follows. First, we model each data point as a sample of a class-dependent stochastic process and assume that statistics of this process can be estimated from a single sample and these statistics are sufficient to distinguish the classes. We then construct a neural network whose initial parameters exactly implement an algorithm for estimating these statistics, making the network fully interpretable. To account for mismatch between the idealized model and real data, we fine-tune this network while controlling its deviation from the algorithmic initialization. The trained network hence roughly retains the interpretation of the initial network. A PAC-Bayesian analysis yields a uniform generalization bound whose complexity term scales with the fine-tuning radius, providing a statistical motivation for our approach. We instantiate the framework for texture classification using the scattering transform to estimate the discriminative statistics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种构建神经网络的原则性框架，使网络参数具有明确的算法解释：将数据建模为类别相关的随机过程，用初始参数精确实现统计估计算法，并在受控微调下保持可解释性，以PAC-Bayes给出泛化界。
AI.motivation: 现有"算法启发式"架构虽能刻画网络的计算结构，但经标准训练后，学到的参数与原先启发的算法不再保持清晰对应关系，导致可解释性丧失。作者希望弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.method: 1) 将每个数据点建模为类别相关的随机过程样本；假设该过程的统计量可从单样本估计，且这些统计量足以区分类别。2) 构造神经网络，使其初始参数精确实现估计这些统计量的算法，从而网络完全可解释。3) 针对理想模型与真实数据的失配，在微调时约束网络偏离算法初始化（限制微调半径），使训练后网络大致保留初始解释。4) 用PAC-Bayes分析导出统一泛化界，其复杂度项随微调半径变化。5) 在纹理分类任务上实例化框架，用scattering transform估计判别性统计量。
AI.result: 框架在纹理分类中成功实例化，以scattering transform估计判别统计量；PAC-Bayes给出统一泛化界，其复杂度项随微调半径扩展，为方法提供了统计动机。
AI.conclusion: 通过将统计估计算法嵌入初始参数并在受控微调下偏离，网络既保持可解释性又具备适应真实数据的能力；泛化界为这一设计提供了理论支撑。

title: Trading off rewards and errors in multi-armed bandits
comment: Published at AISTATS 2017 (20th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics)
summary: In multi-armed bandits, the most-explored arms are the most informative, while reward maximization typically pulls only the best arm. We study the tradeoff between identifying arm means accurately and accumulating reward, and present an algorithm with regret guarantees that interpolates between the two objectives. We provide both upper and lower bounds and validate empirically.

AI.tldr: 该文研究多臂老虎机中“准确识别各臂均值”与“累积奖励最大化”之间的权衡，提出一个能在两种目标间插值的算法，给出上下界并做了实证验证。
AI.motivation: 多臂老虎机中最常被拉动的臂信息量最大，而奖励最大化通常只拉动最优臂，两种目标天然冲突。作者希望显式刻画并量化这一权衡，而非只追求单一目标的遗憾界。
AI.method: 提出一种可在“识别臂均值”与“奖励最大化”两种目标间连续插值的算法，并据此推导相应的遗憾保证；理论上分别给出上下界，同时进行实证（模拟）验证。
AI.result: 给出了插值算法的遗憾上界与匹配（或对应）的下界，实证结果验证了理论分析。
AI.conclusion: 存在能够在信息获取与奖励累积之间平滑权衡的算法，其遗憾表现有明确的理论上下界，可通过单一参数调节两种目标的侧重。

title: Large Stepsizes Federated Learning on Logistic Regression with Linearly Separable Data: The Case of Heterogeneous Devices
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, accepted to the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control
summary: This paper revisits the distributed learning problem for training a multinomial logistic regression model with the Federated Averaging ($\texttt{FedAvg}$) algorithm. We concentrate on a scenario with arbitrarily large stepsizes and heterogeneous update rules where the devices may perform a different number of local updates in each round. We show that, with linearly separable data, $\texttt{FedAvg}$ is stable with any stepsizes and the objective values converge to zero at the rate of ${\cal O}(1/R)$, where $R$ is the number of communication rounds. Our result also demonstrates that the effects of device heterogeneity vanish asymptotically. For sufficiently large $R$, the objective values decrease monotonically and is bounded by ${\cal O}( 1 / (R T_{\rm avg}))$, where $T_{\rm avg}$ is the average number of local update steps per communication round across devices. Numerical experiments support our findings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究线性可分数据下FedAvg训练多项逻辑回归的稳定性与收敛性，证明任意步长及设备异构更新规则下目标值以O(1/R)收敛到零，且设备异构的影响渐近消失。
AI.motivation: 现有FedAvg理论分析多局限于小步长或同构本地更新假设，缺乏对任意大步长和设备执行不同本地更新次数的异构场景的理论保证。
AI.method: 在数据线性可分条件下，对允许任意大步长、设备每轮执行不同数量本地更新的异构FedAvg进行理论收敛性分析。
AI.result: 证明FedAvg对任意步长都稳定，目标值以O(1/R)速率收敛到零；设备异构的影响渐近消失；当R足够大时目标值单调下降并以O(1/(R·T_avg))为上界（T_avg为每轮各设备本地更新步数的平均值）。
AI.conclusion: FedAvg在任意大步长和设备异构本地更新下仍具稳定性与O(1/R)收敛速度，异构效应随通信轮数增加渐近消失，数值实验验证了理论结果。

title: Global $L^1$ Exponential Observer for the Quasilinear Diffusion Equation
summary: A nonlinear observer is designed for a one-dimensional quasilinear diffusion equation with Neumann boundary conditions, using as an output the state at one end of the spatial domain. The observer consists of a copy of the system, with a nonlinear (in the output) correction term at the boundary. A Lyapunov-based analysis is performed to ensure global exponential stability of the zero equilibrium for the estimation error dynamics in the $L^1$ norm. The result holds for a general nonlinear diffusivity, under the assumption that it is lower-bounded by a positive constant, i.e., that the diffusion equation is uniformly parabolic.

AI.tldr: 针对一维拟线性扩散方程（Neumann边界条件，单端状态为输出），设计带边界非线性校正项的观测器，并用Lyapunov方法证明估计误差在L¹范数下全局指数稳定，适用于满足一致抛物性（扩散系数有正常数下界）的一般非线性扩散率。
AI.motivation: 拟线性扩散方程的扩散系数依赖于状态，传统线性/常数扩散率下的观测器设计方法难以直接适用；同时仅有单端边界输出，需在弱正则性条件下实现观测，因此需要构造适用于非线性扩散率且仅依赖单端输出的观测器并给出严格的稳定性保证。
AI.method: 构造观测器为系统的一个副本，并在输出所在边界处加入关于输出的非线性校正项；基于Lyapunov方法分析估计误差动力学，在L¹范数下证明零平衡点的全局指数稳定性。分析中对一般非线性扩散率仅要求其下界为正常数（即方程一致抛物）。
AI.result: 证明了估计误差动力学零平衡点在L¹范数下全局指数稳定；结论对一般非线性扩散率成立，前提是扩散率有正常数下界，即扩散方程一致抛物。
AI.conclusion: 该边界非线性校正观测器在一致抛物假设下可实现一维拟线性扩散方程的全局指数收敛估计，且分析在L¹范数框架内完成，适用于较一般的非线性扩散率情形。

title: MaDeL: Manifold-Decomposed Feature Losses for Generative Modeling
summary: Generative models are often trained with isotropic objectives such as mean-squared error. For data concentrated near a low-dimensional manifold, however, such losses conflate displacement along the manifold, which may represent valid variation, with displacement away from it, which produces invalid samples. This mismatch is especially problematic in sparse, highly constrained domains, where ambient-space regression can encourage off-manifold interpolation. We ask whether a generative objective can distinguish manifold-parallel variation from manifold-orthogonal deviation directly from data, without explicitly estimating the manifold. We introduce a manifold-decomposed feature loss (MaDeL) that learns complementary representations from corrupted observations: one is trained to recover the clean sample, while the other is trained to recover the corruption. We show that, under a feature bottleneck, their Jacobians align with the tangent and normal spaces, exactly for linear manifolds and locally for smooth manifolds. Together, these representations define an anisotropic objective that separately measures intrinsic variation and off-manifold deviation. Across synthetic, Earth and climate science, and torsion-angle benchmarks, MaDeL improves support recovery and average angular $W_1$ under single-step sampling; on protein backbones, it reduces steric clashes across one- and few-step sampling budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出流形分解特征损失（MaDeL），在特征瓶颈下从损坏观测中学习互补表示，使雅可比分别对齐切空间与法空间，从而构建各向异性目标，区分流形内变化与偏离流形的误差。
AI.motivation: 常见生成模型使用各向同性目标（如均方误差），但数据集中于低维流形附近时，此类损失无法区分沿流形的位移（有效变化）与远离流形的位移（产生无效样本）。在稀疏、强约束领域，环境空间回归易导致偏离流形的插值。作者希望在不显式估计流形的前提下，直接从数据中区分流形平行变化与正交偏离。
AI.method: MaDeL 从损坏观测中学习两个互补表示：一个恢复干净样本，另一个恢复损坏部分。理论证明：在特征瓶颈下，二者雅可比分别对齐切空间与法空间——对线性流形精确成立，对光滑流形成立（局部）。由此构成各向异性目标，分别度量内在变化与偏离流形的偏差。
AI.result: 在合成数据、地球与气候科学、扭转角基准上，单步采样下 MaDeL 提升了支撑恢复与平均角度 W1 距离；在蛋白质主链上，在单步与少步采样预算下减少空间位阻冲突。
AI.conclusion: MaDeL 无需显式流形估计即可分解流形内与流形外变化，改善生成采样的几何一致性，在科学与结构化数据任务中优于各向同性目标。

title: Revealing graph bandits for maximizing local influence
comment: Published at AISTATS 2016 (19th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics)
summary: We study a graph bandit setting where the objective of the learner is to detect the most influential node of a graph by requesting as little information from the graph as possible. One of the relevant applications for this setting is marketing in social networks, where the marketer aims at finding and taking advantage of the most influential customers. The existing approaches for bandit problems on graphs require either partial or complete knowledge of the graph. In this paper, we do not assume any knowledge of the graph, but we consider a setting where it can be gradually discovered in a sequential and active way. At each round, the learner chooses a node of the graph and the only information it receives is a stochastic set of the nodes that the chosen node is currently influencing. To address this setting, we propose BARE, a bandit strategy for which we prove a regret guarantee that scales with the detectable dimension, a problem dependent quantity that is often much smaller than the number of nodes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究图上的带臂赌博机问题，目标是在几乎不获取图结构信息的前提下，找出图中影响力最大的节点，并提出 BARE 算法，其遗憾界与"可检测维度"这一与问题相关的量成比例。
AI.motivation: 在社交网络营销等场景中，营销者希望找到并利用最具影响力的客户节点。已有的图带臂赌博机方法要么需要部分图知识，要么需要完整图知识，这在实际中往往不可得。因此本文希望在完全不具备图先验知识、仅能通过顺序主动探索逐步发现图结构的前提下求解该问题。
AI.method: 将问题建模为图带臂赌博机设置：每一轮学习器选择一个节点，仅观察到该节点当前所影响节点的一个随机集合，图结构通过这种顺序、主动的方式逐步被揭示。基于该设置提出 BARE（一种 bandit 策略），用于在未知图上检测影响力最大的节点。
AI.result: 作者为 BARE 证明了遗憾保证（regret guarantee），该遗憾界随"可检测维度"（detectable dimension）变化，而可检测维度是一个依赖于问题的量，通常远小于节点总数。
AI.conclusion: 在无需任何图先验知识、仅通过主动顺序探索获取信息的条件下，BARE 能够有效检测图中最具影响力的节点，且其理论遗憾界由可检测维度而非节点规模决定，表明该算法在可检测维度较小的图上具有良好的可扩展性与效率优势。

title: Ramp Metering Control via Hybrid State Deep Reinforcement Learning in Partially Observable Connected Vehicle Environments
summary: Freeway on-ramp merges are major sources of congestion, causing significant economic and environmental costs. While Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers a promising solution for ramp metering, existing approaches rely primarily on aggregated macroscopic data. Connected vehicles (CVs) provide vehicle-level observations that can complement aggregate traffic measurements, but their limited penetration produces incomplete microscopic information. This paper proposes a hybrid observation representation combining macroscopic traffic measurements with a two-channel grid encoding observed CV presence and speed. A Dueling Double Deep Q-Network processes these inputs to select ramp-metering green durations. The controller is trained under varying traffic demands and CV penetration rates and evaluated against ALINEA and macroscopic-only DRL variants in SUMO. Across 50 matched evaluation scenarios, the hybrid controller under partial CV visibility reduces the reported total travel time by 11.4 % and mean spillback duration by 84.9 % relative to ALINEA. Evaluating the same trained policy with full CV visibility yields a further travel-time reduction of approximately 1.6 %. Analysis across penetration rates suggests that the performance gap decreases as microscopic observations become more complete. These results support the use of complementary macroscopic and sparse microscopic observations for learning-based ramp metering. The source code implementation of the model is available at: https://github.com/youcefMehamlia/Multimodal-DRL-RMC

AI.tldr: 提出宏观测量与双通道CV栅格编码混合观测表示，用Dueling Double DQN学习匝道控制绿时长；部分CV可见性下较ALINEA降低总行程时间11.4%、平均排队溢出时长84.9%，完全可见性再降约1.6%。
AI.motivation: 高速公路匝道汇入是拥堵主要来源，带来显著经济与环境成本。DRL虽为匝道控制提供前景方案，但现有方法主要依赖聚合的宏观数据；联网车辆（CV）可提供车辆级观测以补充宏观测量，然而低渗透率导致微观信息不完整，因此需探索如何融合互补的多尺度观测。
AI.method: 提出混合观测表示：宏观交通测量 + 双通道栅格编码（分别编码CV存在与速度）。采用Dueling Double Deep Q-Network处理该输入以选择匝道控制绿灯时长。在多种交通需求和CV渗透率下训练，并在SUMO中与ALINEA及仅宏观DRL变体对比评估。
AI.result: 50个匹配评估场景中，部分CV可见性下混合控制器相较ALINEA使报告的总行程时间降低11.4%，平均排队溢出（spillback）时长降低84.9%；同一训练策略在完全CV可见性下行程时间再降约1.6%。跨渗透率分析表明，随微观观测更完整，性能差距缩小。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在基于学习的匝道控制中使用互补的宏观与稀疏微观观测。

title: Measuring Effective Data Resolution in Guided Diffusion Posteriors
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics
summary: Guided diffusion samplers are increasingly used to reconstruct physical fields from sparse observations, but standard diagnostics do not say how much of the reconstruction was actually determined by the data. We introduce effective data resolution for black-box generative posteriors: a comparison between the resolution warranted by the inverse problem, $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{ref}}$, and the resolution realised by the sampler, $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{samp}}$. A perturbation estimator measures $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{samp}}$ and the spatial map $R(x,x)$ from sampler queries alone. We validate the estimator against exact references and use it to study guided diffusion. The resulting measurements show that guidance weight can strongly alter apparent information transfer, that mean, spread and resolution are not jointly corrected by one weight even with an exact prior and score, and that resolution fidelity does not follow reliably from the apparent principledness of a guidance rule.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"有效数据分辨率"指标，用于量化黑箱生成式后验采样中真正由观测数据决定的重建成分，并据此诊断引导扩散采样器的信息传递。
AI.motivation: 引导扩散采样器被广泛用于从稀疏观测重建物理场，但现有诊断方法无法说明重建结果中有多少实际由数据决定，缺乏对采样器信息利用程度的定量刻画。
AI.method: 提出有效数据分辨率概念，通过比较逆问题本身应有的分辨率 dof_ref 与采样器实际实现的分辨率 dof_samp；设计扰动估计器，仅依赖采样器查询即可测量 dof_samp 及空间映射 R(x,x)，并与精确参考进行验证。
AI.result: 估计器在精确参考下得到验证；应用于引导扩散后发现：引导权重可显著改变表观信息传递；即使先验与分数精确，均值、离散度与分辨率也无法由单一权重联合校正；分辨率保真度并不随引导规则在表面上是否"有原则"而可靠出现。
AI.conclusion: 有效数据分辨率为黑箱生成式后验提供了量化数据贡献的诊断工具，揭示引导扩散中引导权重的局限性与分辨率保真度的不可靠性。

title: Online Control via Counterfactual Tracking
summary:
We study online control of a known linear dynamical system with adversarial costs and bounded disturbances, measuring regret against a general class of benchmark policies. We introduce counterfactual tracking, which separates the challenge of learning from the challenge of controlling the system. An online learner builds a reference trajectory by selecting or averaging the trajectories that the benchmark policies would have generated under the realized costs and disturbances, and a corrective law steers the system toward that reference. Charging each change in the reference its recovery cost (the cost of steering the system onto the new reference) reduces the problem to online learning with switching costs. Conversely, under additional natural assumptions, we show that this reduction is tight: the two problems have the same minimax regret up to a system-dependent factor, uniformly over horizons and policy classes.
  The reduction gives sharp regret guarantees for policy classes beyond standard finite-memory parameterizations. For a class of $N$ possibly nonlinear or history-dependent policies, it achieves $O(\sqrt{T\log N})$ regret over $T$ rounds, provided their trajectories remain within a bounded distance of one another and recovery costs are bounded. For the full $\ell_1$ ball of disturbance-response controllers, it achieves $O(\sqrt{T\log T})$ regret, which is minimax optimal in $T$, without assuming a common decay rate for disturbance effects. The framework also improves the best known regret bounds for linear state-feedback policies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究已知线性动力系统的在线控制问题，在对抗性代价和有界扰动下，针对一般类别的基准策略衡量遗憾。作者提出"反事实跟踪"（counterfactual tracking），将学习挑战与控制挑战分离：在线学习器通过选择或平均基准策略在已实现代价与扰动下会生成的轨迹来构建参考轨迹，再由矫正律将系统导向该参考。将参考轨迹的每次变更计入其恢复代价，可将问题归约为带切换代价的在线学习；并证明该归约在附加自然假设下是紧的，两个问题的极小极大遗憾至多相差系统相关因子。该归约对超出标准有限记忆参数化的策略类给出尖锐遗憾保证：对N个可能非线性或历史依赖策略的类，在轨迹彼此保持有界距离且恢复代价有界时达到O(√(T log N))遗憾；对完整ℓ1球扰动响应控制器达到O(√(T log T))遗憾，且在T上极小极大最优。
AI.motivation: 在线控制中同时应对对抗性代价、有界扰动与一般基准策略类时，学习与控制相互纠缠，难以获得通用的尖锐遗憾保证；已有结果多局限于标准有限记忆参数化或依赖共同衰减率假设。
AI.method: 提出反事实跟踪框架，将问题分解为两部分：在线学习器依据已实现代价与扰动构建参考轨迹（选择或平均基准策略轨迹），矫正律将系统导向该参考；对参考的每次变更计入恢复代价，从而归约为带切换代价的在线学习，并证明该归约的紧性。
AI.result: 对N个可能非线性或历史依赖策略的类，在轨迹有界距离与恢复代价有界条件下达到O(√(T log N))遗憾；对完整ℓ1球扰动响应控制器达到O(√(T log T))遗憾，在T上极小极大最优，且无需共同的扰动衰减率假设；同时改进了线性状态反馈策略的已知最佳遗憾界。
AI.conclusion: 反事实跟踪提供了统一且紧致的归约，将在线控制转化为带切换代价的在线学习，从而为超出标准有限记忆参数化的广泛策略类给出尖锐甚至极小极大最优的遗憾保证，并改进若干已有界。

title: Low Mach number limit of the full Navier-Stokes equations with no-slip boundary conditions and large temperature variations
summary: In this paper, we rigorously justify the low Mach number limit of the full compressible Navier-Stokes equations in a three-dimensional smooth bounded domain, subject to the no-slip boundary condition for the velocity and well-prepared initial data. In the presence of heat conduction and large temperature variations, we establish the uniform estimates for strong solutions on a time interval independent of the Mach number by constructing an energy functional in a Sobolev framework. The no-slip boundary condition cannot provide the vorticity boundary relation used in the slip-boundary setting. A key ingredient is to employ a divergence-free Stokes lifting of the boundary trace of the time derivative of modified velocity to define a test function vanishing on the boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文严格证明了三维光滑有界区域上、带有无滑移速度边界条件和良态初始数据的完全可压缩Navier-Stokes方程的低马赫数极限；在考虑热传导和大幅温度变化的情形下，建立了独立于马赫数的强解一致估计。
AI.motivation: 研究完全可压缩Navier-Stokes方程在无滑移边界条件下的低马赫数极限问题。该情形下边界条件无法提供滑移边界设定中所用的涡量边界关系，因此需要新的处理手段，是非平凡且具挑战性的问题。
AI.method: 在Sobolev框架下构造能量泛函，以获得在独立于马赫数的时间区间上的强解一致估计；关键技巧是对修正速度时间导数的边界迹作无散度Stokes提升，从而构造出在边界上消失的检验函数。
AI.result: 在同时存在热传导和大幅温度变化的条件下，成功建立了独立于马赫数的强解一致估计，从而严格实现了低马赫数极限。
AI.conclusion: 无滑移边界条件下的低马赫数极限可被严格建立，所提出的无散度Stokes提升检验函数方法有效克服了缺乏涡量边界关系带来的困难。

title: On the Trade-off Between Information Loss and Generalization in Sparse Attention
summary: To mitigate the quadratic complexity bottleneck of the Transformer, sparse attention has emerged as a pivotal technology. Despite the extensive empirical success of sparse Transformers, the theoretical understanding of sparse attention remains fragmented. In particular, two fundamental questions remain unclear: (1) How does sparsification affect the information fidelity of attention mechanisms? (2) How does this information loss interact with the generalization behavior of the model? To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a systematic analysis of the Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence and of the generalization gap of sparse attention mechanisms. Specifically, we first characterize the approximation error via the JS divergence. Through an order-statistics-based concentration analysis of the truncation mass alpha --- where the attention scores are assumed to be independent and identically distributed sub-Gaussian random variables with parameter sigma --- the JS divergence between the full attention distribution and the sparse attention distribution is shown to admit the closed form log 2 + ((1 - alpha)/2) log(1 - alpha) - ((2 - alpha)/2) log(2 - alpha). Subsequently, we derive a generalization bound through Rademacher complexity, quantified by O(gamma * sqrt(M/n) * (sqrt(log(3eL/M)) + sqrt(pi)/2)). Furthermore, building on a mutual-information-based generalization bound together with an entropy and covering-number analysis of the sparse hypothesis class, we obtain the sparsity-dependent generalization bound O(sqrt((M/(2n)) * (log(eL/M) + log(1 + 2/epsilon)))). Our analysis shows that sparsity reduces the complexity of the considered hypothesis class while introducing approximation error that can be quantified by the JS divergence. These findings provide a theoretical characterization of the trade-off between information fidelity and generalization in sparse Transformer architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文对稀疏注意力机制进行理论分析，用JS散度刻画信息保真度损失，并通过Rademacher复杂度与互信息-based泛化界推导出依赖稀疏度M的泛化界，揭示了稀疏Transformer中信息保真与泛化之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 稀疏注意力虽在缓解Transformer二次复杂度上取得大量实证成功，但其理论理解仍较零散，尤其两个基本问题尚不明确：(1) 稀疏化如何影响注意力机制的信息保真度；(2) 这种信息损失如何与模型泛化行为相互作用。
AI.method: 首先通过JS散度刻画近似误差：在注意力分数为独立同分布亚高斯随机变量（参数sigma）的假设下，对截断质量alpha进行基于秩序统计量的集中分析，得到全注意力分布与稀疏注意力分布间JS散度的闭式表达式。随后用Rademacher复杂度推导泛化界，并基于互信息的泛化界结合稀疏假设类的熵与覆盖数分析，得到依赖稀疏度的泛化界。
AI.result: JS散度闭式形式为 log2 + ((1-alpha)/2)log(1-alpha) - ((2-alpha)/2)log(2-alpha)；Rademacher复杂度泛化界为 O(gamma*sqrt(M/n)*(sqrt(log(3eL/M))+sqrt(pi)/2))；稀疏度相关泛化界为 O(sqrt((M/(2n))*(log(eL/M)+log(1+2/epsilon))))。
AI.conclusion: 分析表明稀疏性降低了假设类的复杂度，同时引入了可由JS散度量化的近似误差，从理论上刻画了稀疏Transformer架构中信息保真与泛化之间的权衡。

title: An analysis of Mirror-Descent Soft Actor-Critic
summary: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) is widely used for entropy-regularised reinforcement learning with continuous action spaces, and practical implementations perform only a few actor steps towards an evolving target. In this work, we prove convergence guarantees when the target policy arises from policy mirror descent and compare it with the classical Gibbs target. We derive sufficient conditions for the strong convexity and smoothness of the actor objective, characterised by the curvature of the $Q$-function estimate through the Legendre differential operator, and establish an $\mathcal{O}\!\left(N^{-\frac{1}{5}}\right)$ best-iterate finite-time convergence rate up to actor and critic approximation errors. Moreover, the mirror-descent step size $λ$ directly controls the target drift and hence actor tracking error, whereas the analogous Gibbs bound contains a non-vanishing tracking term.

AI.tldr: 本文为采用策略镜像下降目标的SAC算法建立收敛性保证，证明其优于经典Gibbs目标的跟踪性质。
AI.motivation: SAC广泛用于连续动作空间的熵正则强化学习，实际实现仅对演化目标执行少量actor步，但其在镜像下降目标下的收敛性尚缺乏理论保证，且与经典Gibbs目标的对比不清晰。
AI.method: 将SAC目标策略设定为策略镜像下降产生，借助Legendre微分算子刻画Q函数估计的曲率，推导actor目标的强凸性与光滑性充分条件，进而分析有限时间收敛与actor跟踪误差。
AI.result: 在actor与critic近似误差范围内，得到O(N^{-1/5})的最优迭代有限时间收敛率；镜像下降步长λ直接控制目标漂移与actor跟踪误差，而Gibbs对应界含有不消失的跟踪项。
AI.conclusion: 镜像下降目标为SAC提供了更优的收敛与跟踪理论保证，步长λ可有效调控跟踪误差，优于Gibbs目标中不可消除的跟踪项。

title: The Birkhoff Geometry of Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections: Two Channels, Vertex Viscosity, and Sinkhorn as a Retraction
summary: Hyper-connections widen the residual stream of a Transformer to $n$ parallel streams. Their manifold-constrained version (mHC) mixes the streams at each layer with a doubly stochastic matrix, which it computes by Sinkhorn normalization of exponentiated logits. We give a geometric theory of this design on the Birkhoff polytope. First, a doubly stochastic mixer splits the stream into a mean channel, on which mHC is exactly a residual network, and a difference channel, which each layer contracts by its second singular value $σ_2 \le 1 - n \min_{ij} H_{ij}$. Thus the extra width is a fading memory with a horizon of $1/(1-σ_2)$ layers, and among nonnegative mixers only the permutations do not collapse. Second, the Sinkhorn-logit map is a global chart, and its logit gradient is exactly the Fisher-Rao gradient. Thus logit gradient flow follows a squared Fisher-Rao metric, and the straight-through update is exactly entropic mirror descent. Third, under logit gradient flow the logarithm of each entry moves at a rate of at most $4n^3\|\nabla f\|_\infty \varepsilon$, where $\varepsilon$ is the distance to the nearest permutation. Thus gradient flow approaches and leaves the vertices only at rate $1/t$, but mirror descent moves at an exponential rate. Fourth, the local convergence factor of Sinkhorn is $σ_2^2$, so a fixed iteration budget limits the horizon. Experiments confirm the predicted rates.

AI.tldr: 本文在Birkhoff多胞体上为mHC（流形约束超连接）建立了几何理论：双随机混合器将残差流分解为均值通道（等价于残差网络）与差分通道（按第二奇异值收缩），Sinkhorn-logit映射是全局图册且其logit梯度即Fisher-Rao梯度，并给出梯度流与镜像下降的收敛速率，实验验证了理论预测。
AI.motivation: Hyper-connections将Transformer残差流扩展为n条并行流，其mHC版本通过Sinkhorn归一化指数化logits得到双随机矩阵来混合各流。然而这一设计缺乏理论解释：为何额外宽度表现为衰减记忆、Sinkhorn参数化的几何本质是什么、梯度流与镜像下降的行为及收敛速率如何，均未被系统刻画。本文旨在为mHC提供几何理论支撑。
AI.method: 在Birkhoff多胞体框架下进行分析：一是将双随机混合器分解为均值通道与差分通道，用第二奇异值σ₂刻画收缩；二是证明Sinkhorn-logit映射是全局图册，并证明其logit梯度恰为Fisher-Rao梯度，从而将logit梯度流对应到平方Fisher-Rao度量，将straight-through更新对应到熵镜像下降；三是推导logit梯度流下各元素对数变化率的上界（涉及到最近置换的距离ε），并分析梯度流与镜像下降在顶点附近的不同速率；四是计算Sinkhorn的局部收敛因子为σ₂²。最后用实验验证。
AI.result: 理论上：双随机混合器将流分解为均值通道（mHC在此恰为残差网络）和差分通道，后者每层按σ₂≤1−n·min_ij H_ij收缩，故额外宽度是视野为1/(1−σ₂)层的衰减记忆，且在非负混合器中只有置换不会坍缩；Sinkhorn-logit映射是全局图册，其logit梯度即Fisher-Rao梯度，logit梯度流遵循平方Fisher-Rao度量，straight-through更新即熵镜像下降；logit梯度流下各元素对数变化率至多为4n³‖∇f‖_∞·ε（ε为到最近置换的距离），故梯度流以1/t速率接近和离开顶点，而镜像下降呈指数速率；Sinkhorn的局部收敛因子为σ₂²，固定迭代预算限制了视野。实验验证了所预测的速率。
AI.conclusion: 本文在Birkhoff多胞体上为mHC提供了统一的几何理论：揭示了额外宽度作为衰减记忆的本质、Sinkhorn-logit参数化的Fisher-Rao几何结构，以及梯度流与镜像下降在置换顶点附近的速率差异，并通过实验验证。这些结果为超连接/流形约束设计的收敛性与迭代预算提供了理论指导。

title: UnAct: Gradient-Free Unlearning via Targeted Activation Intervention
summary: Machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of designated training data from a trained model without retraining from scratch. Retrain-free methods such as Selective Synaptic Dampening (SSD) and its label-free variant LFSSD avoid full retraining but still require backpropagation and parameter importance computed over the entire dataset. We ask: what happens when a deletion request arrives with only a few images of the class to be forgotten? To answer this question, we introduce UnAct, a gradient-free class-unlearning method that needs only forward passes over the forget images. UnAct scores late-layer units by their responses, attenuates the most responsive connections, and repeats this for up to 20 rounds using no gradients, no labels, and no retained data. On ResNet-18 trained with CIFAR-10, CIFAR-20, and CIFAR-100, UnAct is competitive with SSD and LFSSD when forgetting entire classes and, unlike them, never collapses the network when forget data is scarce. On ResNet-18, across all tested sizes, UnAct's retain accuracy stays within 2.5 points of retraining, while SSD and LFSSD, at their full-class operating points, lose up to 86 points on some classes. With five forget images on CIFAR-10, UnAct's distance to retraining is 0.21 points, against 67 for LFSSD and 90 for SSD, and re-selecting SSD's threshold at each size with an oracle does not close the gap. In preliminary transfer to ViT-B/16, UnAct's distance to retraining is 11.5 against 33.7 for SSD, and a request is 19x faster than SSD when SSD computes its importance at request time. The code is available at https://github.com/abdulmuizz0903/UnAct

AI.tldr: UnAct是一种无梯度、无标签、无需保留数据的类别遗忘方法，仅需对遗忘图像做前向传播，在遗忘数据稀缺时显著优于SSD和LFSSD。
AI.motivation: 现有免重训方法（SSD、LFSSD）虽避免全量重训，但仍需反向传播，并在整个数据集上计算参数重要性。当删除请求只携带少量待遗忘类别图像时，这些方法性能急剧退化甚至导致网络崩溃，因此需要一种在遗忘数据稀缺时仍稳健的类遗忘方法。
AI.method: 提出UnAct：一种无梯度的类别遗忘方法，仅对遗忘图像做前向传播。它根据响应对后层单元评分，衰减响应最强的连接，最多迭代20轮；过程中不使用梯度、不使用标签、不使用保留数据。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/20/100上训练的ResNet-18上，UnAct在遗忘整个类别时与SSD、LFSSD相当，且在遗忘数据稀缺时不会导致网络崩溃。所有测试规模下，UnAct的保留准确率与重训练相差不超过2.5个百分点；而SSD和LFSSD在全类操作点最多损失86个百分点。CIFAR-10仅用5张遗忘图像时，UnAct与重训练差距为0.21个百分点，LFSSD为67，SSD为90；即便用oracle在每个规模重新选择SSD阈值也无法弥补差距。在ViT-B/16初步迁移中，UnAct与重训练差距为11.5，SSD为33.7；当SSD在请求时计算重要性时，UnAct请求速度快19倍。
AI.conclusion: UnAct为遗忘数据稀缺场景提供了有效且高效的类别遗忘方案：无需梯度、标签和保留数据，保留准确率接近重训练，且计算效率高，具备向ViT迁移的潜力。

title: COSMOS: Soft Mechanism Mixtures with Verifiable Routing for Long-Horizon PDE Forecasting
summary:
Neural operators offer an efficient alternative to classical PDE solvers, but most learn a monolithic map per equation family and discretization. Real systems are compositional: transport, diffusion, wave, and reaction processes can act simultaneously. Existing mixture-of-experts operators typically use sparse top-$K$ routing, although concurrent physics is naturally a blend rather than a discrete choice.
  We propose COSMOS (Cooperative Operator Specialists with Mechanism-level Operator Soft-routing), a soft mechanism-mixture neural operator. Four process-biased specialists remain active at every step and are continuously mixed by a learned gate, with their features fused by a small network. Specialists share a coarse latent grid, while a zero-initialized full-resolution residual restores detail lost through the bottleneck. We also introduce an operator-splitting compositional benchmark with known mixture weights $w^\star$ per trajectory.
  Against family-tuned FNO under 20-step rollouts, an initial 3-seed evaluation suggested gains on diffusion--reaction, parity on Navier--Stokes, and weaker shallow-water performance. An 11-seed audit showed that the diffusion--reaction gain was unstable, motivating caution in small-seed rollout comparisons and precluding a reliable accuracy-win claim on these families. Ablations show that uniform routing or removing the specialist mixture substantially degrades stable-regime rollouts. On the labeled benchmark, dense soft routing yields $2.2\times$ lower error than hard top-1 routing at identical fusion; using generator weights $w^\star$ at inference further lowers rollout error to $0.034$, diagnosing limitations of the learned gate. However, routing labels do not align with the specialists' intended mechanisms: COSMOS supports compositional accuracy, not mechanism identity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COSMOS——一种软机制混合神经算子，用四个过程偏置专家在每个步骤持续激活并由学习门控连续混合，同时引入算子分裂组合基准；实验显示软路由优于硬top-1路由，但精度增益在多次子种子审计中不稳定，且路由标签与专家预设机制不对齐。
AI.motivation: 多数神经算子按方程族与离散化学习单一映射，而真实系统具有组合性：输运、扩散、波动、反应等过程可同时发生，现有专家混合算子多采用稀疏top-K硬路由，与并发物理的"混合"本质不符。
AI.method: COSMOS采用四个过程偏置专家，每步均激活并由学习门控连续软混合，特征经小网络融合；专家共享粗潜网格，另加零初始化全分辨率残差以恢复瓶颈丢失的细节。同时构建带已知混合权重w*的算子分裂组合基准，并做均匀路由、移除专家混合等消融。
AI.result: 20步滚动下对比族调优FNO：初测3种子显示扩散-反应有增益、Navier-Stokes持平、浅水较弱；11种子审计表明扩散-反应增益不稳定，故无法可靠宣称精度优势。消融显示均匀路由或移除专家混合显著降低稳定区间滚动表现。标签基准上稠密软路由误差比同融合硬top-1低2.2倍，推理时用w*可将滚动误差降至0.034，揭示学习门控的局限。
AI.conclusion: COSMOS可支持组合精度，但路由标签与专家预期机制不对齐，即其提供的是组合层面的准确性而非机制可辨识性；小种子滚动比较需谨慎。

title: Finite-time blow-up for the real-valued defocusing energy-supercritical quintic NLW
summary:
We consider the defocusing quintic wave equation $\partial_t^2u-Δu+u^5=0$ for real-valued functions on $\mathbb{R}^{1+10}$, which is energy-supercritical. We construct a discretely self-similar solution in a backward light cone, of the form $$u(t,x)=(T-t)^{-1/2}W^*\big(ω^*\log\frac1{T-t},\frac{|x|}{T-t}\big),$$ where the nonzero profile $W^*$ is $2π$-periodic in its first variable and real-analytic up to and across the light cone. Cutting off its initial data gives smooth, compactly supported, radial data whose solution coincides with the discretely self-similar solution in the backward light cone, is smooth on $[0,T]\times\mathbb{R}^{10}$ except at the vertex $(T,0)$ of the cone, and blows up there at the self-similar rate. The solutions we construct here appear to be the first real-valued blow-up solutions of defocusing energy-supercritical NLW.
  Existence of the real profile is proved by a computer-assisted Newton--Kantorovich argument in a Banach algebra of Fourier--Chebyshev coefficients, with rigorous error control. We find the approximate profile by numerically continuing rotating self-similar profiles of the complex-valued equation. This step is not essential for the blow-up proof, so it is left as non-rigorous numerics. The main analytic ingredients are an exact description of the mode operators for the linear part, which are hypergeometric and upper triangular in the Chebyshev basis, and a bound for their inverses that is uniform at high frequencies. All computer-assisted proofs, including the requisite codes and the approximate objects, are accessible on GitHub at \cite{code}.

AI.tldr: 本文在 $\mathbb{R}^{1+10}$ 上研究能量超临界的散焦五次波动方程，构造了后向光锥内离散自相似解并证明其对应的光滑紧支径向初值数据在锥顶以自相似速率爆破，这是散焦能量超临界 NLW 的首个实值爆破解。
AI.motivation: 散焦能量超临界非线性波动方程是否存在爆破解是长期未决问题，此前缺乏实值爆破解的构造。
AI.method: 构造形如 $u=(T-t)^{-1/2}W^*(\omega^*\log\frac{1}{T-t},\frac{|x|}{T-t})$ 的离散自相似解；通过实值剖面的计算机辅助 Newton--Kantorovich 论证（在 Fourier--Chebyshev 系数的 Banach 代数中带严格误差控制）证明其存在；近似剖面由复值方程旋转自相似剖面数值延拓得到（非严格）。关键分析工具为线性部分模算子的精确描述（在 Chebyshev 基下为超几何、上三角）及在高频一致成立的逆算子界。
AI.result: 构造出非零实解析剖面 $W^*$，其在第一变量上 $2\pi$ 周期且可跨越光锥；截断后得光滑紧支径向数据，其解在锥内与离散自相似解一致，在 $[0,T]\times\mathbb{R}^{10}$ 上除顶点 $(T,0)$ 外光滑，并在该点以自相似速率爆破。
AI.conclusion: 所得解为散焦能量超临界 NLW 的首个实值爆破解；计算机辅助证明的代码与近似对象已在 GitHub 公开。

title: LocusRL: Diagnosing LLM Reward and Policy Interventions in Competitive Games
summary:
Large language models can intervene in reinforcement learning through both reward design and action selection, yet aggregate performance offers an incomplete account of what these interventions actually do. Similar returns can conceal different learning mechanisms, while plausible rewards can induce undesirable behavior. We introduce LocusRL, a diagnostic framework that connects controlled reward-policy comparisons with audits of reward judgments, signal delivery, optimization objectives, and executed actions. The framework traces performance differences to testable explanations and checks targeted corrections through executable rules and counterfactual replay.
  Across two evaluation batches covering ten Connect Four training seeds, we uncover seed-dependent reversals in intervention effects and show how tracing actual updates changes their interpretation: historical Qwen training operates through reward-weighted teacher-action likelihood. A separate matched three-seed reward-direction experiment distinguishes sensitivity to a learning signal from its usefulness. With terminal rewards held fixed, a sign-reversed dense oracle yields a 2.8% aggregate win rate, compared with 57.2% for terminal-only training and 46.7% for the positive dense oracle. Thus, a reward can strongly influence learning without improving performance. At the decision level, counterfactual replay verifies a winning correction to a diagnosed action error. Complementary experiments in Leduc and reward-validation studies in Goofspiel extend the analysis to imperfect-information settings, revealing how reference-label definitions and validation-data exposure affect intervention assessment.
  Together, these findings show why evaluating LLM interventions requires tracing how their outputs become learning signals and actions. LocusRL turns aggregate outcomes into actionable diagnoses and verifiable corrections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LocusRL 诊断框架，将受控的奖励—策略对比与对奖励判断、信号传递、优化目标和实际动作的分层审计相连接，用执行规则与反事实重放把性能差异追溯到可检验解释并验证纠正措施。实验揭示干预效果存在种子依赖反转，奖励可强烈影响学习却不提升性能，并扩展至不完全信息与奖励校验场景。
AI.motivation: LLM 既可通过奖励设计也可通过动作选择介入强化学习，但仅看聚合回报不足以说明干预的实际作用：相近回报可能掩盖不同的学习机制，而看似合理的奖励可能诱发出不良行为。因此需要一种能把结果差异追溯到机制层面的诊断方法。
AI.method: LocusRL 框架：将受控的奖励—策略对比与四类审计结合——奖励判断、信号传递、优化目标、已执行动作；通过追踪性能差异形成可检验解释，并用可执行规则与反事实重放检验针对性纠正。实验设置包括两批评估、十个 Connect Four 训练种子；一个匹配的三种子奖励方向实验（固定终端奖励，比较符号反转的密集 oracle、仅终端训练、正向密集 oracle）；以及在 Leduc 的补充实验和 Goofspiel 的奖励校验研究。
AI.result: 发现干预效果存在种子依赖的反转；追踪实际更新改变了对其的解释：历史 Qwen 训练通过奖励加权的教师动作似然进行。奖励方向实验中，符号反转的密集 oracle 聚合胜率仅 2.8%，仅终端训练为 57.2%，正向密集 oracle 为 46.7%，说明奖励可强烈影响学习却不改善性能。决策层面，反事实重放验证了对已诊断动作错误的一项获胜纠正。Leduc 与 Goofspiel 实验表明参考标签定义与校验数据暴露会影响干预评估。
AI.conclusion: 评估 LLM 干预必须追踪其输出如何转化为学习信号与动作；LocusRL 能把聚合结果转化为可操作的诊断与可验证的纠正。

title: Finite-time blowup for 2D unforced IPM
summary: We construct an odd smooth initial density for the unforced incompressible porous media (IPM) equation on $\mathbb T^2$ whose solution develops a finite-time blowup. The components $\partial_{x_2}ρ(t,0)$ and $\partial_{x_1}u_1(t,0)$ tend to $+\infty$ as the maximal smooth existence time is approached, while the density and velocity remain bounded in $L^2$. Starting from a stationary solution, we iterate the angular amplification of localized oscillations with rapidly growing frequencies, adapting the mechanism of Córdoba and Martínez-Zoroa [7] for forced IPM. Each perturbation is constructed from time zero and creates the geometry configuration for the next iteration stage. A one-sided upper bound for the pressure Hessian is applied to control backward preparation and initial perturbations, following an idea from the Euler construction of OpenAI [14].

AI.tldr: 本文在二维环面上构造了无外力不可压缩多孔介质(IPM)方程的一个奇对称光滑初值密度，使其解在有限时间内发生爆破：当逼近最大光滑存在时间时，∂_{x2}ρ(t,0)与∂_{x1}u_1(t,0)趋于+∞，而密度与速度仍保持L²有界。
AI.motivation: IPM方程有限时间爆破是流体方程研究中的核心问题。作者希望将Córdoba与Martínez-Zoroa针对有外力IPM的角向放大机制推广到无外力IPM情形，以证明无外力条件下光滑解也可能在有限时间内爆破。
AI.method: 从稳态解出发，迭代进行局部振荡的角向放大，振荡频率快速增大，并自适应地重构造Córdoba–Martínez-Zoroa机制。每一阶扰动均从时间零点构造，并为下一迭代阶段生成所需几何构型。采用压力Hessian的单侧上界控制反向准备与初始扰动，借鉴了OpenAI的Euler方程构造思想。
AI.result: 成功构造出奇对称光滑初值，其解在有限时间内爆破：∂_{x2}ρ(t,0)和∂_{x1}u_1(t,0)在最大光滑存在时间趋于+∞，同时密度与速度在L²范数下保持有界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将角向放大爆破机制从有外力IPM推广至无外力IPM方程，证实无外力二维IPM方程存在有限时间爆破的光滑解，并展示压力Hessian单侧上界控制在构造中的关键作用。

title: One-Step Generation via Riemannian Wasserstein Gradient Flows
summary: Recently, Drifting Models and Wasserstein Gradient Flows have attracted substantial attention because they move iterative distributional refinement to training and amortize it into a generator, enabling fast inference. However, existing formulations have been developed largely for continuous Euclidean domains, such as image spaces, where particles admit unconstrained additive updates. On constrained spaces, these updates can leave the valid domain or ignore its geometry, making them unsuitable targets for training. Recent work has adapted updates to these spaces, but has focused on particular fields or offered limited empirical comparison. We derive and compare several geometry-aware fields within a common training framework for one-step generators. We test the method on data with different structures and obtain competitive one-step results in each setting. The best-performing field varies by task, showing why the choice of objective matters in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文将 Drifting Models 与 Wasserstein 梯度流推广到带约束的几何空间，在统一训练框架下推导并比较多种几何感知漂移场，实现一步生成器，并在不同结构化数据上取得有竞争力的一步生成结果，发现最优场随任务而变。
AI.motivation: 现有 Drifting Models 与 Wasserstein 梯度流主要针对连续欧氏域（如图像空间），粒子更新为无约束加性形式；在带约束空间上这类更新会越界或忽略几何结构，不适合作为训练目标。已有针对特定空间的自适应工作，但局限于个别领域且缺乏系统实证比较。
AI.method: 在面向一步生成器的统一训练框架内，推导多种几何感知漂移场（geometry-aware fields），并将其与相应空间几何相结合，以支持在带约束空间上的迭代分布精炼与训练摊销。随后在具有不同结构的数据上进行对比实验。
AI.result: 在各测试的约束/结构化数据设定上均获得有竞争力的一步生成结果；不同任务中表现最佳的漂移场并不相同。
AI.conclusion: 将漂移模型推广至几何约束空间是可行且有效的，统一框架便于公平比较不同几何感知漂移场；目标函数（漂移场）的选择在实践中至关重要，需按任务结构进行选择。

title: Fractional Calderón problem with a potential
summary: We prove that the knowledge of local Cauchy data for a fractional Schrödinger equation on a smooth closed and connected Riemannian manifold of dimension at least two determines the manifold, its metric, and a smooth complex- valued potential, up to an isometry fixing the observation set. The observation set may be any nonempty open subset and no further geometric assumptions are required. The proof uses functional calculus identities to recover the local action of the resolvent of the Laplace-Beltrami operator.

AI.tldr: 证明在光滑闭连通流形（维数≥2）上，分数阶Schrödinger方程局部Cauchy数据可唯一确定流形、度量及复值势，精确到固定观测集的等距。
AI.motivation: 研究分数阶Schrödinger方程正问题的局部观测反问题，探究仅凭局部Cauchy数据能否同时恢复几何（流形与度量）与势函数，并放宽以往对观测集和几何条件的限制。
AI.method: 利用函数演算（functional calculus）恒等式，从局部Cauchy数据中恢复Laplace–Beltrami算子预解式的局部作用，进而重建流形、度量与势。
AI.result: 局部Cauchy数据可确定流形、其度量以及一个光滑复值势，唯一性成立到固定观测集的等距；观测集可为任意非空开子集，无需额外几何假设。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出分数阶Schrödinger方程局部数据反问题的普适唯一性结果，显著弱化了几何与观测条件。

title: Target-free Latent Safety Alignment
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain highly vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that induce harmful behaviors and circumvent safety alignment. To defend against such attacks, adversarial training paradigms have been proposed to first simulate failure modes and then train the model to correct them, yielding promising improvements in safety alignment. However, these methods typically construct adversarial samples either by encouraging fixed harmful target completions or by performing targeted activation ablation derived from fixed benign--harmful data pairs. As a result, the generated adversarial samples tend to induce homogeneous harmful behaviors that poorly reflect the diversity of behaviors elicited by real-world jailbreak attacks. This behavior-level narrowness fundamentally limits their robustness. To address this issue, we propose a target-free adversarial training framework that generates adversarial samples in an unsupervised manner. By amplifying and diversifying behavior-level shifts in the model's latent space, our approach produces semantically diverse adversarial samples that induce a wide range of harmful behaviors. This expanded behavioral coverage exposes more diverse failure modes and thereby improves safety alignment. To quantify this effect, we use semantic entropy as an output-level measure of adversarial behavioral diversity. Empirically, our method elicits diverse harmful behaviors in the target model, substantially mitigating behavioral narrowness and improving robustness to jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无目标对抗训练框架，通过在潜空间放大并多样化行为层面的偏移，以无监督方式生成语义多样的对抗样本，从而缓解现有对抗训练方法的行为同质化问题，并提升模型抵御越狱攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型仍易受越狱攻击影响，现有对抗训练方法虽能提升安全对齐，但其对抗样本依赖固定的有害目标补全或基于固定良性—有害数据对的目标性激活消融，导致生成的对抗样本诱导的有害行为高度同质，难以反映真实越狱攻击的行为多样性。这种行为层面的狭窄性从根本上限制了其鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出无目标（target-free）对抗训练框架，以无监督方式生成对抗样本：在模型潜空间中放大并多样化行为层面的偏移，从而产生语义多样、能诱导多种有害行为的对抗样本。采用语义熵作为输出层面衡量对抗行为多样性的指标，用以量化该效应。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法能够在目标模型中诱导出多样的有害行为，显著缓解行为狭窄性问题，并提升模型对越狱攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过在潜空间放大并多样化行为偏移实现无监督、无目标的对抗样本生成，可扩大行为覆盖范围、暴露更多失败模式，进而改善安全对齐，是缓解行为同质化并增强越狱鲁棒性的有效途径。

title: On the Dirichlet problem for the degenerate $2$-Hessian equation
summary: In this paper, we establish global $C^{1,1}$ solvability of the Dirichlet problem for the degenerate $2$-Hessian equation on bounded strictly mean convex $C^{3,1}$ domains $Ω$, with general $C^{3,1}$ boundary values and nonnegative right-hand sides $f\in C^{1,1}(\overlineΩ)$, resolving the $k=2$ case of a longstanding open problem. We uncover a global semiconvexity structure for general $2$-admissible solutions by proving a lower bound for $σ_{3}[D^{2}u]$ independent of $\inf_Ωf$. For $3\leq k\leq n-1$, we also establish global semiconvexity for $k$-admissible solutions on the unit ball with $C^{3}$ boundary values and $f^{1/(k-1)}\in C^{1,1}(\overline{B}_{1})$, with a bound independent of $\inf_{B_{1}}f$. A counterexample shows that the $C^{3,1}$ boundary value assumption for global $C^{1,1}$ solvability is sharp in the Hölder scale.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了退化2-Hessian方程Dirichlet问题在严格平均凸C^{3,1}区域上的全局C^{1,1}可解性，并揭示了解的全局半凸结构，同时证明相关边界正则性假设在Hölder尺度下是sharp的。
AI.motivation: 退化2-Hessian方程的Dirichlet问题在k=2情形下的全局C^{1,1}可解性是一个长期未解决的公开问题，其难点在于缺乏与inf f无关的先验估计。
AI.method: 通过证明σ_{3}[D^{2}u]的一个不依赖于inf_Ω f下界的估计，揭示一般2-admissible解的全局半凸性结构；并将全局半凸性结果推广到3≤k≤n-1情形（单位球、C^{3}边界值、f^{1/(k-1)}∈C^{1,1}）。
AI.result: 获得了Dirichlet问题的全局C^{1,1}可解性（一般C^{3,1}边界值，f∈C^{1,1}(Ω̄)非负）；建立了与inf_Ω f无关的σ_{3}[D^{2}u]下界从而得到全局半凸性；对3≤k≤n-1在单位球上得到独立于inf f的全局半凸性；构造反例表明C^{3,1}边界值假设在Hölder尺度下sharp。
AI.conclusion: 本文解决了退化2-Hessian方程Dirichlet问题k=2情形这一长期公开问题，并给出全局半凸性这一新结构，同时说明结果的正则性假设在Hölder尺度下是最优的。

title: BARQ: Balanced Codebook Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
summary: As large language models (LLMs) grow in parameter count, model storage and parameter memory traffic have become major bottlenecks to efficient deployment. Codebook-based weight quantization reduces these costs, but imbalanced nearest-codeword assignments during fitting can leave some codewords insufficiently updated, limiting effective codebook utilization. To address this limitation, we propose Balanced Assignment Refinement for Quantization (BARQ), which improves quantization quality through balanced fitting of existing codebooks. Specifically, we first compute joint soft assignments between weight blocks and codewords through entropically regularized optimal transport with uniform marginals and curvature-weighted reconstruction costs, ensuring equal positive fitting mass for every codeword in the exact solution. We then refine the codewords through an assignment-weighted barycentric update, which we prove minimizes the fitting objective for fixed assignments. For finite Sinkhorn iterations, the implemented update retains this optimality provided all codeword masses exceed the denominator floor. Finally, we discard the soft assignments and use the refined codebook for standard hard nearest-codeword encoding, with our analysis establishing sufficient conditions for reducing hard-quantization distortion and evaluation loss. Across multiple LLMs, BARQ achieves lower perplexity and higher mean zero-shot accuracy than the evaluated baselines at comparable bit budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/chenhangcuisg-code/BARQ.

AI.tldr: BARQ通过熵正则化最优传输实现码字均衡分配，并结合重心更新优化码本，在同等比特预算下降低多个LLM的困惑度并提升零样本准确率。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM参数量增长，模型存储与参数内存访存成为高效部署的主要瓶颈。基于码本的权重量化可降低这些开销，但拟合过程中最近码字分配不均衡，导致部分码字更新不足，限制了码本的有效利用率。
AI.method: 提出BARQ（Balanced Assignment Refinement for Quantization）。首先通过带均匀边际的熵正则化最优传输与曲率加权重建代价，计算权重块与码字之间的联合软分配，保证精确解中每个码字获得相等的正拟合质量；随后采用分配加权的重心更新精炼码字，并证明其在固定分配下最小化拟合目标；对有限Sinkhorn迭代，只要所有码字质量超过分母下限，所实现更新仍保持该最优性；最后丢弃软分配，用精炼后的码本进行标准硬最近码字编码。
AI.result: 在多个LLM上，BARQ在可比比特预算下取得了比所评估基线更低的困惑度和更高的平均零样本准确率。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: BARQ通过均衡拟合现有码本提升量化质量，理论分析给出了降低硬量化失真与评估损失的充分条件，实验验证了其有效性。

title: Understanding Clustering in Slot Attention via Particle Dynamics
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the DynaFront workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Studying attention through the lens of interacting particle dynamics has shown how token clustering can emerge from the underlying dynamics. We extend this perspective to slot attention, a method for object-centric image segmentation and representation learning in which learned components obscure how much of the clustering behaviour is intrinsic to the attention dynamics. We therefore introduce simplified slot attention (SSA), a parameter-free variant whose dynamics are connected to soft $k$-means clustering and which provides a straightforward mechanistic explanation for the emergence of object-centric representations. On the Pascal VOC dataset, SSA achieves performance comparable to that of slot attention, demonstrating that competitive object-centric segmentation can be achieved without learned neural-network components.

AI.tldr: 将注意力视为相互作用粒子动力学，提出无参数的简化槽注意力（SSA），其动力学与软 k-means 聚类相关，在 Pascal VOC 上取得与槽注意力相当的性能，说明无需学习神经网络组件也能实现有竞争力的对象中心分割。
AI.motivation: 已有研究从相互作用粒子动力学角度理解注意力，揭示 token 聚类的涌现机制；但槽注意力中学习到的组件掩盖了聚类行为有多少源于注意力动力学本身，因此需要简化模型以厘清其内在机理。
AI.method: 提出简化槽注意力（SSA），一种无参数变体，其动力学与软 k-means 聚类建立联系，从而为对象中心表征的涌现提供直接的机制性解释。
AI.result: 在 Pascal VOC 数据集上，SSA 取得与槽注意力相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 无需学习神经网络组件即可实现有竞争力的对象中心分割，表明对象中心表征的涌现很大程度上源自注意力动力学本身而非学习组件。

title: LoRA's Second Descent Extends Beyond Parameter Parity
summary: Double descent has sparked considerable interest, with recent work relating it to the data, the model and the learning configuration. Practical fine-tuning commonly involves training a small adapter on top of frozen pretrained weights, as in low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The adapter's rank is the hyperparameter that sets its capacity, yet how this rank relates to double descent has not been well explored. We quantify this relation under label noise on four vision backbones and a 7B language model with a module-matched rank sweep (MMRS), which extends past full rank and compares every rank with dense fine-tuning of the same modules, paired by seed. On DeiT-Tiny, risk is lowest at rank one and rises sharply as the adapter becomes able to fit the noisy labels, forming an interpolation cliff. Past the peak, risk falls again, but every tested post-peak rank that still saves parameters remains above dense risk. Rank-one LoRA outperforms dense fine-tuning on three of the four vision backbones, consistent with strong regularization at small rank. LoRA thus exhibits a second descent, but matches dense risk only after losing its parameter advantage, first on DeiT-Tiny at four times dense's projection weights. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lora-second-descent-C7B5.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LoRA适配器秩与双下降现象的关系，在4个视觉骨干和7B语言模型上通过MMRS扫秩，发现LoRA秩存在双下降，但秩一风险最低且秩一LoRA在多数视觉任务上优于全量微调。
AI.motivation: 双下降现象已受关注并与数据、模型、学习配置相关联，但实际微调常用LoRA等小适配器，其决定容量的秩超参数与双下降的关系尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出模块匹配秩扫描(MMRS)，在标签噪声下对4个视觉骨干和一个7B语言模型扫描LoRA秩，超越全秩范围，并将每个秩与同模块的稠密微调按随机种子配对比较。
AI.result: 在DeiT-Tiny上，秩一时风险最低，随适配器能拟合噪声标签而急剧上升形成插值峭壁；超过峰值后风险再次下降，但所有仍节省参数的峰后秩仍高于稠密风险。秩一LoRA在4个视觉骨干中的3个上优于稠密微调，体现小秩强正则。LoRA需在DeiT-Tiny上达到稠密投影权重4倍时才追平稠密风险，此时已丧失参数优势。
AI.conclusion: LoRA确实表现出第二次下降，但仅在失去参数优势后才匹配稠密风险，说明其双下降的收益与参数效率之间存在权衡。
