title: Coupling Noisy Pairwise Knowledge to the DAG Posterior for Causal Discovery
summary: External causal reports can improve structure learning from limited observations, but their reliability varies across sources and variable pairs. We introduce HB-NoisyKG, a Bayesian framework that combines observational data with repeated causal reports from sources such as large language models. Each report is a noisy observation of a direct pair state implied by one DAG. A feature-conditioned Beta prior pools information about pair reliability, and a shared error matrix captures systematic mistakes. Alternating inference uses the graph posterior to refine reliability estimates, which determine how reports influence subsequent graph updates. The report likelihood uses only graph pair-state marginals, so the same observation layer supports discrete and continuous likelihoods in graph-only and joint inference. Against an 80-restart no-KG baseline, HB uses at most 80 total restarts and lowers mean SHD from 22.39 to 16.06 on five discrete benchmarks. On a physical light tunnel with random variable IDs and retained descriptions, HB lowers SHD from 39.00 for no-KG to 27.30. On continuous Sachs, graph-only BGe raises AUROC by 0.121 over no-KG Top-K. In a controlled synthetic study, continued updating also reduces mean reliability estimation error and held-out report log loss compared with one-time estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出HB-NoisyKG贝叶斯框架，融合观测数据与含噪因果报告，通过特征条件Beta先验与共享误差矩阵建模来源可靠性，交替推断提升结构学习。
AI.motivation: 外部因果报告可在观测数据有限时改善结构学习，但不同来源、不同变量对的报告可靠性差异大，需对报告质量进行可靠建模与加权。
AI.method: HB-NoisyKG将每条报告视为某DAG隐含的直接成对状态的含噪观测；用特征条件Beta先验汇聚成对可靠性信息，用共享误差矩阵刻画系统性错误；采用交替推断，以图后验修正可靠性估计并据此更新图。报告似然仅依赖图成对状态边缘，故同一观测层支持离散与连续似然、图仅推断与联合推断。
AI.result: 对比80次重启无KG基线，HB总重启不超过80次，在五个离散基准上平均SHD从22.39降至16.06；在随机变量ID且保留描述的物理光隧道任务上SHD从39.00降至27.30；连续Sachs上图仅BGe较无KG Top-K提升AUROC 0.121；受控合成实验中持续更新比一次性估计降低平均可靠性估计误差与留出报告对数损失。
AI.conclusion: HB-NoisyKG能有效利用不完美外部因果报告改进结构学习，并通过交替推断持续优化可靠性估计，在离散、连续及真实场景中均优于无KG基线。

title: Length Generalization Needs Proper Regularization
summary: Length generalization is the ability of sequential models to perform well on context lengths unseen during training. In this work, we show that the challenge of achieving length generalization is related not only to architectural choices such as positional encoding and the attention mechanism but also to the training procedure itself. We study how regularization affects length generalization and find that weight decay can hinder extrapolation. In contrast, dropout improves extrapolation when its placement within the architecture is reconsidered. In that regard, we show that the standard placement of dropout before layer normalization introduces a systematic distributional mismatch, and that applying dropout just before the linear projection resolves this issue. For example, a modified SmolLM3 with sliding window attention, continually pre-trained with dropout, can extrapolate perfectly to 64$\times$ on Needle-in-a-Haystack and far beyond the pre-training context size on RULER and HELMET. Mamba2 also benefits from dropout, suggesting an architecture-agnostic nature of the problem. We further propose Variance-Preserving Affine Dropout (VPAD), a new dropout strategy that substantially reduces the resulting pre-activation variance mismatch, leading to further extrapolation improvements in transformers.

AI.tldr: 正则化方式（而非仅架构）显著影响序列模型的长度泛化：权重衰减损害外推，而重新设计 dropout 位置可提升外推，甚至实现 64× 外推。
AI.motivation: 长度泛化通常被归因于架构设计（位置编码、注意力机制），本文旨在说明训练过程本身（尤其是正则化）也是关键因素，并厘清正则化对训练长度之外外推能力的影响。
AI.method: 系统研究正则化对长度泛化的影响；发现 dropout 的标准放置（层归一化之前）会造成系统性分布失配，提出将 dropout 置于线性投影之前；并进一步提出保方差仿射 Dropout（VPAD）以减小激活前方差失配。
AI.result: 权重衰减阻碍外推；调整 dropout 位置后，采用滑动窗口注意力的改进版 SmolLM3 经带 dropout 的持续预训练，在 Needle-in-a-Haystack 上可完美外推至 64×，在 RULER 与 HELMET 上远超预训练上下文长度；Mamba2 同样受益，表明问题与架构无关；VPAD 明显降低激活前方差失配并进一步提升 Transformer 外推表现。
AI.conclusion: 长度泛化不仅是架构问题，也取决于训练中的正则化设计；合理的 dropout 放置与保方差策略可显著提升外推能力，且该结论具有跨架构的普适性。

title: Beyond Overparameterization: Provable Learning of Input-Convex Multi-Layer Polynomial Networks with Active Queries
summary: The theoretical understanding of multi-layer neural networks is largely confined to overparameterized settings, which obscure parameter identifiability and incur high sample complexity. Neural tangent kernel (NTK) provides a general theory for wide networks, but does not offer efficient sample-complexity guarantees. Recent feature-learning results go beyond kernel methods for single-neuron, multi-index, and hierarchical targets. However, the analysis is often restricted to shallow or specific architectures and to the overparameterized regime. We break this paradigm to achieve parameter-level recovery of deep target networks, albeit by using active data queries. Specifically, we study $L$-layer polynomial networks with even degree-$k$ monomial activations and nonnegative higher-layer weights. This structure makes the target network input-convex, while the optimization landscape remains highly nonconvex with respect to the parameters. Leveraging input convexity and active queries, we propose \textbf{ASPIRE} (\textbf{A}ctive \textbf{S}am\textbf{P}ling for \textbf{I}terative \textbf{R}ecovery via \textbf{E}igendirections), a layerwise sampling-based diagonalization algorithm that recovers all network parameters to $δ$-accuracy with sample complexity $ \widetilde O_{k,L}\left(d^{L^2+O(L)}δ^{-2e}\right) $ in polynomial time. To our knowledge, this is the \emph{first} parameter-recovery guarantee for deep target networks whose exponent grows only polynomially with depth, as well as the \emph{first} justification for the effectiveness of using high-quality data in neural network training, with a remarkably \emph{exponential} separation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ASPIRE 算法，利用输入凸性与主动查询，实现对深层多项式网络的参数级恢复，样本复杂度指数仅随深度多项式增长。
AI.motivation: 现有深度网络理论多局限于过参数化情形，NTK 理论虽适用于宽网络但样本复杂度效率不足，特征学习结果又常限于浅层或特定结构；本文希望打破这一范式，实现深层目标网络的参数级恢复。
AI.method: 研究对象为 $L$ 层多项式网络，激活函数为偶数次 $k$ 阶单项式，高层权重非负，使目标网络具有输入凸性。提出 ASPIRE（基于特征方向的主动采样迭代恢复）算法，采用逐层采样与对角化策略，结合输入凸性与主动数据查询进行参数恢复。
AI.result: ASPIRE 能在多项式时间内以 $\delta$ 精度恢复全部网络参数，样本复杂度为 $\widetilde O_{k,L}(d^{L^2+O(L)}\delta^{-2e})$，其指数仅随深度呈多项式增长。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个对深层目标网络实现参数恢复、且样本复杂度指数仅随深度多项式增长的保证，也是首次从理论上证明高质量数据对神经网络训练有效，并展现出显著的指数级分离优势。

title: Proximal Causal Learning under Unmeasured Confounding
summary: Estimating treatment effects from observational data typically relies on the No Unmeasured Confounding Assumption (NUCA), which rarely holds in practice. Proximal causal learning (PCL) addresses unmeasured confounding via proxy variables, yet existing methods require the proxy variables to be pre-specified. Thus, we propose PCL-U, a framework that learns proxy variables directly from observed covariates. PCL-U uses neural encoders to decompose covariates into treatment-inducing, outcome-inducing, and shared proxies, guided by minimax mutual information objectives, and obtains causal estimates through a practical moment-based risk function. Experiments on benchmarks show that PCL-U matches or outperforms existing baselines. Besides, there are two types of synthetic datasets with varying dimensions and confounding strengths that illustrate that our method maintains stable estimation accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 PCL-U 框架，从观测协变量中自动学习代理变量以应对未测量混杂，通过神经编码器分解协变量并结合极小极大互信息目标与矩风险函数进行因果估计，在基准实验中达到或超越现有方法且估计稳定性良好。
AI.motivation: 从观测数据估计处理效应通常依赖"无未测量混杂假设"（NUCA），但该假设在实际中很少成立。近端因果学习（PCL）借助代理变量处理未测量混杂，但现有方法要求代理变量预先指定，限制了适用范围。
AI.method: PCL-U 直接从观测协变量中学习代理变量：使用神经编码器将协变量分解为处理诱导型、结果诱导型与共享型代理，并以极小极大互信息目标进行引导；随后通过一个实用的基于矩的风险函数获得因果估计。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上，PCL-U 的估计效果与现有基线持平或更优；此外，在两类具有不同维度和混杂强度的合成数据集上，方法均保持稳定的估计精度。
AI.conclusion: PCL-U 通过自动学习代理变量，缓解了 PCL 对代理变量预先指定的依赖，为存在未测量混杂的观测数据因果推断提供了一种可行且稳健的方案。

title: Measuring Learned Monotone Temporal Aggregation at Matched Admissibility
summary: Risk regulation imposes directional constraints on scores; we adopt their strict per-input form -- the score monotone non-decreasing in every exposure input -- as a normative commitment. Deployed pipelines -- monotone hand-crafted aggregates feeding sign-constrained gradient boosting -- already satisfy it by composition, so constrained-versus-unconstrained comparisons price a guarantee the incumbent has for free. We instead hold admissibility fixed on both sides and measure what learning the aggregation is worth. Our instrument is a recurrent network whose state is classical risk statistics (an exponentially weighted moving average and a high-water mark with learned transforms), monotone by construction in every input and per MC-dropout sample. The central finding, by functional regression, is a subsumption boundary: a learned monotone channel reproduces the geometrically weighted separable family of hand-crafted statistics, one channel per member, to Spearman $ρ\ge 0.996$, approximates window statistics with measurable ceilings, and fails at consecutivity ($ρ= 0.924$) and time localization (0.628), both structural, and at the exposure floor (0.829), a learnability boundary. One explicit admissible basis repairs each failure (rank correlation 1.000). In or near the separable family, learned and engineered aggregation are substitutes, and the learned channel is never statistically behind at full sample size and specified capacity. Its advantages are incumbent-specific: a committed grid pays up to 0.019 AUC in decay regions it leaves uncovered (the learned channel stays within 0.004 of the strongest engineered consumer at every swept point); the highest-dimensional comparator degrades fastest with scarce data; and beyond the training support, grid-fed tree-ensemble scores go flat while a strictly increasing head keeps ranking. No single incumbent is dominated on all three axes.

AI.tldr: 该论文在保持"逐输入单调非降"这一合规约束双向固定的前提下，探究将手工聚合替换为可学习聚合的价值。作者用状态为经典风险统计量（EWMA与高水位标记，含可学习变换）的循环网络作为工具，通过函数回归发现一个包含/替代边界：可学习单调通道能以一个通道对应一个成员的方式复现几何加权可分族（Spearman ρ≥0.996），但会在连续性、时间定位和暴露下限处失效，且各失效点均可用显式合规基修复。结论是：在可分族内学习聚合与工程聚合互为替代，学习通道在任何扫点均不落后，但其优势依现任者而定，且不存在在所有三个维度上被完全支配的单一现任模型。
AI.motivation: 风险监管对分数施加方向性约束，作者把其严格逐输入形式——分数对每个暴露输入单调非降——作为规范性承诺。由于已部署的流水线（单调手工聚合+符号约束梯度提升）通过组合天然满足该约束，因此"约束vs无约束"的比较实际上是在为现任方案免费拥有的保证定价。作者因此改为在两侧都固定合规性，直接度量"学习聚合"本身的价值。
AI.method: 采用状态为经典风险统计量（一个指数加权移动平均和一个带可学习变换的高水位标记）的循环网络作为工具，该网络按构造对每个输入单调，并对每个MC-dropout样本单调。通过函数回归刻画可学习单调通道与手工统计量之间的关系，并比较学习聚合与工程聚合（含网格化、高维比较器、树集成）在不同数据量与训练支持外的表现。
AI.result: 发现一个包含/替代边界：可学习单调通道以每成员一通道的方式复现几何加权可分族（Spearman ρ≥0.996）；对窗口统计量的近似存在可测上限；在连续性（ρ=0.924）、时间定位（0.628）——两者均为结构性——以及暴露下限（0.829，属可学习性边界）处失效。每一失效均可由一个显式合规基修复（秩相关1.000）。在可分族内或附近，学习聚合与工程聚合互为替代，学习通道在全样本量和指定容量下从不显著落后。其优势是现任特定的：限定网格在未覆盖的衰减区域最多损失0.019 AUC（学习通道在每个扫点均保持在最强工程消费者0.004以内）；最高维比较器在数据稀缺时退化最快；在训练支持之外，网格驱动的树集成分数趋于平坦，而严格递增的头仍能保持排序。
AI.conclusion: 在逐输入单调合规约束固定不变的前提下，学习聚合在可分族内与手工聚合互为替代，并具有依现任者而定的边际优势；没有任何单一现任模型在全部三个维度上被支配。研究还明确了该学习通道的结构性边界与可学习性边界，并指出显式合规基可为每类失效提供修复。

title: Weight Decay and Neuron Condensation: A Three-Stage Analysis of Two-Layer ReLU Networks
summary: Weight decay is widely used as a regularization technique in neural network training, yet its role in neuron condensation (parameter direction alignment) remains unclear. Starting from a parameter initialization in the neural tangent kernel regime, we characterize training dynamics under weight decay through three stages: rapid fitting, amplitude compression, and neuron condensation. Using a two-layer ReLU network, we analyze a residual correlation field that governs both neuron amplitudes and directions. During rapid fitting, the residual approaches a quasi-static equilibrium maintained by weight decay while the tangent kernel remains nearly unchanged. In the early stage of amplitude compression, kernel decay amplifies the residual correlation field, whose isolated attracting extrema provide candidates for condensation directions. As neuron amplitudes stabilize, we bound the drift of attracting extrema and demonstrate contraction of neuron directions around them, leading to neuron condensation. This staged analysis provides a dynamical understanding of how weight decay promotes a condensed representation, beyond reducing parameter norms.

AI.tldr: 本文从NTK初始化的参数出发，刻画权重衰减下的三阶段训练动力学（快速拟合、幅度压缩、神经元凝聚），揭示权重衰减不仅压缩参数范数，还能通过残差关联场促进神经元方向对齐（凝聚）。
AI.motivation: 权重衰减作为常用正则化手段，其在神经元凝聚（参数方向对齐）中的作用尚不明确，需要从动力学角度给出理论解释。
AI.method: 以两层ReLU网络为对象，在NTK（神经正切核）机制下的参数初始化出发，分析控制神经元幅度与方向的残差关联场；分三阶段（快速拟合、幅度压缩、神经元凝聚）推导训练动力学，并给出吸引极值漂移的界与神经元方向的收缩证明。
AI.result: 快速拟合阶段：残差趋于由权重衰减维持的准静态平衡，切核近似不变；幅度压缩早期：核衰减放大残差关联场，其孤立吸引极值成为凝聚方向的候选；幅度稳定后：吸引极值漂移有界，神经元方向向其收缩，从而发生神经元凝聚。
AI.conclusion: 该分阶段分析从动力学上解释了权重衰减如何促进凝聚表示，其作用超出单纯降低参数范数。

title: Diffusion Transformers are Provably Optimal In-context Generators
summary: Generative foundation models are attracting interest for their ability to produce desired outputs from demonstrations given at inference time, without updating parameters. However, since a few demonstrations cannot uniquely identify the intended task, the challenge is how to learn and sample from an output distribution that reflects this task uncertainty. In this work, we theoretically analyze how a Diffusion Transformer (DiT), pretrained across diverse tasks, learns and generates predictive distributions for a new query from demonstrations. We first show that the natural target to generate from finite demonstrations is not an output derived from estimating a single task, but rather a predictive distribution that captures the task uncertainty remaining after observing the demonstrations. We then prove that a DiT can learn this predictive distribution through score estimation, using attention to aggregate information from demonstrations and diffusion to generate samples. Owing to this property, with sufficient pretraining resources and diffusion sampling steps, the resulting DiT achieves the minimax optimal rate over a Hölder class of test-time tasks. These results imply that DiT acts as a statistically grounded in-context generator capable of generating distributions adapted to new tasks while retaining the uncertainty inherent in finite demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上分析了预训练 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 如何在推理时基于少量演示（demonstrations）学习并采样出反映任务不确定性的预测分布，证明其可通过 score estimation 学习该分布，并在 Hölder 任务类上达到 minimax 最优收敛速率，表明 DiT 是一种统计上有依据的 in-context 生成器。
AI.motivation: 生成式基础模型能在推理时仅凭演示产生输出而无需更新参数，但少量演示无法唯一确定目标任务，因此核心挑战在于如何学习并采样一个能反映该任务不确定性的输出分布。作者希望从理论上厘清 DiT 在此情境下学习与生成预测分布的机制及其统计性质。
AI.method: 理论分析。首先论证有限演示下合理的生成目标并非估计单一任务得到的输出，而是捕捉观测演示后残余任务不确定性的预测分布；随后证明 DiT 可借助 attention 聚合演示信息、借助 diffusion 生成样本，通过 score estimation 学习该预测分布。
AI.result: 在充足的预训练资源与扩散采样步数下，所得 DiT 在 Hölder 测试任务类上达到 minimax 最优收敛速率。
AI.conclusion: DiT 可被视为一种统计上有依据的 in-context 生成器，能够生成适应新任务的分布，同时保留有限演示中固有的不确定性。

title: PhaseGate: Phase-Aware CPU Retrieval Scheduling for On-Device LLMs on Unified Memory
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints
summary: On-device assistants run GPU-based LLM inference alongside CPU retrieval on unified-memory systems. Under a saturated local-retrieval workload, four concurrent retrieval workers raise 95th-percentile (p95) decode latency by 60-61% on two M4 systems, whereas prefill latency rises by only 5.7-6.9%. We study LLM phase as an admission signal for independent CPU retrieval under controlled LLM workloads. PHASEGATE calibrates separate concurrency limits for prefill and decode, selecting four and one on our base-M4 configuration. Under a backlogged queue, it achieves 2.0 times the aggregate retrieval throughput of the best tested feasible fixed policy, with both p95 LLM latency metrics within 1.25 times their no-retrieval baselines in all seven held-out runs. A phase-blind control, TimeGate, uses the same two limits on a calibration-derived schedule without observing LLM phase. It achieves similar retrieval throughput but violates the output-token latency limit in every run. M2 and M2 Pro Mac minis reproduce the policy ordering, while output-length sweeps show that the advantage narrows as decode occupies more of each request.

AI.tldr: PHASEGATE利用LLM的prefill/decode阶段作为CPU检索任务的准入信号，为两阶段分别校准并发上限，在保障LLM延迟的前提下显著提升检索吞吐。
AI.motivation: 在统一内存设备端助手中，GPU LLM推理与CPU检索并发运行时，饱和的本地检索负载会显著抬高decode阶段的p95延迟（60-61%），而对prefill影响很小（5.7-6.9%）。因此需要一种能区分LLM阶段、动态控制检索并发的准入机制。
AI.method: PHASEGATE为prefill和decode分别校准并发上限（在base-M4上分别取4和1），根据LLM当前阶段选择对应限额进行准入控制。研究设置了一个阶段盲的对照策略TimeGate，它使用相同的两个限额但按校准得到的固定时间表切换，不观测LLM阶段。
AI.result: 在积压队列下，PHASEGATE达到最佳可行固定策略检索聚合吞吐的2.0倍；在全部七次留出运行中，两项p95 LLM延迟指标均保持在无检索基线的1.25倍以内。阶段盲对照TimeGate吞吐相近，但每次运行都违反输出token延迟上限。M2与M2 Pro Mac mini复现了策略排序；输出长度扫描显示，当decode在请求中占比更大时，PHASEGATE的优势收窄。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM阶段作为准入信号能有效协调CPU检索与GPU推理的资源竞争：观测阶段并按阶段设定并发上限，可在不显著损害LLM延迟的情况下提升检索吞吐，而忽略阶段的调度方案无法满足延迟约束。该策略的优势随decode占比增加而减弱。

title: From Pixels, Without Pre-training: Joint Generative and Self-Supervised Representation Learning in One Model
summary: Strong image generation models are conditioned on class labels, aligned to frozen pretrained encoders, or built on separately trained autoencoders. While effective, generation then depends on supervision or pretraining: labels must be annotated, and encoders or autoencoders pretrained for the target domain. We study joint generative and self-supervised representation learning in a single model, enabling self-conditioned generation without labels or pretrained models. This is challenging because the objectives are mismatched: contrastive learning consumes clean augmented views and favors coarse, invariant semantics, while flow matching consumes noisy images and must preserve the fine detail and spatial layout that contrastive learning discards. We propose SCION (Self-conditioned Generation on Self-supervised representation), whose core is a single pixel-space encoder conditioned on the flow timestep and an embedding. For representation learning, this conditioning embedding is a learned global vector shared across images, with the encoder's [CLS] token yielding the semantic representation trained by the contrastive loss. For generative training, the conditioning embedding is the image's own [CLS] representation, while patch tokens pass through a decoder to predict the image. To sample without a reference image at inference, we jointly learn a prior over the embedding. Gradient-norm balancing and stop-gradient mechanisms enable joint optimization in one run. SCION is self-supervised and self-contained, with no labels or pretrained models. On ImageNet 256x256, with the JiT-B recipe and no representation guidance, SCION reaches 8.92 FID, surpassing class-unconditional iREPA, which aligns to pretrained DINOv2 (46.44), and RCG, which conditions on it (14.27). With JiT-L, SCION achieves 5.89 FID without guidance and 3.47 with representation guidance, outperforming RCG with the ADM recipe (6.24).

AI.tldr: 提出SCION，在单一模型中联合进行自监督表示学习与生成，无需标签或预训练模型，实现自条件生成。
AI.motivation: 现有强生成模型依赖类别标签、对齐的冻结预训练编码器或独立训练的自编码器，其生成能力因此受限于监督信息或预训练资源（标签需标注、编码器/自编码器需在目标域预训练）。作者希望用单一模型同时实现生成与自监督表示学习，从而摆脱标签和预训练依赖。
AI.method: 核心是单个像素空间编码器，其条件为flow时间步与一个embedding。表示学习时，条件embedding为所有图像共享的可学习全局向量，编码器的[CLS] token作为语义表示并由对比损失训练；生成训练时，条件embedding为该图像自身的[CLS]表示，patch token经解码器重建图像。为在推理时无需参考图像采样，联合学习embedding上的先验。通过梯度范数平衡与stop-gradient机制实现单次联合优化。解决了对比学习（需干净增强视图、偏好粗糙不变语义）与flow matching（需噪声图像、须保留细节与空间布局）目标不匹配的问题。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256x256上，采用JiT-B配方且无表示引导时FID为8.92，优于类别无条件iREPA（对齐预训练DINOv2，46.44）和RCG（以其为条件，14.27）；采用JiT-L时无引导FID 5.89，带表示引导3.47，超过使用ADM配方的RCG（6.24）。
AI.conclusion: SCION是自监督且自包含的，无需标签和预训练模型，验证了联合生成与自监督表示学习在单一模型中的可行性，并在ImageNet 256x256上取得了优于依赖预训练编码器方法的生成性能。

title: TMAML: Temporal Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Cold-Start Time Series Forecasting
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, Accepted at Neurips 2026 TS-LIMITS Workshop
summary: Cold-start forecasting, the task of forecasting a time series with little to no historical data, is a common challenge. Addressing it requires approaches that learn quickly from few datapoints and leverage information from related series, typically through static covariates, to generalize well to unseen series. While some global forecasting models can generate cold-start predictions by leveraging information shared across multiple series, they are not optimized for out-of-train-set generalization or adaptation from short histories. In this work, we formulate cold-start forecasting as a few-window learning problem and introduce Temporal Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (TMAML), which tailors the model-agnostic meta-learning algorithm, originally developed for few-shot adaptation of neural networks, to deep time series forecasting. TMAML constructs meta-tasks as temporally consistent support-query windows and pairs them with a temporal meta-training and meta-testing procedure, yielding forecasting models that are explicitly optimized for cold-start forecasting. We instantiate TMAML on the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and present an initial empirical analysis of forecast accuracy and calibration across three cold-start scenarios: TMAML consistently outperforms or matches a standard ERM-trained TFT, yields better-calibrated forecasts than naive on two of the three scenarios, but does not consistently outperform naive on probabilistic forecast accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文将冷启动预测形式化为少窗口学习问题，提出时序模型无关元学习（TMAML），在TFT上实例化，在三个冷启动场景中开展了初步实证分析。
AI.motivation: 冷启动预测（历史数据极少或没有）是常见难题，需要能从少量数据快速学习并借助相关序列（通常通过静态协变量）泛化到未见序列的方法。现有全局预测模型虽可借助跨序列共享信息生成冷启动预测，但未针对训练集外泛化或短历史自适应进行优化。
AI.method: 将冷启动预测建模为少窗口学习问题；提出TMAML，把原本用于神经网络少样本自适应的模型无关元学习（MAML）改造到深度时序预测中。TMAML以时间一致的支持-查询窗口构建元任务，并配合时序元训练与元测试流程，使模型显式针对冷启动预测优化。在Temporal Fusion Transformer（TFT）上实例化TMAML。
AI.result: 在三个冷启动场景下开展预测精度与校准的初步实证分析：TMAML一致优于或持平于标准ERM训练的TFT；在三个场景中的两个场景上比naive方法获得更好的校准；但在概率预测精度上并未一致优于naive方法。
AI.conclusion: TMAML为冷启动预测提供了显式优化的元学习框架，在点预测精度与预测校准方面展现初步优势，但概率预测精度相对naive方法尚不稳定，需进一步验证与改进。

title: The Blind Spot Paradox: When Adaptive Classifiers Defeat Drift Detectors
comment: Accepted at IEEE ICDM 2026 Workshops (OWAD 2026). 10 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/TheBlindSpotParadox/TheBlindSpotParadox-Experiments
summary: Monitoring concept drift from an adaptive classifier's error stream creates an operational conflict with the model's own update loop. When internal adaptation outpaces evidence accumulation, accuracy recovers before cumulative detectors (CUSUM, Page-Hinkley) can reach threshold. Instrumenting an Adaptive Random Forest (ARF) shows that surviving trees absorb 98.6% of the post-drift error transient through incremental leaf updates alone. The first background tree swap accounts for just 0.71% of this erased error volume, but drops external detection rates by 31 percentage points. We derive the finite-horizon boundary where cumulative evidence fails to cross threshold and measure a critical magnitude floor ($Δe_c = 0.120$) below which false-alarm budgets preclude detection. This failure manifests as missed shifts on stationary streams and false-alarm flooding triggered by internal tree swaps on noisy baselines. We validate on synthetic shifts, ARMA-GARCH series (ProteuS), and tabular benchmarks (BAF, INSECTS); on the synthetic sweep at a standard threshold, the blind spot appears at $Δe \approx 0.25$, showing why classical benchmarks like SEA ($Δe \le 0.21$) failed to reach it.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了自适应分类器的内部快速适应会"抹去"漂移误差证据，使CUSUM、Page-Hinkley等累积型检测器出现检测盲区，并给出有限时域边界与临界幅度下界（Δe_c=0.120）。
AI.motivation: 概念漂移监测器通常基于模型误差流进行累积统计检验，但自适应模型自身会持续更新以恢复精度，二者形成操作性冲突：当内部适应速度快于证据积累速度时，误差瞬态在检测器达到阈值前就被消除。作者旨在刻画这一冲突导致的检测失效条件与边界。
AI.method: 以自适应随机森林（ARF）为对象进行插桩分析，量化各组件对漂移后误差瞬态的"吸收"比例；推导累积证据无法越过阈值的有限时域边界，并测量导致误报预算禁止检测的临界幅度下界Δe_c。在合成漂移、ARMA-GARCH序列（ProteuS）及表格基准（BAF、INSECTS）上进行验证，并与经典基准SEA对比。
AI.result: 幸存树通过叶节点增量更新吸收98.6%的漂移后误差瞬态；首次后台树替换仅占被抹去误差量的0.71%，却使外部检测率下降31个百分点。临界幅度下界Δe_c=0.120，低于该值时误报预算使检测不可行。失效表现为平稳流上的漏检和噪声基线中由内部树替换引发的误报泛滥。合成扫描在标准阈值下盲区出现在Δe≈0.25，解释了SEA（Δe≤0.21）未能触及该盲区的原因。
AI.conclusion: 自适应模型的内部更新回路会系统性削弱累积型漂移检测器的可见证据，形成依赖幅度与误报预算的检测盲区；经典基准因漂移幅度低于盲区阈值而掩盖了该问题，需在漂移检测设计中显式考虑适应速度与证据积累速率的耦合。

title: Only Project Once: Projection-Adaptive Loss for Exact Constraint Satisfaction
summary: Precise constraint satisfaction is a prerequisite to deploying learned models in many areas, motivating methods that repair raw neural predictions with a repair procedure. Current methods unroll multiple repair steps in training and softly penalize constraint violations that remain after the unroll. This is compute- and memory-intensive, lacks robustness when the repair fails to converge, and surrenders most of the constraint satisfaction work to the repair. Our central finding is that, contrary to common practice, a single detached projection step suffices in training. We accomplish this with a Projection-Adaptive Loss (PAL), which uses the constraint residual after this single step to adaptively weigh constraint penalties on the raw prediction. In experiments, PAL is the only method that retains virtually perfect feasibility on extremely nonlinear constraints, and matches or outperforms current methods on synthetic and engineering benchmarks. Because it only requires a single detached projection step, PAL trains 2.5x faster than the canonical repair-based method (DC3) on its own ACOPF benchmark. PAL can also be trained when constraints are expensive to evaluate (e.g., via neural surrogates), a setting where current unrolled methods are memory-intractable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Projection-Adaptive Loss（PAL），发现训练中仅需一次 detach 的投影步骤即可实现精确约束满足，无需多次展开修复步骤。
AI.motivation: 当前将学习模型部署到需精确约束满足的领域时，常采用修复过程修正神经预测，但现有方法在训练中展开多步修复并对残余违反施加软惩罚，存在计算与内存开销大、修复不收敛时鲁棒性差、约束满足主要依赖修复等问题。
AI.method: 作者提出 Projection-Adaptive Loss（PAL）：在训练中使用单次 detached 投影步骤，并利用该步骤后的约束残差自适应地加权原始预测上的约束惩罚项。
AI.result: 实验表明，PAL 是唯一在极度非线性约束下仍保持近乎完美可行性的方法，在合成与工程基准上匹配或优于现有方法；在其 ACOPF 基准上训练速度比经典修复方法 DC3 快 2.5 倍；在约束评估代价高昂（如使用神经代理模型）且现有展开方法内存不可行的场景下，PAL 仍可训练。
AI.conclusion: 与常见做法相反，训练中单次 detached 投影步骤已足够实现精确约束满足，PAL 在可行性、效率与内存可扩展性方面均具优势。

title: Global Communication or Graph-Specific Memory?
summary: Scalable Graph Transformers are commonly trained and evaluated on static large graphs in a transductive setup. Many scalable Graph Transformer components can be formulated as a constant-size shared memory, similar to virtual nodes, providing compressed information about the whole graph. The counterpart of these models in language models and other domains is justified as the input changes, and this mechanism learns to compress some useful information about the input. In transductive learning on a single fixed graph, however, any shared memory can be seen as a constant at test time. This raises the question of what exactly this shared memory does in this static setup. We give preliminary evidence that optimizing a shared memory directly performs similarly to global communication methods, and so normal local message-passing models can embed similar information in their weights. Thus, these settings may be a poor fit for evaluating global communication in graph neural networks.

AI.tldr: 在静态图的直推式学习设定下，共享记忆（如虚拟节点）可被视为测试期常量，直接优化其效果与全局通信方法相近，说明此类设定不适合评估GNN中的全局通信。
AI.motivation: 可扩展Graph Transformer常在静态大图上进行直推式训练与评估，其组件可建模为类似虚拟节点的常量共享记忆，用于压缩全图信息。但在这类设定下输入固定不变，共享记忆在测试时可视为常量，因此其实际作用存疑，需要澄清该机制在静态场景中的意义。
AI.method: 将可扩展Graph Transformer中的共享记忆组件统一表述为常量大小的共享记忆，并在此框架下直接优化共享记忆，与全局通信方法进行对比，同时考察普通局部消息传递模型能否在权重中嵌入类似信息。
AI.result: 初步证据表明，直接优化共享记忆的性能与全局通信方法相当，且普通局部消息传递模型也能在权重中嵌入类似信息。
AI.conclusion: 静态直推式图学习设定可能不适合评估图神经网络中的全局通信机制，因为共享记忆在此场景下退化为常量，可由局部模型通过权重近似替代。

title: DiffGate: Difficulty-Gated Teacher Guidance for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a widely used paradigm for post-training large language models, reducing the train--test mismatch of conventional distillation by supervising the student on its own generated trajectories. However, existing OPD objectives remain largely token-local and outcome-agnostic, optimizing teacher--student agreement at each prefix despite reasoning quality being determined at the trajectory level. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), provides complementary outcome-level supervision but suffers from sparse rewards and coarse credit assignment. We show that OPD and RLVR exhibit complementary blind spots: teacher signals provide dense local guidance but are weakly aligned with rollout correctness, whereas group-relative rewards capture task success but provide coarse token-level credit and vanish on all-failure groups. We introduce DiffGate, an outcome-gated objective that combines GRPO with selective, bounded teacher guidance. Teacher supervision is applied only to failed trajectories, scaled by group difficulty, and smoothly bounded to prevent extreme teacher--student discrepancies from dominating optimization. The verifier therefore determines \emph{which trajectories} receive teacher guidance, while the teacher provides dense token-level update directions within those trajectories. Across Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B students, DiffGate improves code avg@8 over matched GRPO by $+1.7$ and $+1.8$ points and pass@8 by $+1.6$ and $+5.7$ points, respectively. On mathematics, avg@8 remains within $0.5$ points of GRPO while pass@8 improves by $+1.1$ and $+3.9$ points. Overall, DiffGate improves pass@8 across all four model--domain settings, demonstrating improved solution coverage under our evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: DiffGate结合GRPO与选择性、有界教师指导，仅对失败轨迹施加按组难度缩放的教师监督，在Qwen3学生模型上跨代码与数学任务提升pass@8与avg@8。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy蒸馏（OPD）目标多为token局部且忽视结果，仅在每个前缀上优化师生一致性，而推理质量由轨迹层面决定；RLVR（如GRPO）提供互补的结果级监督，却存在奖励稀疏、信用分配粗糙、全失败组奖励消失等问题。二者存在互补的盲区，作者旨在融合两类信号的优点。
AI.method: 提出DiffGate，一种结果门控（outcome-gated）目标：在GRPO基础上加入选择性的、有界的教师指导。教师监督仅施加于失败轨迹，并按组难度进行缩放，同时做平滑有界处理，防止极端师生差异主导优化。由验证器决定哪些轨迹获得教师指导，教师则在被选轨迹内提供密集的token级更新方向。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-0.6B与Qwen3-1.7B学生模型上，DiffGate相较匹配的GRPO在代码任务上avg@8分别提升+1.7与+1.8分，pass@8分别提升+1.6与+5.7分；在数学任务上avg@8与GRPO差距在0.5分以内，pass@8分别提升+1.1与+3.9分。总体在全部四种模型—领域设定下pass@8均有提升。
AI.conclusion: DiffGate通过结果门控融合RLVR的结果级信号与OPD的密集局部指导，缓解了奖励稀疏与信用分配粗糙的问题，在所评估协议下改善了解决方案覆盖率（pass@8）并保持或提升avg@8。

title: Sampling Allocation of LinUCB: Optimal Design Limits in the Small-Gap Regime
summary: We study the sampling allocation of LinUCB in the small-gap regime, where the reward gaps are of order at most $n^{-1/2}$ over the decision horizon $n$. This scaling captures the hard instances underlying worst-case regret lower bounds, for which LinUCB is known to be near optimal up to logarithmic factors in $n$. Using a mean-field perspective, we characterize this allocation through the empirical sampling distribution, a macroscopic object that averages the effect of adaptive decisions over the horizon, and identify its limit as $n\to\infty$. We establish that in this regime, the empirical sampling distribution induced by LinUCB converges to the set of D-optimal designs. This central result reveals that, in the small-gap regime, LinUCB not only achieves near optimal minimax regret but also allocates samples in a way that is asymptotically efficient for learning the reward parameter, thereby connecting regret-driven online learning with information-efficient experimental design. Building on the optimal design limit, we obtain two useful consequences. First, we refine the asymptotic regret analysis of LinUCB in the small-gap regime by characterizing its leading-order constant in the limit. Second, we show that, despite LinUCB's adaptive sampling strategy, the regularized least-squares estimator satisfies a central-limit-type theorem in the small-gap regime, thereby enabling valid statistical inference for the reward parameter.

AI.tldr: 本文研究小间隙（gap为 $n^{-1/2}$ 量级）下 LinUCB 的采样分配，证明其经验采样分布收敛到 D-最优设计集合，并由此改进渐近遗憾常数并给出奖励参数的正则化最小二乘估计的中心极限定理。
AI.motivation: 小间隙区间是导致最坏情况遗憾下界的关键困难实例，LinUCB 在其中已达近最优（相差对数因子）。作者希望从"平均场/采样分布"这一宏观视角，理解 LinUCB 的自适应采样究竟如何分配样本，以及这种分配是否对学习奖励参数本身是高效的。
AI.method: 采用平均场视角，通过经验采样分布（将自适应决策效果在整个决策周期上取平均的宏观对象）刻画采样分配，并分析其 $n\to\infty$ 的极限行为。核心是证明该经验分布收敛到 D-最优设计集合，进而基于此最优设计极限推导渐近遗憾的领头阶常数，并分析正则化最小二乘估计的渐近分布。
AI.result: （1）在 $n^{-1/2}$ 小间隙区间，LinUCB 诱导的经验采样分布收敛到 D-最优设计集合；（2）刻画了 LinUCB 渐近遗憾的领头阶常数；（3）证明即使采样自适应，正则化最小二乘估计仍满足中心极限定理型结果。
AI.conclusion: LinUCB 在小间隙下不仅达到近最优的极小极大遗憾，其样本分配还渐近等价于对奖励参数学习最优的 D-最优设计，从而将遗憾驱动的在线学习与信息高效的实验设计联系起来；该极限进一步支持渐近遗憾常数的精化与奖励参数的有效统计推断。

title: Asymptotically Optimal Best Arm Identification with Fixed-Budget under Differential Privacy
summary: Best arm identification under differential privacy is a pure-exploration problem in which both statistical efficiency and privacy protection must be achieved simultaneously. We study fixed-budget best arm identification for bandits under pure $ε$-differential privacy, where the learner must recommend an arm after a prescribed sampling budget while protecting the full transcript. We prove that the optimal exponential decay rate of the error probability is upper bounded by an instance-dependent privacy-aware transportation exponent that differs from the analogous quantity used to characterize the stopping time in fixed-confidence analysis by Jourdan and Azize [2025]. Guided by this exponent, we propose AO-Pri-BAI, an adaptive algorithm that maintains private running estimates through Laplace-tree mechanisms and learns a sampling design through a min--max interaction between hard alternatives and arm allocations. We prove that AO-Pri-BAI satisfies pure $ε$-differential privacy. We also establish that the exponent of the failure probability of AO-Pri-BAI matches the privacy-aware benchmark. Numerical studies show that even in the non-asymptotic setting, AO-Pri-BAI outperforms benchmark algorithms on various instances, complementing the theoretical analyses.

AI.tldr: 研究纯ε-差分隐私下的固定预算最佳臂识别问题，推导了错误概率最优指数衰减率的上界（隐私感知传输指数），并提出AO-Pri-BAI算法，其失败概率指数达到该基准，数值实验优于现有算法。
AI.motivation: 在差分隐私约束下进行最佳臂识别时，需要同时保证统计效率与隐私保护。固定预算设定下的最优错误概率衰减率尚缺乏明确的隐私感知刻画，且与固定置信度分析中的相应量可能不同，因此需要建立理论基础并设计匹配该基准的算法。
AI.method: 针对纯ε-差分隐私带臂问题，证明错误概率的最优指数衰减率上界由实例相关的隐私感知传输指数决定（区别于Jourdan和Azize [2025]固定置信度分析中刻画停止时间的量）。据此提出AO-Pri-BAI自适应算法：通过Laplace-tree机制维护私有运行估计，并在困难备择与臂分配之间进行min-max交互学习采样设计。
AI.result: 证明了AO-Pri-BAI满足纯ε-差分隐私；建立了其失败概率指数与隐私感知基准相匹配。数值研究表明，即使在非渐近情形下，AO-Pri-BAI在多种实例上均优于基准算法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为差分隐私固定预算最佳臂识别提供了紧致的隐私感知指数刻画，并提出达到该基准的自适应算法AO-Pri-BAI，理论保证与数值表现一致。

title: When Are Concept Bottleneck Model Explanations Faithful and Compact?
summary: Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) are neural classifiers that allow to explain their decisions via high-level concepts, potentially enabling understanding, steering and debugging. However, their explanations are often derived heuristically. Building on formal explainability, we argue they should also be faithful, i.e., not misreport which concepts actually matter. We show that, for widespread CBM architectures, including recent VLM-based variants, faithful explanations must include all concepts in the bottleneck, compromising interpretability when this is large. This result applies to both heuristic and faithful-by-construction formal explanations. To encourage the existence of compact faithful explanations, we suggest i) modeling concepts probabilistically as binary or categorical random variables (rather than logits), and ii) employing per-concept training-time sparsification via group lasso (rather than regular elastic net). We also extend algorithms from formal explainability to CBMs, and show they outperform natural heuristics in terms of guarantees and explanation size. Overall, our work warns against naive interpretability claims and provides formal conditions and practical strategies for ensuring CBMs are as interpretable as advertised.

AI.tldr: 本文从形式化可解释性角度审视概念瓶颈模型（CBM），证明在常见架构下忠实解释必须包含瓶颈层全部概念，并提出概率化概念建模与逐概念稀疏化等策略以获得紧凑忠实解释。
AI.motivation: CBM通过高层概念解释决策，但其解释多由启发式方法导出，可能误报真正重要的概念。作者主张CBM解释应满足忠实性（不错误报告哪些概念真正重要），并研究在何种条件下才能同时保证忠实与简洁。
AI.method: 1) 基于形式化可解释性（formal explainability）分析CBM的忠实解释；2) 对包括近期VLM-based变体在内的主流CBM架构进行理论分析；3) 提出两项设计建议：将概念建模为二值或类别随机变量（而非logits），以及采用group lasso进行逐概念的训练时稀疏化（替代elastic net）；4) 将形式化可解释性算法扩展到CBM。
AI.result: 对主流CBM架构（含VLM-based变体），忠实解释必须包含瓶颈层中的所有概念，当瓶颈较大时损害可解释性；该结论对启发式解释与“构造即忠实”的形式化解释均成立。所扩展的形式化算法在保证性与解释规模上均优于自然启发式方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究警示不应轻信朴素的CBM可解释性主张，并给出确保CBM达到其所宣称可解释性的形式化条件与实用策略。

title: Anticipating the Consequences of Curriculum Decisions with Large Language Models
summary: Automatic curriculum learning can improve the effectiveness of reinforcement learning by selecting the training experiences presented to the agent over time. Predicting the consequences of such decisions can, however, be difficult. We analyze automatic curriculum learning as a sequential decision-making problem, highlighting a gap between the quantities that determine the value of curriculum decisions and the information captured by local learning signals commonly used to guide them. We then investigate whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can exploit richer information about the learning problem to better anticipate the consequences of curriculum decisions. We introduce a method that combines online learning-progress estimates with LLM-informed estimates of (i) the potential downstream benefits of learning on each task and (ii) whether direct training on a task is currently likely to produce progress. We evaluate the approach on a custom benchmark of 256 textual goals in Craftax under different curriculum objectives. We observe the strongest gains when optimizing for individual target tasks. When optimizing across the full task set, the benefits vary across learners with different mechanisms for cross-task transfer, ranging from modest improvements in learning speed to larger gains that persist through the end of training.

AI.tldr: 该论文将自动课程学习建模为序贯决策问题，指出决定课程决策价值的信息与常用局部学习信号之间存在鸿沟；提出结合在线学习进度估计与LLM估计的方法（评估各任务的下游收益潜力及当前直接训练该任务是否能产生进展），并在Craftax的256个文本目标基准上验证。
AI.motivation: 自动课程学习能通过随时间选择呈现给智能体的训练经验来提升强化学习效果，但预测此类课程决策的后果较困难。作者指出：决定课程决策价值的量（如任务的下游收益）与常用于指导课程的局部学习信号（如即时学习进度）之间存在不匹配，因此希望利用LLM所掌握的关于学习问题的更丰富信息来更好预判课程决策的后果。
AI.method: 将自动课程学习形式化为序贯决策问题；提出一种方法，把在线学习进度估计与LLM给出的两类估计相结合：(i) 在每个任务上学习可能带来的下游收益潜力；(ii) 当前直接训练某任务是否可能产生进展。在此基础上构建了包含256个文本目标的Craftax自定义基准，并在不同的课程目标下进行评估。
AI.result: 在面向单个目标任务进行优化时，收益最为显著；当在完整任务集上优化时，效果因智能体的跨任务迁移机制而异，从学习速度的适度提升到能够持续到训练结束的更大收益不等。
AI.conclusion: LLM提供的高层信息可弥补局部学习信号在预判课程决策后果上的不足，从而提升自动课程学习的效果；但收益大小依赖于课程目标（单目标任务 vs. 全任务集）以及智能体的跨任务迁移机制。

title: Quantifying the Stability of Multi-Step Reasoning via Error Amplification
summary: We consider the stability of multi-step reasoning processes, which have extensive applications in language models, including chain-of-thought and algorithmic reasoning. While longer sequences of reasoning can improve a model's generation capability at test time, the errors due to intermediate reasoning steps can accumulate in autoregressive generation, and thus grow substantially at the end. In this paper, we ask: What are the key factors determining the stability of multi-step reasoning? First, we show an inference error bound governed by the product of spectral norms of the Jacobians taken through the input space across generation steps. This product can be viewed as an error amplification factor, which could scale exponentially with the number of reasoning steps, serving as a quantitative measure of reasoning stability. Second, we analyze this measure in transformer models trained to predict simple tasks like linear and quadratic functions. We theoretically prove that the transformer model converges to a solution where the stability measure decays, thus yielding nearly zero inference loss over (arbitrarily) long steps. Finally, the stability analysis leads to several algorithmic implications for controlling the stability, through (i) chain-of-thought length compression that reduces the sensitivity of each step, and (ii) quantization-aware training that regularizes the input Jacobian norms. We validate the proposed algorithms by fine-tuning language models on graph-algorithmic reasoning tasks and symbolic state-tracking tasks. Across seven evaluations, our algorithms improve over baseline comparisons by 3.5% on average, and by 8.2% for longer-length inputs. Ablation analysis validates that the stability measure is drastically reduced by 3-8$\times$, confirming the regularization effect on the spectral norms of the (input space) Jacobians.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多步推理的稳定性问题，提出以跨生成步输入空间雅可比谱范数乘积作为误差放大因子，理论证明Transformer可收敛到稳定解，并提出CoT长度压缩与量化感知训练两种稳定化算法，在多项任务上平均提升3.5%（长输入8.2%）。
AI.motivation: 多步推理（如思维链、算法推理）在语言模型中广泛应用，更长的推理序列可提升测试时的生成能力，但自回归生成中中间步骤误差会累积并在末端显著放大。因此需要明确决定多步推理稳定性的关键因素。
AI.method: 1) 推导推理误差上界：由跨生成步、穿过输入空间的雅可比谱范数乘积控制，该乘积可视为误差放大因子，随推理步数可能指数增长，作为推理稳定性的定量度量。2) 在训练线性与二次函数任务的Transformer上分析该度量，理论上证明模型收敛到稳定度量衰减的解，从而在（任意）长步数下获得近乎零的推理损失。3) 基于稳定性分析提出两种控制算法：(i) 思维链长度压缩以降低每步敏感度；(ii) 量化感知训练以正则化输入雅可比范数。
AI.result: 在图算法推理任务和符号状态追踪任务上微调语言模型进行验证：七项评估中，算法平均优于基线3.5%，长输入上提升8.2%；消融分析显示稳定性度量大幅降低3-8倍，证实对输入空间雅可比谱范数的正则化效果。
AI.conclusion: 跨步输入空间雅可比谱范数乘积是刻画多步推理稳定性的关键量化指标；通过CoT长度压缩与量化感知训练可有效正则化该指标，提升长链推理的稳定性与性能。

title: Backward-Consistent Diffusion Sampling for Sparsely Observed PDE Inverse Problems
summary: Recovering Partial Differential Equation (PDE) coefficient fields from extremely sparse observations is a severely ill-posed inverse problem for which generative machine learning methods (e.g., diffusion models) have become a leading way to encode the prior. Recent state-of-the-art diffusion solvers lift these priors to function spaces, finding a physics-consistent reconstruction in the output space of the diffusion denoiser. We prove that, in a discontinuous PDE setting, output space methods can result in failure to appropriately minimize the unobserved error with the correct coefficient field. Consequently, we propose Function space Backward-Consistent Sampling (FunBCS), an input space optimization approach for solving PDE problems which aims to find the best input such that the denoiser reconstruction is physics-consistent. We then prove that FunBCS appropriately minimizes the unobserved error, unlike output space optimization methods. Per our theoretical analysis, we also provide insights on how to dynamically allocate the number of input space optimization steps used throughout the sampling process. Our evaluations, across four PDE inverse problems (including the discontinuous Darcy flow), demonstrate that FunBCS reduces the reconstruction error by $27$-$64\%$ while running $1.4$-$2.1\times$ faster when compared to the current state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FunBCS——一种输入空间优化的扩散采样方法，用于从极稀疏观测中恢复PDE系数场，理论上证明其优于输出空间方法，并在四类PDE反问题中降低重构误差27%-64%且加速1.4-2.1倍。
AI.motivation: 从极稀疏观测中恢复偏微分方程（PDE）系数场是严重病态的逆问题，扩散模型等生成式方法已成为编码先验的主流。现有最先进的扩散求解器将先验提升到函数空间，在扩散去噪器的输出空间中寻找物理一致的解。但本文证明：在不连续的PDE情形下，输出空间方法无法正确最小化关于真实系数场的未观测误差，导致重构失败。
AI.method: 提出Function space Backward-Consistent Sampling（FunBCS），一种输入空间优化方法：寻找最佳输入，使去噪器重构结果满足物理一致性。基于理论分析，进一步给出在采样过程中动态分配输入空间优化步数的策略。
AI.result: 理论证明FunBCS能够正确最小化未观测误差，而输出空间优化方法不能。在四个PDE反问题（含不连续Darcy流）上的评估显示，相比当前最先进方法，FunBCS将重构误差降低27%-64%，同时运行速度提升1.4-2.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 在函数空间中进行输入空间优化是解决PDE系数场反问题的更优范式：它既保证了未观测误差的正确最小化，又在精度与效率上显著优于输出空间方法，对不连续PDE等困难场景尤为有效。

title: LinearPFN: Amortized Variable Selection for Linear Models with Interactions
summary: Spike-and-slab regression is a standard Bayesian formulation of variable selection: it returns a posterior distribution over which candidate effects are active rather than a single selected subset, so that every candidate effect carries an inclusion probability. Its cost grows exponentially with the number of candidate effects, so the posterior can be enumerated exactly only when the number of predictors is small. Beyond that reach, the posterior has to be approximated, typically by Markov chain Monte Carlo over the model space, which requires a fresh run for every dataset and, within a fixed budget of steps, may fail to converge. We present LinearPFN, a prior-data fitted transformer network that amortizes spike-and-slab inference for linear models with main effects and pairwise interactions. The network is pretrained once on synthetic datasets, drawn from an explicitly specified prior, and a single forward pass over a new dataset returns posterior inclusion probabilities, posterior-mean coefficients and posterior predictive distributions with no per-dataset fitting. The prior is conjugate by design, so that the posterior for each fixed set of active effects has a closed form, and wherever the exact posterior is still computable by enumeration we verify the network's outputs against it. On real predictor matrices from published social-science datasets, with outcomes drawn from the prior so that the true active set is known, LinearPFN attains a higher per-dataset selection AUC and a higher F1 under the median probability model rule than five classical baselines. The lead holds when the coefficients, the interactions or the noise depart from the prior. Code: https://github.com/schiekiera/LinearPFN. Trained model: https://huggingface.co/schiekiera/LinearPFN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LinearPFN，一种先验-数据拟合的 Transformer 网络，将线性模型（含主效应与成对交互）上的 spike-and-slab 变量选择推断进行摊销：单次前向传播即可输出后验包含概率、后验均值系数与后验预测分布，无需逐数据集拟合。
AI.motivation: spike-and-slab 回归是贝叶斯变量选择的标准方法，能给出每个候选效应的包含概率而非单一子集。但其代价随候选效应数指数增长，仅在预测变量较少时可精确枚举后验；超出该范围需用 MCMC 等近似方法，需对每个数据集重新运行，且在固定步数预算内可能不收敛。
AI.method: LinearPFN 是在合成数据集上一次性预训练的先验-数据拟合 Transformer。数据由显式指定的先验生成；先验被设计为共轭的，因此对任意固定活跃效应集合，其后验有闭式解。对新数据集，网络通过单次前向传播直接给出后验包含概率、后验均值系数和后验预测分布，无需逐数据集拟合。在精确后验仍可枚举的情形下，将网络输出与枚举结果进行验证。
AI.result: 在使用已发表社会科学数据集的真实预测矩阵、且结果变量从先验抽取（真实活跃集已知）的实验中，LinearPFN 相比五个经典基线取得更高的逐数据集选择 AUC，并在中位概率模型规则下取得更高的 F1；当系数、交互或噪声偏离先验时，该领先优势依然保持。
AI.conclusion: LinearPFN 可将 spike-and-slab 推断摊销到单次前向传播中，在保持后验包含概率等完整贝叶斯输出的同时避免逐数据集 MCMC 拟合，并在真实预测矩阵与先验偏离情形下优于五个经典基线。代码与训练模型已公开。

title: Hyperbolic Graph Representation Learning: Embed in One Metric, Optimize with Another
summary: Hierarchical graphs embed in hyperbolic space with lower distortion than in Euclidean space owing to its negative curvature. However, their gradient-based learning is hampered at large radii, where the Poincaré ball and the Lorentz hyperboloid models fail numerically. Polar coordinates avoid this problem, but the hyperbolic metric scales the angular step by the hyperbolic sine of the radius, freezing angular motion. We observe that this factor is a choice, silently fixed by existing implementations: the Euclidean tangent parametrization, for instance, uses the radius itself. We show that other choices are not only possible but preferable. They are endpoints of a one-parameter family of optimization preconditioners with curvatures from $-1$ to $0$, while the embedding remains at curvature $-1$. We show that since the Euclidean preconditioner rearranges a layout but refines it poorly, while an intermediate one refines far better once a layout is in place, combining them in two stages reduces the loss on real-world trees by 46-74% over the best single curvature.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用一参数族的优化预条件子（曲率从 -1 到 0）替代现有实现中"隐式固定"的角步缩放因子，并采用两阶段训练策略，在真实世界树结构数据上将损失较最佳单一曲率降低 46–74%。
AI.motivation: 层级图嵌入双曲空间时失真低于欧氏空间，但在大半径处梯度学习受阻：Poincaré 球与 Lorentz 双曲面模型数值不稳定，而极坐标虽避免该问题，却因双曲度量将角步长按半径的双曲正弦缩放，导致角向运动被"冻结"。
AI.method: 作者指出该缩放因子只是一种选择，却被现有实现默默固定（如欧氏切空间参数化使用半径本身）。他们证明其他选择不仅可行且更优：这些选择构成一个优化预条件子的一参数族，其曲率从 -1 到 0 连续变化，而嵌入本身仍保持在曲率 -1。基于欧氏预条件子擅长重排布局但精细化能力弱、中间曲率预条件子在已有布局上精细化更好的观察，提出两阶段组合训练策略。
AI.result: 在真实世界树结构数据上，两阶段组合方案相比最佳单一曲率将损失降低 46–74%。
AI.conclusion: 角步缩放因子是可设计的优化自由度而非固定常量；通过在曲率 -1 与 0 之间的一参数预条件子族中分两阶段训练，可显著改善双曲层级嵌入在大半径处的优化效果。

title: Revisiting the Generalization of Neural Graph Edit Distance Models
summary: Neural approaches to Graph Edit Distance (GED) have achieved strong results under standard within-dataset evaluation, but much less is known about how well these models transfer across graph collections. We conduct a systematic study of this problem using exact GED supervision across diverse graph datasets and a broad set of representative learning-based methods. Our results reveal a pronounced gap between within-collection performance and cross-collection transfer. Models that perform well on their training collections often lose this advantage when evaluated on structurally different data. Training on multiple source collections substantially improves zero-shot transfer and provides a better starting point when limited supervision is available for a new target collection. Further analysis shows that transfer behavior varies with the source--target direction and the structural characteristics of the collections involved. These findings suggest that conventional within-collection evaluation provides only a partial view of the generalization behavior of neural GED models and motivate broader evaluation across heterogeneous graph collections.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了神经图编辑距离（GED）模型在跨图集合迁移场景下的泛化能力，发现其在集内评估表现优异，但跨集合迁移存在显著性能落差。
AI.motivation: 现有神经GED方法多在标准集内（within-dataset）评估下取得良好效果，但对其跨图集合迁移能力的了解十分有限，缺乏对泛化行为的全面认识。
AI.method: 在多个多样化图数据集上，使用精确GED监督，对一系列代表性学习方法进行系统性的跨集合迁移研究，重点考察零样本迁移与少样本监督下的表现。
AI.result: 1）集内性能与跨集合迁移之间存在明显落差；2）在训练集合上表现良好的模型，在结构不同的数据上往往失去优势；3）多源集合联合训练显著提升零样本迁移，并为新目标任务提供更优起点；4）迁移行为随源-目标方向及集合结构特征而变化。
AI.conclusion: 传统集内评估仅能部分反映神经GED模型的泛化行为，需推动在异构图集合上进行更广泛的跨集合评估。

title: Round-Trip KNN Clustering: multiscale hierarchical cluster detection on directed nearest-neighbour graphs
comment: Submitted to Knowledge and Information Systems (KAIS). 32 pages, 6 figures
summary: We introduce Round-Trip KNN Clustering (RTKNNC), a graph-based method for finding cluster structure at several neighbourhood scales without requiring the number of clusters in advance. Unlike approaches that first make a $k$-nearest-neighbour (KNN) graph undirected, RTKNNC keeps both directions of the neighbour relation: which points a given point selects and which points select it. Incoming selections are treated as weighted votes that help decide which local connections remain visible during a recursive forward-and-reverse traversal. Repeating the procedure for increasing $K$ reveals how groups persist or merge as the neighbourhood scale grows; for the reference inverse-square model before structural refinement, clusters can merge but do not split. Because graph connectivity can occasionally join distinct groups through a sparse bridge or a small region of overlap, we add an optional label-free refinement. It first tests whether an already formed component is better described by two or three Gaussian subpopulations, and accepts a subdivision only when the proposed groups are large enough and consistent with the visible KNN graph. Across eight synthetic datasets and $K=2,\ldots,16$, independent C and Python implementations produced identical partitions in all 120 reference runs. Refinement increased adjusted Rand index from $0.7817$ to $0.9627$ on a variable-density benchmark and from $0.8083$ to $0.9853$ on a sparse-bridge benchmark. Comparisons with seven external clustering methods show competitive performance while preserving a label-free cluster-construction process.

AI.tldr: RTKNNC 是一种无需预设簇数的有向 KNN 图聚类方法，通过保留邻居关系的双向性并递归遍历确定簇结构，配合可选的无标签细化，在多尺度上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 已有 KNN 图聚类通常先将 KNN 图转为无向图，丢失了"谁选择谁"的方向信息；同时多数方法需预先指定簇数，且图连通性可能通过稀疏桥或重叠区域错误合并不同簇。
AI.method: 保留邻居关系的双向性：记录某点选择了哪些点以及哪些点选择了它；将被选择视为加权投票，决定在递归的正向-反向遍历中哪些局部连接保留；对递增 K 重复该过程以观察簇的持续与合并。另加无标签细化：检验已形成连通分量是否更适合由两或三个高斯子群描述，仅在子群足够大且与 KNN 图一致时接受细分。
AI.result: 在 8 个合成数据集、K=2…16 共 120 次参考运行中，独立的 C 与 Python 实现得到完全一致的分区。细化使变密度基准的 ARI 从 0.7817 提升至 0.9627，稀疏桥基准从 0.8083 提升至 0.9853。与 7 种外部聚类方法比较，性能具有竞争力，且保持无标签的簇构建过程。
AI.conclusion: RTKNNC 利用有向邻居关系与加权投票实现无需预设簇数的多尺度图聚类，递归遍历确保簇在尺度增长时只合并而不分裂；可选的高斯细分细化能有效纠正稀疏桥或重叠导致的误连，在合成基准上取得高一致性、高 ARI 并具竞争力。

title: Gated Target Propagation for Compositional Generalization in Continual Learning
summary: Continual learning is typically framed as acquiring new knowledge without catastrophically forgetting previous tasks. However, a flexible continual learner should also be able to reuse and recombine previously acquired knowledge to rapidly solve novel task compositions. We introduce Gated Target Propagation (GaTaP), a continual learning algorithm in which task-specific gating variables---learned through a closed-form inner loop update---selectively suppress or enhance network modules. Network parameters are learned in a slower timescale outer loop, using the same local difference target propagation error signal as is used for adapting gating variables. We provide tractable experiments on class-incremental learning scenarios for both multilayer perceptron and convolutional network architectures. We show strong performance retention on previously learned tasks, as well as compositional generalization to unseen tasks, achieved through few-shot gain adaptation at inference. We analyze learned gating patterns and find that related tasks exhibit similar gating patterns, suggesting that inferred gates capture meaningful, reusable task structure. Overall, GaTaP provides a powerful framework for jointly ameliorating catastrophic forgetting and enabling few-shot compositional generalization in neural network models.

AI.tldr: 提出GaTaP持续学习算法，通过快慢双时间尺度学习，用门控变量选择性调节网络模块，并复用同一目标传播误差信号，兼具抗遗忘与少样本组合泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习主要关注"不遗忘旧任务"，但灵活的持续学习器还应能复用并重组已学知识，快速求解新的任务组合。模型需同时缓解灾难性遗忘并具备组合泛化。
AI.method: 1）为每个任务学习门控变量，通过闭式内循环更新，选择性地抑制或增强网络模块；2）网络参数在较慢时间尺度的外循环中更新；3）内外循环均使用同一"局部差分目标传播"误差信号；4）推理时通过少样本增益（gain）自适应实现组合泛化；5）在MLP与卷积网络上进行类增量学习实验，并分析门控模式。
AI.result: 在类增量场景下对旧任务保持强性能保留，同时通过推理时少样本增益自适应，对未见任务组合实现组合泛化；分析发现相关任务呈现相似门控模式，表明门控捕捉到可复用的任务结构。
AI.conclusion: GaTaP通过双时间尺度与任务门控机制，统一缓解灾难性遗忘并支持少样本组合泛化，为持续学习提供有效框架，门控变量可解释且具可复用任务结构。

title: Block Disentanglement in CRL: Bridging Identifiability and Visual State Estimation
summary: Causal representation learning (CRL) is the process of recovering causally-related latent variables from high-dimensional observations. As a label-free inference method, CRL is particularly attractive for applications where data labels are unavailable or impractical to obtain. While there has been significant progress in understanding the identifiability guarantees of CRL, such guarantees often hold under highly stylized assumptions, which temper the direct application to real-world problems. This paper has a two-fold objective for interventional CRL. First, it establishes identifiability guarantees for substantially weaker interventional assumptions, resulting in block disentanglement of the causal variables, where the block structure depends on the realistically available intervention mechanisms. Secondly, the block disentanglement framework is used for embodied visual state estimation, in which the objective is to recover the latent physical variables of a robotic system directly from visual data (images and videos) without labeled data. These two components are critically complementary. The block disentanglement theory delineates identifiability guarantees under weakened assumptions, and the application demonstrates that the resulting objective remains effective in a controlled embodied setting despite further assumption violations, providing a theory-to-practice bridge needed to translate the promise of label-free CRL into practical problems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对干预式因果表征学习（CRL），在显著弱化的干预假设下建立可辨识性保证，得到因果变量的分块解耦（block disentanglement），并将该框架用于无标签的具身视觉状态估计，从而在可控具身场景中架起从理论到实践的桥梁。
AI.motivation: CRL作为无标签推理方法在数据标签不可得或不现实的应用中极具吸引力，但现有可辨识性保证往往依赖高度理想化的假设，难以直接应用于现实问题。因此需要弱化干预假设，并在真实感更强的设定中验证方法的有效性。
AI.method: 一方面，在更弱的干预假设下证明干预式CRL的可辨识性，得到因果变量的分块解耦，其中分块结构由现实中可获取的干预机制决定；另一方面，将分块解耦框架用于具身视觉状态估计，即无需标注数据、直接从图像和视频中恢复机器人系统的潜在物理变量。
AI.result: 在弱化假设下获得了分块解耦形式的可辨识性保证；在可控具身场景中，尽管存在进一步的假设违背，所构建的目标仍然有效，能够支持无标签的视觉状态估计。
AI.conclusion: 分块解耦理论给出了弱假设下的可辨识性保证，而具身应用表明该目标在现实违背假设的情况下依然有效，二者互补，为将无标签CRL的前景转化为实际问题的解决提供了理论到实践的桥梁。

title: Pareto-Improving Adversarial Attacks with Primal-Dual Regularization
summary: Transferable adversarial attacks are arguably the most practical black-box threat model. Under the same perturbation budget, stronger transfer attacks attain higher attack success rate (ASR), yet their imperceptibility also tends to degrade. Under such a fixed-budget protocol, transferability and imperceptibility therefore appear to trade off against each other. We argue that this conflict is an artifact of fixed-budget evaluation, not an intrinsic trade-off. When attacks are compared on the ASR--imperceptibility Pareto frontier obtained by sweeping $ε$, stronger transfer attacks already attain better imperceptibility at matched ASR than weaker ones. To exploit this latent advantage, we introduce the stealthy transfer attack ST, a plug-in primal-dual wrapper that adds an $L_\infty$ saturation regularizer to the standard constrained objective and resolves it through a two-step primal-dual update: a projected primal step on the perturbation coupled with an $L_1$-ball projection on a dual variable that absorbs the regularizer through Fenchel duality, requiring no auxiliary models or handcrafted perceptual priors. Empirically, ST extends the Pareto frontier across different base attacks and additional surrogate architectures. At $ε{=}16/255$, average imperceptibility gains over each base attack are $17\%$ on LPIPS and $14\%$ on NIQE while ASR is preserved or improved. At matched high-ASR levels, the strongest ST variants further Pareto-dominate dedicated stealth-oriented transfer attacks, confirming that the latent imperceptibility advantage of strong transfer attacks can be unlocked by a primal-dual optimization wrapper without sacrificing transferability. Code will be made available at \url{https://github.com/AndssY/ST}.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出迁移性与不可感知性在固定扰动预算下看似存在权衡，实为评估方式的假象；作者提出即插即用的原对偶包装器ST，通过添加L∞饱和正则项并采用两步原对偶更新扩展ASR-不可感知性帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 可迁移对抗攻击是最实用的黑盒威胁模型。在固定扰动预算下，更强的迁移攻击虽提升攻击成功率（ASR），但不可感知性往往下降，二者看似存在权衡。作者认为该冲突是固定预算评估的假象，而非内在权衡：若在扫描ε得到的ASR-不可感知性帕累托前沿上比较，强迁移攻击在匹配ASR下已具备更优不可感知性。为利用这一潜在优势，需设计方法在保持迁移性的同时提升不可感知性。
AI.method: 提出ST（stealthy transfer attack），一种即插即用的原对偶包装器。在标准约束目标上加入L∞饱和正则项，并通过两步原对偶更新求解：对扰动执行带投影的原始步，同时通过对偶变量做L1球投影，借助Fenchel对偶吸收正则项。该方法无需辅助模型或手工设计的感知先验。
AI.result: ST在不同基础攻击与额外替代架构上扩展了帕累托前沿。在ε=16/255时，相对各基础攻击平均不可感知性提升为LPIPS 17%、NIQE 14%，同时ASR保持或提升。在匹配高ASR水平下，最强的ST变体进一步对专门的隐身导向迁移攻击实现帕累托支配。
AI.conclusion: 强迁移攻击潜在的不可感知性优势可通过原对偶优化包装器释放，而无需牺牲迁移性。代码将在 https://github.com/AndssY/ST 发布。

title: Private online learning and prediction for Littlestone classes
summary: We study mistake bounds for differentially private online learning and online prediction under oblivious realisable adversaries. Online learning requires the learner to release a hypothesis at each time step whereas in online prediction, the learner only needs to make predictions without releasing a hypothesis. Using a novel lower bound for private online learning and an upper bound for private prediction, we show that the sample complexity of these two problems are separated by a factor that grows with the time horizon for every class of finite Littlestone dimension $d$. First, we prove that every $\br{ε,δ}$-private online learner has a deterministic realisable stream of length $T$ on which the mistake bound is at least $\bE\bs{M_T}=\Om{\frac dε\log\br{ T}^{2/3}}$. In particular, this is the first non-trivial lower in the range $1/T<δ<1/\log T)$ left open in earlier works[SR22,DSS24,LWY24]. Second, we prove that for every class of of Littlestone dimension $d$, there exists an $(ε,δ)$-jointly private predictor with at most $2^{2^{cd^2}}ε^{-2}\log^2\br{2/\br{εδ}}$ expected mistakes, independently of $T$, for some absolute constant $c>0$. Thus, for every fixed class of finite Littlestone dimension when $δ=Θ\br{1/\log T}$, private learning requires $\Om{\br{\log T}^{2/3}}$ expected mistakes, whereas private prediction admits $\bigO{\br{\log\log T}^2}$.

AI.tldr: 该文研究差分隐私在线学习与在线预 测的可实现（realisable）错误界，证明二者样本复杂度对任意有限 Littlestone 维数 $d$ 的类存在随时域 $T$ 增长的分离：私密在线学习下界为 $\Omega(\frac{d}{\epsilon}\log^{2/3} T)$，而私密预测上界仅为 $2^{2^{cd^2}}\epsilon^{-2}\log^2(2/(\epsilon\delta))$，独立于 $T$。
AI.motivation: 在线学习需每步发布假设，而在线预测仅需给出预测，二者在非隐私设定下可能相近；作者希望在差分隐私（oblivious realisable adversary）设定下厘清二者是否可分，并填补前期工作[SR22,DSS24,LWY24]在 $1/T<\delta<1/\log T$ 区间缺少非平凡下界的空白。
AI.method: 利用一个新的私密在线学习下界（基于确定性 realisable 流构造）和一个私密预测上界算法；下界针对任意 $(\epsilon,\delta)$-私密在线学习器，上界构造 $(\epsilon,\delta)$-联合私密预测器。
AI.result: (1) 任一 $(\epsilon,\delta)$-私密在线学习器存在长度 $T$ 的确定性 realisable 流，使期望错误至少 $\Omega(\frac{d}{\epsilon}\log^{2/3} T)$，首次覆盖 $\delta\in(1/T,1/\log T)$；(2) 对任意 Littlestone 维数 $d$ 的类，存在 $(\epsilon,\delta)$-联合私密预测器，期望错误至多 $2^{2^{cd^2}}\epsilon^{-2}\log^2(2/(\epsilon\delta))$，与 $T$ 无关；当 $\delta=\Theta(1/\log T)$ 时，学习需 $\Omega(\log^{2/3} T)$ 而预测仅需 $O((\log\log T)^2)$。
AI.conclusion: 在差分隐私在线设定下，在线学习与在线预测的样本复杂度对每个有限 Littlestone 维数类均可随时域分离，分离因子随 $T$ 增长，纠正了二者在隐私下可能同阶的直觉。

title: Path Laplacian Encodings for Directed Graphs
summary: Directed graphs naturally model many real-world systems in which interactions are asymmetric, such as citation networks, web graphs, and information-flow networks. However, graph learning methods commonly rely on message passing with symmetrized graph representations or positional encodings that only partially exploit edge directionality. We introduce PathLapPE, a novel spectral positional encoding (PE) derived from the path Laplacian on directed graphs. PathLapPE provides node- and edge-level features that encode directional higher-order structure and can be incorporated into standard graph learning architectures. Empirical results on node- and graph-level benchmark tasks show that PathLapPE yields consistent improvements across several architectures, especially when combined with direction-aware message passing. Compared with magnetic Laplacian positional encodings, a widely studied spectral positional encoding for directed graphs, PathLapPE does not require additional fine-tuning of directionality hyperparameters while offering competitive runtime and performance.

AI.tldr: 提出PathLapPE：一种基于有向图路径拉普拉斯算子的谱位置编码，可编码方向性高阶结构，无需调节方向超参数即取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 有向图广泛存在于引文网络、网页图和信息流网络等真实系统，但主流图学习方法多依赖对称化表示的消息传递或仅部分利用边方向性的位置编码，无法充分刻画方向性高阶结构。
AI.method: 从有向图上的路径拉普拉斯算子出发，构造谱位置编码PathLapPE，产生节点级与边级特征，编码方向性的高阶结构，并可无缝嵌入标准图学习架构（如与方向感知的消息传递结合）。
AI.result: 在节点级与图级基准任务上，PathLapPE在多种架构中均带来一致的性能提升，尤其与方向感知消息传递结合时效果更显著；相较于磁拉普拉斯位置编码，无需额外微调方向性超参数，且运行时间与性能具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: PathLapPE为有向图提供了一种高效、免调参的谱位置编码方案，能有效利用方向性高阶结构，是磁拉普拉斯等现有有向图谱编码的有力替代。

title: Low-Fidelity FDM Spectral Guidance for Neural Eigenvalue Solvers
summary: Operator eigenvalue problems appear throughout science. Classical methods usually discretize the operator into a matrix and then solve the resulting matrix eigenvalue problem. This works well in low dimensions, but fine grids quickly become expensive in both memory and computation as the dimension grows. Neural network based solvers avoid storing these large grids, but recent state of the art neural methods can require hundreds of thousands of training steps and may struggle to find the desired eigenvalues. We show that the two approaches can help each other. A coarse finite difference method (FDM) calculation acts as a cheap numerical model of the operator spectrum. We use the approximate eigenvalues as fixed shifts during the training of the neural solver, as they only need to locate the relevant part of the spectrum. We also introduce Stabilized Inverse Power Method Neural Network (SIPMNN), a more stable training procedure for higher-dimensional problems. Across five test problems at $d=10$, the combined approach is more accurate overall than the tested fully neural alternatives while using eight to ten times fewer iterations.

AI.tldr: 将粗网格有限差分计算的近似特征值作为固定位移，用于训练神经网络特征值求解器，并提出更稳定的SIPMNN训练流程；在d=10的五个测试问题上，整体精度优于纯神经网络方法，迭代次数减少8–10倍。
AI.motivation: 算子特征值问题广泛存在于科学计算中。经典方法将算子离散为矩阵求解，但在高维下细网格导致内存与计算代价急剧上升；而纯神经网络求解器虽避免存储大网格，却常需数十万训练步、且难以找到目标特征值。作者希望结合两者优势，用廉价的粗网格数值模型引导神经网络训练。
AI.method: 采用粗网格有限差分法（FDM）计算算子谱的粗略数值模型，将其近似特征值作为训练神经网络求解器时的固定位移（fixed shifts），使网络只需定位谱的相关部分；同时提出稳定化逆幂法神经网络（SIPMNN），一种面向高维问题更稳定的训练流程。
AI.result: 在d=10的五个测试问题上，该组合方法相比所测试的纯神经网络替代方案整体精度更高，同时训练迭代次数减少8–10倍。
AI.conclusion: 粗网格数值方法与神经网络求解器可相互促进：粗FDM提供廉价谱先验作为固定位移，SIPMNN提升高维训练稳定性，从而在精度与效率上同时超越纯神经方法。

title: Score-Calibrated Flow for Sampling from Unnormalized Densities with Applications to Generative Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for online reinforcement learning (RL), enabling multimodal behaviors and improved performance. However, training these policies remains challenging: the critic specifies the desired policy as an unnormalized Boltzmann density but does not provide direct samples from it. Many existing methods rely on importance sampling to construct training signals, which can suffer from high variance, increasing computational cost and destabilizing training. We propose Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF), a simple and efficient algorithm for training generative models to sample from unnormalized densities without importance sampling or backpropagation through the sampling trajectory. We learn the desired flow by enforcing self-consistency, bypassing target posterior mean estimation. By jointly exploiting the prescribed target score and the structure of flow matching, we establish these self-consistency requirements as score-calibrated optimality conditions, first for the terminal density and then for the trainable velocity field. We prove that their unique solutions are, respectively, the target density and the ideal flow model that conditional flow matching (CFM) would recover if target samples were available. We formulate the velocity condition as a fixed-point equation and exploit its conditional-expectation structure to construct a stop-gradient objective for enforcing it. The resulting training procedure retains the scalable sample-interpolate-regress structure of CFM despite the absence of target samples, using endpoints generated by the current flow. For online RL, the critic gradient supplies the target score at the generated actions, yielding a direct approach to actor training. Experiments on RL benchmarks demonstrate that SCF matches or improves upon state-of-the-art generative-policy baselines, while substantially reducing training time.

AI.tldr: 提出Score-Calibrated Flow（SCF），一种无需重要性采样、无需对采样轨迹反传的高效生成式策略训练算法，通过自洽性将目标得分与流匹配结构结合为最优性条件，用于在线强化学习。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型与流模型作为在线RL中的表达性策略类，能实现多模态行为并提升性能，但训练困难：评论家（critic）将目标策略指定为未归一化的Boltzmann密度，却不直接提供其样本。现有方法多依赖重要性采样来构造训练信号，导致高方差、计算开销大、训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出SCF：通过强制自洽性学习目标流，绕过目标后验均值估计。联合利用给定的目标得分与流匹配结构，将自洽性要求建立为"得分校准最优性条件"，先针对终端密度，再针对可训练速度场；证明其唯一解分别是目标密度与在目标样本可得时CFM本应恢复的理想流模型。将速度条件表述为不动点方程，利用其条件期望结构构造带stop-gradient的目标函数；训练过程保留CFM可扩展的"采样-插值-回归"结构（尽管无目标样本），使用当前流生成的端点。在线RL中，critic梯度在生成动作处提供目标得分，直接用于actor训练。
AI.result: 在RL基准实验中，SCF达到或超越当前最先进的生成式策略基线，同时显著缩短训练时间。
AI.conclusion: SCF以简洁高效的方式，在不使用重要性采样、不通过采样轨迹反传的前提下，从非归一化密度中采样训练生成式策略，为在线RL的actor训练提供了直接途径，兼具性能与效率优势。

title: Learning Discriminative Geometry for Drifting Models
summary: Recently proposed Drifting Models shift iterative distribution refinement from inference to training, enabling effective one-step generation. However, their performance on complex image datasets depends strongly on the representation used to construct the drifting field: pixel-space drifting performs poorly, whereas pretrained feature spaces substantially improve sample quality for reasons that remain unclear. We trace this gap to the discriminative geometry of the representation, which determines sample weighting in kernel density estimation (KDE) and, consequently drift. We introduce persistent representation learning, which continuously learns a more discriminative representation geometry as the generator evolves across batches. We further establish a current-step gradient equivalence between the KDE ratio loss and drift regression loss under matched conditions, connecting density-ratio-based generator optimization to empirical drifting and motivating direct control of the drifting velocity. Across multiple datasets, our method learns effective discriminative representations directly from pixels and reduces FID by approximately $82-95\%$ over the original pixel-space Drifting Models, without pretrained encoders. Adapting pretrained representations and applying velocity clipping provide further gains.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示 Drifting Models 性能依赖表示几何，提出持续表示学习 (persistent representation learning)，无需预训练编码器即可从像素学习判别性表示，使 FID 相对原始像素空间 Drifting Models 降低约 82-95%。
AI.motivation: 最近提出的 Drifting Models 将迭代分布精炼从推理阶段转移到训练阶段，从而支持有效的单步生成。但其在复杂图像数据集上的性能强烈依赖于构建漂移场 (drifting field) 所用的表示：像素空间漂移表现很差，而预训练特征空间能显著提升样本质量，然而这一差异的原因尚不清楚。作者旨在厘清表示的作用机制并消除对预训练编码器的依赖。
AI.method: 作者将性能差异归因于表示的判别性几何 (discriminative geometry)，该几何决定了核密度估计 (KDE) 中的样本权重，进而影响漂移。据此提出持续表示学习 (persistent representation learning)：随生成器跨批次演化，持续学习更具判别性的表示几何。作者还在匹配条件下建立了 KDE 比值损失与漂移回归损失的当前步梯度等价性，将基于密度比的生成器优化与经验漂移联系起来，并据此直接控制漂移速度。此外作者还分析了适配预训练表示与速度裁剪 (velocity clipping) 的作用。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，该方法可直接从像素学习有效的判别性表示。无需预训练编码器的情况下，相对原始像素空间 Drifting Models 将 FID 降低约 82-95%。适配预训练表示并施加速度裁剪可带来进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 表示空间的判别性几何是 Drifting Models 单步生成质量的关键决定因素。通过持续学习表示几何，可以在不依赖预训练编码器的情况下大幅提升生成质量，同时理论上的梯度等价性为直接控制漂移速度提供了依据。

title: Localized Operator Learning with Adaptive Partition-of-Unity Mixture-of-Expert Networks
summary: Operator learning methods such as DeepONets and FNOs often struggle with PDE families featuring sharp interfaces, heterogeneous coefficients, and localized multiscale structures. We introduce a partition-of-unity (POU) mixture-of-experts framework for localized operator learning, in which geometry-aware gating networks produce smooth spatial partitions which blend the contributions of local expert networks. Our main contribution is HiRefPOU, a residual-style hierarchical POU architecture for DeepONets that organizes localized representations through nested parent-child partitions while preserving global continuity. We also show that the same POU principle can be incorporated into Fourier Neural Operators to introduce spatial adaptivity without modifying the underlying spectral layers. On heterogeneous Darcy and reaction-diffusion benchmarks, HiRefPOU achieves substantially lower error than global DeepONet and static POU-MoE baselines, while the broader operator-learning experiments show that the benefits of localization depend on the PDE structure and the chosen neural-operator backbone. The learned partitions are interpretable and align with interfaces and regions of rapid solution variation. These results show that explicit geometric localization can improve both accuracy and interpretability in neural operator learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于单位分解（POU）的专家混合框架用于局部化算子学习，核心贡献为面向 DeepONet 的残差式层次化 POU 架构 HiRefPOU，并在 Darcy 与反应扩散问题上验证其精度与可解释性优势。
AI.motivation: DeepONet、FNO 等算子学习方法在处理具有尖锐界面、非均匀系数和局部多尺度结构的 PDE 族时表现不佳，缺乏显式的几何局部化能力。
AI.method: 提出 POU 专家混合框架：由几何感知门控网络生成平滑空间划分，混合局部专家网络输出；核心方法 HiRefPOU 为 DeepONet 的残差式层次化 POU 架构，通过嵌套父子划分组织局部表示并保持全局连续性；同一 POU 原理亦可嵌入 FNO，在不改动谱层的前提下引入空间自适应。
AI.result: 在非均匀 Darcy 与反应扩散基准上，HiRefPOU 误差显著低于全局 DeepONet 和静态 POU-MoE 基线；更广泛的算子学习实验表明局部化收益依赖 PDE 结构与所选算子骨干；学习到的划分具有可解释性，与界面及解快速变化区域对齐。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何局部化能够同时提升神经算子学习的精度与可解释性。

title: FoSeRL: Formal Sequential Robustness Certification for Reinforcement Learning Policies
summary: Even a few action perturbations can substantially degrade the performance of a deployed decision policy. Certifying the resulting return loss is challenging in stochastic environments, where returns vary even without an attack. We introduce FoSeRL, a framework for certifying deployed RL policies against precommitted, temporally sparse action attacks. The deployed policy is unchanged, with no smoothing or retraining. Certification requires a resettable simulator supporting shared randomness and independent one-step successor queries, but no analytical dynamics model. FoSeRL certifies that an attacked episode loses no more than a prescribed amount of return relative to the same episode unattacked, with at least a target probability and at a user-specified confidence level. Both runs share the initial state and randomness, so the measured loss reflects the attack, not the episode; carrying the running return gap as a state coordinate makes it the terminal value, reducing trajectory-level certification to terminal safety. Time-dependent barrier conditions on the augmented state bound the terminal failure probability: satisfied exactly, they certify every admissible precommitted attack; learned from sampled trajectories and verified on held-out data, they certify the same guarantee under a specified attack-episode setting. Across six stochastic continuous-control environments and three RL policy families (TD3, SAC, and PPO), FoSeRL certifies non-trivial cardinality--magnitude robustness frontiers, achieves substantially larger certified budgets than policy smoothing, and reveals marked robustness differences among policies with comparable nominal performance.

AI.tldr: FoSeRL是一个在不需要解析动力学模型、不修改部署策略（无平滑、无重训练）的前提下，针对随机环境中"预承诺、时间稀疏"动作攻击的认证框架：通过共享随机性与重置仿真器，将轨迹级认证归约为终端安全性，并借助时间相关障碍条件给出具有目标概率和置信度保证的回报损失认证。
AI.motivation: 即使少量动作扰动也会显著降低已部署决策策略的性能；而在随机环境中收益本身波动，使得攻击导致的回报损失难以认证。现有方法（如策略平滑）往往需要修改策略，且认证的鲁棒性预算有限，因此需要在随机环境下对未修改策略给出严格认证。
AI.method: 提出FoSeRL框架：部署策略保持不变，无平滑与重训练；仅需支持共享随机性和独立单步后继查询的可重置仿真器，无需解析动力学模型。认证目标为：相对同一未受攻击回合，攻击回合的回报损失不超过给定额度，且以不低于目标概率、在用户指定置信水平下成立。两次运行共享初始状态与随机性，使测得损失归因于攻击而非回合差异。将运行回报差作为状态坐标，使其成为终端值，从而将轨迹级认证归约为终端安全性问题。再对增广状态施加时间相关障碍条件来约束终端失败概率：条件精确满足时认证所有可行的预承诺攻击；从采样轨迹学习并在留出数据上验证时，在指定攻击-回合设定下给出同样保证。
AI.result: 在六个随机连续控制环境和三类RL策略族（TD3、SAC、PPO）上，FoSeRL能够认证非平凡的"基数—幅度"鲁棒性前沿，获得远超策略平滑的认证预算，并揭示标称性能相近的策略之间存在显著的鲁棒性差异。
AI.conclusion: FoSeRL为随机环境下的已部署RL策略提供了一种无需修改策略、无需动力学模型的严格认证途径，可支持对时间稀疏动作攻击的回报损失认证，并可用于比较标称性能相近策略的鲁棒性。

title: EasyClassifier: Honest, Reproducible Machine-Learning Classification for Researchers Who Do Not Program
summary: Machine-learning classification is now used across medicine, the social sciences, economics, education and engineering, very often by researchers who do not program. Two errors recur in such work: preprocessing learned on all rows before cross-validation (data leakage), and reporting the cross-validation score of the classifier that won a comparison (selection bias). Both make published scores optimistic. We present EasyClassifier, an open-source Python package that guides a user from a CSV or Excel file to a finished analysis through a sequence of plain-language, multiple-choice questions, with no code. It makes the correct procedure the default rather than an option: every preprocessing step is learned inside each training fold; the selected classifier receives a separate final score from nested cross-validation (up to 2,000 rows), or an untouched 20% test set; classifiers run with fixed default parameters and fixed random seeds; and every run writes a report with a ready-to-adapt Methods paragraph, the references to cite, and figures prepared for publication. On ten public datasets from seven fields and a random-label control, split in half so that one half served as an untouched external test, the common practice overstated balanced accuracy by 2.9 percentage points on average (up to 9.9 on small data), whereas the score EasyClassifier reports had a mean signed bias of +0.7 points and a mean absolute error of 2.3 points (one-sided Wilcoxon p = 3.2 x 10^{-4}, 30 runs). On random labels it reported 48.8% balanced accuracy against a chance level of 50%. EasyClassifier is available under the MIT license from PyPI (pip install easyclassifier), GitHub, and Zenodo.

AI.tldr: EasyClassifier 是一个开源无代码 Python 工具，通过问答式流程引导非编程研究者完成机器学习分类分析，默认执行正确的交叉验证流程，避免数据泄漏与选择偏差。
AI.motivation: 机器学习分类在医学、社会科学、经济、教育、工程等领域被广泛使用，但常由不编程的研究者操作。其中两类错误反复出现：交叉验证前对全部数据行学习预处理（数据泄漏），以及报告比较中胜出分类器的交叉验证分数（选择偏差），二者都会使发表分数过于乐观。
AI.method: 提出 EasyClassifier：开源 Python 包，用户从 CSV/Excel 文件出发，经一系列通俗语言的多选题完成分析，无需代码。将正确流程设为默认：每步预处理都在各训练折内学习；所选分类器由嵌套交叉验证（≤2000 行）或未触碰的 20% 测试集给出独立最终分数；分类器使用固定默认参数与固定随机种子；每次运行输出报告，含可直接改写的 Methods 段落、引用文献与出版级图表。
AI.result: 在 7 个领域的 10 个公开数据集及随机标签对照上，数据对半划分，一半作为未触碰的外部测试集。常见做法平均高估平衡准确率 2.9 个百分点（小数据上高达 9.9）；EasyClassifier 报告的分数平均有符号偏差 +0.7 个百分点、平均绝对误差 2.3 个百分点（单侧 Wilcoxon p = 3.2×10⁻⁴，30 次运行）。在随机标签上报告 48.8% 平衡准确率，而随机水平为 50%。
AI.conclusion: EasyClassifier 通过将正确流程设为默认，有效抑制数据泄漏与选择偏差导致的乐观偏差，为非编程研究者提供可靠、可复现且有报告支持的分类分析工具。经 MIT 许可发布于 PyPI（pip install easyclassifier）、GitHub 和 Zenodo。

title: Variance-Optimal Control Variates for Learning with Black-box Feedback
summary: Modern models increasingly learn through black-box oracles such as humans, optimization solvers, and external tools that provide feedback without exposing their internal mechanisms. A common remedy is to learn an (action-)value function as a control variate. In this paper, we first observe that even an exact action-value function can be arbitrarily far from variance-optimal. We show that this gap arises because the value function minimizes the noise in each action's own gradient term, while an action can still affect the rest of the gradient estimator through shared parameters. A simple unbiased correction, at no extra oracle cost, can still reduce its variance by an arbitrarily large factor. Motivated by this, we then prove that the residual variance can be decomposed exactly by actions with no cross terms. This decomposition yields a closed-form variance-minimizing correction for neural-network parameters, which can be computed by a simple projection. Empirically, our correction consistently reduces the variance left by the value function and improves learning across all tasks. The source code for all experiments is available at https://github.com/Zihao-Kevin/black_box_opt.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出精确的动作价值函数作为控制变量并非方差最优，并基于残差方差的精确分解给出闭式、可投影计算的方差最小化修正，实验上稳定降低方差并改进学习。
AI.motivation: 现代模型越来越多地通过黑箱预言机（人类、优化求解器、外部工具）学习，这类反馈不暴露内部机制。常见做法是学习（动作）价值函数作为控制变量来降低梯度估计方差。但作者首先观察到，即使价值函数精确，也可能与方差最优相差任意远，因此需要解释这一差距来源并加以修正。
AI.method: 1）分析差距成因：价值函数只最小化每个动作自身梯度项内的噪声，而动作仍可通过共享参数影响梯度估计器的其余部分；2）提出一种简单无偏修正，不增加额外预言机开销；3）证明残差方差可按动作精确分解且无交叉项；4）据此为神经网络参数导出闭式的方差最小化修正，可通过简单投影计算。
AI.result: 理论上：精确动作价值函数可任意远离方差最优，简单无偏修正可将方差降低任意大的倍数；残差方差可无交叉项地精确分解，并得到神经网络参数的闭式方差最小化修正（由简单投影计算）。实证上：该修正一致地降低价值函数遗留的方差，并在所有任务上改进学习效果。
AI.conclusion: 价值函数作为控制变量存在结构性次优，即使精确也不等于方差最优；通过按动作无交叉项的残差方差分解，可获得闭式方差最小修正，无需额外预言机成本即可显著降方差并提升学习，代码已开源。

title: Repeated-Measure Leakage, Distribution Shift, and Reliability under Partial Observation in Patient World Models
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Selected for oral presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models for High-Stakes Health (WMHS) Replication Package: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/AUZVR
summary: Patient world models are increasingly proposed for longitudinal prediction, intervention-aware reasoning, and clinical-trial simulation. Causal or clinical intervention validity is distinct from predictive generalization and reliability; before making stronger claims, the underlying predictive state should generalize across patients, survive realistic shifts and missing observations, and expose failure through meaningful reliability signals. We evaluate these prerequisites in a deliberately narrow setting: short-horizon digital-biomarker forecasting from PhysioNet GaitPDB, comprising 165 participants, 306 recordings, and 51,129 context-future pairs. Using persistence, ridge, MLP, GRU, Transformer, and a compact JEPA-style predictor, we build an evaluation ladder that progressively removes raw temporal overlap, same-recording familiarity, and same-patient familiarity before testing unseen-patient generalization. For GRU, NMSE rises from 0.1227 under random-window splitting to 0.1393 after eliminating raw train-test overlap and to 0.1961 under patient holdout. Among 54 participants with repeated recordings, exposure to a different recording from the same patient improves GRU NMSE from 0.2177 to 0.1556, while a recording-excluded identity hypothesis is not supported at the participant level. Under participant-held-out evaluation, MLP and Transformer are statistically indistinguishable. Study shift, a four-times-longer prediction gap, and partial observation further degrade performance; under 50% temporal masking, Transformer NMSE rises to 0.611 while MC-dropout predictive variance falls. We do not claim a longitudinal or intervention-aware simulator. Instead, the results support a prerequisite evaluation stack of patient separation, repeated-measure controls, shift, missingness, and uncertainty validation before stronger patient-world-model claims are trusted.

AI.tldr: 该研究在短时程数字生物标志物预测任务上，构建了一个逐步收紧的评估阶梯，检验患者世界模型的前提条件：跨患者泛化、对现实偏移与缺失观测的稳健性，以及可靠性信号的有效性。
