AI.motivation: 患者世界模型被日益用于纵向预测、干预感知推理和临床试验模拟，但其因果/临床干预效度与预测泛化性、可靠性是不同的问题。在提出更强主张之前，需要先验证底层预测状态能否跨患者泛化、能否在现实偏移和缺失观测下保持稳健，以及能否通过有意义的可靠性信号暴露失败。
AI.method: 在刻意收窄的设定下评估短时程数字生物标志物预测，数据来自PhysioNet GaitPDB，包含165名参与者、306段记录、51,129个上下文-未来样本对。采用persistence、ridge、MLP、GRU、Transformer及紧凑JEPA式预测器，构建逐步消除原始时间重叠、同记录熟悉度、同患者熟悉度的评估阶梯，最后测试未见患者泛化；并进一步考察研究间偏移、四倍长的预测间隔、部分观测与50%时间掩码下的表现及MC-dropout预测方差。
AI.result: GRU的NMSE从随机窗口划分下的0.1227，升至消除原始训练-测试重叠后的0.1393，再到患者留出下的0.1961。在54名有重复记录的参与者中，接触同一患者的另一段记录使GRU NMSE从0.2177改善至0.1556，而排除记录的同一性假设在参与者层面未获支持。患者留出评估下，MLP与Transformer统计上不可区分。研究偏移、四倍长预测间隔和部分观测进一步降低性能；50%时间掩码下Transformer NMSE升至0.611，而MC-dropout预测方差反而下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究不主张构建纵向或干预感知的模拟器，而是支持一套前提评估栈：患者分离、重复测量控制、偏移、缺失性与不确定性验证，只有在通过这些检验之后，更强的患者世界模型主张才值得信任。

title: DASH: Fast, Valid Counterfactuals for Deep Networks via Batched Directional Search
summary: Counterfactual explanations are most useful when they can be generated with low latency, remain close to the factual input, and satisfy input-domain, categorical, and actionability constraints. Achieving these objectives simultaneously is challenging for deep neural networks. Heuristic methods are often fast but may return invalid counterfactuals, whereas exact methods can certify global proximity but may not finish within practical time limits. We introduce DASH, a batched heuristic search method for finding close, valid, and actionable counterfactuals for deep neural networks under $\ell_1$, $\ell_2$, and $\ell_\infty$ objectives. DASH uses directional Lipschitz bounds and local affine models to generate anchors, then ranks and expands promising regions with batched network evaluations. We compare DASH against nine prior heuristic methods and time-limited exact mixed-integer baselines on four tabular datasets, with network depths from 2 to 32, and evaluate scalability on PBMC3k. Across 9,000 tabular query-norm cases, DASH returns a valid counterfactual within $5\%$ of the best heuristic-observed valid distance in $94.6\%$ of cases, with a median CPU search runtime of $0.061$ s. PGD-bisect, the baseline with the highest pooled within-$5\%$ coverage, meets this criterion in $41.1\%$ of cases, with a median runtime of $0.298$ s. These results show that the proposed search maintains high valid proximity across norms while keeping its search runtime practical.

AI.tldr: DASH是一种针对深度神经网络的反事实解释方法，利用方向性Lipschitz界和局部仿射模型生成锚点，并通过批量网络评估扩展有前景区域，在低延迟下同时满足邻近性、有效性与可操作性约束。
AI.motivation: 反事实解释需同时具备低延迟、靠近原始输入、满足输入域/类别/可操作性约束等特性，但深度神经网络中这些目标难以兼顾。启发式方法速度快却常返回无效反事实；精确方法能保证全局邻近性却难以在实用时间内完成求解。
AI.method: 提出DASH——一种批量启发式搜索方法，在ℓ1、ℓ2和ℓ∞目标下为深度神经网络寻找近似、有效且可执行的反事实。方法使用方向性Lipschitz界与局部仿射模型生成锚点，再通过批量网络评估对候选区域进行排序与扩展。
AI.result: 在四个表格数据集（网络深度2至32层）上与九种现有启发式方法及限时精确混合整数基线比较，并在PBMC3k上评估可扩展性。在9000个表格查询-范数案例中，DASH在94.6%的情况下返回有效反事实，其距离处于最佳启发式观测有效距离的5%以内，中位CPU搜索耗时为0.061秒；而聚合5%覆盖率最高的基线PGD-bisect仅达41.1%，中位耗时0.298秒。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，DASH所提搜索方法在保持高有效邻近性的同时，能在各范数下维持实用的搜索运行时间，兼顾了启发式方法的效率与精确方法的有效性。

title: KALEIDO: Input-Space Adaptation of a Vision Model for Time-Series Forecasting Through Gated Fold Geometries
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems (FMTS)
summary: Time-series foundation models buy zero-shot forecasting with large temporal corpora; a vision model needs none, since a natural image implicitly embeds the patterns a forecaster must model, and an ImageNet-pretrained masked autoencoder forecasts a series by inpainting a rendering of it. A rendered series is not a natural image, however, and closing that gap takes temporal-aware adaptation. We show that the rendering geometry - how the series is folded and drawn - is a controllable, mixable axis for it. Kaleido detects the dominant periods, renders a rule-generated set of fold geometries, combines the inpaintings with a convex per-position gate fit on validation only, and fuses the result with the zero-shot output at one fixed share, with no per-dataset hyperparameter beyond the baseline's published settings. Training only LayerNorm (0.05%), Kaleido lowers MSE by 13% against the published zero-shot baseline on LTSF and, frozen, by 6.6%; on GIFT-Eval it improves the baseline by 7.4% in MASE and 19.3% in CRPS.

AI.tldr: Kaleido通过将时序渲染成多种折叠几何形状并借助预训练视觉掩码自编码器进行图像修复预测，仅训练LayerNorm即可显著超越零样本时序基础模型。
AI.motivation: 时序基础模型需要大规模时间语料实现零样本预测，而自然图像本身隐含了预测器所需的模式，因此ImageNet预训练的掩码自编码器可通过修复序列渲染图来做预测。然而渲染得到的序列图并非自然图像，二者之间存在域差距，需要通过时序感知的适配来弥合。
AI.method: Kaleido将"渲染几何"视为可控制、可混合的适配轴：先检测序列的主导周期，生成一组规则化的折叠几何，分别渲染并修复得到多组预测，再用仅在验证集上拟合的凸逐位置门控进行组合，并以固定比例与零样本输出融合；除基线已发布的设置外不引入任何逐数据集超参数，仅训练LayerNorm（0.05%参数）。
AI.result: 在LTSF上，相对已发布的零样本基线MSE降低13%（微调）与6.6%（冻结）；在GIFT-Eval上，MASE提升7.4%，CRPS提升19.3%。
AI.conclusion: 以渲染几何为适配轴、极少量参数微调，即可有效弥合渲染序列图与自然图像的域差距，使视觉基础模型在零样本时序预测上稳定优于时序基础模型基线。

title: TIMBRE: Teaching Time Series Forecasters to Read, Remember, and Reconcile
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/stephen-guan-researcher/TIMBRE ; Checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/XinyuGuan/TIMBRE
summary: Event-informed forecasting requires translating reports and historical responses into changes to a numerical forecast. We propose TIMBRE (Temporal Integration of Memory-Based Responses and Evidence), which combines source-aware representation, state-conditioned response transfer, and reliability-guided fusion before a frozen forecast head. A separate readout adjusts interval widths while preserving the median. In a single-seed, one-epoch development study of 13 tasks, TIMBRE improves MAE over ordinary fusion on eight tasks but over native Chronos-2 on only two. Disabling response transfer in the trained model reduces BTC and AULF MAE by 47.04% and 6.81%, respectively. These findings identify sensitivity to learned response transfer rather than a general forecasting advantage. Missing development-set scores and the absence of retrained ablations limit attribution to individual evidence mechanisms.

AI.tldr: TIMBRE通过源感知表示、状态条件响应迁移与可靠性引导融合，在冻结预测头上整合事件信息，但单种子单周期实验显示其优势主要来自对学习式响应迁移的敏感性，而非通用预测性能提升。
AI.motivation: 事件驱动的预测需要将文本报告与历史响应转化为对数值预测的修正，现有方法缺乏对来源信息、状态依赖响应及可靠性加权的系统整合，且事件证据对预测的实际贡献归因不清。
AI.method: 提出TIMBRE架构：在冻结的预测头之前，依次进行源感知表示、状态条件响应迁移和可靠性引导融合；另设独立读出模块在不改变中位数的前提下调整区间宽度。通过13个任务的单种子单周期开发实验，对比普通融合与原生Chronos-2，并进行禁用响应迁移的消融。
AI.result: TIMBRE在8个任务上MAE优于普通融合，但仅在2个任务上优于原生Chronos-2。禁用已训练模型中的响应迁移后，BTC与AULF的MAE分别下降47.04%和6.81%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明TIMBRE的性能主要体现为对学习式响应迁移的敏感性，而非通用预测优势；开发集评分缺失及未重训练消融限制了对各证据机制的独立归因，需更严格的实验设计验证。

title: Multi-Agent Spectrum Sharing
summary: This project explores how multiple cognitive radars can learn to share limited wireless spectrum with other radio users without interfering with one another. Using machine learning (ML), each device independently decides where and how widely to transmit within a fixed 100 MHz band. The system analyzes real or simulated signal activity to detect which parts of the spectrum are currently in use and which are open. Based on this information, the devices adapt their transmission choices to avoid crowded frequencies while making efficient use of available space. The goal is to develop a flexible, scalable approach to spectrum sharing that could support future wireless communication systems. Experimental results using both over-the-air software-defined radio (SDR) recordings and simulated environments demonstrate that the proposed meta-learning approach consistently balances competing objectives better than conventional reinforcement learning (RL) methods in multi-agent spectrum-sharing scenarios. Across five multi-agent benchmark environments, our proposed method achieved the highest average reward among the primary baseline algorithms while simultaneously maintaining low collision rates and stable transmission behavior.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究多认知雷达与其他无线用户共享100 MHz频段的问题，提出基于元学习的多智能体频谱共享方法。实验表明其性能优于传统强化学习基线。
AI.motivation: 无线频谱资源有限且多用户共存易造成干扰，需要一种灵活、可扩展的频谱共享机制，使各设备能在避免冲突的同时高效利用空闲频谱，以支撑未来无线通信系统。
AI.method: 每个设备利用机器学习独立决策在固定100 MHz频段内的发射位置与带宽；系统分析真实或仿真信号活动，识别频谱占用与空闲情况，并据此自适应调整传输策略。核心方法为面向多智能体频谱共享的元学习（meta-learning）框架。
AI.result: 在基于空口软件定义无线电（SDR）录制数据与仿真环境的实验中，所提元学习方法在五个多智能体基准环境中取得最高平均奖励，同时保持低碰撞率与稳定的传输行为，一致优于传统强化学习（RL）方法。
AI.conclusion: 元学习能更优地平衡多智能体频谱共享中的相互竞争目标，验证了该灵活、可扩展频谱共享途径的有效性。

title: Separating Decision Time from Decision Quality in the Real-Time Gap of Distilled Deciders: Evidence from a Game and a Conveyor Simulator
comment: 80 pages including supplementary material. Submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems
summary: Real-time agents are often evaluated with the world paused, or with decision time rounded to whole ticks (tick conversion). Tick conversion predicts almost no loss for a learned decider whose hit accuracy falls by 14.8 percentage points (pp) on the same games in asynchronous play. We instead split the decider's gap to a zero-latency teacher into time and quality components. In ViZDoom, we train a small decider by imitating a scripted teacher, run the game on wall-clock time, and add a control in which the teacher waits for a call to the decider's server before deciding. On a Windows host, three preregistered studies put the time component at 6.5-8.7 pp and the quality component at 6.3-8.6 pp. On a Linux host that skips 0.08-0.09% of ticks, the time component disappeared (-0.1 pp; paired 95% bootstrap interval [-0.4, 0.0]) while the quality component remained (5.6 pp [3.7, 7.5]). Retraining on teacher-labelled states from the decider's own play (DAgger) improved it on new games on both hosts (2.6 pp [0.4, 4.9] and 3.1 pp [1.1, 5.2]), a preregistered partial success. Imposing one delay schedule on every arm in live play left a quality component of 5.8 pp [4.0, 7.5] on 100 new games, and retraining cut the decider's disagreement with the teacher on its own states from 22.7% to 14.9%. In a conveyor simulator with a 400 ms deadline, delay past it erased the quality component. A latency-matched control whose delays match the decider's shows which remedy to try.

AI.tldr: 将实时决策器与零延迟教师的差距分解为时间成分与质量成分，发现异步决策损失中约一半来自决策质量而非决策时机。
AI.motivation: 实时智能体常以"暂停世界"或"取整到整tick"（tick conversion）的方式评估，后者在命中准确率实际下降14.8个百分点时仍几乎预测零损失，说明该评估方式掩盖了异步决策的真实代价。作者希望找出这一差距的真正来源，并据此判断该用什么补救手段。
AI.method: 在ViZDoom中让小决策器模仿脚本教师，并在墙钟时间下运行游戏；加入一个对照：教师等待决策器服务器回调后再决策，从而把差距拆为时间成分与质量成分。三项预注册研究分别在Windows主机（会跳tick）与Linux主机（仅跳0.08-0.09% tick）上重复。另用DAgger（在决策器自身对局、教师标注的状态上重训练）验证改进，并在传送带模拟器（400 ms截止期）中检验。
AI.result: Windows上时间成分6.5-8.7 pp、质量成分6.3-8.6 pp；Linux上因跳tick极少，时间成分消失（-0.1 pp，配对95% bootstrap区间[-0.4, 0.0]），质量成分仍在（5.6 pp [3.7, 7.5]）。DAgger在两个主机的新游戏上均有提升（2.6 pp [0.4, 4.9]与3.1 pp [1.1, 5.2]），为预注册的部分成功。在100个新游戏中施加统一延迟调度后仍余5.8 pp [4.0, 7.5]质量成分；重训练把决策器在自身状态上与教师的分歧从22.7%降到14.9%。在400 ms截止期的传送带模拟器中，超期延迟消除了质量成分。延迟匹配对照可指示该用哪种补救措施。
AI.conclusion: tick conversion严重低估了异步决策的真实损失；该损失可分解，且其中稳定的质量成分不随主机跳tick情况消失，需通过DAgger式的分布对齐重训练来缓解，延迟匹配对照则用于选择合适补救方案。质量成分仅在超过截止期的极端延迟下才被抹除。

title: GRAM: Correcting Frozen Time-Series Foundation Models via Graph-Retrieved Amplitude Memory
summary: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) enable zero-shot forecasting through large-scale cross-domain pretraining, while retrieval augmentation further improves their performance by leveraging historical information. However, existing methods typically correct TSFM forecasts using the ground-truth futures of similar historical windows, which contain both predictive components already captured by the foundation model and sample-specific random fluctuation that is difficult to transfer. In contrast, recurring systematic model bias within prediction errors more directly characterizes the failure modes of a frozen TSFM and therefore provides more valuable correction signals. Effectively exploiting such model bias, however, poses two challenges: prediction errors at different numerical levels are difficult to compare due to scale differences, and the recurring bias must be extracted from prediction errors contaminated by random fluctuation. To address these challenges, we propose GRAM, a general retrieval-augmented framework for frozen TSFMs. GRAM first introduces an Amplitude Memory Module (AMM) that scales prediction errors by amplitude and aggregates them into retrievable prototypes. It then employs a Prototype Graph Module (PGM) to model relations among prototypes to aggregate consistent bias information while suppressing random fluctuation. During online forecasting, GRAM retrieves and expands prototypes relevant to the current query and generates per-horizon corrections to refine the original TSFM forecast. Experiments across multiple datasets and foundation models demonstrate consistent forecasting improvements.

AI.tldr: GRAM是一个面向冻结时序基础模型的通用检索增强框架，通过挖掘可复现的系统性模型偏差来修正预测，而非直接使用相似历史窗口的真实未来值。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强方法用相似历史窗口的真实未来值修正TSFM预测，但真实未来值既包含基础模型已捕捉的预测成分，又包含难以迁移的样本特有随机波动。相比之下，预测误差中可复现的系统性模型偏差更能刻画冻结TSFM的失效模式，是更有价值的修正信号。
AI.method: GRAM包含两个模块：1）幅度记忆模块（AMM）：按幅度对预测误差进行缩放，并将其聚合为可检索的原型；2）原型图模块（PGM）：建模原型间关系，聚合一致的偏差信息并抑制随机波动。在线预测时，检索并扩展与当前查询相关的原型，生成逐预测步（per-horizon）的修正量以精炼原始TSFM预测。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种基础模型上的实验表明，GRAM能持续提升预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 利用可复现的系统性模型偏差作为检索修正信号，是提升冻结时序基础模型零样本预测能力的有效途径，GRAM验证了这一思路的通用性与有效性。

title: Which Preferences to Train On? End-to-End Multi-Objective Alignment with an Adversarial Preference Distribution
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values is important for safe, efficient, and beneficial AI deployment. However, human values are multifaceted: helpfulness, harmlessness and humor trade off against one another, and different users want different trade-offs. Multi-objective alignment (MOA) addresses this by training a policy that can provide any point of the Pareto front, but existing methods either train one model per preference, interpolate a few separately aligned experts post hoc, or train a single conditioned model without considering which preferences it should be trained on. Since the hard regions of the preference simplex depend on the objectives at hand, existing methods leave them under-trained and do not get the most out of a single model. Therefore, we propose MAESTRO (Multi-objective Alignment via End-to-end STeering and Robust Optimization), which formulates MOA as a minimax problem over preference distributions and trains a single prompt-conditioned policy end-to-end with RL against an adversarial preference distribution: a Dirichlet distribution updated by online mirror descent toward the preferences the current policy serves worst, rather than on a fixed one. On HH-RLHF, BeaverTails and a summarization task, with up to three objectives, MAESTRO attains the best Pareto front on most tasks in a single training run, at the lowest training cost among the compared methods. The largest margins appear in the hard regions that a fixed preference distribution leaves under-trained, confirming that a single prompt-conditioned model is capable of covering the objective trade-offs on its own.

AI.tldr: 提出 MAESTRO，将多目标对齐（MOA）建模为对偏好分布的极小极大问题，用在线镜像下降更新对抗性 Dirichlet 偏好分布，端到端 RL 训练单一提示条件策略，在多数任务上单次训练即取得最佳 Pareto 前沿且训练成本最低。
AI.motivation: 人类价值是多方面的（有用性、无害性、幽默性等相互权衡），且不同用户偏好不同折中。现有 MOA 方法或为每个偏好训练一个模型、或事后插值若干独立对齐的专家、或训练单一条件模型但不考虑应训练哪些偏好；由于偏好单纯形中的"困难区域"取决于具体目标，现有方法对这些区域训练不足，未能充分发挥单模型潜力。
AI.method: MAESTRO（Multi-objective Alignment via End-to-end STeering and Robust Optimization）：将 MOA 形式化为偏好分布上的极小极大问题，端到端训练一个提示条件策略，并以强化学习对抗一个对抗性偏好分布——该分布为 Dirichlet 分布，通过在线镜像下降（online mirror descent）向当前策略表现最差的偏好方向更新，而非固定分布。
AI.result: 在 HH-RLHF、BeaverTails 及一个摘要任务上（最多三个目标），MAESTRO 在多数任务上于单次训练中取得最佳 Pareto 前沿，且在所比较方法中训练成本最低。最大优势出现在固定偏好分布导致训练不足的困难区域。
AI.conclusion: 结果证实单一提示条件模型自身即可覆盖各目标间的权衡，验证了以对抗性偏好分布驱动的端到端鲁棒优化在 MOA 中的有效性。

title: PIT-GCL: Protein Interaction using Topological Graph Contrastive Learning
summary: Protein binding prediction is central to target identification, therapeutic binder design, and large scale screening, yet remains challenging because binding depends on sequence, three dimensional geometry, and global structural organization. Recent folding models such as AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2 have substantially improved structure prediction, but their confidence outputs (pLDDT, pTM, ipTM) are not specifically designed for binary binding prediction, and dedicated structure aware predictors often require bound complex structures that are unavailable at screening scale. We introduce PIT-GCL, a dual tower structure aware framework that encodes each protein independently from its amino acid sequence, Cα point cloud, and a global persistent homology descriptor. Each tower combines residue ESM-2 embeddings with a topological summary computed from the H0 and H1 persistence landscapes of a Vietoris-Rips filtration, and processes the resulting tokens with a structure aware Transformer in which pairwise Cα distances enter as a learned attention bias. A bidirectional cross attention module then performs latent space soft docking between the two per-protein representations, and the model is trained with a combined binary cross entropy and NT-Xent contrastive objective. On three binary interaction prediction benchmarks, general PPI on PPIRef, TCRpMHC binding on STAG, and whole chain pairs on PPB-Affinity, PIT-GCL outperforms representative sequence based, structure aware, and task specific baselines on general PPI under our evaluation, and is the only method above chance on PPB-Affinity; on TCR-pMHC it leads at a fixed decision threshold but is outranked by a task specific sequence model. Because each protein is encoded independently in the first phase, its representation can be precomputed and reused across candidate pairs, which is convenient for large scale screening.

AI.tldr: PIT-GCL是一个双塔结构感知框架，独立编码每个蛋白的序列、Cα点云和持续同调描述符，并通过双向交叉注意力实现潜在空间软对接，用于蛋白质结合预测。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质结合预测对靶点识别、治疗性结合剂设计和规模化筛选至关重要，但结合依赖于序列、三维几何和全局结构组织，难度大。现有折叠模型（AlphaFold3、Boltz-2）的置信度输出（pLDDT、pTM、ipTM）并非为二分类结合预测设计，而专门的结构感知预测器通常需要筛选阶段无法获得的结合复合物结构。
AI.method: 提出PIT-GCL双塔结构感知框架：每个蛋白塔从氨基酸序列、Cα点云和全局持续同调描述符独立编码；将残基ESM-2嵌入与基于Vietoris-Rips滤流的H0、H1持续景观拓扑摘要结合，用结构感知Transformer处理token，其中成对Cα距离作为学习的注意力偏置；再由双向交叉注意力模块在两个单蛋白表示间执行潜在空间软对接；训练目标为二元交叉熵与NT-Xent对比损失的组合。
AI.result: 在三个二元相互作用预测基准上评估：PPIRef上的通用PPI、STAG上的TCRpMHC结合、PPB-Affinity上的全链对。在本文评估下，PIT-GCL在通用PPI上优于代表性序列方法、结构感知方法和任务特定基线；在PPB-Affinity上是唯一超过随机水平的方法；在TCR-pMHC上于固定决策阈值下领先，但被任务特定的序列模型超越。
AI.conclusion: 由于第一阶段每个蛋白独立编码，其表示可预计算并在候选对之间复用，便于大规模筛选。方法在通用PPI及PPB-Affinity上具有优势，但在TCR-pMHC任务上任务特定序列模型仍具竞争力。

title: CURIO: Curiosity-Driven Test-Time Learning for Open-Ended Discovery
summary: Open-ended discovery requires learning from repeated attempts while continuing to explore directions whose value is not yet apparent. Search with a frozen large language model (LLM) can reuse previous solutions in context, but cannot update the model from its successes and failures on the test problem. Reinforcement learning (RL) enables such adaptation; however, strongly favoring high-reward trajectories may suppress low-reward yet potentially promising directions too early. We introduce CURIO, a curiosity-driven test-time learning framework that complements task feedback with an Intrinsic Curiosity World Model (ICWM). The ICWM learns transitions in the policy's hidden-state representation and supplies prediction-error bonuses at sampled tokens outside the policy's top-k choices. Epoch normalization and an annealed weight regulate their contribution to the policy update. On six mathematical discovery tasks and single-cell denoising with Qwen3 backbones from 8B to 235B, three-run means improve over a matched task-only RL control on five mathematical objectives, match the best reported performance on Circle Packing, and improve denoising Score and mean squared error (MSE) on both held-out corpora at every tested scale. Relative gains reach 18.3% on Hadamard and 10.8% on denoising Score. Code-diversity measurements show greater structural variation among generated programs, supporting curiosity as a complementary exploration signal for learning in open-ended discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出CURIO，一种好奇心驱动的测试时学习框架，通过内在好奇心世界模型（ICWM）在策略隐藏状态表示上学习转移动态，并对策略top-k之外的采样token提供预测误差奖励，从而在开放式发现任务中平衡任务反馈与探索。
AI.motivation: 开放式发现需要从反复尝试中学习，同时继续探索价值尚不明确的方向。冻结LLM的搜索可复用上下文中的先前解，但无法根据测试问题上的成败更新模型；RL虽能实现自适应，但过度偏好高奖励轨迹会过早抑制低奖励却可能有前景的方向。
AI.method: CURIO框架包含内在好奇心世界模型（ICWM），学习策略隐藏状态表示中的转移，并在策略top-k选择之外的采样token上提供预测误差奖励。通过epoch归一化和退火权重调节其对策略更新的贡献。基于Qwen3骨干（8B至235B）在六个数学发现任务和单细胞去噪任务上验证。
AI.result: 三次运行均值在五个数学目标上优于匹配的任务-only RL对照，在Circle Packing上达到最佳已报告性能，在所有测试规模下两个留出语料库上的去噪Score和MSE均有提升。相对增益在Hadamard上达18.3%，去噪Score达10.8%。代码多样性测量显示生成程序具有更大的结构变化。
AI.conclusion: 好奇心作为补充探索信号，有助于开放式发现中的学习，能够提升性能并增加生成程序的结构多样性。

title: Greedy Local Learning for Language Model Pretraining: Gaps and Objective Design
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Collaborative, Open, and Decentralized Training of Foundation Models (CODEC-FM). 13 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables
summary: Greedy block-wise local learning splits a network into gradient-isolated blocks trained by local auxiliary losses, deleting the backward pass between blocks: inter-stage communication becomes forward-only and every block can step its optimizer independently, properties directly relevant to decentralized model-parallel training. Local learning is competitive with end-to-end backpropagation on image classification, and on small Transformers it is known to trade a worse best loss for parallel speedup. How this loss gap behaves in autoregressive language model (LM) pretraining at larger scale, and which auxiliary designs reduce it, has not been measured. We present a token-budget-matched empirical study at 125M and 400M parameters with $K \in \{1,2,4\}$ blocks at Chinchilla-optimal budgets, factorizing the auxiliary design into network architecture and training objective. We observe: (i) the gap to end-to-end training more than doubles from $K=2$ to $K=4$, but at $K=4$ shrinks from 125M to 400M; (ii) replacing an MLP auxiliary with a Transformer-based one is a strong network-side intervention, recovering 22-41% of the gap; (iii) a multi-token-prediction (MTP) auxiliary objective helps at the first block boundary, whereas adding it at deeper boundaries hurts, and restricting it to the first block yields the best $K=4$ configuration ($+0.062$ vs. $+0.075$ nats at 400M); and (iv) deployment-style per-block execution reduces activation memory by up to $2.2\times$. We frame these results as an empirically grounded method direction rather than a finalized method: local objectives should apply future-predictive pressure selectively across boundaries while resisting shortcuts that bypass predictive content.

AI.tldr: 本文在125M与400M参数、K∈{1,2,4}块、Chinchilla最优预算下，对自回归语言模型预训练中的贪心分块局部学习进行token预算匹配的实证研究，将辅助设计分解为网络结构与训练目标，量化了与端到端训练的损失差距及可缓解该差距的干预手段。
AI.motivation: 贪心分块局部学习通过梯度隔离块与局部辅助损失删除块间反向传播，使块间通信仅前向、各块可独立优化，契合去中心化模型并行训练。局部学习在图像分类上可与端到端反向传播竞争，在小Transformer上已知以更差的最优损失换取并行加速，但在更大规模自回归语言模型预训练中该损失差距如何变化、哪些辅助设计能缩小它，尚未被测量。
AI.method: 在125M与400M参数、Chinchilla最优token预算下，对K∈{1,2,4}块进行token预算匹配的对照实验；将辅助设计因子化为网络架构与训练目标两个维度，比较MLP辅助与Transformer辅助、多token预测（MTP）辅助目标的不同放置位置（首块边界、更深边界、仅限首块），并测量部署式逐块执行的激活内存占用。
AI.result: (i) 与端到端训练的差距从K=2到K=4翻倍以上，但K=4时从125M到400M缩小；(ii) 用Transformer辅助替换MLP辅助是强网络侧干预，挽回22–41%的差距；(iii) MTP辅助目标在首个块边界有帮助，加到更深边界反而有害，仅限首块得到最佳K=4配置（400M下+0.062 vs. +0.075 nats）；(iv) 部署式逐块执行将激活内存降低最多2.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 作者将结果定位为有实证依据的方法方向而非定型方法：局部目标应在各块边界上选择性地施加未来预测压力，同时抵抗绕过预测内容的捷径。

title: Your Temporal Link Predictor Is Blind to Who Is Active: A Missing Factor That Transfers Across Models
summary: An interaction has two parts: someone decides to act, and then chooses whom to act on. Temporal link prediction has concentrated on the second, and we show that it is blind to the first by construction: a standard negative keeps the real source and swaps the destination, and we prove that this cancels the source's activity exactly from the optimal score, so no model trained and evaluated this way is ever rewarded for learning it. Under the harder historical and inductive negatives, whose sources differ, the same factor becomes the dominant signal. We model it with Source Node Activity Modeling (SNAM), a self-exciting event intensity fitted by an exact point-process likelihood to decayed interaction counts the history states already contain; it has fewer than 20 parameters. On their own, never looking at the destination, these parameters beat DyGFormer and TPNet on four of five datasets under historical negatives. Added to the frozen scores of TPNet, TGN, DyGFormer and DSRD, four models of different design, without retraining anything, they raise AP on almost every backbone-dataset pair in both settings, by up to 25 points. Our full model ranks first overall against eleven baselines on 13 datasets and three protocols, and on million-event streams trains an epoch 9-100x faster than TPNet and DyGFormer. We conclude that source activity is a blind spot of temporal link prediction, and a cheap, transferable one to close. Code is available at https://github.com/Erutaner/Your-Temporal-Link-Predictor-Is-Blind-to-Who-Is-Active.

AI.tldr: 本文指出时序链路预测的负采样机制系统性忽略了"谁在发起行为"（源节点活跃度），提出仅用少于20个参数的源节点活跃度建模（SNAM），可独立或即插即用地提升多个主干模型性能。
AI.motivation: 交互包含两部分：谁决定行动、以及对谁行动。时序链路预测研究长期聚焦后者，而作者论证标准负采样（保留真实源节点、替换目标节点）在构造上使模型对源节点活跃度"失明"——在最优得分中源节点活跃度因子被精确抵消，模型无论训练还是评估都无法因学到该信号而获得奖励。而更困难的历史负采样与归纳负采样中源节点不同，该因子反而成为主导信号，形成明显的建模盲区。
AI.method: 提出源节点活跃度建模（SNAM）：以自激发事件强度（self-exciting event intensity）刻画源节点活跃度，通过精确的点过程似然（point-process likelihood）拟合历史中已包含的衰减交互计数；模型参数少于20个。训练时只关注源节点、完全不看目标节点。SNAM可作为独立评分器，也可作为附加项加到冻结的TPNet、TGN、DyGFormer、DSRD得分上，无需重训练。
AI.result: 独立使用时，SNAM在历史负采样下于5个数据集中的4个上超越DyGFormer与TPNet；作为附加项时，在两种设定下几乎每一组"主干-数据集"组合上都提升AP，最高提升25个点；完整模型在13个数据集、3种协议上、对11个基线排名第一，且在百万级事件流上每轮训练比TPNet与DyGFormer快9–100倍。
AI.conclusion: 源节点活跃度是时序链路预测的一个盲区，且是一个代价低、可迁移、易于弥补的盲区。作者将SNAM视为对现有模型设计的正交补充，代码已开源。

title: ResOPD: Tail Residualization for Sparse On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on self-generated trajectories, but transmitting dense teacher distributions across long reasoning traces creates prohibitive communication and memory bottlenecks. Practical systems therefore rely on sparse teacher interfaces, typically transmitting either the sampled-token score or a small Top-$k$ distribution. However, this sparse setting faces a fundamental dilemma: sampled-token estimators are unbiased but suffer from severe gradient variance, whereas directly optimizing Top-$k$ objectives introduces systematic bias. To improve this trade-off, we propose ResOPD (On-Policy Distillation with Tail Residualization), which provides unbiased full-vocabulary reverse KL gradient estimation under on-policy sampling, with substantial variance reduction under the same sparse payload in the evaluated settings. ResOPD aggregates the unobserved vocabulary into an observable coarse tail event, computes its exact aggregate gradient, and samples only the fine-grained within-tail residual, which requires no additional teacher queries or forward passes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ResOPD substantially reduces gradient variance, stabilizes online training dynamics, and improves downstream performance across the evaluated settings. These results establish ResOPD as an efficient, plug-and-play variance reduction primitive for sparse on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: ResOPD 是一种针对稀疏 on-policy 蒸馏的无偏方差缩减方法：将未观测词表聚合成可观测的粗粒度尾部事件并精确计算其聚合梯度，仅对尾部内部残差采样，从而在相同稀疏载荷下降低梯度方差并稳定在线训练。
AI.motivation: On-policy 蒸馏在自生成轨迹上训练学生模型，但跨长推理链传输稠密教师分布会造成通信与内存瓶颈，实际系统只能用稀疏教师接口（采样 token 分数或小 Top-k 分布）。该稀疏设定存在根本困境：采样 token 估计量无偏但梯度方差大，直接优化 Top-k 目标则引入系统性偏差。因此需要改进这一偏差-方差权衡。
AI.method: 提出 ResOPD（On-Policy Distillation with Tail Residualization）。它在 on-policy 采样下提供无偏的全词表 reverse KL 梯度估计：将未观测词表聚合成一个可观测的粗粒度尾部事件，精确计算其聚合梯度，再仅对尾部内部的细粒度残差进行采样。该方法不需要额外的教师查询或前向传播。
AI.result: 在评测设定中，ResOPD 在相同稀疏载荷下显著降低梯度方差，稳定在线训练动态，并提升下游性能。
AI.conclusion: ResOPD 可作为一种高效、即插即用的稀疏 on-policy 蒸馏方差缩减原语。

title: SFlexRCA: Lightweight, Scalable, and Flexible Root Cause Analysis for IIoT Edge Systems
summary: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) systems generate high-dimensional sensor telemetry from interconnected components, where faults can propagate across the system. To address these challenges, we propose SFlexRCA (Scalable and Flexible Root Cause Analysis), a topology-free RCA framework designed for resource-constrained IIoT environments. SFlexRCA transforms multivariate telemetry into compact orthogonal representations and applies shared lightweight linear modeling, avoiding explicit graph construction, message passing, and per-variable or lag-specific parameter growth. We evaluate SFlexRCA on three publicly available IIoT datasets, BATADAL, SWaT, and WADI, spanning different numbers of monitored variables, temporal characteristics, and training-data regimes. SFlexRCA is compared with 10 statistical, causal, and non-causal baselines in terms of RCA accuracy, training efficiency, inference latency, and memory consumption. In addition, inference efficiency and memory consumption are evaluated on Raspberry Pi 3 and Raspberry Pi 5, while energy consumption is additionally measured on Raspberry Pi 5. We further investigate temporalcontext sensitivity, architectural and loss components, and alternative representations. Notably, SFlexRCA maintains strong localization performance on BATADAL despite its limited normal-operation training data, while its compact shared architecture avoids the parameter growth associated with causal and graph-based approaches. Its lightweight shared architecture further enables efficient deployment on resource-constrained IIoT edge devices. The SFlexRCA code is available at https://github.com/theamrzaki/RootCause- Analysis-Correlation-Attentive-Modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出无需拓扑的根因分析框架SFlexRCA，将多元遥测转化为紧凑正交表示并用共享轻量线性模型，在三个IIoT数据集上兼顾精度与边缘端效率。
AI.motivation: IIoT系统由互联部件产生高维传感器遥测数据，故障可在系统内传播，根因定位具有挑战性；同时IIoT边缘设备资源受限，现有因果与图方法需显式构图、消息传递且参数量随变量与滞后增长，难以部署。
AI.method: SFlexRCA为拓扑无关（topology-free）框架：将多元遥测转换为紧凑的正交表示，采用共享的轻量线性建模，避免显式图构建、消息传递以及按变量或按滞后增长参数。
AI.result: 在BATADAL、SWaT、WADI三个公开IIoT数据集上，与10个统计、因果及非因果基线对比RCA精度、训练效率、推理时延与内存占用；并在树莓派3与树莓派5上评估推理效率与内存，树莓派5上额外测量能耗；同时开展时间上下文敏感性、架构与损失组件、替代表示等消融分析。SFlexRCA在正常工况训练数据有限的BATADAL上仍保持较强定位性能。
AI.conclusion: SFlexRCA以紧凑共享架构避免因果和图方法的参数膨胀，兼具较强根因定位能力与轻量化特性，适合资源受限IIoT边缘设备部署。代码已开源。

title: ScopeSAE: Model-Scope Feature Discovery with Interpretable Layer Selection
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are a central tool in mechanistic interpretability. However, existing SAEs are primarily trained per layer. The modeling subspace is therefore fixed by layer identity, independent of which token-layer states actually drive each prediction. We argue that this constraint contributes to several limitations observed in layer-wise SAEs, including low feature utilization, high dictionary redundancy, and features that lack direct behavioral grounding. In this paper, we propose ScopeSAE, which selects the modeling subspace per token by attributing each prediction to its most influential token-layer state via normalized gradient-based attribution, and learns features over the resulting prediction-relevant subspace. Empirically, ScopeSAE yields an effect we term reconstruction-better-than-original. Written-back reconstructions of the SAE produce lower next-token cross-entropy than the original activations, an outcome that, to our knowledge, has not previously been reported for SAEs. Through interventional analyses and a KL fine-tuning counter-experiment, we show that this effect is attributable to ScopeSAE's prediction-relevant subspace itself rather than to architectural changes. ScopeSAE further improves effective feature count, interpretability, utilization, and dictionary redundancy over existing layer-based baselines, suggesting that choosing the SAE modeling subspace by predictive relevance leads to more useful and behaviorally meaningful features.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ScopeSAE，通过归一化梯度归因将每个预测分配到最具影响力的 token-层状态，从而按 token 动态选择建模子空间，并在该预测相关子空间上学习稀疏自编码器特征。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏自编码器（SAE）主要按层训练，建模子空间由层身份固定，与真正驱动每个预测的 token-层状态无关。这一约束导致特征利用率低、字典冗余高、特征缺乏直接的行为基础等问题。
AI.method: ScopeSAE 利用归一化梯度归因，将每个预测归因到最具影响力的 token-层状态，从而为每个 token 选择建模子空间，并在该预测相关子空间上学习特征。
AI.result: ScopeSAE 产生一种被称为“reconstruction-better-than-original”的现象：SAE 回写重建得到的下一 token 交叉熵低于原始激活。通过干预分析和 KL 微调对照实验，证明该效应源自预测相关子空间本身而非架构变化。此外，ScopeSAE 在有效特征数、可解释性、特征利用率和字典冗余方面均优于现有基于层的基线。
AI.conclusion: 按预测相关性选择 SAE 建模子空间可产生更有用且更具行为意义的特征，表明动态、预测相关的子空间选择是改进机制可解释性 SAE 的有效方向。

title: Why Subliminal Learning Needs So Much Data: A Noisy Inverse View through Steering Vector Recovery
summary: Subliminal learning lets a student inherit a teacher's behavioral trait from semantically unrelated data, yet published demonstrations typically require tens of thousands of carrier examples. We ask where this data requirement comes from. Our testbed is subliminal steering: the teacher trait is a known residual-stream vector $Δ_T$, so transfer can be measured directly as parameter recovery. On identical carrier prefixes, we compare token-level (hard) NLL supervision with full-distribution (soft) KL supervision. At initialization the two objectives give nearly collinear gradients, and both align poorly with $Δ_T$. Under iterative optimization, however, they diverge: soft supervision recovers $Δ_T$ almost exactly from a few hundred carriers, while hard supervision stays well below it even with tens of thousands. We explain this gap by casting steering-vector distillation as a noisy linear inverse problem. Locally, the carrier task maps the trait through its Fisher matrix $F$, so gradients point toward $FΔ_T$ rather than $Δ_T$. Gradient descent then acts as a progressively less-damped inverse of $F$. With soft targets, this inverse restores low-curvature directions. With hard labels, it also amplifies the sampling noise in those same directions. The result is an optimal inversion depth that grows with the number of independent carriers. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma-2-9B confirm four predictions: the Fisher distortion of the initial gradient, recovery ordered from steep to flat directions, an optimal depth that shifts with data scale, and the finding that resampling completions from a fixed prompt pool works as well as adding new prompts. In this setting, large carrier datasets are needed less to reveal the trait than to suppress label noise amplified by Fisher inversion. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/luoyuchenmlcv/subliminal-data}.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"潜意识学习"中数据需求量大的根源，将其建模为含噪线性逆问题，指出硬标签NLL监督会因Fisher逆放大大规模采样噪声而需要海量载体样本，而软分布KL监督仅需几百条载体即可几乎精确恢复教师特质向量。
AI.motivation: 已发表的潜意识学习演示通常需要数万条载体样本才能让学生继承教师的行为特质，但这一数据需求究竟从何而来并不清楚。作者希望通过可控的实验台——潜意识引导（教师特质为已知残差流向量Δ_T，可直接以参数恢复程度衡量迁移效果）——定位该数据瓶颈的根本原因。
AI.method: 在相同载体前缀下，对比token级（硬）NLL监督与全分布（软）KL监督。将引导向量蒸馏刻画为含噪线性逆问题：载体任务通过Fisher矩阵F将特质映射为FΔ_T，梯度下降相当于对F做逐步减弱阻尼的求逆；软目标可恢复低曲率方向，硬标签则会放大这些方向上的采样噪声，从而存在随独立载体数量增长的最优逆深度。在Qwen2.5-7B与Gemma-2-9B上验证四个预测。
AI.result: 在初始化时两种目标的梯度近乎共线且均与Δ_T对齐较差；迭代优化后二者分化：软监督用几百条载体即可几乎精确恢复Δ_T，硬监督即使数万条也远低于此。实验确认：(1)初始梯度的Fisher畸变；(2)恢复顺序由陡峭到平坦方向排列；(3)最优逆深度随数据规模移动；(4)从固定提示池重采样补全与新增提示效果相当。
AI.conclusion: 大规模载体数据集的作用并非揭示特质，而是抑制被Fisher逆放大的标签噪声。软监督通过恢复低曲率方向大幅降低数据需求，为潜意识学习的样本效率问题提供了机制性解释。

title: Residual Visual Credit Optimization: Conserved Evidence Routing for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards scales multimodal reasoning, but an outcome reward says how much a trajectory is worth, not how that value should be spread over the decisions that produced it. We introduce Residual Visual Credit Optimization (RVCO), which treats token credit as a conserved routing problem. A controlled visual intervention yields a per-token evidence response; robust within-trajectory coordinates remove incidental scale; and a budgeted entropic router distributes a fixed amount of sequence utility according to perceptual dependence. A residual support path guarantees positive credit at every valid position, and an analytic correction restores the prescribed credit mass exactly. The resulting field is selective, bounded, full-support, and invariant to response-local score shifts, and recovers hard token selection as a limiting case. Across four model families and seven reasoning benchmarks, RVCO improves accuracy over strong RLVR baselines while maintaining late-stage optimization stability, corruption robustness, and competitive training cost. Rewards, rollouts, and the group-relative advantage estimator are unchanged; only the geometry of token-level credit differs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Residual Visual Credit Optimization（RVCO），将 token 级信用分配建模为守恒路由问题：通过受控视觉干预获得逐 token 证据响应，去除偶然尺度后，用带预算的熵路由按感知依赖分配固定序列效用，并以残差支撑路径与解析校正保证信用质量守恒，从而在四类模型与七个推理基准上优于强 RLVR 基线。
AI.motivation: RLVR 已能扩展多模态推理，但结果奖励只给出轨迹整体价值，未说明该价值应如何分摊到产生它的各个决策（token）上，即缺少合理的 token 级信用分配几何。
AI.method: 将 token 信用视为守恒路由问题：1）受控视觉干预产生逐 token 证据响应；2）用稳健的轨迹内坐标消除偶然尺度；3）带预算的熵路由依据感知依赖分配固定序列效用；4）残差支撑路径保证每个有效位置获得正信用；5）解析校正精确恢复指定信用质量。奖励、rollout 与组相对优势估计器均不变，仅改变 token 级信用几何。
AI.result: 所得信用场具备选择性、有界性、全支撑，并对响应局部分数平移不变，可将硬 token 选择作为极限情形恢复。在四类模型家族与七个推理基准上，RVCO 相对强 RLVR 基线提升准确率，同时保持后期优化稳定性、损坏鲁棒性与有竞争力的训练开销。
AI.conclusion: 在多模态推理的 RLVR 中，仅重新设计 token 级信用分配几何（不改动奖励、rollout 与优势估计）即可同时提升精度与优化稳定性，表明信用路由是提升 RLVR 的有效且低侵入方向。

title: TSAE: Structured Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Time-Series Forecasting Models
summary: Time-series forecasting informs critical decisions in energy dispatch, industrial operations, and environmental monitoring; understanding the patterns models rely on is essential for assessing reliability and identifying failures. Input attribution identifies important variables and time segments but offers limited insight into internal features, while standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not directly constrain cross-variable structure or temporal continuity. We introduce TSAE, a structured sparse autoencoder for forecasting representations that decomposes hidden states into individually inspectable features. TSAE organizes cross-variable structure through shared and variable-routed private dictionaries, separates feature detection from magnitude estimation with gated encoding, and constrains neighboring sparse-code changes according to raw-segment similarity. These mechanisms support analysis of variable context, activation strength, and temporal evolution. Forecast-consistency fine-tuning further improves preservation of the frozen forecaster's outputs. The accompanying TSEVAL protocol separately audits fidelity, feature coherence, and physical calibration to ground feature interpretation. In three-seed experiments with frozen PatchTST on ETTh1, ETTh2, and ETTm1, TSAE achieves the lowest hidden-state reconstruction error, normalized forecast-reconstruction error (NFRE), and feature transition rate among five SAEs at comparable per-token activity. NFRE decreases by 4.3-26.4% relative to the next-best mean. Dataset-dependent tradeoffs in selectivity, physical correlation, and calibration show that fidelity and temporal-stability gains require independent semantic validation to support feature interpretation.

AI.tldr: 提出TSAE结构化稀疏自编码器，将预测模型隐状态分解为可检查特征，并配套TSEVAL评估协议，在多个ETT数据集上取得最低重构误差与特征转换率。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测中的输入归因只能识别重要变量与时间段，难以洞察内部特征；而标准稀疏自编码器（SAE）目标未直接约束跨变量结构与时间连续性，因此需要一种结构化方法以支持可靠性评估与失效识别。
AI.method: TSAE通过共享字典与变量路由私有字典组织跨变量结构；采用门控编码将特征检测与幅度估计分离；依据原始片段相似度约束相邻稀疏码变化；并使用预测一致性微调以保持冻结预测器的输出。同时提出TSEVAL协议，分别审计保真度、特征一致性与物理校准。
AI.result: 在冻结PatchTST、三个随机种子、ETTh1/ETTh2/ETTm1实验中，TSAE在五类SAE中取得最低隐状态重构误差、归一化预测-重构误差（NFRE）和特征转换率（在相近每token活跃度下）。NFRE相对次优均值下降4.3%–26.4%。选择性、物理相关性与校准存在数据集依赖的权衡。
AI.conclusion: TSAE提升保真度与时间稳定性，但特征解释仍需独立语义验证；保真度和时序稳定性增益不能自动保证语义有效性。

title: Prompt Dominance and Asymmetric Verifier Costs: Empirical Ablations of GRPO at 1B Scale on GSM8K
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures. Code, run records, and figure scripts: https://github.com/Helios-YQH/llm-from-scratch
summary: This paper studies GRPO at 1B scale from both directions: what estimator choices do to the learning signal, and what a degraded reward signal does to what is learned. We train OLMo-2-0425-1B on GSM8K with a from-scratch implementation and measure both sides in controlled sweeps, including a verifier-quality experiment that degrades the training reward and the test-time selector identically. Four results stand out. The prompt is the first-order decision: the zero-shot prompt leaves the base model at 0.08% (its outputs are degenerate continuations, not wrong answers), so almost no group carries a gradient, and training succeeds because the 3-shot prompt reaches 18.3%. At this scale the estimator variants sit within seed noise, with Dr. GRPO ahead on both seeds. In the off-policy regime, clipping is the whole story: training on data without a clipped ratio loses 4-6 points relative to the on-policy reference, while GRPO-style clipping and GSPO recover the loss entirely. Finally, the same weak verifier is far cheaper in RL than in test-time selection: a 10%-flip verifier leaves RL's attainable gain intact (91% and 106% retained across two seeds) where selection retains 57%, and a format-only verifier leaves RL with 16-30% of its gain and selection with essentially nothing. Flip noise acts as an affine transform on the expected reward, and the group-normalized advantage with Adam's rescaling removes it exactly; the residual is a second-order variance effect that the matched-step comparison at a 30% flip rate tests.

AI.tldr: 本文在1B规模上系统研究GRPO，从估计器选择对学习信号的影响与退化奖励信号对学习结果的影响两个方向展开，通过OLMo-2-0425-1B在GSM8K上的从零实现与受控扫描实验，得出提示词是一阶决策、估计器变体差异在种子噪声内、off-policy下裁剪机制关键，以及弱验证器对RL的损害远小于对测试时选择等结论。
AI.motivation: 作者希望厘清GRPO在较小规模（1B）下的两个关键问题：不同估计器设计如何影响学习信号，以及退化（噪声/弱）奖励信号如何影响最终学到的策略，从而为小规模RL训练提供可控的经验依据。
AI.method: 使用从零实现的GRPO训练OLMo-2-0425-1B于GSM8K，进行受控扫描实验，包括验证器质量实验（同时退化训练奖励与测试时选择器），比较不同提示词、估计器变体、on-policy与off-policy下的裁剪机制（GRPO式裁剪与GSPO），并测试不同翻转率（如10%、30%）及仅格式验证器的影响。
AI.result: 四点突出发现：(1) 提示词是一阶决策，零样本提示下基础模型仅0.08%（输出为退化续写），3-shot提示达18.3%；(2) 该规模下估计器变体差异在种子噪声内，Dr. GRPO在两个种子上均领先；(3) off-policy下裁剪是全部关键，无裁剪比率训练损失4-6分，GRPO式裁剪与GSPO完全恢复；(4) 弱验证器对RL的代价远低于测试时选择：10%翻转验证器下RL保留91%和106%增益，而选择仅保留57%；仅格式验证器下RL保留16-30%增益，选择几乎为零。翻转噪声对期望奖励是仿射变换，组归一化优势配合Adam重缩放可精确消除，残余为二阶方差效应。
AI.conclusion: 在1B规模上，提示词质量是GRPO成功的一阶因素；估计器变体影响有限；off-policy训练中裁剪机制至关重要；RL对弱验证器的鲁棒性显著高于测试时选择，且翻转噪声可通过组归一化优势与Adam重缩放精确消除，残余为二阶方差效应。

title: Billion-Scale Thumbnail Optimization for Uncurated Short-Form Videos via Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: This paper introduces a real-time thumbnail optimization system deployed at a global $O(B)$ scale on a major short-form video platform. Unlike traditional long-form content, where custom thumbnails are heavily curated by creators, a considerable fraction of short-form videos are published without human-selected artwork. To address this uncurated corpus, we present a fully automated, end-to-end framework that replaces static default frames with dynamic, data-driven selections across billions of videos. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first published work demonstrating an online Multi-Armed Bandit framework successfully deployed at an $O(B)$ scale for uncurated short-form video discovery. Our solution pairs a multi-stage candidate generation pipeline with a low-latency serving infrastructure. By initializing the exploration framework with image-specific priors derived from a deep visual quality model, the system minimizes exploration costs and dynamically serves optimal thumbnails at serving time. Global deployment demonstrates statistically significant improvements in core user discovery and engagement metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并部署了一个面向全球十亿级（O(B)）短视频平台的实时缩略图优化系统：针对大量无人工封面（uncurated）的短视频，用全自动端到端框架以数据驱动的动态封面替代静态默认帧，并首次公开报道了在O(B)规模上成功上线用于无人工干预短视频发现的多臂老虎机（MAB）框架。
AI.motivation: 区别于长视频通常由创作者精心挑选自定义封面，短视频中存在相当比例的作品未提供人工选定封面（uncurated corpus），导致静态默认帧无法有效吸引用户点击、不利于内容发现。因此需要一套自动化方案在大规模场景下动态优选封面以提升发现与互动指标。
AI.method: 核心是线上多臂老虎机（Multi-Armed Bandit）探索框架，配合多阶段候选生成流水线（multi-stage candidate generation）与低时延服务基础设施（low-latency serving infrastructure）；关键在于用基于深度视觉质量模型得到的图像级先验（image-specific priors）对探索框架进行初始化，以降低探索成本，并在服务时动态下发最优缩略图。
AI.result: 在全球范围部署后，核心用户发现（discovery）与互动（engagement）指标均取得统计显著提升；系统覆盖数十亿视频规模（O(B)）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了在O(B)量级无人工封面短视频场景中，将深度视觉质量先验与线上MAB探索结合的全自动缩略图优化框架具备可行性与显著业务收益，据作者所知为首个公开报道的此类大规模落地实践。

title: Learning under Localized Minority Imbalance
summary: Class-imbalance methods implicitly assume that the minority class is uniformly undersampled relative to the majority class. However, in many real-world settings, minority instances may be disproportionately under-observed in certain regions of the feature space. For example, small businesses that go bankrupt may disappear from records, while those that survive remain visible, making bankruptcy appear less common among small firms than it actually is. This gives rise to localized minority imbalance (LMI), a challenge that is often overlooked and extends beyond general class-count imbalance. We show that under LMI, existing imbalance mitigation techniques can fit observation-induced biases in the training data and generalize poorly to under-observed regions of the true minority distribution. To address this, we propose a tree-based stratified approach that recursively partitions the feature space with the goal of reducing within-stratum LMI distortion. For each resulting stratum, we pair its majority instances with the full observed minority set and train a base classifier to create an ensemble. Extensive experiments over benchmark tabular datasets simulated with LMI show that our stratified ensembling approach outperforms popular and state-of-the-art imbalance mitigation techniques. We also introduce a gold-standard evaluation protocol that uses unbiased test sets, and demonstrate that conventional hold-out evaluation from the same LMI-biased data can substantially mislead performance. Overall, our results highlight that the cause of imbalance is as important as the correction method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"局部少数类不平衡"(LMI)概念，指出少数类在特征空间某些区域被不成比例地欠观测，会使现有不平衡处理方法拟合观测偏差。作者提出基于树的递归分层集成方法，并给出无偏测试集评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有类不平衡方法隐含假设少数类相对多数类是均匀欠采样的。但现实中，少数类样本可能在特征空间特定区域被不成比例地欠观测（如破产小企业从记录中消失），导致局部少数类不平衡(LMI)。这一挑战常被忽视，且现有方法会拟合观测诱发的偏差，在欠观测区域泛化差。作者认为不平衡的成因与纠正方法同等重要。
AI.method: 提出基于树的递归分层方法：递归划分特征空间，以降低层内LMI失真为目标；对每个得到的层，将其多数类实例与全部观测到的少数类集合配对，训练基分类器并构成集成。
AI.result: 在模拟LMI的基准表格数据集上，分层集成方法优于流行及最先进的不平衡处理技术。同时提出使用无偏测试集的黄金标准评估协议，证明基于同一LMI偏差数据的常规留出评估会严重误导性能判断。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调不平衡的成因与纠正方法同样重要；LMI是超出一般类别计数不平衡的独立挑战，递归分层集成结合无偏评估能更真实地反映模型在真实少数类分布上的表现。

title: D-DOIT: Training-free Adaptation of Discrete Diffusion via Doob's h-Transform
summary: We propose D-DOIT (Discrete Doob-Oriented Inference-time Transformation), a training-free and efficient adaptation method for discrete diffusion models with generic rewards. D-DOIT formulates adaptation as sampling from a reward-tilted target distribution and realizes this transport through Doob's h-transform of the discrete diffusion reverse kernel, using only reward values rather than reward gradients. Unlike continuous diffusion, masked discrete diffusion samples categorical token-reveal transitions rather than continuous state updates. D-DOIT derives the corresponding discrete Doob's h-transform, which guides sampling by reweighting reverse transition probabilities instead of adding a drift correction. To make this transformation practical, D-DOIT avoids expensive future rollouts. At each guided step, D-DOIT samples candidate next states, uses the model prediction head to complete each candidate into a clean sequence, evaluates each completion with the reward oracle, and resamples the next state with probabilities proportional to the rewards. An optional late-stage best-of-K refinement further improves sample quality by branching trajectories only near the end of denoising, avoiding the $K$-fold cost over the full trajectory. Empirically, across regulatory DNA design and protein inverse folding benchmarks, D-DOIT outperforms training-free guidance baselines. It improves enhancer activity and cell-type specificity while preserving sequence naturalness, and achieves the highest success rate in protein inverse folding.

AI.tldr: D-DOIT 是一种针对离散扩散模型的免训练自适应方法，通过离散 Doob h-变换将通用奖励引导实现为对反向转移概率的重新加权，并结合候选采样与末期 best-of-K 精炼，在调控 DNA 设计和蛋白质逆折叠任务上超越免训练引导基线。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型（尤其是掩码离散扩散）在通用奖励下的适配缺乏高效、免训练的引导方法。连续扩散的奖励引导依赖梯度或漂移修正，而离散扩散采样的是类别化的 token 揭示转移，无法直接照搬；同时现有引导若需未来 rollout 会带来高昂计算成本。
AI.method: 将适配建模为从奖励倾斜目标分布中采样，并通过离散扩散反向核的 Doob h-变换实现该传输，仅用奖励值而非奖励梯度。针对掩码离散扩散，D-DOIT 推导出对应的离散 Doob h-变换，通过重新加权反向转移概率（而非添加漂移修正）来引导采样。为避免昂贵的未来 rollout，在每个引导步中采样候选下一状态，用模型预测头将各候选补全为干净序列，用奖励 oracle 评估每个补全，并按与奖励成比例的概率重采样下一状态；另设可选的末期 best-of-K 精炼，仅在去噪末期分支轨迹以提升质量，避免全轨迹的 K 倍成本。
AI.result: 在调控 DNA 设计和蛋白质逆折叠基准上，D-DOIT 优于免训练引导基线：提升增强子活性与细胞类型特异性，同时保持序列自然度；在蛋白质逆折叠上取得最高成功率。
AI.conclusion: D-DOIT 为离散扩散模型提供了一种免训练、高效且适用于通用奖励的引导框架，其离散 Doob h-变换与候选重采样机制在多项生物序列设计任务上验证了有效性，末期 best-of-K 精炼可在低额外成本下进一步提升样本质量。

title: A Graph-Based Inspection and Intervention Tool for Assessing Mechanistic Learning in PINNs
comment: This is a developmental work which was submitted to NeurIPS workshops. Useful feedback was obtained and an improved version is being developed
summary: We ask whether physically meaningful correspondences discovered inside a trained scientific model remain meaningful outside the conditions under which they were discovered. We introduce GIIT (Graph-based Inspection and Intervention Tool), which represents governing physics as a computational physics dependency graph, maps graph nodes to internal network components via sensitivity- and trend-based discovery, and tests the resulting mapping under targeted intervention. Evaluating on temporal extrapolation out-of-distribution (OOD) regimes of increasing severity, we find that temporal extrapolation is associated with layer-wise correspondence drift and reduced functional correspondence. Specifically, while the model achieves low physics residual in-distribution (1.915 x 10-4 on full ID and 1.01 x 10-4 on an ID sub-window t in [0.5, 0.8]), the functional mapping changes even before leaving the training domain, and the shift continues as the evaluation window extends beyond the training domain: residual error increases from 2.81 x 10-2 on the boundary-crossing window (t in [0.5, 1.5]) to 3.30 x 10-1 on severe OOD (t in [1, 2]), accompanied by a systematic leftward shift of internal layer mappings, where the average winner layer index drops from 5.71 (ID) to 3.00 (ID sub-window) down to 2.29 (severe OOD). Only 2 of 7 physical nodes maintain stable layer assignments across the boundary-crossing window, and only 1 of 7 under severe extrapolation, revealing potential internal functional correspondence changes before severe degradation in conventional output metrics. Additional results for linear oscillatory systems are further detailed in the appendix.

AI.tldr: 提出GIIT工具，检验科学模型内部物理对应关系在分布外是否仍成立，发现时间外推伴随层级对应漂移与功能对应减弱。
AI.motivation: 探讨在训练条件下发现的、具有物理意义的内部对应关系，是否在训练条件之外仍然有意义，即检验科学机器学习模型内部物理映射的可外推性与稳定性。
AI.method: 提出GIIT（基于图的检查与干预工具）：将支配物理表示为计算物理依赖图，通过基于敏感度与趋势的发现方法把图节点映射到网络内部组件，并通过定向干预测试该映射。
AI.result: 在递增严重程度的时间外推OOD场景中：ID残差低（全ID为1.915×10⁻⁴，子窗口t∈[0.5,0.8]为1.01×10⁻⁴）；残差在跨边界窗口t∈[0.5,1.5]升至2.81×10⁻²，严重OOD t∈[1,2]升至3.30×10⁻¹；内部层映射系统性左移，平均获胜层索引由5.71（ID）降至3.00（子窗口）再到2.29（严重OOD）；跨边界窗口仅7个物理节点中2个保持稳定层分配，严重外推下仅1个。
AI.conclusion: 时间外推与层级对应漂移及功能对应减弱相关；功能映射在离开训练域之前即已改变，并在超出训练域后持续偏移，可在常规输出指标严重退化之前揭示潜在的内部分功能对应变化。线性振荡系统的补充结果见附录。

title: Software World Models: From Consequence Prediction to Decision Value
summary: A coding agent may safely modify one repository while silently breaking downstream services, libraries, or datastores that depend on it. Exhaustively running integration tests after every agent action is impractical, so the agent must predict these failures before executing them. Existing software world models predict the agent's own observations, while static change-impact analysis only identifies where a change may propagate. We instead introduce the Software World Model (SWM), which models the broader system affected by a code change and predicts its blast set: the components that the change will break. SWM follows three stages: explore, learn, and act. Explore executes candidate changes from restored system states, prioritizing regions where observed failures contradict the dependency graph. Learn fine-tunes a language model on these execution outcomes to predict downstream breakage. Act converts sampled predictions into per-consumer break probabilities for change ranking, proactive migration, and deciding when another execution is worth its cost. On held-out synthetic systems, SWM improves blast-set F1 from 0.431 for static reachability to $0.571\pm0.037$, more than halves ranking regret, and improves migration return at all nine evaluation checkpoints. The two methods are complementary: reachability is stronger on dependencies represented in the graph, while SWM recovers failures caused by couplings the graph misses. Experiments on held-out real libraries further show that predicting structured failure outcomes, rather than only scalar risk, is important for downstream decision quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出软件世界模型（SWM），通过"探索—学习—行动"三阶段预测代码变更的爆炸集（blast set），即变更将破坏的下游组件。在合成系统上，爆炸集F1从静态可达性的0.431提升至0.571±0.037，排序后悔减半，迁移回报在九个检查点全面提升。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体修改某仓库时，可能悄悄破坏依赖它的下游服务、库或数据存储。每次行动后穷尽运行集成测试不现实，因此智能体必须在执行前预测这些失效。现有软件世界模型只预测智能体自身的观测，而静态变更影响分析仅能识别变更可能传播的位置，无法预测破坏结果。
AI.method: SWM分三阶段：Explore（探索）从恢复的系统状态执行候选变更，优先探索观测到的失效与依赖图相矛盾的区域；Learn（学习）基于这些执行结果微调语言模型以预测下游破坏；Act（行动）将采样预测转化为逐消费者破坏概率，用于变更排序、主动迁移及判断再次执行是否值得其成本。
AI.result: 在留出的合成系统上，爆炸集F1从静态可达性的0.431提升至0.571±0.037，排序后悔减少一半以上，迁移回报在全部九个评估检查点上均提升。两种方法互补：可达性在依赖图已表示的依赖上更强，而SWM能恢复因图未捕捉的耦合所导致的失效。在留出的真实库实验进一步表明，预测结构化失效结果而非仅标量风险对下游决策质量很重要。
AI.conclusion: 建模受代码变更影响的更广泛系统并预测其爆炸集，优于仅预测智能体观测或仅做静态影响分析的方法；预测结构化失效结果比仅输出标量风险更有价值，且SWM与基于图的静态可达性方法互补。

title: TempoBridge: Source-Conditioned Flow Matching with Optimal Transport Couplings for Single-Cell Population Transitions
summary: Destructive single-cell measurements provide unpaired population snapshots rather than observations of the same cells across conditions. Local cell states and transition requests may also be insufficient to distinguish responses across source populations. We introduce TempoBridge, a common source-conditioned transport formulation for temporal, genetic, and chemical population transitions. Source cells initialize latent transport and provide a fixed empirical population summary. The velocity field receives this summary alongside the evolving cell state, flow time, and a structured transition descriptor. Minibatch optimal transport (OT) supplies couplings only for conditional flow-matching training paths; inference requires neither target expression nor OT computation. On held-out donors, TempoBridge achieves an Energy distance of 0.129 versus 0.144 for scGen. Genetic mean-expression $L_2$ error is 2.261 versus 3.156 for scGPT-scratch under Seen 2/2. On held-out compounds, condition-averaged drug-effect correlation is 0.598 versus 0.561 for the CellFlow adapter. Temporal ablations show higher mean distributional error after removing source context, replacing optimal transport with random pairing, or replacing flow matching with static residual regression. Together, these results demonstrate the predictive utility of a common source-conditioned transport formulation across held-out donors, gene combinations, and compounds.

AI.tldr: TempoBridge：一种公共源条件运输框架，用源细胞初始化潜在运输并固定经验群体摘要，配合速度场实现跨供体、基因组合与化合物的预测性建模。
AI.motivation: 破坏性单细胞测量只能提供非配对的群体快照，无法观测同一细胞在条件间变化；且局部细胞状态与转变请求不足以区分不同源群体的响应差异。
AI.method: 提出统一的条件运输公式，适用于时间、遗传与化学群体转变。源细胞初始化潜在运输并提供固定经验群体摘要；速度场同时接收该摘要、演化细胞状态、流时间与结构化转变描述符。小批量最优运输仅为条件流匹配训练路径提供耦合，推断时无需目标表达或OT计算。
AI.result: 在留出供体上Energy distance为0.129（scGen为0.144）；Seen 2/2下遗传均值表达L2误差2.261（scGPT-scratch为3.156）；留出化合物上条件平均药效相关性0.598（CellFlow适配器为0.561）。消融显示移除源上下文、以随机配对替代最优运输、或以静态残差回归替代流匹配均升高平均分布误差。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明公共源条件运输公式在留出供体、基因组合与化合物上具有预测效用。

title: Bridging the EHR Divide: Asymmetric Contrastive Learning for Cross-National Medical Representation Transfer
summary: Cross-system transfer of longitudinal Electronic Health Record (EHR) representations is challenging because clinical coding, patient populations, and healthcare workflows differ substantially across institutions and countries. We introduce Asymmetric Supervised Contrastive Learning (Asymmetric SupCon), a task-specific pre-training objective motivated by the heterogeneity of negative clinical outcomes. The objective clusters patients sharing a target positive outcome without explicitly attracting negative trajectories toward one another. We pre-train temporal Transformer encoders on longitudinal records from 3.98 million patients in the Taiwanese National Health Insurance Research Database (NHIRD) and transfer them to two U.S. EHR datasets, MIMIC-IV and EHRSHOT. A hybrid semantic mapping pipeline combining direct mappings with embedding-based retrieval enables transfer across heterogeneous clinical vocabularies. On MIMIC-IV, NHIRD pre-training consistently improves over random initialization while substantially narrowing the performance gap to task-specific in-domain pre-training. On EHRSHOT, the transferred models show particularly strong few-shot performance for incident disease prediction. A controlled objective ablation shows that Asymmetric SupCon achieves the best AUPRC on three of four evaluated tasks and is 0.003 AUPRC below Standard SupCon on the fourth. These results support asymmetric contrastive pre-training as an effective approach for task-specific cross-national EHR representation transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/qingYzhang/Asymmetric_SupCon.

AI.tldr: 提出非对称监督对比学习(Asymmetric SupCon)预训练目标，实现跨系统EHR表征迁移。
AI.motivation: 跨机构、跨国家的EHR表征迁移困难，原因在于临床编码、患者群体和医疗流程存在显著差异。作者注意到负性临床结局具有异质性，据此提出任务特异的预训练目标。
AI.method: 提出Asymmetric SupCon：将具有相同目标阳性结局的患者聚类，而不显式地将负性轨迹相互吸引。在台湾NHIRD（398万患者）纵向记录上预训练时序Transformer编码器，并迁移至美国MIMIC-IV与EHRSHOT。采用结合直接映射与嵌入检索的混合语义映射流程以跨异质临床词表迁移。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV上，NHIRD预训练始终优于随机初始化，并显著缩小与任务特异的域内预训练的性能差距；在EHRSHOT上，迁移模型在事件疾病预测上展现强小样本性能。受控目标消融显示Asymmetric SupCon在四项任务中的三项取得最佳AUPRC，第四项仅比标准SupCon低0.003 AUPRC。
AI.conclusion: 非对称对比预训练是任务特异、跨国EHR表征迁移的有效方法。

title: How Should Teachers Be Prepared? RL on Student-Induced States for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves the reasoning capabilities of small language models through token-level teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. Yet can teachers that excel at solving problems independently also guide student reasoning effectively? Prior work shows that when student prefixes follow reasoning paths that differ from the teacher's own or contain errors, teachers can be less accurate when continuing from these prefixes than when solving problems independently. To this end, we propose Prep-OPD, which uses reinforcement learning (RL) before distillation to train the teacher to adapt to the student's existing reasoning state and correct course when errors arise. Training optimizes teacher continuations from fixed student prefixes using final-answer correctness as the reward. The prepared teacher then trains the student through trajectory guidance and token-level supervision. We evaluate Prep-OPD on eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks, using Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as the teacher and Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B as students. With the 4B teacher and 1.7B student, Prep-OPD improves average accuracy over standard OPD and the strongest baseline, Relay-OPD, by 8.28 and 2.30 percentage points, respectively. Controlled experiments further show that teacher RL conditioned on student-generated prefixes yields higher student accuracy than problem-start teacher RL with and without handoff on Qwen3-1.7B. Reusing the same prepared teacher also improves Qwen3-0.6B.

AI.tldr: 提出 Prep-OPD：在蒸馏前用强化学习基于学生前缀训练教师，使其能适应学生推理状态并纠错，从而提升小模型推理能力。
AI.motivation: on-policy蒸馏依赖教师在学生生成的轨迹上做token级监督，但擅长独立解题的教师在学生前缀偏离其自身路径或含错误时，续写准确率反而不如独立解题，导致指导效果受限。
AI.method: Prep-OPD先用RL对教师进行准备训练：以固定的学生前缀为条件，优化教师续写，奖励为最终答案正确性，使教师学会适应学生当前推理状态并在出错时纠偏；随后用该教师通过轨迹引导与token级监督训练学生。
AI.result: 在8个数学推理基准上，教师为Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507，学生为Qwen3-0.6B与Qwen3-1.7B。4B教师+1.7B学生时，Prep-OPD平均准确率比标准OPD和最强基线Relay-OPD分别高8.28和2.30个百分点；受控实验显示，基于学生生成前缀的教师RL优于问题起点的教师RL（无论是否交接）；同一准备好的教师也提升了Qwen3-0.6B。
AI.conclusion: 教师独立解题能力强并不等于擅长引导学生推理；先以学生前缀为条件对教师做RL准备，可显著提升on-policy蒸馏中学生推理表现，且具备跨学生规模的可复用性。

title: EDISCO: Equivariant DIScrete Diffusion for Euclidean Combinatorial Optimization
comment: 45 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables, accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Euclidean combinatorial optimization problems (ECOPs), such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) and Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), possess inherent symmetries under the two-dimensional Euclidean group E(2), including rotations, reflections, and translations. Existing learning-based methods, including recent diffusion-based methods, rely on data augmentation or regularization to approximate E(2)-equivariance. This paper presents EDISCO, the first discrete diffusion model for ECOPs with exact E(2)-invariant generative distributions over node-index solutions. EDISCO introduces an E(2)-equivariant edge-score network coupled with a categorical continuous-time Markov chain over discrete edge variables, and exact posterior sampling provides efficient multi-step inference. This design gives EDISCO a local geometric inductive bias: edge neighborhoods with the same relative geometry and combinatorial context are represented consistently regardless of absolute position or orientation, making learning more efficient and inference more robust than non-equivariant methods. EDISCO outperforms previous learning-based state-of-the-art solvers on synthetic TSP from 100 to 10000 nodes and CVRP from 50 to 2000 customers, while using only 33-50% of the training instances. Trained only on uniform synthetic data, EDISCO also outperforms competing learning-based baselines under spatial distribution shift and CVRP constraint-tightness shift. Code is available at https://github.com/ValleyC/EDISCO.

AI.tldr: EDISCO是首个针对欧氏组合优化问题（ECOPs）具有精确E(2)-不变生成分布的离散扩散模型，通过E(2)-等变边打分网络与离散边变量上的分类连续时间马尔可夫链实现，在TSP和CVRP上超越现有学习型SOTA，且训练数据用量仅为33-50%。
AI.motivation: 欧氏组合优化问题（如TSP、CVRP）在二维欧氏群E(2)下具有旋转、反射、平移的固有对称性。现有基于学习的方法（包括扩散方法）仅通过数据增强或正则化来近似E(2)-等变性，未能精确满足该对称性，导致学习效率与推理鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: 提出EDISCO：首个对节点索引解具有精确E(2)-不变生成分布的离散扩散模型。核心设计包括：(1) E(2)-等变的边打分网络；(2) 离散边变量上的分类连续时间马尔可夫链；(3) 精确后验采样实现高效多步推理。由此获得局部几何归纳偏置：具有相同相对几何与组合上下文的边邻域表示一致，与绝对位置或朝向无关。
AI.result: 在100至10000节点的合成TSP和50至2000客户的CVRP上，EDISCO超越此前学习型SOTA求解器，且仅使用33-50%的训练实例。仅用均匀合成数据训练，EDISCO在空间分布偏移和CVRP约束紧度偏移下仍优于竞争的学习型基线。
AI.conclusion: 精确E(2)-不变性赋予EDISCO几何归纳偏置，使其学习更高效、推理更鲁棒；在多个规模与分布偏移场景下均优于非等变方法，代码已开源。

title: Trinity: One Differentiable Physics for Training, Refining and Scoring Generative Floorplanners
comment: Shih-Ying Yeh and Tzu-Sian Wang contributed equally. 85 pages, 65 figures, 67 tables. Project page: https://kohaku-lab.github.io/Trinity/ Code: https://github.com/Kohaku-Lab/Trinity Models: https://huggingface.co/KBlueLeaf/Trinity
summary: Floorplanning arranges the blocks of a chip and decides their shapes under objectives that press blocks together, short wirelength and a small outline, and constraints that hold them apart, non-overlap, clusters, MIB shapes and boundary blocks. Recent diffusion placers train on reference layouts alone and leave this coupled system to guidance, post-hoc loops and a legalizer, reporting only the endpoint, which hides what the generator contributes. We re-implement four of them under one recipe on FloorSet, score raw, refined and legalized layouts on one scale, and propose Trinity, a flow-matching floorplanner whose six differentiable functions for the constraints and objectives are its training loss term, the energy of a closed-form refiner after sampling and the base of a soft cost for every stage. The network thus learns the correction prior placers apply in their samplers, and sampling needs no guidance. Stage by stage, the training term lowers a plain transformer's raw soft cost by 26% and matters most at short budgets, the shared refiner decides more of the final cost than the generator and matches a ported placer's loop in 16 to 660 times fewer steps, Trinity's refined soft cost is 36% below the best ported pipeline, the soft cost ranks settings as the contest's hard cost does, and on the FloorSet val set the pipeline reaches a mean hard cost of 1.014 in 1.63 s per case.

AI.tldr: 该论文在统一实验协议下复现了四个基于扩散的布局器，并提出Trinity——一种基于流匹配的布局方法，将六个可微的约束与目标函数同时用作训练损失、采样后闭式精修器的能量函数以及各阶段软代价的基础，无需额外引导即可采样。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散布局器仅基于参考布局训练，将耦合的约束与目标交给引导、事后循环和合法化处理，且只报告最终结果，掩盖了生成器本身的贡献，难以分辨各组件的作用。
AI.method: 在FloorSet上以统一配方复现四个扩散布局器，并对原始、精修和合法化布局用同一尺度评分；提出Trinity流匹配布局器，其六个可微函数构成训练损失项、采样后闭式精修器的能量以及各阶段软代价的基础，使网络学习纠正先验，采样无需引导。
AI.result: 训练损失项使普通Transformer的原始软代价降低26%，在短预算下尤为关键；共享精修器对最终代价的贡献超过生成器，并以少16至660倍的步数匹配移植布局器的循环；Trinity的精修软代价比最佳移植流程低36%；软代价与竞赛硬代价排序一致；在FloorSet验证集上平均硬代价1.014，每例耗时1.63秒。
AI.conclusion: 统一评分与可微损失设计能清晰揭示生成器与精修器的贡献，Trinity通过流匹配与闭式精修在少量步骤内取得优于现有移植流程的布局质量，软代价可有效代理硬代价。

title: MAGIC: Topology-Aware Analytic Graph Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Graph few-shot class-incremental learning (GFSCIL) requires a model to continually recognize emerging classes from only a few labeled nodes while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Beyond the catastrophic forgetting inherited from conventional graph continual learning, GFSCIL presents two distinctive challenges: extremely limited novel-class supervision causes severe overfitting, while cross-session edges---edges connecting newly arriving nodes with historical nodes---alter historical propagation neighborhoods and thereby induce representation drift. We propose MAGIC, a replay-free GFSCIL framework that combines a frozen graph representation backbone (e.g., an intrinsically parameter-free backbone such as SGC or a pretrained graph foundation model) with closed-form analytic continual learning. To alleviate novel-session overfitting, MAGIC learns a topological prior from the base graph that can characterize both homophilous and heterophilous relations, and injects this prior through Potts Markov random field inference to refine supervision for novel classes. To mitigate representation drift, MAGIC transfers previous predictions from the old representations of affected historical nodes to their updated representations through drift-aware analytic distillation. Experiments across five datasets and eight baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of MAGIC. Under the 5-shot setting, MAGIC improves Mean Accuracy and Final Accuracy by 5.48 percentage points and 9.33 percentage points on average, and reduces Performance Drop by 10.78 percentage points on average compared with the best baselines. MAGIC also shows clear advantages under the 1- and 3-shot settings, with larger gains as the number of supports increases. Moreover, MAGIC requires substantially less training time.

AI.tldr: MAGIC：面向图小样本类增量学习的免回放框架，冻结图表示骨干+闭式解析增量学习，用拓扑先验Potts推断缓解过拟合、漂移感知解析蒸馏缓解表示漂移。
AI.motivation: 图小样本类增量学习（GFSCIL）除传统图持续学习的灾难性遗忘外，还有两大特有挑战：新类监督极少导致严重过拟合；跨会话边（新节点连接历史节点）改变历史传播邻域，引起表示漂移。
AI.method: MAGIC为免回放框架：冻结图表示骨干（如无参SGC或预训练图基础模型）+闭式解析持续学习。其一是从基图学习可刻画同配与异配关系的拓扑先验，并通过Potts马尔可夫随机场推断注入，以精炼新类监督；其二是通过漂移感知解析蒸馏，将受影响历史节点在旧表示上的预测迁移到更新后的表示，缓解表示漂移。
AI.result: 在5个数据集、8个基线上验证有效：5-shot下平均Mean Accuracy提升5.48个百分点，Final Accuracy提升9.33个百分点，Performance Drop平均降低10.78个百分点；1-shot与3-shot同样占优，支持数增多增益更大；训练时间显著更少。
AI.conclusion: MAGIC通过冻结骨干与闭式解析持续学习，结合拓扑先验Potts推断与漂移感知解析蒸馏，有效应对GFSCIL的过拟合与表示漂移，在精度、抗遗忘与效率上均优于现有基线。

title: One Token Can Be Enough: Bridging Prompting and Activation Steering with Prefix Steering
summary: Prompting guides language model behavior through the initial context, whereas activation steering often intervenes throughout generation. A natural question is whether steering can produce effects on subsequent computation similar to those of prompting. Under fixed-state attention assumptions, we establish sufficient conditions for single- and multi-token steering to match prompt-induced attention-head outputs, and characterize how changes in input representations affect this match and its approximation error. This attention-level connection leads us to ask whether, at the behavioral level, steering can also guide subsequent generation through a brief initial intervention. We study Prefix Steering, which applies existing steering directions and operators over a short span starting at the final prompt token, with no further direct intervention afterward. We examine how intervention duration and strength jointly shape the control-capability trade-off. Across four models and five tasks, intervention over a short span, even a single token, often retains much of full steering's behavioral control while better preserving general capabilities, offering a trade-off competitive with, and in some settings better than, prompting and alternative steering-strength policies. Prefix Steering also remains effective on final-answer formatting tasks after reasoning, suggesting that a brief initial intervention can influence behavior expressed well after steering ends. These findings challenge the common practice of steering every generated token and motivate a more dynamical view of activation steering, in which a brief intervention can alter the trajectory of subsequent generation without continued intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"Prefix Steering"，即在提示末尾少量token上施加激活引导后停止干预，发现短时干预常能保留大部分行为控制力并更好保持通用能力，提出激活引导的动态视角。
AI.motivation: 提示通过初始上下文影响模型行为，而激活引导通常在整个生成过程持续干预。作者追问：引导能否像提示那样，仅通过一次性/短时的初始干预来影响后续计算与生成行为。
AI.method: 1) 在固定状态注意力假设下，推导单token与多token引导匹配提示诱导的注意力头输出的充分条件，并刻画输入表示变化对匹配效果及近似误差的影响；2) 提出Prefix Steering，从最后一个提示token开始，在短跨度的若干token上施加既有引导方向与算子，之后不再直接干预；3) 考察干预时长与强度对"控制能力—通用能力"权衡的联合作用。
AI.result: 在4个模型、5个任务上，短跨度（甚至单token）干预常能保留完整引导的大部分行为控制，同时更好保持通用能力，其权衡优于或可媲美提示及其他引导强度策略；在推理后的最终答案格式任务上依然有效，表明短暂的初始干预能影响引导结束后才表现出的行为。
AI.conclusion: 研究挑战了"对每个生成token都施加引导"的常规做法，支持激活引导的动态观点：短暂干预即可改变后续生成轨迹，无需持续干预。

title: Priced Guidance: Can Language Models Generate Future Research Ideas?
summary: We evaluate language models' capability to generate novel research ideas through the lens of compression. We aim to lower-bound the potentially tiny probability that a language model generates the essence of a future research idea without any hints. Rather than estimate this probability through expensive repeated sampling, our Priced Guidance framework measures the compression cost: how many additional bits of information are needed to guide the model to recover the target idea. We prove that if the model can recover the target idea with at most K bits of guidance in expectation, then it can generate the idea without any guidance with probability at least $2^{-K}$. In our framework, the language model, called the generator, can pose a sequence of multiple-choice questions and specify a probability distribution over possible answers. A guide, which is a language model with access to the target idea, selects answers. If a selected answer has prior probability p, the generator pays $-\log_2 p$ bits. The generator aims to produce an idea that matches the essence of the target idea with minimal cumulative cost. This cumulative cost equals, up to an additive constant, the number of bits of information sent by the guide. Using this methodology, we evaluate five generator LLMs (Opus 5, Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and GLM 5.3) on the core ideas in 87 recent high-quality deep learning papers and we use LLM as judge to determine whether the generated idea matches the target in terms of the central research object and defining mechanism. Fable 5.1 achieves the lowest median compression cost at 69.9 bits, substantially lower than gzip's median of 5,712 bits for losslessly compressing the summary of the target idea. A uniform ensemble of Fable 5.1, Opus 5, and Astra further reduces the median compression cost to 55.8 bits and improves the generation probability lower bound by 18,000 times.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Priced Guidance 框架，通过"压缩成本"衡量语言模型生成新研究想法的能力，无需重复采样即可给出无提示生成目标想法的概率下界，并在 87 篇深度学习论文的核心想法上评测了五个生成模型。
AI.motivation: 评估语言模型能否自主产生新颖研究想法，其无提示命中某未来想法的概率极小，直接重复采样成本过高。作者希望用一个可计算、可下界的替代指标来刻画这种能力。
AI.method: 采用压缩视角：证明若模型能在期望不超过 K 比特的引导下恢复目标想法，则无引导生成该想法的概率至少为 2^{-K}。框架中"生成器"（语言模型）提出一系列多选题并给出答案的概率分布，"引导者"（可访问目标想法的语言模型）选择答案；若所选答案先验概率为 p，生成器支付 -log2 p 比特。累计成本（至多差一个常数）即引导者发送的信息量，生成器以最小累计成本产出与目标想法本质匹配的想法。
AI.result: 在 87 篇近期高质量深度学习论文的核心想法上评测五个生成器 LLM（Opus 5、Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol、GLM 5.3），以 LLM 作为评判者判断生成想法是否在核心研究对象与决定机制上与目标一致。Fable 5.1 取得最低中位压缩成本 69.9 比特，远低于 gzip 无损压缩目标摘要的 5,712 比特中位数；由 Fable 5.1、Opus 5 与 Astra 组成的均匀集成进一步降至 55.8 比特，将生成概率下界提升约 18,000 倍。
AI.conclusion: 压缩成本可作为衡量语言模型生成新研究想法能力的有效、低成本指标，并给出可证明的概率下界；集成多个生成器能显著降低压缩成本、提升生成可能性。

title: What Will Post-Training Fix? Per-Problem Gains Are Shared Across Independent RL Runs, and Existing Checkpoints Predict Them Better Than A Priori Signals
summary: Data selection, curricula and the evaluation of post-training recipes all assume that we can tell, before training, which problems a model will improve on. We test this assumption directly. For two base models, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, we evaluate eighteen post-training runs on up to 1532 competition math problems with many samples per problem, and compare signals available before training against a noise ceiling derived from the agreement between disjoint subsets of runs. Three findings hold on both base models. What post-training fixes is shared: independent runs agree on which rarely solved problems improve, with a noise ceiling of about 0.9, yet the two base models agree with each other only at rho=0.25 - the shared component belongs to the base model, not to the problem. A priori signals capture a minority of it: base pass rate, the likelihood of a correct solution, a larger model's pass rate and their combinations explain only 0.30 and 0.24 of the explainable variance in gains. Existing checkpoints are the better predictor: the per-problem gains of a single checkpoint from another family predict a new run better than every a priori signal, alone or combined (0.52 vs. 0.33 and 0.34 vs. 0.17 against the combined signals). The conclusions hold on problems from 2025-2026 competitions and when the baselines on the two sides of every comparison are estimated independently. We propose the noise ceiling as a standard companion to per-problem signals.

AI.tldr: 该论文直接检验"训练前即可预测模型将在哪些问题上提升"这一假设。基于两个1.5B基座模型、18次后训练运行与至多1532道竞赛数学题的大规模采样，发现可预测性存在约0.9的噪声上限，但先验信号只能解释少数可解释方差，而现有checkpoint的预测能力更强。
AI.motivation: 数据选择、课程学习与后训练方案评估均隐含假设：训练前就能判断模型会在哪些问题上进步。作者认为该假设缺乏直接验证，需要量化"问题层面提升"的可预测性上限，并比较不同先验信号与已有模型checkpoint的预测能力。
AI.method: 选取DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B与Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B两个基座模型，对至多1532道竞赛数学题（每题多采样）进行18次后训练运行。利用互不相交运行子集之间的一致性构造噪声上限（noise ceiling），并将训练前可获得的信号（base pass rate、正确解似然、更大模型的pass rate及其组合）与来自其他模型家族的单个checkpoint的逐题增益进行对比预测能力评估。
AI.result: 三项发现对两个基座模型均成立：(1) 后训练改善的是共享成分——独立运行对"罕见被解决的问题"哪些会改善高度一致，噪声上限约0.9，但两个基座模型之间仅rho=0.25，说明共享成分属于基座模型而非问题本身；(2) 先验信号只解释少数可解释方差——base pass rate、正确解似然、更大模型pass rate及其组合分别只解释0.30与0.24的可解释增益方差；(3) 已有checkpoint预测更优——单一异构checkpoint的逐题增益预测新运行优于所有先验信号（0.52 vs 0.33；0.34 vs 0.17）。结论在2025-2026年竞赛题目上、以及两侧基线独立估计时仍成立。
AI.conclusion: 训练前先验信号无法可靠预测逐题提升，模型已有checkpoint是更强的预测器。作者建议将噪声上限（noise ceiling）作为逐题信号评估的标准伴随指标。

title: How Long, Not How Close: A Learned Temporal Metric for Planning in Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models plan by rolling a frozen predictor forward under candidate action sequences and ranking the candidates by the latent distance between their imagined end state and the goal. However, this ranking breaks down when the goal lies several plans away, because the latent distance measures how closely an end state resembles the goal rather than how far it remains from reaching it. To address this, we propose TEMPO, a temporal-distance planning objective that leaves the world model untouched, learns only from the demonstrations already used to train it, and adds negligible cost to the planner's search. TEMPO learns a small map of the frozen latent in which the distance between two states of an episode reflects the number of environment steps between them, and blends this distance into the planner's cost. It requires no rewards, policies or success labels and, being a cost rather than a model, applies to frozen world models with one latent vector per state that plan by a latent distance. We evaluate TEMPO on eleven simulated environments (e.g., maze navigation, tabletop pushing, robotic arm control and three-dimensional manipulation) with the LeWM and PLDM planners. With a small MLP that adds at most 0.3% to a plan's arithmetic, TEMPO improves both planners at every goal distance, including the one-plan setting of their evaluations, raises LeWM from 36% to 99% on TwoRoom three plans from the goal, and remains competitive on a broad range of 2D and 3D navigation, reaching and manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出TEMPO：一种时间距离规划目标，通过对冻结世界模型的隐空间学习状态间步数距离并融入规划代价，解决多步目标下隐距离排序失效问题，在11个仿真环境中显著提升LeWM与PLDM规划器性能。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型通过将候选动作序列下预测的想象终态与目标做隐空间距离比较来排序，但该距离衡量的是终态与目标的相似度而非剩余到达距离。当目标需要多步规划时，这种排序会失效，导致规划性能下降。
AI.method: TEMPO是一种时间距离规划目标：保持世界模型冻结，仅利用训练该模型已有的演示数据学习。它在一个小型映射中学习冻结隐空间，使同一轨迹中两状态间的距离反映其环境步数间隔，并将该时间距离混合进规划器代价。无需奖励、策略或成功标签，作为代价函数而非模型，适用于每状态一个隐向量、以隐距离规划的冻结世界模型。
AI.result: 在11个仿真环境（迷宫导航、桌面推物、机械臂控制和三维操作）上，用LeWM和PLDM规划器评估。仅用一个增加不超过0.3%算术开销的小型MLP，TEMPO在每个目标距离上均提升两个规划器，包括其原评估中的单步设定；将LeWM在TwoRoom、距目标三步任务上从36%提升至99%，并在广泛的2D/3D导航、到达与操作任务上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 以时间距离替代相似度距离可有效修复冻结世界模型在多步规划中的排序失效问题，代价极低、无需额外监督，具有良好的通用性与即插即用性。

title: Pessimistic Minimax Learning for Public-Private Information Games under Unilateral Coverage
summary: We study offline learning in two-player zero-sum contextual games with public and private information, motivated by strategic settings such as auctions and negotiations with private valuations. We introduce unilateral prescriptive concentrability and show that asymmetric information can change offline coverage through its effect on equilibrium behavior. For finite state-action spaces, we develop a pessimistic algorithm with an $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$ exploitability rate, matching the standard sample-size dependence for fully observed minimax games. We further develop a pessimistic policy mirror descent framework, PPA-PMD, for general function approximation and obtain a unified $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n} + 1/\sqrt{T})$ exploitability rate with no-regret actor updates. Together, these results provide the first theoretical framework for offline equilibrium learning under public-private information constraints.

AI.tldr: 该文研究具有公开与私有信息的两方零和情境博弈中的离线学习问题，提出单边规定性集中性概念和悲观算法，在有限状态-动作空间取得 $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$ 可利用性率，并通过 PPA-PMD 框架推广到一般函数逼近，获得统一 $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n}+1/\sqrt{T})$ 可利用性率。
AI.motivation: 由拍卖、谈判等具有私有估值的策略性场景驱动，研究公开与私有信息约束下两方零和情境博弈的离线学习，弥补现有离线均衡学习理论在此类信息结构下的空白。
AI.method: 引入单边规定性集中性以刻画非对称信息通过影响均衡行为而改变离线覆盖的机制；针对有限状态-动作空间设计悲观算法；进一步提出用于一般函数逼近的悲观策略镜像下降框架 PPA-PMD，并采用无遗憾演员更新。
AI.result: 有限状态-动作空间下悲观算法达到 $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$ 的可利用性率，与完全观测极小极大博弈的标准样本量依赖相匹配；PPA-PMD 在一般函数逼近下获得统一的 $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n}+1/\sqrt{T})$ 可利用性率。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果共同构成了公开-私有信息约束下离线均衡学习的首个理论框架。

title: MetaKernelBench: Measuring GPU Kernel Knowledge Transfer Beyond Code
summary: Recent GPU kernel optimization agents retain what they learn in knowledge bases or as distilled skills. Kernel benchmarks score each attempt's implementation for correctness and speed but leave the reuse value of retained experience unmeasured. We introduce MetaKernelBench, which measures whether experience distilled from an attempt in one kernel domain-specific language (DSL) improves a fresh attempt at the same problem in another. Its 74 problems are fused subgraphs in six families, each posed as a pair of CuTe DSL and TIRx variants that differ only in the DSL. The agent first attempts each variant solo and is instructed to distill what it learns into a natural-language skill, which is transferred whether or not the source attempt passes verification. The skill is the only extra input to a skill-conditioned attempt by the same model in the other DSL. We compare each skill-conditioned attempt with the solo attempt on the same variant under matched per-attempt budgets, scoring correctness and end-to-end runtime. Across six models and both directions, paired lift over solo attempts ranges from -19% to +29%.
