Four models gain in both directions, yet regressions occur on 16% to 45% of problems in every model and direction. Outcomes follow the source attempt's result relative to the target's solo attempt rather than source success alone, improving in 71% of comparisons when the source stands above and regressing in 54% when it stands below. MetaKernelBench complements implementation-quality metrics by measuring same-problem cross-DSL kernel knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MetaKernelBench，用于衡量从一个内核领域特定语言（DSL）中提炼的经验能否迁移到另一DSL下求解同一问题的全新尝试，弥补现有基准只评估实现质量、不评估经验复用价值的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有GPU内核优化智能体将所学知识存入知识库或蒸馏为技能，但内核基准仅对每次尝试的实现给出正确性与速度评分，未度量所保留经验的复用价值。论文旨在填补这一空白，度量同一问题下跨DSL的内核知识迁移效果。
AI.method: MetaKernelBench包含74个问题，均为六个家族中的融合子图，每个问题以CuTe DSL与TIRx两个变体成对呈现，二者仅DSL不同。智能体先单独尝试每个变体，并被要求将所学蒸馏为自然语言技能（无论源尝试是否通过验证均进行迁移）；该技能是同一模型在另一DSL中进行技能条件尝试的唯一额外输入。在匹配的每次尝试预算下，将技能条件尝试与同一变体的单独尝试对比，评测正确性与端到端运行时。
AI.result: 在六个模型与两个迁移方向上，技能条件尝试相对单独尝试的配对提升范围为-19%至+29%。四个模型在两个方向上均有增益，但每个模型、每个方向上仍有16%至45%的问题出现回退。结果取决于源尝试相对目标单独尝试的表现，而非源尝试本身是否成功：当源优于目标时71%的对比得到改善，当源劣于目标时54%出现回退。
AI.conclusion: MetaKernelBench补充了实现质量类指标，通过度量同一问题的跨DSL内核知识迁移，揭示了蒸馏技能迁移收益的双向性与不稳定性，为评估智能体的经验复用价值提供了新维度。

title: Operational Abstractions of Neural Network Concepts via Topological Representations
summary: Concept-based methods provide a semantic level for interpreting and manipulating learned representations, but existing editing approaches are typically specialized to particular interventions and do not provide a common and editable representation of concept organization. To achieve this, we introduce Topological Concept Representations (TCR), a post-hoc operational abstraction that jointly characterizes the concepts encoded in a learned representation and their relationships. TCR constructs an intermediate concept space from concept recoverability and interaction scores, and compactly encodes its organization through topology. Interventions are expressed through modifications of this abstraction that are propagated back to the underlying learned representation. This allows different concept-level operations to share the same optimization framework and separates the desired concept organization from the mechanism to achieve it. We establish stability and reparameterization-invariance properties of TCR and its connections to existing concept-editing formulations. We use TCR to disentangle concepts as a preprocessing step for existing erasure methods, improving worst-group accuracy by 21.89 on average at comparable concept leakage. We further use TCR to transfer concepts from teacher to student models, improving concept recoverability by up to 5.54 while also improving or maintaining competitive test top-1 accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出拓扑概念表示（TCR），一种事后可操作抽象，联合刻画学习表示中的概念及其关系，通过拓扑紧凑编码概念组织，并将概念级干预统一到同一优化框架，实现概念解缠与跨模型概念迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有基于概念的方法虽提供语义层面的表示解释与操控能力，但其编辑方法通常针对特定干预专门设计，缺乏统一、可编辑的概念组织表示。因此需要一种通用抽象来同时刻画编码的概念及其相互关系，并将"期望的概念组织"与"实现机制"解耦。
AI.method: TCR 从概念可恢复性（concept recoverability）与交互得分（interaction scores）构建中间概念空间，并通过拓扑结构紧凑编码其组织方式。各类干预通过对该抽象的修改来表达，并传播回底层学习表示，从而让不同概念级操作共享同一优化框架。论文还建立了 TCR 的稳定性与重参数化不变性性质，并阐明其与现有概念编辑形式化方法的联系。
AI.result: 将 TCR 用于概念解缠，作为现有擦除方法的预处理步骤，在概念泄漏相当的情况下将最差组准确率平均提升 21.89；将 TCR 用于教师到学生的概念迁移，概念可恢复性最高提升 5.54，同时保持或提升有竞争力的测试 top-1 准确率。
AI.conclusion: TCR 提供了一种通用、可编辑的概念组织抽象，统一了概念级干预的优化框架，并具备稳定性与重参数化不变性；实验证明其在概念解缠与概念迁移任务上均带来显著增益，验证了该抽象的有效性与通用性。

title: Calibrated Weak Supervision for Post-Harvest Burned-Cropland Mapping Under Label Scarcity
summary: Mapping post-harvest burned cropland is difficult when fires are small and fragmented and reliable labels are scarce. We developed a calibrated weak-supervision framework for Punjab, India, using Sentinel-2 spectral change, VIIRS active-fire context, and MODIS MCD64A1 as a coarse external calibration and agreement reference. Three pseudo-label recipes, five feature representations, and linear, tree-based, boosted, and neural classifiers were evaluated using nested district-held-out cross-validation over three seeds and five folds. NBR and dNBR were excluded from classifier inputs. The best configuration used the very-strict recipe, a multilayer perceptron, and the full optical feature set (mean Cohen's kappa 0.395, AUROC 0.753, F1 0.747, balanced accuracy 0.703); Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM were practically tied. Higher agreement with held-out pseudo-labels did not establish improved label correctness or independent burned-area accuracy. For deployment, a Random Forest with the very-strict recipe and full optical features was retained. An externally calibrated threshold of 0.60 yielded district-level MODIS agreement of R-squared 0.636, a mapped-to-MODIS burned-area ratio of 1.005, and Spearman correlation of 0.779 with district fire counts. Pixel-level MODIS agreement remained modest (F1 0.205, kappa 0.093). Zero-shot transfer to Haryana was promising (mean kappa 0.641), but Punjab cross-year stability was weak, and Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 feature concatenation did not improve the optical baseline. Optical observations ended before the seasonal fire context, limiting coverage of late burns. The framework supports district-scale burden assessment and hotspot screening, with limited support for exact scar boundaries or temporally stable annual mapping.

AI.tldr: 提出一个校准式弱监督框架，用Sentinel-2光谱变化、VIIRS活跃火与MODIS MCD64A1作为外部校准参考，绘制印度旁遮普省小块碎化收获后焚烧农田；最优配置为MLP+very-strict配方+全光学特征（kappa 0.395），但仅支持区县尺度筛查。
AI.motivation: 收获后焚烧农田往往火点小且破碎，可靠地面标签稀缺，导致制图困难；需要一种不依赖大量人工标注、可外部校准的弱监督方法，用于区县尺度的焚烧负担评估与热点筛查。
AI.method: 在印度旁遮普构建校准式弱监督框架：输入为Sentinel-2光谱变化、VIIRS活跃火上下文，并以MODIS MCD64A1作为粗分辨率外部校准与一致性参考。设计3种伪标签配方、5种特征表征，比较线性、树模型、提升模型与神经网络分类器；采用嵌套的区县留出交叉验证（3个随机种子×5折）；NBR与dNBR被排除在分类器输入之外；部署时采用Random Forest+very-strict配方+全光学特征，并以外部校准阈值0.60进行判定；另做Haryana零样本迁移、旁遮普跨年稳定性及Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2特征拼接对照。
AI.result: 最优配置为very-strict配方+多层感知机+全光学特征集（mean Cohen's kappa 0.395、AUROC 0.753、F1 0.747、balanced accuracy 0.703），Random Forest、XGBoost与LightGBM表现基本并列。与留出伪标签一致性提高并不能证明标签正确性或独立的过火面积精度。部署模型在阈值0.60下：区县尺度MODIS一致性R²=0.636，制图/ MODIS过火面积比1.005，与区县火点数的Spearman相关0.779；像元尺度MODIS一致性仍偏低（F1 0.205，kappa 0.093）。Haryana零样本迁移较有希望（mean kappa 0.641），但旁遮普跨年稳定性弱；Sentinel-1与Sentinel-2特征拼接未优于纯光学基线。光学观测在季节性火情背景之前结束，限制了对晚期焚烧的覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可支持区县尺度的焚烧负担评估与热点筛查，但在精确火烧迹地边界刻画和跨年时间稳定制图方面能力有限；高伪标签一致性不等于更高的真实标签正确性或独立过火面积精度。

title: E$^2$-OPSD: Taming Entropy Overshoot in On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides dense token-level supervision without a second model: one network acts as teacher with the reference solution and as student with only the problem. We identify a specific failure mode of this recipe. During training, student token entropy rises past the teacher's and remains elevated, a pattern we call entropy overshoot. We trace it to both sides of distillation. The reference-conditioned teacher is confident along its answer-directed reasoning path, but this confidence transfers poorly to student-generated prefixes, making its supervision overly tied to answer-specific cues rather than reusable reasoning patterns; meanwhile, the forward KL used by OPSD continually diffuses the student's predictive distribution without pulling it back. We introduce E$^2$-OPSD to address both causes. Exemplar-guided teaching replaces the current answer with a retrieved solved neighboring problem, providing transferable reasoning guidance without revealing the destination and better matching student-reachable states. Entropy-aware distillation uses the student-teacher entropy gap to determine the direction and strength of each token's correction. E$^2$-OPSD improves math reasoning by up to 4.3 points in mean@16 over OPSD, while out-of-domain evaluations show gains over the corresponding base models of up to 4.9 points in mean@16 and 5.5 points in pass@8. Despite these gains, E$^2$-OPSD remains simple, requiring no additional forward passes or networks.

AI.tldr: 本文识别出在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中的"熵过冲"失效模式，并提出 E²-OPSD，通过示例引导教学与熵感知蒸馏两个机制加以修正，在数学推理与域外任务上取得显著提升且不增加额外计算。
AI.motivation: OPSD 无需第二模型即可提供稠密的 token 级监督，但存在特定失效模式：训练中学生 token 熵超过教师并持续保持高位（熵过冲）。作者希望定位该现象的成因并加以解决，以提升蒸馏的有效性与泛化性。
AI.method: E²-OPSD 包含两部分：(1) 示例引导教学，用检索到的已解邻近问题替代当前答案，提供可迁移的推理指导而不泄露最终答案，更好地匹配学生可达状态；(2) 熵感知蒸馏，利用学生-教师熵差决定每个 token 修正的方向与强度。
AI.result: 相较 OPSD，E²-OPSD 在数学推理 mean@16 上最高提升 4.3 分；域外评测相较对应基模型最高提升 mean@16 4.9 分、pass@8 5.5 分。
AI.conclusion: E²-OPSD 同时解决了教师监督过度绑定答案特定线索与前向 KL 持续扩散学生分布这两大成因，在无需额外前向传播或网络的条件下显著提升性能，方法保持简洁。

title: LogSig-SSM: Time-Series Modelling with Multi-Scale Log-Signature Compression for State-Space Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 2 figures, 15 tables
summary: Time-series data are often sampled irregularly at high frequencies and exhibit long-range dependencies, which makes long-horizon modelling difficult. Continuous-time models such as neural controlled differential equations (NCDEs) and neural rough differential equations (NRDEs) can handle irregular sampling, but they scale poorly to long sequences. Selective state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba scale linearly with sequence length, but they provide limited recurrent mixing across hidden dimensions within a single block. We propose LogSig-SSM (Log-Signature Compression for State-Space Models), which first compresses long multivariate time series into a shorter sequence of tokens using multi-scale windowed log-signatures, and then processes these tokens with a selective SSM backbone. LogSig-SSM is scalable and robust to irregular sampling, combining log-signature tokens that capture higher-order cross-channel interactions with a selective SSM that models long-range dependencies. The model also admits a continuous-time interpretation as an NCDE/NRDE-style system driven by a log-signature-based input, in which selectivity induces an input-dependent rescaling of the latent dynamics. Across four benchmarks, namely long-sequence classification on UEA, high-frequency physiological regression on PPG-DaLiA, multivariate weather forecasting, and irregularly sampled clinical prediction on PhysioNet Sepsis, LogSig-SSM outperforms or matches strong SSM and continuous-time baselines while training up to $30\times$ faster and using up to $37\times$ less GPU memory than Mamba on the longest sequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LogSig-SSM模型，利用多尺度窗口对数签名压缩长多元时间序列，并用选择性状态空间模型（SSM）主干处理压缩后的token，在保持对不规则采样鲁棒性的同时显著降低计算与显存开销。
AI.motivation: 时间序列常以不规则高频方式采样且具有长程依赖，导致长时建模困难。神经控制/粗糙微分方程（NCDE/NRDE）能处理不规则采样但难以扩展到长序列；选择性SSM（如Mamba）对序列长度线性扩展，但单块内隐藏维度的递归混合能力有限。因此需要一个兼具可扩展性、不规则采样鲁棒性及高阶跨通道交互建模能力的框架。
AI.method: LogSig-SSM分两步：先用多尺度窗口对数签名（log-signature）将长多元时间序列压缩为较短的token序列，token可捕获高阶跨通道交互；再用选择性SSM主干处理这些token以建模长程依赖。模型还可解释为以对数签名为输入的NCDE/NRDE式连续时间系统，其中选择性体现为对隐动态的输入依赖重缩放。
AI.result: 在四个基准上评测：UEA长序列分类、PPG-DaLiA高频生理回归、多元天气预测、PhysioNet Sepsis不规则采样临床预测。LogSig-SSM优于或持平强SSM与连续时间基线，且在最长序列上训练速度最高快30倍、显存占用最高减少37倍（相较Mamba）。
AI.conclusion: LogSig-SSM通过将对数签名压缩与选择性SSM结合，统一了高阶跨通道交互捕获与长程依赖建模，兼具连续时间解释性和对不规则采样的鲁棒性，在多个任务上实现更优性能与显著更高的计算效率。

title: Revealing After Overwriting: An Exponential POMDP OPE Lower Bound under History-Dependent Logging
summary: Multi-step revealing can make off-policy evaluation tractable under memoryless logging. With history-dependent logging, state decodability and target-relevant evidence can separate. For every horizon $H\ge3$, we construct two exactly realizable POMDPs with four actions, at most four states per layer, a known logger, and a memoryless target. Action overlap, history coverage, and observation-only revealing remain bounded independently of $H$, yet the target values differ by $1/2$ and the KL divergence between the logged laws is $Θ(4^{-(H-1)})$, forcing exponential sample complexity. Logger memory makes states distinguishable, while reset erases the model-distinguishing evidence preserved by the target. A separate construction retains this barrier with common, known observation-only revealing operators. Under action and history coverage, we give a finite-class OPE guarantee using common observable value representations that remain valid at every history. The sample bound depends polynomially on their second-moment cost. In the common-operator construction, the same value direction has constant marginal decoding cost but exponential history-conditioned cost. Finally, on a fixed four-action continuum, we derive matching passive and budgeted readout rates. With one known channel and unit read cost, early reads are optimal. With unknown sensor bias, early reads alone remain exponentially costly. Combining them with post-reset calibration gives sample complexity independent of $H$ when both read types receive fixed positive expected budgets per trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究历史依赖日志（history-dependent logging）下的离策略评估（OPE）可解性，构造了horizon $H\ge3$、每层至多四状态、四动作的可实现POMDP，证明即使动作重叠、历史覆盖与仅观测revealing均有界，目标值仍相差$1/2$且对数分布KL散度为$\Theta(4^{-(H-1)})$，导致指数样本复杂度；并在动作与历史覆盖条件下给出有限类OPE保证，以及被动与预算化读出的匹配速率。
AI.motivation: 多步revealing可使无记忆日志下的离策略评估可解，但历史依赖日志下状态可解码性与目标相关证据可能分离，导致揭示性指标不足以保证可评估性。作者希望刻画这一分离并给出充分条件与样本复杂度界。
AI.method: 构造精确可实现的POMDP族：对每个$H\ge3$，使用四动作、每层至多四状态、已知logger与无记忆目标，使动作重叠、历史覆盖与仅观测revealing独立于$H$有界；另构造保持相同障碍的公共已知仅观测revealing算子情形。在动作与历史覆盖下，基于公共可观测价值表示给出有限类OPE保证，样本界对二阶矩代价多项式依赖。并在固定四动作连续统上推导被动与预算化读出的匹配速率。
AI.result: 构造的两个POMDP目标值相差$1/2$，而日志分布KL散度为$\Theta(4^{-(H-1)})$，样本复杂度指数级；logger记忆使状态可区分，但reset抹除目标所保留的区分性证据。公共算子构造中同一价值方向边际解码代价为常数，而历史条件代价指数级。读出速率结果：一个已知通道且单位读取代价时早期读出最优；未知传感器偏差时仅早期读出仍指数昂贵，结合reset后校准且两类读出均获固定正期望预算时样本复杂度与$H$无关。
AI.conclusion: 历史依赖日志下，状态可解码性与目标相关证据可分离，常规覆盖/揭示指标不足以确保OPE可解；在动作与历史覆盖假设下可获得多项式样本界，而校准与预算化读出设计可消除对horizon的指数依赖。

title: Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides denser token-level supervision and better computational efficiency than Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). However, this denser supervision may introduce substantial noise and training instability. Existing improvements often rely on high-variance per-token statistics and introduce extra hyperparameters and trade-offs. Based on the advantage formulation in RLVR, we analyze the OPSD objective from the same perspective, incorporating outcome correctness signals. We find that vanilla OPSD imposes insufficient penalties and excessive rewards on incorrect trajectories because it applies a fixed divergence objective regardless of outcome correctness. Furthermore, the reliability of teacher supervision is associated with both trajectory outcome and the cumulative average teacher entropy along the rollout. Based on these observations, we propose Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation (OG-OPSD), which dynamically adapts both the divergence objective and distillation position according to binary outcome rewards and the cumulative average teacher entropy. Extensive experiments show that OG-OPSD consistently improves the performance of vanilla OPSD and multiple strong baselines in mathematical reasoning, multimodal reasoning, and out-of-distribution tasks across Qwen3 models at 1.7B, 4B, and 8B scales, as well as Qwen3-VL-2B.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation（OG-OPSD），通过结果正确性与教师熵动态调整散度目标与蒸馏位置，缓解 vanilla OPSD 的噪声与训练不稳定问题，在多任务多规模模型上稳定提升性能。
AI.motivation: On-policy self-distillation（OPSD）相比 RLVR 提供更密集的 token 级监督与更高计算效率，但这种密集监督会引入大量噪声和训练不稳定；现有改进多依赖高方差的 per-token 统计量，并附带额外超参数与权衡，缺乏对 OPSD 目标本身的深入分析。
AI.method: 作者从 RLVR 的 advantage 表述出发分析 OPSD 目标，引入结果正确性信号，发现 vanilla OPSD 因对正确性不敏感地施加固定散度目标，导致对错误轨迹惩罚不足、奖励过度；同时发现教师监督的可靠性与轨迹结果及 rollout 过程中的累计平均教师熵相关。据此提出 OG-OPSD，根据二值结果奖励与累计平均教师熵，动态调整散度目标和蒸馏位置。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，OG-OPSD 在数学推理、多模态推理及分布外任务上，于 Qwen3 1.7B、4B、8B 规模及 Qwen3-VL-2B 上，一致优于 vanilla OPSD 及多个强基线。
AI.conclusion: 将 OPSD 置于 RLVR advantage 视角下分析，并利用结果正确性与教师熵作为引导信号，可有效提升自蒸馏监督的质量与稳定性，OG-OPSD 在多种任务与模型规模上具备良好的一致性与泛化性。

title: Discrete Action Matching: Learning Stochastic Dynamics from Samples via State Graphs
summary: Learning population dynamics from unpaired temporal marginals is an ill-posed inverse problem that requires structural assumptions on the underlying dynamics. We introduce $\textit{Discrete Action Matching}$ (DAM), a finite-state counterpart of Action Matching based on discrete Wasserstein geometry. For a prescribed marginal path and transport geometry, we derive an action-minimization objective for its canonical minimum-kinetic-energy current. Our key observation is that the density dependence of the discrete action reduces to neighboring density ratios. Along an empirical interpolation of the snapshots, DAM first estimates these ratios and then learns an action potential. The learned fields also define a graph-supported Markov sampler. Experiments on controlled synthetic dynamics and real mouse gastrulation data evaluate marginal reconstruction and interpolation. Additional experiments approximate numerical surface-transport paths from paired samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出离散作用匹配（DAM），从非配对时间边缘分布中学习群体动态，通过离散Wasserstein几何将密度依赖简化为邻近密度比，先估计密度比再学习作用势，并导出图支撑的马尔可夫采样器。
AI.motivation: 从非配对的时间边缘分布学习群体动态是一个不适定逆问题，需要对底层动态施加结构假设；现有方法缺乏在有限状态空间下基于离散Wasserstein几何的规范构造。
AI.method: 提出Discrete Action Matching（DAM），即Action Matching在有限状态下的对应形式，基于离散Wasserstein几何。针对给定边缘路径与传输几何，推导其规范最小动能流的作用最小化目标。关键观察是离散作用的密度依赖可归结为邻近密度比；在快照的经验插值路径上，先估计这些密度比，再学习作用势，所学场同时定义图支撑的马尔可夫采样器。
AI.result: 在受控合成动态和真实小鼠原肠胚数据上评估边缘重建与插值；额外实验从成对样本近似数值曲面传输路径。
AI.conclusion: DAM为有限状态上的群体动态学习提供了具有理论依据的离散化框架，兼具边缘重建、插值与采样能力。

title: ReDiffNet: Differential RGB-Infrared Learning for Low-Light UAV Oriented Vehicle Detection
summary: Low-light UAV-based RGB-infrared oriented small-vehicle detection is important for nighttime traffic monitoring, emergency response, and urban inspection. Illumination variations, headlight glare, local shadows, and thermal-response degradation cause spatially varying modality reliability, while the small visual extent of vehicles further weakens boundaries, orientation cues, and thermal responses. Accordingly, selecting trustworthy observations based on local modality reliability while further exploiting complementary discriminative information in regions with ambiguous modality preference is key to constructing effective multimodal representations. Based on this insight, we propose ReDiffNet, a reliability-conditioned differential representation network in which modality reliability guides both evidence selection and complementary recovery. Specifically, degradation-aware reliability learning estimates relative spatial reliability, uncertainty-guided differential recovery exploits cross-modal differences to recover complementary cues in ambiguous regions, and reliability-conditioned reconstruction integrates retained and recovered evidence into a unified representation. ReDiffNet achieves 85.3% and 73.9% mAP50 on DroneVehicle and VEDAI, respectively, supporting its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出ReDiffNet，一种可靠性条件化差分表征网络，用于低光无人机RGB-红外定向小车辆检测，通过可靠性引导的证据选择与互补恢复提升多模态表征。
AI.motivation: 低光UAV RGB-红外定向小车辆检测对照明变化、车灯眩光、局部阴影及热响应退化敏感，导致模态可靠性空间异质；车辆视觉尺寸小进一步削弱边界、方向线索与热响应。因此需依据局部模态可靠性选择可信观测，并在模态偏好模糊区域挖掘互补判别信息。
AI.method: ReDiffNet包含三部分：退化感知可靠性学习估计相对空间可靠性；不确定性引导的差分恢复利用跨模态差异在模糊区域恢复互补线索；可靠性条件化重建将保留与恢复的证据整合为统一表征。可靠性同时指导证据选择与互补恢复。
AI.result: 在DroneVehicle上达到85.3% mAP50，在VEDAI上达到73.9% mAP50，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以局部模态可靠性为核心，联合证据选择与互补恢复构建多模态表征，可有效提升低光UAV RGB-红外定向小车辆检测性能。

title: How Execution Assumptions Change Short-Horizon Sharpe Rankings: Evidence from a Synthetic Trading Benchmark
summary: Backtests of LLM trading agents often assume that every order fills at the closing price. We ask whether this choice changes only reported returns or also the order of the agents. Five prompted LLM signal policies and seven classical baselines trade the same synthetic price paths under six execution settings, from near-ideal fills to latency, spread, participation, and impact stresses. The main experiment contains $2{,}462$ runs with matched decision frequencies and paired market paths. On the compressed two-asset board, agreement between the near-ideal and default-stress rankings falls to Kendall $τ_b=0.21$ in the high-volatility regime, compared with $0.82$ in the calm regime. The seed-bootstrap intervals, $[0.00,0.52]$ and $[0.48,0.94]$, are wide and overlap. On a fixed 11-policy board, agreement rises from 0.24 with two assets to 0.85 with ten; the two-asset point estimate differs substantially from the wider settings we tested. Rank changes are related to turnover, and comparisons with buy-and-hold also depend on how that anchor is initialized. The experiment does not compare LLM trading skill. It shows that, on a short horizon, an execution convention can become part of the benchmark's headline. Execution assumptions and rank stability should be reported alongside returns.

AI.tldr: 在合成价格路径上以6种成交执行设定、5个提示式LLM信号策略与7个经典基线进行2,462次配对实验，检验执行假设是否不仅改变报告收益，还改变策略排序。
AI.motivation: LLM交易智能体的回测常假设所有订单按收盘价成交，作者质疑这一执行约定是否仅影响报告收益水平，还是也会改变智能体之间的排序，从而影响基准结论的可比性。
AI.method: 5个提示式LLM信号策略与7个经典基线在相同合成价格路径上交易，设置6种执行条件（从近理想成交到延迟、买卖价差、参与率与市场冲击压力），保持决策频率匹配并使用配对市场路径，共2,462次运行；主要用Kendall τ_b衡量近理想与默认压力排序的一致性，并用种子自助法给出区间，同时在2资产与11策略固定面板上进行资产数量（2→10）的敏感性分析及换手率相关分析。
AI.result: 在压缩的两资产面板上，高波动状态下近理想与默认压力排序一致性降至Kendall τ_b=0.21，而平静状态为0.82；自助法区间分别为[0.00,0.52]与[0.48,0.94]，较宽且相互重叠。在固定11策略面板上，一致性随资产数从2增至10时由0.24升至0.85，两资产点估计与更宽设定差异明显。排序变化与换手率相关，且与买入持有基准的比较也取决于该锚的初始化方式。
AI.conclusion: 本研究不比较LLM交易技能，而是表明在短时间尺度上，执行约定可能成为基准标题性结论的一部分；因此执行假设与排序稳定性应与收益指标一并报告。

title: Direction-Conditioned Policies for Online Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CRL) learns representations that estimate goal reachability, yet its policy remains conditioned on raw goals and therefore does not directly exploit the geometry encoded by its critic. We introduce Direction-Conditioned Policies (DCP), a method built around a small modification to CRL: DCP selects previously visited states as waypoints during online training and conditions the policy on their direction and distance in representation space. At deployment, DCP applies the same interface directly to the final goal, requiring neither waypoint selection nor planning. Across nine navigation and manipulation tasks, DCP attains higher final success rates than CRL on seven tasks and spends more time near the goal on seven. Controlled maze experiments further show that DCP captures shortest-path geometry more accurately and that the supplied direction causally influences the actor's behavior. We identify waypoint coverage and ranking as limits to exploration, and show that learned candidate generation improves goal reaching in two controlled mazes.

AI.tldr: 提出方向条件策略（DCP），通过对CRL的小改动，将策略条件从原始目标改为表征空间中已访问状态的方向与距离，部署时无需路径点选择或规划，在多数导航与操作任务上优于CRL。
AI.motivation: 对比强化学习（CRL）学到的表征能估计目标可达性，但其策略仍以原始目标为条件，未能直接利用critic所编码的几何结构，导致表征与策略之间脱节。
AI.method: DCP在CRL基础上做小改动：在线训练时选取已访问状态作为路径点，将策略条件设为这些路径点在表征空间中的方向与距离；部署时直接将同一接口作用于最终目标，无需路径点选择或规划。另引入学习式候选生成以缓解探索受限问题。
AI.result: 在9个导航与操作任务中，DCP在7个任务上取得更高最终成功率，并在7个任务上花更多时间靠近目标；受控迷宫实验中，DCP更准确地捕捉最短路径几何，且所提供的方向对actor行为具有因果影响。方法局限在于路径点覆盖与排序对探索的影响，学习式候选生成在2个受控迷宫中提升了目标到达效果。
AI.conclusion: 将策略条件从原始目标改为表征空间中的方向—距离，可使策略直接利用CRL几何信息，提升成功率与目标邻近度，且部署简洁、无需规划；未来可改进路径点覆盖与排序以增强探索。

title: Advectra: Asymmetric Latent Transport for Non-Stationary Physics
summary: Many latent neural operators represent input and output fields in a stationary latent chart. In particular, common latent routing mechanisms use fixed or shared assignment weights for feature projection and reconstruction, limiting their ability to model transport-dominated systems where coherent structures move relative to fixed coordinate frames. We propose Advectra, a transport-aware latent operator that introduces a regularized kinematic coordinate map to decouple source and target coordinate systems. This yields an approximately co-moving latent reference frame and enables asymmetric feature aggregation and reconstruction. Combined with a geometry-aware ordering mechanism for state-space models, Advectra captures advective dynamics while maintaining stable global interactions. Advectra achieves the best performance among evaluated geometry-constrained and form-free baselines on advection-dominated benchmarks, including passive scalar transport in Navier--Stokes flows and Rayleigh--Taylor instability, while demonstrating strong generalization on real-world engineering tasks. These results highlight the benefit of explicit moving-frame structure in neural operators for non-stationary physics.

AI.tldr: 提出 Advectra，一种具有平流感知能力的潜在神经算子，通过引入正则化运动学坐标映射解耦源与目标坐标系，形成近似随动参考系，并结合几何感知排序机制，在平流主导基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在神经算子在固定的静态潜在图中表示输入输出场，其潜在路由机制采用固定或共享的投影与重构权重，难以建模相干结构相对于固定坐标系移动的输运主导系统。
AI.method: 引入正则化运动学坐标映射，解耦源坐标系与目标坐标系，构造近似共动的潜在参考系，实现非对称的特征聚合与重构；并结合面向状态空间模型的几何感知排序机制，以在捕捉平流动力学的同时保持稳定的全局交互。
AI.result: 在平流主导基准上（含 Navier-Stokes 流中的被动标量输运与 Rayleigh-Taylor 不稳定性），优于所评测的几何约束与无形式约束基线，并在真实工程任务上展现出较强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 在神经算子中显式引入移动参考系结构，对建模非稳态物理过程具有明显收益。

title: METRO: Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator
summary: State-of-the-art neural operators scale to complex meshes via slice-and-process architectures, yet many rely on linear compatibility scores for latent tokenization. Under common feature normalization, such scores are equivalent to isotropic Euclidean clustering, while without normalization they induce unbounded linear decision regions. In both cases, they lack slice-specific anisotropic locality, which can lead to redundant and entangled latent slices. To address this, we propose Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator (METRO), a geometry-aware routing mechanism that replaces linear projection with a learnable Mahalanobis metric. By enabling each latent slice to learn a local anisotropic tensor, METRO shapes receptive fields into exponentially localized, oriented ellipsoids that naturally align with flow features like boundary layers and wakes. As a drop-in replacement, METRO yields consistent improvements across both Transformer and Mamba backbones. Empirically, our method achieves substantial performance gains on irregular domains, outperforming baselines on both standard PDE benchmarks and complex industrial design tasks. Finally, METRO exhibits enhanced robustness in out-of-distribution regimes across varying Reynolds numbers and geometric configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出METRO，用可学习的Mahalanobis度量替代线性投影，实现切片特定的各向异性token路由，作为即插即用模块在Transformer与Mamba骨干上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子（如slice-and-process架构）在潜在token化时多采用线性兼容度评分：在特征归一化下等价于各向同性欧氏聚类，不归一化时又产生无界线性决策区域。两者都缺乏切片特定的各向异性局部性，导致潜在切片冗余、纠缠，难以贴合边界层、尾流等流动特征。
AI.method: 提出Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator（METRO），一种几何感知的路由机制：将线性投影替换为可学习的Mahalanobis度量，使每个潜在切片学习局部各向异性张量，从而把感受野塑造成指数局部化、方向性的椭球，与流动特征自然对齐。该模块可作为drop-in替换嵌入Transformer和Mamba骨干。
AI.result: 在Transformer与Mamba骨干上均取得一致改进；在不规则域上性能显著提升，在标准PDE基准与复杂工业设计任务上均优于基线；在不同Reynolds数与几何配置的分布外情形下鲁棒性更强。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入Mahalanobis度量实现各向异性、切片特定的路由，可有效缓解潜在切片冗余与纠缠问题，提升神经算子在复杂网格、不规则域及分布外场景下的精度与鲁棒性，且与现有骨干架构兼容。

title: Private Component-by-Component Learning
summary: We study differentially private learning problems in the realizable setting, where a hypothesis is specified by $k$ components. A direct iteration of private component learners is obstructed by a simple difficulty: an approximate choice of the next component may destroy exact realizability of the labeled sample, even when the next component is locally accurate. We restore realizability using the LabelBoost procedure of Beimel, Nissim, and Stemmer [SODA '15, Algorithmica '21] and recycle data through two alternating reservoirs. The resulting learner, for a target privacy $\varepsilon$, pays only $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$ overhead relative to the active sample requirement of a single component learning step at target accuracy $Θ(α/k)$. For learning $d$-dimensional halfspaces over a finite coordinate grid of size $L$, exact realizability makes the direct component-depth objective quasi-concave. Instantiating the framework with the IPConcave algorithm of Nissim, Tsfadia, and Yan [SODA '26] and with the quasi-concave optimizer of Cohen, Lyu, Nelson, Sarl'os, and Stemmer [STOC '23] yields a realizable sample complexity of $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon α}\cdot \min\{d^{2.5} \log^*L, \:\: d^{2.5} + d^{1.5} 2^{\log^*L}\}\right),$ which improves on the previously known bound of $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon α}\cdot\min\{\frac{1}α\cdot d^{5.5}\log^*L,\:\: d^{2.5}2^{\log^*L}\}\right).$ We also apply the framework to Boolean compositions: given proper private learners for classes $H_1,\ldots,H_k$, we obtain a proper private learner for $G(H_1,\ldots,H_k)$ for any fixed Boolean function $G:\{0,1\}^k\to\{0,1\}$. Compared with the closure theorem of Alon, Beimel, Moran, and Stemmer [COLT '20], this reduces the overhead on a common component sample bound from $\widetilde O(k/\varepsilon)$ to $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究可实现设定下的差分隐私学习问题，提出通过 LabelBoost 恢复可实现性并配合双交替蓄水池回收数据的学习框架，将隐私开销从 O(k/ε) 降至 Õ(√k/ε)，并改进半空间与布尔组合的可实现样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 在可实现设定下，假设由 k 个组件指定。直接迭代私有组件学习器存在困难：即使下一组件局部准确，其近似选择也可能破坏标记样本的精确可实现性。因此需要一种机制在不放弃隐私的前提下恢复可实现性。
AI.method: 利用 Beimel、Nissim、Stemmer 的 LabelBoost 过程恢复可实现性，并通过两个交替蓄水池回收数据。对于有限坐标网格上的 d 维半空间，精确可实现性使直接组件深度目标呈拟凹性，结合 IPConcave 算法与拟凹优化器实例化框架。进一步应用于布尔组合，构造 G(H_1,...,H_k) 的恰当私有学习器。
AI.result: 目标隐私 ε 下，相对单组件学习步骤（目标精度 Θ(α/k)）的主动样本需求仅需 Õ(√k/ε) 开销。半空间可实现样本复杂度上界为 Õ((1/(εα))·min{d^{2.5} log*L, d^{2.5}+d^{1.5}2^{log*L}})，优于此前 Õ((1/(εα))·min{(1/α)d^{5.5}log*L, d^{2.5}2^{log*L}})。布尔组合方面，将常见组件样本界上的开销从 Õ(k/ε) 降至 Õ(√k/ε)。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了可实现设定下差分隐私学习的通用框架，通过 LabelBoost 与交替蓄水池有效解决组件迭代中的可实现性破坏问题，显著降低隐私开销，并在半空间学习与布尔组合上取得更优的样本复杂度。

title: Best-of-$N$ Guidance for Test-time Diffusion Alignment
summary: Diffusion models achieve strong generative performance but often struggle to align generated samples with human preferences measured by a reward model. A simple yet effective algorithm for test-time alignment is Best-of-$N$ (BoN) sampling, which draws $N$ i.i.d. samples from a pre-trained diffusion model and outputs the single highest-reward sample. Despite its empirical success, BoN makes limited use of reward information, as it is incorporated only at the final selection stage without influencing the reverse diffusion trajectory during sampling. Consequently, BoN sampling does not improve the average alignment of generated samples and is primarily suited to single-output settings. We propose Best-of-$N$ Guidance (BoNG), a novel method that integrates the principle of BoN sampling directly into the reverse diffusion process. BoNG performs online BoN selection over denoising particles and adjusts the reverse diffusion process to steer the particle population toward higher-reward regions during generation. Specifically, by introducing an asymmetric guidance interaction among denoising particles, BoNG uses the current BoN particle as a guidance signal to the rest of the particle population. This particle-level interaction reshapes the sampling process toward higher-reward regions, enabling BoNG to improve not only the final best sample beyond Vanilla BoN sampling, but also the average quality of generated samples. Over 36 empirical comparisons, BoNG achieves the best performance in 29 cases, ranking first in 80.56% of the comparisons against SMC and Vanilla BoN sampling. BoNG also supports multi-output capability, achieving 1.3$\times$ ImageReward score of the latest sample-based guidance method with a 1.6$\times$ speedup. We release the code at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/BoNG.

AI.tldr: 提出BoNG方法，将Best-of-N选择原则融入扩散反向过程，通过粒子间非对称引导提升对齐质量与平均样本质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型生成能力强，但难以与人类偏好（由奖励模型衡量）对齐。Best-of-N（BoN）采样简单有效，但仅在最终选择阶段利用奖励信息，不影响反向扩散轨迹，因此无法提升生成样本的平均对齐度，且主要适用于单输出场景。
AI.method: BoNG在反向扩散过程中对去噪粒子进行在线BoN选择，并调整反向扩散过程，将粒子群导向高奖励区域。具体通过引入去噪粒子间的非对称引导交互，以当前BoN粒子作为其余粒子群的引导信号，从而重塑采样过程。
AI.result: 在36项实证比较中，BoNG在29项取得最佳表现，对SMC与Vanilla BoN的对比中排名第一的比例达80.56%。BoNG支持多输出，ImageReward得分为最新基于采样的引导方法的1.3倍，同时速度提升1.6倍。
AI.conclusion: BoNG将BoN原则嵌入扩散采样过程，通过粒子级交互提升最终最优样本与平均样本质量，兼具多输出能力与效率优势。代码已开源。

title: Bayesian Entropy-based Reordering for Calibrated Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) generate sequences by iteratively replacing masked tokens with model predictions. At each denoising step, the decoder chooses which positions are sufficiently confident to commit. Existing decoding methods typically rely on softmax confidence, which can be miscalibrated. We introduce BayesER (BAYESian Entropy-based Reordering), a post-hoc Bayesian decoding framework that uses predictive uncertainty to guide token commitment. In BayesER, we construct a lightweight approximate posterior centered at the pretrained checkpoint, similar to Laplace-LoRA but without training LoRA adapters. We average predictions over posterior samples and use predictive entropy to prioritize reliable positions. We examine how posterior predictions affect position ordering and token selection across benchmarks spanning code generation, mathematical reasoning, planning, and molecular generation. We show that BayesER reduces sequence-level calibration error while preserving or improving accuracy relative to common decoding schemes, including confidence-threshold decoding. Additionally, a posterior fitted on one code-generation dataset reduces calibration error on another without refitting, suggesting that Bayesian uncertainty may provide a transferable signal for more reliable MDLM decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出BayesER，一种基于贝叶斯预测熵的后处理解码框架，用于掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM），通过近似后验采样与熵排序提升提交位置可靠性，在降低校准误差的同时保持或提升准确率，并展现出跨数据集的迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有MDLM解码多依赖softmax置信度来决定提交哪些位置，但该置信度存在校准偏差（miscalibration），难以可靠反映真实预测可靠性，从而影响解码质量与校准。
AI.method: BayesER（BAYESian Entropy-based Reordering）：以后处理方式构建以预训练checkpoint为中心的轻量近似后验（类似Laplace-LoRA，但不训练LoRA适配器）；对后验样本的预测取平均，并用预测熵对位置可靠性排序，指导token提交顺序与选择。
AI.result: 在代码生成、数学推理、规划与分子生成等多类基准上，BayesER相较常见解码方案（含置信度阈值解码）降低了序列级校准误差，同时保持或提升准确率；且在一个代码生成数据集上拟合的后验无需重拟合即可降低另一数据集的校准误差。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯不确定性可为MDLM解码提供可迁移的可靠性信号，BayesER是一种无需额外训练、可即插即用且有效的后处理解码改进方案。

title: Component-Level Evaluation of Adaptive PINN Training for CFD-Oriented Crystal Growth Simulation
summary: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) training minimizes a weighted combination of partial differential equation (PDE), boundary-condition, and initial-condition losses. Because adaptive methods modify these weights during training, their weighted total losses are not always directly comparable. We compare fixed-weight PINN, gradient-normalized PINN (GNPINN), and a rule-based adaptive controller (AgenticPINN) under matched settings on a heat-equation benchmark and a simplified Czochralski-oriented thermal-fluid problem. In the crystal-growth MLP experiment, adaptive control reduced the PDE residual from the order of $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-6}$, while the boundary-condition loss increased from the order of $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-2}$. On the heat-equation benchmark, GNPINN achieved the lowest relative $L_2$ field error (0.054), whereas AgenticPINN obtained the smallest PDE residual but a relative $L_2$ error of 1.368. Gaussian-process surrogates were additionally evaluated using case-wise holdout tests on corrected Czochralski CFD parameter sweeps. The temperature-field error for the temperature sweep was approximately 6%, whereas the axial-velocity error for the crystal-rotation sweep was approximately 42%. These findings show that adaptive control can improve equation satisfaction while weakening other physical constraints. PINN training should therefore be evaluated using separate PDE, boundary-condition, and solution-error metrics rather than weighted total loss alone.

AI.tldr: 该文比较了固定权重PINN、梯度归一化PINN（GNPINN）与规则型自适应控制器（AgenticPINN），发现自适应控制可在降低PDE残差的同时恶化边界条件损失，强调应使用分项指标而非加权总损失评估PINN。
AI.motivation: PINN训练通过加权组合PDE、边界条件和初始条件损失进行优化，而自适应方法会在训练中改变权重，导致其加权总损失与其他方法不可直接比较，因此需要更公平、更细粒度的评估方式。
AI.method: 在热传导基准问题和简化的Czochralski定向热流体问题上，对固定权重PINN、GNPINN和AgenticPINN在匹配设置下进行比较；此外，用逐案例留出测试评估高斯过程代理模型在修正后的Czochralski CFD参数扫描上的表现。
AI.result: 在晶体生长MLP实验中，自适应控制将PDE残差从10^-5量级降至10^-6量级，但边界条件损失从10^-5量级升至10^-2量级；热传导基准上GNPINN取得最低相对L2场误差0.054，而AgenticPINN的PDE残差最小但相对L2误差为1.368；高斯过程代理模型中，温度扫描的温度场误差约6%，晶体旋转扫描的轴向速度误差约42%。
AI.conclusion: 自适应控制可提升方程满足程度，却可能削弱其他物理约束；PINN训练不应只依据加权总损失，而应分别报告PDE、边界条件和解误差等分项指标进行综合评估。

title: Hidden in the Comments: A Context-Injection Attack Surface in Code LLMs
summary: Code large language model (Code LLM) assistants generate code from heterogeneous development contexts, including open files, imported modules, pasted snippets, and comments, much of which may originate from untrusted sources. We investigate whether insecure instructions embedded in such contexts can steer Code LLMs toward vulnerable code without access to model weights or training data. We evaluate ten open-weight Code LLMs spanning 3B--13B parameters, including four base and six instruction-tuned models, across ten web-application weakness classes. We compare completion tasks containing insecure instructions embedded as code comments with benign tasks without malicious instructions. Attack-condition completions contained a medium-or-higher weakness in {\bf 77.4--92.3}\% of cases, compared with {\bf 1.7--5.1}\% in the benign condition. Base and instruction-tuned models averaged 86.5\% and 84.5\% vulnerable outputs, respectively; equivalence testing and three matched model pairs indicated reductions of at most 8.1\% after instruction tuning. Susceptibility showed no clear association with model scale or specialization. Among vulnerable attack outputs, 86.2--91.0\% were rated high or critical, and the effect persisted without the pattern-based detector. Post-generation screening reduced but did not eliminate the risk, the strongest screen leaving roughly one-third undetected. These findings identify inference-time context injection as a substantial attack surface and motivate provenance-aware training objectives.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究代码大模型在推理阶段被上下文中嵌入的不安全指令"带偏"生成漏洞代码的风险，结果表明攻击成功率极高（77.4–92.3%），且模型规模、专项化与指令微调均无法有效缓解。
AI.motivation: 代码LLM助手在异构开发上下文中生成代码（打开的文件、导入模块、粘贴片段、注释），这些上下文可能来自不可信来源。作者希望探究在无法访问模型权重和训练数据的情况下，嵌入上下文的"不安全指令"是否能诱导模型生成漏洞代码，从而识别推理阶段的攻击面。
AI.method: 评估10个开源权重代码LLM（3B–13B参数，含4个基座模型和6个指令微调模型），覆盖10类Web应用弱点。对比两类任务：将不安全指令以代码注释形式嵌入的补全任务 vs. 不含恶意指令的良性任务。采用模式检测器评估，辅以等效性检验和三对配对模型比较，并考察指令微调的影响及规模/专项化的关联。
AI.result: 攻击条件下77.4–92.3%的补全结果含中等及以上弱点，而良性条件仅1.7–5.1%。基座模型与指令微调模型平均脆弱输出率分别为86.5%和84.5%；等效性检验及配对比较显示，指令微调后脆弱率最多降低8.1%。易感性同模型规模或专项化无明显关联。在脆弱攻击输出中，86.2–91.0%被评为高或严重级别；去除模式检测器后效应依然存在。生成后筛查可降低风险但无法消除，最强筛查仍约三分之一漏检。
AI.conclusion: 推理阶段上下文注入构成重大攻击面。指令微调、模型规模与领域专项化均不足以提供稳健防御，生成后筛查也不充分，研究结果支持采用"来源感知"（provenance-aware）的训练目标。

title: Arithmetic Actor Heads and Training Stabilization for Out-of-Distribution Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies can deteriorate under out-of-distribution (OOD) magnitude shifts. Starting from soft actor-critic (SAC) and its Bayesian Amnesic Piecewise-Robust (BAPR) predecessor, we study the causal-symbolic BAPR (CS-BAPR) family. The practical method combines six training-stabilization settings with alternative actor heads: a Neural Addition Unit (NAU) with a Neural Multiplication Unit (NMU)-inspired quadratic correction, a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN), or a multilayer perceptron (MLP) with rectified linear unit (ReLU) or hyperbolic-tangent activations.

AI.tldr: 该研究在SAC及其BAPR前身基础上提出因果符号BAPR（CS-BAPR）家族，通过六种训练稳定化配置与多种actor头（NAU+NMU二次修正、KAN、ReLU/ tanh MLP）组合，应对OOD幅度偏移下的策略退化问题。
AI.motivation: 强化学习策略在分布外（OOD）幅度偏移下容易出现性能退化，已有SAC与BAPR方法仍存在鲁棒性不足。作者希望借助因果-符号结构提升策略在幅度变化场景下的稳定性。
AI.method: 从SAC与贝叶斯遗忘式分段鲁棒（BAPR）出发，构建因果符号BAPR（CS-BAPR）家族。实用方法将六种训练稳定化设置与备选actor头结合：带NMU启发的二次修正的神经加法单元（NAU）、Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN），以及使用ReLU或tanh激活的多层感知机（MLP）。
AI.result: 摘要仅说明所采用的方法组合，未给出定量实验数据或性能对比结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出CS-BAPR框架，通过训练稳定化与多种符号/神经网络actor头的搭配，有望缓解OOD幅度偏移导致的RL策略退化，其具体有效性有待实验验证。

title: Cross-Modal Contrastive Learning for the Retrieval of Immunotherapy-Associated Molecular Signatures from Histopathology
summary: Gastric Adenocarcinoma is a leading cause of cancer mortality. Although "Inflamed/Non-Inflamed" subtypes have been proposed to predict immunotherapy response, their identification relies on a costly 10-gene RNA signature. We propose a Cross-modal Contrastive Multiple Instance Learning (CCMIL) framework for cross-modal retrieval, imputing these molecular signatures directly from standard Hematoxylin & Eosin (H&E) slides. By leveraging a supervised contrastive objective, CCMIL aligns visual morphological patterns with molecular phenotypes into a shared latent space. This establishes an interpretable search-by-case retrieval engine, enabling pathologists to query a whole slide image to surface transcriptomically coherent neighbors and approximate RNA signatures without genomic sequencing at inference. Our results demonstrate that this retrieval-first approach captures the continuous phenotypic spectrum of tumor inflammation and yields clinically interpretable attention heatmaps. Furthermore, the learned representation also supports competitive downstream classification, providing a practical molecular pre-screening strategy.

AI.tldr: 提出跨模态对比多实例学习（CCMIL）框架，用H&E切片直接推断胃癌"炎症/非炎症"分子亚型，构建可解释的按病例检索引擎，无需测序即可近似RNA签名。
AI.motivation: 胃癌是癌症致死的主要原因之一。"炎症/非炎症"亚型虽可预测免疫治疗反应，但其识别依赖昂贵的10基因RNA签名，限制了临床应用的可及性与推广。
AI.method: 提出CCMIL（跨模态对比多实例学习）框架：基于多实例学习处理全切片图像，并采用监督对比目标，将视觉形态模式与分子表型对齐到共享潜空间，实现跨模态检索；推理阶段仅需H&E切片即可检索转录组一致的近邻病例并近似RNA签名。
AI.result: 该检索优先的方法能够捕捉肿瘤炎症的连续表型谱，生成临床可解释的注意力热图；所学表征在下游分类任务中亦具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: CCMIL为胃癌分子亚型识别提供了一种实用的分子预筛查策略，可降低对基因组测序的依赖，并为病理学家提供可解释的按病例检索工具。

title: Cross-Time Directional Selection in Diffusion Sampling
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures. NeurIPS 2026 AI for Stochastic Dynamics Workshop (poster)
summary:
How strongly do the remaining diffusion-sampling steps amplify a perturbation at a late latent state? Standard measurements answer this question with newly sampled isotropic noise, even though perturbations encountered during sampling have already been transformed by earlier steps. We compare these two cases directly. For each trajectory, we transport a centered perturbation from an earlier step to a late state, then replay its direction at the same magnitude as a newly sampled isotropic perturbation; both then undergo the same remaining
  updates. Across the samplers we study, median paired shaped-to-fresh angular-gain ratios range from $1.14$ to $2.35$. Shaped angular gain exceeds its matched fresh counterpart in every trajectory in the original main cohorts. The same pattern appears when endpoint change is measured by latent RMS. The effect also appears in perceptual feature representations: earlier-sampling directions cause larger feature
  changes at the endpoint, even when the corresponding pixel-space change is comparable. Permuting shaped directions across trajectories weakens the effect, including within class, indicating that the advantage depends on alignment with the receiving trajectory as well as on shared directional structure.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较了扩散采样中"经早期步骤变换后的扰动方向"与"新采样各向同性噪声"在剩余采样步骤中被放大的程度，发现前者（shaped）的角增益显著大于后者（fresh），中位配对角增益比为1.14至2.35，且在潜空间RMS和感知特征空间均成立。
AI.motivation: 标准测量用新采样的各向同性噪声来评估剩余扩散采样步骤对后期潜状态扰动的放大强度，但采样过程中实际遇到的扰动已被早期步骤变换过，二者并不等价。作者希望直接比较这两种情形，以更准确地刻画采样过程对扰动的真实放大行为。
AI.method: 对每条轨迹，将来自较早步骤的中心化扰动传输到后期状态，然后以相同幅度重放其方向，作为新采样各向同性扰动；两者随后经历相同的剩余更新。通过配对比较"shaped"与"fresh"扰动的角增益，并在潜空间RMS和感知特征表示中测量端点变化，同时用跨轨迹置换shaped方向作为对照。
AI.result: 在所研究的各采样器中，shaped-to-fresh中位配对角增益比在1.14至2.35之间；在原始主队列的每条轨迹中，shaped角增益均超过其匹配的fresh对应值。以潜空间RMS衡量端点变化时同样出现该模式。在感知特征表示中，早期采样方向在端点引起更大的特征变化，即使对应像素空间变化相当。跨轨迹置换shaped方向会削弱该效应，包括类内置换，说明该优势既依赖于与接收轨迹的对齐，也依赖于共享的方向结构。
AI.conclusion: 扩散采样中后期扰动被剩余步骤放大的程度，显著依赖于扰动的来源与方向对齐：经早期步骤变换的扰动比新采样的各向同性扰动获得更大的角增益与特征变化，且该效应依赖于与具体轨迹的对齐而非仅由共享方向结构决定。

title: Learning without Overwriting: A Theory of Self-Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning in Continual Reasoning
comment: main 11 pages, total 55 pages, main 2 figures, total 4 figures, 1 algorithm table in appendix
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) of large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated the ability to improve reasoning capabilities while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Despite substantial empirical success, the dynamics of OPSD in continual reasoning remain incompletely understood. Modeling LLM reasoning as search over a directed acyclic graph, we provide a unified theoretical analysis of both the dynamics of post-training---OPSD and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in continual learning---and the impact of pre-training on subsequent performance. Our findings establish three key insights with an optimization guarantee: (i) OPSD with hints from correct outputs enables continual learning without forgetting by sparse yet effective gradient descent updates induced by the hint structure. (ii) SFT on correct reasoning paths can lead to catastrophic forgetting due to dense updates along the training paths, which overwrite the information previously acquired. (iii) Diversity in pre-training is crucial for enabling a post-trained model to reach a correct output when a rollout starts from an intermediate state. Our results, supported by theoretical analysis, show that reliable continual reasoning depends on how post-training updates interact with the reasoning structure established during pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文将LLM推理建模为有向无环图上的搜索，统一分析了持续学习中OPSD与SFT的动力学及预训练的影响，揭示OPSD通过稀疏有效更新避免遗忘，而SFT因密集更新导致灾难性遗忘，并强调预训练多样性的关键作用。
AI.motivation: on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）虽在提升LLM推理能力同时保留已有知识方面取得实证成功，但其在持续推理中的动力学机制尚不完全清楚，缺乏对OPSD与SFT差异及预训练影响的理论理解。
AI.method: 将LLM推理建模为有向无环图上的搜索，在统一理论框架下分析后训练（OPSD与SFT）在持续学习中的动力学，以及预训练对后续性能的影响。
AI.result: 得到三个关键结论并具优化保证：(i) 来自正确输出的提示使OPSD通过提示结构诱导的稀疏而有效的梯度下降更新，实现无遗忘的持续学习；(ii) 在正确推理路径上的SFT会因沿训练路径的密集更新覆盖已获得信息，导致灾难性遗忘；(iii) 预训练多样性对于后训练模型在从中间状态开始rollout时达到正确输出至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的持续推理取决于后训练更新如何与预训练阶段建立的推理结构相互作用。

title: Ranking Bandits for Carousel Interfaces with Observable Browsing Depth
summary: Carousel interfaces allow a recommender system to directly observe how far a user has browsed. This signal distinguishes displayed but unclicked items from items that were never displayed, whereas conventional ranking-bandit models, including cascade and position-based models, generally treat examination as latent. We formulate a ranking-bandit problem in which a learner presents a list of $L$ items, observes the user's maximum browsing depth, and receives click feedback only for positions up to that depth. The objective is to maximize the expected number of clicks under an unknown item-attractiveness vector and a browsing-depth distribution. We propose three algorithms based on UCB, Thompson Sampling, and DMED, all of which update item statistics only from observed exposures. We derive an instance-dependent logarithmic upper bound for our UCB-based algorithm and an asymptotic upper bound for our DMED-based algorithm that coincides with the lower bound as its parameter $α\downarrow 0$, establishing asymptotic optimality in this limit. Simulations in synthetic shallow- and deep-browsing environments, together with experiments parameterized from RecGaze interaction logs, show that OD-TS attains final mean regret similar to PBM-TS, while the proposed methods achieve lower final mean regret than PBM-UCB.

AI.tldr: 本文将轮播界面的最大浏览深度作为可观测曝光信号，建立新的排序赌博机模型，并提出UCB、TS、DMED三种算法，理论上给出对数遗憾上界及DMED渐近最优性，实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统排序赌博机（如级联模型、位置模型）通常将用户是否"查看"某物品视为潜在变量，无法区分"已展示但未点击"与"从未展示"的物品。而轮播界面允许系统直接观测用户浏览的最大深度，从而提供更精确的曝光信息。作者希望利用这一额外可观测信号，设计更高效的推荐算法并刻画其理论性能。
AI.method: 作者将问题形式化为排序赌博机：学习者在每轮展示包含L个物品的列表，观测用户的最大浏览深度，并仅获得深度范围内位置的点击反馈。目标是最大化在未知物品吸引力向量和浏览深度分布下的期望点击数。基于此，提出三种算法：UCB型、Thompson Sampling型和DMED型，均只利用已观测曝光来更新物品统计量。
AI.result: 理论上，UCB型算法获得依赖于具体实例的对数上界；DMED型算法获得渐近上界，当参数α趋于0时与下界吻合，从而实现该极限下的渐近最优性。实验方面，在合成浅浏览与深浏览环境，以及基于RecGaze交互日志参数化的实验中，OD-TS取得与PBM-TS相近的最终平均遗憾，而所提方法均优于PBM-UCB。
AI.conclusion: 利用轮播界面可观测的浏览深度信号可有效改进排序赌博机推荐，所提算法在理论与实验上均表现出竞争力，尤其DMED在特定极限下达到渐近最优。

title: EMG-GPT: Predictive Pretraining on Residual-Quantized EMG Tokens for Hand Pose Estimation
summary: Surface electromyography (sEMG) is a low-power, cost-effective biosignal for hand-pose estimation and gesture classification. In this work, we examine whether self-supervised pretraining on sEMG can yield transferable representations for continuous hand-pose estimation. We introduce EMG-GPT, a causal transformer-based model that operates on discrete sEMG representations from a frozen residual vector quantization (RVQ) tokenizer and learns temporal dynamics through depth-autoregressive future-code prediction. The model combines within-frame integration with causal temporal modeling while preserving the geometry of the pretrained codebook. EMG-GPT shows competitive results in both Regression and Tracking tasks, supporting EMG-only pretraining as a viable approach for learning transferable sEMG representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EMG-GPT，一种基于因果 Transformer 的自监督模型，在冻结的 RVQ 离散表征上通过深度自回归预测未来码本，实现可迁移的 sEMG 连续手势估计。
AI.motivation: sEMG 是低成本、低功耗的生物信号，适用于手势估计与分类；作者探究自监督预训练能否为连续手势估计学习到可迁移表征，以缓解标注数据稀缺问题。
AI.method: 采用冻结的残差向量量化（RVQ）分词器将 sEMG 转为离散表征；构建因果 Transformer（EMG-GPT），通过深度自回归未来码预测学习时序动态；融合帧内集成与因果时序建模，同时保持预训练码本的几何结构。
AI.result: 在回归（Regression）与跟踪（Tracking）两类任务上均取得有竞争力的结果，验证了纯 EMG 自监督预训练可获得可迁移表征。
AI.conclusion: EMG-only 预训练是学习可迁移 sEMG 表征的有效途径，EMG-GPT 为连续手势估计提供了可行方案。

title: Pythia: Toward Foundation World Models for Multimodal Time Series
summary: Time-series foundation models offer a unified approach to forecasting across heterogeneous domains. Textual context and auxiliary observations provide complementary information about temporal dynamics, yet reusable multimodal predictive representations remain underexplored. We introduce Pythia, a foundation world model that learns context-conditioned latent dynamics across datasets through a joint-embedding predictive architecture. A stop-gradient numerical reference guides contextual corrections to predicted future states. A separate probabilistic decoder then adapts to the frozen predictive representation and observed history, decoupling world-model pretraining from observation-space forecasting. On MUSE, Pythia-Tiny's normalized mean absolute scaled error (MASE) and weighted sum quantile loss (WSQL) are 0.6879 and 0.4269, reducing errors by 6.26% and 5.00% relative to the strongest model evaluated in the published MUSE leaderboard. Through a series of controlled experiments, we investigate how to design a time-series world model through shared pretraining and how joint-embedding predictive learning can incorporate multimodal information. The results support separating predictive representation learning from probabilistic readout and show complementary contributions from entity descriptions, events, and covariates.

AI.tldr: 提出 Pythia，一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的时间序列基础世界模型，通过共享预训练学习上下文条件化的潜在动力学，并将预测表征学习与概率解码解耦。在 MUSE 上 MASE 0.6879、WSQL 0.4269，相较榜单最强模型分别降低 6.26% 和 5.00%。实验支持将预测表征与概率读出分离，并显示实体描述、事件与协变量的互补贡献。
AI.motivation: 异构领域的时间序列预测需要统一方法；文本上下文与辅助观测能提供关于时序动力学的互补信息，但可复用的多模态预测表征仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: Pythia 采用 joint-embedding predictive architecture，跨数据集学习上下文条件化的潜在动力学。引入带 stop-gradient 的数值参考，引导对预测未来状态的上下文修正；另设独立的概率解码器，在冻结的预测表征与观测历史上自适应，从而将世界模型预训练与观测空间预测解耦。并通过一系列控制实验分析共享预训练与多模态信息融入 JEPA 的设计。
AI.result: MUSE 上 Pythia-Tiny 的 MASE 为 0.6879、WSQL 为 0.4269，相较已公布 MUSE 排行榜中被评估的最强模型，误差分别降低 6.26% 与 5.00%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将预测表征学习与概率读出分离的设计，并表明实体描述、事件与协变量对预测具有互补贡献。

title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Personal Context Recognition on ExtraSensory
summary: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) have attracted increasing attention in recent years, with applications across a wide range of AI tasks. In this paper, we evaluate several KAN variants on the ExtraSensory dataset for personal context recognition and compare them with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and TabM. We conduct the main experiments using five user folds and three random seeds per fold and report the average Macro-F1, Micro-F1, and training time. We also perform shallow ablation studies on grid size, the number of grids, and data normalization to examine their effects on KAN performance. The results show that all evaluated KAN variants significantly outperform MLP in terms of Macro-F1 and Micro-F1 and achieve performance comparable to TabM. However, KAN variants generally require more training time, while TabM provides a more favorable balance between predictive performance and training efficiency. These results suggest that KANs are promising for personal context recognition, while their computational efficiency remains an important challenge. Our source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/hoangthangta/ExtraSensory-KANs.

AI.tldr: 本文在ExtraSensory个人情境识别数据集上评测多种KAN变体，并与MLP和TabM对比，发现KAN在F1指标上显著优于MLP、与TabM相当，但训练时间更长。
AI.motivation: KANs近年来在多种AI任务中受到关注，但其在个人情境识别任务上的适用性与效率尚缺乏系统评估，因此需要与成熟基线（MLP、TabM）进行对比研究。
AI.method: 在ExtraSensory数据集上评测多种KAN变体，并与MLP和TabM比较。主实验采用五个用户折、每折三个随机种子，报告平均Macro-F1、Micro-F1和训练时间；并对网格大小、网格数量和数据归一化进行浅层消融实验。
AI.result: 所有评测的KAN变体在Macro-F1和Micro-F1上显著优于MLP，性能与TabM相当；但KAN通常需要更长训练时间，TabM在预测性能与训练效率间平衡更佳。
AI.conclusion: KANs在个人情境识别中具有潜力，但计算效率仍是其重要挑战。代码已开源。

title: Loopy: Low-Bit Quantization Framework for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models provide a parameter-efficient way to scale iterative test-time computation by repeatedly executing a shared recurrent core. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce the memory footprint and inference cost of looped language models, but errors introduced by a quantized shared core affect subsequent cores. Among PTQ methods, channel scaling and orthogonal rotations preserve the floating-point computation while producing representations with different quantization quality. We find that quantization configuration candidate rankings can change with recurrent depth, motivating configuration selection at the target deployment depth. However, evaluating every candidate over the full calibration set at this depth is costly. We therefore propose Loopy, a PTQ framework that formulates shared-core quantization through a recurrent-depth-aware objective, selecting shared low-bit representations by their final prediction loss at the target deployment depth. Channel scaling and orthogonal rotations parameterize the candidate representations. To approximately solve this selection problem efficiently, Loopy progressively allocates calibration windows to promising candidates while preserving complete target-depth execution, using only forward evaluations. Across eight settings, Loopy achieves the state-of-the-art results among different baselines. On Ouro-1.4B under W4A4, Loopy reduces LAMBADA perplexity by 36.5% relative to SpinQuant. Our code is available at https://github.com/Shameless0817/Loopy-review.git.

AI.tldr: Loopy：面向循环语言模型训练后量化的循环深度感知框架，在目标部署深度选择共享低比特表示，八个设置达SOTA，W4A4下Ouro-1.4B的LAMBADA困惑度较SpinQuant降36.5%。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型通过反复执行共享循环核心，以参数高效的方式扩展迭代式测试时计算；PTQ可降低其显存与推理开销，但量化共享核心引入的误差会向后传播并叠加。作者发现量化配置候选排序会随循环深度变化，因此必须在目标部署深度进行配置选择，而逐一评估全部候选代价高昂。
AI.method: 提出Loopy框架：以循环深度感知目标建模共享核心量化，按目标部署深度上的最终预测损失选择共享低比特表示；候选表示由通道缩放与正交旋转参数化。为高效近似求解，Loopy仅用前向评估，逐步将校准窗口分配给有潜力的候选，同时保持完整的目标深度执行。
AI.result: 在八个设置中均取得优于各基线的最先进结果；在Ouro-1.4B的W4A4设定下，Loopy将LAMBADA困惑度相对SpinQuant降低36.5%。
AI.conclusion: 量化配置的优劣排序依赖循环深度，针对目标部署深度进行选择可显著提升循环语言模型的PTQ效果；Loopy以低成本的前向校准窗口分配实现该选择，验证了深度感知目标的有效性。

title: A Unified Scaling Law for Time Series Foundation Models
summary: We develop a Unified Scaling Law and a Unified Theory of Time Series Learning to understand how model capacity and historical information support forecasting. Across different lookback lengths and forecast horizons, we analyze 18,768 experimental cells from 21 checkpoints on 23 dataset-frequency tasks spanning six domains. Our empirical methodology integrates local resource relations into a parsimonious, fitted five-parameter law: capacity gains increase with history, context gains diminish toward saturation, and horizon effects enter as a common shift. Fitted without Toto 2.0, the law predicts its horizon-averaged capacity-scaling curves with mean absolute percentage errors of 1.09% and 1.50% at input lengths 2048 and 4096. To understand how history supports prediction, our learning theory uses Gaussian regression to analyze rule identification and predictive capability. We hypothesize that full-shot models learn by accumulating information in weights, while frozen time series foundation models (TSFMs) use history by extracting information through activations. Matched-history comparisons establish the predictive value of additional history. Controlled parameter exchanges and activation interventions provide evidence that history-derived rule information can be retained, reused across queries, and used to recover a contribution to long-context prediction. Together, these findings inform capacity scaling, context allocation, and the development of models that retain and apply historical rules. Code and main results are available at https://github.com/Fifthky/UniScale.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出统一缩放律与时间序列学习理论，基于23个数据集频率任务、21个检查点、18,768个实验单元，用五参数拟合律刻画容量、历史与预测步长的关系，并以高斯回归理论解释历史信息的作用机制。
AI.motivation: 理解模型容量与历史信息如何共同支撑时间序列预测，特别是全样本训练模型与冻结时间序列基础模型（TSFM）利用历史方式的差异。
AI.method: 在多种回看长度与预测视野下分析18,768个实验单元（21个检查点、23个数据集频率任务、六个领域）；将局部资源关系整合为五参数拟合的统一缩放律；用量化高斯回归的学习理论分析规则识别与预测能力；开展匹配历史对比、受控参数交换与激活干预实验。
AI.result: 未用Toto 2.0拟合的缩放律在输入长度2048与4096下预测其视野平均容量缩放曲线，平均绝对百分比误差分别为1.09%与1.50%；匹配历史对比验证了额外历史的预测价值；参数交换与激活干预表明历史导出的规则信息可被保留、跨查询复用并恢复对长上下文预测的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 全样本模型通过学习将信息累积在权重中，而冻结TSFM通过激活提取历史信息；研究结果为容量缩放、上下文分配以及保留并应用历史规则的模型开发提供指导，代码与主要结果已公开。

title: Fast Convergence through Distributed Augmentation for Class-Imbalanced Federated Learning
summary: In federated learning, mitigating class imbalance is essential to improve minority-class performance. A common approach to address this problem is to augment minority-class samples to achieve local class balance. Existing approaches treat augmentation as a heuristic and do not establish how the amount of augmentation influences the convergence of federated learning, leading to excessive augmentation and increased training time. To address this limitation, we first establish the relationship between augmentation and the convergence behavior of federated learning. Leveraging this insight, we propose DAFL, a distributed augmentation framework that determines the minimum augmentation required for each client-class pair by jointly minimizing augmentation and training time while constraining global class imbalance, thereby improving minority-class F1-score. Experimental results demonstrate that DAFL consistently improves minority-class F1-score while substantially reducing training time, particularly under severe global class imbalance and high label proportion imbalance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAFL，通过建立数据增强量与联邦学习收敛性的关系，求解每个客户端-类别对所需的最小增强量，在缓解全局类别不平衡的同时缩短训练时间。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中的类别不平衡会损害少数类性能。现有方法将少数类样本增强视为启发式手段，未刻画增强量与收敛行为的关系，导致过度增强与训练时间增加。
AI.method: 首先分析并建立增强量与联邦学习收敛行为之间的定量关系；基于该结论提出DAFL分布式增强框架，通过联合最小化增强量与训练时间、并约束全局类别不平衡，为每个客户端-类别对确定所需的最小增强量。
AI.result: 实验表明，DAFL在持续提升少数类F1分数的同时显著减少训练时间，在严重的全局类别不平衡和高标签比例不平衡条件下效果尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 将增强量纳入收敛性分析可为联邦学习不平衡问题提供更高效的增强策略，兼顾性能提升与训练开销降低。

title: Smoothed Gradient Method for Nonconvex Federated Stochastic Bilevel Optimization
summary: In recent years, federated stochastic bilevel optimization has attracted increasing attention due to its wide range of applications in machine learning. To reduce the computational overhead associated with second-order Hessian and Jacobian matrices, several first-order methods have been proposed. However, existing methods typically impose restrictive assumptions on the lower-level function, suffer from a strong dependence on the condition number in their convergence rates, and require different learning-rate scales for variables across the upper- and lower-level problems, limiting their practical applicability and complicating hyperparameter tuning. To address these challenges, we propose a stochastic doubly smoothed gradient method for nonconvex federated stochastic bilevel optimization problems, which decouples the learning rates of upper- and lower-level variables and does not require a strongly-convex lower-level loss function. We establish rigorous theoretical guarantees for the proposed algorithm, demonstrating an improved convergence rate of $O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)$ and a communication complexity of $O(κ^{4}/ε^3)$, where $κ$ denotes the condition number and $ε$ represents the solution accuracy. Notably, these bounds exhibit significantly better dependence on the condition number $κ$ than those of existing methods. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our algorithm.

AI.tldr: 提出随机双平滑梯度方法（stochastic doubly smoothed gradient method）求解非凸联邦随机双层优化，解耦上下层学习率且不要求下层强凸，收敛率 $O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)$，通信复杂度 $O(κ^{4}/ε^3)$，对条件数 $κ$ 的依赖显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 联邦随机双层优化在机器学习中应用广泛，但其二阶 Hessian/Jacobian 计算开销大。现有的一阶方法存在三大局限：（1）对下层函数施加较强假设（如强凸性）；（2）收敛率对条件数 $κ$ 依赖过强；（3）上下层变量需要不同的学习率尺度，导致超参数调优困难、实用受限。
AI.method: 提出随机双平滑梯度方法（stochastic doubly smoothed gradient method）：通过双重平滑机制处理非凸联邦双层优化，解耦上下层变量的学习率，且不要求下层损失函数强凸，从而放宽假设并简化调参。
AI.result: 理论上给出严格收敛保证：收敛率为 $O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)$，通信复杂度为 $O(κ^{4}/ε^3)$（$κ$ 为条件数，$ε$ 为求解精度）；对条件数 $κ$ 的依赖明显优于现有方法。大量实验验证了算法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在放宽下层函数假设、解耦学习率的同时，改善了条件数依赖，为非凸联邦随机双层优化提供了更实用、高效的解决方案，理论与实验均得到支持。

title: Erased, Rerouted, or Rescaled? Post-Training and the Causal Quotient of a Language Model's Belief State
summary: What happens to information a pretrained model already encodes when post-training no longer rewards using it? The common language of representation compression conflates three fates: information may be erased, rerouted away from the decision while still represented, or rescaled to occupy less variance while still represented and used. We make these fates identifiable in models whose pretraining recovers Bayesian belief states. A reward that reads only a coarse function of the hidden state defines an exact reward-null kernel. The kernel lets us separately measure whether the information remains recoverable, whether decisions causally depend on it, and how much activation variance it occupies. Theory says what is protected: KL-anchored reinforcement learning preserves the reference policy's log-odds among equally rewarded outputs, supervised and unanchored objectives carry no such constraint, and spectral compression implies neither erasure nor loss of use. In controlled worlds, post-training mostly reroutes or rescales reward-null information and leaves it decodable. Without an anchor decisions can stop using it although the representation survives, and with one they keep using it. Erasure appears only under prolonged weight decay, for distinctions that neither reward nor next-token prediction can see. Open language models show the same dissociation: in-context belief geometry stays decodable under late-layer spectral compression, and within-class behavior depends on the anchor. Post-training thus selects a causal quotient of the pretrained belief state: the reward defines decision-equivalence, the anchor and the state update protect part of what it ignores, and optimization decides whether the rest is erased, rerouted, or rescaled.

AI.tldr: 该文将"后训练中被奖励忽略的信息"的命运拆解为三种可识别形式：被擦除、被改道（仍表征但不再因果参与决策）、被缩放（方差减小但仍被表征和使用），并通过"奖励零核"在贝叶斯信念状态可识别的模型中分别测量这三种命运，理论加实验表明后训练主要造成改道与缩放而非擦除。
AI.motivation: 既有关于"表征压缩"的普遍说法把信息被擦除、被改道离开决策以及与仍被使用但方差缩小这三种截然不同的情况混为一谈，导致无法判断后训练到底对预训练编码的信息做了什么。作者希望让这三种命运可被区分和量化，并厘清哪些信息受到保护、哪些会被舍弃。
AI.method: 在预训练能恢复贝叶斯信念状态的模型上，利用只读取隐藏状态粗略函数的奖励定义"奖励零核"，从而分别测量：信息是否仍可解码、决策是否因果依赖该信息、该信息占据多少激活方差。理论层面分析 KL 锚定的强化学习、监督/无锚定目标以及谱压缩对保真度约束的不同影响；实验层面在可控世界和开源语言模型中验证这些预测。
AI.result: 在受控世界中，后训练主要对奖励零信息进行改道或缩放，信息大多仍可解码；无锚定时决策可停止使用该信息但表征仍存续，有锚定时则持续使用。擦除只在长期权重衰减下、且仅对奖励与下一词预测均无法看到的区分出现。开源语言模型呈相同解离：上下文中信念几何在深层谱压缩下仍可解码，且类内行为取决于锚定设置。
AI.conclusion: 后训练实质上是为预训练信念状态选择一个"因果商"：奖励决定决策等价关系，锚定与状态更新保护部分被奖励忽略的信息，优化过程决定其余信息是被擦除、改道还是缩放。

title: FlexCast: Adaptive Weather Forecasting from Arbitrary Field Sets
summary: Most deep learning weather models assign a fixed set of variables and pressure levels to predefined channels, limiting transfer across atmospheric field configurations. This dependence on a fixed field set limits the transferability of trained models across atmospheric field configurations. We propose FlexCast, a field-adaptive weather forecasting model that uses a single set of parameters to produce identity-aligned forecasts for variable-cardinality subsets drawn from a 69-field ERA5 registry. Specifically, a metadata-conditioned adapter the first encodes variable identity, pressure level, and field type and combines them with spatial features. Then, shared rank-16 projec?tions are modulated by metadata-dependent gates to produce field?specific features, while masked set fusion aggregates the available fields into a fixed-width representation. Subsequently, a multiscale U-Transformer processes the fused atmospheric features, while an identity-aware query decoder produces forecasts for the requested fields. Finally, FlexCast learns a standardized six-hour increment and applies it recursively to generate forecasts at longer lead times. Experiments on the 2020 ERA5 test set demonstrate that FlexCast operates across varying field configurations. Compatible cross-field context is associated with lower forecast errors, whereas mismatched context increases them.

AI.tldr: 提出FlexCast，一种场自适应天气预报模型，用单套参数对69字段ERA5注册表中任意字段子集生成对齐预报，并在2020年ERA5测试集上验证其跨场配置能力。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习天气模型将固定变量和气压层绑定到预定义通道，导致模型难以在不同大气场配置间迁移，泛化与复用受限。
AI.method: 元数据条件适配器编码变量身份、气压层与场类型并与空间特征融合；用元数据相关门控调制共享rank-16投影生成场特异特征；掩码集合融合将可用场聚合为固定宽度表示；多尺度U-Transformer处理融合特征；身份感知查询解码器输出所请求字段的预报；学习标准化六小时增量并递归生成更长预报时效。
AI.result: 在2020年ERA5测试集上，FlexCast可在不同场配置下运行；兼容的跨场上下文对应更低预报误差，而错配上下文会增大误差。
AI.conclusion: FlexCast通过场自适应设计突破了固定字段集的限制，实现单参数集对可变基数子集的统一预报，并表明跨场上下文质量直接影响预报精度。

title: Do Neural Networks Learn Structure-Preserving Maps? A Case Study in Latent-to-Hilbert Embeddings
summary: We ask whether a neural network can learn a structure-preserving map from a compressed latent space to a Hilbert-space representation. Using an 8-dimensional autoencoder bottleneck on MNIST and $n$-qubit product-state targets from PCA-based angle encoding, we report four findings. Although the target angles are generated by a nonlinear sigmoid transformation of the latent projections, the resulting mapping is well approximated by a linear function over the observed latent distribution: linear regression from $z$ to the true target angles achieves $R^{2} = 0.98$, while regression to the MLP's recovered angles achieves $R^{2} = 0.91$. The learned map's primary direction is strongly aligned with the target-induced direction, with cosine similarity $0.989$, while remaining nearly orthogonal to the input's principal direction, with cosine similarity $0.002$. The map is genuinely rank-4: removing any singular direction degrades inner-product preservation by $2.5$--$5.9\times$ despite a singular-value spectrum with two dominant and two small values. The learned subspace does not coincide with the PCA basis used to construct the target, and different random seeds recover the same primary direction but diverge in higher ranks. Finally, kernel ridge regression with an RBF kernel outperforms a tuned MLP (IP error $0.0144$ vs.\ $0.0197$), suggesting that for approximately linear structure-preserving mappings, classical kernel methods may be a simpler and more effective alternative.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨神经网络能否学习从压缩潜空间到希尔伯特空间表示的结构保持映射，发现在MNIST上该映射可被线性函数良好近似，且核岭回归优于MLP。
AI.motivation: 探究神经网络是否能够学习从压缩潜空间到量子希尔伯特空间表示的结构保持映射，并检验其线性程度、方向对齐性与秩结构，进而比较经典核方法与神经网络的效果。
AI.method: 在MNIST上使用8维自编码器瓶颈，结合基于PCA的角度编码生成n量子比特乘积态目标；采用线性回归、MLP，并对比RBF核岭回归，分析方向余弦相似度与奇异值谱。
AI.result: 潜变量到真实目标角度的线性回归达R²=0.98，对MLP恢复角度为R²=0.91；主方向余弦相似度0.989，与输入主方向近乎正交(0.002)；映射为秩4，去除任一奇异方向内积保持误差上升2.5–5.9倍；学习子空间与PCA基不一致，随机种子仅在高秩发散；RBF核岭回归内积误差0.0144优于MLP的0.0197。
AI.conclusion: 对于近似线性的结构保持映射，经典核方法可能是更简单且更有效的替代方案。

title: ASCENT: Online Test-Time Training of Long-Horizon Agents via Self-Distillation of Verified Experience
summary: A large language model (LLM) agent solves long-horizon tasks through many reasoning-action turns, with one verification signal at termination. Deployed agents face streams of related tasks, making their trajectories a natural resource for improvement. In-context adaptation agents store reflections, memories, or skills as text, so reuse depends on retrieving the right experience and on a frozen policy executing it. We study Online Agentic Test-Time Training (OaTTT), which trains the LLM's weights on its own execution trajectories during deployment. The agent executes each task once, in one pass over the stream, and the executed trajectory with its verification result is the only learning signal for weight updates that persist across tasks. Directly imitating or reinforcing the generated tokens of this single attempt destabilizes the policy. We introduce ASCENT (Agentic Self-distillation for Cross-task EvolutioN at Test-time), which instead self-distills verified experience. A stable version of the LLM, its frozen initial copy, receives the verified trajectory as privileged information and predicts next-token distributions along it with this hindsight. Distilling them into persistent LoRA fast weights updates the agent for later tasks, without an external reference solution or stronger teacher. By further removing invalid-action turns, ASCENT distills enhanced privileged experience for more efficient execution. We characterize its population target and the limits of sparse outcome selection. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and AppWorld at varied model scales, ASCENT improves task success and interaction efficiency as experience accumulates, outperforms online adaptation methods, and transfers to held-out scenes, showing that an agent can consolidate verified experience into its weights without a separate training phase or memory retrieval. Project page: https://artificer-ai-lab.github.io/ASCENT

AI.tldr: 本文提出在线智能体测试时训练（OaTTT）与ASCENT方法：智能体在部署期间用自身执行轨迹训练LLM权重，通过冻结初始模型对已验证轨迹进行自蒸馏生成特权监督信号，蒸馏进持久LoRA快速权重，实现跨任务持续改进，无需外部参考解或记忆检索。
AI.motivation: 长期任务需多轮"推理-行动"，而验证信号仅在终止时给出；部署中的智能体面对相关任务流，轨迹是可利用的资源。现有上下文适应方法将反思/记忆/技能存为文本，依赖正确检索且策略被冻结；直接模仿或强化单次生成token会破坏策略稳定性。因此需要一种在部署中持续更新权重、不依赖外部教师或检索的机制。
AI.method: 提出ASCENT：以LLM的冻结初始副本作为稳定的"教师"，将已验证轨迹作为特权信息输入，预测沿轨迹的下一token分布（后见之明），再蒸馏进持久的LoRA快速权重。进一步剔除无效动作轮次，蒸馏增强的特权经验以提升执行效率。智能体对每个任务只执行一次、单遍流式处理，验证结果作为唯一学习信号，权重更新跨任务持久保留。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、AppWorld及多种模型规模上，ASCENT随经验积累提升任务成功率与交互效率，优于在线适应方法，并能迁移到未见过场景；同时刻画了其总体目标与稀疏结果选择的局限。
AI.conclusion: 智能体可将已验证经验巩固进自身权重，无需单独训练阶段或记忆检索，即可实现跨任务持续进化。

title: Robust Parameter-Efficient LLM Adaptation on Analog Hardware
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints (ODI 2026)
summary: Analog in-memory computing is a promising platform for on-device execution of large language models because it performs matrix--vector multiplications (MVMs) in memory and in parallel, reducing data movement. However, limited digital-to-analog converter precision, input noise, and finite conductance states can degrade model accuracy, while full-model retraining to address these effects can be costly. We develop an optimizer-agnostic, parameter-efficient adaptation method based on Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), keeping the pretrained weights stored on analog arrays fixed while training the LoRA weights to adapt to downstream tasks and hardware non-idealities. Reliable adaptation requires handling errors in both forward and backward MVMs and physical weight updates. We use input reshaping to reduce input-induced MVM errors and update accumulation to retain small updates before programming them to finite-state analog devices. Across Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B with both Muon and AdamW, input reshaping improves analog LoRA fine-tuning under noisy MVM computation. Update accumulation separately preserves sub-threshold updates and substantially improves adaptation under finite-resolution programming, including configurations with as few as 20 conductance states. Additional experiments show consistent held-out negative log-likelihood improvements across noisy analog settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种优化器无关、参数高效的LoRA适配方法，用于在模拟存内计算硬件上微调大语言模型：固定阵列上的预训练权重，仅训练LoRA权重，并通过输入重塑与更新累积分别缓解前/反向MVM噪声和有限电导态编程误差。
AI.motivation: 模拟存内计算可并行完成MVM、减少数据搬运，适合端侧部署大语言模型；但DAC精度有限、输入噪声与有限电导态会降低精度，而全模型重训练代价高。因此需要一种参数高效、能同时适应下游任务与硬件非理想性的适配方法。
AI.method: 基于LoRA的优化器无关、参数高效适配：预训练权重固定存储在模拟阵列中，仅训练LoRA权重。针对前向与反向MVM误差以及物理权重编程误差，采用两项技术：(1) 输入重塑（input reshaping）降低输入引起的MVM误差；(2) 更新累积（update accumulation）在编程到有限状态器件前保留微小更新。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct与Llama-3-8B上，使用Muon和AdamW优化器：输入重塑在有噪声MVM计算下改善模拟LoRA微调；更新累积单独保留次阈值更新，在有限分辨率编程（少至20个电导态）下显著改善适配。额外实验显示在多种噪声模拟设置下held-out负对数似然一致改善。
AI.conclusion: 输入重塑与更新累积是两项互补、优化器无关的技术，可分别应对MVM噪声与有限电导态编程，使LoRA能在模拟存内计算硬件上高效适配大语言模型，并在低至20电导态条件下仍有效。

title: When Does Longer Reasoning Help? Predicting Mathematical Reasoning Through Discovery and Execution
summary: Test-time compute can improve mathematical reasoning, but can short-budget runs predict how mathematical reasoning scales with additional compute? We introduce a Discovery--Execution (DE) framework that predicts the aggregate held-out scaling curves through a convolution of strategy discovery and conditional execution. From independent short-budget attempts and oracle-sketch-conditioned runs, the framework estimates cumulative success along held-out reasoning trajectories under alternate compute allocations. We evaluate four models on 35 fresh Olympiad problems and non-geometry problems from IMO-ProofBench Advanced. Under the DE framework, near-saturated execution predicts geometric scaling, as observed for the GPT models. For Claude Opus 4.8, incorporating measured execution substantially improves held-out forecasts over geometric extrapolation across one- and two-arm allocations. As a secondary application, regularized DE (R-DE) decisions to continue or restart yield lower average regret than the best model-specific retrospective policy. Together, these results show that measuring conditional execution provides information about longer reasoning that short-budget success rates do not always capture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Discovery–Execution (DE) 框架，用短预算运行的策略发现与条件执行卷积来预测留出集上的推理随算力扩展曲线。
AI.motivation: Test-time compute 能提升数学推理，但短预算运行能否预测增加算力后的推理扩展性尚不明确，需要一种可外推的预测方法。
AI.method: DE 框架通过短预算尝试与 oracle-sketch 条件下的运行，估计不同算力分配下留出推理轨迹的累积成功率（策略发现与条件执行的卷积）；并提出正则化 DE (R-DE) 用于继续/重启决策。
AI.result: 在 35 道新 Olympiad 题目及 IMO-ProofBench Advanced 非几何题上评估四个模型：近饱和执行预测出 GPT 模型的几何式扩展；对 Claude Opus 4.8，纳入实测执行显著优于几何外推（单臂与双臂分配）；R-DE 决策的平均 regret 低于最佳模型专属回溯策略。
AI.conclusion: 测量条件执行能提供短预算成功率所无法捕捉的长推理信息，说明执行维度的测量对算力扩展预测至关重要。

title: Understanding the Weight Averaging Mechanism in LLM Training for Post-Training Quantization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are typically pretrained in high precision but increasingly deployed with low-precision post-training quantization (PTQ). Recent studies have shown that using weight averaging during pretraining can improve PTQ performance compared with learning-rate decay, suggesting that it might provide a simple way to improve the pretraining-to-quantization transition. But the mechanism behind weight averaging remains insufficiently explained. This leads to inconsistent and fragile performance gains, thereby preventing practitioners from applying such a technique confidently. As a response, we formulate weight averaging as a trade-off between retaining training progress and improving robustness under perturbation. We further derive a continuous family of averaging kernels that unifies conventional strategies and achieves the Pareto frontier between the two competing goals. Critically, a theoretical framework for performing weight averaging under PTQ is developed. It can be shown that coarser quantization is more susceptible to perturbations, whereas finer quantization could be less affected. Thus, our results could provide unified theoretical guidance for performing weight averaging under different PTQ conditions. Experiments validate both the predicted behavior and the proposed averaging strategy. Code is available at https://github.com/MOFA-LAB/weight-averaging-for-ptq.

AI.tldr: 本文将权重平均形式化为“保留训练进度”与“提升扰动鲁棒性”之间的权衡，推导出一族统一的平均核并刻画其Pareto前沿，并为PTQ场景下的权重平均建立理论框架，实验验证了预测行为与所提策略。
AI.motivation: 预训练通常使用高精度，而部署时越来越多采用低精度PTQ。已有研究表明，预训练中使用权重平均相比学习率衰减能改善PTQ性能，但其中机制尚不充分，导致性能增益不稳定且脆弱，实践者难以放心使用。因此需要解释机制并给出统一理论指导。
AI.method: 将权重平均建模为保留训练进度与提升扰动鲁棒性之间的权衡；推导出一族连续的平均核，统一传统策略，并在两个相互竞争目标间达到Pareto前沿；进一步建立PTQ下进行权重平均的理论框架，分析量化粗细对扰动敏感性的影响。
AI.result: 理论上表明更粗的量化更易受扰动影响，而更细的量化受影响较小；该结果为不同PTQ条件下的权重平均提供统一理论指导。实验验证了预测的行为以及所提出的平均策略。
AI.conclusion: 权重平均的效果可由“训练进度保留—鲁棒性”权衡解释，所推导的连续平均核族可统一传统方法并实现Pareto最优；在PTQ下，量化精度会影响扰动敏感性，因此该框架能为不同PTQ条件提供统一指导，代码已开源。

title: Compact set-valued deep ensembling in multi-class classification
summary: This paper tackles visible challenges in deep ensemble learning, where deep neural networks serve as ensemble members: training and storage burdens, and robustness of cautious (set-valued) predictions targeting multiple utilities, which may involve reward-sensitivity. To mitigate the training and storage burdens, we propose to employ compact ensembles, such as Bayesian Neural Networks and Convolutional Neural Networks with the Monte-Carlo dropout prediction option, to produce probabilistic predictions. For each query instance, these probabilistic predictions are then used to define a representative distribution optimizing some statistical distance. The representative distribution is then employed to define the Bayes-optimal prediction (BOP) of any utility. To address the potential unrobustness of singleton prediction making, we propose a family of set-utilities satisfying some desirable properties and whose set-valued BOPs can be found efficiently. Empirical evidence is then given to illustrate the potential (dis)advantages of the proposed ensemble learning framework.

AI.tldr: 提出紧凑集成框架（BNN、MC-dropout CNN）生成概率预测，经代表分布得到任意效用下的贝叶斯最优预测，并设计可高效求解的集合效用族以获得稳健的集合值预测。
AI.motivation: 深度集成存在训练与存储负担重的问题，且面对多种效用（尤其奖励敏感情形）时，谨慎（集合值）预测的稳健性不足。
AI.method: 采用紧凑集成（贝叶斯神经网络、带蒙特卡洛 dropout 的卷积神经网络）产生概率预测；对每个查询实例，用这些概率预测定义优化某统计距离的代表分布；再由代表分布定义任意效用的贝叶斯最优预测（BOP）；同时提出满足若干理想性质的集合效用族，以高效求解其集合值BOP。
AI.result: 给出了经验证据，说明所提集成学习框架的潜在优点与缺点。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑集成结合代表分布与集合效用族，可在缓解训练存储负担的同时实现稳健的集合值贝叶斯最优预测，但框架的优劣需视具体情况而定。

title: Green-Routed Neural Operators:\\Physics Determines Where the Network Reads
summary: We identify a mismatch between the physical role of transport fields in many PDEs and their usual role in neural operators: PDEs use them to select read coordinates, whereas neural operators typically treat them only as input values. We address this mismatch with the Green-Routed Neural Operator (GRNO), which uses the governing equation to determine where latent features are sampled. A parameter-free equation adapter evaluates the diagnostic relation and constructs a departure map whose values are the read coordinates. A multiscale encoder-decoder combines centered and routed reads of latent features to learn the complete finite-time update. Across five two- and three-dimensional PDE systems, GRNO achieves the lowest mean final relative $L^2$ error on four under 40-step autoregressive evaluation and remains competitive on Keller-Segel. Fixed-weight route interventions reveal strong dependence on direction and spatial alignment in four systems, with weak dependence in Keller-Segel. In independently trained ablations, GRNO achieves lower mean errors than variants that supply the transport field only as an input feature, substitute a learned displacement for the equation-specified route, or apply the route with a spatial misalignment, across all five systems. It also substantially outperforms directly advecting the physical state and learning the remaining update, indicating that equation-specified read coordinates provide an effective structural prior for long-horizon PDE forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Green-Routed Neural Operator（GRNO），通过方程诊断关系构造"departure map"来确定潜特征采样坐标（routed read），纠正了输运场在PDE与神经算子中角色不匹配的问题；在五个2D/3D PDE系统上，多数情形取得最低平均末步相对L²误差，消融验证了方程指定读取坐标作为结构先验的有效性。
AI.motivation: 动机在于指出现有神经算子与PDE物理角色之间的不匹配：PDE中输运场（transport fields）用于确定读取坐标，而神经算子通常仅将其当作普通输入特征值。这一treat-as-input的做法丢掉了方程赋予输运场的坐标选择语义，因此需要一种让网络"按方程采样潜特征"的结构化机制，以改善长时间自回归预测。
