AI.result: 在1D和2D的四类PDE、三种骨干网络(FNO、Transolver、CNO)上，模型在72个种子级比较中赢下61个；学习到精确的输运与波符号，在热方程与Burgers上耗散率误差在13%以内，在平流中不产生耗散。常数L消融实验表明精确Jacobi的代价是失去Burgers拟合能力，学习熵消融则会在每个可逆-不可逆问题上注入能量。
AI.conclusion: 按GENERIC原始方式构造退化性可在机器精度上同时满足反对称、正性、双退化与Jacobi恒等式，且可跨骨干网络泛化、学习精确符号与耗散率；代价是常数L设定下无法处理Burgers类非线性输运问题，学习熵会破坏能量守恒。

title: Disentangling Task Difficulty from Run-Level Failure in Agent Failure Prediction
summary: Predicting whether an LLM agent will fail has emerged as a promising direction for supporting intervention during execution. Recent approaches report strong predictive performance, often with AUROC values between 0.85 and 0.94. However, predictors are typically trained by pooling runs from many tasks. We hypothesize that part of this performance comes from recognizing that some tasks are harder than others, rather than detecting whether a particular run is heading toward failure. This distinction matters because task-level difficulty supports decisions about where to allocate computation, while run-level prediction is needed to decide whether to intervene in an ongoing trajectory. We study benchmarks with repeated attempts of the same task by the same agent and separate cross-unit comparisons from comparisons between successful and failed runs of the same model-task unit. Across the evaluated corpora, more than 99.93% of the positive-negative pairs underlying pooled AUROC are cross-unit. Accordingly, predictors that never observe the current run can achieve high pooled performance, including a difficulty oracle with AUROC up to 0.945, while remaining at chance within task. Early run-level discrimination is consistently weak across trajectory predictors, released monitors, and hidden-state probes, although it improves later in execution and is stronger for weaker agents. Under fixed token budgets, task-level allocation outperforms abort-only strategies, while early stopping becomes beneficial only when within-task AUROC reaches about 0.84-0.93, far above the 0.50-0.55 range observed for early monitors. These results show that failure prediction should be evaluated not only by outcome accuracy, but by whether the captured signal supports the intended deployment decision.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示LLM Agent失败预测的高AUROC主要由跨任务难度差异驱动，而非真正检测当前轨迹的失败倾向；应区分任务级分配与运行级干预两类决策进行评测。
AI.motivation: 近期失败预测器报告AUROC在0.85-0.94之间，性能看似很强，但作者假设其中相当部分来自"识别某些任务更难"而非"判断某次运行是否走向失败"。这一混淆有实际后果：任务级难度可支撑"在哪里分配算力"的决策，而运行级预测才能支撑"是否干预正在进行的轨迹"。若评估指标掩盖了这一差别，就会误导部署决策。
AI.method: 作者选取包含同一Agent对同一任务多次重复尝试的基准，将比较拆分为跨单元（cross-unit，不同任务/模型单元之间）与单元内（同一模型-任务单元内成功与失败运行之间）两类。统计池化AUROC背后的正负样本对来源，并构造从不观察当前运行的预测器（如难度oracle）作为对照，进而评测轨迹预测器、已发布monitor与隐状态探针在不同执行阶段的运行级判别能力，并在固定token预算下比较任务级分配、仅中止与早停策略。
AI.result: 在所评估语料中，超过99.93%的池化AUROC正负样本对属于跨单元。因此从不观察当前运行的预测器也能获得高池化性能，难度oracle的AUROC最高达0.945，但在任务内部仅相当于随机水平。早期运行级判别在所有评测方法中持续较弱（AUROC约0.50-0.55），随执行推进而改善，且在能力较弱的Agent上更强。固定token预算下，任务级分配优于仅中止策略；早停只有在单元内AUROC达到约0.84-0.93时才产生收益，远高于早期monitor的实际水平。
AI.conclusion: 失败预测的评测不应只看结果准确率，而应检验所捕捉的信号是否支撑预期的部署决策。池化AUROC高估了真正可用于在线干预的运行级信号；任务级难度信号适合算力分配，但不足以支持早期中止，二者需明确区分与分别评估。

title: What Does an Observability Foundation Model Know?
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS Main Conference '26. 25 pages
summary: A linear probe can show that a label is recoverable from a model's hidden states, but not whether that goes beyond what the input already reveals, or whether the model uses it. We audit Toto, an observability forecasting foundation model, on the Benchmark of Observability Metrics (BOOM) across five series-disjoint resplits, comparing linear probes on its frozen residual stream with models that read the raw input window and with Toto's architecture stripped of its trained configuration. Short-vs-medium cadence and metric type are more linearly recoverable from Toto's residuals than from the strongest raw-window model in every resplit (macro-F1 0.766 vs. 0.633 and 0.545 vs. 0.498). Domain is nearly tied, and series cardinality is recovered far better from the raw window. MOMENT-base shows related cadence, metric-type, and domain readouts. Recoverability is not use: exchanging Toto's residuals with those of high-burst donors moves a future-burstiness readout as intended but does not make forecasts consistently burstier than a randomized donor. A BOOM-trained coordination probe has negative zero-shot R^2 on the tested external benchmarks. We report each label against its strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文审计可观测性预测基础模型Toto，比较线性探针、原始输入窗口模型与去掉训练配置的同架构模型，发现部分标签在残差中更易解码，但可恢复性不等于模型实际使用该信息。
AI.motivation: 线性探针只能证明某标签可从模型隐状态中恢复，却无法说明该信息是否超出输入本身所揭示的内容，也无法证明模型真的使用了它，因此需要更严格的可恢复性与使用性审计。
AI.method: 在BOOM基准的五个序列不相交重划分上审计Toto：对其冻结残差流做线性探针，与读取原始输入窗口的最强模型对比，并与剥离训练配置的Toto架构对照；另做残差替换实验和BOOM训练的协调探针零样本测试。
AI.result: 短/中节奏与指标类型在Toto残差中比最强原始窗口模型更可线性恢复（宏F1 0.766对0.633，0.545对0.498）；领域几乎持平，序列基数在原始窗口上恢复更好。MOMENT-base呈现类似的节奏、指标类型与领域读出。用高突发供体残差替换后，未来突发性读出按预期变化，但预测并未比随机供体更持续突发；协调探针在外部基准上零样本R²为负。
AI.conclusion: 每个标签应与其最强基线比较；隐状态可恢复性不能作为模型使用该信息的证据，需辅以因果替换和零样本迁移检验。

title: Expanding LLM Reasoning
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS Main Conference '26 with a score of 4.33
summary: Extra inference compute is usually spent on sampling more reasoning chains. We study where inside an existing chain an additional continuation should begin. We define expansion utility, the change in correctness from restarting a chain at a stored step, and measure it at every eligible step for nine models on six benchmarks (41 model and benchmark cells). Restart position matters: steps selected on one set of continuations beat uniform placement when scored on disjoint ones, in held-out audits on 5, 16, and 38 cells (+4.25 points [+2.51, +6.63] in a fresh five-cell audit). A fixed rule that restarts from the last eligible steps, always-last, is a strong baseline: our learned router beats uniform placement but shows no detected gain over it, and on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B/MATH-500 always-last exceeds the exact self-consistency frontier at matched aggregate generated output by +0.052 [+0.008, +0.098], using 0.774x the aggregate generated output of four-sample self-consistency. Cross-fitted oracle selection still finds held-out headroom beyond declared positional classes, a target for future selectors. Finally, breaking step-label ties by earliest index flips the sign of a pointwise selector's gain over uniform placement in every seed of a five-seed diagnostic with four rollouts per step; randomized ties remove the bias.

AI.tldr: 本文定义"扩展效用"（在已存步骤处重启推理链带来的正确率变化）并在9个模型×6个基准（41个单元格）上逐步骤测量，发现重启位置确实重要，但一个简单的"总是从最后一个合法步骤重启"（always-last）规则已是很强的基线，学习式路由器未能显著超越它。
AI.motivation: 额外推理算力通常用于采样更多推理链，但已有链条内部"从哪里开始续写"这一分配问题未被研究，作者希望明确重启位置是否重要以及如何选择。
AI.method: 定义扩展效用为在存储步骤处重启链条后正确率的变化，对9个模型、6个基准共41个模型-基准单元格的每个合法步骤进行测量；做跨续写集（held-out）审计与五单元格新审计；对比学习式路由器、均匀放置与固定规则 always-last；与自洽性前沿在匹配聚合生成输出下比较；用交叉拟合oracle刻画上界；并做五种子诊断检验步骤标签并列时的索引偏置。
AI.result: 重启位置有效：在一组续写上选出的步骤在不相交续写上仍优于均匀放置（held-out审计+4.25点[+2.51,+6.63]）。always-last是强基线，学习路由器优于均匀放置但相对always-last无显著增益；在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B/MATH-500上，matched聚合生成输出下always-last超过精确自洽性前沿+0.052[+0.008,+0.098]，且仅用四样本自洽性聚合生成输出的0.774倍。交叉拟合oracle仍发现超出既定位置类的held-out空间；按最早索引打破步骤标签并列会翻转点式选择器增益符号（五种子的每一个），随机化并列可消除偏置。
AI.conclusion: 链条内重启位置是可利用的信号，但简单固定的always-last规则已难以被学习式选择器超越，是应当采用的强基线；既定位置类别之外仍有通过oracle可见的改进空间，且需注意步骤标签并列带来的索引偏置，应使用随机化打破并列。

title: ColdDDI: Evaluating Knowledge Utilization in Cold-Start Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction
summary: Cold-start drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction tests whether models can identify clinically significant interactions for drugs without training-time interaction history. Existing benchmarks mostly report aggregate edge-prediction scores, leaving a key evaluation question unanswered: when models receive molecular, textual, or knowledge-graph (KG) evidence, do they actually use the evidence that pharmacologically supports the interaction? We introduce ColdDDI, a reconstructible diagnostic benchmark built from DrugBank 5.1.13, with 1,900 approved small-molecule drugs and 565,731 positive DDI pairs. ColdDDI evaluates pairs with zero, one, or two unseen drugs. It also annotates each interaction by whether it changes drug exposure or drug effect, and by whether the biomedical knowledge graph contains shared enzymes, transporters, or targets that can plausibly mediate the interaction. These annotations separate evidence availability from predictive dependence. We evaluate eight conventional DDI methods and 13 LLMs; for open-weight LLMs, we test five prompt patterns and use masking, drug replacement, and channel-sensitivity metrics to probe knowledge utilization. ColdDDI exposes that, in the hardest split where both drugs are unseen, the main performance divide is mediator availability. A fine-tuned 1B LLM recovers 89-93% of interactions with a shared enzyme, transporter, or target, but only 40-62% without such a mediator. More importantly, KG-provided evidence is not always used; several KG-augmented baselines change little when the shared mediator is masked or disrupted, whereas fine-tuned LLMs respond strongly to this intervention. Thus, ColdDDI evaluates knowledge utilization rather than knowledge access alone, showing where cold-start DDI models rely on mechanistic evidence and where they fail despite receiving it. Code is available at https://github.com/0217ljh/ColdDDI-NeurIPS2026.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ColdDDI 诊断基准，用于评估冷启动药物-药物相互作用预测中模型是否真正利用了药理学证据，而不仅是获取证据。
AI.motivation: 现有 DDI 基准多报告聚合边预测分数，未回答模型在获得分子、文本或知识图谱证据时是否真正使用了支持相互作用的关键证据，即混淆了"证据可用性"与"预测依赖性"。
AI.method: 基于 DrugBank 5.1.13 构建 ColdDDI，包含 1,900 个已批准小分子药物和 565,731 个正 DDI 对；评估零/一个/两个未见药物的配对；对每个相互作用标注其是否改变药物暴露或药效，以及生物医学知识图谱中是否存在可介导该相互作用的共享酶、转运体或靶点。评估 8 种常规 DDI 方法与 13 个 LLM；对开放权重 LLM 测试五种提示模式，并采用掩码、药物替换和通道敏感性指标探测知识利用。
AI.result: 在双药均未见的最难划分中，主要性能差异来自介导物可用性：微调 1B LLM 对有共享酶/转运体/靶点的相互作用恢复率 89-93%，无介导物时仅 40-62%。多个 KG 增强基线在共享介导物被掩码或扰动时变化很小，而微调 LLM 对此干预反应强烈，表明 KG 证据并不总是被使用。
AI.conclusion: ColdDDI 评估的是知识利用而非仅知识获取，揭示了冷启动 DDI 模型在何处依赖机制性证据、以及在获得证据时仍失败的位置。

title: When the Cross-Silo Federation Goes Offline: Continual Learning for Site Onboarding with Limited Unlabeled Data
comment: Accepted to the Continual Learning for Enterprise AI Agents (CLEA) workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 9 pages, 1 figure, plus appendix
summary: An organization often holds too little labeled data to train a model that generalizes, and the records that would supply the rest sit with organizations that cannot release them. Cross-silo federated learning offers a way through, since participants exchange model parameters rather than records, but it ordinarily settles two aspects of the arrangement in advance, the participating sites and the classes the model can predict, and deployment can breach both. A new site joins after training, once the established sites have finished their engagement and gone offline, and its records arrive unlabeled, mixing conditions the model already recognizes with conditions no participant has observed. We present an autonomous three-stage procedure that expands the model entirely at the joining site: reconstruction experts screen for novelty, clustering separates the flagged records into candidate conditions, and class means describe the old classes, all inside one shared representation. Those classes were learned from records that never leave their owners, so the usual defenses against forgetting are unavailable, and the procedure supplies the evidence they would have carried from either of two dissimilar sources, prototypes held by the federation or records held by the joining site. On a real industrial condition-monitoring dataset, run end to end with no label consulted, either source holds old-class accuracy at 0.868 or above with forgetting at most 0.063, and the two differ by 0.021, so a configuration can be chosen by the disclosure it permits rather than the accuracy it delivers. Both keep old- and new-class accuracy in balance where every alternative we measure gives up one for the other, and both retain more of the old classes than distillation- and regularization-based baselines. The balance still holds with only 6 labeled records per arriving condition and 3 retained per old class.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在联邦学习中加入新站点时的三阶段自主扩展方法：利用重构专家筛查新类、聚类分离候选条件、类均值刻画旧类，在原站点离线且无标签的情况下实现新类发现与旧类保持。
AI.motivation: 跨孤岛联邦学习通常预先把参与站点和可预测类别固定，但部署中常出现训练后新站点加入、且其数据无标签并混杂已知与未知条件的情况，此时传统防遗忘手段（依赖旧数据或旧参与者在线）均不可用。
AI.method: 在加入站点本地执行三阶段流程：重构专家进行新颖性筛查，聚类将被标记记录分成候选条件，类均值描述旧类；两阶段均在共享表示空间内进行。旧类证据来自两种不同来源之一：联邦持有的原型或加入站点持有的记录。
AI.result: 在真实工业状态监测数据集上端到端运行（不查询任何标签），两种证据来源均可将旧类准确率保持在0.868以上，遗忘不超过0.063，两者相差0.021；新旧类准确率保持平衡，优于蒸馏与正则化基线；在每种新到达条件仅6个标注记录、每个旧类保留3个的情况下仍保持平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该自主流程可在无标签、原站点离线条件下同时实现新类发现与旧类保持，且允许依据数据披露许可而非精度来选择证据来源配置。

title: An LLM-in-the-loop RL Framework for Bioinformatics Feature Selection
summary: High-dimensional bioinformatics data, characterized by a large number of features relative to the number of samples, pose major challenges such as the ``curse of dimensionality,'' leading to overfitting, high computational cost, and poor generalization. Traditional feature selection methods often suffer from limited scalability and adaptability in such domains. We propose an LLM-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (RL) framework for bioinformatics feature selection, where the RL agent formulates feature selection as a sequential decision-making task, while the large language model (LLM) enhances the process in two ways: (1) guiding exploration through domain-informed advice, and (2) providing hybrid rewards that integrate data-driven performance with knowledge-driven evaluation. The LLM also produces explanations to improve interpretability for human experts without altering the RL policy update. Experiments on diverse bioinformatics datasets show that the LLM-in-the-loop framework outperforms baselines, achieves stable performance across downstream models, and converges faster than pure RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"LLM在环"的强化学习框架用于生物信息学特征选择：RL代理将特征选择建模为序贯决策任务，LLM通过领域知识引导探索并提供融合数据驱动性能与知识驱动评估的混合奖励，同时输出解释以提高可解释性，在多个生物信息学数据集上优于基线、跨下游模型稳定且收敛更快。
AI.motivation: 高维生物信息学数据存在特征远多于样本的特点，引发"维度灾难"，导致过拟合、计算开销高、泛化性差；传统特征选择方法在此类领域可扩展性与适应性有限。
AI.method: 提出LLM在环的强化学习特征选择框架。RL代理把特征选择形式化为序贯决策问题；LLM从两方面增强：(1)以领域知识建议引导探索；(2)提供融合数据驱动性能与知识驱动评估的混合奖励。LLM还生成解释以提升对领域专家而言的可解释性，且不改变RL策略更新。
AI.result: 在多种生物信息学数据集上，该LLM在环框架优于基线方法，在不同下游模型上表现稳定，且相比纯RL收敛更快。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM的领域知识与解释能力引入RL特征选择环中，可有效缓解高维生物信息学特征选择的探索效率与可解释性难题，兼顾性能、稳定性与收敛速度。

title: Your Unlearning Gives You Away: Identifying Erased Concepts in Diffusion Models
summary: Existing attacks on unlearned diffusion models assume that the erased concepts are known in advance and focus on recovering them. In practice, however, model providers may not disclose which concepts have been removed, and even with access to the original base model, an adversary may still lack a clear target to attack. In this paper, we aim to answer the following critical but overlooked questions: which concepts have been erased from the model, and how many have been erased in total? To this end, we present Tracer, a framework that rapidly and accurately identifies erased concepts and estimates their number. Tracer efficiently identifies erased concepts without generating and classifying images. By combining lightweight spectral analysis of weight footprints, it enables efficient search over large candidate vocabularies. To distinguish multiple erased concepts, we introduce a footprint coverage objective that guides sequential discovery. Tracer estimates the number of erased concepts by detecting a sharp decline in candidate confidence as the selected concepts account for the erasure footprint, without requiring labeled examples for calibration. The framework requires only lightweight linear algebra and limited forward probes, with no prior knowledge of the unlearning algorithm. Experiments across text-to-image and text-to-video backbones and diverse unlearning methods demonstrate that Tracer identifies erased concepts and estimates their number in seconds, achieving 150 to 137,000 times and 133 to 20,000 times speedups over MIA and brute-force search on image and video models, respectively, with substantially higher identification accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Tracer 框架，在无先验概念知识的前提下，快速准确地识别被遗忘（erased）概念并估计其数量。
AI.motivation: 现有针对遗忘后扩散模型的攻击假设被抹除的概念是已知的，仅关注如何恢复它们。但实际中模型提供方可能不披露删除了哪些概念，攻击者即使有原始基座模型也缺乏明确攻击目标，因此"哪些概念被抹除、总共抹除多少"这一关键问题被忽视。
AI.method: Tracer 无需生成并分类图像即可识别被抹除概念：通过权重足迹的轻量级谱分析，实现大规模候选词表的高效搜索；引入足迹覆盖（footprint coverage）目标引导顺序发现多个概念；通过检测候选置信度在所选概念覆盖遗忘足迹时的急剧下降来估计数量，无需标注样本校准。
AI.result: 仅需轻量线性代数与有限前向探测，无需了解遗忘算法先验。在文生图与文生视频骨干及多种遗忘方法上，Tracer 可在数秒内识别被抹除概念并估计数量，相较 MIA 和暴力搜索在图像与视频模型上分别实现 150–137,000 倍和 133–20,000 倍加速，且识别准确率显著更高。
AI.conclusion: Tracer 首次系统性地回答"模型被抹除了哪些概念、共抹除多少"的问题，兼具高效性、准确性与算法无关性。

title: Delay-coordinate reconstruction and conditional-moment causal diagnostics in stochastic systems
summary: Partial observation and delay-coordinate reconstruction are rooted in deterministic dynamical-systems theory, whereas there are many systems with intrinsic stochasticity. We propose a conditional-moment interpretation of delay-coordinate reconstruction for stochastic systems, in which a delay vector is used to reconstruct conditional moments of a future distribution rather than a unique future sample path. Two complementary arguments motivate this viewpoint. First, the probability density of a stochastic differential equation obeys a deterministic Fokker-Planck equation and, under certain assumptions, is represented by an infinite deterministic hierarchy of moments. Hence, a finite-moment closure suggests a Takens-like finite-dimensional approximation. Second, a discussion based on the Koopman operator theory clarifies that the time evolution of an observable in the Mori-Zwanzig formalism yields a conditional expectation in stochastic systems. Then, the orthogonal "noise" term in the coefficient-space Mori-Zwanzig equation vanishes in the stochastic cases; this result is consistent with the moment-based argument. As an application of this stochastic delay-reconstruction viewpoint, we revisit convergent cross mapping (CCM) for diagnosing certain causal relationships. Although CCM based on the embedding theorem cannot generally be applied to stochastic systems, it is possible to examine certain types of causal relationships by using conditional moments. Using coupled logistic systems with additive and multiplicative coupling mechanisms, we discuss how causal relationships are embedded in stochastic systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向随机系统的延迟坐标重构的“条件矩”解释：延迟向量不重构唯一的未来样本路径，而是重构未来分布的条件矩，并借此重新审视收敛交叉映射（CCM）在随机系统中的因果诊断能力。
AI.motivation: 延迟坐标重构与部分观测理论根植于确定性动力系统理论，但许多真实系统具有内在随机性，原有基于Takens嵌入定理的框架难以直接适用于随机系统。
AI.method: 提出延迟坐标重构的条件矩解释：1）基于随机微分方程的概率密度服从确定性Fokker-Planck方程，在特定假设下由无限确定性矩层级表示，有限矩闭合给出类Takens的有限维近似；2）基于Koopman算子理论，说明Mori-Zwanzig形式中可观测量的时间演化在随机系统中给出条件期望，从而使系数空间Mori-Zwanzig方程中的正交“噪声”项消失，与矩方法结论一致。并将该观点应用于CCM，用含加性与乘性耦合的耦合logistic系统讨论随机系统中因果关系的嵌入。
AI.result: 论证了两条互补路径（矩闭合与Koopman/Mori-Zwanzig）结论一致；指出基于嵌入定理的CCM一般不能用于随机系统，但利用条件矩可以检验某些类型的因果关系；并通过加性和乘性耦合的logistic系统展示了因果关系如何嵌入随机系统。
AI.conclusion: 随机系统的延迟坐标重构应被理解为对未来分布条件矩的重构而非唯一轨迹的重构，这为在随机系统中进行因果诊断（如扩展CCM）提供了理论基础。

title: When Does a Diffusion Model Decide What to Draw ?
summary: A diffusion model starts from pure noise and removes it step by step. Somewhere along the way it stops being able to become "anything" and becomes committed to, say, a horse rather than a truck. We measure when this happens, and what a trained model gets wrong about it, on CIFAR-10. The most direct measurement is to freeze a half-finished image, restart the generation from that point many times, and count how often each class comes out. We call this probability the committor. Measured this way, the model settles coarse questions (vehicle or animal?) at roughly twice the noise level of fine ones (which animal?). A much cheaper measurement, the noise level at which a classifier's opinion about two classes splits into two distinct groups, gets the order of these decisions right (rank correlation 0.73-0.88) but not their exact timing. We then compare pretrained models with their

AI.tldr: 该论文在CIFAR-10上测量扩散模型从纯噪声逐步去噪时"何时"从可生成任意类别转变为锁定特定类别，提出用"committor"概率刻画这一决策时刻，并给出更廉价的分类器分歧代理指标。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型从纯噪声逐步去噪，途中会从"什么都能生成"的状态转变为对某一具体类别（如马而非卡车）的"承诺/锁定"。理解这一决策发生的时间点及其与语义粒度（粗粒度 vs 细粒度）的关系，对认识生成过程的机制具有重要意义。
AI.method: 直接测量法：冻结半成品图像，从该点多次重启生成，统计各类别出现频率，定义为committor概率。廉价代理法：测量分类器对两个类别的意见分裂为两个独立群体时的噪声水平。并在CIFAR-10上比较预训练模型与其对应模型（如蒸馏/剪枝版本等）的表现。
AI.result: 模型对粗粒度问题（载具还是动物）做出决策的噪声水平约为细粒度问题（哪一种动物）的两倍。廉价代理指标能正确排序决策先后（秩相关0.73–0.88），但无法准确复现其确切时间点。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型的语义承诺遵循由粗到细的分层顺序，粗粒度类别决策先于细粒度决策发生；分类器分歧可作为决策顺序的廉价近似，但精度不足以替代直接committor测量。

title: Training and Scaling Compute-Optimal Physiological Waveform Foundation Models
summary: We investigate the scaling laws and compute-optimal training of physiological waveform foundation models (FMs). We train Aether, a family of over one hundred FMs ranging from 20M to 2.1B parameters, on up to 36.3M hours of physiological waveforms. We construct eight clinical prediction tasks from MIMIC-III and evaluate the FMs through linear probing. The 720M FM outperforms all existing baseline FMs across all eight tasks. A scaling law of model size, pretraining hours, and labeled patients predicts downstream ranking error, i.e. $1-\mathrm{AUROC}$, effectively with $0.5\%$ prediction MAE at held-out resource scales and $0.9\%$ MAE when extrapolating to 2.1B parameters. We present three findings: (1) Compute-optimal training scales both FM size and pretraining hours. Under the fitted law, a $10.0\times$ increase in compute FLOPs scales model size by $1.2\times$ and pretraining hours by $8.2\times$. (2) Larger FMs use waveform data more efficiently, and greater pretraining exposure increases the benefit of model scaling. Starting from 25M parameters and 4.8M pretraining hours, doubling FM size reduces the predicted hours needed for the same performance by $51.8\%$. (3) Pretraining and clinical supervision reinforce each other: more labeled patients increase the return to pretraining, while larger FMs and longer pretraining reduce labeling requirements. For the example of the 720M FM, extending pretraining from 120K to 36.3M hours reduces the predicted patient requirement by $61\%$ at a target ranking error. These findings provide a quantitative training recipe and a promising and durable scaling path for physiological waveform modeling and downstream clinical prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生理波形基础模型的缩放律与最优算力训练策略，训练了参数量20M至2.1B的Aether模型系列，发现算力增加应同时扩大模型规模与预训练时长，且预训练与临床监督相互促进。
AI.motivation: 生理波形基础模型在临床预测中潜力巨大，但缺乏关于模型规模、预训练数据量与标注患者数量如何影响下游性能的定量缩放规律，导致训练资源配置缺乏指导。
AI.method: 构建Aether模型系列（100余个模型，20M–2.1B参数），在最多36.3M小时生理波形数据上预训练；基于MIMIC-III构建八项临床预测任务，采用线性探测评估；拟合模型规模、预训练时长与标注患者数对下游排序误差（1-AUROC）的缩放律。
AI.result: 720M模型在全部八项任务上超越现有基线；缩放律在留出资源尺度上预测MAE为0.5%，外推至2.1B参数时为0.9%。主要发现：(1) 算力增加10.0×时，模型规模扩大1.2×、预训练时长增加8.2×；(2) 模型规模翻倍可减少51.8%的所需预训练时长；(3) 预训练从120K延长至36.3M小时，720M模型所需标注患者数减少61%。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了生理波形建模的定量训练配方与可持续的缩放路径，表明预训练与临床监督协同增效，为下游临床预测奠定基础。

title: Graph Data Augmentation via Contrastive Generator Inversion ($\texttt{DCBA}$)
comment: Accepted to 5th Learning on Graphs Conference; Boston, MA, USA; 20-22.11.2026
summary: Graphs provide a natural representation of many complex systems, ranging from social platforms to ecosystems. However, the development of graph-based machine learning methods is often constrained by the limited availability of large and diverse graph datasets. In this paper, we introduce $\texttt{DCBA}$, a model-based approach to graph data augmentation that infers the configuration of a synthetic graph generator from an observed network. We instantiate the proposed framework using the $\texttt{ABCD}$ generator, which produces scale-free networks with community structure. Our model learns a joint representation of graphs and generator parametrisations using a multi-positive contrastive objective with soft negative weighting. The learned representation enables the prediction of an $\texttt{ABCD}$ configuration whose stochastic realisations preserve the macrostructural properties encoded by the generator. Experiments show that $\texttt{DCBA}$ recovers generator parameters more accurately and robustly than an algorithmic inverse-modelling baseline. Its downstream utility is further demonstrated in community detection, where inferred configurations used to fine-tune $\texttt{PRoCD}$ improve AMI on average by $161\%$ on synthetic and $273\%$ on real-world networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DCBA，一种基于模型的图数据增强方法：通过多正样本对比学习从观测网络反推合成图生成器（ABCD）的参数配置，用于扩充图数据并提升下游社区检测性能。
AI.motivation: 图机器学习方法的发展受限于大规模、多样化图数据集的匮乏，需要有效的图数据增强手段来扩充训练数据。
AI.method: 将图数据增强建模为逆问题：以ABCD生成器（生成带社区结构的无标度网络）为对象，用多正样本对比目标（结合软负样本加权）联合学习图与生成器参数化表示的映射，从而预测出能保持宏观结构特性的ABCD配置。
AI.result: 相比算法式逆建模基线，DCBA能更准确、更鲁棒地恢复生成器参数；在下游社区检测中，用推断配置微调PRoCD，在合成网络上平均提升AMI 161%，在真实网络上平均提升273%。
AI.conclusion: 基于模型的生成器参数反演是一种有效的图数据增强范式，其生成的合成图既保留宏观结构特性，又能显著提升下游任务表现。

title: Bellman-Centric Learning: Near-Optimal Regret for Linear Bandits with Memory
summary: We study linear bandits with memory, where past actions induce endogenous nonstationarity through an arbitrary known, bounded matrix-valued memory map. To trade off exploration and exploitation while accounting for the memory dynamics, we develop RSM-LinUCB, a Bellman-centric algorithm that learns as in linear bandits and plans as in reinforcement learning. This design admits a novel regret decomposition which separates the memory-induced error from the cumulative reward estimation error along the learner's trajectory. We prove a high-probability regret bound of $\widetilde O\big(dRS(M+1)+σd\sqrt T\big)$, where $T$ is the learning horizon, $d$ is the parameter dimension, $M$ is the memory length, $R$ and $S$ bound the memory-map operator norm and reward-parameter norm, respectively, and $σ$ is the sub-Gaussian noise scale. Our results reveal that the multiplicative memory-horizon coupling in prior bounds is not intrinsic: memory only contributes an additive cost, up to logarithmic factors. We also prove a matching minimax lower bound, establishing near-optimality. We further extend the algorithm to generalized linear rewards, preserving this separation with near-optimal memory and leading statistical dependence. Our algorithms outperform the baselines in numerical experiments on synthetic instances and semi-synthetic KV- and semantic-cache tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带记忆的线性赌博机，提出RSM-LinUCB算法，给出近最优遗憾界，证明记忆仅带来加性代价。
AI.motivation: 过去动作通过已知有界矩阵值记忆映射引发内生非平稳性。需在考虑记忆动态的同时权衡探索与利用，并厘清记忆对遗憾的影响本质（是否必然造成乘性耦合）。
AI.method: 提出RSM-LinUCB：以Bellman为中心的算法，像线性赌博机一样学习、像强化学习一样规划；采用新颖的遗憾分解，将记忆诱导误差与轨迹上的累计奖励估计误差分离。并扩展至广义线性奖励。
AI.result: 证明高概率遗憾界 Õ(dRS(M+1)+σd√T)；证明匹配的极小极大下界，达到近最优。广义线性奖励扩展保持该分离性与近最优的记忆及统计依赖。数值实验（合成实例与半合成KV-、语义缓存任务）优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 先前界中记忆与时间跨度的乘性耦合并非本质：记忆仅贡献加性代价（至多对数因子）。所提算法近最优且在实验中优于基线。

title: Sharp Integrality Gaps in Calibration Distance
summary: We study the offline gap between deterministic calibration distance C and its fractional relaxation L for binary unit-weight sequences under total absolute-change cost. We sharpen the offline comparison C <= L + O(sqrt(T)) (Qiao and Zheng, 2024, Theorem 2) to the sharp worst-case order Theta(T^(1/3)). If Delta_T is the supremum of C - L over length-T inputs, then T^(1/3)/1000 <= Delta_T <= 41T^(1/3) for T >= 216. The upper bound holds for every input, while each T >= 216 has a rational lower-bound input. For every input with m distinct forecasts, C <= L + m, and the unrestricted-sample worst-case sparse order is Theta(m). For rational forecasts and accuracy, with binary-encoded multiplicities of separately assignable unit identities, a grid-free polynomial-bit-time procedure returns B <= L <= U, U - B < eta, and an exactly calibrated compact repair of cost at most U + m <= L + m + eta.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二元单位权重序列在总绝对变化代价下确定性校准距离 C 与其分数松弛 L 的离线差距，将已有 C ≤ L + O(√T) 加强为紧的 Θ(T^(1/3)) 阶，并给出精确校准修复的算法保证。
AI.motivation: 已有工作（Qiao 和 Zheng, 2024, Theorem 2）仅给出离线差距 C ≤ L + O(√T) 的上界，其上界与真实最坏情况阶之间存在数量级差距，缺乏紧的刻画；同时需要理解差距随预测值数量的稀疏结构以及构造低代价精确校准修复的可计算性。
AI.method: 对长度 T 的输入定义 Δ_T = sup(C - L)，分别构造通用上界证明与有理数下界实例；通过 m 个不同预测值的结构性分析导出 C ≤ L + m；对有理数预测与准确度，采用二进制编码、可单独指派单位身份的乘积表示，设计无网格、多项式比特时间的算法，返回下界 B 与上界 U 并构造紧致精确校准修复。
AI.result: 最坏情况差距被刻画为 Θ(T^(1/3))：当 T ≥ 216 时 T^(1/3)/1000 ≤ Δ_T ≤ 41T^(1/3)，上界对所有输入成立，每个 T ≥ 216 均存在有理数下界输入。对含 m 个不同预测值的输入有 C ≤ L + m，且无限制样本的最坏情况稀疏阶为 Θ(m)。算法返回 B ≤ L ≤ U 且 U - B < eta，并给出代价至多 U + m ≤ L + m + eta 的精确校准紧致修复。
AI.conclusion: 离线校准差距的紧阶为 Θ(T^(1/3))，且差距可被预测值个数 m 线性控制；在有理数设定下存在多项式比特时间的高效算法，同时给出分数松弛的近似与代价接近最优的精确校准修复，闭合了此前 O(√T) 与真实阶之间的理论缺口。

title: Square-Root Regret for Adversarial Multiplayer Bandits without Collision Information or Shared Randomness
summary:
We study adversarial multiplayer bandits with $K$ arms and $2\le m<K$ labeled players, without collision information, shared randomness, or an external communication channel. We design a constructive communication and synchronization protocol with a Monte Carlo public constructor. With probability at least $1-CN^{-32}$ over preprocessing, where $N=2Km(T+1)$, its fixed published output satisfies \[
  R_T\le C K^{5/2}\sqrt T\log^2(2Km(T+1)) \] simultaneously for every oblivious reward sequence chosen after preprocessing. Here $R_T$ is expected regret over the players' private execution randomness. Positive reward observations establish a common learning schedule and synchronize players before learning begins. The cost of delayed communication is charged to the support of positive rewards, ensuring that periods with little useful feedback incur only limited regret. A slow--fast learning procedure then maintains valid reward estimates while assignments and scores are exchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无碰撞信息、无共享随机性与无外部通信信道条件下的对抗性多人多臂老虎机，提出带蒙特卡洛公共构造器的通信与同步协议，实现固定发布输出对所有遗忘型奖励序列同时成立的 $O(K^{5/2}\sqrt{T}\log^2 T)$ 遗憾上界。
AI.motivation: 多人多臂老虎机通常依赖碰撞信息、共享随机性或外部通信信道进行协调。本文去除了这些强假设，研究在仅有正奖励观测可用、通信受限且奖励由对手自适应选择的更困难设定下，如何实现玩家间的有效同步与学习，从而降低整体遗憾。
AI.method: 设计一种建设性的通信与同步协议，并给出蒙特卡洛公共构造器。预处理阶段生成一个固定发布输出，使其以至少 $1-CN^{-32}$ 的概率（$N=2Km(T+1)$）对所有预处理之后选定的遗忘型奖励序列同时有效。利用正奖励观测建立共同学习调度并在学习开始前同步玩家；将延迟通信的代价计入正奖励支撑集，使得有效反馈稀少的时段仅产生有限遗憾；随后采用慢—快学习过程，在交换分配与得分的同时维持有效的奖励估计。
AI.result: 在预处理随机性下以至少 $1-CN^{-32}$ 的概率，固定发布输出对每个预处理后选定的遗忘型奖励序列同时满足 $R_T\le C K^{5/2}\sqrt{T}\log^2(2Km(T+1))$，其中 $R_T$ 为玩家私有执行随机性下的期望遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，即使没有碰撞信息、共享随机性和外部通信信道，也可借助基于正奖励观测的通信与同步协议，在对抗性多人老虎机中实现同时有效的亚线性遗憾保证，为受限反馈下的多智能体协调学习提供了可行方案。

title: Planetary Geospatial Foundation Models: A New Paradigm for Global Public Health
comment: 41 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables (6 main tables, 6 Extended Data tables)
summary: The efficacy of traditional disease prediction is limited by spatial gaps and temporal lags, which impact the timing and targets of resource deployments. Outbreaks escalate undetected, chronic disease burdens are quantified years later, and at-risk populations in data-sparse regions remain unaddressed. Planetary geospatial foundation models complement existing epidemiological workflows to provide operational improvements, encoding multimodal search, mobility, and environmental signals into generalizable place representations. As illustrations of this complementarity, we present independent global health case studies of Google Earth AI's Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM) -- a foundation model for geospatial inference -- across four domains (vaccine-preventable, communicable, noncommunicable, maternal mental health), five tasks (spatial extrapolation, interpolation/nowcasting, probabilistic forecasting, prospective forecasting, risk stratification), and four countries (USA, Canada, Mexico, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo). Across these case studies, PDFM addresses critical surveillance gaps across domains: improving US-Canada border MMR vaccination coverage predictions by capturing cross-border behavioral spillovers domestic models miss; nowcasting cardiovascular disease to accelerate data availability; enhancing short-term municipal Mexican dengue forecasts for timely outbreak vector control; improving forecasts of cholera hotspots; and adding a transferable signal to individual-level postpartum-depression risk prediction in US states the model had never seen, while not replacing individual socioeconomic data or closing demographic screening gaps. Together, these results showcase capabilities of geospatial foundation models for public health surveillance.

AI.tldr: 该研究展示地球空间基础模型（Google Earth AI的PDFM）在公共卫生监测中的补充作用，通过跨4个疾病领域、5类任务、4个国家的全球健康案例，证明其可填补传统疾病预测在空间与时序上的空白。
AI.motivation: 传统疾病预测受空间间隔与时间滞后制约，影响资源配置的时机与目标：疫情在未被察觉时升级、慢性病负担数年后才被量化、数据稀疏地区的高危人群长期被忽视。因此需要能整合多模态信号、具备泛化能力的地方表征模型来补充现有流行病学工作流。
AI.method: 提出并评估Google Earth AI的人口动态基础模型（PDFM）——一个用于地理空间推断的基础模型，将多模态搜索、移动性与环境信号编码为可泛化的地方表征。在4个领域（疫苗可预防疾病、传染病、非传染性疾病、孕产妇心理健康）、5类任务（空间外推、插值/临近预报、概率预测、前瞻性预测、风险分层）和4个国家（美国、加拿大、墨西哥、刚果民主共和国）开展独立案例研究。
AI.result: （1）提升美加边境MMR疫苗接种覆盖率预测，捕捉国内模型忽略的跨境行为溢出效应；（2）对心血管病进行临近预报，加速数据可获取性；（3）改进墨西哥市级登革热短期预测，支持及时的病媒控制；（4）改善霍乱热点预测；（5）在模型未见过的美国州为个体产后抑郁风险预测增加可迁移信号，但无法替代个体社会经济数据，也未弥合人口筛查缺口。
AI.conclusion: 这些案例共同展示了地理空间基础模型在公共卫生监测中的能力，可跨领域填补关键监测空白，作为现有流行病学工作流的有效补充。

title: Voltic: Distinguishing Volatility from Stochasticity in Recurrent Memory
summary: Recurrent sequence models must decide how strongly to overwrite their memory at each token. Read as Bayesian filtering, this write is the gain of a Kalman update, set by uncertainty from two sources that pull it in opposite directions: volatility, how quickly the underlying associations change, and stochasticity, how noisy each observation of them is. First, we show that the update of gated delta-rule memories is the form this filter takes under isotropic uncertainty. Next, we introduce Voltic, a recurrent memory that keeps the covariance anisotropic and makes both noise variances input-dependent, so the write is vector-valued and carries uncertainty accumulated over the sequence. A dense covariance would have to be propagated token by token, ruling out the parallel training these models depend on. We therefore give two assumed-density approximations, diagonal and quasi-diagonal, both of which leave the memory update in delta-rule form and reuse its chunked kernels. On controlled recall tasks in which associations change and observations are corrupted, Voltic leads all baselines. On the task combining volatility and stochasticity, its margin over the strongest baseline is larger at both extrapolation sizes than at the training sizes. In 45M-parameter language models it leads an eight-task reasoning average and achieves higher retrieval accuracy beyond the training context length than gated baselines, at throughput close to those baselines. Deriving the write from an uncertainty recursion therefore makes memory more responsive to change.

AI.tldr: 该论文将循环序列模型的门控写入视为贝叶斯滤波中的卡尔曼增益，提出 Voltic——一种保持协方差各向异性、噪声方差输入依赖的循环记忆机制，并通过对角与准对角两种假设密度近似保持 delta-rule 形式以复用分块并行核。实验表明其在受控回忆任务、45M 语言模型推理平均与超训练长度检索上均优于门控基线，且吞吐接近。
AI.motivation: 循环序列模型需要逐 token 决定以多大强度覆写记忆。从贝叶斯滤波视角看，这一写入量即卡尔曼增益，由两个方向相反的噪声来源共同决定：关联变化的波动性（volatility）与观测噪声的随机性（stochasticity）。现有门控 delta-rule 记忆隐含各向同性不确定性假设，无法区分并适应这两类不确定性的输入依赖变化，因而对关联快速变化的场景响应不足。
AI.method: 1) 推导证明门控 delta-rule 记忆的更新等价于各向同性不确定性下的卡尔曼滤波更新形式；2) 提出 Voltic，保持协方差各向异性，并将波动性与随机性两个噪声方差设为输入依赖，使写入量成为携带序列累积不确定性的向量值；3) 为避免逐 token 传播稠密协方差而破坏并行训练，给出对角与准对角两种假设密度近似，二者均使记忆更新保持 delta-rule 形式，从而复用现有分块（chunked）核实现并行训练。
AI.result: 在关联变化且观测被污染的受控回忆任务上，Voltic 领先所有基线；在同时结合波动性与随机性的任务上，相对于最强基线，其在两种外推规模下的领先幅度均大于训练规模下的幅度。在 45M 参数语言模型上，Voltic 在八任务推理平均上领先，并在超出训练上下文长度时取得比门控基线更高的检索准确率，吞吐接近这些基线。
AI.conclusion: 从不确定性递推推导写入量，使记忆对变化更具响应性；Voltic 在保持并行训练效率的同时，通过各向异性、输入依赖的不确定性建模提升了循环记忆的适应性与长上下文检索能力。

title: ReMaD: Tuning-free Domain Adaptation for Classification and Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: We introduce Reduced-rank Mahalanobis Distance (ReMaD), a novel prototypical distance-based refinement to classification and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection using pretrained models without finetuning. We use embeddings of the target dataset to fit closed-form distribution statistics in the model's latent space which can classify in-distribution samples and detect OOD samples, all without training or prior knowledge of the OOD data. Building on prototype classification and OOD detection, we analyze the distribution properties of large pretrained models when processing new datasets; based on this analysis, we formulate a simple modification to Mahalanobis Distance to adapt models' latent space distributions to new domains by removing unused features, without the finetuning or hyperparameter searches required by other adaptation procedures. We demonstrate the efficacy of this method to adapt existing large pretrained image embedding models to new classification domains outside their trained capabilities by testing across four target datasets, with competitive performance in both classification and OOD detection.

AI.tldr: 提出ReMaD（降秩马氏距离），一种无需微调的基于原型的距离度量方法，用于预训练模型的分类与OOD检测，通过去除未使用特征使潜空间分布适配新域。
AI.motivation: 大型预训练模型迁移到新领域时，其潜空间分布与目标数据不匹配，而现有适配方法依赖微调或超参数搜索，成本高且需OOD先验知识。作者希望找到一种无需训练、无需OOD数据先验的简单适配方案。
AI.method: 利用目标数据集嵌入拟合潜空间中的闭式分布统计量；基于对预训练模型处理新数据集时分布特性的分析，对马氏距离进行简单修改（降秩，即去除未使用/冗余特征），从而将模型潜空间分布适配到新域，全程无需微调或超参数搜索，且无需训练或OOD数据先验。
AI.result: 在四个目标数据集上测试，将现有大型预训练图像嵌入模型适配到其训练能力之外的新分类域，在分类与OOD检测两方面均取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: ReMaD为预训练模型的无训练域适配提供了简单有效的途径，兼具分类与OOD检测能力，避免了微调和超参数搜索的开销。

title: PACMI: Provenance-Aware Cascading Memory Invalidation for Long-Term LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents rely on long-term memory to retain and reuse information when performing tasks over long horizons. Existing methods provide limited support for handling memories that become outdated as new observations or domain evidence arrive. Such outdated memories may remain semantically relevant, continue to affect dependent records, and retain value as historical evidence. This calls for two capabilities: dependency tracking to identify downstream effects and historical preservation to retain useful past records. We propose Provenance-Aware Cascading Memory Invalidation (PACMI), a framework that represents memories and new evidence in a provenance graph with typed dependency edges. PACMI assigns records to a four-state validity lattice, propagates validity changes to dependent memories, and uses the resulting states for retrieval and stale-premise detection. We also introduce a diagnostic benchmark with 100 cases and 300 queries across five domains. The evaluation separates node, context-, and answer-level performance. PACMI achieves the highest final-answer accuracy on this benchmark, and its paired difference from the strongest baseline is significant under an exact McNemar test. The premise checker achieves perfect precision, recall, and F 1 on the controlled query distribution. Cascading propagation primarily improves memorystate correctness: removing it increases final-answer errors from 3 to 11, but the paired difference does not reach the 0.05 significance threshold. Code and data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出PACMI框架，用溯源图与四态有效性格管理LLM代理的过期记忆，实现依赖追踪与历史保留，并在新基准上取得最高最终答案准确率，但级联传播的消融差异未达显著。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在长时程任务中依赖长期记忆，但现有方法难以处理因新观察或领域证据而变得过期的记忆。此类过期记忆仍可能语义相关、影响下游记录，并具有历史证据价值，因此需要依赖追踪与历史保留两种能力。
AI.method: 提出Provenance-Aware Cascading Memory Invalidation（PACMI）：将记忆与新证据表示为带类型依赖边的溯源图；把记录分配到四态有效性格；将有效性变化级联传播至依赖记忆；并利用所得状态进行检索与过期前提检测。同时构建含5个领域、100个案例、300条查询的诊断基准，评估分为节点级、上下文级与答案级。
AI.result: PACMI在该基准上取得最高最终答案准确率，与最强基线的配对差异在精确McNemar检验下显著。前提检查器在受控查询分布上达到完美的精确率、召回率与F1。级联传播主要提升记忆状态正确性：移除它使最终答案错误从3增至11，但配对差异未达0.05显著性阈值。
AI.conclusion: PACMI通过溯源感知的级联失效机制有效支持过期记忆处理与检索，最终答案性能显著优于基线，前提检测表现完美；级联传播对记忆状态正确性的贡献明显，但对最终答案的影响在统计上尚不显著，需更大规模验证。

title: CIPHER-MoE: Balancing Efficiency and Routing Fidelity in Trillion-Scale MoE Training
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has been widely adopted in recent large language model (LLM) architectures. However, scaling up MoE in LLM training introduces system-level challenges on training, where non-uniform token routing can lead to highly imbalanced workloads across experts and devices, further destabilizing the training process. With trillion-scale LLMs, imbalanced expert workloads further amplify the resource cost of MoE training, resulting in degraded training efficiency and hardware utilization for underloaded experts, while hot experts require additional resources to accommodate excessive workloads. Recent studies address imbalanced MoE training through intricate parallelism strategies or resource reallocation. However, these system-level approaches often introduce additional resource requirements and considerable orchestration complexity, which become increasingly difficult to afford when training trillion-parameter LLMs under constrained computational resources. This work introduces CIPHER-MoE, which mitigates MoE workload imbalance while keeping the router's token-side Top-K selection unchanged. CIPHER-MoE applies affinity-aware Expert-to-Token filtering with explicit capacity control to reduce hotspot expert workloads without additional hardware resources or complex runtime design. The proposed method has been evaluated on large-scale MoE models, including DeepSeek-V4-Pro, showing up to 64.9 percentage points Top-1 expert workload reduction and 1.10$\times$-1.94$\times$ training acceleration, while preserving the training quality. The source code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: CIPHER-MoE通过亲和力感知的专家到Token过滤与显式容量控制，在不改变路由器Top-K选择的前提下缓解MoE训练负载不均衡，实现最高64.9个百分点热点专家负载降低和1.10–1.94倍训练加速。
AI.motivation: MoE在LLM训练中因非均匀Token路由导致专家与设备间负载高度不均衡，万亿级模型下该问题进一步放大资源开销：冷门专家硬件利用率下降，热点专家需额外资源。现有基于复杂并行策略或资源重分配的系统级方案会引入额外资源需求与高编排复杂度，在算力受限场景下难以承受。
AI.method: 提出CIPHER-MoE，保持路由器Token侧Top-K选择不变，采用亲和力感知的Expert-to-Token过滤（affinity-aware Expert-to-Token filtering）并结合显式容量控制，在不增加硬件资源、不引入复杂运行时设计的情况下削减热点专家负载。
AI.result: 在包括DeepSeek-V4-Pro在内的大规模MoE模型上评估，Top-1专家负载最高降低64.9个百分点，训练加速1.10×–1.94×，同时保持训练质量。
AI.conclusion: CIPHER-MoE以低成本、低复杂度的方式有效缓解MoE训练负载不均衡，兼顾效率与训练质量，为受限算力下训练万亿参数MoE模型提供了实用方案；源码即将开源。

title: Beyond In-Distribution Preservation: Recovering Generalization in Quantized VLAs via Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning
summary: Post-training quantization has been shown to preserve VLA performance under standard evaluation conditions, but whether it preserves the full-precision model's robustness and generalization remains underexplored. In this study, we systematically study the robustness and generalization of post-quantized VLA policies under environmental disturbances. Empirical results show that quantized policies can become fragile to subtle environmental variations despite retaining comparable in-distribution performance. We further observe that action discrepancies are concentrated in a small subset of rollout states, while teacher guidance has opposite effects depending on discrepancy: it improves generalization at high-discrepancy states but can degrade it at low-discrepancy states. These findings reveal that effective post-quantization recovery requires selectively intervening on vulnerable states rather than globally distilling the student. We therefore propose Policy-Induced Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning (PIVOT-Q), a vulnerability-aware On-Policy Distillation (OPD) framework that selectively corrects vulnerable states encountered during quantized-student rollouts using the frozen full-precision policy as a teacher. PIVOT-Q identifies vulnerable states using discounted accumulated discrepancies over a short horizon, applies phase-balanced sparse supervision, and uses a Behavioral Anchor to prevent unnecessary changes. Experiments under seven LIBERO-Plus environmental variations demonstrate consistent recovery across multiple VLA backbones and quantization methods. Notably, PIVOT-Q consistently outperforms full-state distillation across all settings while using only 7.4% of its state-level distillation budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/ruanruan-andy/PIVOT-Q.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究后训练量化VLA策略在环境扰动下的鲁棒性与泛化性，发现量化策略虽保持分布内性能但对细微环境变化脆弱，动作差异集中于少量rollout状态。据此提出PIVOT-Q：基于脆弱状态选择性干预的在线策略蒸馏框架，在LIBERO-Plus七种环境变化下以仅7.4%的蒸馏预算超越全状态蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化被证明在标准评测下能保持VLA性能，但其是否保留全精度模型的鲁棒性与泛化能力尚缺乏研究。作者希望揭示量化策略在环境扰动下的脆弱性根源，并找到比全局蒸馏更高效的恢复方案。
AI.method: 提出PIVOT-Q（Policy-Induced Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning），一种脆弱性感知的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）框架：以冻结的全精度策略为教师，仅对量化学生rollout中遇到的脆弱状态进行选择性纠正。具体用短时域上的折扣累积差异识别脆弱状态，采用阶段平衡的稀疏监督，并用行为锚点（Behavioral Anchor）防止不必要的改动。
AI.result: 在七种LIBERO-Plus环境变化下、跨多种VLA骨干与量化方法均实现一致的性能恢复；PIVOT-Q在所有设置下持续优于全状态蒸馏，且仅使用其状态级蒸馏预算的7.4%。
AI.conclusion: 量化策略的鲁棒性恢复需对脆弱状态选择性干预而非全局蒸馏；教师指导在高差异状态提升泛化、在低差异状态反而损害泛化，验证了选择性监督的必要性。PIVOT-Q为量化VLA策略的鲁棒性恢复提供了高效且通用的方案。

title: AdaSpark: Adaptive DSpark with Online Learning for Tree Verification and N-gram Fill
summary:
Block drafters such as DSpark propose ranked candidates for several positions in one forward pass, and a tree verifier checks them in one pass of the target. The number of rows to verify trades the tokens a wider tree is expected to accept against the time a wider verify takes. Most schedulers that choose this number take the verify time from a table or model measured before serving, corrected online by at most one scale factor, and take acceptance from the drafter's confidence estimates or from a map fitted offline.
  AdaSpark learns both quantities while it serves, with no profile, calibration or sweep in advance. It learns which verify widths are worth offering and fits each one's verify time as a function of context. It fits each candidate's acceptance probability to the target's verify outcomes, with the drafter's confidence head as one input, and orders and sizes the tree by that fit instead of by the head. The same model prices n-gram continuations of the request's own text, so drafted and text-derived candidates compete for rows in one best-first order. The width is chosen by pricing time at the long-run decode rate.
  On single- and multi-turn conversations from six public datasets, on three dense targets and one mixture-of-experts target, AdaSpark decodes 1.5-3.1x faster than llama.cpp's DSpark with the same drafters. Our imparo engine with AdaSpark is 1.17-1.52x faster than imparo running with a three-token chain (the default llama.cpp setting); this gain comes from the scheduler alone. Without a width sweep, AdaSpark is never more than 0.3% slower than the best pinned tree width on any dense target or context band. On the mixture-of-experts target it ties the best pinned width, and the other pinned widths from 4 to 16 rows are 5-14% slower.

AI.tldr: AdaSpark 是一种在线自学习的投机解码调度器，在服务过程中同时学习验证宽度价值与各宽度验证时间、以及候选接受概率，无需预先剖析或调参，即可实现 1.5–3.1 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有块状草稿（如 DSpark）在前向中提出多个位置的排名候选，由树验证器一次验证。验证行数需在"更宽的树预期接受的 token 收益"与"更宽验证的耗时"之间权衡。但多数调度器依赖服务前测得的验证时间表/模型（在线仅用单一缩放因子修正），接受概率则取自草稿器置信度或离线拟合映射，缺乏自适应与准确性。
AI.method: AdaSpark 在服务过程中在线学习两个量，无需预剖析、校准或扫参。其一，学习哪些验证宽度值得采用，并将各宽度的验证时间拟合为上下文的函数；其二，将每个候选的接受概率拟合到目标模型的验证结果上，以草稿器置信度头作为输入之一，并据此（而非置信度头）对树进行排序与定尺。同一模型还为请求自身文本的 n-gram 续写定价，使草稿候选与文本派生候选在统一的最佳优先顺序中竞争验证行。宽度选择通过按长期解码速率对时间定价完成。
AI.result: 在六个公开数据集的单轮与多轮对话上，针对三个稠密目标和一个混合专家目标，AdaSpark 在相同草稿器下比 llama.cpp 的 DSpark 解码快 1.5–3.1 倍。搭载 AdaSpark 的 imparo 引擎比使用三 token 链（llama.cpp 默认设置）的 imparo 快 1.17–1.52 倍，且该增益完全来自调度器。无需宽度扫参，AdaSpark 在任何稠密目标或上下文区间上比最佳固定树宽度最多慢不超过 0.3%。在混合专家目标上，它与最佳固定宽度持平，而 4 到 16 行的其他固定宽度慢 5–14%。
AI.conclusion: AdaSpark 通过在线学习验证时间与接受概率，并统一调度草稿与文本派生候选，消除了对预剖析、离线校准和宽度扫参的依赖，在多种目标与对话场景下稳定优于 DSpark 与默认设置，且接近最佳固定宽度的性能上界。

title: Image resolution enhancement for advanced semiconductor nodes
summary: Advanced semiconductor nodes are pushing the limits of feature sizes and require metrology with sub-nm resolution without compromising on the throughput as needed for in-line process control. Recently, high-throughput scanning probe microscopy (SPM) based metrology and inspection tools capable of meeting these needs have been introduced to the market and qualified for use in HVM. While innovative measurement methods and tool architecture have allowed for a leap of improvement in throughput, the next step in further reducing imaging time can be obtained through the application of machine learning for enhancing the resolution of measured images for extraction of relevant parameters. In this work, we provide the general framework under which a neural network-based resolution enhancer is designed and used for SPM images. We showcase the effectiveness of this framework using measurements performed on Line/Space structures with a pitch of 200 nm. For the reusability of a pre-developed pre-trained model, we additionally leverage transfer learning and show that a new model for slightly differing structures can be re-trained and calibrated with a smaller data set of measurements performed on Line/Space structures with a pitch of 100 nm.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出基于神经网络的SPM图像分辨率增强框架，通过迁移学习实现预训练模型复用，在100/200 nm线宽结构测量中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 先进半导体节点要求亚纳米分辨率且不牺牲在线工艺控制所需的吞吐量。尽管高通量SPM量测与检测设备已进入HVM，进一步缩短成像时间仍需新手段；用机器学习增强已测图像分辨率以提取关键参数成为下一步方向。
AI.method: 设计了基于神经网络的SPM图像分辨率增强器并给出通用框架；在200 nm间距的Line/Space结构测量上验证框架有效性；进一步引入迁移学习，用小规模100 nm间距Line/Space测量数据对模型进行再训练与校准，实现预训练模型复用。
AI.result: 框架在200 nm间距Line/Space结构测量中显示出有效性；通过迁移学习，针对略有差异的100 nm间距结构的新模型可用更小数据集完成再训练与校准。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络分辨率增强结合迁移学习可在不改变硬件的前提下降低SPM成像时间，并为不同结构提供可复用、低成本的数据高效建模路径，适用于HVM在线量测。

title: Feature identification for parameter extraction and defect detection using machine learning
summary: Process control of advanced semiconductor nodes is not only pushing the limits of metrology equipment requirements in terms of resolution and throughput but also in terms of the richness of data to be extracted to enable engineers to finetune the process steps for increased yield. The move towards 3D structures requires extraction of critical dimension parameters from structures which can vary largely from layer to layer. For in-line process control, the necessary automation forces the development of layer and equipment-specific dedicated image processing algorithms. Similarly, with the increase in stochastic defects in the EUV era, detection of defects at the nm scale requires the identification of features captured in low resolution to meet the throughput requirements of HVM fabs, which can again lead to custom algorithm development. With the emergence of ML-based image processing methods, this process of algorithm development for both cases can be accelerated. In this work, we provide the general framework under which the images obtained from high-speed scanning probe microscopy-based systems can be used to train a network for either feature detection for parameter extraction or defect identification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个通用框架，利用高速扫描探针显微镜（SPM）图像训练机器学习网络，用于三维结构的特征检测与参数提取，以及 EUV 时代 nm 级缺陷识别，以加速专用图像处理算法的开发。
AI.motivation: 先进半导体节点的工艺控制对量测设备提出更高要求：不仅需提升分辨率与吞吐量，还需提取更丰富的数据以帮助工程师微调工艺步骤、提高良率。三维结构的层间关键尺寸差异大，在线工艺控制所需的自动化迫使开发针对特定层与设备的专用图像处理算法；同时 EUV 时代随机缺陷增多，为满足 HVM 晶圆厂吞吐需求，需在低分辨率图像中识别特征以检测 nm 级缺陷，同样导致定制算法开发。ML 图像处理方法为加速这两类算法开发提供了契机。
AI.method: 提出一个通用框架，将高速扫描探针显微镜（SPM）系统采集的图像用于训练神经网络，分别面向特征检测（用于参数提取）与缺陷识别两类任务。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据或定量结果，仅阐述该框架可加速上述两类应用场景下的算法开发。
AI.conclusion: 基于高速 SPM 图像训练网络的通用框架，可同时支撑三维结构的关键尺寸参数提取与低分辨率下的 nm 级缺陷识别，从而加速专用图像处理算法的开发。

title: Usefulness of Quantile-Aware Diffusion Modeling for Highly Imbalanced Tabular Data
summary: Classification problem in the context of highly imbalanced data is a major challenge in many real-world applications (e.g., FinTech, healthcare, etc.). In these cases, the vast majority of instances belong to a single class and a small fraction represent the minority class (often the most critical class). Recently, diffusion models have emerged as powerful approaches to reduce the degree of ``imbalanced-ness'' in the dataset; they work by generating synthetic data by capturing complex data distributions using iterative transformations. However, standard diffusion models are not inherently suited to highly skewed or heavy-tailed data, due to inbuilt quadratic error loss, which lacks the structural sensitivity to capture rare, extreme values, and minority-class nuances. We propose a novel approach, namely, Quantile-TabDDPM, based on a quantile-regularized denoising objective that combines the standard quadratic error loss with a quantile loss term to explicitly capture rare events while preserving the theoretical grounding of the original denoising objective. We extensively evaluated our approach on a real-world credit card transaction dataset characterized by extreme class imbalance. The results demonstrate that the integration of diffusion-based synthetic data generation with a quantile-regularized denoising objective provides a robust and effective framework for fraud detection in highly imbalanced datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出Quantile-TabDDPM，用量化正则化去噪目标改进扩散模型，生成合成数据以缓解极端类别不平衡，在信用卡欺诈检测数据集上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 高度不平衡数据分类是金融科技、医疗等领域的重大挑战，少数类往往最关键。扩散模型虽可通过迭代变换生成合成数据来降低不平衡程度，但标准扩散模型依赖二次误差损失，缺乏结构敏感性，难以捕捉稀有极端值和少数类细微特征，不适合高度偏斜或重尾数据。
AI.method: 提出Quantile-TabDDPM，基于量化正则化去噪目标，将标准二次误差损失与量化损失项相结合，显式捕捉稀有事件，同时保留原始去噪目标的理论基础。
AI.result: 在具有极端类别不平衡的真实信用卡交易数据集上进行了广泛评估。
AI.conclusion: 扩散式合成数据生成与量化正则化去噪目标的结合，为高度不平衡数据集中的欺诈检测提供了稳健有效的框架。

title: Selecting Long-Horizon Trajectories for Reliable and Efficient Terminal-Agent Training
summary: Terminal agents are commonly trained by imitating long teacher trajectories, yet how much of each trajectory to supervise remains unexplored. We study the \emph{supervision horizon}, the number of trajectory tokens retained for training, and show that it is a key design axis for reliability and cost. Reliability improves with longer horizons but saturates: on Terminal-Bench, a 12K-token horizon solves more tasks than 16K ($29\pm0.7$ vs.\ $26\pm0.8$) while requiring 30\% less training time. The horizon also shapes agent behavior: short horizons cause premature termination, intermediate horizons yield productive error recovery, and long horizons induce over-persistence. We analyze this saturation through a bias--complexity bound, in which longer supervision reduces temporal supervision bias but increases finite-sample estimation error from more heterogeneous late-stage histories. Guided by this analysis, we propose \emph{selective long-horizon refinement}, which first trains on short prefixes and then refines only on continuations that are most likely under the warm-start model. It consistently outperforms full long-horizon training. At 16K, it raises successful attempts from $110\pm2.7$ to $126\pm2.1$ and tasks solved in at least six of eight attempts from $9\pm0.7$ to $14\pm0.6$; with half of the long-horizon data, it still reaches $122\pm2.4$ while cutting training time by 23\%. The gains transfer across benchmarks, from $64\pm2.6$ to $73\pm2.1$ on Terminal-Bench v2.0 and from $137\pm2.7$ to $155\pm2.2$ on OpenThoughts-TBLite. For long-horizon supervision, selecting the right trajectories matters more than training on all of them.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"监督视野"（训练保留的轨迹token数）对终端智能体可靠性与成本的影响，发现可靠性随视野增长而饱和，并提出"选择性长视野精炼"方法，先短前缀训练、再仅对暖启动模型下高概率的续写进行精炼，性能优于全量长视野训练且成本更低。
AI.motivation: 终端智能体通常通过模仿长教师轨迹训练，但每条轨迹应监督多少比例尚未被探索，监督视野这一关键设计轴对可靠性与训练成本的影响缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 定义监督视野为保留训练的轨迹token数，系统考察不同视野长度对性能的影响；通过偏差-复杂度界分析饱和现象（长监督降低时间监督偏差，但增加有限样本估计误差）；据此提出选择性长视野精炼（selective long-horizon refinement）：先用短前缀训练，再仅在暖启动模型下最可能的续写上精炼。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench上，12K视野（29±0.7）比16K（26±0.8）解决更多任务且训练时间少30%。短视野导致过早终止，中等视野产生有效错误恢复，长视野导致过度坚持。16K下方法将成功尝试从110±2.7提升至126±2.1，八次中至少六次成功的任务从9±0.7提升至14±0.6；仅用一半长视野数据仍达122±2.4并减少23%训练时间。跨基准迁移：Terminal-Bench v2.0从64±2.6提升至73±2.1，OpenThoughts-TBLite从137±2.7提升至155±2.2。
AI.conclusion: 监督视野是可靠性与成本的关键设计轴，可靠性随视野增长而饱和；对于长视野监督，选择正确的轨迹比使用全部轨迹更重要，选择性长视野精炼可持续优于全量训练且更高效。

title: HiER-BLS: A Hierarchy-Guided and Error-Correcting Robust Incremental Broad Learning System
summary: Broad Learning System (BLS) supports analytical training and incremental expansion, but its growth needs guidance on which inputs new blocks should learn from. Weight errors pose a further challenge by displacing learned outputs across class boundaries. We propose HiER-BLS to couple hierarchy-guided representation growth with error-correcting learning. Successive blocks focus on inputs selected by feature importance and correlation while preserving earlier representations. The evolving branch guides encoded learners through subspace size and sample confidence, so its learning experience informs both their feature views and supervision. For finite broad readouts, we show how codeword correlations transform fitted class scores. Prediction preservation depends on the distance from the actual output to the nearest decoding boundary relative to the model's sensitivity to weight errors. Experiments on five image and five tabular datasets demonstrate improved classification performance over representative BLS variants. Component studies show that hierarchy guidance benefits the encoded branch even when the guiding branch has lower standalone accuracy, with further gains from combining their scores. Longer codes continue to improve accuracy under stronger Gaussian weight errors after clean accuracy has largely saturated.

AI.tldr: 提出HiER-BLS，将层次引导的表示增长与纠错学习耦合，在5个图像与5个表格数据集上优于代表性BLS变体。
AI.motivation: BLS虽支持解析训练与增量扩展，但新增块应向哪些输入学习缺乏指导；同时权重误差会使已学输出跨越类别边界，导致预测偏移。
AI.method: 利用特征重要性与相关性筛选输入，使连续块聚焦这些输入并保留早期表示；演化分支通过子空间大小与样本置信度引导编码学习器，使其学习经验同时塑造特征视图与监督信号。对有限宽带读出，分析码字相关性如何变换拟合的类别得分，并给出预测保持条件：取决于实际输出到最近解码边界的距离相对于模型对权重误差敏感度的比值。
AI.result: 在五个图像和五个表格数据集上分类性能优于代表性BLS变体；组件研究表明，即使引导分支单独精度较低，层次引导仍有益于编码分支，结合两者得分可获进一步提升；在干净精度基本饱和后，更长码字在更强高斯权重误差下仍持续改善精度。
AI.conclusion: 层次引导的表示增长与纠错学习相结合，可有效提升BLS的分类鲁棒性；码长增加对权重误差下的预测保持具有持续增益。

title: CACFG: Curvature-Aware Classifier-Free Guidance and Optimal Control
summary: Diffusion models generate samples by learning to reverse a fixed corruption process, and classifier-free guidance (CFG) is the standard mechanism for conditioning this process on a desired class or prompt. CFG can be applied at varying guidance strengths, and while higher strengths improve image quality and conditional alignment, too high a guidance strength can degrade image quality and diversity. Furthermore, CFG violates principled diffusion sampling dynamics, and existing explanations for why it works despite the violation disagree on the underlying theory or do not extend to deterministic samplers used in practice. We address both these issues. We first frame CFG sampling as a continuous-time optimal control problem, treating the sampling trajectory as a sequence of controls chosen to maximise the probability of the desired condition. Solving the resulting Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation shows that CFG is recovered under specific path costs when using an unconstrained control set. We argue this lack of constraint is responsible for CFG's failure at high guidance strengths, since it permits the sampling path to move arbitrarily far from the current image estimate. To fix this, we propose curvature-aware CFG (CACFG), which constrains the control set to a hypersphere informed by the Gaussian regularisation used when training variational autoencoders. We show that the control inputs produced by CFG sampling routinely violate this bound, and that across diffusion models, datasets, and guidance schedules, CACFG achieves superior generative quality at mid-to-high guidance strengths with a less severe quality-diversity tradeoff than regular CFG.

AI.tldr: 将无分类器引导（CFG）采样建模为连续时间最优控制问题，揭示CFG在无约束控制集下对应特定路径代价的解，并据此提出曲率感知CFG（CACFG）以修复高引导强度下的质量退化。
AI.motivation: CFG是扩散模型条件生成的标准机制：提高引导强度可改善图像质量与条件对齐，但过高强度会损害质量与多样性。同时CFG违背了原则性的扩散采样动力学，现有解释在理论上互相分歧，且不适用于实践中使用的确定性采样器，因此需要统一的理论框架并解决高强度失效问题。
AI.method: 把CFG采样刻画为连续时间最优控制问题，将采样轨迹视为一系列为使目标条件概率最大化而选择的控制量；求解相应的Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman方程，证明在无约束控制集与特定路径代价下可恢复出CFG。基于无约束控制允许采样路径任意远离当前图像估计这一观察，提出CACFG，参照变分自编码器训练中的高斯正则化，将控制集约束到一个超球面上。
AI.result: 分析显示CFG采样产生的控制输入普遍违反该超球面边界（即越界）；实验表明在多种扩散模型、数据集与引导调度下，CACFG在中高引导强度处取得更优的生成质量，且质量–多样性权衡的恶化程度比常规CFG更轻。
AI.conclusion: CFG的高引导强度失效可归因于控制集缺乏约束，最优控制视角为CFG提供了统一解释；通过引入基于高斯正则化的超球面控制约束，CACFG在保持条件对齐的同时显著缓解了质量–多样性权衡，验证了该理论诊断的有效性。

title: RepICL: Reusable In-Context Prediction Across Heterogeneous Representation Spaces
summary: Frozen representations are widely reused for downstream classification, yet each new task typically requires fitting a new predictor. We ask whether the few-shot prediction procedure itself can instead be learned once and reused across datasets and representation spaces. To study this question, we introduce RepShiftBench, comprising 1,218 encoder--dataset tasks across text, image, and audio, with separate evaluation of generalization to unseen datasets, unseen encoders, jointly unseen datasets and encoders, and unseen modalities. The benchmark exposes a substantial gap: Logistic Regression fitted independently on each episode outperforms every evaluated in-context learner across all settings. We introduce RepICL, a meta-trained in-context learner that canonicalizes each episode through episodic whitening before prediction. Its inductive variant, RepICL-I, surpasses Logistic Regression in all 12 benchmark settings, while RepICL-T substantially outperforms existing transductive methods. Ablations identify episodic whitening as the primary source of these gains, while showing that it is not a universally beneficial preprocessing step. Across both variants, the gains concentrate on queries for which simple support prototypes favor the wrong class or provide little separation between the true class and competing classes. Transduction provides its largest additional gains when limited support coverage gives a misleading view of class separation. Together, these results demonstrate that a shared few-shot prediction procedure can generalize beyond the representation spaces observed during training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RepShiftBench 基准（1,218 个编码器-数据集任务，覆盖文本、图像、音频）与元训练上下文学习器 RepICL，通过 episodic whitening 使共享的少样本预测流程可跨数据集与表征空间复用，RepICL-I 在全部 12 个设定下超越逻辑回归。
AI.motivation: 冻结表征被广泛复用于下游分类，但每个新任务通常仍需重新拟合一个预测器。作者希望探究：少样本预测过程本身能否被一次性学习并跨数据集、跨表征空间复用。
AI.method: 构建 RepShiftBench 基准，包含 1,218 个编码器-数据集任务，覆盖文本、图像、音频，并分别评估对未见数据集、未见编码器、数据集与编码器联合未见、以及未见模态的泛化。提出 RepICL：一个元训练的上下文学习器，在预测前通过 episodic whitening 对每个 episode 进行规范化。其归纳式变体为 RepICL-I，直推式变体为 RepICL-T。并通过消融分析定位增益来源。
AI.result: 基准揭示显著差距：逐 episode 独立拟合的逻辑回归在所有设定下均优于所有被评估的上下文学习器。RepICL-I 在全部 12 个基准设定中超越逻辑回归，RepICL-T 显著优于现有直推式方法。消融表明 episodic whitening 是主要增益来源，但它并非普遍有益的预处理步骤。增益集中于简单支持原型指向错误类别、或真实类与竞争类之间分离度不足的查询；当支持集覆盖有限导致类别分离被误判时，直推式方法带来最大的额外收益。
AI.conclusion: 共享的少样本预测流程可以泛化到训练时未见过的表征空间，说明将预测过程本身作为可复用组件学习是可行的，且 episodic whitening 是关键机制。

title: TurboPairFormer: Fast and Stable Protein Folding Model Training with an Optimized Triangle Attention Kernel
summary: Triangular attention is a core computation in AlphaFold3-style biomolecular models, with cubic cost in token count. Its shared pair bias adds a gradient reduction across attention slices to the usual reductions over queries and keys. The open-source backends we examine handle these reductions through repeated probability recomputation, floating-point atomics, or full score-gradient storage. Separately, computing the softmax backward correction from BF16-rounded forward outputs loses numerical precision. We present TurboPairFormer, a triangular attention implementation for NVIDIA Hopper GPUs that addresses both issues. Our key-tile-parallel backward algorithm recomputes each probability tile once for the query, key, value, and pair-bias gradients, using ordered partial reductions for deterministic accumulation without floating-point atomics or full score-gradient storage. Output-residual compensation retains a BF16 approximation of the output-rounding residual to compute the backward correction more accurately in FP32, without changing the BF16 output. With BF16 inputs at crop sizes 384, 640, and 768 and head dimensions 16 and 32, TurboPairFormer achieves the lowest mean query, key, and pair-bias gradient RMSE against an FP64 reference among the implementations compared in this paper. Residual compensation reduces these RMSE values by 28-47% in controlled ablations. All four gradients are bitwise identical across five repeated calls in all 600 input cases under fixed execution conditions. Integrated into OpenFold3 with our triangle multiplication kernels, TurboPairFormer achieves the lowest GPU computation time per optimizer step among the evaluated backend configurations on 16 H100 GPUs, with speedups of $1.73\times$ over OpenFold3's Triton backend and $1.13\times$ over cuEquivariance at crop size 768.

AI.tldr: TurboPairFormer：面向Hopper GPU的三角注意力实现，通过key-tile并行反向算法与输出残差补偿，实现高效、确定且数值精确的梯度计算。
AI.motivation: AlphaFold3式模型的三角注意力计算成本随token数呈立方增长；其共享pair bias在query、key归约之外引入跨注意力切片的梯度归约。现有开源后端通过重复概率重算、浮点原子操作或完整score-gradient存储来处理这些归约，效率或内存受限；同时从BF16舍入后的前向输出计算softmax反向修正会损失数值精度。
AI.method: 提出TurboPairFormer。关键tile并行反向算法：每个概率tile仅重算一次，同时用于query、key、value和pair-bias梯度，采用有序部分归约实现确定性累加，避免浮点原子操作与完整score-gradient存储；输出残差补偿：保留输出舍入残差的BF16近似，以FP32更精确地计算反向修正，而不改变BF16输出。
AI.result: 在BF16输入、crop size为384/640/768、head dim为16/32下，对FP64参考取得最低的query、key、pair-bias梯度平均RMSE；残差补偿在受控消融中使RMSE降低28-47%。固定执行条件下，全部600个输入案例、五次重复调用的四种梯度均逐位一致。集成到OpenFold3后，在16块H100上取得最低的单优化器步GPU计算时间，crop size 768时相对OpenFold3 Triton后端加速1.73倍，相对cuEquivariance加速1.13倍。
AI.conclusion: TurboPairFormer通过tile并行重算、有序部分归约与输出残差补偿，在保证确定性与数值精度的同时显著提升三角注意力的训练效率，优于现有开源后端。

title: CCQ: A Multi-State Child Care Quality Dataset to Support AI for Children's Health Research
comment: 29 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/GAIN-Lab/CCQ ; Code: https://github.com/Veeeeeee7/CCQ
summary: High-quality child care in early life is a critical determinant of children's growth and development. Research on child care quality has been constrained by fragmented, non-research-friendly, and privacy-bound datasets. We present CCQ (Child Care Quality), a large-scale, de-identified dataset for applied data science research at the intersection of AI and early childhood health. CCQ integrates 59,372 child care provider records across 12 U.S. states, covering diverse provider types as well as data schemas. To ensure research utility while protecting privacy, we implement an automated, LLM-based curation pipeline that anonymizes, cleans, and standardizes raw state records into two complementary releases: a cleaned textual release and a fully preprocessed tabular release. We also benchmark traditional machine learning models, tabular foundation models, and language models on quality rating prediction and important features analytics. Within a state, tabular classifiers on the preprocessed tables perform best. Across states, zero-shot transfer is near chance, but modest target-state supervision recovers most of the within-state performance, and pretraining on other states benefits finetuned language models. We release both datasets with all code to accelerate AI-driven research on child care quality and ultimately improve children's health and development.

AI.tldr: 本文发布CCQ数据集，整合美国12州59,372条托育机构记录，通过LLM自动化流程匿名化并标准化，提供文本与表格两版数据，并对质量评级预测进行多模型基准评测。
AI.motivation: 高质量托育是儿童早期发展的关键决定因素，但相关研究受制于数据碎片化、不利于研究使用以及隐私限制等问题。
AI.method: 构建CCQ大规模去标识化数据集，整合12个州、59,372条托育机构记录，涵盖多种机构类型与数据模式；采用基于LLM的自动化策展流程对原始州记录进行匿名化、清洗与标准化，产出清洗文本版与预处理表格版两个版本。
AI.result: 在质量评级预测与重要特征分析任务上，评测了传统机器学习模型、表格基础模型与语言模型。州内任务中，基于预处理表格的表格分类器表现最佳；跨州零样本迁移接近随机水平，但少量目标州监督即可恢复大部分州内性能，且在其他州预训练可提升微调语言模型的效果。
AI.conclusion: 公开发布两个数据集及全部代码，以加速AI驱动的托育质量研究，最终促进儿童健康与发展。

title: Off-Policy Merging Beats On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continual Learning
summary: A long-standing goal of AI is a model that can continually learn and improve itself. On post-trained models, supervised finetuning (SFT) on new data often causes poor generalization and catastrophic forgetting. As such, the conventional wisdom is that on-policy training is a prerequisite for continual learning. In practice, however, data containing new knowledge or capabilities are often off-policy. While methods such as on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) try to bridge this gap by converting off-policy data into on-policy signal, they have been shown to cause reasoning collapse. In this paper, we show that off-policy merging beats OPSD for continual learning. We first show that SFT learns a useful signal from new data, but naively applying its update interferes with existing capabilities. We reduce this interference with a simple recipe we term grafting, which changes where the update is learned and how it is applied: (1) learning the update on an earlier donor checkpoint, ideally even before the end of pretraining, and applying the weight update to the post-trained model; (2) scaling the weight update, equivalent to a form of model merging; and (3) optionally, masking the most sensitive update directions when the new data distribution is far from the post-trained model. Across continual learning settings including (1) distilling from expert traces, (2) self-improvement with STaR and Pedagogical RL, and (3) injecting knowledge after pretraining cutoff, grafting Pareto-dominates both SFT and OPSD in new-task and old-task performance, while avoiding expensive on-policy sampling. Therefore, our work challenges on-policy training as a necessity for continual learning on RL-trained models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"grafting"方法，通过将SFT更新学习于更早的donor checkpoint并缩放/掩码权重更新，实现off-policy continual learning，在多项设置下Pareto优于SFT和OPSD。
AI.motivation: AI持续学习长期目标受困于：对post-trained模型做SFT会导致泛化差与灾难性遗忘，因此传统观点认为on-policy训练是持续学习的必要条件。但现实中新知识/能力数据常为off-policy，OPSD等方法转换off-policy为on-policy信号却导致推理崩溃。
AI.method: 提出grafting配方，核心改变更新学习位置与应用方式：(1)在更早的donor checkpoint（甚至预训练结束前）学习更新，再应用到post-trained模型；(2)缩放权重更新，等价于模型合并；(3)当新数据分布远离post-trained模型时，可选掩码最敏感的更新方向。
AI.result: 在包括(1)从专家轨迹蒸馏、(2)用STaR和Pedagogical RL自我改进、(3)预训练截止后注入知识等持续学习设置中，grafting在新任务和旧任务性能上均Pareto优于SFT和OPSD，并避免了昂贵的on-policy采样。
AI.conclusion: 该工作挑战了on-policy训练是RL-trained模型持续学习必要条件的传统观点，表明off-policy merging优于OPSD。

title: OGAM: Connecting Systematic Testing to Runtime Assurance through Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring for VLA Policies
summary: Benchmarks expose vision-language-action (VLA) policies to few canonical instructions, while exhaustive deployment testing is impossible. We introduce Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring (OGAM), connecting systematic testing to runtime assurance: testing reveals attention divergence between successful and failed executions, and OGAM uses this signal to stop failures beyond the finite suite. We generate scene-grounded instructions through pairwise combinations of action templates and objects, and separately test meaning-preserving paraphrases. All 87 out-of-benchmark cases reveal problematic behavior across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, UniVLA, and $π_{0.5}$: none completes any of the 24 feasible instructions, while infeasible or hazardous requests also trigger behavior substitution. At each action query, we project gradient-weighted visual attention through object masks and group it by instruction role for comparison across tasks and policies. Dynamic time warping aligns this course with a successful reference despite speed differences; conformal calibration on successful episodes sets the early-stopping threshold for sustained deviations, with a nominal false-stop target of $α=0.05$. Across four policies, OGAM stops 87-100% of failed episodes at median times of 5-12s within a 20s budget, with observed false-stop rates of 3-5%, without failure-labeled training. Finite testing thus identifies attention patterns that support online intervention before failure fully unfolds.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OGAM方法，将系统化测试与运行时保障相连：测试揭示成功与失败执行间的注意力差异，OGAM利用该信号在有限测试集之外停止失败。87个基准外案例显示四种VLA策略均存在严重问题，OGAM在无失败标注训练下可停止87-100%的失败回合。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略基准仅暴露于少量规范指令，而穷尽的部署测试不可行；需要一种机制把有限的系统化测试结果转化为运行时保障，以在超出有限测试套件的场景中提前阻止失败。
AI.method: 通过对动作模板与物体进行成对组合生成场景接地指令，并单独测试语义保持的复述句。在每个动作查询处，将梯度加权的视觉注意力经物体掩码投影，并按指令角色分组进行跨任务、跨策略比较。用动态时间规整（DTW）将该过程与成功参考对齐以消除速度差异，并在成功回合上做保形校准，设定持续偏差的早停阈值（名义误停目标α=0.05）。
AI.result: 全部87个基准外案例中，OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、UniVLA和π_{0.5}均表现有问题：无一完成24条可行指令，不可行或危险请求也会触发行为替换。跨四种策略，OGAM在20s预算内以5-12s的中位时间停止87-100%的失败回合，实测误停率为3-5%，且无需失败标注训练。
AI.conclusion: 有限的系统化测试能够识别出支持在线干预的注意力模式，从而在失败完全展开之前进行干预；注意力监测可作为连接测试与运行时保障的有效桥梁。

title: The Optimization Landscape of Learning Compacted Context Models
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents
summary: Many works approach continual learning through the lens of infinite context windows. As an agent puts more observation into context (concretely the KV cache), compacting said context is akin to direct memory manipulation, without affecting the base model's weights. Many works pose KV compaction as an optimization problem: learn a smaller set of KV vectors that matches the behavior of the full KV cache. While this preserves base model behavior, optimizing through a frozen base model results in a highly nontrivial optimization problem with a brittle and flat loss landscape. In this paper, we characterize what makes these optimization problems difficult and demonstrate that a heavily simplified Perceiver-based architecture not only matches performance of a full Perceiver transformer in continuous context compaction, but outperforms baselines on compaction utility. Results are presented on MCQ tasks across Finance, Legal, Gutenberg, and Code.

AI.tldr: 该论文将KV缓存压缩视为对基础模型记忆的直接操作，指出通过冻结基础模型优化压缩向量会形成病态且平坦的损失景观；作者刻画了该优化难点，并提出一种大幅简化的Perceiver架构，在连续上下文压缩中不仅达到完整Perceiver transformer的性能，还在压缩效用上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 持续学习常被类比为无限上下文窗口问题，将观测不断写入KV缓存；压缩KV缓存相当于在不改变基础模型权重的前提下直接操纵记忆。已有方法将KV压缩建模为学习一小组KV向量以复现完整KV缓存行为，但需通过冻结的基础模型进行优化，导致优化问题极为困难、损失景观平坦且脆弱。
AI.method: 作者首先分析并刻画使这类KV压缩优化问题困难的原因；随后设计并采用一种高度简化的Perceiver-based架构进行连续上下文压缩，并与完整Perceiver transformer及若干基线方法进行比较。
AI.result: 简化的Perceiver架构在连续上下文压缩任务上匹配完整Perceiver transformer的性能，并在压缩效用上优于基线方法。实验在Finance、Legal、Gutenberg和Code四类领域的多选题（MCQ）任务上进行评估。
AI.conclusion: 通过简化架构而非在冻结基础模型上求解复杂优化，可更有效地实现KV缓存压缩；这表明针对压缩器本身的结构设计可能比直接优化压缩向量更为关键。

title: Collaborative Personalized Preference Alignment for LLMs under Data Deficiency
summary: Real-world users often exhibit highly heterogeneous preferences over multiple objectives for LLM responses. A lightweight aligner can tailor these responses to individual preferences, but scarce user-specific feedback makes personalized training difficult. Learning shared initializations across users can support few-shot adaptation. However, heterogeneous preferences and competing objectives cause gradient conflicts across users and within each user, hindering effective initialization learning. This raises a central question: \textbf{how can we collaboratively learn aligner initializations that support few-shot adaptation to diverse user preferences?} To answer this question, we propose \textbf{A}pproximate \textbf{P}areto \textbf{O}ptimality (APO). We first group users whose updates are compatible, so that their information can be combined with less interference. Within each group, we combine gradient descent with controlled ascent to coordinate competing objectives and move towards preference-specific points on the Pareto front. This produces an initialization that is close to the optima of the users in the group. We then iteratively refine it using updates from few-shot local adaptation, making it more effective for personalization. Furthermore, we establish conditional suboptimality bounds for a one-local-step collaborative update and characterize how initialization error affects subsequent stochastic adaptation. Experiments on Fed-ChatbotPA and UltraFeedback show consistent improvements over existing methods using only 20 local examples.

AI.tldr: 提出 APO 方法，通过用户分组与梯度下降-受控上升协调多目标梯度冲突，协作学习对齐器初始化，实现仅需 20 条本地样本的少样本个性化对齐。
AI.motivation: LLM 响应的个性化对齐面临用户偏好高度异质、用户特定反馈稀缺的难题；跨用户学习共享初始化可支持少样本适配，但用户间及用户内部的多目标梯度冲突会阻碍有效的初始化学习。
AI.method: APO（Approximate Pareto Optimality）：1) 将更新相容的用户分组，降低信息聚合时的相互干扰；2) 组内结合梯度下降与受控上升（controlled ascent）协调竞争目标，逼近 Pareto 前沿上偏好特异的点，得到接近组内用户最优的初始化；3) 利用少样本本地适配的更新迭代精炼初始化。理论上给出一局部步协作更新的条件次优性界，并刻画初始化误差对后续随机适配的影响。
AI.result: 在 Fed-ChatbotPA 与 UltraFeedback 上，仅使用 20 条本地样本即持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 用户分组与 Pareto 导向的梯度协调可有效缓解多目标梯度冲突，学习到支持多样用户偏好少样本适配的对齐器初始化，兼具实证效果与理论保证。

title: On Hyperparameter Tuning on the Test Set
summary: "Don't tune hyperparameters on the test set" is often stated in machine learning textbooks. Violating it is considered a cardinal sin that produces misleadingly optimistic results, corrupts benchmark integrity, and thus can even be interpreted as scientific fraud. Yet evidence suggests that test set hyperparameter tuning does occur in practice, making it all the more important to understand its actual consequences. So how bad is it, really? In this work we question this dogma and put it to an empirical test. We systematically study the magnitude of the performance inflation caused by tuning the hyperparameters on the test set for MNIST-1D, CIFAR-10, and three tasks from the GLUE benchmark. Our experiments show that while the effect is real and significant, it is frequently small relative to other sources of noise. In many cases, we find that tuning on the test set recovers exactly the same model as when tuning on the validation set. Most importantly, we find that the rankings of models remain essentially preserved after tuning on the test set and therefore that consistent test-set tuning may not invalidate benchmarks or model selection. Our results call for a more nuanced view of tuning hyperparameters on the test set, stimulating researchers to openly report test tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文对"在测试集上调超参数是学术不端"这一教条进行实证检验。作者在MNIST-1D、CIFAR-10及GLUE的三个任务上系统研究测试集调参导致的性能膨胀幅度，发现该效应虽真实存在，但常小于其他噪声来源；多数情况下测试集调参选出的模型与验证集调参完全一致，模型排名基本保持不变。作者据此呼吁对测试集调参持更细致、更包容的观点，并鼓励研究者公开报告此类行为。
AI.motivation: 机器学习教材普遍将"在测试集上调超参数"视为严重违规，认为它会产生误导性的乐观结果、破坏基准公正性，甚至可被解读为学术造假。然而有证据表明该做法在实践中确实存在，因此有必要弄清其真实后果："到底有多糟糕？"作者认为现有讨论多为教条式论断，缺乏系统的实证证据，故有必要对这一天条进行实证挑战。
AI.method: 作者设计了系统的实证实验，在多个数据集与任务上进行对比：包括MNIST-1D、CIFAR-10，以及GLUE基准中的三个任务。方法上比较两类调参流程——在验证集上调参与在测试集上调参，并度量由此引发的性能膨胀幅度。同时考察选出的最优模型是否一致、模型排名是否稳定，并将调参带来的性能变化与其他噪声来源的大小进行对比。
AI.result: 结果显示：测试集调参导致的性能膨胀真实且显著，但相对于其他噪声来源而言，其幅度常常很小。在许多情况下，测试集调参选出的模型与验证集调参完全相同。最关键的是，测试集调参后各模型的排名基本保持不变。因此，一致的测试集调参并不会使基准测试或模型选择失效。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张对"测试集调超参数"采取更细致入微的观点，认为不应将其简单定性为学术不端。由于排名基本稳定、效应常被其他噪声掩盖，一致性的测试集调参未必破坏基准有效性。作者进而呼吁研究者公开、透明地报告测试集调参行为，以推动该领域更诚实、更规范的研究实践。

title: CoHyFuse: Condition-wise Hypergraph Fusion with Global Connectome in Task-fMRI
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM 2026)
summary: Task-fMRI connectomes reveal state-dependent neural reconfigurations, yet conventional methods marginalize these signals by aggregating distinct conditions into static pairwise graphs, thereby obscuring condition-specific multi-ROI organization. We introduce CoHyFuse, a condition-aware ROI-centered hypergraph framework that constructs a task-state-specific incidence matrix from condition-wise functional connectivity (FC)-profile embeddings, allowing the same ROI to form different multi-ROI hyperedges across task phases. Condition-specific neighborhood sizes $K_q$ further adapt the hyperedge scale to each task state, and the resulting condition embeddings are fused with a complementary whole-session FC branch for prediction. In the AABC cohort (N=1,074), CoHyFuse achieved the best mean out-of-fold predictive performance among evaluated baselines on FACENAME Fluid Cognition Composite (FCC) prediction (7.83$\pm$0.10 MAE, 0.439$\pm$0.026 \(R^2\)) and VISMOTOR age prediction (7.52$\pm$0.37 MAE, 0.592$\pm$0.022 \(R^2\)). In an auxiliary CMI-HBN attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) classification benchmark (N=223), CoHyFuse obtained 72.0$\pm$2.1\% macro-AUC and 74.2$\pm$2.9\% accuracy. Ablation studies support the contributions of condition-wise incidence construction and dual-view fusion, suggesting that state-resolved ROI-set structure provides complementary predictive information beyond whole-session FC alone. Occlusion analysis identifies the Distraction condition as the primary driver of model prediction, pointing toward the Salience/Ventral Attention Network (SAN)--FrontoParietal Network (FPN) and within-SAN hyperedge-defined ROI-set motifs as candidate model-relevant patterns. This framework provides an interpretable, state-resolved view of the connectome for downstream cohort analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CoHyFuse——一种条件感知、以 ROI 为中心的超图框架，从任务态 fMRI 的条件级 FC 剖面嵌入构建任务状态特异关联矩阵，并通过双视图融合进行预测，在认知与年龄预测及 ADHD 分类基准上均取得最佳表现。
